fields.title: Ng’Omutima Gwe Bwe Gwagala
fields.subtitle: Obukulembeze obw’Omwoyo mu Kkubo lya Yesu
fields.description: Ekitabo ku bukulembeze obw’Omwoyo eri Ekkanisa yonna: abasumba n’abakadde b’ekkanisa, abakulembeze b’ekkanisa ez’omu maka, abadyakoni, abasomesa, abazadde, n’abakkiriza abakulembera ku mirimu. Essuula amakumi ataano mu bitundu kkumi ziyigiriza okuyitibwa kw’omukulembeze, omutima gwe n’obulamu bwe ne Katonda; okulunda ekisibo; okukulembera awamu; okwolesebwa n’omulimu; obulabe obusuula abakulembeze; okukulembera mu bizibu; amaka, omulimu n’okubalibwako; n’okumaliriza obulungi. Buli ssuula ejjudde Ebyawandiikibwa, enyumya emboozi z’abakulembeze okuva mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa ne mu Kkanisa ey’Ensi Yonna, era ekomekkerezebwa n’ebibuuzo n’eky’okukola wiiki eyo.
fields.about_html:
“Ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala,” Katonda bwe yasuubiza ng’ayita mu Yeremiya, “abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera.” Ekitabo kino kyogera ku mukulembeze ow’engeri eyo. Si kitabo kya bukodyo. Kitandikira ku mutima, kubanga Mukama atunuulira omutima, era kiraga Yesu, Omusumba Omulungi, ng’ekyokulabirako eri buli akulembera abantu be, ka kibe kibiina ky’abakkiriza, ekkanisa ey’omu maka, ekibiina ky’abaana, amaka oba ttiimu ku mulimu.

Essuula amakumi ataano ziyita mu bitundu kkumi: Okuyitibwa; Omutima gw’Omukulembeze; Omukulembeze ne Katonda; Okulunda Ekisibo; Okukulembera Awamu; Okwolesebwa n’Omulimu; Obulabe mu Kkubo, okuva ku malala, ssente n’ekibi eky’okwegatta okutuuka ku kukozesa obubi obuyinza n’obuggya; Okukulembera mu Bizibu, okuva ku kiwuubaalo n’okukoowa ennyo okutuuka ku kugwa, okuyigganyizibwa n’emyaka egikwekeddwa; Obulamu bw’Omukulembeze, awaka, ng’oli omu atali mu bufumbo, ku mulimu ne mu kubalibwako; n’Okumaliriza Obulungi. Okufundikira kukuŋŋaanya ekifaananyi ky’omusumba ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala.

Buli ssuula ejjudde Ebyawandiikibwa era eleka abakulembeze okuva mu byasa byonna ne mu nsi yonna okwogera: Polycarp ne Gregory Omukulu, Richard Baxter ne John Wesley, Samuel Ajayi Crowther ne Pandita Ramabai, Amy Carmichael ne Mary Slessor, Hudson Taylor, Watchman Nee, Josephine Bakhita n’abakulembeze b’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba, n’abalala bangi. Buli emu ekomekkerezebwa n’ebibuuzo eby’okufumiitirizaako n’eky’okukola kimu mu wiiki. Abakristaayo abeesigwa we batakkiriziganya, gamba ku ngeri ekkanisa gy’efugibwamu oba ku bakazi mu bifo by’obukulembeze mu kkanisa, ekitabo kinnyonnyola endowooza enkulu mu bwenkanya. Ebyongerezeddwako bisatu binnyonnyola engeri ekkanisa gye zikulemberwamu, biwa omukulembeze ebibuuzo eby’okwekebera, era biwa enteekateeka ez’okutendeka abakulembeze, ate Amakulu g’Ebigambo ganyonnyola ebigambo omukulembeze omuggya by’ayinza obutamanya. Mu nkyusa eno ey’Oluganda, Ebyawandiikibwa bijuliziddwa okuva mu Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (© Biblica, CC BY-SA 4.0).

qa.question: Ekitabo Ng’Omutima Gwe Bwe Gwagala kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kitabo ku bukulembeze obw’Omwoyo mu kkubo lya Yesu. Omutwe gwakyo guva mu kisuubizo kya Katonda mu Yeremiya 3:15: “Ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala.” Kiyigiriza omukulembeze Omukristaayo ky’asaanidde okuba, engeri y’okulabirira abantu ba Katonda, obulabe bw’alina okwegendereza, n’engeri y’okumaliriza obulungi.

qa.question: Ekitabo Ng’Omutima Gwe Bwe Gwagala kyawandiikirwa baani?
qa.answer: Kya buli muntu akulembera abantu ba Katonda mu ngeri yonna: abasumba, abakadde b’ekkanisa n’abadyakoni, abakulembeze b’ekkanisa ez’omu maka n’ab’ebibinja ebitono, abasomesa b’essomero lya Ssande, abakulembeze b’abavubuka n’ab’abakazi, abaminsani, abazadde, n’abakkiriza abakulembera ku mirimu oba mu bantu. Kyawandiikibwa nga balowooza ku kkanisa ezikula amangu mu Afirika, mu Asiya ne mu Latin America, era kya bakulembeze abaggya awamu n’abo abalina obumanyirivu.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kisaanira omukulembeze omuggya?
qa.answer: Yee. Ennyanjula eraga omukulembeze omuggya w’ayinza okutandikira, olulimi lukuumiddwa nga lwangu, okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku bibuuzo Abakristaayo bye batakkiriziganyaako kuteereddwako akabonero “Okugenda mu Buziba” era kuyinza okulinda, ate Amakulu g’Ebigambo ku nkomerero ganyonnyola ebigambo ebitamanyiddwa.

qa.question: Buli ssuula etegekeddwa etya?
qa.answer: Buli ssuula etandika n’Ekyawandiikibwa ekikulu, eyigiriza okuva mu bitundu bingi ebya Bayibuli, eleka omukulembeze omu oba okusingawo okuva mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa oba mu Kkanisa ey’Ensi Yonna okwogera mu bigambo byabwe, era ekomekkerezebwa n’ebibuuzo eby’okufumiitirizaako n’eky’okukola kimu eky’omugaso mu wiiki eddako.

qa.question: Ekitabo Ng’Omutima Gwe Bwe Gwagala kiyinza okukozesebwa okutendeka abakulembeze mu kibinja?
qa.answer: Yee. Ekyongerezeddwako C kiwa enteekateeka bbiri: kkoosi ey’enkuŋŋaana kkumi ezizimbiddwa ku ssuula enkulu, n’enteekateeka ya wiiki amakumi ataano eyita mu kitabo kyonna, wamu n’obulagirizi ku ngeri y’okukulemberamu olukuŋŋaana n’okutendeka abalala okukulembera ebibinja nabo. Ekyongerezeddwako B kiwa ebibuuzo eby’okwekebera ku buli kimu ku bitundu ekkumi.

qa.question: Ekitabo kikwata kitya ebibuuzo Abakristaayo bye batakkiriziganyaako?
qa.answer: Abakristaayo abeesigwa we baawukana, gamba ku ngeri ekkanisa gy’efugibwamu, ku kubatizibwa mu Mwoyo, ku kuzuukuka, oba ku bakazi mu bifo by’obukulembeze mu kkanisa, kiraga endowooza enkulu mu bwenkanya, n’oluvannyuma ne kituuka ku ebyo bonna bye bakkiriziganyaako. Ekyongerezeddwako A kinnyonnyola enfuga ey’abalabirizi, ey’abakadde n’ey’ekibiina awatali kwekubira ludda.

qa.question: Bayibuli ki ekozesebwa?
qa.answer: Mu nkyusa eno ey’Oluganda, buli Kyawandiikibwa kijuliziddwa okuva mu Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (© Biblica, CC BY-SA 4.0), Bayibuli ey’Oluganda ey’omulembe guno.

fields.title: Ennyanjula: Ng’Omutima Gwe Bwe Gwagala
fields.body_html:
“Era ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala, abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera.”

— Yeremiya 3:15

Leero, awantu awamu, waliwo omukazi aggulawo ennyumba ye entono okuyigirizaamu Bayibuli. Omuvubuka ayimiridde mu maaso g’ekibiina ky’abavubuka omulundi gwe ogusooka, ng’emikono gye gikankana. Omulimi, era nga mukadde w’ekkanisa, atambula okulambula muliraanwa we omulwadde ng’enjuba tennaba kwokya. Omusumba atafuna musaala ayera wansi mu kkanisa ezimbiddwa mu mabaati. Maama asaba wamu n’abaana be nga tebannagenda ku ssomero. Omukkiriza mu ofiisi asalawo oba anaateeka omukono ku lipoota gy’amanyi nti ya bulimba. Buli omu ku bano mukulembeze. Buli omu ku bano abumba obulamu bw’abantu abalala, oba ku lw’obulungi oba ku lw’obubi.

Ekitabo kino kyabwe. Kya basumba n’abakadde b’ekkanisa, abadyakoni n’abasomesa, abaminsani n’abakulembeze b’abavubuka, abakulembeze b’ebibinja ebitono n’abasomesa b’essomero lya Ssande. Era kya bazadde, n’abakkiriza abakulembera mu bizinensi, mu ssomero, mu ddwaliro oba mu ofiisi ya gavumenti. Bwe wabaawo akugoberera, akuwuliriza oba ayiga okuva gy’oli, oli mukulembeze, era Katonda afaayo ku ngeri gy’okulemberamu.

Lwaki ekitabo ekirala ku bukulembeze?

Waliwo ebitabo bingi ku bukulembeze. Ebisinga obungi biwandiikirwa bya bizinensi. Biyigiriza ebintu eby’omugaso: engeri y’okuteekateeka, engeri y’okukozesa obudde, engeri y’okuzimba ttiimu. Naye emirundi egisinga bipima omukulembeze okusinziira ku bivudde mu mulimu gwe. Kampuni yakula? Emiwendo gyalinnya? Abantu baakola by’obadde oyagala?

Bayibuli epima abakulembeze mu ngeri endala. Katonda bwe yagaana Sawulo okuba kabaka wa Isirayiri, Samwiri yamugamba nti, “Mukama anoonyezzaayo omusajja alina omutima ogumunoonya” (1 Samwiri 13:14). Samwiri bwe yagenda okufuka amafuta ku kabaka eyali addako, yasikirizibwa omuwanvu asinga mu batabani ba Yese. Naye Katonda n’amugamba nti, “Mukama tatunuulira ebyo abantu bye batunuulira. Abantu batunuulira bya kungulu naye Mukama atunuulira bya mu mutima” (1 Samwiri 16:7). Omusajja Katonda gwe yalonda ye yali omwana omuto mu bonna, eyali ku ttale ng’alunda endiga.

Oluvannyuma lw’ebyasa bingi, abantu ba Katonda bwe baali bamaze ebbanga ddene nga bakulemberwa bubi, Katonda yabasuubiza ekisuubizo ng’ayita mu nnabbi Yeremiya: “Era ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala, abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera” (Yeremiya 3:15). Ekisuubizo ekyo kye kiwadde ekitabo kino erinnya lyakyo. Katonda tasooka kunoonya bakulembeze bagezigezi, ab’amaanyi oba abaagalibwa abantu. Anoonya abakulembeze abalina emitima egifaanana n’omutima gwe. Okumanya n’obukugu bikulu, era ekitabo kino kijja kuyigiriza ebintu bingi eby’okukola. Naye bimera okuva mu mutima. Omukulembeze alina obukugu bungi naye ng’omutima gwe mukyamu asobola okukola akabi kanene. Omukulembeze alina omutima omutuufu naye ng’obukugu bwe butono asobola okuyiga, era Katonda alimukozesa.

Ekitabo ky’Ekkanisa yonna

Kati Abakristaayo abasinga obungi mu nsi bali mu Afirika, mu Asiya ne mu Latin Amerika. Ekkanisa zaabwe nnyingi zikulemberwa abasumba n’abakadde abatasomangako mu ttendekero lya Bayibuli. Bangi ku bo bakola omulimu omulala mu wiiki okuliisa amaka gaabwe. Bangi bakulembera mu bifo Abakristaayo gye bali abaavu, oba abatono, oba abayigganyizibwa. Tebeetaaga kitabo ekiteebereza nti waliwo ekizimbe ekinene, abakozi abasasulwa n’embalirira ennene. Beetaaga Bayibuli, n’amagezi g’Abakristaayo abaatambula mu kkubo lino nga bo tebannaba.

Noolwekyo ekitabo kino kiggya amagezi mu Kkanisa yonna, mu byasa byonna ne mu nsi yonna. Ojja kusisinkana Gregory, omulabirizi w’e Rooma awo nga mu mwaka AD 600, eyawandiika ekimu ku bitabo ebyasooka ku kulabirira emyoyo. Ojja kusisinkana Augustine ow’omu Bukiikakkono bwa Afirika, Chrysostom ow’e Antiyokiya, ne Polycarp, eyayigira ku mutume Yokaana. Ojja kusisinkana Samuel Ajayi Crowther, omulenzi Omuyoruba eyawonyezebwa okuva ku lyato ly’abaddu, n’afuuka omulabirizi Omufirika eyasooka mu Kkanisa ya Anglican. Ojja kusisinkana Pandita Ramabai ow’e Buyindi, abakulembeze b’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba, abasumba mu China, n’abaatandikawo ekkanisa ez’Abaddugavu ezaasooka mu Amerika. Bingi ku bitabo byabwe n’ebbaluwa zaabwe osobola okubisoma ku bwereere ku Ochorus. Bwe tunaabajuliza, tujja kukubuulira w’osobola okubisanga.

Era twagala ekitabo kino kibe kyangu okuvvuunulwa, kubanga kiwandiikiddwa Ekkanisa yonna mu nnimi nnyingi. Kyetuvudde tugezaako okuwandiika mu ngeri ennyangu, mu sentensi ennyimpi, n’okunnyonnyola buli kigambo omusomi omupya ky’ayinza obutamanya. Amakulu g’Ebigambo agali ku nkomerero y’ekitabo (Essuula 56) ganyonnyola ebigambo nga omukadde w’ekkanisa, omulabirizi, omudyakoni n’okuyawulibwa olw’obuweereza.

Olugendo oluli mu maaso

Ekitabo kirimu ebitundu kkumi, era buli kitundu kirimu essuula ttaano.

  • Ekitundu Ekisooka: Okuyitibwa kibuuza obukulembeze obw’omwoyo kye ki, era ani atuyita okubukola. Tutunuulira Yesu Omusumba Omukulu, engeri Katonda gy’ayitamu abakulembeze, ekiremba n’ebbensani eby’obukulembeze obuweereza, n’engeri y’obuyinza omukulembeze ow’omwoyo bw’alina.
  • Ekitundu eky’Okubiri: Omutima gw’Omukulembeze kitunuulira empisa: obwetoowaze, obwesigwa, okwekuuma mu mwoyo gwo, okwagala n’obuvumu.
  • Ekitundu eky’Okusatu: Omukulembeze ne Katonda kidda ku bulamu obw’omu kyama obuliisa obulamu obwa lwatu: okusaba, Ekigambo, Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okuwummula, n’okunoonya obulagirizi bwa Katonda.
  • Ekitundu eky’Okuna: Okulunda Ekisibo kyogera ku mulimu gwa buli lunaku ogw’okulabirira abantu: okuyigiriza, okumanya buli muntu, okunoonya abaabula, okunenya n’okuzzaawo, n’okubudaabuda ababonaabona.
  • Ekitundu eky’Okutaano: Okukulembera Awamu kiraga nti tewali n’omu asaanidde kukulembera yekka. Kyogera ku bukulembeze obugabanibwa, okutendeka abakulembeze abapya, obumu, okugonjoola enkaayana, n’abasajja n’abakazi okuweereza awamu.
  • Ekitundu eky’Omukaaga: Okwolesebwa n’Omulimu kitunula ebweru: okulaba Katonda by’alaba, okuteekateeka n’amagezi, okutuuka ku mawanga, okulabirira abaavu, n’okukulembera mu biseera eby’okuzuukuka n’enkyukakyuka.
  • Ekitundu eky’Omusanvu: Obulabe mu Kkubo kyogera mu lwatu ku bikemo ebizikiriza abakulembeze: amalala, ssente, ekibi ky’obwenzi, okukozesa obubi obuyinza, n’obuggya n’okusosola.
  • Ekitundu eky’Omunaana: Okukulembera mu Bizibu kitambula naawe mu kiwuubaalo, mu kukoowa ennyo, mu kugwa, mu kuyigganyizibwa ne mu myaka egikwekeddwa egy’okulinda.
  • Ekitundu eky’Omwenda: Obulamu bw’Omukulembeze kidda ku maka g’omukulembeze, ku kubeera omu nga toli mu bufumbo, ku kulabirira omubiri gwo n’obudde bwo, ku kukulembera ku mulimu, ne ku kubalibwako.
  • Ekitundu eky’Ekkumi: Okumaliriza Obulungi kitunuulira enkomerero: okukwasa abalala omulimu, okulekawo ebirekebwawo, okukaddiwa mu mulimu, okuwa Kristo embalirira, n’olunaku Omusumba Omukulu lw’alirabika.

Oluvannyuma lw’Okufundikira waliwo ebyongerezeddwako bisatu. Ekyongerezeddwako A (Essuula 53) kinnyonnyola engeri enkulu ekkanisa gye zikulemberwamu n’okufugibwamu. Ekyongerezeddwako B (Essuula 54) kiwa ebibuuzo omukulembeze by’ayinza okukozesa okwekebera obulamu bwe. Ekyongerezeddwako C (Essuula 55) kiraga engeri y’okukozesa ekitabo kino okutendeka ekibinja ky’abakulembeze. Amakulu g’Ebigambo (Essuula 56) ge gasembayo.

Engeri y’okusomamu ekitabo kino

Buli ssuula egoberera enteekateeka y’emu. Etandika n’olunyiriri lw’Ekyawandiikibwa. Eyigiriza okuva mu Bayibuli wansi w’emitwe emitono. Oluvannyuma enyumya ku bulamu bw’omusajja oba omukazi wa Katonda omu, oba ereeta ekitundu ku bbaluwa gye yawandiika, wansi w’omutwe “Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa”. Ekomekkerezebwa n’ebibuuzo eby’okufumiitirizaako n’eky’okukola kimu eky’omugaso mu wiiki eddako.

Osobola okusoma ekitabo kino mu ngeri ssatu.

  • Ng’oli wekka. Soma essuula emu buli wiiki, mpola mpola. Noonya ebitundu bya Bayibuli ebyogerwako. Wandiika by’oddamu mu bibuuzo. Kola eky’okukola kya wiiki.
  • N’omuluŋŋamya. Saba Omukristaayo akusinga obukulu n’amagezi akisome naawe. Musisinkane omulundi gumu buli wiiki okwogera ku ssuula emu. Beera mwesimbu gy’ali ku bibuuzo ebikukaluubirira.
  • Mu kibinja ky’abakulembeze. Ekkanisa nnyingi zisobola okukozesa ekitabo kino okutendeka abakadde baazo, abadyakoni n’abakulembeze b’ebibinja awamu. Buli ssuula mpimpi ekimala olukuŋŋaana lumu. Ekyongerezeddwako C (Essuula 55) kiwa enteekateeka y’omusomo gwa wiiki kkumi n’ogw’omwaka mulamba.

Essuula ezimu zirimu ekitundu ekimpi ekiyitibwa “Okugenda mu Buziba”. Ebitundu bino byogera ku bibuuzo Abakristaayo abeesigwa bye batakkaanyaako, ng’engeri ekkanisa gy’esaanidde okufugibwamu. Tulaga endowooza enkulu mu bwenkanya nga bwe tusobola. Bw’oba ng’okyali mupya mu kukulembera, osobola okubibuuka n’obikomawo oluvannyuma.

Oli mupya mu kukulembera? Tandikira wano

Oboolyawo waakasabibwa okukulembera ekintu omulundi gwo ogusooka. Oboolyawo tokakasa nti weetegese. Eyo ntandikwa nnungi, kubanga tewali muntu yeetegeka ku bubwe. Bw’oba tomanyi w’otandikira, soma essuula zino ennya okusooka.

  1. Essuula 2, Ekifuula Obukulembeze Okuba obw’Omwoyo. Ennyonnyola ekitabo kino kye kitegeeza ku bukulembeze, era lwaki buli mukkiriza alina gw’akulembera.
  2. Essuula 5, Ekiremba n’Ebbensani. Eraga engeri Yesu gye yakulemberamu, ng’aweereza.
  3. Essuula 7, Obwetoowaze. Ennyonnyola endowooza ekuuma omukulembeze obutatuukibwako kabi.
  4. Essuula 12, Okusaba Okusooka. Eraga amaanyi g’omukulembeze gye gava.

Oluvannyuma komawo osome ekitabo okuva ku ntandikwa. Toweeraliikirira bwe wabaawo essuula ezirabika ng’ezoogera ku mulimu munene nnyo okusinga ogugwo. Omusumba y’omu y’akulembera ekkanisa ey’omu maka mu kyalo ne lutikko ey’omu kibuga, era emisingi gye gimu gikola ku byombi.

Maapu ennyimpi ey’ebyafaayo by’Ekkanisa

Ojja kusisinkana abantu ab’omu byasa bingi mu kitabo kino. Maapu eno ennyimpi ejja kukuyamba okumanya buli omu we yabeerera.

  • Ekkanisa eyasooka (awo nga AD 30 okutuuka ku 500). Abatume n’abakulembeze abaasooka okubaddirira, nga Clement ow’e Rooma, Ignatius ow’e Antiyokiya ne Polycarp ow’e Sumuna. Oluvannyuma, abasomesa abakulu ab’omu Bukiikakkono bwa Afirika n’okwetooloola Ennyanja Meditereniyani, nga Cyprian, Athanasius, Augustine ne John Chrysostom. Ekitundu ekinene eky’Ekkanisa kyayigganyizibwanga okutuusa ku ntandikwa y’emyaka gya 300.
  • Ekkanisa ey’omu Byasa eby’Omu Makkati (awo nga 500 okutuuka ku 1500). Abakulembeze nga Gregory Omukulu, Bernard ow’e Clairvaux ne Catherine ow’e Siena. Ennyumba z’abamonaki zaakuuma Ebyawandiikibwa nga biramu era ne zisindika abaminsani.
  • Okuzza Obuggya (emyaka gya 1500). Martin Luther, John Calvin n’abalala baakoowoola Ekkanisa okudda eri Bayibuli n’eri obulokozi olw’ekisa okuyita mu kukkiriza.
  • Abapuritaani n’okuzuukuka (emyaka gya 1600 ne 1700). Abasumba nga Richard Baxter, n’ababuulizi nga John Wesley ne George Whitefield, Katonda be yayitamu enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu ne bajja mu kukkiriza.
  • Omulembe gw’obuminsani mu nsi yonna (emyaka gya 1800 n’entandikwa y’emyaka gya 1900). Abaminsani nga William Carey ne Hudson Taylor, era, ekikulu kyenkanyi, abakulembeze abakulu abaasooka ab’ekkanisa ze baayamba okusimba, nga Samuel Ajayi Crowther mu Nigeria ne Pandita Ramabai mu Buyindi.
  • Ekkanisa ey’ensi yonna leero. Okuva ku Kuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba okutuuka ku kkanisa ez’omu maka eza China, amakkati g’ensi y’Ekikristaayo gasenguse ne gadda mu bukiikaddyo n’ebuvanjuba. Kati Ekkanisa ddala ffamire eva mu buli ggwanga.

Ekisa kisooka

Ekintu kimu ekirala nga tetunnatandika. Ekitabo kino kijja kukusoomooza. Kijja kukubuuza ebibuuzo ebizibu ku mutima gwo, ku bigendererwa byo, ku maka go, ku ssente zo, ne ku ngeri gy’okozesaamu obuyinza. Essuula ezimu ziyinza okukuwulizisa nti tosaanidde kukulembera n’akatono.

Bw’owulira bw’otyo, jjukira kino: tewali mukulembeze n’omu mu Bayibuli eyali asaanidde ku bubwe. Musa yali yatta omuntu. Dawudi yayenda era n’atta. Peetero yeegaana Yesu emirundi esatu. Pawulo yali ayigganyizza Ekkanisa. Buli omu ku bo yali mwonoonyi eyalokolebwa olw’ekisa era n’akuumibwa olw’ekisa. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “obwesige bwaffe buva eri Katonda” (2 Abakkolinso 3:5).

Obukulembeze obw’omwoyo tebutandikira ku bye tukolera Katonda. Butandikira ku Katonda bye yatukolera mu Yesu Kristo. Ye musumba omulungi eyawaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga (Yokaana 10:11). Buli omu ku ffe yali endiga eyabula gye yasitula n’agikomyawo eka. Tukulembera abalala kubanga ye yasooka okutukulembera, era tukulembera bulungi nga bwe tweyongera okumugoberera.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Baani abantu b’okulembera, awaka, mu kkanisa, ku mulimu oba mu kitundu kyo? Wandiika amannya gaabwe.
  • Lowooza ku mukulembeze eyakuyamba okumanya Katonda obulungi. Kiki ku ye ekyaleeta enjawulo?
  • Bw’owulira ekigambo “omukulembeze”, kifaananyi ki ekijja mu birowoozo byo? Kigeraageranyizibwa kitya n’abasumba Katonda be yasuubiza, “abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala” (Yeremiya 3:15)?
  • Ekitundu ki ku bitundu ekkumi eby’ekitabo kino ky’osinga okwetaaga kati, era lwaki?
  • Owulira ng’oli mwetegefu okukulembera, oba nedda? 2 Abakkolinso 3:5 ekugamba ki?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wandiika amannya g’abantu b’okulembera ku kapapula akatono, ne bwe baba babiri oba basatu bokka. Kakuume mu Bayibuli yo. Buli lunaku mu wiiki eno, saba ku lwa buli muntu ng’omwogera erinnya. Saba Katonda akuwe omutima ng’ogugwe gye bali. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, weetegereze oba okubasabira kukyusizza engeri gy’obalabamu.

study_questions.question: Kitegeeza ki okuba omusumba akola ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala?
study_questions.answer: Kitegeeza okukulembera nga Katonda yennyini bw’akulembera abantu be: n’okwagala, n’amazima n’okufaayo, so si ku lw’okwefunira. Katonda yasuubiza nti, “Era ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala, abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera” (Yeremiya 3:15). Omutima gwe gusooka, kubanga “Mukama tatunuulira ebyo abantu bye batunuulira” (1 Samwiri 16:7).

study_questions.question: Ekitabo kino eky’obukulembeze obw’omwoyo kyawandiikirwa baani?
study_questions.answer: Kyawandiikirwa buli muntu akulembera abantu ba Katonda mu ngeri yonna: abasumba n’abakadde b’ekkanisa, abakulembeze b’ekkanisa ez’omu maka, abadyakoni, abasomesa b’essomero lya Ssande, abakulembeze b’abavubuka n’ab’abakazi, abazadde, n’abakkiriza abakulembera ku mulimu. Kyawandiikirwa Ekkanisa yonna ey’ensi yonna, era abakulembeze abapya baweereddwa ekkubo eddimpi mu kitabo kino okutandikirako.

study_questions.question: Nnina okuba n’ebirabo oba obumanyirivu okusobola okukulembera mu kkanisa?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Obukulembeze butandikira ku kisa kya Katonda, so si ku busobozi bwaffe. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “obwesige bwaffe buva eri Katonda” (2 Abakkolinso 3:5). Katonda ayita abantu ab’abulijjo, abumba emitima gyabwe era abawa bye beetaaga, noolwekyo omukulembeze omupya asobola okutandika ng’amwesigama.

fields.title: Ekifuula Obukulembeze Okuba obw’Omwoyo
fields.body_html:
“Naye tekisaanye kuba bwe kityo mu mmwe. Buli ayagala okubeera omukulu mu mmwe, abeerenga muweereza wa banne.”

— Matayo 20:26

Kuba akafaananyi k’abakulembeze babiri mu kibuga kye kimu. Ow’olubereberye ye musajja asinga obuyinza mu disitulikiti. Abantu bayimirira bw’ayingira mu kisenge. Tewali amuwakanya. Bw’ayagala ekintu kikolebwe, kikolebwa mangu, kubanga abantu batya ekiyinza okubaawo singa tekikolebwa. Ow’okubiri ye mukazi omukadde akulembera ekibinja ekitono eky’okusaba mu maka ge. Talina kitiibwa kya bwakulu era talina ssente. Naye bamaama abato bwe baba mu buzibu, bagenda gy’ali. Enkaayana bw’ezuuka mu kkanisa, abantu babuuza ky’alowooza. Bw’asaba, abantu bakkiriza nti Katonda awulira.

Ani ku bombi mukulembeze? Mu ngeri emu, bombi bakulembeze. Buli omu abumba obulamu bw’abantu abalala. Naye omu yekka y’akulembera mu ngeri Yesu gye yayigiriza. Essuula eno ebuuza ekifuula obukulembeze okuba obw’omwoyo. Eky’okuddamu si kitiibwa kya bwakulu, si kizimbe era si kibiina kinene ky’abantu. Kintu kya buziba okusingawo.

Obukulembeze kye ki?

Mu ngeri ennyangu ddala, obukulembeze kwe kusobola okukwata ku bantu abalala. Omukulembeze ye muntu ebigambo bye, by’asalawo n’ekyokulabirako kye bikyusa abantu abalala. Abakulembeze abamu balina ebitiibwa: omusumba, omukadde w’ekkanisa, omulabirizi, dayirekita, omwami. Bangi tebabirina. Taata akulembera abaana be. Mwannyinaffe omukulu akulembera baganda be abato. Omukozi agaana okukumpanya akulembera abo b’akola nabo, k’abe nga akimanyi oba nedda.

Kino kitegeeza nti kumpi buli Mukristaayo alina gw’akulembera. Oyinza obutakulembera kkanisa, naye oyinza okukulembera amaka, ekibiina ky’abayizi, ttiimu mu dduuka oba mu nnimiro, oba ekibinja ky’emikwano. Ekibuuzo si kya kuba nti onookwata ku bantu abalala oba nedda. Kino okikola dda. Ekibuuzo kiri nti obatwala wa, era otya.

Bayibuli etwala okukulembera ng’ekirabo okuva eri Katonda. Pawulo bw’abala ebimu ku birabo Katonda by’awa abantu be, ayogera ku “omulala, okufuga n’obunyiikivu” (Abaruumi 12:8). Era agamba nti, “Omuntu yenna bw’ayagalanga okuba Omulabirizi aba yeegombye omulimu omulungi” (1 Timoseewo 3:1). Si kibi okwagala okukulembera. Mulimu mulungi. Naye olw’okuba mulimu mulungi, gulina okukolebwa mu ngeri ya Katonda.

“Tekisaanye kuba bwe kityo mu mmwe”

Lumu nnyina wa Yakobo ne Yokaana yajja eri Yesu ne batabani be bombi. Yamusaba abawe ebifo ebibiri ebisinga obulungi mu bwakabaka bwe, omu ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo n’omulala ku gwa kkono. Abayigirizwa abalala ekkumi bwe baakiwulira, ne basunguwala. Oboolyawo baasunguwala kubanga nabo baali baagala ebifo ebyo.

Yesu n’abayita bonna awamu n’abagamba nti: “Mumanyi ng’abakulembeze b’abamawanga babazitoowereza embeera, n’abakulu baabwe babafuza lyanyi. Naye tekisaanye kuba bwe kityo mu mmwe. Buli ayagala okubeera omukulu mu mmwe, abeerenga muweereza wa banne. Na buli ayagala okuba omwami mu mmwe aweerezenga banne ng’omuddu waabwe” (Matayo 20:25-27).

Yesu teyagaana nti abayigirizwa bandikulembedde. Yali abatendeka okukulembera Ekkanisa ye. Naye yassaawo olusalosalo olweyolefu wakati w’ebika by’obukulembeze bibiri. Mu kika ekisooka, omukulembeze ali waggulu era abantu gye bali okuweereza omukulembeze. Mu kika eky’okubiri, omukulembeze gy’ali okuweereza abantu. Yesu yagamba nti, “Naye tekisaanye kuba bwe kityo mu mmwe.” Ebigambo ebyo, nti si bwe kityo bwe kiba mu mmwe, gwe mutima gw’ekitabo kino kyonna.

Awo Yesu ne yeetunuulira yennyini: “Mube nga Omwana w’Omuntu atajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi” (Matayo 20:28). Omukulembeze asinga obukulu eyali abaddewo teyalagira balala kumuweereza. Ye yabaweereza, okutuuka ku musaalaba.

Obubonero buna obw’obukulembeze obw’omwoyo

Kale, kiki ekifuula obukulembeze okuba obw’omwoyo? Tekimala omukulembeze okuba Omukristaayo, oba omulimu okukolerwa mu kkanisa. Omusumba asobola okukulembera mu ngeri ey’ensi, n’omukkiriza mu bizinensi asobola okukulembera mu ngeri ey’omwoyo. Bino bye bubonero buna.

1. Buva eri Katonda. Obukulembeze obw’omwoyo butandikira ku kuyitibwa kwa Katonda n’ebirabo bya Katonda, so si ku kwegomba kwaffe. Yesu yagamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Si mmwe mwannonda! Wabula Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala ate ebibala eby’olubeerera” (Yokaana 15:16). Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo amanyi nti akulembera kubanga Katonda ye yamuteeka mu kifo ekyo, era nti asobola okukulembera obulungi ng’akozesa amaanyi Katonda g’awa gokka. Peetero yawandiika nti, “ayamba, akikolenga n’amaanyi gonna Katonda g’amuwadde” (1 Peetero 4:11). Tujja kutunuulira okuyitibwa kwa Katonda mu Ssuula 4.

2. Kye kigendererwa kya Katonda kye bugoberera. Omukulembeze ow’ensi abuuza nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuleetera abantu okukola bye njagala?” Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo abuuza nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuyamba abantu okufuuka Katonda by’ayagala babeere?” Pawulo yannyonnyola ekigendererwa kye bw’ati: “Kristo oyo gwe tutegeeza nga tuyigiriza buli muntu mu magezi gonna era nga tulabula buli omu, tulyoke twanjule buli muntu eri Katonda ng’atuukiridde mu Kristo” (Abakkolosaayi 1:28). Ekigendererwa si kibinja kinene okusingawo, si linnya lya ttutumu era si pulojekiti ewangula. Ebyo biyinza okujja, naye ekigendererwa bantu abamanyi Katonda, abaagala Katonda era abafuuka nga Kristo.

3. Bukozesa amakubo ga Katonda. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo takozesa buli ngeri ekola. Tayogera bulimba, tatiisatiisa, tawaanawaana bwereere era takozesa bantu mu nkwe, ne bwe kiba ku lw’ensonga ennungi. Akulembera ng’aweereza, ng’ayogera amazima mu kwagala, ng’alaga ekyokulabirako, ng’asaba era ng’eyeesigama ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Peetero yagamba abakadde b’ekkanisa nti, “Be mukulembera temubakambuwaliranga wabula mubakulemberenga nga mubalaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi” (1 Peetero 5:3). Engeri gye tukulemberamu ekulu eri Katonda nga bw’ekulu gye tutwala abantu.

4. Bukolebwa mu maaso ga Katonda. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo amanyi nti alibalibwa Katonda olw’abantu b’akulembera. Ebbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya egamba nti abakulembeze, “obuweereza bwabwe kwe kulabirira emyoyo gyammwe” (Abaebbulaniya 13:17), era nti balibaako kye baddamu ku lw’emyoyo egyo. Kino kirowoozo ekikankanya, naye era kiwa eddembe. Omukulembeze abeera mu maaso ga Katonda teyeetaaga kusanyusa buli muntu. Yeetaaga kubeera mwesigwa eri Oyo eyamuyita. Tujja kukomawo ku kino mu Ssuula 50, Okuwa Embalirira.

Ebika by’abakulembeze bibiri

Kiyinza okuyamba okuteeka ebika by’obukulembeze ebibiri kinnakimu ku bbali w’ekinnaakyo. Bino si mateeka, wabula bifaananyi ebikuyamba okulaba enjawulo.

  • Omukulembeze ow’ensi akubirizibwa kwegomba. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo akubirizibwa kuyitibwa kwa Katonda.
  • Omukulembeze ow’ensi yeesiga ebirabo bye. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo yeesigama ku Katonda.
  • Omukulembeze ow’ensi ayagala okuweerezebwa. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo ayagala okuweereza.
  • Omukulembeze ow’ensi akozesa abantu okutuuka ku kigendererwa. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo alaba abantu nga be kigendererwa.
  • Omukulembeze ow’ensi ayagala okulabibwa. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo ayagala Kristo y’alabibwe.
  • Omukulembeze ow’ensi aleetera abantu okumwesigamako. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo ayamba abantu okwesigama ku Katonda, era atendeka abalala okukulembera.
  • Omukulembeze ow’ensi yeenyigiriza eri ekibiina ky’abantu. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo yeenyigiriza eri Katonda.

Beera mwesimbu ng’osoma olukalala luno. Abasinga obungi ku ffe tulaba ekitundu ku bika byombi eby’abakulembeze mu ffe ffennyini. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki twetaaga ekisa kya Katonda, era lwaki obukulembeze obw’omwoyo bulamu bwa kukula, so si kifo kye tutuukamu omulundi gumu ne kiggwa.

Omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa n’emikono egy’amagezi

Emirundi mingi Bayibuli egeraageranya abakulembeze n’abasumba. Kino kifaananyi abantu mu bitundu bingi eby’ensi kye bakyategeera obulungi. Omusumba abeera wamu n’endiga. Azitwala mu muddo ne ku mazzi. Azikuuma ku nsolo enkambwe. Anoonya ezo eziba zibuze. Asitula ezo ennafu. Mulimu gwa bwetoowaze, gukooya, era emirundi mingi gwa kiwuubaalo.

Kabaka Dawudi yatandika obulamu bwe ng’omusumba. Emu ku zabbuli ennyonnyola engeri Katonda gye yamuggya mu kulabirira endiga n’amuteeka okulabirira eggwanga: “N’abalabirira n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa, n’abakulembera n’amagezi g’emikono gye” (Zabbuli 78:72).

Weetegereze ebintu ebibiri mu lunyiriri olwo: omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa n’amagezi g’emikono. Byombi bikulu. Omukulembeze alina omutima omulungi naye nga talina bukugu ayinza okwagala abantu naye n’abakulembera bubi. Ayinza obutateekateeka n’akatono, obutayigiriza mu ngeri etegeerekeka, obutagonjoola bizibu, ekisibo ne kibonaabona. Omukulembeze alina obukugu bungi naye ng’omutima gwe gulimu obukuusa wa bulabe n’okusingawo. Ayinza okuzimba ekintu ekyewuunyisa, naye ajja kukozesa abantu era ku nkomerero ajja kubalumya.

Katonda ayagala byombi. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki ekitabo kino kirimu essuula ku mpisa ne ku kusaba, era n’essuula ku kuyigiriza, ku kuteekateeka, ku ttiimu ne ku kugonjoola enkaayana. Naye weetegereze ensengeka. Omutima gwe gusooka. Obukugu busobola okuyigibwa mu myezi mitono oba mu myaka. Omutima ogukola nga Katonda bw’ayagala gubumbibwa mu bulamu bwonna obw’okutambula naye.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Gregory Omukulu

Mu mwaka 590, omusajja ayitibwa Gregory yalondebwa okuba omulabirizi w’e Rooma. Mu kiseera ekyo Rooma kyali kibuga ekyonooneddwa. Amataba gaali gazikirizza amaterekero g’emmere. Kawumpuli yali asse omulabirizi eyasooka. Amagye g’abalabe gaali gatiisatiisa ekibuga, era abantu baali baavu era nga batidde. Gregory teyayagala mulimu ogwo. Yali awaddeyo obugagga bw’ab’ewaabwe okutandikawo ennyumba z’abamonaki, era yali ayagala okumala obulamu bwe mu kusaba ne mu kusoma. Yawandiikira n’omufuzi w’obwakabaka ng’amusaba aleme kukakasa kulondebwa okwo. Naye abantu ne balemerako, Gregory n’akkiriza.

Mangu ddala oluvannyuma, omulabirizi omulala yawandiikira Gregory n’amunenya mu bukkakkamu olw’okugezaako okwewala obuvunaanyizibwa obwo. Gregory yamuddamu n’ekitabo, ekyamanyibwa nga The Book of Pastoral Rule (Ekitabo ky’Obulagirizi bw’Abasumba). Kye kimu ku bitabo ebyasooka okuwandiikibwa ku ngeri y’okukulembera n’okulabirira abantu ba Katonda, era okumala ebyasa bingi oluvannyuma, abalabirizi mu bitundu bingi ebya Bulaaya baaweebwanga kopi yaakyo nga batandika omulimu gwabwe. Kitandika n’ebigambo bino:

“Tewali muntu yeetulinkiriza kuyigiriza bukugu nga tasoose kubuyiga ng’afumiitiriza nnyo. Kale bujoozi bwa ngeri ki, abatalina bukugu okwetwalira obuyinza bw’obusumba, okuva okufuga emyoyo bwe bukugu obusinga obukugu bwonna! Kubanga ani atamanyi nti ebiwundu by’ebirowoozo by’abantu bikwekeddwa okusinga ebiwundu by’ebyenda?”

— Gregory Omukulu, The Book of Pastoral Rule, Ekitundu I

Mu bigambo ebyangu, Gregory agamba kino: tewali muntu agezaako kuyigiriza mulimu gwa mikono nga tannaba kuguyiga. Noolwekyo busirusiru omuntu yenna okwetikka obuvunaanyizibwa ku myoyo gy’abantu abalala nga teyeetegese, kubanga okulabirira emyoyo gwe mulimu ogusinga emirimu gyonna obukugu. Ebiwundu by’omutima bikwekeddwa okusinga ebiwundu by’omubiri. Omusawo atamanyi bya ddagala yandiswadde okujjanjaba omubiri omulwadde. Kale ffe tusaanidde okwegendereza okusingako wa ku mwoyo omulwadde?

Gregory yakulembera ekkanisa y’e Rooma okumala emyaka kkumi n’ena. Yaliisa abaavu b’ekibuga ng’akozesa emmere okuva mu faamu z’ekkanisa. Yasindika abaminsani mu kizinga ekyali ewala ekya Bungereza. Yawandiika ebbaluwa ezisukka mu bikumi. Era yeeronderamu ekitiibwa abakulembeze b’ekkanisa bangi kye bakozesezza okuva olwo: “omuweereza w’abaweereza ba Katonda”. Yategeera Yesu kye yali ategeeza bwe yagamba nti, “Naye tekisaanye kuba bwe kityo mu mmwe.”

Oluvannyuma lw’ebyasa kkumi na bisatu, omusumba Omumerika ayitibwa E. M. Bounds yayogera amazima ago gamu mu ngeri endala. Mu kitabo kye Amaanyi Agava mu Kusaba yawandiika nti: “Abantu ye nkola ya Katonda. Ekkanisa enoonya enkola ennungi; Katonda anoonya abantu abalungi.” Bounds yakozesa olulimi lw’omulembe gwe, naye kye yayogera kituufu ku bakazi ne ku basajja kyenkanyi. Enteekateeka ya Katonda ey’okutuuka ku nsi tesooka kwesigama ku pulogulaamu, ku bizimbe oba ku ssente. Yeesigama ku bantu abalina emitima egiri gy’ali.

Lwaki kino kikulu

Abakulembeze bakulu kubanga abantu babagoberera. “Mujjukirenga abakulembeze bammwe abaababuulira ekigambo kya Katonda, nga mutunuulira empisa zaabwe nga mugobereranga okukkiriza” (Abaebbulaniya 13:7). Abantu bakoppa abakulembeze bye bakola okusinga ennyo bye boogera. Ekkanisa tetera kusaba okusinga abakulembeze baayo bwe basaba, oba okugaba n’omutima omugabi okusinga abakulembeze baayo bwe bagaba, oba okusonyiwa mu ddembe okusinga abakulembeze baayo bwe basonyiwa.

Abakulembeze bakulu era kubanga bye bakola bibeerawo ebbanga ddene. Taata atambula ne Katonda asobola okubumba bazzukulu be. Omusumba ayigiriza Bayibuli n’obwesigwa asobola okubumba ekkanisa okumala omulembe mulamba. Omukulembeze akozesa obubi obuyinza bwe asobola okwonoona okukkiriza kw’abantu okumala obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki Katonda atwala obukulembeze nga kikulu nnyo, era lwaki asuubiza okuwa abantu be “abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala” (Yeremiya 3:15).

Bw’oba oli mukulembeze ow’engeri yonna, Katonda akwesize ekintu eky’omuwendo: abantu abalala. Si babo. Babe. Mu ssuula eddako tujja kusisinkana Oyo nnannyini kisibo, era ekyokulabirako kya buli mukulembeze: Yesu, Omusumba Omukulu.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Bifo ki gy’olina obusobozi okukwata ku bantu abalala? Teekamu awaka, ku mulimu ne mu kkanisa.
  • Soma Matayo 20:20-28. Olowooza lwaki abayigirizwa baali beeraliikirira nnyo ku ani alibeera omukulu? Okwegomba okwo kwe kumu okulaba wa mu ggwe?
  • Ku bubonero obuna obw’obukulembeze obw’omwoyo (ensibuko yabwo, ekigendererwa kyabwo, amakubo gaabwo, n’okubeera mu maaso ga Katonda), kabonero ki akasinga okuba ak’amaanyi mu bulamu bwo? Kabonero ki akasinga okunafuwa?
  • Tunuulira olukalala lw’“ebika by’abakulembeze bibiri”. Lunyiriri ki olusinga okukusoomooza, era lwaki?
  • Gregory yagamba nti okulabirira emyoyo “bwe bukugu obusinga obukugu bwonna”. Kiki ky’olina okuyiga okusobola okulabirira abantu obulungi okusingawo?
  • Lowooza ku bantu abagoberera ekyokulabirako kyo. Bayiga ki mu ngeri gy’obeeramu?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno, kolera abantu b’okulembera omulimu gumu tewali agenda kukiraba wadde okukwebaza. Yonja ekintu, situla ekintu, oba yamba omuntu mu kasirise. Tobuulira muntu yenna. Bw’oba ng’okikola, saba nti, “Mukama Yesu, tewajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza. Fuula obukulembeze bwange obulinga obubwo.” Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, weebuuze ky’oyize ku mutima gwo ggwe kennyini mu kukikola.

study_questions.question: Kiki ekyawula obukulembeze obw’Ekikristaayo ku bukulembeze obw’ensi?
study_questions.answer: Yesu yagamba nti abafuzi b’amawanga bafuga abantu baabwe na lyanyi, naye “Naye tekisaanye kuba bwe kityo mu mmwe. Buli ayagala okubeera omukulu mu mmwe, abeerenga muweereza wa banne” (Matayo 20:26). Obukulembeze obw’omwoyo buweereza, buweebwa Katonda era bukolebwa mu maanyi ge, ku lw’obulungi bw’abalala.

study_questions.question: Kibi okwagala okuba omukulembeze mu kkanisa?
study_questions.answer: Si kibi singa okwegomba kuba kwa mulimu so si kwa kitiibwa. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Omuntu yenna bw’ayagalanga okuba Omulabirizi aba yeegombye omulimu omulungi” (1 Timoseewo 3:1). Ekigezo kiri nti twagala kuweereza, nga Yesu “atajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza”, oba twagala kuweerezebwa.

study_questions.question: Amaanyi g’omukulembeze ow’omwoyo gava wa?
study_questions.answer: Gava eri Katonda, so si mu talanta oba mu kifo ky’alimu. Peetero yawandiika nti, “ayamba, akikolenga n’amaanyi gonna Katonda g’amuwadde” (1 Peetero 4:11). Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo alondebwa era atumibwa Kristo, eyagamba nti, “Si mmwe mwannonda! Wabula Nze nabalonda” (Yokaana 15:16).

fields.title: Yesu, Omusumba Omukulu
fields.body_html:
“Nze musumba omulungi. Omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga.”

— Yokaana 10:11

Mu bitundu bingi eby’ensi, abasumba bakyakulembera ebisibo byabwe mu ngeri ey’edda. Omulunzi afuluma ku makya, ensolo ne zimugoberera, kubanga zimanyi eddoboozi erizita. Akawungeezi omulunzi azibala nga zikomawo eka. Bwe wabaawo ebula, addayo ebweru okuginoonya, ne mu kizikiza. Abantu abakirabye buli lunaku mu bulamu bwabwe bwonna bategeerera ddala mangu lwaki Bayibuli eyogera ku Katonda ng’omusumba.

Mu ssuula ewedde twalaba nti obukulembeze obw’omwoyo bwawukana ku bukulembeze obw’ensi. Mu ssuula eno tusisinkana Oyo atulaga enjawulo eyo bw’efaanana. Buli mukulembeze Omukristaayo musumba mu ngeri emu oba endala. Naye waliwo Omusumba Omukulu omu yekka. Nga tetunnasobola kukulembera balala, twetaaga okumumanya, okumugoberera n’okumuyigirako.

Omusumba wa Isirayiri

Yesu nga tannazaalibwa, abantu ba Katonda baali bamumanyi dda ng’omusumba waabwe. Dawudi, eyali yalundako endiga ye kennyini, yawandiika oluyimba olusinga okumanyibwa mu Bayibuli: “Mukama ye Musumba wange, seetaagenga. Angalamiza ne mpummulira mu ddundiro ly’omuddo omuto. Antwala awali amazzi amateefu” (Zabbuli 23:1-2).

Nnabbi Isaaya yannyonnyola okulabirira kwa Katonda okw’obukkakkamu mu ngeri y’emu: “Aliisa ekisibo kye ng’omusumba, akuŋŋaanya abaana b’endiga mu mukono gwe n’abasitula mu kifuba kye, n’akulembera mpola mpola ezibayonsa” (Isaaya 40:11). Katonda wa maanyi, naye si mukambwe. Asitula abato. Tavuga nnyo ezo ennafu.

Naye abantu ba Isirayiri baalina n’abasumba ab’omubiri: bakabaka baabwe, bakabona baabwe ne bannabbi baabwe. Bangi ku bo baakulembera bubi. Ng’ayita mu nnabbi Ezeekyeri, Katonda yayogera ebigambo eby’amaanyi ku bo: “Zibasanze abasumba ba Isirayiri abeefaako bokka. Abasumba tebasaanye kuliisa ndiga? Mulya amasavu, ne mwambala ebyoya, ne mutta ensolo ensava, naye temufaayo ku bisibo. Ennafu temuzizzaamu maanyi, so n’endwadde temuzijjanjabye, so n’ezirumizibbwa temusibye biwundu byazo, so n’ezibuze temuzikomezzaawo, naye muzifuze n’amaanyi” (Ezeekyeri 34:2-4).

Bino bye bimu ku bigambo ebisinga okuba eby’amaanyi mu Bayibuli eri buli akulembera. Abasumba ababi baakozesa ekisibo olw’obweyagaze bwabwe. Beetwalira emmere esinga obulungi n’engoye ezisinga obulungi. Tebaafaayo ku nnafu wadde okunoonya ezaabula. Era baafuga na maanyi. Tujja kukomawo ku bigambo bino mu Kitundu eky’Omusanvu: Obulabe mu Kkubo, bwe tunaatunuulira okukozesa obubi obuyinza.

Awo Katonda n’asuubiza ekisuubizo ekyewuunyisa: “Nze kennyini ndinoonya endiga zange ne nzirabirira” (Ezeekyeri 34:11). “Ndinoonya ezaabula, ne nkomyawo ezaawaba. Ndigyanjaba ezaalumizibwa, ne ŋŋumya ennafu” (Ezeekyeri 34:16). Era n’agamba nti, “Ndiziwa omusumba omu, omuweereza wange Dawudi, alizirunda; alizirabirira” (Ezeekyeri 34:23). Dawudi yali yafa dda nnyo. Katonda yali asuubiza Dawudi omuggya, Kabaka ow’omu lulyo lwa Dawudi eyandibadde omusumba ow’amazima ow’abantu be.

Omusumba Omulungi azze

Yesu bwe yagamba nti, “Nze musumba omulungi” (Yokaana 10:11), abantu abaamuwulira baali bamanyi ebisuubizo bino. Yesu yali agamba nti ye Oyo gwe baali balindiridde. Mu Yokaana 10 annyonnyola omusumba omulungi by’akola. Buli kitundu ku nnyinnyonnyola ye kya kuyiga eri buli mukulembeze.

Amanyi endiga ze amannya gaazo. “Aziyita amannya gaazo n’azifulumya ebweru” (Yokaana 10:3). “Endiga zange nzimanyi era nazo zimmanyi” (Yokaana 10:14). Yesu talaba kibiina kya bantu. Alaba buli muntu. Amanyi erinnya lye, ebyafaayo bye n’ebyetaago bye.

Azisooka mu maaso. “Azikulembera ne zimugoberera, kubanga zimanyi eddoboozi lye” (Yokaana 10:4). Omusumba omulungi tavuga ndiga ng’ali emabega azo n’omuggo. Atambula mu maaso, ne zimugoberera. Tazisaba n’akatono kugenda gy’atasoose kugenda.

Aziwa obulamu. “Nze najja, zibe n’obulamu, era zibe nabwo mu bujjuvu” (Yokaana 10:10). Omubbi ajja kutwala. Omusumba ajja kuwa.

Awaayo obulamu bwe ku lwazo. “Omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga” (Yokaana 10:11). Wano we wali enjawulo esinga obuziba wakati wa Yesu ne buli musumba omubi. Abasumba ababi aba Ezeekyeri 34 baalya endiga. Omusumba Omulungi yakkiriza okuttibwa asobole okuzirokola.

Tadduka. Yesu yeegeraageranya n’omupakasi: “Omupakasi, atali musumba, endiga nga si zize, bw’alaba omusege nga gujja adduka n’aleka awo endiga” (Yokaana 10:12). Awo n’annyonnyola ensonga: “Akola atyo kubanga mupakasi, so n’endiga tazifaako” (Yokaana 10:13). Omupakasi akola olw’ebyo by’afuna. Akabi bwe kajja, yeekuuma yekka.

Akuŋŋaanya n’endiga endala. “Nnina n’endiga endala ezitali za mu kisibo kino, nazo kiŋŋwanidde okuzireeta, era nazo ziriwulira eddoboozi lyange, endiga zonna ne ziba ekisibo kimu era ne ziba n’omusumba omu” (Yokaana 10:16). Omutima gwa Yesu gusukka Isirayiri ne gutuuka ku bantu b’amawanga gonna. Ekisibo kye leero kyogera ennimi enkumi n’enkumi.

Enjiri ziraga nti kino tekyali kuyigiriza kwokka. Bwe butyo Yesu bwe yali abeera. “Yesu bwe yava mu lyato n’alaba ekibiina ky’abantu bangi abaali bakuŋŋaanye n’abasaasira nga bali ng’endiga ezitalina musumba. Awo n’atandika okubayigiriza ebintu bingi” (Makko 6:34). Yali akooye. Yali agenze eyo okuwummula. Naye bwe yalaba abantu, yawulira obwetaavu bwabwe, n’abaliisa, okusooka n’Ekigambo, oluvannyuma n’emigaati.

Omusumba Omukulu n’abasumba abali wansi we

Yesu bwe yamala okuzuukira mu bafu n’addayo mu ggulu, teyaleka kisibo kye nga tekirina basumba. Yawa Ekkanisa abakulembeze okukirabirira. Naye teyakibakwasa ne kiba kyabwe. Akyali Musumba waakyo.

Omutume Peetero kino yakitegeera bulungi. Ng’anaatera okumaliriza obulamu bwe, yawandiikira abakadde b’ekkanisa nti: “nze mukadde munnammwe, omujulirwa w’okubonaabona kwa Kristo … Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe” (1 Peetero 5:1-2). Weetegereze ebintu bibiri. Ekisooka, Peetero tawandiika ng’omutume omukulu awa ebiragiro okuva waggulu. Awandiika nga “mukadde munnammwe”, omukozi munnaabwe. Eky’okubiri, akiyita “ekisibo kya Katonda”. Si kya bakadde. Awo n’atunuulira ebiri mu maaso: “Era Omusumba Omukulu bw’alikomawo, muliweebwa engule ey’ekitiibwa ekitaliggwaawo” (1 Peetero 5:4).

Noolwekyo buli mukulembeze Omukristaayo musumba ali wansi wa Musumba Omukulu. Yesu ye Musumba Omukulu. Amazima gano amangu gakyusa buli kimu ku ngeri gye tukulemberamu.

Ekisibo si kyaffe. Pawulo yagamba abakadde b’e Efeso nti bateekeddwa “okulabiriranga Ekkanisa ya Katonda gye yeegulira n’omusaayi gwe” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28). Abantu be tukulembera baagulibwa n’omusaayi gwa Yesu. Tetusaanidde n’akatono kwogera oba kukola ng’abali nti bintu byaffe. Omukulembeze ayogera nti “ekkanisa yange” oba “abantu bange” alina okujjukira nti alabirira bulabirizi eky’obugagga ky’omulala. Lumu tulikizzaayo.

Tugoberera ekyokulabirako kye. Oba nga Yesu ye Musumba Omukulu, kale engeri ye ey’okulunda kye kyokulabirako kyaffe. Tumanya abantu amannya gaabwe. Tubasooka mu maaso ne tubalaga ekyokulabirako. Tuwa obulamu mu kifo ky’okubutwala. Tetudduka akabi bwe kajja. Tutuuka ku abo abatannaba mu kisibo.

Tetuli bokka. Omulimu gw’okulabirira abantu muzito nnyo eri omuntu yenna. Naye Omusumba Omukulu tatulekedde mulimu ogwo ffekka. Ebbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya ekomekkerezebwa n’okusaba: “Kale, Katonda ow’emirembe eyazuukiza Mukama waffe Yesu, Omusumba w’endiga omukulu ow’endagaano etaggwaawo gye yanyweza n’omusaayi gwe, abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala” (Abaebbulaniya 13:20-21). Omusumba eyazuukira mu bafu akyakulembera ekisibo kye, era awa abasumba abali wansi we bye beetaaga.

Tulimuwa embalirira. Lumu Omusumba Omukulu alirabika. Alibuuza engeri gye twalabiriramu endiga ze. Ekyo kisaanye kitufuule abeegendereza. Era kisaanye kituwe essuubi, kubanga asuubiza engule etaliggwaawo eri abo abaamuweereza n’obwesigwa.

Abasumba nabo ndiga

Waliwo amazima amalala buli mukulembeze ge yeetaaga okuwulira. Nga tetunnafuuka basumba, twali ndiga ezaabula. Peetero yawandiika nti, “Kubanga mwali muwabye ng’endiga, naye kaakano mukomezebbwaawo eri Omusumba era alabirira obulamu bwammwe” (1 Peetero 2:25).

Omukulembeze talekera awo kuba omu ku ndiga. Tukyetaaga okuwulira eddoboozi ly’Omusumba. Tukyetaaga okuliisibwa, okunenyezebwa, okusitulibwa n’okusonyiyibwa. Omukulembeze ekyo akyerabira afuuka wa malala era wa kiwuubaalo. Atandika okulowooza nti alina okuba n’eby’okuddamu byonna. Alekera awo okuwuliriza. Alekera awo okwatula ebibi bye. Alekera awo okuliisibwa ye kennyini. Abakulembeze bangi bagudde kubanga beerabira nti nabo baali ndiga.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Augustine ow’e Hippo

Augustine yali mulabirizi mu kibuga Hippo, ku lubalama lw’ennyanja mu Bukiikakkono bwa Afirika, mu kitundu kati ekiyitibwa Algeria. Yaliwo okuva mu mwaka AD 354 okutuuka mu 430. Yali omu ku bantu abasinga amagezi Ekkanisa be yali emanyi, naye teyeerabira nti yali ndiga nga tannafuuka musumba. Buli mwaka ku lunaku olw’okujjukira bwe yafuuka omulabirizi, yabuuliranga abantu be ku ekyo kye kyali kitegeeza. Mu emu ku bubaka obwo, obumanyiddwa leero nga Okubuulira 340, yayogera ekintu abakulembeze kye bajulizza okuva olwo. Mu Luganda olwangu, ebigambo bye byali bino:

“Kye ndi ku lwammwe kintiisa. Kye ndi nga ndi nammwe kimbudaabuda. Ku lwammwe ndi mulabirizi; nga ndi nammwe ndi Mukristaayo. Ekisooka linnya lya bwakulu bwe naweebwa. Eky’okubiri linnya lya kisa. Ekisooka kabi. Eky’okubiri bulokozi.”

— Augustine, Okubuulira 340

Augustine yawulira obuzito bw’okuba omukulembeze. Yali amanyi nti aliwa Katonda embalirira ku lw’abantu be, era ekyo kyamutiisanga. Naye yafunanga okubudaabudibwa mu kujjukira nti naye yali omu ku bo, omwonoonyi eyasonyiyibwa, omu ku kisibo kye kimu, wansi w’Omusumba y’omu. Obwakulu bwe bwali buvunaanyizibwa buzito. Obulokozi bwe bwali kirabo kya bwereere. Teyatabula bintu ebyo byombi.

Buli mukulembeze yeetaaga okukwatira awamu amazima gano gombi. Ku lw’abantu bo, oli mukulembeze, era olina okukitwala nga kikulu. Ng’oli wamu n’abantu bo, oli muganda waabwe oba mwannyinaabwe mu Kristo, eyalokolebwa olw’ekisa kye kimu. Bw’oneerabira ekisooka, ojja kufuuka omulagajjavu. Bw’oneerabira eky’okubiri, ojja kufuuka wa malala.

Onjagala?

Ekifaananyi ekisinga okukwata ku mutima eky’Omusumba Omukulu n’abasumba abali wansi we kijja ku nkomerero y’Enjiri ya Yokaana. Peetero yali yeegaanyi Yesu emirundi esatu mu kiro kye yakwatibwamu. Oluvannyuma lw’okuzuukira, Yesu yasisinkana Peetero ku lubalama lw’ennyanja n’amubuuza emirundi esatu nti, “Simooni omwana wa Yokaana, onjagala?” Buli mulundi Peetero yaddamu nti yee. Era buli mulundi Yesu yamuwa omulimu: “Kale liisanga abaana b’endiga zange.” “Kale lundanga endiga zange.” “Kale liisanga endiga zange” (Yokaana 21:15-17).

Weetegereze Yesu ky’ataabuuza. Teyabuuza nti, “Peetero, olina amagezi agamala? Olina amaanyi agamala? Toligwa nate?” Yabuuza nti, “Onjagala?” Okwagala Yesu kye kisaanyizo ekisooka eky’okulabirira abantu be. Omukulembeze ayinza okuba n’ebirabo bingi, naye bw’ataba na kwagala eri Omusumba, tajja kwagala ndiga mu mazima.

Weetegereze era Yesu kye yayogera ng’emboozi ekomekkerezebwa. Yagamba Peetero nti lumu naye alifiira okukkiriza kwe, n’oluvannyuma n’agamba nti, “Ngoberera” (Yokaana 21:19). Yesu yali yayita Peetero n’ebigambo bye bimu ku nnyanja y’emu, emyaka esatu emabega (Makko 1:17). Obukulembeze tebwadda mu kifo ky’okugoberera. Omusumba w’endiga yali akyali mugoberezi w’Omusumba.

Awo obukulembeze bwonna obw’omwoyo we butandikira. Tumwagala kubanga ye yasooka okutwagala. Tumugoberera, era nga bwe tumugoberera, tuliisa endiga ze. Mu ssuula eddako tujja kubuuza engeri gy’ayitamu abantu okukola omulimu guno.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Zabbuli 23 mpola mpola. Kifaananyi ki eky’Omusumba ekikusinga okuba eky’amakulu leero? Kiyinza kitya okubumba engeri gy’okulemberamu abalala?
  • Soma Ezeekyeri 34:1-6. Ku bulemeezi bw’abasumba ababi, buliwa bw’olowooza nti businga okulabika mu bakulembeze leero?
  • Yesu amanyi endiga ze amannya gaazo. Abantu b’okulembera obamanyi kwenkana wa? Kiki ky’oyinza okukola okubamanya obulungi okusingawo?
  • Wali olowoozezza ku bantu b’okulembera nti “babo”? Kiki ekikyuka bw’ojjukira nti kisibo kya Katonda, ekyagulibwa n’omusaayi gwe?
  • Augustine yagamba nti, “Ku lwammwe ndi mulabirizi; nga ndi nammwe ndi Mukristaayo.” Ku mazima gano gombi, ge galiwa g’osinga okwerabira amangu?
  • Singa Yesu akubuuza leero nti, “Onjagala?”, wandiddamu ki? Okwagala kw’olina gy’ali kweyoleka kutya mu ngeri gy’okulemberamu?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Buli lunaku mu wiiki eno, soma ennyiriri ntono okuva mu Yokaana 10:1-18. Oluvannyuma londa omuntu omu gw’okulembera omukolere ekintu kimu omusumba omulungi ky’andikoze: muyite erinnya lye, mubuuze bw’ali ddala, mulambule, muyambe, oba musabe naye. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, weebaze Omusumba Omukulu olw’obutalekera awo kukulabirira.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Yesu ayitibwa Omusumba Omulungi?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga awaayo obulamu bwe yennyini ku lw’abantu be. Yagamba nti, “Nze musumba omulungi. Omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga” (Yokaana 10:11). Atuukiriza ekisuubizo kya Katonda mu Ezeekyeri: “Nze kennyini ndinoonya endiga zange ne nzirabirira” (Ezeekyeri 34:11).

study_questions.question: Katonda yagamba ki abasumba ababi aba Isirayiri?
study_questions.answer: Yasalira omusango abakulembeze abeeweerezanga bokka: “Zibasanze abasumba ba Isirayiri abeefaako bokka. Abasumba tebasaanye kuliisa ndiga?” (Ezeekyeri 34:2). Awo n’asuubiza okukola omulimu ogwo ye kennyini: “Ndinoonya ezaabula, ne nkomyawo ezaawaba. Ndigyanjaba ezaalumizibwa, ne ŋŋumya ennafu” (Ezeekyeri 34:16).

study_questions.question: Abakulembeze b’ekkanisa basaanidde kwetunuulira batya bwe bageraageranyizibwa ne Yesu?
study_questions.answer: Ng’abasumba abali wansi w’Omusumba Omukulu, era ng’endiga nabo ezeetaaga okulabirira kwe. Ekisibo kya Kristo, si kya mukulembeze, era buli mukulembeze alina okusooka okumugoberera, nga zabbuli bw’egamba nti, “Mukama ye Musumba wange, seetaagenga” (Zabbuli 23:1).

fields.title: Okuyitibwa kwa Katonda
fields.body_html:
“Ne mpulira eddoboozi lya Mukama ng’abuuza nti, ‘Naatuma ani, era ani anaagenda ku lwaffe?’ Ne ndyoka njogera nti, ‘Nze wendi! Tuma nze!’”

— Isaaya 6:8

“Nnyinza ntya okumanya oba Katonda ampita okukulembera?” Ebibuuzo bitono ebisinga kino okutawaanya Abakristaayo abato. Abamu balinda okumala emyaka mingi eddoboozi okuva mu ggulu eritajja. Abalala banguwa okwesooza kubanga banyumirwa okubeera mu maaso, era tebayimirira n’akatono kwebuuza oba Katonda ye yabatuma. Abamu bawulira okwagala okw’amaanyi okuweereza naye ne bagambibwa nti bato nnyo, baavu nnyo oba tebasoma kimala. Abalala basindikibwa ekkanisa yaabwe mu bukulembeze nga tebannaba kwetegeka, ne bubabetenta.

Bayibuli tetuwa nkola nnyangu ya kugoberera. Naye etulaga engeri Katonda gye yayitamu abaweereza be mu byasa byonna, era etuwa amakubo ag’okutegeera okuyitibwa kwe. Essuula eno etunuulira byombi.

Ebika by’okuyitibwa bibiri

Okusooka, twetaaga okulaba nti Bayibuli eyogera ku kuyitibwa mu ngeri bbiri.

Okuyitibwa okusooka era okusinga obukulu kujjira buli Mukristaayo. Kwe kuyitibwa okugoberera Yesu. Pawulo yawandiikira ekkanisa ey’omu Kkolinso nti, “Kubanga mulabe okuyitibwa kwammwe abooluganda, bangi ku mmwe temwali bagezi mu mubiri, era nga bangi temuli b’amaanyi, era nga bangi temwazaalibwa nga muli ba kitiibwa” (1 Abakkolinso 1:26). Katonda yabayita okubeera aba Kristo, okufuuka abatukuvu, n’okumuweereza n’obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Okuyitibwa okwo kwa buli mukkiriza, k’abe nga akulembera oba nedda.

Ekika eky’okubiri eky’okuyitibwa kwe kuyitibwa okukola omulimu ogw’enjawulo oba okubeera mu kifo ekimu mu bantu ba Katonda. Katonda yayita Musa okukulembera Isirayiri okuva mu Misiri. Yayita Yeremiya okuba nnabbi. Yesu yayita abayigirizwa kkumi na babiri okuba abatume. Omwoyo Omutukuvu yayita Balunabba ne Sawulo okugenda mu lugendo lw’obuminsani. Ne leero Katonda akyayita abantu okuba abasumba, abakadde b’ekkanisa, abadyakoni, ababuulizi b’enjiri, abaminsani, abasomesa n’abakulembeze ab’engeri nnyingi.

Okuyitibwa okusooka bulijjo kukulembera okw’okubiri. Tewali ayinza kukulembera balala kudda eri Kristo nga ye kennyini tasoose kujja eri Kristo. Era okuyitibwa okw’okubiri tekudda mu kifo ky’okusooka. Omusumba asooka kuba muyigirizwa, oluvannyuma n’aba musumba. Bw’oba tokakasa ku kuyitibwa okukulembera, sooka okakase okuyitibwa kwo okugoberera.

Engeri Katonda gye yayitamu abaweereza be

Bayibuli ejjudde ebyafaayo by’abantu Katonda be yayita. Tewali byafaayo bibiri ebifaanagana ddala, naye waliwo enkola ezimu ezeeyoleka emirundi n’emirundi.

Katonda y’asooka okutambula. Musa yali tanoonya mulimu gwa kukola Katonda bwe yayogera okuva mu kisaka ekyaka omuliro. Yali alunda endiga za ssezaala we. Isaaya yali asinza mu yeekaalu bwe yalaba Mukama. Amosi yagamba nti, “nnali mulunzi wa ndiga era nga ndabirira miti emisukamooli. Naye Mukama yanziggya eyo mu kulunda ekisibo n’aŋŋamba nti, ‘Genda owe obunnabbi abantu bange, Isirayiri’” (Amosi 7:14-15). Yesu yagamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Si mmwe mwannonda! Wabula Nze nabalonda” (Yokaana 15:16). Obukulembeze obw’omwoyo butandikira ku Katonda, so si ku ffe.

Emirundi mingi Katonda ayita abantu nga bali mu makkati g’emirimu gyabwe egya bulijjo. Musa yali alunda endiga. Gidyoni yali awuula eŋŋaano. Erisa yali alima ennimiro n’emigogo gy’ente kkumi n’ebiri Eriya bwe yamusuulako omunagiro gwe (1 Bassekabaka 19:19). Peetero ne Andereya baali basuula obutimba mu nnyanja (Makko 1:16). Katonda tatera kuyita bantu abatuula obutuuzi nga balindirira okuyitibwa. Ayita abantu abali abeesigwa mu kifo we bali.

Katonda ayita abantu abatasuubirwa. Musa yagamba nti tasobola kwogera bulungi. Yeremiya yagamba nti yali muto nnyo. Gidyoni yagamba nti ennyumba yaabwe ye yali esinga obunafu mu kika kye. Peetero yagamba nti, “Mukama wange, nkwegayiridde ndeka, kubanga ndi mwonoonyi nnyo” (Lukka 5:8). Pawulo yali ayigganyizza Ekkanisa. Kirabika Katonda asanyukira okulonda abantu ensi be yandibuusizza amaaso. “Katonda yalonda ebinafu eby’ensi, akwase ab’amaanyi ensonyi … waleme kubaawo muntu n’omu eyeenyumiriza mu maaso ga Katonda” (1 Abakkolinso 1:27-29).

Emirundi mingi okuyitibwa kwa Katonda kusanga obutayagala. Katonda bwe yagamba Musa okugenda ewa Falaawo, Musa yabuuza nti, “Nange nze ani agenda ewa Falaawo nziggyeyo abaana ba Isirayiri mu Misiri?” (Okuva 3:11). Yaleeta ensonga emu oluvannyuma lw’endala, okutuusa lwe yagamba nti, “Mukama wange, nkwegayiridde tuma omuntu omulala” (Okuva 4:13). Yeremiya yawakanya nti, “Laba nno, Mukama Katonda! Simanyi kwogera mu bantu, ndi mwana muto” (Yeremiya 1:6). Okuwulira ng’oli munafu si kabonero nti Katonda takuyise. Emirundi mingi kabonero nti otegeera obunene bw’omulimu.

Okuyitibwa kwa Katonda kujja wamu n’okubeerawo kwa Katonda. Katonda teyaddamu Musa ng’amubuulira ebirabo by’alina bwe biri ebingi. Yagamba nti, “Ddala, nnaabeeranga naawe” (Okuva 3:12). Yagamba Yeremiya nti, “Tobatyanga, kubanga nze ndi naawe okukuwonya” (Yeremiya 1:8). Amaanyi g’oyo ayitiddwa tegali mu ye kennyini wabula mu Oyo amuyita.

Emirundi mingi okuyitibwa kwa Katonda kutandika n’okusisinkana obutukuvu bwe. Isaaya yalaba Mukama “ng’atudde ku ntebe empanvu ng’agulumizibbwa” (Isaaya 6:1). Kye yasooka okwogera tekyali nti “Tuma nze!” wabula nti “Zinsanze nze! Nfudde mpeddewo! Kubanga ndi muntu ow’emimwa egitali mirongoofu” (Isaaya 6:5). Katonda bwe yamala okumulongoosa, n’alyoka awulira okuyitibwa n’addamu nti, “Nze wendi! Tuma nze!” (Isaaya 6:8). Abo abalabye Katonda bw’ali omutukuvu, era bw’ali ow’ekisa okusonyiwa, bafuuka abaweereza abeetoowaze era abeetegefu.

Engeri ssatu ez’okutegeera okuyitibwa

Abakulembeze abasinga obungi leero tebawulira Katonda ng’ayogera okuva mu kisaka ekyaka omuliro. Kale, tuyinza tutya okumanya oba Katonda atuyita okukola omulimu? Abakristaayo mu byasa byonna banoonyezza ebintu bisatu ebikolera awamu. Bitwale ng’obuguwa busatu obulukibwa mu muguwa gumu. Akaguwa kamu kokka kanafu. Obusatu awamu bwa maanyi.

1. Okwegomba n’omugugu ebiri munda. Pawulo agamba nti, “Omuntu yenna bw’ayagalanga okuba Omulabirizi aba yeegombye omulimu omulungi” (1 Timoseewo 3:1). Emirundi mingi Katonda atandika okuyita kwe ng’ateeka okwegomba mu mutima: okwagala abantu be, omugugu ku lw’abaabula, okuyaayaanira okuyigiriza Ekigambo kye. Yeremiya yakinnyonnyola nti “mu mutima gwange kiri ng’omuliro ogwaka, ogukwekeddwa mu magumba gange” (Yeremiya 20:9). Pawulo yagamba nti, “mpalirizibwa okugibuulira. Era ziba zinsanze bwe sigibuulira” (1 Abakkolinso 9:16).

Naye tulina okugezesa okwegomba kuno. Kwegomba kuweereza, oba kwegomba kuba wa kitiibwa? Mugugu ku lw’abantu, oba kwagala kuba waggulu ku kituuti abantu bakulabe? Okuyitibwa okw’amazima okuva eri Katonda emirundi mingi kweyongera amaanyi nga bwe kumala ebbanga ne mu kusaba. Kuwangula ebizibu n’okuggwaamu essuubi. Okwegomba okw’okwenoonyeza kutera okuggwaawo nga tewali mpeera.

2. Ekkanisa okukakasa. Mu Bayibuli, kumpi bulijjo okuyitibwa kwa Katonda okukulembera kwategeerwanga abalala. Abatume bwe beetaaga abayambi okulabirira bannamwandu, baasaba ekkanisa nti, “mwerondemu abasajja musanvu, abasiimibwa abantu, ng’abantu b’amagezi, era abajjudde Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:3). Katonda bwe yayita Balunabba ne Sawulo, yayogera eri ekibinja kyonna eky’abakulembeze mu Antiyokiya, era “bwe baamala okusaba n’okusiiba, ne bassa emikono gyabwe ku Balunabba ne Sawulo, ne babasiibula ne bagenda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:3). Pawulo yajjukiza Timoseewo ekirabo kye yaweebwa “abakadde bwe baakussaako emikono gyabwe” (1 Timoseewo 4:14).

Kino kitukuuma. Emitima gyaffe giyinza okutulimba. Tuyinza okulowooza nti tuyitiddwa so nga tuli bakwegomba bwegombi. Oba tuyinza okulowooza nti tetuyitiddwa so nga tuli batya butya. Abantu ab’amagezi era abatya Katonda abatumanyi obulungi emirundi mingi basobola okulaba ffe kye tutasobola kulaba. Bw’oba okkiriza nti Katonda akuyita okukulembera, kibuulire abakkiriza abakuze n’abakulembeze mu kkanisa yo. Basabe bakusabire era bakubuulire mu bwesimbu kye balaba. Beera mwetegefu okulinda bo okukikakasa.

3. Ebirabo n’empisa ebyetaagisa okukola omulimu. Katonda awa ebyetaagisa abo b’ayita. Pawulo bw’annyonnyola abakulembeze b’ekkanisa, abala empisa zaabwe okusinga ennyo obusobozi bwabwe. Omulabirizi alina okuba “nga muntu eyeefuga, nga mwegendereza, nga mukwata mpola, ayaniriza abagenyi, era ng’amanyi okuyigiriza. Tateekwa kuba mutamiivu, era nga si mukambwe, wabula omuwombeefu, nga si muyombi era nga talulunkanira nsimbi” (1 Timoseewo 3:2-3). Ekintu kimu kyokka ku lukalala olwo, “ng’amanyi okuyigiriza”, bwe bukugu. Ebirala byonna binnyonnyola omuntu obulamu bwe Kristo bwe yakyusa.

Noolwekyo weebuuze: Katonda ampadde ebirabo omulimu guno bye gwetaaga? Era obulamu bwange bulaga ebibala by’Omwoyo? Noonya obujulizi mu by’okola dda. Katonda bw’aba akuyita okuyigiriza, okuyigiriza kwo kwali kuyambye dda abantu? Katonda bw’aba akuyita okukulembera ekibinja, abantu bajja dda gy’oli okubayamba? Katonda atera okuyita abantu ku mulimu omunene oluvannyuma lw’okuba abeesigwa mu mutono.

Oluusi wabaawo akaguwa ak’okuna: Katonda aggulawo oluggi. Wabaawo obwetaavu ggwe bw’osobola okumalawo. Ekkanisa ekuyita. Ekkubo ne liggulwawo we litaaliwo. Naye enzigi enzigule zokka tezimala kulaga kuyitibwa, kubanga si buli luggi oluggule nti luva eri Katonda. Noonya oluggi oluggule wamu n’obuguwa obulala obusatu.

Obulabe bubiri

Ku nsonga y’okuyitibwa kwa Katonda, abantu batera okugwa mu bulabe bumu ku bubiri.

Obulabe obusooka kwe kudduka okwolekera ekituuti. Abantu abamu baagala okukulembera kubanga baagala okulabibwa, okussibwamu ekitiibwa oba okusasulwa. Beesindika mu maaso. Tebalina bugumiikiriza mu nkola empola ey’okugezesebwa. Pawulo alabula nti omukulembeze “tateekwa kuba muntu eyaakakkiriza Kristo, si kulwa nga yeekuluntaza, n’asalirwa omusango nga Setaani bwe yagusalirwa” (1 Timoseewo 3:6). Obukulembeze obuweebwa amangu ennyo busobola okuzikiriza omukkiriza omuto. Bw’ozuula nti oyagala ekitiibwa ky’obwakulu okusinga bw’oyagala okuweereza, yimirira weekebere omutima gwo. Katonda tali mu kwanguyiriza.

Obulabe obw’okubiri kwe kudduka okuva ku kuyitibwa okw’amazima. Abalala bawulira bulungi okuyitibwa kwa Katonda naye ne bakugaana. Batya okulemererwa, oba okuvumirirwa, oba omuwendo gwe balina okusasula. Yona “n’adduka okuva mu maaso ga Mukama, n’aserengeta okulaga e Talusiisi” (Yona 1:3). Musa yaleeta ensonga nnyingi nnyo okutuusa “Mukama n’asunguwalira nnyo Musa” (Okuva 4:14). Obwetoowaze obw’obulimba buyinza okuba engeri y’obujeemu. Katonda bw’aba akuyise, era Ekkanisa n’ekikakasa, okugamba nti nedda si bwetoowaze. Kuba kugaana Katonda bugaanyi.

Abamu ku bakulembeze abasinga obukulu mu byafaayo by’Ekkanisa baawulira obulabe obwo bwombi omulundi gumu. Gregory ow’e Nazianzus, omulabirizi mu kitundu kati ekiyitibwa Turkey mu myaka gya 300, yadduka bwe yamala okufuulibwa kabona nga tayagala. Oluvannyuma yakomawo n’awandiika ennyinnyonnyola empanvu ku nsonga lwaki omulimu ogwo gwamutiisa nnyo. Mukwano gwe John Chrysostom yalimbalimba mukwano gwe ow’oku lusegere, Basil, n’amuleetera okuyawulibwa olw’obuweereza, ye kennyini n’adduka. Oluvannyuma n’awandiika ekitabo, On the Priesthood (Ku Bwakabona), okunnyonnyola lwaki yakikola. Bombi oluvannyuma baafuuka abakulembeze abakulu. Okutya kwabwe kwava mu kutegeera okw’amazima ku bukulu bw’omulimu. Naye ku nkomerero baalina okugondera.

Okugenda mu Buziba: Ani ayinza okuyitibwa?

Abakristaayo bakkiriziganya nti Katonda ayita abasajja n’abakazi okumuweereza, era abawa bombi ebirabo bye. Naye tebakkiriziganya oba ebifo ebimu mu kkanisa, ng’eky’omusumba oba eky’omukadde w’ekkanisa, biggule eri abakazi. Ekkanisa ezimu zikkiriza nti Bayibuli ebifo bino ebikuumira abasajja. Endala zikkiriza nti biggule eri bonna Katonda b’awa ebirabo n’ayita. Tujja kutunuulira endowooza enkulu mu bwenkanya mu Ssuula 26, Abasajja n’Abakazi mu Mulimu gwa Katonda.

Abakristaayo era bakozesa ekigambo “okuyawulibwa olw’obuweereza” mu ngeri ez’enjawulo. Mu kkanisa ezimu kikolwa kitukuvu ekyawula omuntu okumala obulamu bwe bwonna. Mu ndala kwe kukkiriza okwangu okw’ekibiina ky’abakkiriza. Kye bonna bakkiriziganyaako y’enkola eri mu Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13: Katonda ayita, ekkanisa esaba, era ekkanisa etuma. Ekyongerezeddwako A (Essuula 53) kinnyonnyola engeri enkulu ekkanisa gye zitegeeramu n’okulondamu abakulembeze baazo.

Ekisembayo, okuyitibwa mu buweereza si kye kimu n’omusaala. Abasumba bangi mu nsi bakola omulimu omulala okuliisa amaka gaabwe, nga Pawulo yennyini bwe yatungiranga weema. Okuyitibwa kwabwe si kwa mazima katono. Tujja kutunuulira kino mu Ssuula 45, Abakulembeze ku Mulimu ne mu Bantu.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Samuel Ajayi Crowther

Samuel Ajayi Crowther bwe yali nga wa myaka kkumi n’esatu, abanyazi baayokya ekibuga ky’ewaabwe mu kitundu kati ekiyitibwa Nigeria. Baamusiba omuguwa mu bulago ne bamutwala. Yatundibwa emirundi mukaaga. Ku nkomerero yasibibwa enjegere ku lyato eryali ligenda mu Amerika. Akawungeezi ako kennyini, ekyombo ky’olutalo ekya Bungereza kyayimiriza eryato ly’abaddu ne kisumulula abawambe. Crowther yatwalibwa e Sierra Leone, gye yayigira okusoma, n’akkiriza Kristo era n’abatizibwa.

Yafuuka omusomesa, oluvannyuma omusumba, oluvannyuma omuminsani eri abantu b’ewaabwe Abayoruba. Yavvuunula Bayibuli mu Luyoruba. Yatambula ng’ayambuka omugga omunene Niger, emirundi mingi mu kabi, ng’asimba ekkanisa ezikulemberwa Abafirika. Mu mwaka 1864, yali amaze emyaka egisukka mu abiri ng’omuweereza w’Ekigambo.

Mu mwaka ogwo Henry Venn, omukulembeze w’ekibiina ky’abaminsani Crowther mwe yali akolera, yakola enteekateeka ey’obuvumu. Yali ayagala Crowther afuuke omulabirizi, omulabirizi Omufirika eyasooka mu Kkanisa ya Anglican. Abaminsani abamu Abazungu baali tebakyagala. Naye okuwakanya okusinga amaanyi kwava ku Crowther yennyini. Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka mingi, mutabani we yanyumya ebyaliwo. Crowther yajja mu kakiiko e London ng’ayambadde ekkooti enkadde eriko eppeesa ez’ekikomo, abamu ku bakiise ne bamusekerera. Venn bwe yamubuulira enteekateeka, yagaana. “Sisaanira,” bwe yagamba. “Nedda, ssebo, ndi muweereza waabwe mu nnimiro; siyinza kukikkiriza.”

Venn yasaba naye n’amusindika okumala ennaku bbiri okulowooza n’okusaba. Bwe yakomawo, yagaana nate. Ku nkomerero, ab’omu maka ge bwe baajjukira, omukadde yamwegayirira omulundi omulala. Crowther yaddamu n’ebigambo bya Eri mu 1 Samwiri 3:18: “Ye Mukama, akole nga bw’asiima.” Abasajja bombi ne bafukamira wamu okusaba, Venn n’akaaba.

Ebyafaayo bino eby’omu maka tusaanidde okubikwata nga tetubinywezezza nnyo, kubanga byanyumizibwa oluvannyuma lw’emyaka mingi. Naye bikwatagana na buli kimu kye tumanyi ku Crowther. Ng’omulabirizi, yasaba ayitibwenga “Omulabirizi Omukulu ow’Ekitiibwa, so si ‘Mukama wange’ n’akatono.” Yali amanyi nti amaaso ga bangi gaali gamutunuulidde, era nti “buli kigere kikyamu kye nditambula kirikosa Ekkanisa zonna ez’enzaalwa.” Teyayagala bwakulu obwo. Yabukkiriza kubanga yakkiriza nti Katonda n’Ekkanisa baali bamuyita okubukola. Era yabuweerezaamu okumala kumpi emyaka asatu, nga bwe yali agambye, ng’omuweereza mu nnimiro.

Ebyafaayo bya Crowther biraga obuguwa bwonna obusatu obw’okuyitibwa. Yalina okwagala okw’amaanyi eri abantu be n’omugugu okubatuukako. Ekkanisa yalaba omukono gwa Katonda ku ye n’ekikakasa. Era obuweereza bwe obw’ebbanga eddene n’obwesigwa bwali bulaze dda ebirabo n’empisa omulimu bye gwetaaga. Obutayagala bwe tebwali bujeemu. Kwali kutya okutuufu, okutya okwamufukamiza ku maviivi.

Oyo ayita mwesigwa

Bw’oba nga weebuuza oba Katonda akuyita, toweeraliikirira. Weeyongere okugoberera Yesu. Beera mwesigwa we wali. Weereza mu ngeri entono. Saba. Yogera n’abakkiriza ab’amagezi. Leka Ekkanisa ekugezese. Katonda bw’aba akuyita, ajja kukyeyolesa mu kiseera kye, era ajja kukuwa by’oyetaaga okugondera.

Era Katonda bw’aba amaze okukuyita, guma omwoyo. Ne bw’oba munafu otya, eky’okuddamu kye yawa Musa kye kya kuddamu gy’oli: “Ddala, nnaabeeranga naawe” (Okuva 3:12).

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Okakasa okuyitibwa kwo okusooka, okuyitibwa okugoberera Yesu? Kwajja kutya gy’oli?
  • Byafaayo ki eby’okuyitibwa mu Bayibuli (Musa, Isaaya, Yeremiya, Amosi, Erisa, Peetero oba Pawulo) ebisinga okufaanana n’ebyo by’oyiseemu? Lwaki?
  • Lowooza ku buguwa obusatu obw’okuyitibwa: okwegomba okuli munda, Ekkanisa okukakasa, n’ebirabo n’empisa ebyetaagisa omulimu. Kaguwa ki ku buno k’olaba mu bulamu bwo? Kaguwa ki akabulamu?
  • Oli mu bulabe bw’okudduka okwolekera ekituuti, oba obw’okudduka okuva ku kuyitibwa okw’amazima? Beera mwesimbu.
  • Baani abakkiriza abakuze abayinza okukuyamba okugezesa ky’owulira ku kuyitibwa kwo? Wababuuzizza?
  • Crowther yagamba nti, “ndi muweereza waabwe mu nnimiro.” Kyandifaananye kitya ggwe okulaba ekifo kyo mu ngeri eyo?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Londa omukkiriza oba omukulembeze omu akuze gwe weesiga. Wiiki eno, musabe musisinkane. Mubuulire mu bwesimbu ky’owulira nti Katonda ayinza okuba akuyita okukola, oba ky’okola dda. Mubuuze ebibuuzo bisatu: “Olaba mu nze okwegomba okuweereza, oba okwegomba okuba ow’ekitiibwa? Birabo ki by’olaba mu nze? Kiki mu mpisa zange ekyetaaga okukula nga sinnaba kusobola kwetikka bingi okusingawo?” Wuliriza nga teweewolereza. Oluvannyuma saba ku by’akugamba.

study_questions.question: Nnyinza ntya okumanya oba Katonda ampita okukulembera?
study_questions.answer: Essuula eno ewa obubonero busatu obw’okunoonyeza awamu: okuwulira munda nti Katonda akuyita, ebirabo n’empisa ebyetaagisa okukola omulimu, n’ekkanisa okukakasa. Eky’okuddamu kya Isaaya, “Nze wendi! Tuma nze!”, kyajja ng’amaze okusisinkana Katonda (Isaaya 6:8).

study_questions.question: Katonda ayita bantu bokka abasomye oba ab’ekitiibwa?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Kubanga mulabe okuyitibwa kwammwe abooluganda, bangi ku mmwe temwali bagezi mu mubiri” (1 Abakkolinso 1:26). Amosi yali mulunzi: “Mukama yanziggya eyo mu kulunda ekisibo” (Amosi 7:15). Katonda alonda abanafu waleme kubaawo yeenyumiriza.

study_questions.question: Nkole ki bwe mpulira nga sisaanira kuyitibwa kwa Katonda?
study_questions.answer: Tooli wekka. Musa yabuuza nti, “Nange nze ani agenda ewa Falaawo nziggyeyo abaana ba Isirayiri mu Misiri?” (Okuva 3:11), ne Peetero n’agamba nti, “Mukama wange, nkwegayiridde ndeka, kubanga ndi mwonoonyi nnyo” (Lukka 5:8). Eky’okuddamu kya Katonda si nti tusaanira, wabula nti agenda naffe era mwesigwa eri omulimu gw’atuwa.

fields.title: Ekiremba n’Ebbensani
fields.body_html:
“N’Omwana w’Omuntu, teyajja ku nsi kuweerezebwa, wabula okuweereza abalala, era n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi.”

— Makko 10:45

Mu biseera bya Yesu, abantu baatambulanga buli wamu ku makubo ag’enfuufu nga bambadde engatto ez’embaata eziggule. Abagenyi bwe baatuukanga mu nnyumba okulya ekijjulo, waabangawo omuntu abanaaza ebigere. Omulimu ogwo tegwali gwa kusanyusa. Gwakolebwanga omuddu asembayo wansi mu nnyumba. Tewali muyigiriza assibwamu kitiibwa eyali ayinza okugukolera abayigirizwa be. Ne leero mu mawanga mangi wakyaliwo emirimu egy’engeri eyo: emirimu omuntu yenna alina ekitiibwa gy’atayagala kulabibwako ng’agikola.

Ekiro nga tannafa, Yesu yakola gumu ku mirimu egyo. Yafukamira wansi ng’alina ekiremba n’ebbensani y’amazzi, n’anaaza abayigirizwa be ebigere. Oluvannyuma n’abagamba nabo bakolerenga bannaabwe bwe batyo. Mu kikolwa ekyo ekyangu, Yesu yawa Ekkanisa ye ekifaananyi ky’obukulembeze ky’etasobolangako kwerabira. Essuula eno etunuulira amakulu gaakyo.

Yesu kye yali amanyi

Yokaana atandika olugero luno mu ngeri eyeewuunyisa: “Yesu bwe yamanya nti Kitaawe yateeka byonna mu mikono gye, era nga yava wa Katonda ate gy’adda, n’asituka ku mmere, ne yeggyako omunagiro gwe, ne yeesiba ettawulo mu kiwato” (Yokaana 13:3-4).

Weetegereze engeri ebintu gye biddiriŋŋanamu. Yesu yali amanyi nti ye ani. Yali amanyi nti obuyinza bwonna bwali bumuweereddwa. Yali amanyi gye yava ne gy’agenda. Era olw’okuba yali amanyi ebintu ebyo, yali wa ddembe okukwata ekiremba.

Kino kye kyama ky’obukulembeze obw’okuweereza. Abakulembeze bangi tebasobola kuweereza kubanga tebeekakasa. Batya nti bwe banaakola emirimu egya wansi, abantu bajja kulekera awo okubassaamu ekitiibwa. Beetaaga amannya gaabwe ag’ekitiibwa, entebe zaabwe ez’omu maaso n’okukolwako mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, kubanga awatali bintu ebyo tebamanya bo kye bali. Yesu teyalina kyetaago kya bintu ebyo. Kye yali kyali kinywevu mu Kitaawe. N’olwekyo yasobola okufukamira wansi nga talina ky’afiirwa.

Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne gye tuli. Omukulembeze amanyi nti ayagalibwa Katonda, nti akkiriziddwa mu Kristo era nti atumiddwa Ye, teyeetaaga kukakasa bukulu bwe. Aba wa ddembe okuweereza. Gye tukoma okunywera mu Katonda, gye tukoma okusobola okukutama wansi.

Ekiremba n’ebbensani

Yokaana era atubuulira lwaki Yesu yakikola: “Yesu bwe yayagala ababe mu nsi, yabalagira ddala okwagala kwe kwonna okutuusiza ddala ku kiseera ekisembayo” (Yokaana 13:1). Ekiremba kyali kikolwa kya kwagala. Yesu teyali mu kukola mukolo gwa ddiini. Yali alabirira mikwano gye.

Peetero teyasobola kukikkiriza. “Mukama wange, ggwe onnaaze ebigere?” bwe yabuuza. “Nedda, tolinnaaza bigere emirembe gyonna” (Yokaana 13:6, 8). Peetero yali amanyi nti kino kyali kikyamu, nga kikontana n’engeri ebintu gye bisaanidde okuba. Mukama tasaanidde kuweereza muyigirizwa. Naye Yesu n’addamu nti, “Bwe siikunaaze bigere, nga tossa kimu nange” (Yokaana 13:8). Nga tetunnaba kuweereza balala, tulina okuleka Yesu atuweereze. Tulina okukkiriza okutunaaza kwe, okutusonyiwa kwe n’okutulabirira kwe. Abantu ab’amalala kino kibazibuwalira. Bandyagadde okuweereza okusinga okuweerezebwa, kubanga okuweerezebwa kubawulizisa nga banafu.

Bwe yamala, Yesu n’atuula n’annyonnyola: “Mmwe mumpita Muyigiriza era Mukama wammwe, mukola bulungi okumpita bwe mutyo kubanga ddala bwe ntyo bwe ndi. Kale Nze Mukama wammwe era Omuyigiriza, nga bwe mbanaazizza ebigere, nammwe musaana okunaazagananga ebigere. Mbalaze ekyokulabirako, mukolenga nga Nze bwe mbakoze” (Yokaana 13:13-15). Era n’agattako nti: “Bwe mumanya ebintu bino muba n’omukisa bwe mubikola” (Yokaana 13:17).

Weetegereze nti Yesu teyalekera awo kuba Muyigiriza na Mukama bwe yabanaaza ebigere. Yagamba nti, “mukola bulungi okumpita bwe mutyo kubanga ddala bwe ntyo bwe ndi.” Obukulembeze obw’okuweereza tebutegeeza nti omukulembeze alekera awo okukulembera. Butegeeza nti omukulembeze akulembera ng’aweereza.

Okuwakana ku mmeeza

Lukka atubuulira ekintu ekinakuwaza ku kiro ekyo kyennyini. Ku kijjulo ekyo kyennyini Yesu kwe yabanaaliza ebigere, “ne batandika okuwakana bokka ne bokka, ani asinga ekitiibwa mu bo” (Lukka 22:24). Ne bwe baali bamaze emyaka esatu ne Yesu, abayigirizwa baali bakyavuganya ku bifo.

Yesu yabaddamu n’obugumiikiriza: “Bakabaka b’abamawanga bafuga abantu baabwe, n’ab’obuyinza ne babazunza mu kino na kiri, naye abafugibwa tebalina kya kukola wabula okubayita abayambi baabwe. Naye mu mmwe tekisaanira kuba bwe kityo. Oyo asinga ekitiibwa mu mmwe asaana yeeyisenga ng’asembayo, n’omukulembeze mu mmwe asaana abeere ng’omuweereza wammwe. Mu nsi muno omukungu y’atula ku mmeeza abaddu be ne bamuweereza. Naye wano mu ffe nze muweereza wammwe” (Lukka 22:25-27).

Weetegereze ekigambo “abayambi”. Abafuzi mu biseera ebyo baayagalanga okuyitibwa abayambi, kwe kugamba abantu abakolera abalala ebirungi. Baakozesanga obuyinza ku bantu, ate ne basuubira abantu okubeebaza olw’ekyo. Abakulembeze basobola okukola bwe batyo ne leero. Bafuga abantu, ate oluvannyuma ne babajjukiza bingi bye babakoledde. Yesu yagamba nti, “Naye mu mmwe tekisaanira kuba bwe kityo.”

Endowooza ya Kristo

Pawulo atuwa ekifaananyi ekisingayo obuziba eky’obukulembeze obw’okuweereza mu bbaluwa ye eri Abafiripi. Akubiriza abakkiriza okubeera bwe bati: “nga temukola kintu na kimu olw’okuvuganya wadde okwewaana okutaliimu, wabula mu bwetoowaze nga buli muntu agulumiza munne okusinga bwe mwegulumiza mwekka” (Abafiripi 2:3). Oluvannyuma n’atusonga ku Yesu: “Mubengamu endowooza eri eyali mu Kristo Yesu, ye newaakubadde nga yali mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, Teyeerowooza kwenkanankana ne Katonda, wabula yeewaayo n’afuuka ng’omuddu, era n’azaalibwa ng’omuntu, era n’alabikira mu kifaananyi ky’omuntu, ne yeetoowaza, n’aba muwulize n’okutuukira ddala ku kufa, ate okufa okw’okukomererwa ku musaalaba” (Abafiripi 2:5-8).

Ekiremba mu kisenge ekya waggulu kyali kifaananyi kitono eky’ekintu ekisingawo ennyo obunene. Omwana wa Katonda yava mu ggulu n’akka, n’afuuka omuntu, n’abeera ng’omuweereza, n’afiira ku musaalaba. Eyo y’engeri obulamu bwe bwonna gye bwali: wansi, ne wansi, ne wansi nate, ku lwaffe.

Oluvannyuma Pawulo n’awandiika nti, “Katonda kyeyava amugulumiza, n’amuwa erinnya erisinga amannya gonna” (Abafiripi 2:9). Ekkubo erigenda waggulu mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda lye kkubo erikka wansi. Yesu yayigiriza kino emirundi n’emirundi: “Naye buli alyegulumiza alikkakkanyizibwa, na buli alyetoowaza aligulumizibwa” (Matayo 23:12). Peetero yayiga eky’okuyiga kino n’akiyisa eri abalala: “Noolwekyo mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda ogw’amaanyi, naye alibagulumiza ng’obudde butuuse” (1 Peetero 5:6). Omukulembeze omuweereza tagezaako kwegulumiza. Ekyo akirekera Katonda.

Obukulembeze obw’okuweereza bye butali

Ebigambo “obukulembeze obw’okuweereza” bikozesebwa nnyo leero ne kiba nti biyinza okufiirwa amakulu gaabyo. Noolwekyo kiyamba okwogera bye butali.

Si bunafu. Yesu yanaaza ebigere, naye era yagoba abawaanyisa ssente mu yeekaalu. Yali muteefu eri abamenyese, naye yayogeranga n’amaanyi eri abakulembeze b’eddiini ab’amalala. Omukulembeze omuweereza asobola okuba omunywevu, okwogera ebintu ebizibu n’okusalawo ebintu ebizibu. Ekibuuzo kiri kino: banoonya bulungi bwa ani?

Si kukola buli kintu abantu kye baagala. Yesu yaweereza ebyetaago by’abantu, so si bulijjo bye baali beegomba. Ebibiina bwe byayagala okumufuula kabaka lwa maanyi, “n’addayo yekka ku lusozi” (Yokaana 6:15). Abantu b’ekibuga ekimu bwe baayagala asigale nabo, yagamba nti, “Tugende awalala mu byalo ebituliraanye, n’abeeyo mbabuulire” (Makko 1:38). Omukulembeze omuweereza awuliriza abantu, naye aweereza ekigendererwa kya Katonda gye bali, ne bwe baba nga tebannakitegeera.

Si kugaana kukulembera. Abantu abamu bakozesa obwetoowaze ng’ekyekwaso okwewala obuvunaanyizibwa. Tebasalawo kintu, tebanenya muntu yenna era tebalaga kkubo. Ekyo si kuweereza. Ekisibo ekitaliiko musumba kisaasaana. Oluusi ekintu ekisingayo okulaga okwagala omukulembeze ky’asobola okukola kwe kukulembera mu ngeri etegeerekeka obulungi.

Si kukola buli kintu wekka. Omukulembeze omuweereza tekimwetaagisa kukola buli mulimu mu kkanisa. Yesu yatendeka abalala n’abatuma. Musa yayiga okugabana omulimu n’abalala. Okuweereza abantu obulungi emirundi mingi kitegeeza okutendeka abalala n’okubeesiga okuweereza awamu naawe. Kino tujja kukitunuulira mu Kitundu eky’Okutaano.

Obukulembeze obw’okuweereza bye buli

Mu ngeri ey’obulungi, obukulembeze obw’okuweereza butegeeza waakiri ebintu bino.

  • Okukozesa obuyinza ku lw’abalala. Buli mukulembeze alina obuyinza obumu, k’abe obuyinza okusalawo, okwogera, okuyingiza abantu oba okubaggyamu. Omukulembeze omuweereza yeebuuza nti, “Nnyinza ntya okukozesa obuyinza buno olw’obulungi bw’abantu be nkulembera?”
  • Okulaba ebyetaago. Yesu yalaba ebigere ebirimu enfuufu abalala bonna bye baali tebafaako. Omukulembeze omuweereza alaba omuntu ali mu kiwuubaalo, amaka agalumwa enjala, n’omukkiriza omuto ali mu kulwanagana n’ebizibu.
  • Okuba omwetegefu okukola emirimu egya wansi. Tewali mulimu gutasaanira mukulembeze muweereza. Ajja kwera wansi, ateeketeeke entebe, akyalire abalwadde ekiro, era atuule n’abo abali kumpi okufa. Ebyo tabikola kulabibwa, wabula kubanga byetaaga okukolebwa.
  • Okufuula abalala abakulu. Omukulembeze ow’ensi ayagala abeere omuntu asinga obukulu mu kisenge. Omukulembeze omuweereza ayagala abalala bakule, bakozese ebirabo byabwe, era wadde okumusinga mu kukola obulungi.
  • Okukulembera ng’oli ekyokulabirako. Yesu yagamba nti, “Mbalaze ekyokulabirako” (Yokaana 13:15). Omukulembeze omuweereza tasaba balala kukola ekyo ye ky’atayagala kukola.
  • Okwewaayo ye kennyini, so si mulimu gwe gwokka. Pawulo yagamba abakkiriza b’e Sessaloniika nti, “ne tusanyuka okubatuusaako si Enjiri ya Katonda yokka naye n’okuwaayo emyoyo gyaffe ffe, kubanga mwafuuka baagalwa baffe” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:8).

Amannya ag’ekitiibwa n’okuweebwa ekitiibwa

Mu mawanga mangi, abakulembeze baweebwa ekitiibwa kingi. Abantu bayimirira bwe bayingira. Baweebwa entebe esinga obulungi n’emmere esinga obulungi. Bayitibwa amannya ag’ekitiibwa ennyo. Kino kikyamu?

Bayibuli eyigiriza nti abakulembeze basaanidde okussibwamu ekitiibwa. Pawulo yagamba abakkiriza b’e Sessaloniika nti “mumanye abafuba okukola emirimu mu mmwe era ababakulembera mu Mukama waffe” era nti “mubassengamu nnyo ekitiibwa mu kwagala olw’omulimu gwabwe” (1 Abasessaloniika 5:12-13). Kirungi ekkanisa okussa ekitiibwa mu bakulembeze baayo abeesigwa, era kirungi omukulembeze okukkiriza ekitiibwa ekyo n’obuwombeefu.

Naye waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w’okuweebwa ekitiibwa n’okukiyaayaanira. Yesu yalabula abayigirizwa be obutayagala mannya ga kitiibwa: “Temweyitanga ‘Labbi,’ kubanga Katonda yekka ye Muyigiriza wammwe, naye mmwe muli baaluganda” (Matayo 23:8). Obulabe tebuli mu linnya lyennyini. Obulabe buli mu mutima ogulyetaaga. Kino kye kigezo ekirungi: owulira otya bw’otaweebwa kitiibwa ky’osuubira?
