Bw’owulira obusungu oba nga olumiddwa, omutima gwo guyinza okuba nga gwesigamye ku kifo kyo okusinga ku Kristo.

Tumaze okusisinkana abakulembeze babiri abaategeera kino. Gregory, omulabirizi w’e Rooma, yeeyitanga “omuweereza w’abaweereza ba Katonda” (Essuula 2). Samuel Ajayi Crowther yasaba okuyitibwanga “Omulabirizi Ow’ekitiibwa (Right Reverend Bishop), so si Mukama wange (My Lord)” (Essuula 4). Bombi baalina ebifo ebya waggulu. Bombi baagaana ebifo ebyo okubaleetera amalala.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Hudson Taylor ne William Burns

Mu 1855, omuminsani omuto Omungereza ayitibwa Hudson Taylor yali akolera mu China. Yalina emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu gyokka. Abaminsani abaava ebweru mu biseera ebyo baayambalanga engoye za Bulaaya, baabeeranga mu bitundu by’abagwira mu bibuga ebiri ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, era bwe baatambulanga ebibiina by’abantu byabagobereranga nga bibeekaliriza olw’endabika yaabwe ey’enjawulo. Taylor yakizuula nti ebibiina ebyo byakaluubyanga okubuulira era byakaluubyanga okwanirizibwa mu maka g’abantu.

N’olwekyo yasalawo ekintu ekyewuunyisa ennyo Abazungu banne bangi. Yayambala engoye z’Abachina n’abeera, nga bwe kyasoboka, mu ngeri abantu abaali bamwetoolodde gye baabeeramu. Teyakikola kulabika ng’omugezi. Yakikola okuggyawo ekisenge ekyali wakati we n’abantu be yali azze okuweereza. Mu katabo ke akatono A Retrospect (Okutunula Emabega), yawandiika mu bigambo ebyangu nti: “Twazuula emiganyulo mingi egyava mu kukyusa engoye zino; era nze, n’abasinga obungi ku abo abaakolanga nange, tweyongedde okwambala engoye z’ekinnansi.” Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka, ekibiina China Inland Mission kye yatandikawo kyasaba abaminsani baakyo bonna okukola bwe batyo.

Mangu ddala oluvannyuma, Taylor yatambula okumala emyezi egiwerako n’omuminsani omukulu ayitibwa William Burns, omubuulizi Omuskootilandi eyali yalaba dda okuzuukuka mu Scotland ne mu Canada. Burns yali mukulu, nga mumanyifu nnyo, era ng’alina obumanyirivu bungi nnyo okusinga Taylor. Naye yeetegerezanga ebyabangawo nga batambula bombi. Taylor oluvannyuma yakijjukira bwe kiti:

“Mw. Burns mu kiseera ekyo yali ayambala engoye z’Abangereza; naye yalaba nti newankubadde nga nze nali muto era nga mu buli ngeri sirina bumanyirivu bwe nnyini, nze nafunanga abawulizi abasirifu, ye ng’agobererwa abalenzi abatalina mpisa n’abo abaali baagala okulaba obulabi nga tebafaayo; nti nze nayitibwanga mu maka g’abantu, ye nga bamwetondera nti ekibiina ekyandimugoberedde kyabalemesa okumuyita. Oluvannyuma lwa wiiki ezimu ng’alaba bino, naye yatandika okwambala engoye z’ekinnansi.”

— Hudson Taylor, A Retrospect

Mu bigambo ebyangu: omubuulizi omukulu era omumanyifu yalaba nti omuvubuka yali ayanirizibwa mu maka, ye nga tayanirizibwa. N’olwekyo ne yeetoowaza n’agoberera ekyokulabirako ky’omuvubuka oyo. Mu bbaluwa gye yaweereza ewaabwe, Burns yawandiika nti yali amalirizza nti “kyali kinsaanira okugoberera ekyokulabirako kye.”

Abasajja bombi batulaga ekintu ku bukulembeze obw’okuweereza. Taylor yalekayo okwesiima n’ekitiibwa eky’okulabika ng’Omuzungu asobole okuweereza Abachina. Burns yali mwetegefu okuyiga okuva ku muntu amusinga obuto era atalina bumanyirivu bwe nnyini. Tewali n’omu ku bo eyafaayo ku kulabika ng’omukulu. Baafaayo ku bantu be baali bazze okutuukako. Kino Pawulo kye yali ategeeza bwe yawandiika nti, “Kubanga newaakubadde nga ndi wa ddembe eri abantu bonna, nfuuka omuddu wa bonna olw’okweyagalira, ndyoke ndeete bangi eri Kristo” (1 Abakkolinso 9:19).

Obukulembeze obw’okuweereza tebulabika bulijjo ng’okukyusa engoye. Josephine Bakhita, eyali omuddu okuva mu Sudan eyafuuka omubiikira mu Yitale, yamala emyaka mingi ng’afumbira era ng’omukuumi w’omulyango gw’ennyumba y’ababiikira. Yalamusanga buli mugenyi n’ekisa. Bwe yafa mu 1947, ebibiina by’abantu byajja okumukungubagira, kubanga abantu bangi nnyo baali bajjukira engeri gye yabaanirizangamu. Obukulembeze obw’okuweereza obusinga obungi bulabika bwe butyo: ebikolwa ebitono eby’okwagala n’obwesigwa, ebiddiŋŋanwa okumala emyaka, okutuusa ekitundu kyonna lwe kibumbibwa olw’ebikolwa ebyo.

Kwata ekiremba

Ensi epima abakulembeze okusinziira ku bantu bameka ababaweereza. Yesu apima abakulembeze okusinziira ku bantu bameka be baweereza. Ku nkomerero y’olugero, Yesu yagamba nti, “Bwe mumanya ebintu bino muba n’omukisa bwe mubikola” (Yokaana 13:17). Omukisa tegujja lwa kumanya bumanya ku bukulembeze obw’okuweereza. Gujja lwa kubukola.

Ekiremba kyo kiri ludda wa? Ebbensani yo eri ludda wa? Baani abantu abakwetoolodde nga “ebigere” byabwe byetaaga okunaazibwa: emirimu egitaagalibwa muntu yenna, ebyetaago ebitalabibwa muntu yenna, abantu abatakyalirwa muntu yenna? Awo obukulembeze obw’okuweereza we butandikira.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Yesu yanaaza abayigirizwa ebigere kubanga “yamanya nti Kitaawe yateeka byonna mu mikono gye”. Okumanya ggwe ani mu Kristo kukufuula kutya ow’eddembe okuweereza?
  • Peetero teyayagala Yesu amunaaze ebigere. Kikuzibuwalira okuleka abalala okukuweereza? Lwaki?
  • Soma Lukka 22:24-27. Olaba wa okuvuganya ku bifo mu kkanisa yo oba mu kibinja kyo? Okulaba wa mu mutima gwo?
  • Ku bintu ebina obukulembeze obw’okuweereza bye butali (obunafu, okukola abantu kye baagala, okugaana okukulembera, okukola buli kintu wekka), kiruwa ekisinga okuba eky’obulabe gy’oli?
  • Owulira otya bw’otaweebwa kitiibwa oba bw’otassibwamu kitiibwa ky’osuubira? Ekyo kiraga ki?
  • William Burns yayiga okuva ku musajja eyali amusinga obuto era atalina bumanyirivu bwe nnyini. Ani gw’oyinza okuyigirako, ne bw’aba ng’akusinga obuto oba nga si mukulu nga ggwe?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Noonya omulimu ogwa wansi mu kkanisa yo, mu maka go oba ku mulimu gwo ogutera okulekerwa abalala, oba ogutakolebwa muntu yenna. Wiiki eno, gukole ggwe kennyini, mu kasirise, waakiri emirundi ebiri. Bw’oba ng’olina erinnya ery’ekitiibwa oba entebe ey’enjawulo, londa omulundi gumu ogireke awatali kunnyonnyola. Oluvannyuma soma nate Yokaana 13:1-17 era osabe Mukama akulage ky’ayagala oyige.

study_questions.question: Yesu yayigiriza ki bwe yanaaza abayigirizwa be ebigere?
study_questions.answer: Nti abakulembeze ab’amazima baweereza. “Yesu bwe yamanya nti Kitaawe yateeka byonna mu mikono gye”, yeesiba ettawulo n’abanaaza ebigere (Yokaana 13:3-4). Yagamba nti, “Mmwe mumpita Muyigiriza era Mukama wammwe, mukola bulungi okumpita bwe mutyo,” era n’abagamba bakolenga nga ye bw’abakoze (Yokaana 13:13-15).

study_questions.question: Obukulembeze obw’okuweereza kye ki?
study_questions.answer: Kwe kukulembera nga Yesu bwe yakulembera: “N’Omwana w’Omuntu, teyajja ku nsi kuweerezebwa, wabula okuweereza abalala, era n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe” (Makko 10:45). Si bunafu wadde okukola buli kintu abantu kye baagala; kwe kukozesa obuyinza olw’obulungi bw’abalala, ne bwe kiba nga kitufiiriza.

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze basaanidde okwegendereza ku mannya ag’ekitiibwa n’okuweebwa ekitiibwa?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga amannya ag’ekitiibwa gasobola okuliisa amalala ne gateeka abakulembeze waggulu w’abantu be baweereza. Yesu yalabula abayigirizwa be obutanoonya kitiibwa na bifo, n’abalaga ekkubo erisingako obulungi ng’akozesa ekiremba n’ebbensani, n’agattako nti, “Bwe mumanya ebintu bino muba n’omukisa bwe mubikola” (Yokaana 13:17).

fields.title: Obuyinza wansi w’Obuyinza
fields.body_html:
“Nange waliwo abakulu abantwala, ate nga nange nnina be nfuga. Bwe ndagira omu nti, ‘Genda,’ agenda, n’omulala nti, ‘Jjangu,’ era ajja.”

— Matayo 8:9

Lumu omukulu w’abaserikale Omuruumi yajja eri Yesu okumusaba obuyambi. Omuweereza we yali mulwadde nnyo, kumpi okufa. Yesu yeewaayo okugenda ewuwe, naye omukulu w’abaserikale n’agamba nti tekyali kyetaagisa: “Mukama, sisaanira kukuyingiza mu nnyumba yange, yogera bwogezi ekigambo, omulenzi wange anaawona!” (Matayo 8:8). Oluvannyuma n’annyonnyola lwaki yali mukakafu bw’atyo: “Kubanga nange waliwo abakulu abantwala, ate nga nange nnina be nfuga” (Matayo 8:9).

Yesu yeewuunya nnyo. Yagamba nti yali tannalaba kukkiriza nga kuno wonna wonna mu Isirayiri. Omukulu w’abaserikale, omugwira era omuserikale, yali ategedde ekintu abantu bangi ab’eddiini kye baali bataategeera. Yali amanyi nti obuyinza bwe yalina ku baserikale be bwava mu kuba nti naye yali wansi w’obuyinza bwa Rooma. Era yalaba nti ne Yesu yalina obuyinza, obuyinza obusingira ddala obunene, obwava eri Katonda.

Essuula eno yogera ku buyinza. Buli mukulembeze alina obuyinza obumu, era buli mukulembeze akemebwa okubukozesa obubi. Eky’okuyiga ekikulu mu kukkiriza kw’omuserikale oyo kye kino: abo bokka abali wansi w’obuyinza be basobola okukwata obuyinza mu ngeri entuufu.

Obuyinza bwonna bwa Kristo

Oluvannyuma lw’okuzuukira kwe, Yesu yasisinkana abayigirizwa be ku lusozi mu Ggaliraaya n’agamba nti, “Mpeereddwa obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi” (Matayo 28:18). Eyo ye ntandikwa ya byonna Bayibuli by’eyigiriza ku bukulembeze. Obuyinza bwonna bwa Yesu. Buli buyinza obulala bwonna, mu maka, mu kkanisa, mu ggwanga, bwewole okuva gy’ali.

N’abantu abasingayo amaanyi ku nsi balina buyinza bwewole bwokka. Piraato, gavana Omuruumi, bwe yagamba Yesu nti yalina obuyinza okumuta oba okumukomerera, Yesu yamuddamu nti, “Tewandibadde na buyinza ku Nze n’akatono, singa tebukuweebwa kuva waggulu” (Yokaana 19:11). Piraato yalowooza nti obuyinza bwe bwali bubwe. Tebwali bubwe. Bwali bumuweereddwa, era yali wa kubuvunaanyizibwa olw’engeri gye yabukozesaamu.

Obanga ekyo kyali kituufu ku gavana Omuruumi, kale kisingawo nnyo okuba ekituufu ku musumba, ku mukadde w’ekkanisa oba ku mukulembeze w’ekibinja! Obuyinza bwonna bw’olina si ggwe wabutonda. Bwakuweebwa. Bwa Kristo, era obukutte ku lulwe.

Yesu yabeera wansi w’obuyinza

Kyewuunyisa nti Yesu yennyini, alina obuyinza bwonna, yabeera mu bulamu bwe obw’oku nsi wansi w’obuyinza bwa Kitaawe. Yagamba nti, “Omwana taliiko ky’akola ku bubwe, wabula ekyo ky’alaba Kitaawe ng’akola” (Yokaana 5:19). Yagamba nti, “Nze sibayigiriza byange ku bwange, wabula eby’oyo eyantuma” (Yokaana 7:16). Mu lusuku lw’e Gesusemane yasaba nti, “Naye si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa” (Lukka 22:42).

Ebibiina byakiraba nti Yesu yayogeranga mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku bayigiriza baabwe ab’eddiini: “yabayigiriza nga nannyini buyinza, so si ng’abannyonnyozi b’amateeka baabwe bwe baayigirizanga” (Matayo 7:29). Abannyonnyozi b’amateeka baajulizanga abayigiriza abalala okunyweza endowooza zaabwe. Yesu yayogeranga ng’Oyo amanyi amazima okuva eri Katonda. Naye obuyinza bwe bwava ddala mu buwulize bwe obutuukiridde eri Kitaawe. Ye yali omuntu asingayo okuba ow’eddembe era asingayo okuba omuwulize eyali abaddewo.

Kino kye kyokulabirako eri buli mukulembeze ow’omwoyo. Obuyinza bwaffe bukula ng’obuwulize bwaffe bwe bukula. Omukulembeze atagondera Katonda talina buyinza bwa mwoyo bwa ddala, ne bwe kiba nti erinnya lye ery’ekitiibwa ligamba ki.

Obuyinza obw’omwoyo kye buli

Pawulo yali mutume eyalina obuyinza obwa ddala ku kkanisa ze yatandikawo. Naye yeegenderezanga okwogera obuyinza obwo kye bwali bugendererwa. Yayogera ku “obuyinza bwe tulina, Mukama bwe yatuwa olw’okubazimba so si lwa kubassa wansi” (2 Abakkolinso 10:8). Yakiddamu oluvannyuma mu bbaluwa y’emu: teyayagala kubakambuwalira “okusinziira ku buyinza Mukama bwe yampa okubazimba, so si okubazikiriza” (2 Abakkolinso 13:10).

Kino kituwa ekigezo ekyangu eri buli ngeri yonna obuyinza gye bukozesebwamu. Buzimba abantu, oba bubassa wansi? Bubayamba okukula mu Kristo, oba bubafuula abatono, abatiitiizi era abeesigama ku mukulembeze? Obuyinza obussa abantu wansi olw’omuganyulo gw’omukulembeze si buyinza bwa mwoyo, ne bwe kiba nti ebigambo by’omukulembeze biwulikika ng’eby’omwoyo ennyo.

Obuyinza obw’omwoyo tebuva mu kukaka. Si maanyi ga kubonereza, kutiisatiisa oba kufuga bantu. Buva waakiri mu bintu bina bino:

  • Ekigambo kya Katonda. Omukulembeze ayigiriza Bayibuli n’obwesigwa aba n’obuyinza bwa Bayibuli. Bw’ayogera Katonda bye yayogera, abantu basaanidde okuwuliriza, si olw’okuba omukulembeze y’ani, wabula olw’okuba Katonda y’ani.
  • Obulamu obw’okutya Katonda. Abantu beesiga abakulembeze abalina obulamu obukwatagana n’ebigambo byabwe. Peetero yagamba abakadde nti, “mubakulemberenga nga mubalaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi” (1 Peetero 5:3). Ekyokulabirako kirina obuyinza bungi okusinga ekiragiro.
  • Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Obuyinza obw’omwoyo si kintu kye tusobola kwekolera. Bujja Omwoyo bw’akolera mu mukulembeze okukyusa obulamu bw’abantu.
  • Okukkirizibwa Ekkanisa. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 4, Okuyitibwa kwa Katonda, Katonda atera okukakasa abakulembeze ng’ayitira mu bantu be. Omukulembeze ekkanisa gw’egezesezza n’emulonda aba n’obuyinza bw’okulondebwa okwo.

Obuyinza bunnya obuli waggulu wa buli mukulembeze

Obanga abo bokka abali wansi w’obuyinza be basobola okubukwata mu ngeri entuufu, twetaaga okwebuuza: omukulembeze Omukristaayo ayimiridde wansi w’obuyinza ki? Bayibuli eraga waakiri obuyinza buna.

1. Wansi wa Kristo. Ye Mutwe gw’Ekkanisa era Omusumba Omukulu. Buli kusalawo omukulembeze kw’akola kusaanidde kukolebwa ng’omuweereza we. Omukulembeze asaanidde okwebuuza buli kiseera nti, “Mukama, kino ky’oyagala?”

2. Wansi w’Ebyawandiikibwa. Tewali mukulembeze ali waggulu wa Bayibuli. Ne mu Ndagaano Enkadde, kabaka wa Isirayiri yalagirwa okwewandiikira kkopi ye ey’amateeka ga Katonda, era “anaakisomanga ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwe … nga teyeekulumbaza kusukkirira ku bannansi banne” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 17:19-20). Pawulo yagamba nti ne bw’aba ye yennyini, oba malayika ava mu ggulu, bw’abuulira Enjiri endala, “akolimirwenga” (Abaggalatiya 1:8). Omukulembeze tasaanidde n’akatono kwongera ku Kigambo kya Katonda, kukiggyako kintu, wadde okwegamba nti alina okubikkulirwa okw’ekyama okukisinga. “Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu byonna, Katonda ye yabiruŋŋamya nga biwandiikibwa, era bigasa mu kuyigiriza, mu kunenya, mu kuluŋŋamya ne mu kubuuliranga omuntu abe omutuukirivu” (2 Timoseewo 3:16). Ekyo kizingiramu n’okunenya omukulembeze n’okumuluŋŋamya.

3. Wansi w’Ekkanisa ne bakulembeze banne. Tewali mukulembeze mu Ndagaano Empya eyali yeekolera ky’ayagala. Pawulo, omutume omukulu, yagenda e Yerusaalemi okwanjulira abakulembeze abalala Enjiri gye yabuuliranga, nga bwe yagamba, “si kulwa nga nteganira bwereere” (Abaggalatiya 2:2). Ekibuuzo ekikulu bwe kyajjawo ku Njiri, “abatume n’abakadde b’Ekkanisa ne bakuŋŋaana bateese ku nsonga eyo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:6). Ne Peetero, omutume eyali akulembera abalala, yanenyezebwa: Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Naye Peetero ate era nga ye Keefa, bwe yajja mu Antiyokiya ne mmunenya mu lwatu kubanga yali mukyamu” (Abaggalatiya 2:11). Buli mukulembeze yeetaaga abantu abasobola okumubuuza ebibuuzo, okumunenya, era bwe kiba kyetaagisa, okumuggya mu kifo.

4. Wansi w’abafuzi b’ensi. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Buli muntu awulirenga abafuzi, kubanga tewali buyinza butava eri Katonda” (Abaruumi 13:1). Abakulembeze Abakristaayo basaanidde okugondera amateeka, okusasula emisolo n’okusabira abali mu gavumenti. Naye obuyinza buno bulina ekkomo. Abafuzi b’e Yerusaalemi bwe baalagira abatume okulekera awo okubuulira ku Yesu, “Peetero n’abatume ne baddamu nti, ‘Kitugwanira okugondera Katonda okusinga okugondera abantu’” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:29). Obuyinza bw’abantu bwe bulagira Katonda ky’agaana, oba bwe bugaana Katonda ky’alagira, tulina okugondera Katonda ne tukkiriza omuwendo gwe tusasula. Kino tujja kukitunuulira nnyo mu Ssuula 40, Okuyigganyizibwa n’Omuwendo Ogusasulwa.

Wano waliwo ekibuuzo buli mukulembeze ky’asaanidde okwebuuza: Ani ayinza okuŋŋamba nti nedda? Bwe kiba nti eky’okuddamu eky’amazima kiri nti “tewali”, oli mu bulabe bunene. Omukulembeze atalina gw’avunaanyizibwa gy’ali amangu ddala ajja kutandika okukola ebibi, era tewali ajja kumuziyiza.

Obulabe bubiri obukontana

Bayibuli erabula ku bibi bibiri ebikontana: okujeemera obuyinza obw’okutya Katonda, n’okukozesa obubi obuyinza abo ababulina.

Okujeema. Mu ddungu, omusajja ayitibwa Koola yakuŋŋaanya ekibinja okwolekera Musa ne Alooni. Baagamba nti, “Mwekulumbaza nnyo! Ekibiina kyonna, buli omu mu kyo mutukuvu, ne Mukama Katonda ali nabo. Kale, lwaki mwekulumbaliza ku kibiina ky’abantu ba Mukama?” (Okubala 16:3). Ebigambo byabwe byawulikika ng’eby’omwoyo, naye emitima gyabwe gyali gijjudde obuggya. Emabegako, muganda wa Musa ne mwannyina, Alooni ne Miryamu, baali boogedde ku Musa mu ngeri y’emu. Bayibuli egattako ekigambo ekyewuunyisa: “Musa yali musajja muwombeefu nnyo, nga muteefu okusinga abantu bonna abaali ku nsi” (Okubala 12:3). Musa teyeewolereza. Katonda ye yamuwolereza.

Dawudi yalaga omwoyo ogw’enjawulo. Kabaka Sawulo yali agezaako okumutta, era emirundi ebiri Dawudi yafuna omukisa okusooka okutta Sawulo. Emirundi gyombi yagaana: “Kikafuuwe nze okugolola omukono gwange okutta oyo Mukama gwe yafukako amafuta” (1 Samwiri 26:11). Dawudi yalekera Katonda okwekolera ku Sawulo.

Ebbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya egamba abakkiriza nti, “Muwulirenga abakulembeze bammwe era mubagonderenga, kubanga obuweereza bwabwe kwe kulabirira emyoyo gyammwe, balyoke bakikole n’essanyu nga tebeemulugunya” (Abaebbulaniya 13:17). Ekkanisa buli kiseera eyemulugunya ku bakulembeze baayo, buli kiseera ebasika wansi era buli kiseera enoonya omulala asinga, efuula omulimu gwabwe omugugu. Abasumba bangi abeesigwa bamenyese olw’ekyo.

Okukozesa obubi obuyinza. Naye obulabe obukontana n’obwo nabwo bwa ddala. Omutume Yokaana yawandiika ku mukulembeze w’ekkanisa ayitibwa Diyotuleefe, eyali akola ebyo “olw’okwagala okwefuula omukulembeze” (3 Yokaana 9). Diyotuleefe yagaana okwaniriza ababaka ba Yokaana, n’asaasaanya ebigambo ebibi ku mutume, era “Takoma ku kugaana kwaniriza abooluganda abatambuze kyokka, naye n’okulagira alagira abantu abalala nabo, baleme okubaaniriza era abo ababaaniriza agezaako okubagoba mu Kkanisa” (3 Yokaana 10). Yayisa ekkanisa ng’obwakabaka bwe ku bubwe. Tewali yali asobola kumubuuza kibuuzo, era buli eyakkiriziganya naye nga agobebwa.

Eky’ennaku, waliwo abakulembeze nga Diyotuleefe mu buli mulembe ne mu buli nsi. Okussa ekitiibwa mu bakulembeze tekusaanidde n’akatono kufuuka kibikka ku kibi. Dawudi yagaana okutta Sawulo, naye teyeefuula nga Sawulo yali mutuufu, era teyasigala awo okuttibwa. Bayibuli tesaba n’akatono bakkiriza kugondera mukulembeze abalagira okukola ekibi, wadde okusirika ku kutulugunyizibwa. Ensonga eno enzibu tujja kugitunuulira mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu.

Okugenda mu Buziba: Engeri ekkanisa gye zitegekebwamu

Abakristaayo okuva edda tebakkiriziganya ku ngeri obuyinza gye busaanidde okutegekebwamu mu kkanisa. Ekkanisa ezimu zikulemberwa abalabirizi, abalabirira ebibiina bingi. Endala zikulemberwa ebibinja by’abakadde, nga waggulu waabwe waliwo enkuŋŋaana ennene. Endala zikulemberwa buli kibiina ky’ekitundu kyonna awamu. Buli emu ku nnono zino efuna obuwagizi mu Bayibuli ne mu byafaayo by’Ekkanisa, era abantu abatya Katonda baweerezza mu zonna.

Abakulembeze ab’edda nga Ignatius ow’e Antiyokiya, eyawandiika mu mwaka nga AD 110, baawa omulabirizi ekitiibwa kinene ng’ensibuko y’obumu mu buli kibuga. Abalala basoma Endagaano Empya nga ekozesa “omukadde” ne “omulabirizi” ku kifo kye kimu. Endowooza zino ojja kuzisanga nga zinnyonnyoddwa mu bwenkanya mu Kyongerezeddwako A (Essuula 53). Mu ssuula eno, ekikulu kye kyo ennono zonna kye zikkiriziganyaako: buli mukulembeze ali wansi wa Kristo ne wansi w’Ekigambo kye, era tewali mukulembeze asaanidde kuba nga tasobola kunenyezebwa.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Clement ne Ignatius

Awo nga mu AD 96, ekkanisa y’e Kkolinso, mu Buyonaani, yafuna obuzibu. Ekibinja ekitono eky’abakkiriza kyali kigobye abakadde abaali bakulembedde ekkanisa n’obwesigwa okumala emyaka mingi. Ekkanisa y’e Rooma yakiwulira n’eweereza ebbaluwa empanvu, gye tumanyi leero nga Ebbaluwa Esooka eya Clement eri Abakkolinso. Y’emu ku biwandiiko by’Abakristaayo ebisingayo obukadde ebitali mu Ndagaano Empya.

Ebbaluwa eyo terimu busungu. Ejjudde Ebyawandiikibwa, era eyita Abakkolinso okwetoowaza, emirundi n’emirundi. Ebalaga Kristo, Ibulayimu, Musa ne Dawudi ng’ebyokulabirako by’abantu abeetoowaze. Oluvannyuma n’eyogera lwatu ku ebyo ebyali bibaddewo:

“Kya buswavu, abaagalwa, weewaawo, kya buswavu nnyo, era tekisaanira bulamu bwammwe obw’Ekikristaayo, okuwulirwa ekintu ng’ekyo nti Ekkanisa ey’Abakkolinso esinga obunywevu era ey’edda ennyo, olw’omuntu omu oba babiri, ejeemera abakadde baayo.”

— Ebbaluwa Esooka eya Clement eri Abakkolinso

Mu bigambo ebyangu: kya nsonyi ekkanisa ey’amaanyi era ey’edda okujeemera abakadde baayo olw’omuntu omu oba babiri. Ebbaluwa ennyonnyola nti abakadde abeesigwa “abaweerereza ekisibo kya Kristo awatali kya kunenyezebwa, mu mwoyo omuwombeefu, ogw’emirembe era ogutenoonyeza byagwo” tebasaanidde kugobebwa. Naye tekoma ku kuwagira abo abalina obuyinza. Eyita abaleeta emitawaana okwenenya, era ekubiriza buli muntu, n’abakulembeze nabo, okwagala n’okwetoowaza. Era ereeta n’ekirowoozo nti buli muntu aleeta enjawukana asaanidde okuba omwetegefu okuvaawo, ekisibo kya Kristo kisobole okuba mu mirembe.

Nga wayise emyaka nga kkumi n’etaano, omukulembeze omulala yawandiikira omuto ebbaluwa ennyimpi. Ignatius, omulabirizi w’e Antiyokiya mu Busuuli, yali atwalibwa e Rooma ng’akuumibwa okuttibwa olw’okukkiriza kwe. Ng’ali mu kkubo yawandiikira Polycarp, omulabirizi omuto ow’e Sumuna, mu nsi eyitibwa leero Turkey. Amagezi ge yamuwa galaga obuyinza obw’engeri ki omukulembeze Omukristaayo bw’asaanidde okuba nabwo:

“Faayo ku bumu, kubanga tewali kibusinga. Wanirira abantu bonna, nga Mukama naye bw’akuwanirira. Gumiikiriza abantu bonna mu kwagala, nga bw’okola. Weewe okusaba okutakoma. Saba amagezi amangi okusinga g’olina. … Yimirira nga onywedde, ng’ekyuma omuweesi kw’aweesera bwe kikubibwa. … Bannamwandu baleme kulagajjalirwa. Oluvannyuma lwa Mukama, ggwe beera omukuumi waabwe. … Noonya abantu bonna ng’obayita amannya gaabwe. Tonyoomanga baddu, oba basajja oba bakazi.”

— Ignatius ow’e Antiyokiya, Ebbaluwa eri Polycarp

Mu bigambo ebyangu: kuuma obumu bw’ekkanisa, kubanga tewali kisinga bwo. Gumiikiriza buli muntu, nga Mukama bw’akugumiikiriza. Saba awatali kukoma. Saba Katonda akuwe amagezi agasinga g’olina. Yimirira ng’onywedde, ng’essasi ly’ekyuma erikubibwa emirundi n’emirundi naye ne litamenyeka. Kuuma bannamwandu. Manya buli muntu erinnya lye. Tonyooma baddu.

Buno bwe buyinza obw’omwoyo nga Ekkanisa ey’edda bwe yabutegeeranga. Bunywevu, ng’essasi, okuyigiriza okw’obulimba bwe kulumba. Naye bugonvu, bugumiikiriza era bwetoowaze. Bukuuma abantu abasingayo obunafu mu kkanisa. Bumanya abantu amannya gaabwe. Polycarp yakwata amagezi gano mu mutima. Yakulembera ekkanisa y’e Sumuna okumala emyaka mingi, era, nga bwe tujja okulaba oluvannyuma mu kitabo kino, yafa nga mujulizi, nga mwesigwa okutuuka ku nkomerero.

Wansi w’obuyinza, ku lw’abalala

Omukulu w’abaserikale Omuruumi yagamba nti, “nange waliwo abakulu abantwala.” Awo buli mukulembeze Omukristaayo w’asaanidde okuyimirira. Tuli wansi wa Kristo, wansi w’Ekigambo kye, wansi w’Ekkanisa ye, era, okutuuka omuntu ow’omunda gy’akkiriza, wansi w’abafuzi b’ensi. Okuva mu kifo ekyo, tusobola okukozesa obuyinza bwe twaweebwa nga Yesu bwe yakola: okuzimba so si kussa wansi, okukuuma so si kunyigiriza, okuweereza so si kuweerezebwa.

Kino kye kifundikira Ekitundu Ekisooka. Tulabye ekifuula obukulembeze okuba obw’omwoyo, tusisinkanye Omusumba Omukulu, tulowoozezza ku kuyitibwa kwa Katonda, tukutte ekiremba, era tuyize okuyimirira wansi w’obuyinza. Mu Kitundu eky’Okubiri tuva ku kuyitibwa ne tudda ku mutima. Empisa esooka ey’omutima gw’omukulembeze y’eyo esobozesa endala zonna: obwetoowaze.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Matayo 8:5-13. Omukulu w’abaserikale Omuruumi yategeera ki ku buyinza abalala kye baali bataategeera?
  • Yesu yagamba nti, “Omwana taliiko ky’akola ku bubwe.” Obuwulize bwe eri Kitaawe bukyusa butya engeri gy’olowoozaamu ku buyinza bwo?
  • Lowooza ku mulundi ogusembayo lwe wakozesa obuyinza bwo ng’omukulembeze. Bwazimba abantu oba bwabassa wansi?
  • Ku buyinza obuna obuli waggulu wa buli mukulembeze (Kristo, Ebyawandiikibwa, Ekkanisa n’abafuzi b’ensi), buluwa bw’osanga nga businga okukuzibuwalira okugondera? Lwaki?
  • Ani ayinza okukugamba nti nedda? Bwe kiba nti tewali, onookola ki ku nsonga eyo?
  • Okemebwa nnyo okujeemera abo abakukulembera, oba okufuga abo b’okulembera? Okwenenya kwandibadde kutya?
  • Soma nate amagezi Ignatius ge yawa Polycarp. Kigambo ki ky’osinga okwetaaga okuwulira wiiki eno?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wandiika amannya g’abantu abalina obuyinza ku ggwe ng’omukulembeze: mu kkanisa yo, mu maka go ne ku mulimu gwo. Bwe kiba nti ku lukalala lwo tekuli muntu ayinza okukunenya, saba omukkiriza omukulu mu by’omwoyo wiiki eno abeere omuntu gw’osisinkana buli kiseera era alina olukusa okukubuuza ebibuuzo ebizibu. Bwe wabaawo omuntu ku lukalala lwo gw’obadde oziyiza oba gw’obadde ovumirira, musabire ng’oyogera erinnya lye buli lunaku wiiki eno, era noonya engeri emu ey’okumuyamba okukola omulimu gwe “n’essanyu nga tebeemulugunya” (Abaebbulaniya 13:17).

study_questions.question: Kitegeeza ki nti omukulembeze ali wansi w’obuyinza?
study_questions.answer: Buli mukulembeze aweereza wansi wa Kristo, eyagamba nti, “Mpeereddwa obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi” (Matayo 28:18). Ng’omukulu w’abaserikale eyagamba nti, “Kubanga nange waliwo abakulu abantwala” (Matayo 8:9), eddembe ly’omukulembeze okukulembera liva mu kuba nti ali wansi wa Katonda, wansi w’Ekigambo kye ne wansi w’Ekkanisa yonna.

study_questions.question: Yesu yalaga atya amakulu g’okubeera wansi w’obuyinza?
study_questions.answer: Yakolanga ekyo kyokka Kitaawe kye yamuwa: “Omwana taliiko ky’akola ku bubwe, wabula ekyo ky’alaba Kitaawe ng’akola” (Yokaana 5:19). Yagamba nti, “Nze sibayigiriza byange ku bwange” (Yokaana 7:16), era mu Gesusemane yasaba nti, “Naye si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa” (Lukka 22:42).

study_questions.question: Obuyinza obw’omwoyo bugendererwa ki?
study_questions.answer: Buweebwa okuzimba abantu n’okubaweereza, so si n’akatono okubafuga oba okubakozesa olw’omuganyulo gwaffe. Essuula erabula ku bulabe bubiri obukontana: abakulembeze abafuga n’obukambwe nga tebalina gwe bavunaanyizibwa gy’ali, n’abakulembeze abagaana okukulembera n’akatono.

fields.title: Obwetoowaze
fields.body_html:
“Noolwekyo mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda ogw’amaanyi, naye alibagulumiza ng’obudde butuuse.”

— 1 Peetero 5:6

Lumu omusumba omuto yabuulira okubuulira kwe okusooka mu kkanisa ennene. Yalinnya ku kituuti ng’ayimusizza omutwe waggulu, nga mukakafu nti ajja kwewuunyisa buli muntu. Naye n’abula w’atuuse, ne yeerabira ensonga ze, n’akka ng’amaaso gamyuse era ng’akwatiddwa ensonyi. Omukyala omukadde eyali awuliriza yamugamba n’ekisa oluvannyuma nti, “Singa walinnya nga bw’okkiddwa, wandikkidde nga bwe walinnye.”

Ekitundu eky’Okubiri, Omutima gw’Omukulembeze, tukitandika n’obwetoowaze, kubanga bwe ttaka buli mpisa endala ennungi mwe zikulira. Awatali bwo, ebirabo bifuuka eby’obulabe, okutuuka ku buwanguzi kufuuka omutego, n’obuyinza bufuuka okutulugunya. Ng’obulina, n’omukulembeze omunafu era owa bulijjo Katonda asobola okumukozesa ennyo.

Obwetoowaze bye butali

Abantu bangi tebategeera bulungi bwetoowaze. Balowooza nti kitegeeza okwevumirira, okugaana okutenderezebwa, oba okwefuula ng’atalina kirabo. Naye ekyo emirundi mingi kiba malala nga geebisse. Omuntu agamba nti “Sirina kye ngasa” n’alindirira abalala bamugambe nti si bwe kiri, aba akyalowooza ku ye yennyini.

Obwetoowaze si kwerowoozaako bubi. Pawulo agamba buli omu “obuteerowooza okusinga ekyo ky’asaanidde okulowooza, naye okulowoozanga nga yeegendereza” (Abaruumi 12:3). Okulowooza ng’oyegendereza kitegeeza okwerabira nga bw’oli ddala: si waggulu w’amazima, era si wansi w’amazima. Katonda bw’aba yakuwa ekirabo eky’okuyigiriza, si bwetoowaze okukyegaana. Obwetoowaze kwe kugamba nti, “Kino kirabo, era si kyange.”

Pawulo yabuuza Abakristaayo ab’amalala ab’e Kkolinso ebibuuzo bisatu ebisala: “Kubanga ani akwawula? Era mulina kye mutaaweebwa? Kale obanga ddala mwaweebwa, kiki ate ekibenyumirizisa ng’abataakifuna?” (1 Abakkolinso 4:7). Buli kye tulina, obulamu bwaffe, omukka gwe tussa, ebirabo byaffe, obulokozi bwaffe, twakiweebwa. Obwetoowaze butandika bwe tukiraba ekyo bulungi.

Obwetoowaze kye buli

Obwetoowaze kwe kubeera mu mazima agakwata ku Katonda ne ku ffe ffennyini. Bulina enjuyi bbiri.

Mu maaso ga Katonda, obwetoowaze kwe kumwesigamira. Ffe tuli bitonde, Ye Mutonzi. Ffe tuli boonoonyi, Ye Mulokozi. Tetuyinza kukola kirungi kyonna awatali Ye. Omuntu omwetoowaze tagezaako kubeera ng’atali mu bwetaavu bwa Katonda. Asaba kubanga amanyi nti amwetaaga. Yeesiga kubanga amanyi nti tasobola kufuga buli kintu. Mikka yafunza Katonda ky’atwetaagisa: “okukola eby’ensonga, okuba n’ekisa era n’okutambulira mu buwombeefu ne Katonda wo” (Mikka 6:8).

Mu maaso g’abantu, obwetoowaze kwe kuweereza. Pawulo yawandiika nti tubeere “nga temukola kintu na kimu olw’okuvuganya wadde okwewaana okutaliimu, wabula mu bwetoowaze nga buli muntu agulumiza munne okusinga bwe mwegulumiza mwekka, nga buli muntu tatunuulira bibye yekka, naye ng’afaayo ne ku by’abalala” (Abafiripi 2:3-4). Omuntu omwetoowaze talowooza buli kiseera ku ngeri gy’alabikamu, oba assibwamu ekitiibwa, oba ky’anaafunamu. Aba wa ddembe okulowooza ku balala.

Omuntu omu yakyogera mu bigambo ebyangu: obwetoowaze si kwetwala nti oli wa wansi, wabula kulekera awo okwerowoozaako buli kiseera. Omukulembeze omwetoowaze tali buli kiseera mu kwegeraageranya n’abalala. Amaaso ge gatunudde ku Kristo ne ku bantu be yamuwa okuweereza.

Lwaki obwetoowaze bukulu nnyo eri abakulembeze

Bayibuli eddiŋŋana ekintu kye kimu emirundi n’emirundi: “Katonda akyawa ab’amalala naye abawombeefu abawa omukisa” (1 Peetero 5:5). Yakobo ajuliza ekigambo kye kimu (Yakobo 4:6), era kisooka kulabikira mu Engero (Engero 3:34). Ekintu bwe kyogerwa emirundi esatu mu Byawandiikibwa, tusaanidde okukissaako omwoyo.

Lowooza ku makulu g’ekyo. Omukulembeze ow’amalala, Katonda amulwanyisa. Ne bw’aba n’ebirabo bingi atya, ne bw’akola ennyo atya, aba akola ng’akontana n’engeri Katonda gye yateekateeka ensi. Omukulembeze omwetoowaze, Katonda amuwa omukisa n’ekisa. Ne bw’aba munafu atya, alina obuyambi bw’Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna. Tekyewuunyisa nti obwetoowaze y’empisa esooka ey’omutima gw’omukulembeze.

Obwetoowaze bukulu eri abakulembeze mu ngeri endala waakiri nnya.

  • Abakulembeze abeetoowaze basobola okuyiga. Omukulembeze ow’amalala alowooza nti amanyi dda. Omukulembeze omwetoowaze yeeyongera okubuuza ebibuuzo, okusoma, okuwuliriza n’okukula. “Amalala bwe gajja, ng’obuswavu butuuse, naye obwetoowaze buleeta amagezi” (Engero 11:2).
  • Abakulembeze abeetoowaze basobola okunenyezebwa. Omuntu bw’abalaga ensobi yaabwe, tebasooka kwewolereza. Beebuuza nti, “Kino kituufu?” Kino kibakuuma okugwa emirundi mingi.
  • Abakulembeze abeetoowaze bawa abalala ebbanga. Tebatya muntu mulala bw’aba n’ekirabo. Basanyuka abalala bwe bakula ne bakola bulungi.
  • Abakulembeze abeetoowaze basobola okwesigibwa n’obuwanguzi. Katonda asobola okuwa omukisa omulimu gw’omukulembeze omwetoowaze awatali kumuzikiriza, kubanga ajja kumuwa ekitiibwa.

Abakulembeze bwe beerabira

Bayibuli etuwa emboozi ez’ennaku ez’abakulembeze abaatandika nga beetoowaze ne bamaliriza nga ba malala. Kabaka Uzziya owa Yuda yali kabaka mulungi okumala emyaka mingi. Katonda yamuyamba, era ettutumu lye ne libuna wala. “Kyokka Uzziya bwe yatutumuka, ne yeegulumiza, n’okugwa n’agwa” (2 Ebyomumirembe 26:16). Yayingira mu yeekaalu okwotereza obubaane, omulimu Katonda gwe yali awadde bakabona bokka, n’akubwa obulwadde bw’olususu obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo.

Kabaka Nebukadduneeza owa Babulooni yatambula ku kasolya k’olubiri lwe n’agamba nti, “Ono si ye Babulooni omukulu gwe nazimba n’amaanyi gange amangi okuba ekibuga ekikulu eky’ekitiibwa eky’obwakabaka bwange?” (Danyeri 4:30). Yali tannamaliriza kwogera, Katonda n’amukkakkanya. Yagwa eddalu n’abeera ng’ensolo okutuusa lwe yategeera “ng’Oyo Ali Waggulu ennyo y’afuga obwakabaka obw’abantu” (Danyeri 4:32). Amagezi ge bwe gaamukomawo, yatendereza Katonda n’agamba nti, “n’abo ab’amalala abakkakkanya” (Danyeri 4:37).

Weetegereze obulabe we bwajjira. Uzziya yeegulumiza “bwe yatutumuka”. Nebukadduneeza yafuna amalala bwe yatunuulira byonna bye yali azimbye. Amalala gasinga okuba ag’obulabe si bwe tuba tulemererwa, wabula bwe tuba tutuuka ku buwanguzi. Omukulembeze ekkanisa ye gy’ekula, erinnya lye gye lyeyongera okumanyibwa era enteekateeka ze gye zituukirira, y’asinga okwetaaga okukuuma omutima gwe n’obwegendereza. Kino tujja kukiddamu mu Ssuula 32, Amalala n’Okwagala Okutenderezebwa.

Obwetoowaze bwa Yesu

Ekifaananyi ekisinga obukulu eky’obwetoowaze si tteeka wabula Muntu. Yesu yagamba nti, “Musitule ekikoligo kyange, muyigire ku nze, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima, n’emyoyo gyammwe girifuna ekiwummulo” (Matayo 11:29). Kyewuunyisa nti, mu bintu byonna Yesu bye yandyogedde ku mutima gwe, kino kye yalonda: omuwombeefu era omuteefu.

Twalaba mu Ssuula 5, Ekiremba n’Ebbensani, nga Yesu bwe “yeewaayo n’afuuka ng’omuddu” era “ne yeetoowaza, n’aba muwulize n’okutuukira ddala ku kufa, ate okufa okw’okukomererwa ku musaalaba” (Abafiripi 2:7-8). Omwana wa Katonda, eyalina eddembe lyonna okuweerezebwa, yalonda okuweereza. Obanga obwetoowaze bwali butuufu gy’ali, butuufu ne gye tuli.

Yesu era atuwa ekiwummulo. Amalala gakooya. Omukulembeze ow’amalala alina buli kiseera okulwanirira erinnya lye, okuvuganya n’abalala n’okukakasa omuwendo gwe. Omukulembeze omwetoowaze talina ky’ateekwa kukakasa. Awummulira mu ekyo Katonda ky’amulowoozaako. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki Yesu agatta omutima omwetoowaze n’emyoyo “okufuna ekiwummulo”.

Mukwano gw’awasa omugole

Yokaana Omubatiza yali omu ku babuulizi abaasinga okwettanirwa mu kiseera kye. Ebibiina byajjanga okuva mu ggwanga lyonna okumuwulira. Oluvannyuma Yesu n’atandika okubuulira, ebibiina ne bitandika okuleka Yokaana ne bigoberera Yesu. Abayigirizwa ba Yokaana ne batabukirwa. Ne bajja gy’ali ne beemulugunya nti buli muntu yali agenda eri Yesu.

Yokaana n’addamu nti, “Omuntu tayinza kuba na kintu okuggyako nga kimuweereddwa okuva mu ggulu” (Yokaana 3:27). Oluvannyuma ne yeeyogerako ng’omukwano gw’oyo awasa ku mbaga. Omukwano oyo tayagala mugole kuba wuwe. Asanyuka bw’awulira eddoboozi ly’oyo awasa. “Noolwekyo essanyu lyange lituukiridde. Kimugwanira ye okugulumizibwa naye nze okutoowazibwa” (Yokaana 3:29-30).

Sentensi eyo esembayo y’emu ku nsaba ezisingayo obulungi omukulembeze z’asobola okusaba: “Kimugwanira ye okugulumizibwa naye nze okutoowazibwa.” Tekitegeeza nti tufuuka bwereere. Kitegeeza nti obulamu bwaffe n’omulimu gwaffe bitunuza abantu eri Kristo, so si eri ffe. Omukulembeze abantu be gwe bamanyi okusinga bwe bamanyi Yesu, aba asubiddwa ekigendererwa ky’obukulembeze.

Engeri y’okukula mu bwetoowaze

Tetuyinza kwefuula beetoowaze nga tufuba okwewulira nga tuli beetoowaze. Naye tusobola okwessa awo Katonda w’atutoowaliza. Zino ze ngeri ezimu ez’okukikola.

  • Beeranga kumpi n’omusaalaba. Pawulo yagamba nti, “Naye nze sigenda kwenyumiririza mu kintu kyonna okuggyako omusaalaba gwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo” (Abaggalatiya 6:14). Bwe tujjukira nti Yesu yalina okufiirira ebibi byaffe, kizibu okusigala nga tuli ba malala.
  • Jjukira gye wava. Pawulo teyeerabira n’akatono nti yayigganya Ekkanisa: “Kubanga nze nsembayo mu batume … Naye olw’ekisa kya Katonda ndi nga bwe ndi kaakano” (1 Abakkolinso 15:9-10).
  • Yatula ebibi byo eri abalala. Abantu ab’amalala bakweka ensobi zaabwe. Abantu abeetoowaze bazireeta mu musana. Kino kye kimu ku bubonero obukulu obw’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba, kwe tujja okusisinkana oluvannyuma mu kitabo kino.
  • Kola ebirungi mu kyama. Yesu yagamba nti, “omukono gwo ogwa kkono guleme kumanya ogwa ddyo kye gukola” (Matayo 6:3). Weereza nga tolabibwa, era Katonda abeere yekka akulaba.
  • Aniriza okunenyezebwa. Omuntu bw’akuvumirira, nga tonnaddamu, buuza Katonda obanga mu ekyo mulimu amazima.
  • Twala ekifo ekya wansi. Yesu yagamba abagoberezi be okulondanga entebe esembayo ku mbaga, so si esingayo waggulu (Lukka 14:10). Noonya emikisa egy’okukulembeza abalala.
  • Kkiriza obunafu. Pawulo yeegayirira Katonda amuggyeko “eriggwa mu mubiri” gwe, naye Katonda n’amuddamu nti, “Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu” (2 Abakkolinso 12:9). Oluusi Katonda atuleka nga tuli banafu tulyoke tusigale nga tuli beetoowaze era nga tumwesigamira.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Andrew Murray ne William Carey

Andrew Murray yali musumba mu South Africa eyaliwo okuva mu 1828 okutuuka mu 1917. Yazaalibwa mu Graaff-Reinet, kitaawe gye yali omusumba, era yaweereza ekkanisa mu Cape okumala ebbanga eddene ery’obulamu bwe obuwanvu. Yayamba okukulembera okuzuukuka, yatandikawo amasomero era yawandiika ebitabo n’obutabo ebisoba mu bibiri, bingi ku byo nga biri ku Ochorus. Ekimu ku bisinga okumanyibwa ke katabo akatono akayitibwa Obwetoowaze. Mu kyo yawandiika nti:

“Obwetoowaze, ekifo eky’okwesigama kwonna ku Katonda, mu butonde bw’ebintu bwennyini, gwe mulimu ogusooka era obutuukirivu obusingira ddala obw’ekitonde, era gwe muzi gwa buli butuukirivu. Bw’atyo amalala, oba okufiirwa obwetoowaze buno, gwe muzi gwa buli kibi na buli kibi ekyonoona.”

— Andrew Murray, Obwetoowaze, Essuula 1

Mu bigambo ebyangu: obwetoowaze kitegeeza okwesigamira Katonda ddala ddala. Kye kintu ekisooka ekitonde kye kibanjibwa Omutonzi waakyo, era buli mpisa endala ennungi ekula okuva mu bwo, ng’amatabi bwe gava ku kikolo. Amalala, kwe kugamba okufiirwa obwetoowaze buno, kye kikolo buli kibi mwe kikulira. Murray agenda mu maaso n’agamba nti Setaani yagwa olw’amalala, era nti bajjajjaffe abaasooka baagwa bwe baayagala okuba nga Katonda. Obanga amalala ge kikolo ky’ekibi kyonna, kale obwetoowaze si mpisa emu ennungi mu nnyingi. Bwe musingi gwazo zonna.

Ekitabo kya Murray tekyogera ku bwetoowaze mu maaso ga Katonda bwokka. Agamba nti obwetoowaze bwaffe mu maaso ga Katonda bukakasibwa engeri gye tuyisaamu abantu abalala, naddala abantu abatunyiiza, abatuggwaamu essuubi, oba abatalina birabo nga ffe.

Omukulembeze omulala atulaga kino bwe kirabika ku nkomerero y’obulamu. William Carey yali mutunzi w’engatto Omungereza eyafuuka omuminsani mu Buyindi mu 1793. Yavvuunula Bayibuli, oba ebitundu byayo, mu nnimi ezisoba mu amakumi asatu. Yayamba okutandikawo ettendekero era n’alwana okukomya empisa ey’okwokya bannamwandu. Atera okuyitibwa “kitaawe w’emirimu gy’obuminsani egy’omulembe guno”. Naye bwe yali ng’afa mu 1834, ajjukirwa okuba nga yagamba omuminsani omuto Omuskootilandi, Alexander Duff, eyali amutendereza olw’omulimu gwe, nti: “Obadde oyogera ku Dr Carey, Dr Carey. Bwe ndimala okugenda, toyogera kintu kyonna ku Dr Carey. Yogera ku Mulokozi wa Dr Carey.”

Carey yasaba ejjinja ly’oku ntaana ye libeeko erinnya lye lyokka, ennaku z’omwezi ze, n’ennyiriri bbiri okuva mu luyimba lwa Isaac Watts: “Nze omunyoomebwa, omwavu era omunafu ng’akawuka, ku mikono gyo egy’ekisa kwe ngwa.” Omusajja eyali akoze ebingi bwe bityo yayagala kujjukirwa nga mwonoonyi yekka akwatiddwa mu mikono gya Kristo. Obwo bwe bwetoowaze. Si kwefuula nga tolina ky’okoze. Kwe kumanya nti buli ky’okoze kyakolebwa lwa kisa.

Ekkubo erigenda waggulu likka wansi

Peetero yawandiika nti, “Noolwekyo mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda ogw’amaanyi, naye alibagulumiza ng’obudde butuuse” (1 Peetero 5:6). Weetegereze ani asitula. Ffe twetoowaza. Katonda atugulumiza. Omulimu gwaffe kwe kukka wansi. Omulimu gwe kwe kusalawo ddi, era obanga, anaatusitula.

Kino kituwonya omulimu ogukooya ogw’okwetumbula. Tetwetaaga kwesindiikiriza mu maaso, kwegeraageranya na balala wadde okulwanira ebifo. Tusobola okukola n’obwesigwa omulimu oguli mu maaso gaffe ne tuleka erinnya lyaffe mu mikono gya Katonda. Nga bwe tujja okulaba mu ssuula eddako, omukulembeze ow’engeri eyo era asobola okwesigibwa okuba omuntu y’omu mu kyama nga bw’ali mu lwatu.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Nga tonnasoma ssuula eno, walowoozanga nti obwetoowaze kye ki? Ekifaananyi ky’olina kikyuse?
  • Soma 1 Abakkolinso 4:7. Wandiika ebirabo bisatu by’olina. Okujjukira nti buli kimu ku byo wakiweebwa kikyusa kitya endowooza yo?
  • “Katonda akyawa ab’amalala naye abawombeefu abawa omukisa.” Mu bulamu bwo, wa w’oyinza okuba ng’olwanyisa Katonda olw’amalala?
  • Uzziya yeegulumiza “bwe yatutumuka”. Buwanguzi ki mu bulamu bwo oba mu buweereza bwo obuyinza okufuuka obulabe eri omutima gwo?
  • Osobola okusaba essaala ya Yokaana Omubatiza, “Kimugwanira ye okugulumizibwa naye nze okutoowazibwa”, ng’okitegeeza ddala? Kiki ekikifuula ekizibu?
  • Ku ngeri ez’okukula mu bwetoowaze, eruwa gy’osinga okwetaaga okutandika wiiki eno?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Buli lunaku wiiki eno, noonya omukisa gumu ogw’okutwala “ekifo ekya wansi”: leka omuntu omulala ayogere asooke, wa omulala ettendo, kkiriza okunenyezebwa nga teweewolereza, oba weereza omuntu atasobola kukusasula. Buli kawungeezi, weebaze Katonda olw’ekintu kimu ky’akuwadde, era oyogere mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, “Kino kyali kirabo, era si kyange.” Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, wandiika ky’okizudde ku mutima gwo.

study_questions.question: Obwetoowaze mu mukulembeze Omukristaayo kye ki?
study_questions.answer: Obwetoowaze si kwerowoozaako bubi wabula kwerabira mu mazima mu maaso ga Katonda. Pawulo yawandiika nti buli omu “obuteerowooza okusinga ekyo ky’asaanidde okulowooza, naye okulowoozanga nga yeegendereza” (Abaruumi 12:3). Buli kye tulina kirabo: “Era mulina kye mutaaweebwa?” (1 Abakkolinso 4:7).

study_questions.question: Lwaki obwetoowaze bukulu nnyo eri abakulembeze?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga “Katonda akyawa ab’amalala naye abawombeefu abawa omukisa” (1 Peetero 5:5). Omukulembeze ow’amalala agwa era alumya abalala: “Amalala bwe gajja, ng’obuswavu butuuse, naye obwetoowaze buleeta amagezi” (Engero 11:2).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okukula mu bwetoowaze?
study_questions.answer: Ng’atunuulira Yesu, eyeetoowaza, era ng’alonda okukulembeza abalala: “mu bwetoowaze nga buli muntu agulumiza munne okusinga bwe mwegulumiza mwekka” (Abafiripi 2:3). Ekisuubizo kiri nti Katonda agulumiza abeetoowaze: “Noolwekyo mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda ogw’amaanyi, naye alibagulumiza ng’obudde butuuse” (1 Peetero 5:6).

fields.title: Obwesigwa: Omuntu Omu ne mu Kyama
fields.body_html:
“Atambulira mu bwesimbu y’atambula emirembe, naye akwata amakubo amakyamu alitegeerebwa.”

— Engero 10:9

Mu butale obumu, abasuubuzi batunda omubisi gw’enjuki ogutabuddwamu amazzi ga ssukaali. Bw’otunuulira eccupa ng’oli bweru, efaanana ng’ey’omubisi gw’enjuki omulongoofu. Langi ntuufu. Akapapula akagiriko katuufu. Naye bw’ogulegako, omanya. Ekigambo ky’Olungereza ekivvuunulwa obwesigwa mu ssuula eno, “integrity”, kiva mu kigambo ekitegeeza ekintu ekiramba, ekitayawuddwamu. Omuntu omwesigwa mu ngeri eno afaanana ng’omubisi gw’enjuki omulongoofu: y’omu okuva kungulu okutuuka munda. Ky’olaba ebweru kye kiri munda.

Essuula eno yogera ku bwesigwa, okuba omuntu y’omu ku kituuti, awaka, mu katale ne bw’oba wekka. Kye kimu ku bintu ebisingayo obuzibu eri omukulembeze, kubanga abakulembeze batunuulirwa mu lwatu, era kyangu okufaayo ennyo ku ngeri gye tulabikamu okusinga ku ekyo kye tuli.

Omuntu omu ne mu kyama

Yesu yaterekera ebigambo bye ebisingayo amaanyi abakulembeze b’eddiini abaalabikanga obulungi kungulu naye nga bavunze munda. “Zibasanze mmwe Abawandiisi nammwe Abafalisaayo! Bannanfuusi mmwe! Muzigula kungulu kw’ekikopo ne kungulu kw’ebbakuli, naye nga munda mujjudde omululu n’okwefaako mwekka” (Matayo 23:25). “Mulabika ng’amalaalo agatemagana kungulu, songa munda gajjudde amagumba g’abafu n’obuvundu obwa buli ngeri” (Matayo 23:27).

Ekigambo ky’Oluyonaani ekivvuunulwa “munnanfuusi” kyali kitegeeza omuzannyi ku katuuti, omuntu eyeebikka ekifaananyi ku maaso n’azannya ekitundu ky’omuntu omulala. Munnanfuusi ye mukulembeze azannya ekitundu ky’omuntu atya Katonda mu lwatu, naye mu kyama n’abeera mu ngeri endala. Yesu yalabula abayigirizwa be nti, “Mwekuume ekizimbulukusa bwe bannanfuusi bw’Abafalisaayo” (Lukka 12:1). Ekizimbulukusa kitono naye kibuna omugaati gwonna. Obunnanfuusi mu mukulembeze bubuna ekkanisa yonna.

Oluvannyuma Yesu n’agattako okulabula buli mukulembeze kw’asaanidde okujjukira: “Tewali ekyakisibwa ekitalimanyibwa, newaakubadde ekyakwekebwa ekitalizuulibwa” (Lukka 12:2). Tewali kintu kisigala nga kikwekeddwa emirembe gyonna. Musa yagamba abantu ba Isirayiri nti, “mutegeerere ddala ng’ekibi kyammwe ekyo kiribayigga ne kibakwasa” (Okubala 32:23). Omukulembeze by’akola mu kyama lumu birimanyibwa, oba mu bulamu buno oba mu maaso ga Kristo.

Emikono emirongoofu egya Samwiri

Bayibuli era etuwa ebifaananyi ebirungi eby’obwesigwa. Nnabbi Samwiri bwe yakaddiwa, yayimirira mu maaso g’eggwanga lyonna erya Isirayiri n’abuuza ekibuuzo ekyewuunyisa: “Nzuuno mu maaso gammwe. Munnumirize ensonga yonna mu maaso ga Mukama ne mu maaso g’oyo gwe yafukako amafuta. Ani gwe nnali ntwalidde ente ye? Oba ani gwe nnali ntwalidde endogoyi ye? Oba ani gwe nnali ndyazaamaanyizza? Oba ani gwe nnali njooze? Oba ani gwe nnali nsabye enguzi? Bwe wabaawo anvunaana mu nsonga yonna nzija kumuliyira” (1 Samwiri 12:3).

Lowooza ku mukulembeze leero ng’ayimiridde mu maaso g’ekkanisa ye oba ab’ekitundu kye n’ayogera bw’atyo. Ssente z’ani ze nnatwala? Ani gwe nnalyazaamaanya? Ani gwe nnajooga? Nguzi y’ani gye nnakkiriza? Abantu baddamu Samwiri nti: “Totunyagangako newaakubadde okutujooga, wadde okulya enguzi okuva mu mukono gw’omuntu yenna” (1 Samwiri 12:4). Oluvannyuma lw’obulamu bwe bwonna ng’akulembera, emikono gya Samwiri gyali mirongoofu.

Wandisobodde okwogera Samwiri bye yayogera? Kino kigezo kirungi eri omukulembeze yenna. Singa wakulembera ekkanisa yo oba ekibinja kyo okumala emyaka amakumi asatu, abantu bandyogedde ki ku ngeri gye wakozesaamu ssente, obuyinza n’abantu?

Danyeri, nga tewali kya kumulumiriza

Danyeri yabeeranga ng’omusibe mu nsi engwira, naye n’akulaakulana n’afuuka omu ku bakungu abasingayo obukulu mu bwakabaka obwo obunene. Abakungu abalala baamukwatirwa obuggya ne bagezaako okumuzikiriza. “Abakungu abalala ababiri n’abaamasaza ne basala amagezi okunoonya ensonga ku Danyeri ku nzirukanya ye ey’ebyemirimu egy’obwakabaka, naye ne batayinza kulaba nsonga nkyamu newaakubadde akabi konna, kubanga yali musajja mwesigwa ataalina kwonoona okw’engeri yonna newaakubadde obulagajjavu” (Danyeri 6:4).

Lowooza ku ekyo. Abalabe be baakebera omulimu gwe nga banoonya ensobi, obugayaavu n’obukumpanya. Tebaalaba kintu. Ku nkomerero baagamba nti, “Tetugenda kulaba nsonga evunaanyisa Danyeri wabula ng’ekwata ku tteeka lya Katonda we” (Danyeri 6:5). Omusango gwokka gwe baali basobola okumuvunaana gwali nti yali mwesigwa eri Katonda.

Kiki ekyali ekyama ky’obwesigwa bwa Danyeri obw’omu lwatu? Essuula y’emu etubuulira. Kabaka bwe yassaawo etteeka erigaana okusaba omuntu yenna okuggyako ye, Danyeri “n’agenda ewuwe mu nnyumba ye, n’ayambuka mu kisenge kye ekya waggulu ekyalina amadirisa nga goolekedde Yerusaalemi, n’afukamiranga emirundi esatu olunaku, n’asabanga era ne yeebazanga Katonda we nga bwe yakolanga bulijjo” (Danyeri 6:10). Weetegereze ebigambo “nga bwe yakolanga bulijjo”. Obwesimbu bwa Danyeri mu gavumenti bwava mu bwesigwa bwe mu kusaba. Obulamu bwe obw’omu kyama bwe bwaliisanga obulamu bwe obw’omu lwatu.

Ebitundu obwesigwa mwe bugezesebwa

Obwesigwa bugezesebwa mu buli kitundu ky’obulamu, naye abakulembeze basinga kugezesebwa mu bitundu ebitonotono. Bino bye bimu ku byo.

Ssente. Pawulo yakwatanga ebirabo ebinene ebyaweerezebwanga abaavu mu Yerusaalemi, era yeegenderezanga nnyo: “nga twewala omuntu yenna okutunenya olw’ekirabo kino kye tuweereza. Kubanga kye tugenderera kwe kukola ebirungi, si mu maaso ga Katonda yekka wabula ne mu maaso g’abantu” (2 Abakkolinso 8:20-21). Weetegereze nti teyafaayo ku kuba mwesimbu mu maaso ga Katonda kyokka, wabula ne ku kulabibwa ng’omwesimbu mu maaso g’abantu. Omukulembeze tasaanidde n’akatono kukwata ssente za kkanisa yekka. Abantu babiri basaanidde okuzibala, ebiwandiiko bisaanidde okukuumibwa, era embalirira esaanidde okuba mu lwatu. Kino tujja kukiddamu mu Ssuula 33, Ssente n’Omululu.

Ebigambo. Yesu yagamba nti, “Naye muddangamu buzzi nti, ‘Weewaawo.’ Oba nti, ‘Si weewaawo’” (Matayo 5:37). Omukulembeze omwesigwa atuukiriza ebisuubizo bye. Tagaziya miwendo gy’abantu okulabika ng’atuuse ku buwanguzi. Tabuulira bantu ba njawulo mboozi za njawulo. Taweemuukiriza. Pawulo yali asobola okugamba nti, “Tetugezangako kubawangula na bigambo biwaaniriza nga nammwe bwe mumanyi, wadde okuba ab’omululu era Katonda akimanyi” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:5).

Omulimu. Omukulembeze asasulwa asaanidde okukola olunaku olulamba. Omukulembeze akola mu bizinensi asaanidde okuba omwesimbu mu buli kye atunda ne mu buli lipoota. Abalabe ba Danyeri baanoonya “obulagajjavu” ne batabulaba. Obugayaavu nabwo kulemererwa mu bwesigwa.

Awaka. Ekigezo ekisinga obutuufu eky’obwesigwa bw’omukulembeze y’engeri gy’ayisaamu ng’oluggi lw’ekkanisa luggaddwa. Omusumba omuteefu ku kituuti naye omukambwe eri munne mu bufumbo n’abaana be, alina omutima ogwawukanyemu. Dawudi yasaba nti, “Nnaabeeranga mu nnyumba yange nga siriiko kya kunenyezebwa” (Zabbuli 101:2). Kino tujja kukitunuulira mu Ssuula 42, Amaka g’Omukulembeze.

Amaaso n’ebirowoozo. Yobu yagamba nti, “Nakola endagaano n’amaaso gange; obutatunuulira muwala n’amaaso ag’obukaba” (Yobu 31:1). Leero abakulembeze bangi bagwa olw’ebyo bye batunuulira mu kyama ku ssimu oba ku lutimbe. Obwesigwa butandikira mu bifo eby’ekyama eby’ebirowoozo. Kino tujja kukitunuulira mu Ssuula 34, Obulongoofu mu by’Okwegatta.

Ebintu ebitono. Yesu yagamba nti, “Omuntu omwesigwa mu kintu ekitono, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene; n’oyo ataba mwesigwa mu kitono era ne mu kinene taba mwesigwa” (Lukka 16:10). Omukulembeze alagajjalira ssente entono, ekisuubizo ekitono oba amazima agalabika ng’amatono, ajja kulagajjalira n’ebinene.

Omuntu ow’omunda omulongoofu

Pawulo yayogeranga nnyo ku muntu we ow’omunda. Yagamba gavana Feliki nti, “nfuba bulijjo okuba n’emmeeme ennongoofu eri Katonda n’eri abantu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 24:16). Yawandiikira Abakkolinso nti, “Tulina okwenyumiriza ng’omwoyo gwaffe gutujulira kubanga twatambulira mu buwombeefu ne mu mazima ga Katonda, so si mu magezi ag’omubiri, naye mu kisa kya Katonda nga tuli mu nsi n’okusingira ddala gye muli” (2 Abakkolinso 1:12).

Omuntu ow’omunda omulongoofu kye kimu ku birabo ebisingayo obukulu omukulembeze by’ayinza okuba nabyo. Kumuwa obuvumu, kubanga tewali ky’akweka. Kumuwa emirembe, kubanga tewali kutya kuzuulibwa. Kumuwa eddembe, kubanga teweetaaga kujjukira mboozi ki gye wabuulira ani. “Atambulira mu bwesimbu y’atambula emirembe” (Engero 10:9).

Ku ludda olulala, omuntu ow’omunda alumirizibwa omusango mpolampola azikiriza omukulembeze okuva munda. Afuuka eyeewolereza buli kiseera, ateekuuma, era atya. Tasobola kubuulira ku kibi n’amaanyi, kubanga amanyi ekikye. Tasobola kunenya balala, kubanga naye alina ky’akweka.

Obwesigwa bwe bumenyese

Oboolyawo ng’osoma essuula eno, omanyi nti obulamu bwo bwawukanyemu. Waliwo ekikwekeddwa: ssente ezaatwalibwa, obulimba obwayogerwa, omuze ogw’ekyama, oba enkolagana enkyamu. Osaanidde kukola ki?

Bayibuli eri mu lwatu: “Oyo akweka ebibi bye, talifuna mukisa kukulaakulana, naye buli abyatula n’abireka, alisaasirwa” (Engero 28:13). Waliwo okusaasira eri abakulembeze abeenenya ne baatula. Naye okwatula kulina okuba okwa ddala. Kitegeeza okukkiriza ekibi eri Katonda, era bwe kiba kyetaagisa eri abantu abakoseddwa n’eri abo abalina obuyinza ku ggwe. Kitegeeza okutereeza ebintu w’osobola, nga Zaakayo bwe yaddiza ebyo bye yali abbye. Kitegeeza okukkiriza ebivaamu, ebiyinza okuzingiramu okuva ku bukulembeze okumala ekiseera.

Ekyo kiruma. Naye kiruma kitono nnyo okusinga okuzuulibwa, era kisingira wala okuyimirira mu maaso ga Kristo n’ekibi ekikwekeddwa. Mu mboozi ya Akani, effeeza ne zzaabu ebyakwekebwa nga biziikiddwa mu weema ye byaleetera abantu bonna akabi (Yoswa 7). Ekibi ekikwekeddwa mu mukulembeze kitera obutakosa mukulembeze yekka. Tujja kuddamu okwogera ku kugwa n’okuzzibwawo mu Ssuula 39, Okugwa n’Okuzzibwawo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Polycarp ow’e Sumuna

Polycarp yali mulabirizi w’ekkanisa y’e Sumuna, ekibuga ekiri ku lubalama lw’ennyanja mu nsi eyitibwa leero Turkey. Bwe yali akyali muvubuka yayigira ku mutume Yokaana. Mu makkati g’ekyasa eky’okubiri, awo nga mu AD 155, yali musajja mukadde nnyo, ng’ayagalibwa Abakristaayo mu kitundu kyonna.

Okuyigganyizibwa okw’amaanyi kwajja mu Sumuna. Ebibiina by’abantu mu kisaawe ne biyoogaana nti Polycarp anoonyezebwe. Mikwano gye baamusendasenda n’ayingira mu nnyumba y’omu nnimiro ebweru w’ekibuga okwekweka, naye n’alyamu olukwe n’akwatibwa. Abaserikale abajja okumukwata beewuunya okusanga omusajja omukadde omuteefu. Yalagira baweebwe emmere n’eby’okunywa, era n’asaba ssaawa emu yokka okusaba. Yasaba okumala essaawa bbiri, ng’ajjukira mu mannya buli muntu gwe yali amanyi, abato n’abakulu, n’Ekkanisa yonna mu nsi yonna.

Yaleetebwa mu kisaawe mu maaso ga gavana Omuruumi. Gavana yayagala okumuwonya, olw’okussa ekitiibwa mu bukadde bwe. Polycarp kye yali yeetaaga kukola kyokka kwali kulayira mu linnya lya kabaka omukulu ow’e Rooma n’okukolimira Kristo. Ebbaluwa okuva mu kkanisa ye, eyawandiikibwa amangu ddala oluvannyuma era emanyiddwa nga The Martyrdom of Polycarp (Okufa kwa Polycarp ng’Omujulizi), etubuulira bwe yaddamu:

“Emyaka kinaana mu mukaaga mmuweerezza, era tannaba kunkola kabi n’akamu: kale nnyinza ntya okuvuma Kabaka wange era Omulokozi wange?”

— The Martyrdom of Polycarp

Mu bigambo ebyangu: mmaze emyaka kinaana mu mukaaga nga mpeereza Kristo, era tannaba kunkola kibi wadde omulundi gumu. Nnyinza ntya okwogera obubi ku Kabaka wange, eyandokola? Gavana bwe yamupikiriza nate, Polycarp n’agamba buzzi nti, “Ndi Mukristaayo.” Yattibwa ku lunaku olwo.

Ebigambo bya Polycarp byogera ku buvumu, era tujja kumusisinkana nate mu ssuula ezijja. Naye era byogera ku bwesigwa. Okumala emyaka kinaana mu mukaaga yali aweerezza Mukama y’omu. Omusajja eyali mu kisaawe ye musajja y’omu eyali asabidde mu nnyumba y’omu nnimiro, eyayigirizanga mu kkanisa era eyaliisa abaserikale abajja okumukwata. Teyalina bulamu bukwekeddwa, teyalina muntu mulala munda mu ye, teyalina kyama kyali kiyinza kukozesebwa kumulwanyisa. Ekigezo ekinene bwe kyajja, teyalina kufuuka muntu mupya. Kye yali yeetaaga kyokka kwali kweyongera okuba nga bwe yali bulijjo.

Ekyo kye kibala ky’obwesigwa. Omukulembeze aba omulamba mu kusalawo okutono okwa buli lunaku ajja kuba mulamba ne ku lunaku olw’okugezesebwa.

Omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa

Twalaba mu Ssuula 2, Ekifuula Obukulembeze Okuba obw’Omwoyo, nti Dawudi yalabirira abantu be “n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa” (Zabbuli 78:72). Awo obwesigwa we bubeera: mu mutima. Tebusobola kwambalibwa ng’ekyambalo ku Ssande ne kiggyibwako ku Bbalaza. Bubumbibwa mpolampola, mu kusalawo okutono enkumi n’enkumi: okwogera amazima, okutuukiriza ekisuubizo, okugaana enguzi n’okwatula ekibi.

Pawulo yakifunza bw’ati eri omukulembeze omuto Tito: “mu bintu byonna, ng’obeera ekyokulabirako ekirungi mu byonna by’okola, ng’oli mwesimbu era assaayo omwoyo mu kuyigiriza kwo. Buli ky’oyogera kiteekwa okuba nga tekiriiko kya kunenyezebwa, oyo awakanya alyoke aswale, nga talina kibi kya kukwogerako” (Tito 2:7-8). Nga Danyeri, abalabe bo baleme kulaba kintu kya kukwogerako, okuggyako nti oli wa Katonda.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Singa omuntu yakugoberera okumala wiiki emu, awaka, ku mulimu ne bw’oba wekka, yandirabye omuntu y’omu gw’alaba mu kkanisa?
  • Soma 1 Samwiri 12:1-5. Wandisobodde okubuuza abantu bo ebibuuzo bya Samwiri? Kiruwa ekyandisinze okuzibuwala okuddamu?
  • Obwesimbu bwa Danyeri obw’omu lwatu bwava mu kusaba kwe okw’omu kyama. Obulamu bwo obw’omu kyama buliisa butya, oba bulemwa butya okuliisa, obulamu bwo obw’omu lwatu?
  • Ku bitundu obwesigwa mwe bugezesebwa (ssente, ebigambo, omulimu, awaka, amaaso n’ebirowoozo, ebintu ebitono), kiruwa ekisinga okuba eky’obulabe gy’oli?
  • Waliwo enkyukakyuka z’olina okukola mu ngeri ssente gye zikwatibwamu mu kkanisa yo oba mu buweereza bwo, gisobole “okukola ebirungi … ne mu maaso g’abantu”?
  • Waliwo ekintu kyonna ekikwekeddwa mu bulamu bwo ky’olina okuleeta mu musana? Ani gw’oyinza okukyogerako naye?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Saba Zabbuli 139:23-24 buli ku makya wiiki eno: “Nkebera, Ayi Katonda, otegeere omutima gwange. Ngezesa omanye ebirowoozo byange. Olabe obanga mu nze mulimu engeri yonna enkyamu; era onkulembere mu kkubo erintuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.” Saba Katonda akulage ekitundu kimu obulamu bwo obw’omu kyama n’obw’omu lwatu we bitakwatagana. Bw’anaakikulaga, kola omutendera gumu ogw’ensonga okukitereeza: yatula ekintu, ddiza ekintu, tuukiriza ekisuubizo kye wamenya, oba saba omuntu akubalirire.

study_questions.question: Obwesigwa mu bukulembeze obw’Ekikristaayo kye ki?
study_questions.answer: Obwesigwa kitegeeza okuba omuntu y’omu mu kyama nga bw’oli mu lwatu. “Atambulira mu bwesimbu y’atambula emirembe, naye akwata amakubo amakyamu alitegeerebwa” (Engero 10:9). Yesu yalabula ku bunnanfuusi bw’abo be yagamba nti, “Muzigula kungulu kw’ekikopo ne kungulu kw’ebbakuli,” so nga munda tebali balongoofu (Matayo 23:25).

study_questions.question: Samwiri yalaga atya obwesigwa ng’omukulembeze?
study_questions.answer: Ku nkomerero y’obukulembeze bwe yasobola okuyimirira mu maaso g’abantu bonna n’ababuuza nti, “Ani gwe nnali ntwalidde ente ye?” (1 Samwiri 12:3). Tewali yasobola kumulumiriza kulyazaamaanya oba kulya nguzi. Emikono gye gyali mirongoofu.

study_questions.question: Ekibi ekikwekeddwa kisobola okusigala nga kikwekeddwa?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Yesu yagamba nti, “Tewali ekyakisibwa ekitalimanyibwa, newaakubadde ekyakwekebwa ekitalizuulibwa” (Lukka 12:2), era Musa yalabula nti, “mutegeerere ddala ng’ekibi kyammwe ekyo kiribayigga ne kibakwasa” (Okubala 32:23). Essuula ekubiriza abakulembeze abaamenya obwesigwa bwabwe okwatula n’okunoonya obuyambi kaakano.

fields.title: Mwekuume Mwekka
fields.body_html:
“Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza era obinywerereko. Bw’onookola bw’otyo olyerokola ggwe wennyini, era n’abo abakuwulira.”

— 1 Timoseewo 4:16

Omulimi ayinza okuba n’ensigo ezisinga obulungi, ennimiro esinga obulungi n’enkuba esinga obulungi, naye bw’aba n’enkumbi ey’ekyuma ekimenyese, omulimu gujja kugenda bubi. Omubazzi atawagala bikozesebwa bye ajja kukola nnyo nnyo, naye ng’afulumya bitono nnyo. Buli mukozi amanyi nti ebikozesebwa birina okulabirirwa.

Eri omukulembeze ow’omwoyo, ekikozesebwa ekisinga obukulu si kizimbe, si mbalirira ya ssente, era si nteekateeka. Gwe mwoyo gw’omukulembeze yennyini. Essuula eno ekwata ku kwekuuma ggwe kennyini. Kiyinza okuwulikika ng’okwefaako wekka, naye kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga okulaga okwagala omukulembeze by’ayinza okukolera abantu b’aweereza.

Sooka weekuume ggwe

Pawulo bwe yali asiibula abakadde b’ekkanisa ey’omu Efeso, yali amanyi nti oboolyawo teyali wa kuddamu kubalaba. Yabakuutira n’obukulu bungi: “Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna Mwoyo Mutukuvu mwe yabateeka okuba abalabirizi okulabiriranga Ekkanisa ya Katonda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28).

Weetegereze engeri ebigambo gye biddiriŋŋanamu: “Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna”. Pawulo teyagamba nti, “Mukuume ekisibo, era bwe musigaza obudde, mwerabirire nammwe.” Yasooka n’omwoyo gw’omukulembeze yennyini. N’eri Timoseewo, omukulembeze omuvubuka, yamuwandiikira ekintu kye kimu: “Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza” (1 Timoseewo 4:16). Era ne wano engeri gye biddiriŋŋanamu y’emu: ggwe kennyini, oluvannyuma by’oyigiriza.

Lwaki? Kubanga omusumba omulwadde mu mwoyo tasobola kulabirira ndiga endwadde. Omukulembeze ng’omuliro gwe gwazikira tasobola kukoleeza muliro mu balala. Omukulembeze eyalekera awo okuwuliriza Katonda tasobola kuyamba balala kumuwulira. Ekisibo kyesigamye ku bulamu bw’omusumba.

“Si kulwa nga mbuulira abalala”

Pawulo yali tatya ku lw’abalala bokka. Yali atya ne ku lulwe yennyini. Yawandiika nti: “Naye mbonereza omubiri gwange ne ngufuula omuddu wange, si kulwa nga mbuulira abalala Enjiri, ate nze nzennyini ne sisiimibwa” (1 Abakkolinso 9:27).

Lino lye limu ku nnyiriri ezisinga okuzibuwaza omutima mu Bayibuli eri buli akulembera. Pawulo, omutume omukulu, eyali asimbye ekkanisa mu nsi yonna ey’Abaruumi, yali amanyi nti kisoboka okubuulira abalala ate ggwe n’obula. Kyali kisoboka okuyamba abalala okuyingira mu mbiro ate ggwe n’ozivaamu.

Bayibuli etuwa eby’okulabirako by’abakulembeze abaakola ekyo kyennyini. Samusooni Katonda yamwawula okuva lwe yazaalibwa. Yaweebwa amaanyi mangi. Naye yazannya n’ekibi okutuusa lumu abalabe be bwe bajja, n’agamba nti, “Nzija kwetakkuluza ŋŋende nga bulijjo.” Bayibuli eyongerako ekigambo eky’entiisa: “Naye teyamanya nga Mukama Katonda amulese” (Abalamuzi 16:20). Samusooni yali amanyidde nnyo amaanyi ga Katonda n’atakitegeera nti gaali gamuvuddeko.

Sulemaani ye yali omusajja asinga amagezi mu biseera bye. Yazimba yeekaalu era n’awandiika engero. Naye “Mu bisera bya Sulemaani eby’obukadde, bakyala be ne basendasenda omutima gwe okugoberera bakatonda abalala” (1 Bassekabaka 11:4), n’omutima gwe ne gutaba gwonna eri Mukama Katonda we. Omusajja eyali asabye emu ku ssaala ezisinga obukulu mu Bayibuli yamaliriza obulamu bwe ng’asinza ebifaananyi.

Abakulembeze bano tebaagwa lunaku lumu. Baaseeyeeya mpola mpola, nga bakyali bakola nnyo omulimu gwa Katonda. Eyo ye nsonga lwaki tulina okwekuuma.

Bye tulina okwekuuma

Mu bulamu bwe, kiki ddala omukulembeze ky’alina okwekuuma? Bino bye bimu ku bisinga obukulu.

Omutima gwo. “Ekisinga byonna kuuma omutima gwo, kubanga y’ensulo y’obulamu bwo” (Engero 4:23). Omutima gwe gusibukamu bye twagala, bye twegomba ne bye tusalawo. Weebuuze buli kiseera: Kiki kye nsinga okwagala? Kiki kye nnyaayaanira? Kiki ekijjuza ebirowoozo byange nga nnina eddembe okulowooza ku kintu kyonna?

Okwagala kwo okwasooka. Yesu yaweereza obubaka eri ekkanisa ey’omu Efeso, ekkanisa y’emu Pawulo gye yali alabudde abakadde baayo. Baali bakola nnyo. Baali bagumiikiriza. Baagezesanga abayigiriza ab’obulimba. Naye Yesu n’agamba nti, “nnina ensonga gye nkuvunaana: tokyanjagala nga bwe wanjagalanga edda” (Okubikkulirwa 2:4). Kisoboka okukolera Katonda ebintu byonna ebituufu ate nga tokyamwagala nga bwe wamwagalanga edda. Abakulembeze be basinga okuba mu kabi kano, kubanga omulimu gwennyini guyinza okudda mu kifo ky’enkolagana ne Katonda.

Okutambula kwo ne Katonda. Okyasisinkana Katonda mu kusaba ne mu Kigambo kye ku lw’omwoyo gwo ggwe, so si kwetegekera bubaka bwokka? Kino tujja kukitunuulira mu Kitundu eky’Okusatu: Omukulembeze ne Katonda.

Obutukuvu bwo. “Nga Katonda eyabayita bw’ali omutukuvu, nammwe mubeerenga batukuvu mu byonna bye mukola” (1 Peetero 1:15). Bibi ki by’ogumiikiriza? Kuliganya ki okwafuuka okwa bulijjo? Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo nti, “ddukanga okwegomba okubi okw’ekivubuka, ogobererenga obutuukirivu, n’okukkiriza, n’okwagalana era n’emirembe” (2 Timoseewo 2:22).

By’oyigiriza. Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo okwekuuma mu by’ayigiriza wamu n’okwekuuma yennyini. Abakulembeze bayinza okuseeyeeya okuva ku mazima mpola mpola, nga bongerako ebirowoozo abantu bye baagala, oba nga baleka ebitundu bya Bayibuli ebizibu. Weeyongere okugeraageranya by’oyigiriza n’Ebyawandiikibwa.

Ekirabo kyo. Pawulo yajjukiza Timoseewo “okuseesanga ekirabo kya Katonda ekiri mu ggwe kye yakuwa” (2 Timoseewo 1:6). Ebirabo biyinza okuwola olw’obuteefiibwako, olw’okutya oba olw’okukoowa. Omuliro gwetaaga okuseesebwa.

Akabi k’okukwatanga ebintu ebitukuvu

Waliwo akabi ak’enjawulo eri abo abakulembera abantu ba Katonda. Ennaku zaffe tuzimala n’ebintu ebitukuvu: Bayibuli, okusaba, okusinza, Ekyeggulo kya Mukama, n’okulabirira emyoyo. Mu kusooka ebintu bino bitujjuza okutya n’okuwuniikirira. Naye ekiseera bwe kigenda kiyitawo, kyangu okubifuula ebya bulijjo. Omubuulizi asoma Bayibuli okunoonya okubuulira, so si okuwulira Katonda. Akulembera okusinza ayimba ebigambo ebikwata ku Katonda nga talowooza ku Katonda. Omusumba asabira mu lujjudde, naye mu kyama tasaba nnyo.

Endagaano Enkadde etuwa eky’okulabirako ekitiisa. Batabani ba Alooni babiri, Nadabu ne Abiku, baali bakabona. Lumu ne bawaayo eri Mukama Katonda “omuliro ogutali mutukuvu”, gw’ataabalagira. “Omuliro ne guva eri Mukama ne gubookya” (Ebyabaleevi 10:1-2). Musa n’annyonnyola Katonda kye yali agambye: “Nzija kweyolekanga nga bwe ndi omutukuvu eri abo abansemberera” (Ebyabaleevi 10:3).

Ffe tuli wansi w’endagaano empya ey’ekisa, era Katonda tatukola mu ngeri y’emu. Naye etteeka lisigaddewo: abo abasemberera Katonda mu bukulembeze balina okumutwala nga mutukuvu. Okumanyiira ebintu ebitukuvu kye kimu ku bulabe obusinga obunene omukulembeze bw’asanga. Eky’okuddamu si kukola bitono, wabula okweyongera okujja eri Katonda ng’omwonoonyi eyeetaaga, so si ng’omukozi w’omulimu omuli ennyo.

Amakubo ag’ensonga ag’okwekuuma

Okwekuuma tekuzibu, naye kulina okukolebwa mu bugenderevu. Gano ge gamu ku makubo abakulembeze mu mirembe egyayita gye baasanga nga gayamba.

  • Beeranga n’ekiseera buli lunaku ne Katonda ekikyo ggwe. Soma Bayibuli okuliisibwa, so si kuliisa balala kwokka. Sabira omwoyo gwo, wamu n’okusabira abantu bo.
  • Weekeberenga buli kiseera. Weeteerewo ekiseera, oboolyawo omulundi gumu mu wiiki oba gumu mu mwezi, weebuuze ebibuuzo eby’amazima. Ekyongerezeddwako B: Omukulembeze Okwekebera (Essuula 54) kirimu olukalala lw’ebibuuzo ebiggiddwa mu bakulembeze nga Richard Baxter ne John Wesley.
  • Beera n’omuntu akumanyi obulungi. Buli mukulembeze yeetaaga waakiri omuntu omu asobola okumubuuza ebibuuzo ebizibu, era gw’abuulira amazima. Kino tujja kukitunuulira mu Ssuula 46, Omwesigwa mu Bitono: Okubalibwako.
  • Yatula ebibi byo mangu. Toleka bibi kukuŋŋaanika. Bikoleko buli lunaku mu maaso ga Katonda, era bwe kiba kyetaagisa, ne mu maaso g’abalala.
  • Weetegereze obubonero obulabula. Obutasaba, okunyiiga amangu, emize egy’ekyama, okubulwa essanyu, obuggya eri abalala, enjala y’okutenderezebwa, n’okuwulira nti amateeka tegakukwatako, byonna bubonero nti waliwo ekitali kituufu.
  • Wummula. Omukulembeze akooye mukulembeze ali mu kabi. Yesu yagamba nti, “Mutunule nga bwe musaba. Omwoyo gwo gwagala, naye omubiri gwe munafu!” (Matayo 26:41). Okuwummula tujja kukutunuulira mu Ssuula 15, Okuwummula, Okwawukana ku Balala, n’Enteekateeka y’Obulamu.
  • Saba essaala ya Dawudi. “Ontondemu omutima omulongoofu, Ayi Katonda, era onteekemu omwoyo omulungi munda yange” (Zabbuli 51:10).

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Richard Baxter, Charles Spurgeon ne Robert Murray M’Cheyne

Richard Baxter yali musumba mu kibuga Kidderminster mu Bungereza mu myaka gya 1600. Bwe yatuuka, ekibuga kyali kimanyiddwa olw’obutamiivu n’obutamanya Katonda. Bwe yavaayo, amaka mangi gaali gasaba buli lunaku mu nnyumba zaago. Mu 1656 yawandiikira basumba banne ekitabo ekiyitibwa Omusumba Omuzzeemu Obuggya. Omulamwa gwakyo gwali bigambo bya Pawulo mu Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28, era omulanga gwakyo omukulu ogwasooka gwali guno:

“Mwekumenga, muleme okubulwa ekisa kya Katonda ekirokola kye muwa abalala, ne muba bannaggwanga eri amaanyi agakola ag’enjiri eyo gye mubuulira; era muleme, nga bwe mulangirira eri ensi obwetaavu bw’Omulokozi, emitima gyammwe ne gimulagajjalira.”

— Richard Baxter, Omusumba Omuzzeemu Obuggya

Mu bigambo ebyangu: mwekuume mwekka. Mukakase nti mwafuna ekisa ekirokola kye muwa abalala. Mukakase nti Enjiri gye mubuulira yakola omulimu mu mitima gyammwe. Temugamba nsi nti yeetaaga Omulokozi ate nga mmwe bennyini mumulagajjalira. Baxter yeeyongera okulabula abasumba baleme “okufa enjala nga bwe mubategekera emmere”, kwe kugamba, obutafa njala nga bafumbira abalala.

Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka ebikumi bibiri, Charles Spurgeon, omusumba Omubatisti mu London, yawa abayizi be omusomo ogwayitibwa “Omubuulizi Okwekuuma”. Yatandika ng’ageraageranya omubuulizi n’omukozi alina ebikozesebwa:

“Mu ngeri emu, ffe ffennyini bye bikozesebwa byaffe, n’olwekyo tulina okwekuuma nga tuli bulungi.”

— Charles Spurgeon, Lectures to My Students (Emboozi eri Abayizi Bange)

Spurgeon yannyonnyola nti omubuulizi ayinza kubuulira na ddoboozi lye yennyini, kulowooza na magezi ge yennyini, n’okuwulira na mutima gwe yennyini. Ebitabo, enteekateeka n’ebigendererwa bya mugaso, naye si bye bikozesebwa by’omukulembeze ebisinga okumuli okumpi. Ebikozesebwa ebisinga okumuli okumpi gwe mwoyo gwe, emmeeme ye n’omubiri gwe. Bino bwe birekebwa, tewali kirala kyonna kiyinza kubidda mu kifo.

Wakati wa Baxter ne Spurgeon waaliwo omusumba omuvubuka Omuskootilandi ayitibwa Robert Murray M’Cheyne. Yaweereza ekkanisa mu Dundee, n’afa mu 1843 ng’alina emyaka abiri mu mwenda. Mu bulamu bwe obumpi abantu bangi bajja mu kukkiriza, era ebbaluwa ze n’okubuulira kwe bizzizza amaanyi mu bakulembeze okuva olwo. Mu bbaluwa gye yawandiikira omubuulizi omulala omuvubuka mu 1840, yawandiika ebigambo mukwano gwe Andrew Bonar bye yafulumya oluvannyuma:

“Katonda tawa mukisa nnyo talanta ennene ng’awa okufaanana Yesu okunene. Omubuulizi omutukuvu kyokulwanyisa eky’entiisa mu mukono gwa Katonda.”

— Robert Murray M’Cheyne, ebbaluwa ya 1840, mu Memoir and Remains (Ebijjukizo n’Ebiwandiiko Ebyasigalawo) ekya Andrew Bonar

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Katonda tawa mukisa birabo binene nga bw’awa obulamu obufaanana Yesu. Omukulembeze omutukuvu kyokulwanyisa ekyewuunyisa mu mukono gwa Katonda. (Mu biseera bya M’Cheyne, ekigambo ky’Olungereza “awful” kyategeezanga “ekijjudde okutya n’okuwuniikirira”, so si “ekibi ennyo”.)

Abasajja bano bonsatule baali babuulizi abaweebwa ebirabo. Bonsatule baagamba ekintu kye kimu: ebirabo byo si bye by’omuwendo bisinga by’olina. Omwoyo gwo gwe gusinga. Gulabirire.

Okwerokola n’okulokola abakuwulira

Pawulo yasuubiza Timoseewo nti bwe yandyekuumye ne mu by’ayigiriza, “olyerokola ggwe wennyini, era n’abo abakuwulira” (1 Timoseewo 4:16). Teyategeeza nti Timoseewo yali asobola okulokola omuntu yenna olw’amaanyi ge ye. Kristo yekka y’alokola. Naye Katonda akozesa abakulembeze abeesigwa ng’ebikozesebwa bye, era omukulembeze eyeekuuma mu mwoyo gwe ajja kuba ekikozesebwa Katonda ky’asobola okukozesa obulamu bwe bwonna.

Kale weekuume, si lwa kutya, wabula lwa kwagala: okwagala Kristo eyakugula; okwagala abantu bo abeetaaga obeere bulungi; n’okwagala omwoyo gwo ggwe, ogw’omuwendo eri Katonda nga bwe gwabwe gwe guli.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28. Olowooza lwaki Pawulo yasooka “Mwekumenga” n’alyoka ayogera ku “kisibo kyonna”?
  • Samusooni “teyamanya nga Mukama Katonda amulese”. Bubonero ki obulaga nti omukulembeze aseeyeeya nga takitegeera?
  • Soma Okubikkulirwa 2:1-5. Okyayagala Yesu nga bwe wamwagalanga ku ntandikwa? Okimanya otya?
  • Mu ngeri ki ebintu ebitukuvu gye byafuuka ebya bulijjo gy’oli? Kiki ekiyinza okukuyamba okuddamu okubitwala ng’ebitukuvu?
  • Baxter yalabula abasumba obutaba “nga mwefiisa enjala nga mutegekera abalala emmere”. Ddi lwe wasembayo okusoma Bayibuli ku lw’omwoyo gwo wekka?
  • Muntu ki akumanyi obulungi ekimala okukulabula? Bwe kiba nga tewali, ani gw’oyinza okusaba?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Weeteerewo essaawa emu wiiki eno, ewala n’omulimu gwo ogwa bulijjo. Jjangu ne Bayibuli yo n’akatabo k’okuwandiikamu. Soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:17-38 mpola. Oluvannyuma wandiika eby’okuddamu eby’amazima ku bibuuzo bino: Okwagala kwange eri Yesu kuli kutya? Kibi ki kye ngumiikiriza? By’njigiriza bikwatagana n’Ebyawandiikibwa? Nkooye, era bwe kiba bwe kityo, lwaki? Nkyukakyuka ki emu gye nneetaaga okukola? Maliriza ng’osaba Zabbuli 51:10-12 ku lulwo.

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze balina okwekuuma bokka?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga omwoyo gw’omukulembeze yennyini gwe gusooka. Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo nti, “Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza” (1 Timoseewo 4:16), era n’agamba abakadde b’e Efeso nti, “Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28). Omukulembeze ayinza okulabirira abalala n’alagajjalira omutima gwe ye.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza okuseeyeeya okuva ku Katonda nga takimanyi?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Samusooni “teyamanya nga Mukama Katonda amulese” (Abalamuzi 16:20), era Sulemaani mu bukadde bwe “bakyala be ne basendasenda omutima gwe okugoberera bakatonda abalala” (1 Bassekabaka 11:4). Yesu yagamba ekkanisa ey’omu Efeso nti, “nnina ensonga gye nkuvunaana: tokyanjagala nga bwe wanjagalanga edda” (Okubikkulirwa 2:4).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okukuuma omutima gwe?
study_questions.answer: “Ekisinga byonna kuuma omutima gwo, kubanga y’ensulo y’obulamu bwo” (Engero 4:23). Essuula eno eteesa ekiseera eky’obwannamunigina ne Katonda, emikwano egy’amazima, okwekebera buli kiseera n’okuwummula, era ekozesa ebigambo bya Richard Baxter, Charles Spurgeon ne Robert Murray M’Cheyne.

fields.title: Okwagala: Ekikukubiriza n’Akabonero
fields.body_html:
“Naye nzija kusanyuka nnyo okwewaayo gye muli, nze ne byonna bye nnina olw’emyoyo gyammwe.”

— 2 Abakkolinso 12:15

Waliwo ekika ky’omukulembeze omulungi ennyo mu mulimu naye atayagala bantu. Ateekateeka bulungi, abuulira bulungi era ategeka bulungi. Naye abantu bawulira nga bakozesebwa so si nga balabirirwa. Bitundu bya pulojekiti y’omukulembeze, so si bitundu by’omutima gwe. Era waliwo ekika ky’omukulembeze akola ensobi nnyingi, naye ng’abantu be bamugoberera buli gy’agenda, kubanga bamanyi nti baagalwa.

Essuula eno ekwata ku kwagala: ekikubiriza obukulembeze bwonna obw’omwoyo, era akabonero ensi k’eneetutegeereramu nti tuli ba Kristo.

Awatali kwagala, tewali kintu

Pawulo essuula esinga okumanyika mu Bayibuli ku kwagala yagiwandiikira ekkanisa eyali ejjudde abakulembeze abaweebwa ebirabo. Abakristaayo ab’omu Kkolinso baalina buli kirabo eky’omwoyo. Baalina ababuulizi, abayigiriza, bannabbi, n’abantu aboogera mu nnimi. Naye baali ba malala, beeyawuddemu, era nga tebalina kisa eri bannaabwe. Kale Pawulo n’awandiika nti:

“Singa njogera ennimi z’abantu n’eza bamalayika, naye nga sirina kwagala, mba ng’ekidde, ekireekaana oba ng’ekitaasa ekisaala. Ne bwe mba n’ekirabo eky’okwogera eby’obunnabbi, ne ntegeera ebyama byonna, era ne mmanya ebintu byonna, era ne bwe mba n’okukkiriza okungi ne kunsobozesa n’okusiguukulula ensozi, naye nga sirina kwagala, mba siri kintu” (1 Abakkolinso 13:1-2).

Ebyo bisome mpola, olowooze ku birabo abakulembeze bye basinga okwegomba: okwogera n’amaanyi, okumanya okw’obuziba, okukkiriza okunene, n’okwefiiriza. Pawulo agamba nti awatali kwagala, byonna tebiriiko kye bigasa. Okubuulira okw’amaanyi okubuulirwa awatali kwagala kuba kuleekaana bulekaanyi. Pulojekiti ennene ekoleddwa awatali kwagala tebalibwa mu ggulu. “Ne bwe mpaayo ebyange byonna okuyamba abaavu, era ne bwe mpaayo omubiri gwange ne nneewaana, naye ne siba na kwagala, sibaako kye ngasibbwa” (1 Abakkolinso 13:3).

Kino kigambo kizibu eri abakulembeze, kubanga emirundi mingi tupimibwa olw’ebirabo byaffe n’ebivudde mu mulimu gwaffe. Katonda atupima olw’okwagala kwaffe.

Okwagala bwe kufaanana

Oluvannyuma Pawulo annyonnyola okwagala, si ng’ekiwulirwa mu mutima, wabula ng’engeri y’okukolamu: “Okwagala kugumiikiriza era kwa kisa. Okwagala tekulina buggya era tekwenyumiikiriza wadde okwekuluntaza. Okwagala tekukola bitasaana, tekunoonya byakwo, tekunyiiga mangu, era tekusiba kibi ku mwoyo. Okwagala tekusanyukira bitali bya butuukirivu, wabula kusanyukira mazima. Okwagala kugumira byonna, kukkiriza byonna, kusuubira byonna era kugumiikiriza byonna” (1 Abakkolinso 13:4-7).

Buli lunyiriri ku zino lunnyonnyola omukulembeze alina okwagala.

  • Mugumiikiriza. Omukulembeze alina okwagala tava ku bantu abakula mpola.
  • Wa kisa. Mukkakkamu mu ngeri gy’ayogeramu, ne bw’aba alina okwogera ebintu ebizibu.
  • Talina buggya. Asanyuka omukulembeze omulala bw’aweebwa omukisa.
  • Teyenyumiriza. Takozesa bantu ng’abalabi b’ebirabo bye.
  • Tanoonya bibye. Takulembera lwa kufunamu kintu.
  • Tanyiiga mangu. Tabogolera bantu wadde okubatiisa.
  • Tasiba kibi ku mwoyo. Takuuma lukalala lw’ensobi z’abantu okuzibakozesaako.
  • Asanyukira mazima. Takweka mazima olw’okusanyusa abantu.
  • Agumira, akkiriza, asuubira, agumiikiriza. Yeeyongera okwagala abantu ne mu kuggwaamu essuubi.

Eky’okukola ekiyamba kwe kuddamu okusoma 1 Abakkolinso 13:4-7 n’oteeka erinnya lyo mu kifo ky’ekigambo “okwagala”: “Musoke mugumiikiriza era wa kisa. Musoke talina buggya ...” Wa we kiwulikika ng’eky’obulimba? Awo w’oyetaagira ekisa kya Katonda.

Okwagala Kristo kwe kusooka

Twalaba mu Ssuula 3, Yesu, Omusumba Omukulu, nti Yesu bwe yazzaawo Peetero, yamubuuza emirundi esatu nti, “Onjagala?” Buli mulundi Peetero bwe yaddamu nti yee, Yesu n’agamba nti, “liisanga endiga zange” (Yokaana 21:17). Okwagala endiga kukula okuva mu kwagala Omusumba.

Kino kikulu, kubanga abantu kizibu okubaagala. Batumalamu amaanyi. Batuvumirira. Beerabira bye twabakolera. Okwagala kwaffe eri abantu bwe kuba kwesigamye ku ngeri gye batuyisaamu kwokka, kujja kuggwaawo. Naye bwe kukulukuta okuva mu kwagala kwaffe eri Kristo, kuba n’ensulo eri wansi ennyo. Tubaweereza kubanga tumwagala, era kubanga ye abaagala.

Yokaana yawandiika nti, “Tulina okwagala kubanga Ye ye yasooka okutwagala” (1 Yokaana 4:19). Gye tukoma okumanya Kristo bw’atwagala ennyo, gye tukoma okusobola okwagala abalala. Omukulembeze atalina bbugumu eri abantu, emirundi mingi aba yasooka kuwola eri Katonda. Eddagala si kufuba nnyo kwagala bantu. Kwe kudda ku musaalaba, Kristo n’akwagala nate.

Yesu yawa abayigirizwa be ekiragiro kino mu kiro ekyasooka okufa kwe: “Mwagalanenga nga nze bwe mbaagala. Bwe munaayagalananga abantu bonna kwe banaategeereranga nti muli bayigirizwa bange” (Yokaana 13:34-35). Ensi tegenda kukkirizibwa lwa bizimbe byaffe, lwa bungi bwaffe, wadde lwa mpaka zaffe. Ejja kukkirizibwa lwa kwagala kwaffe.

Okwagala kw’omuzadde

Emirundi mingi Pawulo yayogeranga ku kwagala kwe eri ekkanisa mu bigambo eby’amaka. Abakkiriza ab’omu Sessaloniika yabawandiikira nti, “twefuula ng’abaana abato mu maaso gammwe, nga nnyina w’abaana bwe yandyagadde abaana be, bwe tutyo bwe twabalumirwa omwoyo ne tusanyuka okubatuusaako si Enjiri ya Katonda yokka naye n’okuwaayo emyoyo gyaffe ffe, kubanga mwafuuka baagalwa baffe” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:7-8).

Maama ayonsa talabirira mwana we lwa kuba mulimu gwe. Akikola kubanga ayagala omwana. Agolokoka ekiro. Agumiikiriza okukaaba. Awaayo amaanyi ge omwana alyoke akule. Bw’atyo Pawulo bwe yawuliranga eri ekkanisa.

Yawandiikira Abafiripi nti, “Katonda ye mujulirwa wange nga mwenna bwe mbaagala n’okwagala okuva eri Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 1:8). Yawandiikira Abakkolinso, abaali bamulumizza ennyo, nti, “nzija kusanyuka nnyo okwewaayo gye muli, nze ne byonna bye nnina olw’emyoyo gyammwe” (2 Abakkolinso 12:15). Era yawandiika ne ku bantu be, Abayudaaya abaali bagaanye Kristo, nti, “nga ndimunakuwavu nnyo era nga nnumwa mu mutima” (Abaruumi 9:2).

Musa naye yawulira bw’atyo. Isirayiri bwe yayonoona ng’esinza ennyana eya zaabu, yaddayo eri Katonda n’asaba nti, “Bw’oba osiima basonyiwe ekibi kyabwe; naye bwe kitaba kityo, nkwegayirira onsangule mu kitabo kyo ky’owandiise” (Okuva 32:32). Yandisinze kubula ye kennyini okusinga okulaba abantu be nga babula. Ogwo gwe mutima gw’omusumba.

Okwagala okwogera amazima

Abantu abamu balowooza nti omukulembeze alina okwagala y’oyo atayogera kintu kyonna kizibu. Naye ekyo si kwagala. Emirundi mingi kuba kutya. Okwagala “tekusanyukira bitali bya butuukirivu, wabula kusanyukira mazima” (1 Abakkolinso 13:6). Omuzadde alina okwagala anenya omwana we. Omusawo alina okwagala abuulira omulwadde amazima ku bulwadde bwe. Omukulembeze alina okwagala alabula, anenya era aluŋŋamya, kubanga afaayo ku bulungi bw’omuntu okusinga okwagalibwa.

Naye okwagala kwe kubumba engeri gye tunenyaamu. Pawulo agamba nti omuntu bw’asangibwa mu kibi, “mmwe ab’omwoyo mumuluŋŋamyenga mu buwombeefu” (Abaggalatiya 6:1).
