Okwagala kwogera amazima mu bukkakkamu, mu kyama we kisoboka, n’amaziga mu kifo ky’obusungu, era bulijjo nga kigendererwa kuzzaawo muntu. Kino tujja kukitunuulira mu Ssuula 20, Okunenya n’Okuzzaawo.

Okwagala okubikka

Peetero yawandiika nti, “N’ekisingira ddala obukulu mwagalanenga ddala mu mazima, kubanga okwagalana kubikka ebibi bingi” (1 Peetero 4:8). Kino tekitegeeza kukweka bikolwa bibi eby’amaanyi wadde okukuuma abo abatulugunya abalala. Kitegeeza nti okwagala tekulangirira nsobi za balala. Tekuwaayiriza. Kuwa abantu omukisa nga tekunnaba kubasalira musango. Kusonyiwa ensobi entono ennyingi ezibaawo buli abantu lwe babeera n’okukolera awamu.

Abakulembeze emirundi mingi balumizibwa abantu be baweereza. Omuntu abavumirira mu bukyamu. Omuntu ava mu kkanisa nga tayogedde kigambo. Omuntu gwe baayamba abeefuukira. Okwagala “tekusiba kibi ku mwoyo” (1 Abakkolinso 13:5). Pawulo atugamba nti, “Bwe wabangawo omuntu yenna alina ensonga ku munne, muzibiikirizaganenga, era musonyiwaganenga. Nga Mukama waffe bwe yabasonyiwa era nammwe musonyiwaganenga. Okwagala kwe kusinga ebintu ebirala byonna, kubanga kwe kunyweza ebintu byonna” (Abakkolosaayi 3:13-14).

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Amy Carmichael

Amy Carmichael yazaalibwa mu Northern Ireland mu 1867. Bwe yali akyali muvubuka, yagenda e Buyindi ng’omuminsani, era teyaddayo waka. Okumala emyaka egisukka mu ataano yabeera e Dohnavur mu bukiikaddyo obw’ewala obwa Buyindi. Eyo ye ne bakozi banne baawonya abaana, bangi ku bo baali mu kabi k’okuweebwayo mu masabo, ne babakuza ng’abaabwe. Ekibiina kya Dohnavur kyafuuka amaka amanene ag’abaana n’abakozi ebikumi n’ebikumi. Amy Carmichael ye yali omukulembeze waakyo, era abaana baamuyitanga “Amma”, ekitegeeza “maama”.

Yawandiika ebitabo bingi. Ekimu ku bisinga obumpi kiyitibwa If (“Bwe”). Lukalala lwa sentensi ennyimpi, buli emu ng’etandika ne “Bwe” era ng’ekoma ku bigambo bye bimu: “awo nga sirina kye mmanyi ku kwagala kw’e Kalvaliyo.” Okwagala kw’e Kalvaliyo yategeeza okwagala Yesu kwe yalaga ku musaalaba e Kalvaliyo. Zino ze zimu ku sentensi ze:

“Bwe mba nga nsobola okwogera ku nsobi n’ebibi by’abalala mu ngeri ennyangu; bwe mba nga nsobola okwogera ku kibi ky’omwana ng’ekintu ekitali kya nsonga, awo nga sirina kye mmanyi ku kwagala kw’e Kalvaliyo. ... Bwe mba nga sirina bugumiikiriza bwa Mulokozi wange eri emyoyo egikula mpola; bwe mba nga mmanyi kitono ku kulumwa okwo okw’okuzaala okutuusa Kristo lw’abumbibwa mu bo mu bujjuvu, awo nga sirina kye mmanyi ku kwagala kw’e Kalvaliyo. ... Bwe mba nga sisobola kutwala kifo kya kubiri n’essanyu, oba eky’amakumi abiri; bwe mba nga sisobola kutwala kifo kisooka nga sireeta ssira ku butasaana bwange, awo nga sirina kye mmanyi ku kwagala kw’e Kalvaliyo. ... Bwe mba nga okutenderezebwa kunsitula ate okunenyezebwa ne kunsuula wansi; bwe mba nga sisobola kuwummula nga sitegeereddwa bulungi nga seewolerezza; bwe mba nga njagala okwagalibwa okusinga okwagala, okuweerezebwa okusinga okuweereza, awo nga sirina kye mmanyi ku kwagala kw’e Kalvaliyo.”

— Amy Carmichael, If

Ebitabo bitono ebikebera omukulembeze nga kino. Amy Carmichael teyawandiika ku kwagala mu ngeri ya wamu. Yawandiika ku bigezo by’okwagala ebitono, ebya buli lunaku, buli mukulembeze by’asanga: engeri gye twogera ku bantu abagwa, obugumiikiriza bwe tulina eri okukula okw’empola, oba tusobola okutwala ekifo eky’okubiri, oba twetaaga okutenderezebwa. Ebigezo bino yali abimanyi bulungi, kubanga yabisanganga buli lunaku mu maka amanene era amazibu.

Obulamu bwe bwalaga nti okwagala si bunafu. Yali munywevu, muzira era ng’asaba abalala bingi. Yayimirira okulwanyisa abantu ab’obuyinza okukuuma abaana. Naye obunywevu bwe bwava mu kwagala, era abaana be yakuza baali bakimanyi.

Ekisinga ku ebyo

Pawulo amaliriza essuula ye ku kwagala n’ebigambo bino: “Kaakano waliwo ebintu bisatu eby’olubeerera: okukkiriza, n’okusuubira, era n’okwagala. Naye ekisingako ku ebyo obukulu kwe kwagala” (1 Abakkolinso 13:13). Lumu ebirabo byaffe tebiribeera nate byetaagisa. Obunnabbi buliggwaawo. Okumanya kulituukirira. Naye okwagala kulisigalawo emirembe gyonna, kubanga Katonda kwagala.

Bw’oba oyagala okumanya obanga oli mukulembeze ow’omwoyo, tosooka kwebuuza ebirabo by’olina bwe biri ebinene, abantu bameka abakugoberera, oba ebingi by’ozimbye. Weebuuze obanga olina okwagala. Weebuuze obanga abantu b’okulembera bawulira nga obaagala. Ako ke kabonero k’omukulembeze ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 1 Abakkolinso 13:1-3. Kirabo ki ky’osinga okukemebwa okwesigamako mu kifo ky’okwagala?
  • Teeka erinnya lyo mu kifo ky’“okwagala” mu 1 Abakkolinso 13:4-7. Lunyiriri ki olusinga okukuzibuwalira okwogera mu mazima?
  • “Tulina okwagala kubanga Ye ye yasooka okutwagala.” Okujjukira okwagala kwa Kristo gy’oli kukyusa kutya engeri gy’olabamu abantu abazibu?
  • Pawulo yeegeraageranya ne maama ayonsa. Kyandibadde kitya ggwe okukulembera n’okulabirira okw’obukkakkamu okw’engeri eyo?
  • Kiki ekisinga okukuzibuwalira: okwogera amazima mu kwagala, oba okubikka ensobi z’abalala mu kwagala? Lwaki?
  • Sentensi ki ku za Amy Carmichael ezitandika ne “Bwe” eyasinga okukukwatako? Ekulaga ki ku mutima gwo?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Lowooza ku muntu omu gw’okulembera gw’osanga nga kizibu okumwagala. Buli lunaku wiiki eno, musabire ng’omwogerako erinnya lye, era osabe Katonda akuwe okwagala kwe gy’ali. Oluvannyuma mukolere ekikolwa kimu eky’okwagala ekirabika: okumukyalira, okumuwa ku mmere, obubaka obw’ekisa, ekigambo ekizzaamu amaanyi, oba okumuyamba mu kasirise. Tomubuulira nsonga lwaki. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, weetegereze obanga by’omuwuliramu bikyuse.

study_questions.question: Lwaki okwagala kwe kabonero k’omukulembeze akasinga obukulu?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga awatali kwagala, n’ebirabo ebinene tebiriiko kye bigasa: “naye nga sirina kwagala, mba ng’ekidde, ekireekaana oba ng’ekitaasa ekisaala” (1 Abakkolinso 13:1). Yesu yagamba nti ensi yandimanyidde abayigirizwa be ku kwagala kwe baalina buli omu eri munne (Yokaana 13:34-35).

study_questions.question: Okwagala kufaanana kutya mu mukulembeze?
study_questions.answer: “Okwagala kugumiikiriza era kwa kisa. Okwagala tekulina buggya era tekwenyumiikiriza wadde okwekuluntaza” (1 Abakkolinso 13:4). Kwewaayo ku lw’abalala, nga Pawulo bwe yawandiika nti: “nzija kusanyuka nnyo okwewaayo gye muli, nze ne byonna bye nnina olw’emyoyo gyammwe” (2 Abakkolinso 12:15).

study_questions.question: Okwagala omukulembeze kw’alina eri abantu kuva wa?
study_questions.answer: Kuva mu kwagala Katonda kw’alina gye tuli. “Tulina okwagala kubanga Ye ye yasooka okutwagala” (1 Yokaana 4:19). Okwagala Kristo kwe kusooka: Yesu nga tannagamba Peetero nti, “liisanga endiga zange”, yasooka kumubuuza nti, “Onjagala?” (Yokaana 21:17).

fields.title: Obuvumu
fields.body_html:
“Kubanga Mwoyo wa Katonda, gwe yatuwa tatufuula bati, wabula atuwa amaanyi, n’okwagala era n’okwegendereza.”

— 2 Timoseewo 1:7

Buli mukulembeze atya oluusi. Atya okulemererwa, okuvumirirwa, okufiirwa emikwano, okufiirwa ekifo kye, era mu bifo ebimu atya okufiirwa eddembe lye oba obulamu bwe. Okutya si kibi. Kiwulirwa kya bulijjo eky’obuntu. Ekibuuzo kiri nti kiki kye tukikolera. Tuleka okutya kwe kusalawo bye twogera ne bye tukola? Oba tugondera Katonda ne bwe tuba nga tutya?

Obwo bwe buvumu. Si butabaamu kutya. Bwe bwesigwa eri Katonda nga n’okutya kuliwo. Essuula eno y’efundikira Ekitundu eky’Okubiri: Omutima gw’Omukulembeze, kubanga omukulembeze ayinza okuba omwetoowaze, omwesigwa, eyeekuuma era alina okwagala, naye n’alemererwa bw’aba talina buvumu bumala okukola.

“Ddamu amaanyi, guma omwoyo”

Musa bwe yafa, abantu ba Isirayiri baali bayimiridde ku nsalo y’ensi ensuubize. Mu maaso gaabwe mwalimu amawanga ag’amaanyi n’ebibuga ebyazimbibwako bbugwe. Omukulembeze waabwe omukulu yali agenze. Katonda n’awa obukulembeze Yoswa, eyali omuyambi wa Musa okumala emyaka amakumi ana.

Ebigambo bya Katonda ebyasooka eri omukulembeze omuggya byali bikwata ku buvumu. Yakyogera emirundi esatu: “Ddamu amaanyi, guma omwoyo; kubanga ggwe oligabira abantu bano ensi gye nasuubiza edda bajjajjaabwe. Ddamu amaanyi era beera muzira ... Noolwekyo ddamu amaanyi, guma omwoyo, totya era toterebuka kubanga Mukama Katonda wo anaabanga naawe buli gy’onoogendanga” (Yoswa 1:6-9).

Weetegereze ebintu bisatu ku bigambo bya Katonda eri Yoswa.

Obuvumu kiragiro. Katonda teyagamba nti, “Nsuubira nti ojja kuwulira ng’oli muvumu.” Yagamba nti, “Ddamu amaanyi, guma omwoyo.” Obuvumu kye kintu kye tusalawo, so si kiwulirwa kyokka kye tulina.

Obuvumu bwegatta n’obuwulize. Wakati mu bigambo bye ku buvumu, Katonda yagamba nti, “byonna by’okola obyesigamye ku mateeka omuweereza wange Musa ge yakulagira; togaviirangako ddala, oleme okukyama ku mukono ogwa ddyo oba ogwa kkono” (Yoswa 1:7). Obuvumu obw’amazima si bwa kwesuulirayo gwa nnaggamba. Bwe buvumu obw’okugondera Ekigambo kya Katonda ng’okugonda kuzibu.

Obuvumu bwesigamye ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda. Ensonga lwaki Yoswa yali asobola okuba omuvumu teyali maanyi ge ye. Yali eno: “Mukama Katonda wo anaabanga naawe buli gy’onoogendanga” (Yoswa 1:9). Musa yali amugambye ekintu kye kimu nga tannafa: “Mukama Katonda wo anaagendanga naawe buli w’onoddanga, taakulekenga so taakwabulirenga” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 31:6).

Omutego gw’okutya abantu

Okutya okusinga okulabika mu bakulembeze si kutya kufa. Kwe kutya abantu: bye banaalowooza, bye banaayogera oba bye banaakola. “Okutya omuntu kuleeta ekyambika, naye buli eyeesiga Mukama anaabanga mirembe” (Engero 29:25).

Okutya abantu kukwasa abakulembeze mu ngeri nnyingi. Kulemesa omusumba okubuulira ku nsonga ejja okunyiiza amaka amakulu. Kulemesa omukadde w’ekkanisa okunenya omukulembeze akola ekibi. Kulemesa omukkiriza ku mulimu okwogera ku bukumpanya. Kufuula abakulembeze okukyusa obubaka bwabwe okusanyusa ekibiina, oba okwewala okusalawo okuzibu kubanga waliwo ayinza okunyiiga.

Pawulo yasanga okukemebwa kuno n’akwatuuma bulungi: “Kale kaakano nkolerera kumatiza bantu oba kusiimibwa Katonda? Oba ngezaako kusanyusa bantu? Singa nnali nkyagezaako okusanyusa abantu, sandibadde muddu wa Kristo” (Abaggalatiya 1:10). Omukulembeze tasobola kuweereza bakama babiri. Bw’oba bulijjo ogezaako okusanyusa abantu, ku nkomerero ojja kujeemera Katonda.

Yesu yawa eky’okuddamu eri okutya abantu: “Era temubatyanga abo abatta omubiri kubanga tebasobola kutta mwoyo! Naye mutyenga oyo yekka, ayinza okuzikiriza byombi omwoyo n’omubiri mu ggeyeena” (Matayo 10:28). Okutya Katonda kugoba okutya abantu. Bwe tujjukira Katonda bw’ali omukulu era omutukuvu, endowooza z’abantu ziba ntono.

Ebifaananyi by’obuvumu

Bayibuli ejjudde abantu aba bulijjo abaafuna obuvumu obw’ekitalo.

Kalebu ne Yoswa baali babiri ku bakessi ekkumi n’ababiri Musa be yatuma mu nsi ensuubize. Ekkumi baakomawo nga batidde nnyo. Naye Kalebu n’agamba nti, “Twambukirewo kaakano tutwale ensi eyo, kubanga ndaba nga tusobola okugiwangula” (Okubala 13:30). Abantu bwe baayagala okubakuba amayinja, Yoswa ne Kalebu ne bagamba nti, “Mukama Katonda ali wamu naffe. Temubatya” (Okubala 14:9). Obuvumu oluusi kitegeeza okuyimirira okwolekera abasinga obungi.

Eseza yali muwala muto Omuyudaaya eyali afuuse nnabagereka wa Buperusi. Etteeka bwe lyayisibwa okuzikiriza abantu be, muganda we Moluddekaayi n’amusaba agende eri kabaka, newaakubadde okugenda nga tayitiddwa kyali kiyinza okumuviirako okufa. N’amugamba nti, “Ate ani amanyi obanga wafuulibwa Nnabagereka lwa kiseera kino?” (Eseza 4:14). Eseza n’asaba abantu bamusiibire, n’alyoka agamba nti, “ndigenda eri Kabaka, newaakubadde nga tekikkirizibwa mu mateeka. Bwe ndiba ow’okuzikirira, nzikirira” (Eseza 4:16). Obuvumu oluusi kitegeeza okukozesa ekifo Katonda ky’akuwadde, ng’oteeka obulamu bwo mu kabi kanene, ku lw’abalala.

Saddulaaki, Meesaki ne Abeduneego baagaana okuvunnamira ekifaananyi ekya zaabu ekya Kabaka Nebukadduneeza. Baagamba kabaka nti, “Katonda gwe tuweereza anaatuwonya ekikoomi ekyaka omuliro era anaatulokola mu mukono gwo, ayi kabaka. Naye ne bwe kitaabe bwe kityo, twagala okimanye, ayi kabaka nga tetugenda kuweereza bakatonda bo” (Danyeri 3:17-18). Ebigambo ebyo, “ne bwe kitaabe bwe kityo”, gwe mutima gw’obuvumu. Beesiga Katonda okubalokola, naye baali ba kumugondera ne bwe yandirese okubalokola.

Peetero ne Yokaana baakwatibwa olw’okubuulira ku Yesu. Abakulembeze abaali bakomeredde Yesu ne babalagira bakomye. “Awo ab’Olukiiko bwe baalaba obuvumu bwa Peetero ne Yokaana, ate n’okutegeera ne bategeera nga tebaasoma, era nga si batendeke, ne beewuunya nnyo, ne bategeera ng’abasajja abo baabeeranga ne Yesu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:13). Obuvumu bwabwe tebwava mu kusoma wadde mu kifo kyabwe. Bwava mu kubeera ne Yesu.

Obuvumu gye buva

Obuvumu bw’abantu bano bonna bwava wa? Bayibuli eraga ebintu ebiwerako.

  • Okubeerawo kwa Katonda. “Totya kubanga nze ndi wamu naawe; tokeŋŋentererwa, kubanga nze Katonda wo. Nnaakuwanga amaanyi. Wewaawo nnaakuyambanga n’omukono ogwa ddyo ogw’obutuukirivu bwange” (Isaaya 41:10). Omukulembeze omuvumu tali yekka.
  • Okutya Katonda. Bwe tutya Katonda okusinga abantu, tusobola okwolekera kyonna abantu kye bakola.
  • Omuntu ow’omunda omulongoofu. “Abakozi b’ebibi badduka nga tewali abagoba, naye abatuukirivu babeera n’obuvumu ng’empologoma” (Engero 28:1). Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 8, Obwesigwa: Omuntu Omu ne mu Kyama, obwesigwa buwa obuvumu.
  • Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Peetero ne Yokaana bwe baamala okuteebwa, ekkanisa yasaba nti, “owe abaddu bo obuvumu babuulire ekigambo kyo.” Awo “bonna ne bajjuzibwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu ne babuulira ekigambo kya Katonda n’obuvumu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:29, 31). Tebaasaba kabi kaggweewo. Baasaba buvumu, era Omwoyo n’abubawa.
  • Essaala z’abalala. Pawulo, ng’ali mu kkomera, yasaba ekkanisa zimusabire “ndyoke ngibuulire abantu n’obuvumu nga bwe kinsaanira” (Abaefeso 6:20). N’abakulembeze abasinga obuvumu beetaaga abalala okubasabira obuvumu.
  • Essuubi erisukka obulamu buno. Omukulembeze amanyi nti okufa si ye nkomerero ayinza okwolekera n’okufa mu mirembe.

Obuvumu mu bintu ebitono

Abakulembeze abasinga obungi tebalyolekera kikoomi kya muliro wadde ekisaawe. Naye buli mukulembeze asanga ebigezo by’obuvumu buli lunaku. Kyetaagisa obuvumu:

  • okubuulira mukwano gwo amazima amazibu g’alina okuwulira;
  • okukkiriza mu maaso g’abalala nti wakola ensobi;
  • okugaana enguzi oba okusaba okw’obukumpanya ku mulimu;
  • okubuulira ebitundu bya Bayibuli abantu bye batayagala;
  • okuyimirirako omuntu ayisibwa mu ngeri etali ya bwenkanya;
  • okukyusa ekintu mu kkanisa ekibadde kikolebwa mu ngeri emu bulijjo;
  • okuggyawo omukulembeze aleeta obulabe, ne bw’aba wa buyinza;
  • okweyongerayo ng’omulimu gugenda mpola era ng’owulira ng’oyagala okulekayo.

Ebiragiro bya Pawulo eri ekkanisa ey’omu Kkolinso bibifunza bulungi: “Mutunulenga, munywerere mu kukkiriza, mubeere bazira era ab’amaanyi. Buli kye mukola mukikolerenga mu kwagala” (1 Abakkolinso 16:13-14). Weetegereze engeri gy’amalirizaamu: “mukikolerenga mu kwagala.” Obuvumu obutaliimu kwagala bufuuka obukambwe. Okwagala okutaliimu buvumu kufuuka obunafu. Omukulembeze ow’omwoyo yeetaaga byombi.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: abakulembeze abaayimirira

Ebyafaayo by’Ekkanisa bijjudde abakulembeze abaafuna obuvumu okuva eri Katonda. Bano be bana ku bo, okuva mu mirembe ena egy’enjawulo.

Athanasius ow’e Alegezanderiya yali mulabirizi w’ekibuga ekinene Alegezanderiya mu Misiri mu myaka gya 300. Mu biseera bye, okuyigiriza kwasaasaana nti Yesu si Katonda ddala wabula kitonde. Abalabirizi bangi ne bakabaka b’obwakabaka baakuwagira. Athanasius yagaana. Yayigiriza nti Yesu Katonda mu bujjuvu, omu ne Kitaawe. Olw’ekyo yagobebwa mu nsi ye emirundi etaano, n’amala emyaka mingi ng’akwekeddwa. Oluvannyuma abantu baafunza obulamu bwe mu bigambo by’Olulattini: Athanasius contra mundum, “Athanasius ng’alwanyisa ensi yonna.” Ebitabo bye, nga Ku Kufuuka Omuntu, biri ku Ochorus, era Ekkanisa ekyayatula ebyo bye yalwanirira.

Katerina ow’e Siena yali mukazi Omuyitale ow’omu myaka gya 1300 atalina kifo kyonna mu kkanisa. Mu biseera bye Paapa yali avudde mu Rooma ng’abeera mu Avignon, mu Bufalansa, era ekkanisa yali nnafu era nga yeeyawuddemu. Katerina yawandiikira Paapa, Gregory XI, emirundi n’emirundi, ng’amukubiriza okuddayo e Rooma n’okuzza obuggya ekkanisa. Yamukoowoola okuba omuvumu n’okutuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bwe. Mu 1377 yaddayo. Omukazi owa bulijjo, ow’amaanyi mu kusaba, yalina obuvumu okwogera n’omukulembeze w’ekkanisa eyali asinga obuyinza mu biseera bye.

Martin Luther yali mumonaki era omusomesa Omugirimaani mu myaka gya 1500. Yali akizudde mu Bayibuli nti tulokolebwa lwa kisa kya Katonda olw’okukkiriza mu Kristo, so si lwa bikolwa byaffe. Mu 1521 yayitibwa mu maaso ga kabaka ow’obwakabaka mu lukuŋŋaana olunene mu kibuga Worms n’alagirwa okwejjako bye yali awandiise. Yali amanyi nti bayinza okumutta. Yaddamu nti okuggyako nga alagiddwa okuva mu Byawandiikibwa ne mu nsonga ennyangu ezitegeerekeka nti yali mukyamu, teyali wa kwejjako kintu kyonna, kubanga omuntu we ow’omunda yali musibe w’Ekigambo kya Katonda.

Janani Luwum yakulira mu Bacooli ab’omu bukiikakkono bwa Uganda, n’afuuka omusomesa, n’ajja mu kukkiriza okulamu okuyita mu Kuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba, n’atuuzibwa ng’omubuulizi. Mu 1974 yafuuka Ssaabalabirizi w’Ekkanisa ya Uganda. Mu kiseera ekyo eggwanga lyali lifugibwa Idi Amin, era abantu nkumi na nkumi baali battibwa oba nga babula. Mu Febwali 1977 Luwum yatwala eri Amin ekiwandiiko eky’okwemulugunya ku lw’abalabirizi ku kuttibwa okwo. Yali amanyi akabi. Abantu abaali okumpi naye baali bamanyi ekyatuukanga ku abo abaawakanya gavumenti eyo. Ajjukirwa ng’eyagamba, mu nnaku ezo ezaasembayo, nti yali mwetegefu okufiira mu ggye lya Yesu. Yakwatibwa, era nga 16 Febwali 1977 yali afudde. Gavumenti yagamba nti yali kabenje ka mmotoka. Kumpi tewali yakikkiriza.

Ekitabo Tukutendereza ku Ochorus, ekinyumya emboozi y’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba, kyogera ekigambo eky’amagezi ku Luwum. Kiraga nti Festo Kivengere, omulabirizi omulala ow’omu kuzuukuka okwo, yaddukira mu nsi endala amangu oluvannyuma, era naye yali mutuufu okukola bw’atyo. Kigamba nti, “Si buli muntu ayitibwa ku kino, era okuddukira mu buwaŋŋanguse si kulyamu lukwe. Tokozesa kufa kwa mujulizi omulala kuswaza oyo eyadduka.” Obuvumu tebutegeeza bulijjo kusigala mu kabi. Yesu yennyini oluusi yeewalanga abo abaali baagala okumutta, okutuusa ekiseera kye lwe kyatuuka. Naye obuvumu bulijjo butegeeza okugondera Katonda okusinga okutya kwaffe.

Amaanyi, n’okwagala era n’okwegendereza

Timoseewo yali mukulembeze muvubuka eyalabika nga mutiitiizi mu buzaaliranwa bwe. Pawulo yamuwandiikira ng’ali mu kkomera nti: “Kubanga Mwoyo wa Katonda, gwe yatuwa tatufuula bati, wabula atuwa amaanyi, n’okwagala era n’okwegendereza” (2 Timoseewo 1:7). Weetegereze ebirabo ebisatu. Amaanyi, tulyoke tusobole okukola. Okwagala, obuvumu bwaffe bulyoke buweereze abalala so si ffe ffekka. Okwegendereza, obuvumu bwaffe bulyoke bubeere bwa magezi so si bwa busiru.

Bw’oba oli mukulembeze omutiitiizi, guma omwoyo. Oli mu bantu balungi. Musa, Yeremiya, Timoseewo n’abalala bangi baatyanga. Katonda teyalinda bakomye kutya alyoke abakozese. Yabawa Omwoyo we, era n’agenda nabo. Ajja kukukolera kye kimu.

Kino kye kifundikira Ekitundu eky’Okubiri: Omutima gw’Omukulembeze. Tutunuulidde empisa ttaano ez’omutima gw’omukulembeze: obwetoowaze, obwesigwa, okwekuuma, okwagala n’obuvumu. Tewali na kimu ku zo kiyinza kuvaamu lwa maanyi gaffe. Zikula nga bwe tutambula okumpi ne Katonda. Ekyo kye kigambo ky’Ekitundu eky’Okusatu: Omukulembeze ne Katonda, ekitandika n’omulimu ogusooka ogwa buli mukulembeze ow’omwoyo: okusaba.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Kiki ky’osinga okutya ng’omukulembeze? Kyogere butereevu.
  • Soma Yoswa 1:1-9. Kigambo ki ku bigambo bya Katonda eri Yoswa ky’osinga okwetaaga okuwulira leero?
  • Mu ngeri ki okutya abantu gye kukukwasa mu mutego? Wa we wakyusizza ebigambo byo oba ebikolwa byo okusanyusa abantu okusinga Katonda?
  • Saddulaaki, Meesaki ne Abeduneego baagamba nti, “ne bwe kitaabe bwe kityo.” Obuwulize bwo eri Katonda bwesigamye ku kukukuuma kwe?
  • Tunuulira olukalala lw’ebikolwa ebitono eby’obuvumu. Kiki ku byo Katonda ky’akusaba wiiki eno?
  • Ekkanisa eyasooka yasaba buvumu okusinga obukuumi. Kyandibadde kitya ggwe okusaba essaala eyo?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Lowooza ku kintu kimu ky’omanyi nti Katonda ayagala okikole oba okyogere, naye nga obadde okyewala kubanga otya. Kiwandiike. Buli nkya wiiki eno, soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:23-31 era osabe obuvumu okukikola. Saba mukwano gwo omu gwe weesiga naye akusabire. Oluvannyuma, wiiki nga tennaggwaako, kikole, mu bukkakkamu ne mu kwagala. Ekyo bw’omala, weebaze Katonda olw’okubeera naawe, ne bwe kinaavaamu kitya.

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze Abakristaayo beetaaga obuvumu?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga obukulembeze obw’obwesigwa emirundi mingi butegeeza okukola oba okwogera abantu bye batayagala. Katonda yagamba Yoswa emirundi n’emirundi okuddamu amaanyi n’okuguma omwoyo, n’asuubiza nti, “Mukama Katonda wo anaabanga naawe buli gy’onoogendanga” (Yoswa 1:9).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okuwangula okutya abantu?
study_questions.answer: “Okutya omuntu kuleeta ekyambika, naye buli eyeesiga Mukama anaabanga mirembe” (Engero 29:25). Pawulo yabuuza nti, “Kale kaakano nkolerera kumatiza bantu oba kusiimibwa Katonda?” (Abaggalatiya 1:10). Obuvumu bukula nga bwe tutya Katonda okusinga abantu.

study_questions.question: Obuvumu buva wa?
study_questions.answer: Buva mu kubeerawo kwa Katonda ne mu Mwoyo we. “Kubanga Mwoyo wa Katonda, gwe yatuwa tatufuula bati, wabula atuwa amaanyi, n’okwagala era n’okwegendereza” (2 Timoseewo 1:7). Musa yagamba Isirayiri nti, “taakulekenga so taakwabulirenga” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 31:6).

fields.title: Okusaba Okusooka
fields.body_html:
“Ffe tulyoke twemalire ku kusaba, n’okubuulira n’okuyigiriza.”

— Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:4

Mu nnaku ez’olubereberye ez’Ekkanisa mu Yerusaalemi, waabaawo obuzibu. Ekkanisa yali erabirira bannamwandu ng’ebagabira emmere buli lunaku, naye bannamwandu abaava mu maka agoogera Oluyonaani baali basuulibwa ebbali. Abantu ne beemulugunya. Kyali kyetaago kya ddala, era kyalina okugonjoolwa.

Abatume bandisobodde okweddiza omulimu gw’emmere bo bennyini. Be baali abakulembeze, era ekyetaago kyali kya mangu. Naye ne bagamba nti, “Kirungi ebiseera byaffe tubimalire ku kubuulira Njiri, so si mu kugabanya mmere.” Ne basaba ekkanisa yeerondemu abantu musanvu ab’amagezi, abajjudde Omwoyo, okulabirira bannamwandu. Ne bagamba nti, “Ffe tulyoke twemalire ku kusaba, n’okubuulira n’okuyigiriza” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:2-4).

Weetegereze ekyasooka: okusaba. Abatume tebaalowooza nti okugabanya emmere kyali kintu ekitali kikulu. Baakakasa nti kikolebwa bulungi. Naye baali bamanyi nti singa baganya n’omulimu omulungi okusindika okusaba ebbali, ekkanisa yonna yandibonyebonye. Essuula eno etandika Ekitundu eky’Okusatu: Omukulembeze ne Katonda, n’omulimu ogusooka ogwa buli mukulembeze ow’omwoyo: okusaba.

Okusaba mulimu

Abakulembeze bangi balowooza nti okusaba kintu kye bakola ng’omulimu ogwa ddala tegunnatandika: essaala ennyimpi okuggulawo olukuŋŋaana, okusabira omukisa amangu nga tebannabuulira. Naye abatume baalaba okusaba ng’omulimu ogwa ddala gwennyini. Kyali kimu ku bintu ebibiri bye baagaana okuvaako.

Pawulo yawandiika ku musajja ayitibwa Epafula “afuba bulijjo ku lwammwe okubasabira” (Abakkolosaayi 4:12). Ekigambo ky’Oluyonaani ekivvuunulwa “afuba” kye kigambo ekikozesebwa ku lutalo oba ku mpaka enzibu. Okusaba eri Epafula tekwali mpisa ya kawoowo. Kwali kutegana. Yalwanirira ekkanisa ey’omu Kolosaayi ng’afukamidde.

Nnabbi Samwiri yayogera ekintu ekyewuunyisa abantu ba Isirayiri bwe baamusaba abasabire: “Nze ku lwange, kikafuuwe, okwonoona eri Mukama ne ssibasabira” (1 Samwiri 12:23). Samwiri yalaba obutasaba si ng’obunafu wabula ng’ekibi. Omukulembeze alekera awo okusabira abantu be aba alemereddwa mu kimu ku buvunaanyizibwa bwe obusinga obukulu.

Obulamu bw’okusaba obwa Yesu

Omuyigiriza w’okusaba asinga obulungi ye Yesu yennyini. Enjiri zitulaga emirundi n’emirundi nti omusajja eyali asinga okuba n’eby’okukola mu bonna abaali babaddewo yafunanga obudde okusaba.

Ku ntandikwa y’obuweereza bwe, oluvannyuma lw’olunaku oluwanvu olw’okuwonya abalwadde mu Kaperunawumu, “Enkeera ng’obudde tebunnalaba Yesu n’azuukuka n’agenda yekka mu kifo ekyekusifu, okusaba” (Makko 1:35). Abayigirizwa be ne bajja nga bamunoonya: “Buli muntu akunoonya” (Makko 1:37). Ebyetaago tebyaggwangawo. Naye Yesu yali asoose kugenda kubeera ne Kitaawe.

Ettutumu lye bwe lyagenda likula, n’okunyigirizibwa ne kukula. “Naye ne yeeyongera bweyongezi okubunya ettutumu ly’obuyinza bwa Yesu era ebibiina binene ne bikuŋŋaana okumuwulira n’okuwonyezebwa endwadde zaabwe. Naye bwe yasalangawo akabanga, ne yeeyawula n’alagako mu bifo eteri bantu, okusaba” (Lukka 5:15-16). Weetegereze ekigambo “Naye”. Abantu gye baakoma okumwetaaga, gye yakoma okusaba. Abasinga obungi mu ffe tukola ekikontana n’ekyo. Bwe tuba n’eby’okukola bingi, okusaba kye kintu ekisooka kye tuleka.

Nga tannasalawo kintu kisinga bukulu mu bukulembeze bw’obuweereza bwe, okulonda abatume ekkumi n’ababiri, “Yesu n’alinnya waggulu ku lusozi okusaba, n’asaba ekiro kyonna eri Katonda” (Lukka 6:12). Okusalawo kwe kwava mu kusaba.

Era yasabiranga abantu be yali akulembera. Mu kiro ekyasooka okufa kwe, yagamba Peetero nti, “Simooni, Simooni, Setaani asabye okukuwewa ng’eŋŋaano, naye ggwe nkusabidde okukkiriza kwo kuleme kukuggwaamu” (Lukka 22:31-32). Mu ssaala ye ennene mu Yokaana 17, yasabira abayigirizwa be, n’oluvannyuma n’atusabira ffe: “nsabira n’abo abanzikiriza olw’ekigambo kyabwe” (Yokaana 17:20). Ne kaakano, Bayibuli etugamba, Yesu abeera mulamu okwegayiririra abantu be (Abaebbulaniya 7:25).

Abayigirizwa bwe baalaba Yesu ng’asaba, ne bamugamba nti, “Mukama waffe, naawe tuyigirize okusaba” (Lukka 11:1). Tebaamusaba kubayigiriza ngeri ya kubuulira wadde ey’okukola ebyamagero. Baalaba nti okusaba kye kyama ky’obulamu bwe.

Okusabira abantu b’okulembera

Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga obukulu omukulembeze by’akolera abantu be kwe kubasabira. Ebbaluwa za Pawulo zijjudde essaala ze ku lw’ekkanisa. Eri Abaefeso yawandiika nti, “sirekangayo kwebaza Katonda ku lwammwe” (Abaefeso 1:16). Eri Abafiripi yawandiika nti, “buli lwe mbasabira mwenna nsaba nga nzijudde essanyu” (Abafiripi 1:4).

Pawulo yasabanga ki? Si okusinga ku bulamu bwabwe obw’omubiri oba ku bweyagaza bwabwe, newaakubadde ng’ebyo bikulu. Yasaba bamanye Katonda okusingawo, bategeere essuubi lye n’amaanyi ge, bakule mu kwagala, era bayimirire nga banywevu. Mu Abaefeso 1 yasaba Katonda “abawe Omwoyo ow’amagezi n’okubikkulirwa mweyongere okumutegeera” (Abaefeso 1:17). Essaala ze zaali zigenderera okukula kwabwe mu mwoyo.

Gano ge gamu ku makubo ag’ensonga ag’okusabira abantu b’okulembera.

  • Saba ng’oyogera amannya. Kuuma olukalala lw’abantu b’olabirira, era olusabire buli kiseera. Ekkanisa yo bw’eba nnene, gabanya olukalala ku nnaku za wiiki.
  • Saba essaala za Bayibuli. Kozesa essaala za Pawulo mu Abaefeso 1:15-23, Abaefeso 3:14-21, Abafiripi 1:9-11 ne Abakkolosaayi 1:9-14. Zituyigiriza ekisinga obukulu.
  • Saba nga tonnakyalira muntu oba okumubuulirira. Saba Katonda amagezi nga tonnasisinkana muntu, era musabire wamu naye bw’oba osobola.
  • Sabira abakulembeze abali ku mabbali go. Sabira abakadde b’ekkanisa banno, abadyakoni n’abakozi, era bo basabe bakusabire.
  • Sabira abakuziyiza. Yesu yatugamba okusabira abalabe baffe. Kizibu okusigala ng’olina obukyayi eri omuntu gw’osabira.
  • Sabira abaabula. Sabira abantu b’omu kitundu kyo abatannamanya Kristo.

Abakulembeze beetaaga abalala okubasabira

Isirayiri bwe yalwana n’Abamaleki mu ddungu, Musa yayimirira ku kasozi waggulu w’olutalo ng’ayimusizza emikono gye eri Katonda. “Musa bwe yawanikanga emikono gye, Abayisirayiri nga bagoba, naye bwe yagissanga, nga Abamaleki bagoba” (Okuva 17:11). Naye Musa n’akoowa. Alooni ne Kuli ne bamutuuza ku jjinja ne bawanirira emikono gye, “omu ng’ali ku ludda olumu, ne munne ku ludda olulala, emikono gye olwo ne ginywerera waggulu okutuusa enjuba lwe yagwa” (Okuva 17:12).

Buli mukulembeze yeetaaga Alooni ne Kuli. Pawulo, omutume omukulu, bulijjo yasabanga ekkanisa zimusabire. Omukulembeze ow’amagezi akuŋŋaanya ekibinja ekitono eky’abantu abeesigwa abanaamusabiranga buli kiseera, era abagamba mu mazima bye balina okusabira. Abakulembeze ab’amalala kino kibazibuwalira, kubanga kitegeeza okukkiriza obunafu. Naye kye kimu ku bukuumi obusinga obunene omukulembeze bw’ayinza okuba nabwo.

Lwaki abakulembeze balekera awo okusaba

Okusaba bwe kuba nga kukulu bwe kutyo, lwaki abakulembeze bangi bwe batyo basaba kitono nnyo? Zino ze zimu ku nsonga ezitera okubaawo.

  • Eby’okukola ebingi. Bulijjo waba waliwo ekintu eky’amangu eky’okukola. Okusaba kuyinza okulinda bulijjo, oba bwe kirabika bwe kityo. Naye ebintu eby’amangu tebitera kuba bye bisinga obukulu.
  • Okwesiga amaanyi go. Ebintu bwe bitambula obulungi, tuwulira nga tusobola okwerwanako ffekka. Obutasaba emirundi mingi kika kya malala ekisirise. Kigamba nti, “Kino nsobola okukikola nga sirina Katonda.”
  • Okuggwaamu amaanyi. Essaala bwe zirabika ng’ezitaddiddwamu, tulekera awo okusaba. Yesu yagera olugero okuyigiriza “nga bwe bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo” (Lukka 18:1).
  • Ekibi ekikwekeddwa. Kizibu okusemberera Katonda nga tulina kye tumukweka.
  • Okusaba okw’omulimu obulimu. Abakulembeze basaba nnyo mu lujjudde okutuusa lwe beerabira okusaba mu kyama. Yesu yagamba nti, “ggwe bw’obanga osaba, oyingiranga mu nnyumba yo, ne weggalira mu kisenge kyo n’osabira eyo mu kyama” (Matayo 6:6).

Okuzimba obulamu bw’okusaba

Okusaba nkolagana, so si kakodyo. Naye enkolagana yeetaaga obudde n’empisa. Zino ze zimu ku mpisa ezayamba abakulembeze mu mirembe egyayita.

  • Ekiseera ekigere. Danyeri yasabanga emirundi esatu olunaku, “nga bwe yakolanga bulijjo” (Danyeri 6:10). Abakulembeze bangi basanga nti ku makya ennyo, eby’okukola eby’olunaku nga tebinnatandika, kye kiseera ekisinga obulungi. Londa ekiseera era okikuume.
  • Ekifo. Yesu yagendanga “mu kifo ekyekusifu”. Funa w’osobola okubeera awatali akutaataaganya, ne bwe kiba nsonda y’ekisenge bwokka oba ekkubo eriteeriimu bantu.
  • Bayibuli ng’eggule. Leka Katonda ayogere naawe okuyita mu Kigambo kye, era leka essaala zo zikule okuva mu by’osoma. Kino tujja kukitunuulira mu ssuula eddako.
  • Olukalala. Wandiika abantu n’ebyetaago by’osabira, era owandiike Katonda lw’addamu. Kijja kuzimba okukkiriza kwo.
  • Okusaba olunaku lwonna. Pawulo yagamba nti, “Musabenga obutayosa” (1 Abasessaloniika 5:17). Essaala ennyimpi ng’otambula, ng’okola, ng’olinda oba ng’oli ku lugendo zikuyamba okusigala ng’omanyi nti Katonda ali naawe.
  • Ebiseera eby’enjawulo. Nekkemiya yagamba nti, “ne mmala ebiro nga nnakuwadde, nga nsiiba era nga nsaba mu maaso ga Katonda w’eggulu” (Nekkemiya 1:4) nga tannatandika mulimu gwe omunene. Weeteerewo ebiseera ebiwanvu eby’okusaba, oluusi n’okusiiba, nga tonnasalawo bintu binene oba mu biseera eby’obwetaavu.
  • Okusaba n’abalala. Ekkanisa eyasooka yasabiranga wamu bulijjo. Kuŋŋaanya abakulembeze bo n’abantu bo okusaba, so si okuteekateeka kwokka.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: E. M. Bounds ne John Hyde

Edward McKendree Bounds yali musumba Omumetodisiti mu Amerika eyaliwo okuva mu 1835 okutuuka mu 1913. Yaweereza ng’omusumba w’amagye mu lutalo lw’Abamerika olw’omunda, n’awambibwa. Oluvannyuma mu bulamu bwe yeewaayo okuwandiika ku kusaba, ng’agolokoka ku makya ennyo buli lunaku okusaba okumala essaawa eziwerako. Ekitabo kye ekisinga okumanyika, Amaanyi Agava mu Kusaba, yakiwandiikira babuulizi. Mu kyo yawandiika nti:

“Ekkanisa ky’eyetaaga leero si byuma bingi oba ebisingako obulungi, si bibiina bipya oba enkola empya ez’enjawulo, wabula abantu Omwoyo Omutukuvu b’asobola okukozesa—abantu abasaba, abantu ab’amaanyi mu kusaba. Omwoyo Omutukuvu tayita mu nkola, wabula ayita mu bantu. Tajja ku byuma, wabula ajja ku bantu. Tafuka mafuta ku ntegeka, wabula ku bantu—abantu abasaba.”

— E. M. Bounds, Amaanyi Agava mu Kusaba

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Ekkanisa okusinga byonna teyetaaga nteekateeka mpya oba enkola ezisingako. Yeetaaga abantu Omwoyo Omutukuvu b’asobola okukozesa, abantu abasaba. Omwoyo takolera mu nteekateeka ne mu nkola, wabula mu bantu abasaba. Bounds era yalabula nti, “Okubuulira okutta kwe kubuulira okutaliimu kusaba.” Okubuulira okutaliiko kusaba emabega waakwo kuyinza okuba okw’amagezi, naye tekujja kuwa bulamu.

Omu ku bantu abaatuukiriza ebigambo bya Bounds mu bulamu bwabwe yali John Hyde, omuminsani Omumerika eyaweereza mu Punjab, ekitundu ekiri kaakano mu Buyindi ne Pakistan, okuva mu 1892 okutuusa akaseera katono nga tannafa mu 1912. Hyde yali musajja musirise, nga si mwogezi wa maanyi mu lujjudde, era yali alwawo okwogera era nga tawulira bulungi nnyo, ekyafuula okuyiga ennimi z’omu kitundu omulimu omuzibu. Naye yamanyika mu Buyindi bwonna nga “Hyde Omusabi”.

Awo nga mu 1904, ekibinja ekitono eky’abaminsani n’abakozi Abayindi mu Punjab ne batandikawo Punjab Prayer Union (Ekibiina ky’Okusaba eky’e Punjab). Hyde yali omu ku baali bakisitula. Buli mmemba yateekanga omukono ku bibuuzo bitaano ebyangu. Ekyasembayo kyabuuzanga nti: “Onooteekangawo ekitundu ky’essaawa buli lunaku amangu ddala nga bw’osobola oluvannyuma lw’ettuntu okusabira okuzuukuka kuno, era oli mwetegefu okusaba okutuusa okuzuukuka lwe kunajja?”

Ekibuuzo ekisooka nakyo kikulu kye kimu. Kyabuuzanga nti: “Osaba okuzzibwamu obulamu mu bulamu bwo ggwe, mu bulamu bwa bakozi banno, ne mu Kkanisa?” Weetegereze engeri gye biddiriŋŋanamu. Buli muntu yatandikanga na kusabira mutima gwe nga tannasabira muntu mulala yenna. Mu myaka egyaddirira, olukuŋŋaana olw’okusaba n’okuyigiriza olwakuŋŋaananga buli mwaka e Sialkot lwafuuka ekifo abantu bangi gye baasisinkanira Katonda mu ngeri empya. Mikwano gya Hyde baamujjukira ng’asaba ekiro kyonna, nga Bayibuli ye eggule, ng’akwata ekisuubizo kimu ekya Katonda n’akiddiŋŋana okutuusa lwe kyalabikanga ng’ekijjuza ekisenge.

Obulamu bwa Hyde bubuuza buli mukulembeze ekibuuzo ekyangu ye kennyini kye yabuuza lumu: “Twali tukaabiddeko emyoyo? Ggwe wali? Nze nali?” Ebyafaayo bye, John Hyde: A Life (Obulamu bwa John Hyde), biri ku Ochorus.

Omulimu ogusooka

Omukulembeze asaba ajja kukola ensobi, naye tajja kukulembera yekka. Omukulembeze atasaba ayinza okuba n’eby’okukola bingi era n’atuuka ku bintu okumala akaseera, naye aba azimba ku musenyu. Samwiri yayita obutasaba ekibi. Abatume baayita okusaba omulimu gwabwe ogusooka. Yesu yakufuula ekyokulabirako ky’obulamu bwe.

Bw’oba tojja kujjukira kirala kyonna mu ssuula eno, jjukira kino: tolikolera bantu b’okulembera kintu kisinga bukulu okusinga okubasabira. Nga tonnateekateeka, saba. Nga tonnabuulira, saba. Nga tonnakyalira muntu, saba. Nga tonnasalawo, saba. Era bw’omala okukola ebirala byonna, ddamu osabe.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:1-7. Lwaki abatume baagaana n’omulimu omulungi okusindika okusaba ebbali? Mulimu ki omulungi ogusindika okusaba ebbali mu bulamu bwo?
  • Yesu yeeyongeranga okusaba nga alina eby’okukola ebingi. Kiki ekituuka ku bulamu bwo obw’okusaba ng’olina eby’okukola ebingi?
  • Samwiri yagamba nti kyandibadde kibi okulekera awo okusabira abantu be. Ddi lwe wasembayo okusabira buli muntu gw’okulembera ng’omwogerako erinnya?
  • Baani Alooni ne Kuli bo, abantu abawanirira emikono gyo mu kusaba? Bw’oba tolina, ani gw’oyinza okusaba?
  • Nsonga ki ku ezo abakulembeze kwe balekera okusaba esinga okuba ey’amazima gy’oli?
  • Soma ebibuuzo ebitaano ebya Punjab Prayer Union. Kiki ku byo ekisinga okukusoomooza?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Kola olukalala lwa buli muntu gw’okulembera, ne bwe baba bantu batono bokka. Lugabanyeemu ebitundu musanvu, kimu ku buli lunaku lwa wiiki. Buli lunaku wiiki eno, weeteerewo waakiri eddakiika kkumi na ttaano okusabira abantu abali ku lukalala lw’olunaku olwo ng’oyogera amannya gaabwe, ng’okozesa emu ku ssaala za Pawulo (Abaefeso 1:15-23, Abafiripi 1:9-11 oba Abakkolosaayi 1:9-14). Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, buuza abantu babiri oba basatu b’oyesiga obanga banaaba beetegefu okukusabiranga buli kiseera.

study_questions.question: Lwaki okusaba kulina okusooka eri omukulembeze?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga okusaba gwe mulimu gw’omukulembeze ogusooka, so si kintu kya kwongerako. Abatume bwe baali bazitoowereddwa baagamba nti, “Ffe tulyoke twemalire ku kusaba, n’okubuulira n’okuyigiriza” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:4). Samwiri yagamba nti kyandibadde kibi okulekera awo okusabira abantu be (1 Samwiri 12:23).

study_questions.question: Yesu yasabanga atya ng’alina eby’okukola ebingi?
study_questions.answer: “Enkeera ng’obudde tebunnalaba Yesu n’azuukuka n’agenda yekka mu kifo ekyekusifu, okusaba” (Makko 1:35). Ebibiina bwe byeyongera, “bwe yasalangawo akabanga, ne yeeyawula n’alagako mu bifo eteri bantu, okusaba” (Lukka 5:16).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze yandisabidde atya abantu b’akulembera?
study_questions.answer: Mu ngeri entongole era mu bwesigwa, nga Epafula, “afuba bulijjo ku lwammwe okubasabira” (Abakkolosaayi 4:12). Essuula eno eteesa okusabira abantu ng’oyogera amannya gaabwe, okusaba abalala bakusabire, n’okuzimba enteekateeka y’okusaba eya buli lunaku, ng’ekozesa ebyokulabirako bya E. M. Bounds ne John Hyde.

fields.title: Okubeera mu Kigambo
fields.body_html:
“Ezera yali amaliridde mu mutima gwe okusoma n’okukuuma Etteeka lya Mukama, era n’okuyigirizanga amateeka n’ebiragiro byalyo mu Isirayiri.”

— Ezera 7:10

Omukazi atunda emmere mu katale tasobola kuwa bamuguliza ky’atalina. Entamu ye bw’eba njereere, bagenda enjala ng’ebaluma. Mu ngeri y’emu, omukulembeze tasobola kuliisa balala ng’omwoyo gwe mukalu. Era emmere Katonda gye yatuwa ku lw’emyoyo gyaffe kye Kigambo kye.

Mu ssuula eyise twalaba nti abatume beewaayo “twemalire ku kusaba, n’okubuulira n’okuyigiriza” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:4). Okusaba n’Ekigambo bitambulira wamu. Mu kusaba twogera ne Katonda. Mu Kigambo kye, Katonda ayogera naffe. Omukulembeze asaba naye nga tawuliriza Kigambo kya Katonda ajja kusabira mu kizikiza. Omukulembeze asoma Ekigambo naye nga tasaba ajja kumanya ebikwata ku Katonda nga tamumanyi ye. Essuula eno ekwata ku kubeera mu Kigambo.

Kisome, kikole, kiyigirize

Ezera yali kabona era omuyigiriza eyakulembera ekibinja ky’Abayudaaya abaali mu buwaŋŋanguse okuva e Babulooni okudda e Yerusaalemi. Bayibuli efunza ekyama ky’obukulembeze bwe mu sentensi emu: “Ezera yali amaliridde mu mutima gwe okusoma n’okukuuma Etteeka lya Mukama, era n’okuyigirizanga amateeka n’ebiragiro byalyo mu Isirayiri” (Ezera 7:10).

Weetegereze engeri gye biddiriŋŋanamu: okusoma, okukuuma, okuyigiriza.

Ekisooka, yalisoma. Ezera teyasomanga Byawandiikibwa mu bwangu wadde mu bulagajjavu. Yali “amaliridde mu mutima gwe” okubisoma. Yabiwa omwoyo gwe gwonna, okumala emyaka mingi.

Eky’okubiri, yalikuuma. Ezera teyasoma lwa kumanya bingi kwokka. Yasoma alyoke agonde. Bye yayiga, yabibeeramu.

Eky’okusatu, yaliyigiriza. Oluvannyuma lw’okusoma n’okugonda, lwe yayigiriza abalala. Okuyigiriza kwe kwalina amaanyi kubanga kwava mu bulamu obwabumbibwa Ekigambo.

Abakulembeze bangi bakyusa engeri eno. Basoma Bayibuli lwa kunoonya kye banaayigiriza kwokka. Bayigiriza ebintu bye batakolangako. Ekivaamu kwe kuyigiriza okuyinza okuba okutuufu naye nga tekuliimu bulamu. Yakobo yalabula nti, “Mubeerenga bakozi ba kigambo, so si abakiwulira ne batakikola, nga mwerimbarimba” (Yakobo 1:22). Omukulembeze ayigiriza by’atakola yeerimba yekka, era emirundi mingi alimba n’abalala.

Ekigambo ku lw’omwoyo gw’omukulembeze yennyini

Ekigambo nga tekinnaba kikozesebwa mu buweereza, kiba mmere y’omukulembeze. Yesu yagamba nti, “Omuntu tabeera mulamu na mmere yokka, wabula na buli kigambo ekiva mu kamwa ka Katonda” (Matayo 4:4). Peetero yawandiika nti, “Ng’abaana abaakazaalibwa bwe beegomba amata, nammwe mwegombenga amata ag’omwoyo, muganywenga mukule era mulokolebwe” (1 Peetero 2:2). Yeremiya yagamba nti, “Ebigambo byo bwe byanzijira, ne mbirya, byali ssanyu era okujaguza kw’omutima gwange” (Yeremiya 15:16).

Katonda bwe yawa Yoswa obukulembeze bwa Isirayiri, teyasooka kumuwa nteekateeka ya lutalo. Yamuwa ekitabo: “Ekitabo kino eky’amateeka tekikuvanga mu kamwa, okifumiitirizangako emisana n’ekiro olyoke oteekenga mu nkola ebyo bye kikulagira era bw’otyo bw’oneefunira obuwanguzi n’okukulaakulana” (Yoswa 1:8). Obuwanguzi bwa Yoswa ng’omukulembeze bwandyesigamye ku kufumiitiriza kwe okwa buli lunaku ku Kigambo kya Katonda.

Zabbuli esooka eyogera ku bantu abasanyukira okuyigiriza kwa Katonda, era nga “mu mateeka ago mw’alowooleza emisana n’ekiro”. Omuntu ow’engeri eyo “Afaanana ng’omuti ogwasimbibwa ku mabbali g’omugga, ogubala ebibala byagwo mu ntuuko zaabyo, n’ebikoola byagwo tebiwotoka” (Zabbuli 1:2-3). Abakulembeze bayita mu biseera eby’ekyeya, mu mpewo ey’ebbugumu, ne mu myaka emingi egy’okutegana. Omukulembeze ng’emirandira gye gikka wansi nnyo mu Kigambo kya Katonda tajja kuwotoka.

Ekigambo kye kikola

Lwaki Bayibuli nkulu nnyo bw’etyo eri abakulembeze? Olw’ekyo ky’eri n’ekyo ky’ekola.

Katonda ye yagiruŋŋamya. “Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu byonna, Katonda ye yabiruŋŋamya nga biwandiikibwa, era bigasa mu kuyigiriza, mu kunenya, mu kuluŋŋamya ne mu kubuuliranga omuntu abe omutuukirivu, omuntu wa Katonda alyoke abe ng’atuukiridde, ng’alina byonna ebyetaagibwa okukola buli mulimu omulungi” (2 Timoseewo 3:16-17). Bayibuli si kakuŋŋaanyizo k’ebirowoozo by’abantu ku Katonda. Kye Kigambo kya Katonda yennyini, era kiwa abakulembeze byonna bye beetaaga olwa buli mulimu omulungi gwe balyayitibwa okukola.

Kiramu. “Ekigambo kya Katonda kiramu era kikola. Kisala okusinga ekitala eky’obwogi obubiri, era kiyitamu ne kituukira ddala ku mmeeme n’omwoyo, n’ennyingo n’obusomyo, era kyawula ebirowoozo n’okufumiitiriza kw’omutima” (Abaebbulaniya 4:12). Ekigambo tekitumanyisa bintu kyokka. Kitukebera. Kitulaga ebigendererwa byaffe ebikwekeddwa. Omukulembeze asoma Bayibuli mu mazima, emirundi mingi ajja kusalibwa nayo nga tannagikozesa ku muntu mulala yenna.

Kiluŋŋamya. “Ekigambo kyo ye ttaala eri ebigere byange, era kye kimulisa ekkubo lyange” (Zabbuli 119:105). Abakulembeze basalawo ebintu bingi. Bayibuli tetubuulira buli kimu, naye etulaga ekkubo ly’amagezi era etuziyiza okukyamira mu makubo mangi amakyamu.

Kikuuma okuva mu kibi. “Ntadde ekigambo kyo mu mutima gwange; ndyoke nneme okwonoona” (Zabbuli 119:11). Yesu bwe yakemebwa mu ddungu, buli kukemebwa yakuddamu n’Ebyawandiikibwa. Omukulembeze ng’omutima gwe gujjudde Ekigambo kya Katonda aba n’ekyokulwanyisa ekyetegefu okukemebwa bwe kujja.

Tekiremererwa. Katonda agamba nti, “bwe kityo ekigambo kyange ekiva mu kamwa kange bwe kiri; tekiriddayo bwereere, naye kirikola ekyo kye njagala era kirituukiriza ekyo kye nakituma” (Isaaya 55:11). Ebigambo byaffe eby’amagezi biyinza okulemererwa. Ekigambo kya Katonda tekiremererwa.

Ekigambo kitulaga Kristo

Kisoboka okumanya Bayibuli obulungi naye n’osubwa ensonga yaayo enkulu. Yesu yagamba abakulembeze b’eddiini ab’omu biseera bye nti, “Munoonya mu Byawandiikibwa kubanga mulowooza nti muyinza okubifuniramu obulamu obutaggwaawo. Kyokka Ebyawandiikibwa ebyo bye binjulira. Naye temwagala kujja gye ndi mulyoke mufune obulamu obutaggwaawo” (Yokaana 5:39-40). Baasomanga Bayibuli n’obwegendereza, naye tebajja eri Oyo Bayibuli gw’eyogerako.

Oluvannyuma lw’okuzuukira kwe, Yesu yatambula n’abayigirizwa babiri abaali baggwaamu amaanyi ku kkubo erigenda e Emmawo. “N’atandikira ku Musa n’ayitaayita mu bannabbi bonna ng’agenda abannyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa bye bimwogerako” (Lukka 24:27). Oluvannyuma ne bagamba nti, “Emitima gyaffe tegyabuguumiridde bwe yabadde ayogera naffe mu kkubo ng’atunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa?” (Lukka 24:32).

Ekyo kye twagala ku lwaffe ne ku lw’abantu be tukulembera: emitima egibuguumirira, kubanga tusisinkanye Yesu mu Byawandiikibwa. Omukulembeze asoma Bayibuli lwa mateeka, lwa kumanya bintu oba lwa birowoozo bya kubuulira kwokka, aba asubiddwa eky’obugagga. Bayibuli kye kifo we tusisinkanira Kristo.

Okukwata Ekigambo mu ngeri entuufu

Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo nti, “Fubanga okweraga ng’osiimibwa Katonda, ng’oli mukozi akola ebitakuswaza, era nga weekuumira mu kkubo ery’obubaka obw’amazima” (2 Timoseewo 2:15). Abakulembeze balina obuvunaanyizibwa obw’enjawulo, kubanga bye bayigiriza bibumba abalala bangi bye bakkiriza. Okutegeeza okukyamu mu kamwa k’omukulembeze kuyinza okukyamya ekkanisa yonna.

Gano ge mateeka agamu amangu ag’okukwata obulungi Ekigambo.

  • Soma Bayibuli yonna. Tosigala ku bitabo oba ennyiriri z’osinga okwagala zokka. Soma Endagaano Enkadde n’Empya, ebitundu ebizibu n’ebitundu ebibudaabuda.
  • Soma ng’otunuulira ebyetoolodde. Weebuuze ekitundu kye kyategeeza eri abaasooka okukisoma. Soma ennyiriri ezikisooka n’eziddirira. Olunyiriri oluggiddwa mu kifo kyalwo luyinza okufuulibwa okwogera kumpi buli kimu.
  • Leka Ebyawandiikibwa binnyonnyole Ebyawandiikibwa. Ekitundu kimu bwe kiba kizibu okutegeera, tunuulira ebitundu ebirala bye byogera ku nsonga y’emu.
  • Soma wamu n’Ekkanisa. Si ffe abaasooka okusoma Bayibuli. Yiga okuva ku bayigiriza abeesigwa ab’edda n’ab’omulembe guno. Bingi ku bitabo byabwe biri ku Ochorus.
  • Gezesa okuyigiriza okuggya. Abakkiriza ab’omu Beroya “Buli lunaku nga babikkula Ebyawandiikibwa okunoonyaamu ebyo Pawulo ne Siira bye baayogerangako bakakase nti bya mazima” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 17:11). Bwe baakebera Pawulo, naffe tusaanidde okukebera buli muyigiriza, nga mw’otwalidde naffe ffennyini.
  • Toyongerako era toggyako. Yesu yalabula abakulembeze b’eddiini nti “munyooma ekigambo kya Katonda mulyoke mutuukirize obulombolombo bwammwe bwe mwaweebwa” (Makko 7:13). Abakulembeze balina okwegendereza obutateeka birowoozo byabwe, oba obulombolombo bw’ennono zaabwe, waggulu wa Bayibuli.

Bayibuli mu buli lulimi

Erimu ku masanyu amanene ag’Ekkanisa ey’ensi yonna leero liri nti Bayibuli kaakano esangibwa, yonna oba ebitundu byayo, mu nnimi enkumi n’enkumi. Naye abakulembeze bangi bakyali tebalina Bayibuli enzijuvu mu lulimi lwabwe olw’omu nda, era bangi tebasobola kusoma bulungi. Bw’oba bw’otyo bw’oli, toggwaamu maanyi. Wuliriza Bayibuli ng’esomebwa mu ddoboozi. Kwata ebitundu mu mutwe. Saba abalala basome naawe. Abakristaayo abaasooka okusinga baawuliranga Ebyawandiikibwa nga bisomebwa mu ddoboozi mu nkuŋŋaana zaabwe. Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo anyiikirire “okusomera abantu Ebyawandiikibwa mu lwatu” (1 Timoseewo 4:13). Ekigambo kya Katonda kikola omulimu gwakyo nga kiyita mu kutu era ne mu liiso.

Era Katonda bw’aba akuwadde obusobozi, lowooza ku ngeri gy’oyinza okuyamba abalala okufuna Ekigambo kye mu lulimi lwabwe. Abamu ku bakulembeze abasinga obukulu mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa baali bavvuunuzi ba Bayibuli.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: George Müller ne Samuel Ajayi Crowther

George Müller yali Mugirimaani eyajja mu Bungereza nga akyali muvubuka n’afuuka omusumba mu Bristol. Asinga kumanyika olw’amaka g’abaana bamulekwa ge yatandikawo, mwe yalabiririra abaana abasukka mu mutwalo gumu mu bulamu bwe bwonna, nga tasabangako muntu yenna ssente. Yasabanga, Katonda n’agaba. Naye ekyama ky’obulamu bwe tekyali kusaba kwokka. Kyali Kigambo.

Mu 1841, oluvannyuma lw’emyaka mingi egy’obuweereza, Müller yazuula ekintu ekyakyusa obulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku. Yakiwandiika mu biwandiiko bye ebya buli lunaku, ebyafulumizibwa oluvannyuma nga The Life of Trust (Obulamu bw’Okwesiga):

“Nalaba bulungi okusinga bwe nali ndabye edda nti omulimu ogusooka era omukulu ennyo gwe nnalina okufaako buli lunaku, kwe kuba n’omwoyo gwange nga musanyufu mu Mukama. Ekintu ekyasooka okufaako tekyali bungi bwa ngeri gye nnyinza okuweereza Mukama, oba engeri gye nnyinza okugulumiza Mukama; wabula engeri gye nnyinza okuleeta omwoyo gwange mu mbeera ey’essanyu, n’engeri omuntu wange ow’omunda gy’ayinza okuliisibwa.”

— George Müller, The Life of Trust

Mu bigambo ebyangu: ekintu ekisinga obukulu kye nnina okukola buli lunaku kwe kukakasa nti omwoyo gwange gukkuse mu Katonda. Nga sinneebuuza bungi bwe nsobola okukolera Katonda, nnina okusooka okukakasa nti omutima gwange gwennyini guliisibwa.

Müller yannyonnyola nti okumala emyaka kkumi yatandikanga buli lunaku ng’agezaako okusaba. Naye ebirowoozo bye emirundi mingi byatambulatambulanga. Kaakano mu kifo ky’ekyo yatandika okusoma Endagaano Empya mpola, “ng’akebera buli lunyiriri, okulufunamu omukisa; si lwa buweereza bw’okubuulira Ekigambo mu lujjudde, si lwa kubuulira ku bye nfumiitirizizzaako, wabula lwa kufuna emmere ey’omwoyo gwange gwennyini.” Yazuula nti oluvannyuma lw’eddakiika ntono, okusoma kwe kwafuukanga okusaba mu ngeri ey’obutonde: okwatula, okwebaza, n’okusaba ku lulwe ne ku lw’abalala. Yagamba nti obudde bw’ekyenkya bwe bwatuukanga, omutima gwe kumpi bulijjo gwabanga mu mirembe.

Eno nkola nnyangu era ey’ensonga buli mukulembeze gy’asobola okukozesa. Ggulawo Bayibuli. Soma mpola. Fuula by’osoma okusaba. Sooka osome ku lw’omwoyo gwo.

Samuel Ajayi Crowther, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 4, Okuyitibwa kwa Katonda, alaga oludda olulala olw’okubeera mu Kigambo: okukiwa abalala. Bwe yamala okuteebwa okuva mu buddu, yayiga okusoma mu Sierra Leone. Yafuuka omu ku bantu abaasooka okuwandiika olulimi lwe olw’Oluyoruba. Yategeka ekitabo ky’ensengeka y’Oluyoruba n’enkuluze, era n’amala emyaka mingi ng’avvuunula Ebyawandiikibwa mu Luyoruba abantu be balyoke bawulire Katonda ng’ayogera mu lulimi lwabwe. Oluvannyuma yayamba okutandika okuvvuunula mu nnimi endala ku Mugga Niger. Omulenzi eyali yatwalibwa ng’asibiddwa mu njegere mu nsi ye yennyini yawa ensi eyo Ekigambo kya Katonda.

Okubeera mu Kigambo

Omukulembeze teyeetaaga kuba mukugu mu kusoma okusobola okuba omuntu w’Ekigambo. Bangi ku bakulembeze abasinga obukulu mu byafaayo by’Ekkanisa baali basomye kitono mu masomero. Kye baalina, yali njala y’Ekigambo kya Katonda n’empisa ey’okukiriisibwako buli lunaku.

Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli yawandiika nti, “Amateeka go nga ngagala nnyo! Ngafumiitirizaako olunaku lwonna” (Zabbuli 119:97). Ekyo kye kigendererwa: si kusoma Bayibuli kwokka, wabula okugyagala, okugirowoozaako olunaku lwonna, n’okugireka ebumbe buli kusalawo. Omukulembeze abeera mu Kigambo ajja kuba n’ekyokuwa abalala, kubanga yasooka kufuna.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Ezera yasoma, n’akuuma era n’ayigiriza Ekigambo, mu ngeri eyo gye biddiriŋŋanamu. Kiki ku bisatu ebyo ekisinga obunafu mu bulamu bwo?
  • Osoma Bayibuli okusinga ku lw’omwoyo gwo, oba okusinga okwetegekera okuyigiriza abalala?
  • Soma Abaebbulaniya 4:12. Ddi Bayibuli lwe yasembayo “okukusala”, ng’ekulaga ekintu mu mutima gwo ekyali kyetaaga okukyuka?
  • Abakulembeze b’eddiini baasomanga Ebyawandiikibwa naye tebajja eri Yesu. Oyinza otya okukakasa nti osisinkana Kristo bw’osoma Bayibuli?
  • Tteeka ki ku ago ag’okukwata Ekigambo mu ngeri entuufu ly’osinga okwetaaga okukolerako?
  • Kiki ky’oyinza okuyigira ku mpisa ya George Müller ey’okusoma mpola n’okufuula Ekigambo okusaba?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Buli nkya wiiki eno, nga tonnakola kintu kirala kyonna, goberera enkola ya George Müller. Londa ekitundu ekimpi, ng’otandika ne Zabbuli 1 ku lunaku olusooka, n’oluvannyuma ng’osoma essuula emu ey’Enjiri ya Makko buli lunaku oluddako. Kisome mpola. Buli bw’omala olunyiriri lumu oba bbiri, yimiriramu ofuule by’osomye okusaba: okwebaza, okwatula, oba okusaba ku lulwo oba ku lw’abalala. Tosoma lwa kwetegekera kubuulira. Soma ku lw’omwoyo gwo. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, wandiika enjawulo gye kyaleeta.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze yandisemberedde atya Bayibuli?
study_questions.answer: Nga Ezera, “yali amaliridde mu mutima gwe okusoma n’okukuuma Etteeka lya Mukama, era n’okuyigirizanga” (Ezera 7:10). Soma, gonda, era oyigirize, mu ngeri eyo gye biddiriŋŋanamu. “Mubeerenga bakozi ba kigambo, so si abakiwulira ne batakikola” (Yakobo 1:22).

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze beetaaga Ekigambo ku lw’emyoyo gyabwe bennyini?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga abakulembeze nabo baliisibwa nakyo: “Omuntu tabeera mulamu na mmere yokka, wabula na buli kigambo ekiva mu kamwa ka Katonda” (Matayo 4:4). Yeremiya yagamba nti, “Ebigambo byo bwe byanzijira, ne mbirya, byali ssanyu” (Yeremiya 15:16). Okusoma lwa kwetegekera kubuulira kwokka kufiisa omwoyo enjala.

study_questions.question: Okufumiitiriza ku Byawandiikibwa kitegeeza ki?
study_questions.answer: Kitegeeza okukuuma Ekigambo kya Katonda mu birowoozo n’okukirowoozaako emisana n’ekiro tulyoke tukibeeremu. Katonda yagamba Yoswa nti, “Ekitabo kino eky’amateeka tekikuvanga mu kamwa, okifumiitirizangako emisana n’ekiro” (Yoswa 1:8).

fields.title: Okujjuzibwa Omwoyo
fields.body_html:
“Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange, bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye.”

— Zekkaliya 4:6

Teebereza omusajja ng’asindika emmotoka ku luguudo. Atuuyana era yeetikka nnyo. Abantu beewuunya amaanyi ge. Emmotoka agisindika mita ntono, n’oluvannyuma n’ayimirira ng’akooye nnyo. Awo omuntu omu n’amulaga nti emmotoka erimu amafuta mu ttanka, n’ekisumuluzo kiri mu kifo kyakyo. Abadde agisindika ebbanga lyonna, so nga yandisobodde okugivuga.

Abakulembeze bangi baweereza Katonda nga omusajja oyo. Basindika era beetikka mu maanyi gaabwe ku bwabwe, ne beewuunya lwaki omulimu muzito nnyo ate ebibala bitono nnyo. Beerabidde nti Katonda yabawa Omwoyo we Omutukuvu okukola omulimu gwe ng’ayita mu bo. Essuula eno eyogera ku maanyi g’Omwoyo mu bulamu bw’omukulembeze.

Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza

Abayudaaya abaali mu buwaŋŋanguse bwe baakomawo okuva e Babulooni okuddamu okuzimba yeekaalu mu Yerusaalemi, omulimu ogwo gwalabika nga tegusoboka. Baali batono era baavu. Abalabe baabwe baabalwanyisa. Omukulembeze waabwe, Zerubbaberi, yali aggwaamu amaanyi. Awo Katonda n’amuweereza obubaka ng’ayita mu nnabbi Zekkaliya: “Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange, bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye” (Zekkaliya 4:6).

Katonda teyali ng’agamba nti okukola ennyo n’ebintu bye tulina tebirina makulu. Zerubbaberi yali akyalina okuzimba. Naye omulimu gwandituuse ku buwanguzi si lwa maanyi ga muntu oba bungi bwa bantu, wabula lwa Mwoyo wa Katonda. Ekyo kye kituufu ku buli mulimu gwa Katonda.

Yesu yayogera ekintu kye kimu mu ngeri endala: “Nze muzabbibu, mmwe matabi. Buli abeera mu Nze nange ne mbeera mu ye oyo abala ebibala bingi. Kubanga awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola” (Yokaana 15:5). Weetegereze ebigambo “temuliiko kye muyinza kukola”. Si nti kitono kye tuyinza okukola, wabula tewali kye tuyinza. Tusobola okutegeka, okuteekateeka, okuzimba n’okubuulira awatali Katonda. Naye tetusobola kubala bibala ebibeerera.

Omwoyo mu bakulembeze b’Endagaano Enkadde

Mu Ndagaano Enkadde yonna, Katonda yawanga Omwoyo we abakulembeze be yayitanga. Gidyoni bwe yali ow’okulwanyisa Abamidiyaani, “Omwoyo wa Mukama Katonda n’akka ku Gidyoni” (Abalamuzi 6:34). Samwiri bwe yafukako Dawudi amafuta, “Okuva ku lunaku olwo Omwoyo wa Mukama n’akka ku Dawudi mu maanyi mangi” (1 Samwiri 16:13). Nnabbi Mikka yagamba nti, “Naye nze, nzijjudde amaanyi n’Omwoyo wa Mukama, okwekaliriza ensonga n’obuvumu, njasanguze eri Yakobo olw’ebikolwa bye ebibi by’akola, olw’ekibi kya Isirayiri” (Mikka 3:8).

Musa bwe yazitoowererwa omugugu gw’okukulembera Isirayiri, Katonda yatoola ku Mwoyo eyali ku Musa n’amuteeka ku bakadde nsanvu, balyoke bagabane naye omulimu (Okubala 11:16-17). Babiri ku bo bwe baatandika okuwa obunnabbi mu lusiisira, omuvubuka omu n’addukira eri Musa okumubuulira, ng’asuubira nti anaabaziyiza. Naye Musa n’agamba nti, “Okwatiddwa obuggya ku lwange? Kyandibadde kirungi singa abantu ba Mukama bonna bannabbi, ne Mukama Katonda n’abawa omwoyo gwe!” (Okubala 11:29).

Ekyo Musa kye yeegomba kyatuukirira ku Pentekoote. Mu Ndagaano Enkadde, Omwoyo yakkanga ku bakulembeze abamu olw’emirimu egimu. Mu Ndagaano Empya, Katonda afuka Omwoyo we ku bantu be bonna.

Yesu, ajjudde Omwoyo

Ne Yesu yennyini, Omwana wa Katonda, yakola omulimu gwe ku nsi mu maanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Bwe yamala okubatizibwa, “Yesu, ng’ajjudde Mwoyo Mutukuvu, n’avaayo ku mugga Yoludaani, Omwoyo n’amutwala mu ddungu” (Lukka 4:1). Bwe yamala okukemebwa, “Yesu n’akomawo mu Ggaliraaya ng’ajjudde amaanyi aga Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (Lukka 4:14). Mu kkuŋŋaaniro e Nazaaleesi yasoma okuva mu Isaaya: “Omwoyo wa Mukama ali ku nze. Anfuseeko amafuta okubuulira abaavu Enjiri” (Lukka 4:18).

Obanga Yesu yennyini yeesigama ku Mwoyo, ffe tetwetaaga nnyo n’okusingawo? Era Yesu yasuubiza abayigirizwa be nti bandifunye Omwoyo oyo yennyini. Bwe yali tannaddayo mu ggulu, yabagamba nti, “Mubeere mu kibuga okutuusa lwe mulyambazibwa amaanyi agava mu ggulu” (Lukka 24:49). “Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8).

Weetegereze nti Yesu yagamba abayigirizwa be okulinda. Baali bamaze naye emyaka esatu. Baali balabye ng’afa era ng’azuukira. Obubaka baali babumanyi. Naye baali tebannaba kweteekateeka kukulembera okutuusa Omwoyo lwe yajja. Okutendekebwa n’okumanya tebyali bimala.

Abakulembeze abajjudde Omwoyo

Okuva ku Pentekoote, Ekitabo ky’Ebikolwa by’Abatume lugero lw’abakulembeze abajjuziddwa Omwoyo. Ku lunaku lwa Pentekoote, “Bonna ne bajjuzibwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:4), era Peetero, eyali yeegaanye Yesu edda, n’abuulira n’obuvumu eri enkumi n’enkumi. Peetero bwe yakwatibwa n’abuuzibwa abafuzi, “Peetero bwe yajjuzibwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu” n’abaddamu (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:8).

Ekkanisa bwe yalonda abantu musanvu okulabirira bannamwandu, ekyasooka okwetaagisa kyali nti babeere “ng’abantu b’amagezi, era abajjudde Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:3). Kino kyewuunyisa. Baali balondebwa kugaba mmere. Naye ne ku mulimu ogwo ogw’emikono, abatume baasooka kunoonya bantu abajjudde Omwoyo. Suteefano, omu ku abo omusanvu, yali “omusajja eyali ajjudde okukkiriza ne Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:5). “Balunabba yali muntu wa kisa ng’ajjudde Mwoyo Mutukuvu n’okukkiriza, abantu bangi ne basenga Mukama” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 11:24).

Okujjula Omwoyo tekyali kintu kya nnyongeza eky’abakulembeze abatono abalowoozebwa okuba ab’omwoyo ennyo. Kye kyali ekisaanyizo ekikulu eri buli mukulembeze mu Kkanisa ey’olubereberye.

Omwoyo by’akolera abakulembeze

Omwoyo Omutukuvu akolera mu bakulembeze mu ngeri nnyingi. Zino ze zimu ku zo.

  • Awa amaanyi okujulira. “Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8). Omwoyo afuula ebigambo byaffe ebikwata ku Yesu okuba ebiramu.
  • Afuula okubuulira okuba okw’amaanyi. Pawulo yagamba nti, “Era okubuulira kwange n’okuyigiriza tebyali mu bigambo bya magezi ebisendasenda, naye byali mu maanyi ne Mwoyo Mutukuvu, okukkiriza kwammwe kuleme kuba kw’amagezi ga bantu wabula kwesigame ku maanyi ga Katonda” (1 Abakkolinso 2:4-5).
  • Ayigiriza era ajjukiza. Yesu yasuubiza nti Omwoyo “alibayigiriza ebintu byonna era alibajjukiza byonna bye nabagamba” (Yokaana 14:26).
  • Aluŋŋamya. Omwoyo yagamba ekkanisa ey’omu Antiyokiya nti, “Munjawulire Balunabba ne Sawulo olw’omulimu gwe mbayitidde” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:2). Oluvannyuma yaziyiza Pawulo okugenda mu Asiya ne Bisuniya, n’amutwala mu kifo ky’ekyo e Makedoniya (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:6-10). Tujja kwogera ku kuluŋŋamizibwa mu Ssuula 16, Okuluŋŋamizibwa n’Okusalawo.
  • Atuyamba okusaba. “N’Omwoyo bw’atyo atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe. Tetumanyi kusaba nga bwe kitugwanira, naye Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra” (Abaruumi 8:26).
  • Agaba ebirabo. “Mwoyo Mutukuvu yeeragira mu buli omu olw’okugasa bonna” (1 Abakkolinso 12:7). Buli kirabo omukulembeze ky’akozesa kirabo kya Mwoyo.
  • Abumba empisa. “Naye ebibala eby’Omwoyo bye bino: okwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, ekisa, obulungi, obwesigwa, obuwombeefu, okwefuga” (Abaggalatiya 5:22-23). Empisa z’omutima gw’omukulembeze ze twayiga mu Kitundu eky’Okubiri: Omutima gw’Omukulembeze bye bibala by’Omwoyo.
  • Agulumiza Kristo. Yesu yayogera ku Mwoyo nti, “Oyo agenda kungulumiza” (Yokaana 16:14). Omukulembeze ajjudde Omwoyo ajja kusikiriza abantu okutunuulira Yesu, so si ye yennyini.

“Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe”

Omukulembeze ayinza atya okujjuzibwa Omwoyo? Pawulo awa ekiragiro: “Ate temutamiiranga, kubanga mujja kweyonoona, wabula Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe” (Abaefeso 5:18). Mu Luyonaani Pawulo lwe yawandiikamu, ekiragiro kino kitegeeza okweyongera okujjuzibwa buli kiseera. Si kintu ekibaawo omulundi gumu gwokka, wabula ngeri ya bulamu egenda mu maaso.

Pawulo ageraageranya okujjuzibwa Omwoyo n’okutamiira omwenge. Omuntu atamidde afugibwa ekyo ky’anywedde. Omuntu ajjudde Omwoyo aluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo. Era Pawulo annyonnyola bwe kirabika: okuyimbira Katonda, “Bulijjo mwebazenga Katonda Kitaffe olwa byonna”, era “Mutyenga Kristo, nga muwuliragananga” (Abaefeso 5:19-21). Obubonero bw’okujjuzibwa Omwoyo kwe kusinza, okwebaza n’obwetoowaze.

Zino ze zimu ku ngeri z’okutambulira mu kujjula kw’Omwoyo.

  • Saba. Yesu yagamba nti, “Kitammwe ali mu ggulu talisinga nnyo okubawa Mwoyo Mutukuvu abo abamusaba?” (Lukka 11:13). Saba Katonda buli lunaku akujjuze.
  • Yatula era weekyuse ove mu kibi. Pawulo alabula nti, “temunakuwazanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu wa Katonda” (Abaefeso 4:30). Ekibi ekitayatulwa kiziyiza omulimu gw’Omwoyo mu ffe.
  • Gondera bw’akuluŋŋamya. “Temuzikizanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (1 Abasessaloniika 5:19). Omwoyo bw’akukubiriza okwogera, okugaba, okusonyiwa oba okukola ekintu, gondera.
  • Weesigame ku ye. Nga tonnabuulira, tonnakyalira muntu, tonnakulembera oba tonnasalawo, yimirira katono obuulire Katonda nti tosobola kukikola awatali ye.
  • Tambula naye buli ddaala. “Kale bwe tuba abalamu ku bw’Omwoyo, tugobererenga okuluŋŋamizibwa kw’Omwoyo” (Abaggalatiya 5:25).
  • Jjangu ng’olumwa ennyonta. Yesu yagamba nti, “Buli alina ennyonta, ajje gye ndi anywe!” (Yokaana 7:37). Yokaana ayongerako nti, “Yesu yali ayogera ku Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (Yokaana 7:39). Omwoyo aweebwa abo abalumwa ennyonta.

Okugenda mu Buziba: Okubatizibwa mu Mwoyo

Abakristaayo bakkiriziganya nti buli mukkiriza afuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’akkiriza, era nti buli mukkiriza ayitibwa okujjuzibwa Omwoyo. Naye bawukana ku bibuuzo ebimu. Waliwo okulaba okw’okubiri oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka, okutera okuyitibwa “okubatizibwa mu Mwoyo”? Bulijjo kulabikira mu kwogera ennimi? Ebirabo byonna ebyogerwako mu Ndagaano Empya biweebwa ne leero?

Abakristaayo abamu, naddala mu makanisa ga Pentekoote n’aga kalisimatiki, bakkiriza nti waliwo okulaba okwa njawulo okw’okubatizibwa mu Mwoyo, okutera okujja oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka, era nti kuleeta amaanyi ag’okuweereza. Abalala bakkiriza nti buli Mukristaayo abatizibwa mu Mwoyo ng’akyuka, era nti ebiddirira oluvannyuma kwe kujjuzibwa obuggya so si kubatizibwa okw’okubiri. Abakulembeze nga D. L. Moody ne R. A. Torrey, ebitabo byabwe ebiri ku Ochorus, baayogera ku kulaba okutegeerekeka okw’amaanyi oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka, wadde nga bonna tebaakunnyonnyola mu ngeri y’emu.

Abakristaayo abeesigwa balina buli kimu ku birowoozo bino. Ekisinga obukulu eri abakulembeze si linnya lye tuwa okulaba okwo, wabula oba ddala tuli balamu era tuweereza mu maanyi g’Omwoyo. Omukulembeze akaayana ku Mwoyo naye nga tatambulira mu ye, ensonga enkulu emusubye. Coram Deo, ekitabo ekirala ekya Ochorus Original, kinnyonnyola ebirowoozo bino mu bujjuvu mu ssuula yaakyo ku birabo by’Omwoyo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: D. L. Moody ne Erica Sabiti

Dwight L. Moody yali Mumerika eyatandika obulamu bwe obw’okukola ng’atunda engatto mu Boston. Teyamaliriza ssomero era teyayawulibwa ku buweereza. Naye we yafiira mu 1899, yali amaze okubuulira abantu obukadde n’obukadde mu Amerika ne Bungereza.

Mu 1871 Moody yali dda omubuulizi akola ennyo era eyali atuuse ku buwanguzi mu Chicago. Naye abakazi babiri ab’omu kkanisa ye ne bamugamba nti baali bamusabira afune amaanyi g’Omwoyo. Mu kusooka yanyiiga. Oluvannyuma n’atandika okuwulira enjala ey’amaanyi eya Katonda. Oluvannyuma yagamba nti yatandika okukaabirira Katonda amuwe amaanyi ago. Mu mwaka ogwo gwe gumu, omuliro omunene gwasaanyaawo ekitundu ekinene ekya Chicago, nga mw’otwalidde ekkanisa ya Moody n’ennyumba ye. Amangu ddala oluvannyuma, bwe yali ng’atambula mu luguudo mu New York, Katonda yamusisinkana mu ngeri ey’amaanyi ennyo ne kiba nti, nga bwe yagamba, yalina okusaba Katonda akome. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, nga bwe yagamba, yabuuliranga obubaka bwe bumu nga bwe yabuuliranga edda, naye kaakano abantu bikumi na bikumi ne bakkiriza. Mu kitabo kye Secret Power (Amaanyi ag’Ekyama), yawandiika ku mulimu gw’Omwoyo ogw’okuwa essuubi: “omuntu ajjudde Omwoyo wa Katonda aliba n’essuubi lingi nnyo.”

Oluvannyuma lw’ekitundu ky’ekyasa, era ewala ennyo ku luuyi olulala olw’ensi, omusumba Omunnayuganda ayitibwa Erica Sabiti yafuna okulaba okufaananako n’okwo. Yazaalibwa mu 1903 mu Ankole, mu bukiikaddyo-bugwanjuba bwa Uganda. Yasomera mu King’s College, Budo, ne e Makerere, n’asomesa mu ssomero, n’ayawulibwa mu 1933 ne mu 1934. Awo, ng’ekitabo Tukutendereza bwe kigamba, “okumala emyaka mukaaga, yali musumba wa Kkanisa ya Angirikani eyayawulibwa, naye nga tannasisinkana kye kitabo kino kyogerako.” Mu 1939 yatambula n’omulabirizi we okugenda e Rwanda ne Burundi, era eyo gye yasisinkanira abakkiriza b’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba. Obuweereza bwe bwakyuka ddala. Oluvannyuma yafuuka omulabirizi, era mu 1966 n’afuuka Ssaabalabirizi Omufirika eyasooka mu Kkanisa ya Uganda.

Tukutendereza kiggya mu lugero lwe essomo buli mukulembeze ly’asaanidde okuwulira: “Okuyawulibwa si kye kimu n’okujjuzibwa.” Sabiti yali mukkiriza. Yali atendekeddwa, agezeseddwa era ayawuliddwa. Yali akola omulimu. Naye waaliwo ekintu ekyali kikyabulamu, okutuusa Katonda lwe yamusisinkana mu ngeri empya.

Abasajja bombi batulaga nti kisoboka omuntu okuba omukulembeze akola ennyo, atuuse ku buwanguzi, era n’ayawuliddwa, naye nga talina kujjula kw’Omwoyo. Era bombi batulaga nti Katonda mwetegefu okuwa ebisingawo abakulembeze abamulumirwa enjala.

Okuvuga, so si kusindika

Ddayo ku musajja asindika emmotoka. Eky’okugonjoola ekizibu kye tekyali kusindika n’amaanyi okusingawo. Kyali kuyingira mu mmotoka n’aleka yingini ekole omulimu. Eky’okugonjoola obunafu bw’omukulembeze si kufuba kungi, wabula kwesigama kungi. “Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange.”

Kino tekitegeeza nti abakulembeze tebakola nnyo. Pawulo yakola nnyo okusinga buli muntu. Naye yagamba nti, “si nze nakola wabula ekisa kya Katonda ekiri nange kye kyakola” (1 Abakkolinso 15:10). Weebuuze mu mazima: Kiki kye nkola kye nnyinza okukola awatali Katonda? Eky’okuddamu bwe kiba “buli kimu”, kye kiseera okulekera awo okusindika osabe okujjuzibwa.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Zekkaliya 4:6 ne Yokaana 15:5. Mu bitundu ki eby’obukulembeze bwo mw’oyimiridde ku “maanyi” ne ku “buyinza” mu kifo ky’Omwoyo wa Katonda?
  • Yesu yagamba abayigirizwa be okulindirira Omwoyo nga tebannatandika mulimu gwabwe. Wali odduse mu maaso nga tolindiridde Katonda?
  • Abasanvu abaalondebwa okugaba emmere baalina okuba “ng’abantu b’amagezi, era abajjudde Mwoyo Mutukuvu”. Ekkanisa yo kino ekinoonya bw’eba erondawo abakulembeze?
  • Ku mirimu gy’Omwoyo gy’akolera abakulembeze, ogusinga okukwetaagisa kaakano gwe guluwa?
  • Waliwo engeri yonna gy’oyinza okuba ng’onakuwaza oba ng’ozikiza Omwoyo?
  • Erica Sabiti yamala emyaka mukaaga ng’ayawuliddwa nga tannajjuzibwa. Olugero lwe lukugamba ki?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Buli ku makya wiiki eno, soma ekimu ku bitundu bino: Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:1-8, Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:1-21, Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:23-31, Abaefeso 5:15-21, Abaggalatiya 5:16-26. Oluvannyuma saba nti, “Kitange, siyinza kukola mulimu gwo mu maanyi gange. Ka nzijjuze Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu leero.” Nga tonnakola buli mulimu gw’obukulembeze mu lunaku, yimirira akaseera katono ogambe nti, “Omwoyo Omutukuvu, nneesigamye ku ggwe.” Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, weetegereze enjawulo yonna mu mulimu gwo ne mu mutima gwo.

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze beetaaga Omwoyo Omutukuvu?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga omulimu gwa Katonda gukolebwa “Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange, bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye” (Zekkaliya 4:6). Yesu yagamba nti, “Nze muzabbibu, mmwe matabi” (Yokaana 15:5). Awatali ye tetuyinza kukola kintu kyonna ekibeerera.

study_questions.question: Omwoyo yakola atya mu bakulembeze mu Bayibuli?
study_questions.answer: “Omwoyo wa Mukama Katonda n’akka ku Gidyoni” (Abalamuzi 6:34), era “Omwoyo wa Mukama n’akka ku Dawudi mu maanyi mangi” (1 Samwiri 16:13). Ne Yesu yennyini “ng’ajjudde Mwoyo Mutukuvu, n’avaayo ku mugga Yoludaani” (Lukka 4:1). Musa yeegomba Omwoyo okubeera ku bantu ba Katonda bonna (Okubala 11:29).

study_questions.question: Okubatizibwa mu Mwoyo kye ki?
study_questions.answer: Abakristaayo bakutegeera mu ngeri ez’enjawulo. Ekitundu ky’essuula eno “Okugenda mu Buziba” kinnyonnyola mu bwenkanya ebirowoozo ebikulu: abamu bakulaba ng’ekitundu ky’okukyuka, abalala ng’okulaba okw’amaanyi okujja oluvannyuma. Bonna bakkiriziganya nti buli mukkiriza yeetaaga okujjuzibwa Omwoyo buli kiseera.

fields.title: Okuwummula, Okwawukana ku Balala, n’Enteekateeka y’Obulamu
fields.body_html:
“Mujje tugende mu kifo eteri bantu tuwummuleko.”

— Makko 6:31

Omulimi amanyi nti ennimiro tesobola kusimbibwamu buli sizoni nga tewummuddeko. Ettaka bwe litaweebwa budde kuddamu maanyi, amakungula gagenda gakendeera buli mwaka okutuusa ng’ate tewakyali kimera. Omulimi ow’amagezi aleka ettaka ne liwummulako, era amakungula agaddako ne gasinga obulungi.

Abakulembeze bali ng’ennimiro eyo. Abakulembeze bangi, naddala abo abaagala Katonda era abaagala abantu baabwe, bakola obutalekera awo. Baddamu buli ssimu, beetaba mu buli lukiiko era beetikka buli mugugu. Okumala akaseera kirabika nga kikola. Oluvannyuma amakungula ne gakendeera. Bakoowa, ne batandika okunyiiga amangu, ne bakalira mu mwoyo. Abamu balwala. Abamu bagwa mu kibi. Abamu bava ku mulimu ddala. Essuula eno eyogera ku kuwummula: lwaki Katonda akulagira, Yesu bwe yakukolanga, n’engeri abakulembeze gye bayinza okuzimba enteekateeka y’okukola n’okuwummula eneebawangaaza obulamu bwabwe bwonna.

Okuwummula kyava wa Katonda

Okuwummula tekwatandika ng’ekyetaago ky’omuntu. Kwatandikira wa Katonda. “Ku lunaku olw’omusanvu Katonda yali amaze ebyo byonna bye yali akola; n’awummulira ku lunaku olwo ng’ava ku mirimu gye gyonna gye yakola. Bw’atyo Katonda olunaku olw’omusanvu n’aluwa omukisa n’alutukuza; kubanga ku olwo Katonda kwe yawummulira emirimu gye yakola mu kutonda” (Olubereberye 2:2-3). Katonda teyali akooye. Yawummula kubanga omulimu gwe gwali guwedde era nga mulungi, era nga ayagala okugusanyukira. Era okuwummula yakuteeka mu nkola y’ebitonde byennyini.

Oluvannyuma, Katonda yafuula okuwummula ekiragiro eri abantu be: “Olunaku lwa Ssabbiiti lujjukirenga era olutukuzenga. Kolanga emirimu gyo, ofaabiine mu nnaku omukaaga, naye olunaku olw’omusanvu ye Ssabbiiti ya Mukama Katonda wo. Ku lunaku olwo tokolerangako mulimu gwonna” (Okuva 20:8-10). Ekiragiro kino kyazingiramu buli muntu: abaana, abaweereza, abagenyi, n’ensolo zennyini. Tewali yalina kukozesebwa nga taweebwa kuwummula.

Katonda yakyogera bulungi nti kino kikola ne mu biseera ebisinga okuba eby’emirimu mingi: “ne mu biseera eby’okukabala n’ebyokukungula onoowummulanga” (Okuva 34:21). Eri abantu abalimi, ekyo kyali kigezo kya ddala eky’okukkiriza. Kyali kitegeeza okwesiga Katonda nti anaabawa bye beetaaga ne bwe banaalekera awo okukola. Ssabbiiti yali kijjukizo buli wiiki nti obulamu bwabwe bwesigama ku Katonda, so si ku kufuba kwabwe.

Musa bwe yaddamu ekiragiro kino mu Kyamateeka Olwokubiri, yawaayo ensonga endala: “Ojjukiranga nga wali muweereza mu nsi ey’e Misiri” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 5:15). Omuddu tasobola kuwummula. Bakama be bamukozesa obutakoma. Ssabbiiti yali kabonero nti abantu ba Katonda baali ba ddembe. Omukulembeze atawummula n’akatono abeera mu bulamu ng’omuddu, ne bwe kiba nti mukama we kwe kwegomba kwe yennyini oba endowooza ye ey’obuvunaanyizibwa.

Yesu yeeyawulanga

Yesu yakuuma enteekateeka y’okukola n’okuwummula. Yakolanga nnyo. Yawonyanga abantu okutuusa ekiro nga kizibye. Yatambulanga n’ebigere okuva mu kibuga okudda mu kirala. Emirundi mingi yalumwanga enjala era ng’akooye. Ku lugendo olumu, “Yesu yali akooye olw’olugendo lwe yatambula, n’atuula awo ku luzzi” (Yokaana 4:6). Ku lulala, yeebaka mu lyato wakati mu kibuyaga (Makko 4:38).

Naye Yesu era yeeyawulanga. Twalaba mu Ssuula 12, Okusaba Okusooka, nga bwe yafulumanga ku makya ennyo okusaba, era nga bwe “yeeyawula n’alagako mu bifo eteri bantu, okusaba” (Lukka 5:16). Yali amanyi nti amaanyi ge gaava wa Kitaawe, era yeewangayo ebiseera okubeera naye.

Era yayigiriza abayigirizwa be okuwummula. Bwe baakomawo okuva ku mulimu ogwali ogw’emirimu mingi, nga bajjudde amawulire ga byonna bye baali bakoze, Yesu n’abagamba nti, “Mujje tugende mu kifo eteri bantu tuwummuleko” (Makko 6:31). Ekigambo ekiddako kinnyonnyola ensonga: “Kubanga baali babuliddwa n’akaseera ak’okuliiramu ku mmere olw’abantu abangi abajjanga gye bali; bano baabanga baakavaawo ate ng’abalala bajja.” Ebyetaago byali bya ddala era abantu baali bangi. Naye Yesu teyagamba bayigirizwa be kukola nnyo okusingawo. Yabagamba okuwummula.

Kyewuunyisa nti bwe baatuuka mu kifo ekyo ekisirifu, ebibiina byali bimaze okubeerayo nga bibalindirira. Era Yesu, ng’akwatiddwa ekisa, n’abayigiriza era n’abaliisa (Makko 6:33-44). Okuwummula tekusoboka bulijjo nga bwe tukuteeseteese. Naye Yesu yakyakufuula ekigendererwa kye, era n’ayigiriza abayigirizwa be okukola bwe batyo.

Lwaki abakulembeze bakaluubirirwa okuwummula

Obanga okuwummula kiragiro kya Katonda era nga y’engeri Yesu gye yatambulangamu, lwaki abakulembeze kibakaluubirira nnyo? Zino ze zimu ku nsonga.

  • Ebyetaago tebiggwaawo. Bulijjo wabaawo omuntu omulala ow’okukyalira, ekizibu ekirala eky’okugonjoola, obubaka obulala obw’okuteekateeka. Omukulembeze alindirira omulimu okuggwa alyoke awummule, talibaako lw’awummula.
  • Tuwulira nga tetuyinza kubulwa. Munda mu mitima gyabwe, abakulembeze abamu bakkiriza nti bwe baliyimirira, buli kimu kijja kusasika. Ekyo kika kya malala. Omulimu gwa Katonda, so si gwaffe. “Mukama bw’atazimba nnyumba, abo abagizimba bazimbira bwereere” (Zabbuli 127:1).
  • Twagala okwetaagibwa. Abakulembeze abamu omuwendo gwabwe baguggya mu kubeera n’emirimu mingi n’okwetaagibwa. Okuwummula kubaleetera okuwulira nga tebalina mugaso. Naye omuwendo gwaffe guva mu kwagalibwa Katonda, so si mu bungi bw’ebyo bye tukola.
  • Tutya abantu kye banaalowooza. Mu buwangwa obumu, omukulembeze awummula alabibwa ng’omugayaavu. Naye endowooza ya Katonda y’esinga obukulu okusinga ey’abantu.
  • Tetwesiga Katonda. Okuwummula kwetaagisa okukkiriza. Kitegeeza okukkiriza nti Katonda ajja kulabirira ebintu bye tulese nga tebinnakolebwa.
  • Tetwayigirizibwa. Abakulembeze bangi baali tebalabangako bakulembeze balala okuggyako abo abaakolanga awatali kuwummula, era balowooza nti obwesigwa bwe butyo bwe bufaanana.

“Mukama abaagalwa be abawa otulo”

Zabbuli 127 luyimba lw’abazimbi n’abakulembeze: “Mukama bw’atazimba nnyumba, abo abagizimba bazimbira bwereere. Mukama bw’atakuuma kibuga, abakuumi bateganira bwereere. Oteganira bwereere bw’okeera mu makya n’okola, ate n’olwawo n’okwebaka ng’okolerera ekyokulya; kubanga Mukama abaagalwa be abawa otulo” (Zabbuli 127:1-2).

Zabbuli eno tegamba nti okukola kibi. Abazimbi balina okuzimba, n’abakuumi balina okukuuma. Naye egamba nti okukola okw’okweraliikirira okutakoma, okukeera mu makya n’okulwawo okwebaka olw’okweraliikirira, tekulina kye kutuukiriza singa Katonda takirimu. Era egamba nti otulo kirabo ekiva mu kwagala kwa Katonda. Bwe tugalamira ne twebaka, tuba twatula nti Katonda y’afuga, so si ffe. “Nnaagalamira ne nneebaka mirembe; kubanga ggwe wekka, Ayi Mukama, ggwe ondabirira akabi ne katantuukako” (Zabbuli 4:8).

Katonda bw’alabirira omukulembeze akooye ennyo

Nnabbi Eriya yali yaakawangula obuwanguzi obunene ku Lusozi Kalumeeri. Omuliro gwali guvudde mu ggulu, n’abantu ne bakomawo eri Katonda. Naye oluvannyuma Kabaka omukazi Yezeberi n’atiisatiisa okumutta, era Eriya n’adduka okuwonya obulamu bwe. Yatambula olugendo lwa lunaku lumu mu ddungu, “n’atuuka awali omwoloola, n’atuula wansi waagwo, n’asaba afe. N’ayogera nti, ‘Kino kimala, Mukama, kaakano twala obulamu bwange’” (1 Bassekabaka 19:4).

Katonda yakolera ki omuweereza we eyali akooye ennyo? Teyamunenya era teyamubuulira bubaka. Yamuleka ne yeebaka. Awo malayika n’amukomako n’amugamba nti, “Golokoka olye.” Emitwetwe we waaliwo omugaati n’amazzi. Eriya n’alya n’addamu okwebaka. Malayika n’akomawo omulundi ogw’okubiri: “Golokoka olye, kubanga olugendo lunene” (1 Bassekabaka 19:5-7). Eriya bwe yamala okwebaka n’okulya, olwo Katonda n’alyoka ayogera naye ku biseera eby’omu maaso.

Weetegereze obukkakkamu bwa Katonda: “olugendo lunene.” Katonda amanyi ekkomo ly’amaanyi gaffe. Tatusuubira kuba byuma. Oluusi ekintu ekisinga okuba eky’omwoyo omukulembeze akooye ennyo ky’ayinza okukola kwe kwebaka n’okulya. Tujja kuddamu okwogera ku lugero lwa Eriya mu Ssuula 38, Okuggwaamu Amaanyi n’Okukoowa Ennyo.

Enteekateeka y’okukola n’okuwummula

“Buli kintu kirina ekiseera kyakyo, na buli ekikolebwa wansi w’eggulu kirina ekiseera kyakyo” (Omubuulizi 3:1). Ekigendererwa si kulekera awo kukola, wabula okufuna enteekateeka ennungi. Eno y’enkola abakulembeze bangi gye basanze nga ebayamba.

  • Buli lunaku: weeyawule. Buli lunaku weewe ekiseera okubeera wekka ne Katonda mu kusaba ne mu Kigambo kye, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 12 ne 13. Era weebake ekimala. Abakulembeze abeebaka ekitono basalawo bubi era banyiiga mangu.
  • Buli wiiki: wummula. Funa olunaku lumu buli wiiki olekere awo emirimu gyo egya bulijjo. Eri abasumba bangi, Ssande lunaku lwa mulimu, n’olwekyo walina okubaawo olunaku olulala olwawulibwa. Lukozese okuwummula, okusinza, okunyumirwa amaka go n’okukola ebikuzzaamu amaanyi. Lukuume n’obwegendereza. Lutegeeze abantu bo, obasabe baluwe ekitiibwa okuggyako mu bizibu eby’amangu ebya ddala.
  • Buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera: genda obeere wekka. Emirundi egiwerako mu mwaka, weewe ekiseera ekiwanvuko ng’oli wala, olunaku lumu oba okusingawo, osabe, osome, olowooze era owulirize Katonda. Yesu yamalanga ekiro kyonna ng’asaba nga tannasalawo bintu binene.
  • Buli mwaka: ddamu amaanyi. Bwe kiba kisoboka, funa ekiseera ekiwanvuko eky’okuwummula omulundi gumu mu mwaka. Abakulembeze bangi tebasobola kusasulira luwummula, naye ne ennaku ntono ng’oli wamu n’amaka go oba mikwano gyo ng’oli wala okuva ku mulimu ziyinza okuleeta okuzzibwamu amaanyi okunene.
  • Mu bulamu bwonna: ebiseera ebyawufu. Amakanisa agamu gawa abakulembeze baago ekiseera ekiwanvu eky’okuwummula n’okusoma oluvannyuma lw’emyaka egiwerako egy’okuweereza. Bwe kiba kisoboka, kino kiyinza okuzza obuggya omukulembeze n’akola emyaka emirala mingi.

Enkola zino zijja kufaanana mu ngeri ez’enjawulo mu bifo eby’enjawulo. Omusumba akola emirimu ebiri, akola ennaku omukaaga mu nnimiro oba mu katale n’akulembera ekkanisa ku Ssande, alina okunyigirizibwa okwa njawulo. Ayinza okwetaaga obuyambi bw’ekkanisa ye okufuna okuwummula n’akatono. Naye omusingi gusigala gwe gumu. Katonda teyatonda muweereza we n’omu kukola awatali kuwummula.

Maliza ne Maliyamu

Lumu Yesu yakyalira amaka g’abaluganda babiri abakazi, Maliza ne Maliyamu. Maliza yali yeetawula ng’ategeka ekyokulya, “yali yeetawula mu mirimu ng’ategekera abagenyi.” Maliyamu “N’atuula awo wansi ku bigere bya Yesu, ng’awuliriza ebigambo Yesu bye yali ayogera.” Maliza ne yeemulugunya nti Maliyamu tamuyamba. Naye Yesu n’agamba nti, “Maliza, Maliza, ebintu ebikutawaanya bingi, naye waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa, Maliyamu alonze omugabo omulungi ogutagenda kumuggyibwako” (Lukka 10:39-42).

Maliza teyali akola kintu kibi. Yali aweereza Yesu. Naye yali akola nnyo ng’amuweereza ne kiba nti teyalina budde kumuwuliriza. Abakulembeze bangi ba Maliza.
