Bakolera Yesu buli kiseera, naye kitono nnyo okutuula ku bigere bye. Yesu atuyita okulonda “omugabo omulungi”: ekiseera naye ekitali muntu ayinza kukituggyako.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Bernard, Antoni ne Brother Lawrence

Bernard ow’e Clairvaux yali mumonaki Omufalansa mu myaka gya 1100, omubuulizi eyalina ekirabo, era omu ku bakulembeze b’ekkanisa abaali basinga obuyinza mu kiseera kye. Omu ku bamonaki be abaali edda yafuuka Paapa, n’atwala erinnya Eugenius III. Bernard yali amwagala era yamweraliikiriranga. Paapa yali yeetooloddwa emisango, enkaayana, abagenyi n’eby’obufuzi okuva ku makya okutuuka ekiro. Bernard kyeyava amuwandiikira ebbaluwa empanvu, eyafuuka ekitabo ekiyitibwa On Consideration (Ku Kufumiitiriza).

Mu kyo, Bernard yalabula Paapa nti emirimu egitakoma giyinza mpolampola okukakanyaza omutima gwe. Omuntu awaayo ebiseera bye byonna eri abalala n’atabiwaako Katonda n’akatono, wadde okwekebera emmeeme ye, ayinza okufiirwa emmeeme ye nga takitegedde. Bernard yamukubiriza okwawula ekiseera eky’“okufumiitiriza”: okulowooza mu kasirise ku Katonda, ku ye yennyini ne ku buvunaanyizibwa bwe. Yajjukiza Paapa nti naye yali muntu eyeetaaga Katonda, era nti teyandisobodde kuweereza balala bulungi singa alagajjalira omutima gwe. Ebigambo bye biyambye abakulembeze abalina emirimu mingi okumala kumpi emyaka lwenda.

Edda ennyo nga Bernard tannabaawo, mu myaka gya 200 ne 300, omuvubuka Omumisiri ayitibwa Antoni yawulira ebigambo bya Yesu nga bisomebwa mu kkanisa, “genda otunde ebibyo, ensimbi ozigabire abaavu” (Matayo 19:21), n’agondera. Yagenda mu ddungu okusaba. Athanasius, omulabirizi omukulu ow’e Alegezanderiya, oluvannyuma yawandiika olugero lwe mu The Life of Antony (Obulamu bwa Antoni), ekiri ku Ochorus. Antoni yamala emyaka mingi ng’ali yekka ne Katonda. Naye teyasigala ng’akwekeddwa emirembe gyonna. Abantu bajjanga gy’ali okufuna amagezi, n’afuuka kitaabwe ow’omwoyo eri enkumi n’enkumi. Obwomu bwe bwamufuula wa mugaso. Yalina eky’okuwa kubanga yali amaze ebbanga ddene ng’afuna okuva eri Katonda.

Brother Lawrence yali mumonaki Omufalansa mu myaka gya 1600 eyakola emyaka mingi mu ffumbiro ly’ennyumba y’abamonaki. Teyali mukulembeze mu ngeri eya bulijjo. Naye emboozi ze n’ebbaluwa ze, ebyakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu The Practice of the Presence of God (Okwegezaamu Okubeera mu Maaso ga Katonda), biyigirizza abakulembeze bangi okuwummulira mu Katonda ne wakati mu mulimu. Mukwano gwe omu yawandiika ku ye nti:

“Ekiseera eky’emirimu,” bwe yagamba, “gyendi tekyawukana ku kiseera eky’okusaba; era mu kuyoogaana n’okukubagana kw’ebintu mu ffumbiro lyange, ng’abantu abawerako mu kiseera kye kimu bampita okubaleetera ebintu eby’enjawulo, Katonda mmubeeramu n’emirembe mingi nga gye nnandibadde nagyo singa mbadde nfukamidde ku Ssakramentu eritukuvu.”

— The Practice of the Presence of God

Mu bigambo ebyangu: gyendi, ekiseera eky’okukola tekyawukana ku kiseera eky’okusaba. Ne mu ffumbiro lyange eririmu oluyoogaano, ng’abantu abawerako bampita okubaleetera ebintu eby’enjawulo omulundi gumu, nsanyukira okubeerawo kwa Katonda n’emirembe nga gye nnandibadde nagyo singa mbadde nfukamidde mu kkanisa.

Abasajja bano abasatu batuyigiriza ebika by’okuwummula bisatu. Bernard atuyigiriza okuyimirira ne tufumiitiriza. Antoni atuyigiriza okweyawula ne tubeera ffekka ne Katonda. Brother Lawrence atuyigiriza okuwummulira mu Katonda ne bwe tuba nga tukola. Buli mukulembeze yeetaaga byonna ebisatu.

Ekiwummulo ekisigaddeyo

Ebbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya egamba nti, “Naye Katonda atusuubizza olunaku olwa Ssabbiiti lwe tuliwummula, newaakubadde nga terunnatuuka. Kubanga oyo ayingira mu kiwummulo kya Katonda, awummula emirimu gye nga Katonda bwe yawummula ng’amaze emirimu gye” (Abaebbulaniya 4:9-10). Okuwummula kwaffe okwa buli wiiki kifaananyi kitono eky’ekiwummulo ekinene ekitulindiridde mu maaso ga Katonda emirembe gyonna. Era kutujjukiza nti obulokozi bwaffe tebwesigama ku bikolwa byaffe. Kristo yamaliriza omulimu. Tusobola okuwummulira mu ye.

Okuyita kwa Yesu kwa bakulembeze nabo: “Mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, nange nnaabawummuza” (Matayo 11:28). Bw’oba ng’okooye, jjangu gy’ali. Teeka wansi omugugu ogutaali gwa kwetikkibwa ggwe wekka. Olwo, ng’owummudde era ng’ozziddwa obuggya, situla ekikoligo kye, kubanga “ekikoligo kyange kyangu,” era n’omugugu gwe, kubanga “omugugu gwange teguzitowa” (Matayo 11:30).

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Owummula olunaku lumu buli wiiki? Bw’oba towummula, kiki ekikulemesa?
  • Ku nsonga ezikaluubiriza abakulembeze okuwummula, ensonga ki esinga okukukwatako?
  • Soma Zabbuli 127:1-2. Wa w’oteganira mu kweraliikirira, ng’okolerera ekyokulya, mu kifo ky’okwesiga Katonda?
  • Soma 1 Bassekabaka 19:1-8. Engeri Katonda gye yalabiriramu Eriya ekuyigiriza ki ku kkomo ly’amaanyi go?
  • Ofaanana nnyo Maliza oba Maliyamu? Okulonda “omugabo omulungi” wiiki eno kyandibadde kitya?
  • Ku bika by’okuwummula ebisatu (okufumiitiriza kwa Bernard, obwomu bwa Antoni, okubeerawo kwa Katonda ku mulimu nga Brother Lawrence), kiki ky’osinga okwetaaga?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Londa olunaku lumu wiiki eno, oba ekitundu ky’olunaku, lubeere lunaku lwa kuwummula. Kitegeeze amaka go n’abantu b’okulembera nga bukyali. Ku lunaku olwo, tokola mirimu gyo egya bulijjo. Malira ekiseera ne Katonda, n’amaka go, ebweru mu butonde, oba ng’okola ekintu ekikuzzaamu amaanyi. Era londa essaawa emu wiiki eno obeere wekka ddala ne Katonda, nga tolina ssimu yo. Gikozese okutuula mu kasirise, okusoma zabbuli, n’okubuulira Katonda mu mazima nga bw’oli. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, weetegereze bw’owulira.

study_questions.question: Okuwummula kikulu eri abakulembeze Abakristaayo?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Okuwummula kyava wa Katonda: “n’awummulira ku lunaku olwo ng’ava ku mirimu gye gyonna gye yakola” (Olubereberye 2:2). Yesu yagamba abayigirizwa be abaali bakooye nti, “Mujje tugende mu kifo eteri bantu tuwummuleko” (Makko 6:31).

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze bakaluubirirwa okuwummula?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga ebyetaago tebiggwaawo, kubanga bawulira nga tebayinza kubulwa, era oluusi kubanga omuwendo gwabwe gusibiddwa ku mulimu gwabwe. Essuula ebajjukiza nti ne Yesu “yali akooye olw’olugendo lwe yatambula, n’atuula awo ku luzzi” (Yokaana 4:6).

study_questions.question: Enteekateeka ennungi ey’okukola n’okuwummula y’eruwa?
study_questions.answer: Olunaku lw’okuwummula buli wiiki, ekiseera ne Katonda buli lunaku, n’ebiseera ebiwanvuko eby’okwawukana ku balala. Katonda yalagira okuwummula “ne mu biseera eby’okukabala n’ebyokukungula” (Okuva 34:21). Essuula eggya amagezi mu Bernard, Antoni ne Brother Lawrence, ne mu lugero lwa Maliza ne Maliyamu.

fields.title: Okuluŋŋamizibwa n’Okusalawo
fields.body_html:
“Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka. Mukama mukulembezenga mu by’okola byonna, naye anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula.”

— Engero 3:5-6

Abakulembeze basalawo ebintu buli lunaku. Ebisinga bitono: eky’okwogera mu lukiiko, gw’okukyalira, engeri y’okuddamu obubaka. Ebimu binene: oba okutandika ekkanisa empya, ani okulondebwa okuba omukadde w’ekkanisa, oba okusenguka okugenda mu kifo ekipya, engeri y’okukwatamu ekizibu ekigwiridde. Abakulembeze bangi okusalawo kuno bakwetikka bokka, nga bagalamira ekiro nga tebeebase, nga beebuuza oba baalonze bulungi.

Katonda tayagala baweereza be kukulembera mu kizikiza. Yasuubiza okuluŋŋamya abo abamunoonya: “Nnaakulagiranga era ne nkuyigiriza ekkubo mw’onootambuliranga; nnaakuwanga amagezi nga bwe nkulabirira” (Zabbuli 32:8). Essuula eno ekomekkereza Ekitundu eky’Okusatu: Omukulembeze ne Katonda, ng’ebuuza engeri abakulembeze gye bayinza okunoonya Katonda by’ayagala, nga bali bokka ne nga bali wamu, ne basalawo mu magezi ebimuweesa ekitiibwa.

Katonda aluŋŋamya abantu be

Bayibuli yonna eyogera ku Katonda akulembera. Yakulembera Ibulayimu okugenda mu nsi gye yali tamanyi. Yakulembera Isirayiri mu ddungu n’ekire emisana n’omuliro ekiro. Yayogera ne bannabbi. Yaluŋŋamya Dawudi mu ntalo. Era Yesu yagamba nti, “Endiga zange zitegeera eddoboozi lyange, era nzimanyi era zingoberera” (Yokaana 10:27). Omusumba atakulembera teyandibadde musumba n’akatono.

Naye okuluŋŋamya kwa Katonda tekutera kuba ddoboozi okuva mu ggulu nga litugamba ddala kye tulina okukola. Emirundi egisinga, atuluŋŋamya ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye, mu kusaba, mu magezi g’atuwa, mu bakkiriza abalala, ne mu ngeri gy’ategekamu embeera zaffe. Okuyiga okutegeera okuluŋŋamya kwe ssomo lya bulamu bwonna.

Okwesiga, so si kwesigama ku magezi go

Engero 3:5-6 ziwa omusingi: “Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka. Mukama mukulembezenga mu by’okola byonna, naye anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula.”

Kino tekitegeeza nti tetulina kulowooza. Katonda yatuwa ebirowoozo, era asuubira tubikozese. Kitegeeza nti tetulina kwesiga magezi gaffe okusinga bwe twesiga Katonda. Abakulembeze batera okuba abagezigezi, abalina obumanyirivu era abeekakasa. Ekyo kyennyini kye kibaleetera okuba mu kabi ak’okusalawo awatali Katonda.

Bayibuli etuwa ekyokulabirako ekitulabula. Yoswa bwe yali akulembera Isirayiri okuyingira mu nsi ensuubize, ekibinja ky’abasajja kyajja gy’ali nga beefuula abava mu nsi ey’ewala. Baali bambadde engoye enkadde era nga basitudde emigaati emikalu egyakula, ne basaba okukola endagaano ey’emirembe. Yoswa n’abakulembeze ne beetegereza obujulizi ne bulabika nga bwa mazima. “Abayisirayiri, awatali kumala kubuuza eri Mukama, ne bakkiriza okulya ku mmere y’abatambuze bano” (Yoswa 9:14). Ne bakola endagaano, era oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ssatu ne bazuula nti baali babalimbye. Abasajja abo baali babeera kumpi. Yoswa yali asazeewo ekintu ekyalabika ng’ekyeyoleka, naye nga tasabye ku nsonga eyo.

Dawudi ye, mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, emirundi mingi “yeebuuza ku Mukama” nga tannakola kintu. Abafirisuuti bwe baalumba, yabuuza Katonda oba agende abalwanyise, Katonda n’amugamba nti yee (1 Ebyomumirembe 14:10). Bwe baddamu okulumba mu kifo kye kimu, Dawudi teyalowooza nti eky’okuddamu kyandibadde kye kimu. Yaddamu n’abuuza, era ku mulundi ogwo Katonda n’amuwa enteekateeka ey’enjawulo (1 Ebyomumirembe 14:14). Okuluŋŋamizibwa okwayita tekudda mu kifo ky’okusaba okwa kaakano.

Katonda bw’aluŋŋamya

F. B. Meyer, omusumba w’Ababatisti mu London ku nkomerero y’emyaka gya 1800 ne ku ntandikwa y’emyaka gya 1900, yawandiika akatabo akatono era akaagalibwa ennyo akayitibwa Ekyama ky’Okuluŋŋamizibwa, akali ku Ochorus. Yawaayo ebiragiro bitaano eby’enkola eri buli muntu anoonya Katonda by’ayagala. Biba musingi mulungi eri abakulembeze.

1. Ebigendererwa byaffe biteekwa okuba ebirongoofu. Meyer yawandiika nti kasita tuba nga mu kyama tunoonya okwefunira ku lwaffe oba ettendo ly’abantu, “tekiriba kisoboka n’akatono okuzuula Katonda ky’ateekateeka ku ffe.” Nga tetunnabuuza Katonda ky’ayagala, tulina okwebuuza lwaki twagala kye twagala. Okusalawo kuno kwa kitiibwa kya Katonda n’obulungi bw’abantu be, oba kwa kweyagala kwange, erinnya lyange oba okwegomba kwange?

2. Bye twagala ffe biteekwa okuweebwayo eri Katonda. By’ayagala Katonda si lukalala lwa mmere mwe tulondera bye twagala. Tulina okuba abeetegefu okukola kyonna ky’anaatulaga nga tannakitulaga. Yesu yasaba mu nnimiro nti, “si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa” (Lukka 22:42). Omukulembeze amaze okusalawo, era ayagala Katonda akakase bukakasa, aba tanoonya ddala kuluŋŋamizibwa.

3. Tuteekwa okunoonyeza ebirowoozo byaffe amawulire. Katonda aluŋŋamya ng’ayita mu kutegeera. Kuŋŋaanya ebituufu. Soma Bayibuli ky’egamba ku nsonga eyo. Lowooza n’obwegendereza. Saba amagezi okuva eri abantu abagezi. “Awatali kuluŋŋamizibwa entegeka zifa, naye awali abawi b’amagezi abangi ziyitamu” (Engero 15:22).

4. Tuteekwa okusaba ennyo okuluŋŋamizibwa. “Naye obanga omuntu yenna ku mmwe aweebuka mu magezi, asabenga Katonda agabira bonna atakayuka, galimuweebwa” (Yakobo 1:5). Weetegereze nti Katonda agaba “atakayuka”. Tanyiiga bwe tumusaba obuyambi. Asanyuka okuwa amagezi abo abagamusaba.

5. Tuteekwa okulindirira enteekateeka ya Katonda okweyoleka mpola mpola. Meyer yawandiika nti okukubiriza kwa Katonda okw’omunda, Ekigambo kye n’okulabirira kwe binaakwatagana: “Katonda by’atuteeka mu mutima munda n’ekigambo kye ebweru bulijjo bikakasibwa okulabirira kwe okutwetoolodde, era tusaanidde okulindirira mu kasirise okutuusa ebintu bino ebisatu lwe binaasisinkana ku kifo kimu.” Mu bigambo ebyangu: Katonda bw’aba ng’atuluŋŋamya, okuwulira okw’omunda kw’atuwa, okuyigiriza kwa Bayibuli, n’engeri embeera gye zigenda zikulaakulanamu, bijja kukwatagana era bitunuulire oluuyi lwe lumu. Bwe bitakwatagana, lindirira.

Ekigambo kye kisooka

Mu ngeri zonna Katonda z’aluŋŋamyamu, Ekigambo kye kye kisinga obukulu era kye kisinga okuba ekikakafu. “Ekigambo kyo ye ttaala eri ebigere byange, era kye kimulisa ekkubo lyange” (Zabbuli 119:105). Katonda talituluŋŋamya kukola kintu Ekigambo kye kye kigaana. Omuntu bw’agamba nti, “Katonda yaŋŋambye mbuleke mukazi wange,” oba “Omwoyo yankulembedde okutwala ssente zino,” ate nga Bayibuli egamba bulala mu bwangu, oyo aba tawulira Katonda.

Okusalawo kungi kwamala dda okusalibwawo Ebyawandiikibwa. Tetwetaaga kusaba kumanya oba tulina okusonyiwa omuntu, okwogera amazima oba okulabirira abaavu. Katonda yamala dda okutugamba. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Temubanga basirusiru, naye mutegeere Mukama waffe ky’ayagala” (Abaefeso 5:17). Ebisinga ku Katonda by’ayagala biwandiikiddwa lwatu mu Bayibuli. Gye tukoma okubimanya, gye tukoma okutegeera okuluŋŋamya kwe mu nsonga Bayibuli z’etayogerako butereevu.

Pawulo era agamba nti okuluŋŋamizibwa kwesigama ku birowoozo ebizziddwa obuggya: “So temwefaananyirizanga ba mirembe gino, naye mukyusibwe olw’okudda obuggya mu birowoozo byammwe okukakasibwa okusiimibwa kwa Katonda, okusanyusa era okw’amazima” (Abaruumi 12:2). Omukulembeze ng’endowooza ye ebumbibwa Bayibuli kimwanguyira okutegeera Katonda by’ayagala okusinga oyo ng’endowooza ye ebumbibwa ensi.

Okusalawo awamu: olukiiko lw’e Yerusaalemi

Ebimu ku bintu ebisinga obukulu ebyasalibwawo mu Bayibuli tebyasalibwawo mukulembeze omu yekka, wabula abakulembeze nga bali wamu. Ekyokulabirako ekisinga okweyoleka kiri mu Bikolwa by’Abatume 15.

Ekibuuzo eky’amaanyi kyali kizuuse mu Kkanisa ey’olubereberye. Abayigiriza abamu baali bagamba nti abakkiriza Abamawanga baali balina okukomolebwa n’okukwata etteeka lya Musa balyoke balokolebwe. Pawulo ne Balunabba ne batakkiriziganya nabo n’akatono. “Pawulo ne Balunabba ne bawakana nnyo nabo ku nsonga eyo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:2). Ekibuuzo kyali kikulu nnyo ne kiba nti kyandisobodde okwawulamu Ekkanisa mu bitundu bibiri.

N’olwekyo “abatume n’abakadde b’Ekkanisa ne bakuŋŋaana bateese ku nsonga eyo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:6). Laba engeri gye baasalawo.

  • Baakuŋŋaana wamu. Tewali mukulembeze omu yasalirawo bonna.
  • Baakubaganya ebirowoozo mu lwatu. “Oluvannyuma nga bateeserezza ebbanga ggwanvu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:7), tebeewala butakkaanya era tebaanguyiriza kusalawo.
  • Baawuliriza obumanyirivu. Peetero yannyonnyola engeri Katonda gye yawaamu Abamawanga Omwoyo. “Ekibiina kyonna ne kisiriikirira ne bawuliriza Balunabba ne Pawulo nga babategeeza eby’amagero n’obubonero Katonda bye yabakozesa nga bali ku mulimu gwe mu baamawanga” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:12).
  • Baanoonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa. Yakobo yajuliza nnabbi Amosi okulaga nti Katonda bulijjo yali ateekateeka okuyingiza Abamawanga (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:15-18).
  • Omukulembeze yafunza. Yakobo yagamba nti, “Kyenva nsalawo nti, Tetusaana kutikka baamawanga abakkiriza Katonda mugugu munene” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:19).
  • Ekkanisa yonna yakkiriziganya. “Awo abatume n’abakadde b’Ekkanisa n’abooluganda bonna mu Kkanisa ne bateesa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:22).
  • Baategeera okuluŋŋamya kwa Katonda. Mu bbaluwa yaabwe baawandiika nti, “kwe kuteesa kwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu, era naffe” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:28).

Ebigambo ebyo ebisembayo birungi nnyo: “Mwoyo Mutukuvu, era naffe.” Tebeegamba nti baafuna okubikkulirwa okw’ekyama. Tebaakoma ku kulonda bulonzi. Baasaba, ne bawuliriza, ne banoonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa, ne boogera okutuusa lwe baakakasa nti kye baasazeewo era kye kyali Omwoyo ky’asazeewo. Kino kyokulabirako eri abakulembeze b’ekkanisa leero, naddala ku kusalawo okunene.

Enzigi enzigule n’enzigi enzigale

Oluusi Katonda aluŋŋamya ng’aggalawo enzigi. Ku lugendo lwe olw’okubiri olw’obuminsani, Pawulo yayagala okubuulira mu ssaza ly’e Asiya, naye ne batasobola “kubanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu yali abaziyizza okugenda mu Asiya okubuulirayo Ekigambo.” Oluvannyuma yagezaako okugenda e Bisuniya, “naye Mwoyo wa Yesu n’atabakkiriza.” Tetubuulirwa ngeri gye kyabaawo. Oboolyawo mu bulwadde, mu kuziyizibwa oba mu kigambo okuva eri nnabbi. Awo, e Tulowa, Pawulo n’afuna okwolesebwa, omusajja ng’agamba nti, “Jjangu ewaffe e Makedoniya otuyambe,” ne batandika olugendo, “kubanga yakitegeera nga Katonda atutumye okubabuulira Enjiri” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:6-10).

Pawulo teyatuula butuuzi ng’alindirira okuluŋŋamizibwa okutuukiridde. Yeeyongera okutambula mu kkubo lye yalowooza nti lye lisinga obulungi, era Katonda n’amukyusa. Kitera okwanguyira Katonda okuvuga eryato eritambula okusinga erisibiddwa ku mwalo. Naye Pawulo era yali mwetegefu okuyimirizibwa. Omukulembeze ow’amagezi enteekateeka ze azikwata mpola, nga tazinyweza nnyo.

Ebimu eby’okwegendereza

Okunoonya okuluŋŋamya kwa Katonda kuyinza okukyama. Gino gye gimu ku mitego egitera okubaawo.

  • Obubonero n’ebyoya by’endiga. Gidyoni yasaba Katonda akabonero ng’akozesa ebyoya by’endiga, emirundi ebiri (Abalamuzi 6:36-40). Katonda mu kisa kye yamuddamu. Naye Gidyoni yali asaba okukakasa ekyo Katonda kye yali amaze okwogera mu lwatu, kubanga yali atya. Tusaanidde okwegendereza okuzimba okusalawo kwaffe ku bubonero bwe twetondedde. Katonda ayinza okubukozesa mu kisa kye, naye si y’engeri gy’atera okukozesa.
  • Enneewulira zokka. Emirembe gikulu. Pawulo agamba nti, “N’emirembe gya Kristo gifugenga emitima gyammwe” (Abakkolosaayi 3:15). Naye enneewulira ziyinza okukwatibwako obukoowu, okutya oba okwegomba. Gezesa enneewulira zo n’Ebyawandiikibwa n’amagezi g’abantu abagezi.
  • Okwekakasa ennyo okusukkiridde. Abakulembeze abamu bagamba nti “Katonda yaŋŋambye” okukomya okukubaganya ebirowoozo n’okusirisa abatakkiriziganya nabo. Ekyo kukozesa bubi buyinza. Beera mwetoowaze ku ky’owulira nti Katonda akukulembera, naddala bwe kikwata ku balala.
  • Ebigambo eby’enjawulo okuva eri abalala. Pawulo bwe yali agenda e Yerusaalemi, “Mwoyo Mutukuvu n’ayogerera mu bayigirizwa abo ne balabula Pawulo aleme kugenda Yerusaalemi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 21:4). Naye Pawulo yakkiriza nti Katonda ye yali amutuma, n’agenda. Oluusi abakkiriza abeesigwa tebakkiriziganya ku Katonda ky’ayogera. Ku nkomerero, mikwano gya Pawulo baagamba nti, “Mukama ky’ayagala kye kiba kikolebwa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 21:14).
  • Okulindirira emirembe gyonna. Abantu abamu tebasalawo n’akatono kubanga batya okulonda obubi. Katonda tagezaako kutukweka by’ayagala. Bw’oba ng’osabye, ng’onoonyerezza mu Byawandiikibwa, ng’onoonyezza amagezi, era ng’ebigendererwa byo birongoofu, emirundi mingi kiba kituufu okukuba eddaala ery’okukkiriza n’olekera Katonda akukyuse bwe kiba kyetaagisa.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Hudson Taylor ku lubalama lw’ennyanja e Brighton

Mu 1865 Hudson Taylor yali akomyewo mu Bungereza oluvannyuma lw’emyaka gye egyasooka mu China. Yali anyigirizibwa omugugu omunene. Obukadde n’obukadde bw’abantu mu masaza ga China ag’omunda baali tebawulirangako Njiri, era tewaali kibiina kya buminsani ekyali kisindikayo abakozi. Yalowooza nti Katonda ayinza okuba ng’ayagala atandike ekibiina ky’obuminsani ekipya. Naye yali atya. Singa asaba abantu okugenda, ne babonaabona oba ne bafa, ye yandivunaanyizibwa. Singa atandika ekibiina ky’obuminsani nga tewali ssente zikakasiddwa, bandibadde balamu batya?

Okumala emyezi yameggana n’okusalawo okwo. Obulamu bwe ne butandika okunafuwa. Awo mukwano gwe n’amuyita okubeera naye mu kibuga eky’oku nnyanja ekiyitibwa Brighton. Ku Ssande, nga 25 Jjuuni 1865, Taylor yagenda mu kkanisa, naye n’atasobola kugumiikiriza kutuula wakati mu Bakristaayo lukumi abaali mu bulamu obunyuvu ng’ate obukadde n’obukadde mu China bazikirira. N’afuluma yekka n’atambula ku lubalama lw’ennyanja. Mu A Retrospect (Okutunula Emabega) yannyonnyola ekyabaawo:

“Eyo Mukama gye yawangulira obutakkiriza bwange, ne nneewaayo eri Katonda olw’obuweereza buno. Ne mmugamba nti obuvunaanyizibwa bwonna obw’ebinaavaamu n’ebinaddirira bulina okuba ku ye; nti nga omuweereza we, ekyange kwe kugondera n’okumugoberera — ekikye, kwe kunkulembera, okundabirira, n’okuluŋŋamya nze n’abo abayinza okukola nange. Kinneetaagisa okugamba nti emirembe amangu ago ne gikulukuta mu mutima gwange ogwali guzitoowereddwa?”

— Hudson Taylor, A Retrospect

Mu bigambo ebyangu: ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, Katonda yawangula obutakkiriza bwange, ne nneewaayo gy’ali olw’omulimu guno. Ne mmugamba nti ebinaavaamu n’ebinaddirira buvunaanyizibwa bwe. Ekitundu kyange kwe kugondera n’okugoberera. Ekitundu kye kwe kunkulembera, okundabirira n’okuluŋŋamya nze ne buli eyakola nange. Era amangu ago, emirembe ne gijja mu mutima gwange.

Awo wennyini, Taylor yasaba Katonda abakozi amakumi abiri mu bana, babiri ku buli limu ku masaza ekkumi n’erimu ag’omunda agaali gatalina muminsani, ne babiri ku lwa Mongolia. Okusaba okwo yakuwandiika ku mabbali ga Bayibuli ye. Mu mwaka gumu, ekibiina China Inland Mission kyali kitandikiddwawo, era ekibinja ky’abakozi ekyasooka ne kisaabala okugenda e China. Mu myaka amakumi egyaddirira, kyasindika abaminsani bikumi na bikumi mu buli ssaza.

Weetegereze engeri okuluŋŋamizibwa kwa Taylor gye kwatambulamu. Yalina omugugu ogwagenda gukula mu biseera. Yali anoonyerezza ku kyetaago. Yali asabye okumala emyezi. Yali anoonyezza amagezi. Naye eddaala eryasalawo byonna lyajja bwe yawaayo bye yayagala byonna eri Katonda era n’ateeka ku ye obuvunaanyizibwa bw’ebinaavaamu. Ekiragiro kya Meyer eky’okubiri, “bye twagala ffe biteekwa okuweebwayo eri Katonda”, kye kyali ekisumuluzo ekyaggulawo ebirala byonna.

Anaakuluŋŋamyanga

Engero zisuubiza nti bwe twesiga Mukama ne tumukulembeza mu byonna, “anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula” (Engero 3:6). Abakulembeze tebeetaaga kumanya kkubo lyonna. Twetaaga okukuba eddaala eriddako nga twesiga. “Omutima gw’omuntu guteekateeka ekkubo lye, naye Mukama y’aluŋŋamya bw’anaatambula” (Engero 16:9).

Kino kye kikomekkereza Ekitundu eky’Okusatu: Omukulembeze ne Katonda. Tutunuulidde obulamu obw’omunda obw’omukulembeze ne Katonda: okusaba, Ekigambo, Omwoyo, okuwummula n’okuluŋŋamizibwa. Mu Kitundu eky’Okuna: Okulunda Ekisibo tudda ku mulimu gw’omusumba ogwa buli lunaku: okuliisa, okumanya, okunoonya, okunenya n’okubudaabuda ekisibo.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Kusalawo ki kw’olina mu maaso go kaakano ng’omukulembeze? Onoonyezza ddala Katonda ku nsonga eyo?
  • Soma Yoswa 9:3-15. Ddi lwe wasalawo ekintu ekyalabika ng’ekyeyoleka nga tobuuzizza Katonda?
  • Ku biragiro bya Meyer ebitaano (ebigendererwa ebirongoofu, by’oyagala okubiwaayo eri Katonda, amawulire, okusaba, okulindirira), kiruwa ky’otera okubuuka?
  • Soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:1-29. Ekkanisa yo oba ttiimu y’abakulembeze bo kiki kye bayinza okuyiga mu ngeri olukiiko lw’e Yerusaalemi gye lwasalawo?
  • Wali oyogedde nti “Katonda yaŋŋambye” mu ngeri eyakomya okukubaganya ebirowoozo? Oyinza otya okwogera ku kuluŋŋamya kwa Katonda mu bwetoowaze obusingawo?
  • Hudson Taylor yafuna emirembe bwe yawaayo eri Katonda obuvunaanyizibwa bw’ebinaavaamu. Biki ebinaavaamu by’olina okuwaayo gy’ali?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wandiika okusalawo kumu kw’olina mu maaso go. Oluvannyuma yita mu biragiro bya Meyer ebitaano ku lupapula. Ekisooka, wandiika mu mazima ku bigendererwa byo. Eky’okubiri, saba essaala ey’okwewaayo: “Mukama, nja kukola kyonna ky’onondaga.” Eky’okusatu, wandiika Bayibuli ky’egamba ekikwata ku kusalawo kuno, n’ebituufu by’omanyi. Eky’okuna, kisabire buli lunaku wiiki eno. Eky’okutaano, saba abakkiriza ab’amagezi waakiri babiri bakuwe amagezi. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, laba oba okuwulira kwo okw’omunda, Ekigambo kya Katonda n’embeera zo bitandise okutunuulira oluuyi lwe lumu.

study_questions.question: Katonda aluŋŋamya atya abakulembeze?
study_questions.answer: Okusingira ddala ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye, era ne mu kusaba, mu magezi g’abantu abagezi, mu mbeera, ne mu bujulirwa bw’Omwoyo obw’omunda. “Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka” (Engero 3:5). Asuubiza nti, “Nnaakulagiranga era ne nkuyigiriza ekkubo mw’onootambuliranga” (Zabbuli 32:8).

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze basaanidde okusalawo nga bali wamu n’abalala?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga “Awatali kuluŋŋamizibwa entegeka zifa, naye awali abawi b’amagezi abangi ziyitamu” (Engero 15:22). Ekkanisa ey’olubereberye yagonjoola ekibuuzo ekinene nga bali wamu ku lukiiko lw’e Yerusaalemi, ate Yoswa yasobya bwe baakola “awatali kumala kubuuza eri Mukama” (Yoswa 9:14).

study_questions.question: Nkole ki bwe mba simanyi kya kusalawo?
study_questions.answer: Saba Katonda. “Naye obanga omuntu yenna ku mmwe aweebuka mu magezi, asabenga Katonda agabira bonna atakayuka” (Yakobo 1:5). Gezesa okusalawo kwo n’Ebyawandiikibwa, noonya amagezi, era beera mwetegefu okugamba nga Yesu nti, “si nga Nze bwe njagala, wabula ky’oyagala kye kiba kikolebwa” (Lukka 22:42).

fields.title: Liisa Endiga Zange
fields.body_html:
“Mukama wange ggwe omanyi buli kimu, omanyi nga nkwagala.” Yesu n’amugamba nti, “Kale liisanga endiga zange.”

— Yokaana 21:17

Ku lubalama lw’ennyanja mu Ggaliraaya, ku makya ennyo, Yesu eyali azuukidde yafumbira abayigirizwa be eky’enkya. Ennaku ntono emabega, Peetero yali amwegaanye emirundi esatu. Kaakano Yesu n’abuuza Peetero emirundi esatu nti, “Onjagala?” Buli mulundi Peetero yaddamu nti yee. Era buli mulundi Yesu yamuwa omulimu gwe gumu: “Kale liisanga abaana b’endiga zange.” “Kale lundanga endiga zange.” “Kale liisanga endiga zange” (Yokaana 21:15-17).

Weetegereze Yesu ky’ataayogera. Teyagamba nti, “Bw’oba onjagala, zimba ekkanisa ennene,” oba “Bw’oba onjagala, ba mwatiikirivu.” Yagamba nti, “Bw’oba onjagala, liisa endiga zange.” Ekyandigezesezza okwagala kwa Peetero eri Kristo kwandibadde okulabirira abantu ba Kristo. Era engeri esooka gye yandibalabiriddemu kwandibadde kubaliisa.

Essuula eno etandika Ekitundu eky’Okuna: Okulunda Ekisibo. Mu Kitundu eky’Okusatu: Omukulembeze ne Katonda twalaba nti omukulembeze alina okusooka okuliisibwa Katonda mu kusaba ne mu Kigambo kye. Kaakano tudda eri abantu. Omusumba ataliisa ndiga si musumba, ne bw’aba ng’alina emirimu mingi atya.

Endiga za ani?

Yesu yagamba nti “abaana b’endiga zange” ne “endiga zange”. Ekisibo si kya Peetero. Kya Kristo. Pawulo yagamba abakadde b’ekkanisa ab’e Efeso okulunda, “okulabiriranga Ekkanisa ya Katonda gye yeegulira n’omusaayi gwe” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28). Peetero oluvannyuma yawandiikira abakulembeze abalala nti, “Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe” (1 Peetero 5:2).

Kino kikyusa buli kimu ku ngeri gye tuliisaamu abantu. Tetuliisa bagoberezi baffe ku lwaffe balyoke batwewuunye. Tuliisa abantu Yesu be yagula n’omusaayi gwe, balyoke bakule nga ba maanyi mu ye. Si baffe okubakozesa. Ba ye okubaweereza. Omufumbi mu nnyumba ennene tafumba ekyo ekimusanyusa ye. Afumba mukama we ky’alagidde, olw’abagenyi ba mukama we.

Era kino kireeta okubudaabudibwa. Ekisibo bwe kiba nga kinafu oba nga kisaasaanye, obuzito tetubwetikka ffekka. Endiga za Kristo, era azifaako okusinga ffe bwe twandisobodde.

Enjala y’ekibiina

Lumu, “Yesu bwe yava mu lyato n’alaba ekibiina ky’abantu bangi abaali bakuŋŋaanye n’abasaasira nga bali ng’endiga ezitalina musumba. Awo n’atandika okubayigiriza ebintu bingi” (Makko 6:34). Weetegereze okusaasira kwe kye kwamuleetera okukola. Yawonya abantu era n’abaliisa emigaati. Naye wano, ekintu ekyasooka okusaasira kwe kye kwakola kwali kuyigiriza.

Oluusi tulowooza nti okuyigiriza kintu kinyogovu, ate okulabirira kintu kibuguumirivu. Yesu teyalowooza bw’atyo. Yalaba nti abantu abatalina mazima ga Katonda bali ng’endiga ezibuze ku lusozi. Tebamanyi wa kufuna mmere, oba mazzi, oba obukuumi. Ekintu ekyasinga ekisa kye yali ayinza okubakolera kwali kubabuulira amazima agakwata ku Katonda.

Mu bifo bingi leero Ekkanisa ekula mangu, naye okuyigiriza tekugenze nayo. Waliwo abakkiriza abapya bangi n’abayigiriza abatendeke batono. Amakanisa agamu galimu oluyoogaano lungi n’essanyu ery’amaanyi, naye abantu baddayo eka nga balumwa enjala. Amalala galina okusinza okuwanvu, naye obubaka bwogera ku ndowooza z’omubuulizi, amawulire agasembyeyo, oba engeri y’okugaggawala. Bayibuli etulabula ku kino: “Kubanga ekiseera kijja lwe baligaana okuwulira enjigiriza entuufu, era olw’okugoberera okwegomba kwabwe balyekuŋŋaanyiza abayigiriza, abalibayigiriza bye baagala, okuwulira” (2 Timoseewo 4:3). Omukulembeze ayagala endiga ajja kuziwa emmere entuufu, ne bwe ziba nga zandyagadde swiiti.

Okuziliisa obulungi

Kitegeeza ki okuliisa obulungi abantu ba Katonda? Bayibuli etuwa obubonero obuwerako.

Baliise Ekigambo. Ekiragiro kya Pawulo ekisembayo eri Timoseewo kyali kyeyolefu: “buuliranga ekigambo kya Katonda, ng’oli mwetegefu mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu, ng’olaga ebikwekeddwa, ng’onenya, ng’ozaamu amaanyi, wakati mu kugumiikiriza, n’okubonaabona okungi, n’okuyigiriza” (2 Timoseewo 4:2). Engero zaffe, ebirowoozo byaffe n’ebyo bye twayitamu biyinza okuyamba okunnyonnyola Ekigambo, naye tebiyinza kudda mu kifo kyakyo.

Baliise Ekigambo kyonna. Pawulo yagamba abakadde b’ekkanisa ab’e Efeso nti, “kubanga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mbabuulira okwagala kwa Katonda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:27). Teyalondamu bitundu byokka ebyagalibwa abantu. Mu biseera, omukulembeze omwesigwa ayigiriza olugero lwa Bayibuli lwonna: okutonda, okugwa, ebisuubizo eri Isirayiri, obulamu bwa Kristo, okufa kwe n’okuzuukira kwe, Ekkanisa, n’ebitonde ebiggya. Abantu abawulira emitwe mitono gyokka egyagalibwa bulijjo bajja kuba banafu era nga tebakwatagana bulungi.

Bayambe okutegeera. Ezera bwe yasomera abantu amateeka oluvannyuma lw’obuwaŋŋanguse, Abaleevi “Ne basoma mu Kitabo ky’Amateeka ga Katonda, nga bataputa, era nga bannyonnyola amakulu, abantu bategeere ebyasomebwa” (Nekkemiya 8:8). Okusoma kwokka tekumala. Tulina okunnyonnyola. Omukungu Omwesiyopya bwe yali ng’asoma Isaaya mu ggaali lye, Firipo yamubuuza nti, “By’osoma obitegeera?” N’addamu nti, “Nnaabitegeera ntya nga sirina abinnyinnyonnyola?” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 8:30-31). Abantu bangi mu makanisa gaffe babuuza ekibuuzo kye kimu. Kozesa ebigambo ebyangu. Kozesa ebifaananyi okuva mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, nga Yesu bwe yakola n’ensigo, endiga, ensimbi n’emigaati. Mu bifo ewoogerwa ennimi nnyingi, yigiriza mu lulimi abantu mwe balowooleza era mwe basabira.

Baliise kye basobola okulya. Pawulo yagamba Abakkolinso nti, “Nabanywesa mata so si mmere enkalubo, kubanga mwali temunnagisobola” (1 Abakkolinso 3:2). Abakkiriza abapya beetaaga okusooka okufuna amazima ag’omusingi. Naye Abaebbulaniya balabula nti abantu tebasaanidde kusigala ku mata emirembe gyonna: “Newaakubadde nga kaakano mwandibadde musobola okuyigiriza abalala, kyetaaga okuddamu okubayigiriza, ebintu ebya bulijjo eby’amazima ebikwata ku kigambo kya Katonda” (Abaebbulaniya 5:12). Omusumba omulungi awa abato amata, n’abo abakula emmere enkalubo, era n’abakulembera okutuuka ku kukula okujjuvu.

Kigendererwa kibe kukula mu Kristo. Pawulo yafunza obuweereza bwe bwonna bw’ati: “Kristo oyo gwe tutegeeza nga tuyigiriza buli muntu mu magezi gonna era nga tulabula buli omu, tulyoke twanjule buli muntu eri Katonda ng’atuukiridde mu Kristo” (Abakkolosaayi 1:28). Ekigendererwa si kujjuza mitwe gya bantu, era si kubafuula abeesigama ku ffe. Ekigendererwa Bakristaayo abakulu abamanyi Kristo, abamugondera era abasobola okuliisa abalala.

Mu lukuŋŋaana ne mu maka

Okuliisa ekisibo tekubeerawo ku kituuti kyokka. Pawulo yajjukiza abakadde b’ekkanisa ab’e Efeso nti, “Naye saalekayo kubabuulira bituufu eby’okubayamba, bwe twabanga tukuŋŋaanye oba bwe najjanga mu maka gammwe” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:20).

Ebimu ku kuyigiriza okusinga obukulu kubeerawo mu bifo ebitono: okusoma Bayibuli mu maka, emboozi nga mulya, omukulembeze ng’asoma Ebyawandiikibwa n’omukkiriza omupya wansi w’omuti, maama ng’ayigiriza abaana be nga tebannagenda kwebaka. Abakristaayo abaasooka “Ne banyiikiranga okuyigirizibwa kw’abatume ne mu kussekimu, ne mu kumenya omugaati era ne mu kusaba” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:42). Okuyigiriza n’obulamu obw’awamu byatambuliranga wamu.

Yesu yagamba abagoberezi be okufuula abantu abayigirizwa, era “mubayigirize okugonderanga byonna bye nabalagira mmwe” (Matayo 28:20). Weetegereze ekigambo “okugonderanga”. Ekigendererwa ky’okuyigiriza si kwe kuba nti abantu bamanya bumanya Yesu bye yalagira, wabula babikole. Okuyigiriza okw’engeri eyo kwetaaga ebisingawo ku bubaka obubuulirwa. Kwetaaga ekyokulabirako, emboozi, ebibuuzo n’okwegezaamu. Mu ssuula eddako tujja kulaba lwaki omusumba alina okumanya buli ndiga alyoke aziliise bulungi.

Obulamu bw’omuyigiriza yennyini

Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo nti, “Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza era obinywerereko. Bw’onookola bw’otyo olyerokola ggwe wennyini, era n’abo abakuwulira” (1 Timoseewo 4:16). Weetegereze nate omutendera: okusooka ggwe kennyini, oluvannyuma by’oyigiriza. Twalaba mu Ssuula 9, Mwekuume Mwekka, nti emmeeme y’omukulembeze yennyini y’esooka. Kye kimu ne bwe tuba tuyigiriza.

Abantu tebawuliriza bigambo byaffe byokka. Batunuulira obulamu bwaffe. Omukulembeze bw’ayigiriza ku bugumiikiriza ate nga amanyiddwa okuboggolera mukazi we, abantu bajja kukkiriza kye balaba, so si kye bawulira. Omukulembeze bw’ayigiriza ku kugaba ate nga amanyiddwa nga wa mululu, obubaka bwe bujja kuba bwa bwereere. Naye obulamu bw’omukulembeze bwe bukwatagana n’Ekigambo, n’okuyigiriza okwangu kuba n’amaanyi mangi.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Augustine ne Charles Spurgeon

Augustine yali mulabirizi e Hippo, mu Afirika ey’Obukiikakkono, ku nkomerero y’ekyasa eky’okuna ne ku ntandikwa y’eky’okutaano. Nga tannafuuka Mukristaayo, yali musomesa w’okwogera mu bantu. Yali amanyi obukodyo bwonna obw’omwogezi omugezigezi. Bwe yajja eri Kristo, yawandiika ekitabo ekiyitibwa On Christian Doctrine (Ku Njigiriza y’Ekikristaayo) okuyamba ababuulizi n’abayigiriza. Mu kyo yajuliza omwogezi Omuruumi omwatiikirivu eyagamba nti omwogezi omulungi alina okuyigiriza, okusanyusa n’okusikiriza. Augustine yakkiriziganya naye, naye n’agamba nti okuyigiriza kwe kusooka. Okusanyusa n’okusikiriza bikulu, naye abantu bwe batategeera mazima, tewali kirala kiyamba. Era yawandiika nti tewali mugaso mu kisumuluzo kya zaabu ekitasobola kuggulawo luggi, era tewali nsonyi mu kisumuluzo kya muti ekisobola okuluggulawo. Ekikulu si bigambo binyuvu, wabula amazima okutuuka ku muwulize.

Awo Augustine n’ayogera ekintu buli muyigiriza ky’asaanidde okuwulira:

“Naye ne bwe bunaaba obukulu bw’engeri y’okwogera butya, obulamu bw’omwogezi bwe bunaasinga okuleetera omuwulize okugondera.”

— Augustine, On Christian Doctrine, Ekitabo IV

Mu bigambo ebyangu: ne bw’oyogera bulungi otya, obulamu bwo bujja kukola bingi okusinga ebigambo byo okuyamba abantu okugondera Katonda.

Oluvannyuma lw’ebyasa kkumi na bina, Charles Spurgeon yatendeka abasumba abavubuka bikumi na bikumi mu London. Emboozi ze gye bali zaakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu Lectures to My Students (Emboozi eri Abayizi Bange), ekiri ku Ochorus. Spurgeon teyalina bugumiikiriza eri obubaka obuwulikika obulungi naye nga tebuliimu mmere:

“Obubaka busaanidde okubaamu okuyigiriza okwa ddala, n’enjigiriza yaabwo ebeere nnywevu, ey’omugaso, era nnyingi. Tetulinnya ku kituuti kwogera lwa kwogera bwogezi; tulina ebiragiro by’okutuusa ebikulu ennyo okukamala, era tetuyinza kwesasulira kwogera bitaliimu ebinyuma obunyumi.”

— Charles Spurgeon, Lectures to My Students

Mu bigambo ebyangu: obubaka bulina okuyigiriza ekintu ekya ddala. Tetubuulira kumala bumazi budde. Katonda yatuwa obubaka obusinga obukulu, n’olwekyo tetuyinza kwonoona biseera by’abantu n’ebigambo ebinyuma ebitaliimu kintu.

Spurgeon era yeegayirira abayizi be okukuuma Kristo wakati mu byonna. Yawandiika nti, “Ayi, singa Kristo eyakomererwa ye yali omugugu gw’abantu ba Katonda bonna.” Yabalabula baleme kusendebwasendebwa kugenda mu kuteebereza ku nkomerero y’ensi, oba mu kukaayana ku by’obufuzi, ng’abantu ababeetoolodde bafa nga tebalina Kristo. Kyonna kye tuyigiriza, buli kkubo lirina okudda eri Yesu n’omusaalaba gwe.

Omwagala?

Ddayo ku lubalama lw’ennyanja mu Ggaliraaya. Peetero yali agudde nnyo. Naye Yesu teyamulekulira. Yamuzzaawo n’ekibuuzo n’ekiragiro: “Onjagala? Kale liisanga endiga zange.” Peetero yamala obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo ng’akola ekyo kyennyini. Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka yawandiikira abakulembeze abalala nti, “Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe” (1 Peetero 5:2). Omusajja Yesu gwe yaliisa ku lubalama lw’ennyanja yafuuka omuliisa w’abalala.

Yesu abuuza buli mukulembeze ekibuuzo kye kimu. Omwagala? Kale liisa endiga ze. Weeteeketeeke n’obwegendereza. Yigiriza mu bwangu bw’okutegeera. Waayo Ekigambo kyonna. Kinnyonnyole mu ngeri ennyangu. Beera mu bulamu bw’oyigiriza. Era kikole olw’okumwagala, kubanga endiga ze, era yazigula n’omusaayi gwe.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Yokaana 21:15-17. Olowooza lwaki Yesu yagatta okwagala kwa Peetero gy’ali n’okuliisa endiga ze?
  • Okusaasira kwa Yesu eri ekibiina kwamuleetera okubayigiriza (Makko 6:34). Okuyigiriza okulaba ng’ekikolwa eky’okwagala? Lwaki yee oba lwaki nedda?
  • Abantu b’okulembera bawulira olugero lwa Bayibuli lwonna, oba emitwe mitono gyokka egyagalibwa?
  • Soma Nekkemiya 8:8. Kiki ky’oyinza okukola okuyamba abantu okutegeera obulungi Bayibuli, so si kuwulira buwulizi ng’esomebwa?
  • Abantu b’oyigiriza bakula okutuuka ku kukula okujjuvu, oba bakyali ku mata? Kiki ekyandibayambye okukula?
  • Augustine yagamba nti obulamu bw’omwogezi businga engeri y’okwogera. Wa obulamu bwo we buwagira okuyigiriza kwo, era wa we bukunafuya?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Londa omuntu omu gw’okulembera akyali omuto mu kukkiriza. Tegeka okusisinkana naye wiiki eno, mu maka ge oba mu gago, musome wamu ekitundu ekimpi eky’Ebyawandiikibwa, nga Makko 6:30-44. Kisome mu ddoboozi, kinnyonnyole mu ngeri ennyangu, era omubuuze ebibuuzo bibiri: “Kino kitulaga ki ku Yesu?” ne “Tusaanidde kukola ki olw’ekyo?” Oluvannyuma musabire wamu. Weetegereze bw’ategeera, n’ebyo by’akyetaaga. Ekyo kikuluŋŋamye ku ky’onooyigiriza oluvannyuma.

study_questions.question: Yesu yali ategeeza ki bwe yagamba Peetero okuliisa endiga ze?
study_questions.answer: Yawa Peetero omulimu gw’okulabirira abantu be, naddala ng’abayigiriza Ekigambo kye. Endiga za Kristo, nga y’Ekkanisa ya Katonda “gye yeegulira n’omusaayi gwe” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28). Peetero oluvannyuma yagamba abakadde b’ekkanisa nti, “Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe” (1 Peetero 5:2).

study_questions.question: Lwaki Yesu yayigiriza ebibiina?
study_questions.answer: Olw’okusaasira: “n’abasaasira nga bali ng’endiga ezitalina musumba. Awo n’atandika okubayigiriza ebintu bingi” (Makko 6:34). Okuyigiriza Ekigambo kya Katonda y’emu ku ngeri enkulu omusumba z’aliisaamu abantu.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okuliisa obulungi ekisibo?
study_questions.answer: Ng’abuulira Ekigambo n’obwesigwa n’obugumiikiriza, “mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu” (2 Timoseewo 4:2), ne bwe kiba nti abantu baagala okuwulira ebyo byokka bye baagala. Okuliisa kubeerawo mu kuyigiriza okw’olukuŋŋaana ne mu maka, era obulamu bw’omuyigiriza yennyini bulina okukwatagana n’obubaka.

fields.title: Okumanya Endiga
fields.body_html:
“Okakasanga nti omanyi bulungi embeera z’ekisibo kyo, ossangayo omwoyo ku ggana lyo.”

— Engero 27:23

Omulunzi ku busozi amanyi ebisolo bye. Amanyi embuzi enkadde etambula mpola, n’eyo eneetera okuzaala, n’eyo bulijjo ewaba n’ekwata ekkubo erigenda ku luguudo, n’eyo ewenyera olw’eriggwa erigiyingidde mu kigere. Tazikwata zonna mu ngeri y’emu. Tasobola, kubanga si zonna nti zifaanagana. Era bw’aba tazimanyi, tasobola kuzirabirira.

Mu ssuula ewedde twalaba nti omusumba alina okuliisa ekisibo. Naye tosobola kuliisa bulungi bantu b’otomanyi. Okubuulira kuyinza okubuulirwa ekibiina ky’abantu. Naye okulunda kukolebwa ku muntu omu omu. Essuula eno ekwata ku kumanya endiga.

Omusumba amanyi endiga ze

Yesu yagamba nti, “Nze ndi musumba mulungi, n’endiga zange nzimanyi era nazo zimmanyi” (Yokaana 10:14). Era yagamba nti omusumba “aziyita amannya gaazo n’azifulumya ebweru” (Yokaana 10:3).

Lowooza ku ngeri Yesu gye yakolaganangamu n’abantu mu Njiri. Teyalina nkola emu eri buli muntu. Nikodemo, omuyigiriza w’amateeka, yamwogerako ku kuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri (Yokaana 3). Omukazi Omusamaliya ku luzzi yamwogerako ku mazzi amalamu, n’amubikkulira mpola ebyayita mu bulamu bwe ebyamuleetera obulumi (Yokaana 4). Omuvubuka omugagga yamugamba nti, “genda otunde ebintu byonna by’olina, ensimbi z’onoggyamu ozigabire abaavu” (Makko 10:21), kubanga ssente ze zaali zikutte omutima gwe. Zaakayo, omusolooza w’omusolo eyakyayibwa ennyo, yamugamba bugambi nti ajja kujja ewuwe (Lukka 19:5). Tomasi, eyabuusabuusa, yamulaga ebiwundu bye (Yokaana 20:27). Peetero, oluvannyuma lw’okugwa kwe, yamubuuza emirundi esatu nti, “Onjagala?” (Yokaana 21:15-17).

Buli muntu yafuna kye yali yeetaaga, kubanga Yesu yali amanyi buli omu. Ye kyakulabirako kyaffe. Tetusobola kumanya bantu nga bw’abamanya, kubanga Ye alaba omutima. Naye tusobola okuyiga amannya gaabwe, ebyafaayo byabwe, emigugu gyabwe n’obulabe bwe balimu.

Abasumba abataamanya

Mu Ssuula 3, Yesu, Omusumba Omukulu, twasoma omusango Katonda gwe yasalira abasumba ba Isirayiri mu Ezeekyeri 34. Laba bye baalemwa okukola: “Ennafu temuzizzaamu maanyi, so n’endwadde temuzijjanjabye, so n’ezirumizibbwa temusibye biwundu byazo, so n’ezibuze temuzikomezzaawo” (Ezeekyeri 34:4).

Weetegereze nti Katonda ayogera ku ndiga ez’engeri ez’enjawulo: ennafu, endwadde, ezirumiziddwa, ezaawaba n’ezaabula. Buli emu yali yeetaaga ekintu kya njawulo. Ennafu zaali zeetaaga amaanyi. Endwadde zaali zeetaaga okuwonyezebwa. Ezirumiziddwa zaali zeetaaga okusibibwa ebiwundu. Ezaawaba zaali zeetaaga okukomezebwawo. Ezaabula zaali zeetaaga okunoonyezebwa. Abasumba ababi tebaakola na kimu ku ebyo, kubanga baali beefaako bokka. Tebaafaayo na kutegeera ani nnafu era ani yabula.

Awo Katonda n’asuubiza nti Ye kennyini ajja kuba omusumba: “Ndinoonya ezaabula, ne nkomyawo ezaawaba. Ndigyanjaba ezaalumizibwa, ne ŋŋumya ennafu” (Ezeekyeri 34:16). Omusumba ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala ajja kukola bw’atyo. Naye okusooka tulina okutegeera buli ndiga nga bw’eri.

Abantu ab’enjawulo, okulabirirwa okw’enjawulo

Pawulo yawa ekkanisa y’e Sessaloniika ekiragiro ekimpi naye eky’amagezi mangi: “Tubakuutira abooluganda, mubuulirirenga abagayaavu, mugumyenga abo abalimu okutya, muyambenga abatalina maanyi, mubenga bagumiikiriza eri abantu bonna” (1 Abasessaloniika 5:14).

Weetegereze bulungi olunyiriri luno. Pawulo ayogera ku bantu ab’engeri ssatu, era buli omu amuwa okulabirirwa okw’enjawulo.

  • Abagayaavu beetaaga okubuulirirwa n’okunenyezebwa. Bagenda bawaba, tebafaayo, oba tebagondera. Ebigambo ebiweweevu byokka tebijja kubayamba. Beetaaga okulabulwa okutegeerekeka.
  • Abalimu okutya beetaaga okugumizibwa. Batya, beeraliikirira, oba baweddemu amaanyi. Okulabula okw’obukambwe kwandibabetenta. Beetaaga okuwulira essuubi.
  • Abatalina maanyi beetaaga omuntu abayamba n’abeera nabo. Balwanagana n’ebizibu, oboolyawo endwadde, obwavu, oba ekibi kye batannaba kusobola kuwangula. Beetaaga obuyambi obw’ensonga n’omuntu abali okumpi.

Awo Pawulo n’ayongerako nti: “mubenga bagumiikiriza eri abantu bonna.” Buli ngeri y’omuntu egezesa obugumiikiriza bw’omukulembeze mu ngeri yaayo.

Obulabe buli mu kuwa ddagala likyamu. Bwe tulabula abalimu okutya, tubamenya. Bwe tubudaabuda bubudaabuzi abatafaayo, tubaleka ne beeyongera okugenda mu kuzikirira. Omusawo eyandiwadde buli mulwadde eddagala lye limu yanditta abamu ku bo. Omukulembeze akwata buli muntu mu ngeri y’emu naye ajja kulumya abamu. Eyo ye nsonga lwaki tulina okumanya endiga.

Engeri y’okumanyamu ekisibo

Olugero lugamba nti, “Okakasanga nti omanyi bulungi embeera z’ekisibo kyo” (Engero 27:23). Omukulembeze ayinza atya okukikola?

Yiga amannya. Kiyinza okulabika ng’ekintu ekitono, naye kikulu. Omuntu amanyiddwa erinnya lye awulira nti wa wano. Yesu ayita endiga ze amannya gaazo.

Kyalira abantu gye babeera. Oyiga bingi ku maka mu ssaawa emu ng’oli mu nnyumba yaabwe okusinga mu mwaka mulamba ogw’okubalamusiza ku mulyango gw’ekkanisa. Olaba omulimu gwabwe, abaana baabwe, n’ebizibu byabwe. Pawulo yayigirizanga “bwe najjanga mu maka gammwe” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:20).

Wuliriza okusinga bw’oyogera. Buuza ebibuuzo ebirungi. “Otambula otya ne Katonda?” “Kiki ekikukaluubirira kati?” “Nkusabire ku ki?” Oluvannyuma wuliriza eky’okuddamu, era okijjukire.

Tunuulira enkyukakyuka. Weetegereze ani alekedde awo okujja, ani alabika nga mukoowu oba nga yeeraliikirira, ani asirise. Emirundi mingi akabonero akasooka ak’endiga eri mu kabi kwe kugenda ng’eseeseetuka okudda ku mbiriizi z’ekisibo.

Labirira abalwadde. Yakobo yawandiika nti, “Waliwo omulwadde mu mmwe? Kirungi atumye abakulembeze b’Ekkanisa, bamusabire” (Yakobo 5:14). Ebiseera by’obulwadde, eby’okuzaala, eby’okufiirwa n’eby’ebizibu bye biseera abantu mwe basinga okwetaaga abasumba baabwe, era bwe basinga okujjukira ani eyajja.

Gabana omulimu. Tewali muntu ayinza kumanya bulungi bantu lukumi. Yesu yalina abayigirizwa kkumi na babiri ab’okumpi, ne basatu abaali basinga okumuba okumpi. Omukulembeze ow’amagezi ow’ekkanisa ennene akakasa nti buli muntu waliwo amumanyi: omukadde w’ekkanisa, omudyakoni, omukulembeze w’ekibinja ekitono. Kino tujja kukyongera okukitunuulira mu Kitundu eky’Okutaano: Okukulembera Awamu.

Obulabe bw’ekibiina ky’abantu

Abakulembeze abamu baagala ebibiina by’abantu abangi. Bawulira obulamu nga bayimiridde mu maaso g’abantu bikumi na bikumi. Naye tebawulira mirembe nga batudde ne nnamwandu omu ali mu nnaku, oba omuvubuka omu atabuddwatabuddwa. Bandyagadde okubuulira okusinga okukyalira abantu.

Ekibiina ky’abantu kiyinza okukweka ebintu bingi. Omukulembeze ayinza okubuulira ekisenge ekijjudde buli wiiki n’atamanya nti obufumbo bw’abafumbo abavubuka bugenda busasika, oba nti omusajja omukadde amaze wiiki nzijjuvu nga talya bulungi, oba nti omuvubuka omuto alowooza okuleka okukkiriza. Ekibiina kirabika bulungi, naye endiga kinnoomu zifa.

Pawulo teyabuuliranga bibiina byokka. Yajjukiza abakadde b’ekkanisa y’Efeso nti okumala emyaka esatu teyalekera awo, “nga bwe nababuulirira nga nkaaba amaziga okumala emyaka esatu, emisana n’ekiro” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:31), ng’abuulirira buli omu ku bo. Buli omu. Okwo kwe kulunda.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Gregory Omukulu ne Richard Baxter

Gregory Omukulu, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 2, Ekifuula Obukulembeze Okuba obw’Omwoyo, yali mulabirizi w’e Rooma ku nkomerero y’ekyasa eky’omukaaga. Ekitabo kye The Book of Pastoral Rule (Ekitabo ky’Obulagirizi bw’Abasumba) kyasomebwanga abakulembeze b’ekkanisa okumala emyaka lukumi. Ekitundu kyakyo eky’okusatu kyonna kikwata ku ndowooza emu ennyangu: abantu ba njawulo, n’olwekyo balina okuyigirizibwa mu ngeri ez’enjawulo.

Gregory yagamba nti omuyigiriza afaanana ng’omuyimbi akuba ennanga. Omuyimbi akuba oluyimba lumu, naye tasuna buli luga mu ngeri y’emu. Bw’atyo omukulembeze “asaanidde okukwata ku mitima gy’abamuwuliriza ng’akozesa okuyigiriza okumu, naye si n’okubuulirira kumu okwa ngeri emu.” Mu bigambo ebyangu: tuyigiriza buli muntu amazima ge gamu, naye tugakozesa mu ngeri ya njawulo eri buli muntu. Gregory yawandiika olukalala oluwanvu olw’abantu ab’engeri ez’enjawulo abeetaaga okubuulirirwa okw’enjawulo. Lutandika bwe luti:

“Abasajja n’abakazi. Abaavu n’abagagga. Abasanyufu n’abanakuwavu. Abakulu n’abali wansi waabwe. Abaddu ne bakama baabwe. Abagezi ab’ensi eno n’abatategeera mangu. Abatalina nsonyi n’abakwatibwa ensonyi. Abeesimbu mu maaso n’abalimu okutya. Abatalina bugumiikiriza n’abagumiikiriza.”

— Gregory Omukulu, The Book of Pastoral Rule, Ekitundu III

Olukalala lugenda mu maaso okumala ennyiriri nnyingi. Gregory yannyonnyola nti “eddagala erikkakkanya obulwadde obumu lyongera obulala obukambwe”, kwe kugamba nti eddagala eriwonya obulwadde obumu liyinza okwongera obulwadde obulala obubi. Omusajja omugagga n’omusajja omwavu, omukazi ow’amalala n’omukazi omutiitiizi, beetaaga ebigambo bya njawulo.

Emyaka lukumi oluvannyuma, Richard Baxter, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 9, Mwekuume Mwekka, kino yakikola mu nkola mu kibuga Kidderminster mu Bungereza. Ekitabo kye Omusumba Omuzzeemu Obuggya, ekiri ku Ochorus, kizimbiddwa ku Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28, “Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna.” Baxter ebigambo “ekisibo kyonna” yabitwala nga bikulu nnyo:

“Kyetaagisa okumanya buli muntu ali mu buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe; kubanga tuyinza tutya okubakuuma nga tetubamanyi? Tuteekwa okufuba okumanya, si bantu bokka, naye n’embeera y’abantu baffe bonna.”

— Richard Baxter, Omusumba Omuzzeemu Obuggya

Mu bigambo ebyangu: tulina okumanya buli muntu ali mu kulabirira kwaffe, kubanga tetusobola kulabirira bantu be tutamanyi. Tulina okuyiga si mannya gaabwe gokka, naye n’embeera y’emyoyo gyabwe.

Baxter kino teyakiwandiika buwandiisi. Yakikola. Ekitundu kye eky’ekkanisa kyalimu amaka agasoba mu lunaana. N’olwekyo ye n’omuyambi we baawaangayo buli Bbalaza ne buli Lwakubiri, “okuva ku makya okutuusa kumpi ekiro”, ne basisinkana amaka kkumi na ttaano oba kkumi na mukaaga buli wiiki, amaka gamu gamu, okwogera nabo ku kukkiriza kwabwe. Mu ngeri eyo baasisinkana buli maka mu kitundu kyabwe buli mwaka. Baxter yawandiika nti yalaba ebibala bingi okuva mu nsisinkano zino ez’omuntu ku muntu “okusinga mu kubuulira kwange kwonna okw’olujjudde gye bali.” Mu myaka egyaddirira, ekibuga kyakyuka. Kigambibwa nti Baxter bwe yatuuka, ku nguudo ezimu waali tewali na maka gamu agaasinzizanga Katonda awaka. Bwe yagenda, waaliwo enguudo awaali tewali na maka gamu agataakikolanga.

Abasinga obungi ku ffe tetujja kukulembera maka lunaana. Naye ffenna tusobola okwebuuza ekibuuzo kya Baxter: abantu Katonda b’atadde mu kulabirira kwange mbamanyi?

Okumanyibwa n’okwagalibwa

Abantu bangi mu nsi yaffe bawulira nti tewali abamanyi. Mu bibuga ebinene, abantu babeera kumpi ne bannaabwe naye tewali amanyi linnya lyabwe. Mu byalo, abantu bayinza okuba nga bamanyiddwa, naye ebibaluma ennyo munda bikwekeddwa. Mu Kkanisa ya Yesu Kristo kisaanidde okuba eky’enjawulo. Buli muntu asaanidde okumanyibwa, n’okwagalibwa, omuntu afaayo ku mwoyo gwe.

Omusumba Omulungi amanyi endiga ze, era nazo zimumanyi. Ffe abasumba abali wansi we, tuyitiddwa okuba nga Ye. Si kufuga bibiina bya bantu, wabula okumanya abantu. Si kubala muwendo gwa bantu, wabula okulabirira emyoyo, kinnoomu, buli omu ng’ayitibwa erinnya lye.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Yokaana 4 ne Yokaana 3 ng’ogeraageranya. Yesu yakolagana atya mu ngeri ya njawulo ne Nikodemo n’omukazi Omusamaliya?
  • Soma 1 Abasessaloniika 5:14. Lowooza ku bantu b’okulembera. Ani yeetaaga okubuulirirwa n’okunenyezebwa? Ani yeetaaga okugumizibwa? Ani yeetaaga omuntu amuyamba n’abeera naye?
  • Wali owaddeko eddagala likyamu, ng’olabula omuntu eyali yeetaaga okubudaabudibwa, oba ng’obudaabuda omuntu eyali yeetaaga okulabulwa? Kiki ekyaddirira?
  • Abantu b’okulembera bameka b’oyinza okumanya amannya gaabwe? Maka ameka g’okyaliddeko omwaka guno?
  • Waliwo omuntu mu kkanisa yo atamanyiddwa bulungi mukulembeze yenna? Ekyo kiyinza kukyuka kitya?
  • Kiki ky’oyinza okuyigira ku nkola ya Baxter ey’okusisinkana amaka gamu gamu?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wandiika amannya g’abantu b’okulembera. Ku mabbali ga buli linnya, wandiika ekintu kimu ky’omanyi ku mbeera y’omwoyo gwabwe kati. Awo w’otosobola kuwandiikawo kintu kyonna, teekako akabonero ku linnya. Wiiki eno, kyalira oba kubira essimu waakiri abantu basatu ku abo b’otaddeko akabonero. Bambuuze nti, “Otambula otya ne Katonda?” ne “Nkusabire ku ki?” Wuliriza n’obwegendereza, musabire wamu, era owandiike by’oyize.

study_questions.question: Lwaki omukulembeze asaanidde okumanya abantu kinnoomu?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga eyo ye ngeri Yesu gy’alundamu: “Nze ndi musumba mulungi, n’endiga zange nzimanyi era nazo zimmanyi” (Yokaana 10:14). “Aziyita amannya gaazo” (Yokaana 10:3). “Okakasanga nti omanyi bulungi embeera z’ekisibo kyo” (Engero 27:23).

study_questions.question: Abantu ab’enjawulo beetaaga okulabirirwa okw’enjawulo?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Ennafu zeetaaga okuzzibwamu amaanyi, endwadde okujjanjabibwa, ezirumiziddwa okusibibwa ebiwundu, n’ezaabula okunoonyezebwa (Ezeekyeri 34:4, 16). Gregory Omukulu yayigiriza nti omusumba alina okwogera mu ngeri ya njawulo eri abantu ab’enjawulo, era Richard Baxter yakyalira buli maka mu kitundu kye eky’ekkanisa.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okumanya ekibiina ekinene eky’abakkiriza?
study_questions.answer: Ng’akyalira amaka, ng’akuuma olukalala lw’amannya era ng’alusabira, ng’agabana obukulembeze n’abalala nga buli omu amanyi bulungi abantu batono, era ng’atunuulira abo abagenda baseeseetuka nga tewali abalaba mu kibiina ky’abantu.

fields.title: Okunoonya Abaabula
fields.body_html:
“Omwana w’Omuntu, yajjirira kunoonya n’okulokola abaabula.”

— Lukka 19:10

Omwana bw’abula mu kyalo, buli kimu kiyimirira. Akatale kaggalwa. Ennimiro zirekebwa. Baliraanwa badduka mu buli kitundu nga bayita erinnya ly’omwana. Tewali agamba nti, “Abaana abalala tukyabalina, n’olwekyo si nsonga.” Tewali addayo waka kwebaka okutuusa ng’omwana azuuliddwa.

Bw’atyo Katonda bw’awulira ku bantu abaabula. Era omukulembeze ng’omutima gwe bwe gwagala ajja kuwulira bw’atyo.

Mu ssuula ebbiri eziwedde twalowooza ku kuliisa ekisibo n’okumanya endiga. Naye omulimu gw’omusumba teguli mu kiraalo kyokka. Yesu yagamba nti, “Nnina n’endiga endala ezitali za mu kisibo kino, nazo kiŋŋwanidde okuzireeta” (Yokaana 10:16). Essuula eno ekwata ku kunoonya abaabula.

Omutima gwa Katonda anoonya

Lukka 15 erimu engero ssatu Yesu ze yagera abakulembeze b’eddiini bwe beemulugunya nti yaaniriza aboonoonyi n’alya nabo. Omusumba abuza endiga emu ku kikumi. Omukazi abuza ensimbi emu ku kkumi. Kitaawe w’abaana abuza omwana omu ku babiri.

Mu buli lugero, ekintu eky’omuwendo kibula. Mu buli lugero, waliwo okunoonya, oba okulinda okuwanvu. Era mu buli lugero, waliwo embaga ng’ekyabula kizuuliddwa. Yesu yayogera ku musumba nti, “Bw’agiraba, agisitula ku bibegabega bye n’agitwala eka ng’ajaguza” (Lukka 15:5). Awo n’annyonnyola nti: “mu ggulu eribaayo essanyu lingi nnyo olw’omwonoonyi omu eyeenenyezza okusinga ekyenda mu omwenda abatuukirivu abateetaaga kwenenya” (Lukka 15:7).

Weetegereze abaali bawuliriza. Engero zino zaagerwa eri abakulembeze b’eddiini abataafangayo ku baabula. Mukulu w’omwana mu lugero olwokusatu kifaananyi kyabwe. Yanyiiga nti kitaawe yaaniriza muto we ng’akomawo eka. Yali asigadde kumpi n’ennyumba, naye omutima gwe gwali wala n’omutima gwa kitaawe.

Kino kulabula eri buli mukulembeze. Kisoboka okukola ennyo mu kkanisa okumala emyaka, okuba omwesigwa mu nkuŋŋaana ne mu kusinza, naye n’otogabana ku ssanyu lya Kitaffe olw’omwonoonyi omu akomawo eka. Obulokozi bw’abaabula bwe butatukwatako, tetunnategeera mutima gwa Katonda.

Yesu yajja okunoonya

Yesu yafunza omulimu gwe gwonna bwe yayogera ne Zaakayo: “Omwana w’Omuntu, yajjirira kunoonya n’okulokola abaabula” (Lukka 19:10). Teyalinda baabula kujja gy’ali. Ye yagenda gye bali. Yagenda mu nnyumba y’omusolooza w’omusolo. Yayogera n’omukazi Omusamaliya ku luzzi. Yakwata ku bagenge. Yasomoka ennyanja okugenda eri omusajja eyaliko dayimooni. Abalabe be baamuyita “mukwano gw’abasolooza b’omusolo n’aboonoonyi” (Lukka 7:34), nga bagenderera kumuvuma. Yesu ekyo yakitwala ng’akabonero k’okwagala.

Bwe yayita abayigirizwa be abaasooka, yagamba nti, “Mujje mungoberere, nange ndibafuula abavubi b’abantu” (Matayo 4:19). Okugoberera Yesu n’okuvuba abantu bitambulira wamu. Tosobola ddala kumugoberera nga togenda gy’agenda, era Ye agenda anoonya abaabula.

Kola omulimu gw’omubuulizi w’enjiri

Pawulo yawandiikira Timoseewo, eyali omusumba era omuyigiriza mu Efeso, nti: “ng’okola omulimu ogw’omubuulizi w’enjiri, ng’otuukiririza ddala obuweereza bwo” (2 Timoseewo 4:5). Abantu abamu balina ekirabo eky’enjawulo eky’okubuulira enjiri. Naye buli mukulembeze ayitiddwa okukola omulimu ogwo, k’abe ng’alina ekirabo ekyo oba nga talina.

Abasumba bangi bamala ebiseera byabwe byonna n’abakkiriza. Wiiki yaabwe ejjula enkuŋŋaana, okubuulira, okukyalira abantu n’ebizibu eby’omu kkanisa. Emyaka giyitawo nga tebalina na mboozi emu ey’amazima gye bayogeddeko n’omuntu atamanyi Kristo. Ekyo bwe kibaawo, emirundi mingi ekkanisa nayo egoberera. Ekkanisa efaanana abakulembeze baayo. Abakulembeze bwe batanoonya baabula, n’abantu nabo tebajja kunoonya.

Pawulo yabuuza ebibuuzo bino: “Kale balikoowoola batya oyo gwe batakkiririzaamu? Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira?” (Abaruumi 10:14). Waliwo alina okubabuulira. Enteekateeka ya Katonda kwe kutuuka ku bantu ng’ayita mu bantu.

Engeri abakulembeze gye banoonyaamu abaabula

Saba ku lw’abaabula ng’oyogera amannya gaabwe. Kuuma olukalala lw’abantu b’omanyi abatagoberera Kristo: baliraanwa, ab’eŋŋanda, b’okola nabo, abantu b’osisinkana mu katale. Basabirenga emirundi mingi. Mu Ssuula 12, Okusaba Okusooka, twalaba nti okusaba gwe mulimu ogusooka. Ekyo kituufu mu kubuulira enjiri nga bwe kiri mu buli kintu ekirala.

Zimba omukwano ogw’amazima. Yesu yalyanga n’aboonoonyi. Teyabeesamba. Abantu bangi bajja mu kukkiriza nga bayita mu mukwano gwabwe gwe beesiga. Beera mukwano wa mazima, so si omuntu alaga ekisa olw’okwagala okufuna omukyufu yekka.

Yogera ku Kristo mu ngeri etegeerekeka. Omukwano gwokka tegumala. Ekiseera kituuka abaabula ne balina okuwulira amawulire amalungi: nti Katonda ye yatutonda, nti twayonoona ne tumukyawa, nti Yesu yafiirira ebibi byaffe n’azuukira, era nti bonna abakyuka okuva mu kibi ne bamwesiga basonyiyibwa era bafuulibwa baggya. Yiga okukinnyonnyola mu ngeri ennyangu, mu ddakiika ntono, mu lulimi lw’abantu b’oyogera nabo.

Beeranga mwetegefu okuddamu. Peetero yawandiika nti, “bulijjo mubenga beetegefu okuddamu buli ababuuza okunnyonnyola essuubi lyammwe” (1 Peetero 3:15). Abantu balina ebibuuzo eby’amazima. Bawulirize n’ekitiibwa, era obaddemu mu bwesimbu. Bw’oba tomanyi kya kuddamu, kyogere, era onoonyereze.

Fuuka byonna eri abantu bonna. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Eri abantu bonna nfuuse byonna, mu ngeri yonna ndyoke mbeeko beentusa ku kulokolebwa” (1 Abakkolinso 9:22). Teyakyusa bubaka, naye yakyusa engeri ye ey’okweyisaamu obubaka busobole okuwulirwa. Omukulembeze anoonya abaabula ajja kuyiga empisa, ebibuuzo n’ebyo abantu abamwetoolodde bye batya.

Twala abalala naawe. Yesu yatuma abayigirizwa be babiri babiri. Bw’ogenda okubuulira enjiri, twala omukkiriza omuto naawe. Ajja kuyiga bingi ng’akulaba okusinga mu kibiina kyonna eky’okusomesebwa.

Ggulawo enzigi z’ekkanisa. Kakasa nti omugenyi bw’ajja, ayanirizibwa, so si kumwekaliriza maaso. Kakasa nti enjiri ennyonnyolwa bulungi mu nkuŋŋaana zammwe, omugenyi asobole okutegeera engeri y’okulokolebwamu.

Okutya okutusirisa

Lwaki abakulembeze bangi kino kibazibuwalira? Emirundi mingi kiva mu kutya: okutya okugaanibwa, okutya okulabika ng’omusirusiru, okutya obutamanya kya kwogera, era mu bifo ebimu, okutya obulabe obw’amazima. Tujja kulowooza ku bulabe n’okuyigganyizibwa mu Ssuula 40, Okuyigganyizibwa n’Omuwendo Ogusasulwa.

Pawulo yennyini yali amanyi okutya kuno. Yasaba Abaefeso bamusabire “mpeebwe eby’okwogera, era mbyogerenga n’obuvumu nga ntegeeza abantu ekyama ky’Enjiri” (Abaefeso 6:19). Omutume omukulu bwe yali yeetaaga okusabirwa afune obuvumu, naffe tukyetaaga. Jjukira Essuula 11, Obuvumu. Obuvumu si bwe butabaamu kutya. Kwe kugondera Katonda ng’otya.

Jjukira nate nti ebivaamu tebiri mu mikono gyaffe. Ffe tusiga era tufukirira, naye Katonda ye akuza (1 Abakkolinso 3:6). Ekitundu kyaffe kwe kuba abeesigwa mu kubuulira. Ekitundu kye kwe kuggula emitima.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: David Brainerd, Samson Occom ne Charles Spurgeon

David Brainerd yali muminsani omuvubuka Omumerika mu myaka gya 1740 eyakolanga mu bantu enzaaliranwa ab’e New York, Pennsylvania ne New Jersey. Yalwalanga nnyo akafuba, yabanga mu kiwuubaalo emirundi mingi, era okumala ekiseera ekiwanvu kumpi teyalaba bibala. Naye teyalekera awo kusabira bantu be yeegomba okutuukako. Ebiwandiiko bye eby’obulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku, ebiri ku Ochorus, biraga omutima ogwaka omuliro olw’abaabula. Yawandiika nti:

“Saafaayo gye nnali mbeera oba engeri gye nnali mbeeramu, oba obuzibu ki bwe nnayitamu, kasita nsobola okuleeta emmeeme eri Kristo.”

— David Brainerd, Obulamu n’Ekitabo ky’Ennaku ekya David Brainerd

Mu kiro ekirala yawandiika nti yali amaze okumegganira mu kusaba era nti “nayagala okumalawo obulamu bwange mu buweereza bwe, n’olw’ekitiibwa kye.” Mu kyeya kya 1745 yatuuka ku kabuga akatono ak’abantu ba Delaware mu kifo ekiyitibwa Crossweeksung, mu New Jersey. Mu wiiki ntono, Katonda n’atandika okukola. Abantu bangi bajja mu kukkiriza, ne bakaaba olw’ekibi kyabwe, ne bafuna emirembe mu Kristo. Brainerd yafa oluvannyuma lw’emyaka ebiri, ng’alina emyaka abiri mu mwenda gyokka. Naye okuva olwo ebiwandiiko bye bisindise abantu bangi mu mulimu gw’obuminsani.

Brainerd yali munnaggwanga eri abantu be yaweerezanga. Samson Occom yali omu ku bo. Occom yazaalibwa mu 1723 mu bantu ba Mohegan ab’e Connecticut. Bwe yali akyali muvubuka, yajja mu kukkiriza mu kuzuukuka okunene okwayita mu New England. Yayiga okusoma, n’asoma, n’afuuka omuweereza w’ekkanisa. Obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo yabuulira abantu enzaaliranwa mu New England yonna ne New York, emirundi mingi mu bwavu obw’amaanyi, era emirundi mingi nga abakulembeze b’ekkanisa abazungu tebamuwa kitiibwa. Mu bukadde bwe yayamba amaka g’Abakristaayo okuva mu mawanga ag’enzaaliranwa agawerako okutandikawo ekibuga ekiggya ekiyitibwa Brothertown, gye baali basobola okusinziza Katonda awamu. Occom atulaga nti omuntu asinga okusobola okutuuka ku ggwanga emirundi mingi aba omu ku bo. Omukulembeze anoonya abaabula ajja kukuza n’abanoonya abalala okuva mu abo abazuuliddwa.

E London, ekyasa ekimu oluvannyuma, Charles Spurgeon yayita omulimu gw’okuwangula emyoyo “omulimu omukulu ogw’omuweereza Omukristaayo” era “omulimu ogwo ogusinga obulungi ng’ogwa kabaka”. Emboozi ze ku nsonga eno zaakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu The Soul Winner (Omuwanguzi w’Emyoyo), ekiri ku Ochorus. Era yalabula abayizi be nti kyandibasaasaanyizza:

“Omuntu owa bulijjo ayinza okuwummulira ku kitanda kye ekiro kyonna, naye omusawo alongoosa ayitibwa essaawa yonna; omulimi ayinza okwewummulirako ku muliro gwe, naye bw’afuuka omusumba ateekwa okuba ebweru mu baana b’endiga, n’agumira embeera y’obudde yonna ku lwazo.”

— Charles Spurgeon, The Soul Winner

Mu bigambo ebyangu: abantu abalala basobola okuwummula, naye omusawo ayitibwa essaawa yonna ey’ekiro, era omusumba ateekwa okufuluma mu buli kika ky’obudde okulabirira abaana b’endiga. Abo abanoonya abaabula bajja kuyitibwa mu biseera ne mu ngeri ezibasaasaanyiza.

Okusanyukira awamu n’eggulu

Engero zigamba nti, “oyo asikiriza emyoyo gy’abantu ne balokoka wa magezi” (Engero 11:30). Tewali ssanyu lisinga mu bulamu bw’omukulembeze ng’okulaba omuntu ng’ajja eri Kristo. Pawulo abakkiriza be yaleeta mu kukkiriza yabayita “ssanyu lyange era … ngule yange” (Abafiripi 4:1).

Eggulu likola embaga omwonoonyi omu bwe yeenenya. Toganya bukulembeze bwo kukwatibwa nnyo ebyenda mu omwenda n’otogenda na lumu kunoonya omu. Saba ku lw’abaabula. Genda gye bali. Bategeeze ku Yesu. Era omu bw’akomawo eka, weegatte ku mbaga.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Lukka 15. Mu ngero zino, ani gw’osinga okufaanana: omusumba anoonya, omukazi anoonya, kitaawe w’abaana alinda, oba mukulu w’omwana?
  • Ddi lw’osembyeyo okwogera mu bwesimbu ku Yesu n’omuntu atamumanyi?
  • Abantu b’okulembera bakulaba ng’onoonya abaabula? Kiki ky’obayigiriza ng’oyita mu kyakulabirako kyo?
  • Oyinza okunnyonnyola amawulire amalungi aga Yesu mu ngeri etegeerekeka mu ddakiika ssatu, mu lulimi lw’abantu abakwetoolodde? Gezaako.
  • Kutya ki okusinga okukusirisa? Obuvumu bwandirabise butya gy’oli wiiki eno?
  • Samson Occom yatuuka ku bantu b’ewaabwe. Ani gw’oyinza okuzzaamu amaanyi n’okutendeka okutuuka ku bantu b’omu kitundu kye?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wandiika amannya g’abantu bataano b’omanyi abatagoberera Kristo. Buli omu ku bo musabire ng’oyogera erinnya lye buli lunaku wiiki eno. Oluvannyuma londako omu ku bo omale naye ebiseera: mulye wamu ekijjulo, kyalira amaka ge oba muyambe mu kintu. Noonya akaseera akatuufu okumubuulira Yesu ky’ali gy’oli. Bw’oba osobola, twala omukkiriza omuto naawe, era oluvannyuma mwogere wamu ku bye muyize.

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze b’ekkanisa basaanidde okunoonya abaabula?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga eyo ye nsonga lwaki Yesu yajja: “Omwana w’Omuntu, yajjirira kunoonya n’okulokola abaabula” (Lukka 19:10). Yagamba nti, “Nnina n’endiga endala ezitali za mu kisibo kino, nazo kiŋŋwanidde okuzireeta” (Yokaana 10:16).

study_questions.question: Eggulu liwulira litya omuntu omu bwe yeenenya?
study_questions.answer: Yesu yagamba nti “mu ggulu eribaayo essanyu lingi nnyo olw’omwonoonyi omu eyeenenyezza okusinga ekyenda mu omwenda abatuukirivu abateetaaga kwenenya” (Lukka 15:7). Omusumba azudde endiga ye eyabula agisitula ku bibegabega bye n’agitwala eka ng’ajaguza.

study_questions.question: N’abasumba bayitiddwa okubuulira enjiri?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Pawulo yagamba omusumba Timoseewo nti: “ng’okola omulimu ogw’omubuulizi w’enjiri, ng’otuukiririza ddala obuweereza bwo” (2 Timoseewo 4:5). Essuula eyogera ku David Brainerd, Samson Occom ne Charles Spurgeon, ne ku ngeri abakulembeze gye bayinza okuwangula okutya okubasirisa.

fields.title: Okunenya n’Okuzzaawo
fields.body_html:
“Abooluganda omuntu bw’abanga alina ekibi ky’akoze, mmwe ab’omwoyo mumuluŋŋamyenga mu buwombeefu nga mwegendereza si kulwa nga nammwe mugwa mu kukemebwa.”

— Abaggalatiya 6:1

Eggumba bwe limenyeka, omusawo omulungi talibuusa maaso ng’asuubira nti lijja kuwona lyokka. Bwe lirekebwa awo, liyinza okuwona nga likyamye, omuntu n’awenyera obulamu bwe bwonna. Naye era omusawo takuba kugulu okumenyese n’omuggo. Omusawo addiza eggumba mu kifo kyalyo n’obwegendereza, alisiba n’amaanyi, oluvannyuma n’alirekera ebiseera liwone. Okuddiza eggumba mu kifo kyalyo kuluma. Naye kukolebwa olw’okuwonya.

Ekigambo Pawulo kye yakozesa mu Abaggalatiya 6:1, ekivvuunulwa wano nti “mumuluŋŋamyenga”, kyakozesebwanga ku kuddaabiriza obutimba bw’okuvuba ne ku kuddiza amagumba agamenyese mu bifo byago. Ekyo kye kifaananyi ky’okunenya mu Kkanisa. Si kubonereza lwa kubonereza. Gwe mulimu ogw’obwegendereza, ogulimu obulumi, era ogw’okwagala, ogw’okuzzaayo ekyamenyese mu kifo kyakyo ekituufu.

Kino kye kimu ku bitundu by’obukulembeze ebisinga obuzibu. Abakulembeze bangi bakyewala ddala. Abalala bakikola n’obukambwe. Essuula eno ekwata ku kukikola nga Yesu bwe yandikikoze.

Okunenya kwagala

Abantu abamu balowooza nti okwagala kitegeeza obutayogera kigambo kizibu na lumu. Naye Bayibuli egamba ekikontana n’ekyo. “Okukangavvulwa kwonna mu biro ebya kaakano tekufaanana nga kwa ssanyu, kuba kwa bulumi, naye oluvannyuma kuleeta ebibala eby’emirembe eri abo abayigirizibwa, era ekivaamu bwe butuukirivu” (Abaebbulaniya 12:11). Katonda akangavvula abaana be kubanga abaagala. Taata atanenya baana be na lumu tabaagala nnyo okusingawo. Abaagala kitono.

Engero zigamba nti, “Okunywegera kw’omulabe kwandiba okungi, naye ebiwundu by’okunenya kw’owoomukwano tebitiisa” (Engero 27:6). Omulabe ajja kukuwaanawaana ng’otambula ng’odda ku kagwa. Mukwano gwo ow’amazima ajja kukubuulira amazima, ne bwe gaba nga galuma.

Yesu yagamba nti, “Muganda wo bw’ayonoonanga, omunenyanga; era singa yeenenya omusonyiwanga” (Lukka 17:3). Ebitundu byombi bikulu. Okulabula awatali kusonyiwa bukambwe. Okusonyiwa awatali kulabula bulagajjavu. Mu Ssuula 10, Okwagala: Ekikukubiriza n’Akabonero, twalaba nti okwagala okw’amazima kunoonya ebirungi by’omuntu omulala. Oluusi ebirungi ebyo kye kigambo ekikakali.

Omukulembeze atanenya muntu yenna talaga kisa. Emirundi mingi aba atya: atya enkaayana, atya okufiirwa abantu, atya obutaagalibwa. Naye ekibi bwe kirekebwa awo tekisigala kitono. Kibuna, ng’ekivundu mu kibbo ky’ebibala. Era omuntu ayonoona alekebwa ne yeeyongera okugenda mu kabi, ng’abakulembeze be basirise.

Eddaala erisooka: mu kyama

Yesu yawa amadaala agategeerekeka ag’okukolagana n’ekibi mu bakkiriza: “Muganda wo bw’akusobyanga ogendanga gy’ali n’omutegeeza ekisobyo kye nga muli babiri. Bw’akkirizanga n’akwetondera olwo ng’oggyeemu omuntu mu muganda wo” (Matayo 18:15).

Weetegereze ebintu bisatu. Ekisooka, genda. Tolinda ye okujja gy’oli. Eky’okubiri, genda mu kyama, “nga muli babiri”. Totandika na kubuulira balala, era tokirangirira mu lwatu. Eky’okusatu, weetegereze ekigendererwa: “olwo ng’oggyeemu omuntu mu muganda wo.” Ekigendererwa si kuwangula nkaayana wabula okuwangula omuntu.

Mu mpisa nnyingi kizibu nnyo okwogera n’omuntu butereevu ku kizibu. Abantu basinga kwagala kuweereza bubaka nga bayita mu muntu omulala, oba okwogera ku kizibu eri buli muntu okuggyako oyo gwe kikwatako. Naye eyo si ye ngeri ya Yesu. Olugambo luzikiriza. Okwogera n’omuntu mu kasirise era mu bwesimbu lye ddaala erisooka ery’okwagala. Mu mpisa ezimu, omutabaganya assibwamu ekitiibwa ayinza okuba ow’amagezi, naddala nga waliwo enjawulo nnene mu myaka oba mu kifo. Naye ne mu mbeera eyo, ekigendererwa kwe kwogera n’omuntu mu bwesimbu ne mu buwombeefu, so si kumwogerako mu mabega ge.

Emboozi ey’omu kyama bw’egaana yokka, lwe tukwata amadaala agaddako: “ofunangayo omuntu omulala omu oba babiri”, era oluvannyuma, bwe kiba kyetaagisa, “ensonga ozitwala eri Ekkanisa” (Matayo 18:16-17). Buli ddaala ligenda mpola era lya maanyi okusinga eryasooka. Buli ddaala liwa omuntu omukisa omulala okuwuliriza.

Engeri y’okunenyaamu

Pawulo tatubuulira kyokka nti tusaanidde okunenya, wabula n’engeri y’okukikolamu.

Mu buwombeefu. “Mmwe ab’omwoyo mumuluŋŋamyenga mu buwombeefu” (Abaggalatiya 6:1). Obusungu, okusekerera n’okuswaza tebitera kuyamba. Obuwombeefu tebutegeeza bunafu. Butegeeza amaanyi agafugibwa.

Ng’olaba bw’oli. “Nga mwegendereza si kulwa nga nammwe mugwa mu kukemebwa” (Abaggalatiya 6:1). Nga tonnanenya muntu mulala, kebera omutima gwo. Yesu yalabula ku kugezaako okuggya akasasiro ku liiso ly’omuntu omulala nga ku liryo kuliko ekisiki (Matayo 7:3-5). Jjukira nti naawe oyinza okukola ekibi kye kimu.

Mu bugumiikiriza. “Omuddu wa Mukama tasaana kulwana, wabula okuba omukkakkamu eri bonna, n’okuba omuyigiriza omulungi agumiikiriza, era aluŋŋamya n’obwetoowaze abo abamuwakanya, oboolyawo Katonda alibawa okwenenya” (2 Timoseewo 2:24-25). Weetegereze aleeta okwenenya: Katonda. Omulimu gwaffe kwe kwogera amazima n’ekisa. Omulimu gwe kwe kukyusa omutima.

N’ekitiibwa. “Tokambuwaliranga musajja mukulu, wabula omubuuliriranga nga kitaawo. Abavubuka bayisenga nga baganda bo, abakazi abakadde bayisenga ng’abazadde bo, abato nga bannyoko, ng’omutima gwo mulongoofu ddala” (1 Timoseewo 5:1-2). Okunenya kusaanidde okutuukana n’omuntu: emyaka gye, enkolagana gy’alina naawe, n’ekitiibwa kye.

Ng’omuyamba okwetikka omugugu gwe. Pawulo agenda mu maaso nti, “Muyambaganenga, bwe mutyo bwe munaatuukirizanga etteeka lya Kristo” (Abaggalatiya 6:2). Tetunenya muntu ne tulyoka tumuvaako. Tusigala ku lusegere lwe ne tumuyamba okwetikka obuzito bw’okukyuka.

Obuvumu okwogera

Kabaka Dawudi bwe yayenda ku Basuseba n’ateekateeka bba attibwe, Katonda yamutumira nnabbi Nasani. Nasani yanyumiza Dawudi olugero lw’omusajja omugagga eyabba akaliga akamu kokka ak’omusajja omwavu. Dawudi yasunguwalira nnyo omusajja omugagga. Awo Nasani n’agamba nti, “Omusajja oyo ye ggwe” (2 Samwiri 12:7).

Nasani yali ayogera ne kabaka eyali yaakamala okutta omuntu okukweka ekibi kye. Yandifiiriddwa obulamu bwe. Naye yayogera, n’amagezi era n’obuvumu. Dawudi ne yeenenya. Zabbuli 51, emu ku ssaala ez’okwenenya ezisinga obukulu ezaali ziwandiikiddwa, yava mu mboozi eyo.

Weetegereze nti Nasani yali wa magezi era nga muvumu. Teyakaayukira Dawudi mu maaso g’abakungu. Yanyumya olugero olwayamba Dawudi okulaba ekibi kye nga tannaba kwogerwako. Okunenya okulungi emirundi mingi kuyamba abantu okwerabira bokka amazima.

Abakulembeze era beetaaga obuvumu okunenya abakulembeze abalala, nga mw’otwalidde n’abo ababasinga. Pawulo omulundi gumu yanenya Peetero mu lwatu, kubanga empisa za Peetero zaali zikyamya abalala (Abaggalatiya 2:11-14). Ku kukolagana n’ebivunaanibwa abakulembeze, Pawulo yawa amateeka ag’obwegendereza: “Tokkirizanga ebyo bye bavunaana omukulembeze okuggyako nga biriko abajulirwa babiri oba basatu” (1 Timoseewo 5:19). Abakulembeze balina okukuumibwa okuva ku bivunaanibwa eby’obulimba. Naye abakulembeze abeeyongera okwonoona tebalina kukuumibwa kuva ku mazima. Mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu, tujja kulaba nti awali okutulugunya, naddala okw’abaana, Ekkanisa tesaanidde kukibikkirira n’akatono.

Ekigendererwa: okuzzaawo

Mu kkanisa y’e Kkolinso, omusajja yali akoze ekibi eky’amaanyi, ekkanisa n’emukangavvula. Omusajja oyo ne yeenenya. Naye abamu mu kkanisa baali bakyagala okumwesuula ewala. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Omuntu ng’oyo ekibonerezo ekyamuweebwa abangi kimumala; kyekiva kisaana mmwe okumusonyiwa n’okumuzzaamu amaanyi si kulwa ng’ennaku emuyitirirako n’emuyinga obungi. Noolwekyo mbakuutira okwongera okumukakasa nti mumwagala” (2 Abakkolinso 2:6-8).

Kino kigambo ekkanisa nnyingi kye zeetaaga. Ekkanisa ezimu zirwawo okunenya, naye bwe zimala okukikola, tezisonyiwa n’akatono. Omuntu eyeenenyezza ayisibwa ng’Omukristaayo ow’eddaala ery’okubiri obulamu bwe bwonna. Ekyo si ye njiri. Omuntu bwe yeenenya ddala, ekkanisa erina okumusonyiwa, okumugumya n’okumulaga okwagala mu lwatu.

Yakobo yawandiika nti, “Abooluganda, singa omu ku mmwe akyama n’ava ku mazima, ne wabaawo amukomyawo, omuntu oyo akomyawo munne eri Katonda, aba awonyezza omwoyo gwa munne okufa era ng’amuleetedde n’okusonyiyibwa ebibi byonna” (Yakobo 5:19-20). Okuzzaawo omuntu si kintu kitono. Kwe kuwonya obulamu.

Okuzzibwa mu kussa ekimu si bulijjo nti kwe kuzzibwa mu bukulembeze. Omukulembeze eyagudde ennyo ayinza okusonyiyibwa ddala n’ayanirizibwa, naye ne yeetaaga ekiseera kiwanvu nga tannaddamu kukulembera, oba n’atakiddamu n’akatono. Kino tujja kukyongera okukitunuulira mu Ssuula 39, Okugwa n’Okuzzibwawo.

Okukkiriza okunenyezebwa

Abakulembeze nabo balina okuyiga okunenyezebwa. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yasaba nti, “Leka omuntu omutuukirivu ankube, kubanga anaaba ankwatiddwa ekisa; muleke annenye, ekyo kinaaba ng’amafuta amalungi agafukiddwa ku mutwe gwange; sijja kugagaana” (Zabbuli 141:5).

Abakulembeze bangi kino kibazibuwalira nnyo. Bamanyidde kunenya balala, so si kunenyezebwa. Bayinza okwekuuma ennyo oba okunyiiga, oba okunoonya engeri y’okuggyawo omuntu eyagumiza okwogera. Naye omukulembeze atasobola kunenyezebwa ali mu kabi kanene. “Oyo akweka ebibi bye, talifuna mukisa kukulaakulana, naye buli abyatula n’abireka, alisaasirwa” (Engero 28:13). Weebaze Katonda olw’omuntu yenna akwagala ekimala okukubuulira amazima.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Gregory Omukulu n’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba

Gregory Omukulu, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 2, Ekifuula Obukulembeze Okuba obw’Omwoyo, yawandiika mu The Book of Pastoral Rule (Ekitabo ky’Obulagirizi bw’Abasumba) ku kutebenkeza ekisa n’obukakali. Yakozesa olugero lw’Omusamaliya Omulungi, eyayiwa wayini n’amafuta byombi ku biwundu by’omusajja eyali alumiziddwa (Lukka 10:34). Mu biseera bya Gregory, wayini yakozesebwanga okulongoosa ekiwundu, n’amafuta okukikkakkanya.

“Kubanga buli alabirira okuwonya ebiwundu ateekwa okuwa mu wayini okubalagala kw’obulumi, ne mu mafuta obugonvu bw’ekisa eky’okwagala, wayini alyoke anaazeemu ekivunda, n’amafuta gakkakkanye ekiyinza okuwona. N’olwekyo obuwombeefu bulina okutabulwamu obukakali.”

— Gregory Omukulu, The Book of Pastoral Rule, Ekitundu II

Mu bigambo ebyangu: buli ajjanjaba ebiwundu ateekwa okukozesa byombi, wayini, ayokya, n’amafuta, agakkakkanya. Wayini anaazaamu ekyavunda. Amafuta gayamba ekiyinza okuwona. Bw’atyo omukulembeze ateekwa okutabula obuwombeefu n’obukakali. Gregory yeeyongera n’agamba nti abantu tebasaanidde kulumizibwa olw’obukambwe obuyitiridde, wadde okufuulibwa abalagajjavu olw’obugonvu obuyitiridde.

Mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri, Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba, okwatandikira mu Rwanda ne Uganda mu myaka gya 1930, kwamanyibwa olw’enkola gye kwayita “okutambulira mu musana”. Ekigambo kino kiva mu 1 Yokaana 1:7: “Naye bwe tutambulira mu musana nga ye bw’ali omusana, olwo tussakimu buli muntu ne munne, n’omusaayi gwa Yesu Omwana we, gutunaazaako buli kibi kyonna.” Ekitabo Tukutendereza ku Ochorus kinnyonnyola nti abakkiriza b’Okuzuukuka “baabitegeeza ng’empisa ey’okukolera ddala, so si ng’embeera y’omutima: obwesimbu obw’olwatu mu maaso ga Katonda ne mu maaso ga bannaabwe, buli kiseera, nga bali wamu.”

Abakkiriza baakuŋŋaananga bulijjo mu nkuŋŋaana entono ez’okussa ekimu. Eyo gye baayatuliranga ebibi byabwe mu lwatu buli omu eri munne, era mu kwagala baalaganga buli omu ekibi kye baalaba mu munne. Era baagendanga eri abantu be baali basobezza ne batereeza ensonga. Okunenya tekwali kintu abakulembeze kye baakolanga ku bantu abalala. Buli muntu, n’abakulembeze nga mw’otwalidde, yabeeranga mu lwatu. Nga Tukutendereza bw’egamba, “Tewayatulanga buyatuzi nti oli mwonoonyi; wayatulanga kye wakola.” Era oluyimba lwabwe olukulu olw’Okuzuukuka, “Tukutendereza Yesu”, lwatenderezanga omusaayi gwa Yesu ogunaaza. Okunenya bulijjo kwazzangayo abantu ku musalaba.

Okuzuukuka kwalina ebizibu byakwo, era oluusi enkuŋŋaana zaakwo ez’okussa ekimu zaafuukanga za bukambwe. Naye mu biseera byakwo ebisinga obulungi kwalaga nti okunenya kusinga kuba kwa mirembe awo buli muntu, nga mw’otwalidde n’omukulembeze, w’atambulira mu musana.

Okuddiza eggumba mu kifo kyalyo

Ddayo ku kifaananyi ky’eggumba eryamenyeka. Omusawo ayagala omulwadde we ajja kuliddiza mu kifo kyalyo, wadde nga kuluma. Omusawo atafaayo ajja kulibuusa maaso, oba alikwate mu ngeri ey’obukambwe. Yesu ye Musawo Omukulu. Teyabuusa maaso kibi na lumu, era teyabetenta mwonoonyi na lumu. Yagamba omukazi eyakwatibwa ng’ayenda nti, “Nange sikusalira musango kukusinga. Genda, naye toddangayo okwonoona” (Yokaana 8:11).

Saba Katonda akuwe omutima gwe: ogw’amazima ekimala okwogera, ogw’obuwombeefu ekimala okuwonya, era ogw’obugumiikiriza ekimala okusigala n’omuntu okutuusa lw’aba nga awonye ddala.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Otera okwewala emboozi enzibu, oba okuzikola n’obukambwe? Lwaki?
  • Soma Matayo 18:15-17. Mu mpisa z’ewammwe, kiki ekizibuwaza okugenda eri omuntu mu kyama? Oyinza otya okugoberera amadaala ga Yesu n’amagezi?
  • Soma Abaggalatiya 6:1-2. Okukola “mu buwombeefu” kulabika kutya mu bikolwa?
  • Waliwo omuntu mu kkanisa yo eyeenenya ekibi naye n’atayanirizibwa ddala nate? 2 Abakkolinso 2:6-8 kyandikusabye kiki?
  • Okola otya omuntu bw’akunenya? Ani alina olukusa okukubuulira amazima?
  • Kiki ky’oyinza okuyigira ku nkola y’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba ey’okutambulira mu musana?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Lowooza ku muntu omu gw’obadde weewala okwogera naye emboozi enzibu. Mala ebiseera mu kusaba, ng’osooka kwekebera omutima gwo (Abaggalatiya 6:1). Oluvannyuma genda gy’ali mu kyama, wiiki eno bw’oba osobola. Yogera mu buwombeefu ne mu bwesimbu, wuliriza n’obwegendereza, era ogenderere okumuwangula, so si kuwangula nkaayana. Oluvannyuma saba mukwano gwo omu gwe weesiga okuba omuntu anaakubuuliranga amazima agakwata ku ggwe, era omwebaze bw’anaakikolanga.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze asaanidde kunenya atya omuntu ayonoonye?
