study_questions.answer: Mu buwombeefu, ng’agenderera okumuzzaawo. “Mmwe ab’omwoyo mumuluŋŋamyenga mu buwombeefu” (Abaggalatiya 6:1). Yesu yagamba okusooka okugenda mu kyama: “ogendanga gy’ali n’omutegeeza ekisobyo kye nga muli babiri” (Matayo 18:15).

study_questions.question: Okunenya omuntu kwagala?
study_questions.answer: Yee, bwe kukolebwa mu kwagala. “Ebiwundu by’okunenya kw’owoomukwano tebitiisa” (Engero 27:6). Okukangavvulwa kuwulirwa nga kuzibu mu kiseera ekyo, naye oluvannyuma kuleeta ebibala eby’emirembe (Abaebbulaniya 12:11). Okusirika ng’omuntu akyama si kisa.

study_questions.question: Ekigendererwa ky’okukangavvula mu kkanisa kye kiruwa?
study_questions.answer: Okuzzaawo, so si kubonereza. Omuddu wa Mukama ateekwa “okuba omukkakkamu eri bonna, n’okuba omuyigiriza omulungi agumiikiriza” (2 Timoseewo 2:24). Essuula ekigeraageranya n’okuddiza eggumba eryamenyeka mu kifo kyalyo, era ekozesa Gregory Omukulu n’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba.

fields.title: Okubudaabuda mu Kubonaabona n’Ennaku
fields.body_html:
“atuzaamu amaanyi mu kubonaabona kwonna kwe tuyitamu, tulyoke tugumye abalala abayita mu kubonaabona okwa buli ngeri, olw’okugumya kwe tufuna nga Katonda atuzaamu amaanyi.”

— 2 Abakkolinso 1:4

Mu bitundu bingi eby’ensi, omuntu bw’afa, ekitundu kyonna kijja ku maka ago. Baliraanwa batuula n’ab’omu maka okumala ennaku eziwera. Abamu baleeta emmere. Abamu bayimba. Bangi boogera kitono nnyo. Bajja bujja, ne basigala. Okubeerawo kwabwe kwogera ebigambo kye bitasobola: “Toli wekka.”

Abantu be tukulembera bajja kusanga endwadde, okufiirwa n’okufa. Abaana bafa. Obufumbo busasika. Emirimu gibula. Entalo n’amataba bizikiriza amaka. Emibiri gikaddiwa ne giggwaamu amaanyi. Omukulembeze tasobola kuziyiza nnaku zino. Naye omukulembeze asobola okubeerawo mu nnaku ezo, era n’alaga abantu Katonda naye abeerawo omwo. Essuula eno, esembayo mu Kitundu eky’Okuna: Okulunda Ekisibo, ekwata ku kubudaabuda mu kubonaabona ne mu nnaku.

Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna

Pawulo atandika ebbaluwa ye ey’okubiri eri Abakkolinso n’okutendereza: “Katonda oyo Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, Kitaffe ow’okusaasira era Katonda azaamu bonna amaanyi yeebazibwe” (2 Abakkolinso 1:3). Pawulo kino yakiwandiika oluvannyuma lw’okubonaabona okw’entiisa. Mu nnyiriri ntono oluvannyuma agamba nti yazitoowererwa nnyo okutuusa “essuubi ery’okuba abalamu ne lituggwaamu” (2 Abakkolinso 1:8). Naye atandika n’okutendereza, kubanga mu kizikiza ekyo yali azudde nti Katonda mubudaabuzi.

Bayibuli ejjudde ekifaananyi kino ekya Katonda. Ng’ayita mu Isaaya yagamba nti, “Mugumye, mugumye abantu bange” (Isaaya 40:1). Era yeeyogerako ng’omusumba omukkakkamu: “akuŋŋaanya abaana b’endiga mu mukono gwe n’abasitula mu kifuba kye, n’akulembera mpola mpola ezibayonsa” (Isaaya 40:11). Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yawandiika nti, “Mukama abeera kumpi n’abalina emitima egimenyese, era alokola abo abalina emyoyo egyennyise” (Zabbuli 34:18).

Nga tetunnaba kubudaabuda balala, tulina okumanya Katonda ono ffe ffennyini. Omukulembeze atatwalangako nnaku ye ye kennyini eri Katonda ajja kuba n’ekitono eky’okuwa abalala mu nnaku zaabwe.

Tubudaabudibwa tulyoke tubudaabude

Pawulo agenda mu maaso nti Katonda “atuzaamu amaanyi mu kubonaabona kwonna kwe tuyitamu, tulyoke tugumye abalala abayita mu kubonaabona okwa buli ngeri, olw’okugumya kwe tufuna nga Katonda atuzaamu amaanyi” (2 Abakkolinso 1:4).

Kino kye kimu ku birabo ebikwekeddwa eby’okubonaabona. Katonda bw’atubudaabuda mu bulumi bwaffe, aba atutegeka n’okubudaabuda abalala. Omusumba eyafiirwa omwana asobola okutuula n’abazadde abali mu nnaku mu ngeri omulala yenna gy’atasobola. Omukulembeze eyayita mu kwennyika kw’omwoyo asobola okutegeera abalala abali mu kizikiza. Nnamwandu asobola okubudaabuda nnamwandu munne. Tewali kintu mu bulamu bwaffe ekyonooneka nga kiri mu mikono gya Katonda.

Kino kitegeeza nti abakulembeze tebasaanidde kukweka nnaku zaabwe zonna eri abantu baabwe. Waliwo ekiseera eky’okubuulira, mu magezi, engeri Katonda gye yatusisinkana mu bulumi bwaffe. Emirundi mingi abantu bayambibwa nnyo obunafu bwaffe obw’amazima okusinga amaanyi gaffe.

Yesu yakaaba

Mukwano gwa Yesu Laazaalo bwe yafa, Yesu yajja mu kyalo Bessaniya. Mwannyina wa Laazaalo, Maliyamu, n’agwa ku bigere bye ng’akaaba. “Yesu bwe yamulaba ng’akaaba era n’Abayudaaya abaali naye nga bakaaba n’anyolwa mu mutima, n’ajjula obuyinike. N’abuuza nti, ‘Mwamuteeka wa?’ Ne bamugamba nti, ‘Mukama waffe jjangu olabeyo.’ Yesu n’akaaba amaziga” (Yokaana 11:33-35).

Kino kyewuunyisa nnyo. Yesu yali amanyi nti mu ddakiika ntono yali agenda kuzuukiza Laazaalo mu bafu. Eky’okuddamu mu nnaku ya Maliyamu yali akirina mu mikono gye. Naye n’akaaba. Teyayanguwa kuyita ku bulumi bwe okutuuka ku kigonjoola. Yasooka kuyingira mu nnaku ye. Era yalumwa nnyo, “n’anyolwa mu mutima”, olw’okufa kwennyini, omulabe asasaanya amaka.

Abakulembeze batera okukemebwa okwanguyiriza. Twagala okugonjoola ekizibu, okujuliza olunyiriri, okunnyonnyola lwaki kyabaawo, ne tweyongerayo. Naye Yesu atulaga ekkubo erisinga obulungi. Nga tetunnayogera, tukaaba. Nga tetunnannyonnyola, tusigalawo. Bayibuli etugamba nti, “Musanyukirenga wamu n’abo abasanyuka, era mukaabirenga wamu n’abo abakaaba” (Abaruumi 12:15). Oluusi ekintu ekisinga okufaanana Kristo omukulembeze ky’ayinza okukola kwe kukaabira wamu n’omuntu.

Era jjukira Omulokozi waffe bw’ali. Isaaya yamuyita “omuntu eyagumira ennaku n’obuyinike” (Isaaya 53:3). Abaebbulaniya bagamba nti, “Tulina Kabona Asinga Obukulu alumirwa awamu naffe mu bunafu bwaffe” (Abaebbulaniya 4:15). Bwe tutuula n’abo ababonaabona, tetubaleetera Katonda ali ewala. Tubaleeta eri Oyo eyabonaabona naye.

Ababudaabuzi abatagasa

Ekitabo kya Yobu kitulaga okubudaabuda okulungi n’okubi. Yobu bwe yafiirwa abaana be, obugagga bwe n’obulamu bwe, mikwano gye esatu ne gijja okumulaba. Mu kusooka baakola bulungi nnyo: “Awo ne batuula naye we yali atudde okumala ennaku musanvu emisana n’ekiro nga tewali anyega, olw’obulumi obungi Yobu bwe yalimu” (Yobu 2:13).

Awo ne batandika okwogera. Okumala essuula nnyingi baanyonnyola Yobu nti ateekwa okuba nga yayonoona, nti Katonda yali amubonereza, era nti bwe yandyenenyezza buli kimu kyandiddamu okutereera. Baali bakyamu. Ku nkomerero y’ekitabo, Katonda yabasunguwalira. Yobu yali abayise “mikwano gyange egitagasa” (Yobu 16:2).

Bino bye bimu ku bintu ebitufuula ababudaabuzi abatagasa:

  • Okwanguyiriza okunnyonnyola. “Kino kyabaawo kubanga…” Emirundi mingi tetumanyi lwaki. Kirungi okugamba nti, “Simanyi lwaki,” okusinga okwogera ekintu eky’obulimba ku Katonda.
  • Okunenya oyo abonaabona. Abayigiriza abamu bagamba nti endwadde zonna n’obwavu bwonna biva mu butaba na kukkiriza oba mu kibi ekikwekeddwa. Oluusi ekibi kireeta okubonaabona. Naye emirundi mingi tekikireeta. Abayigirizwa ba Yesu omulundi gumu baabuuza oba omusajja muzibe w’amaaso ye yayonoona oba bazadde be. Yesu yagamba nti tewali n’omu ku bo (Yokaana 9:1-3).
  • Okwanguyiriza ennaku yaabwe. “Kye kiseera okweyongerayo.” Ennaku etwala ebiseera, emirundi mingi emyaka. Beera mugumiikiriza.
  • Okukozesa ennyiriri nga bandeji. Kituufu nti “eri abo abaagala Katonda, … ebintu byonna bibatuukako olw’obulungi” (Abaruumi 8:28). Naye bwe kyogerwa mangu nnyo, awatali kwagala, kiyinza okuwulirwa ng’olubaga. Amazima ka gogerwe mu kiseera ekituufu ne mu ngeri entuufu.
  • Okubulawo. Abantu bangi beetooloolwa abantu ku kuziika, naye oluvannyuma lw’omwezi ne basigala bokka. Ababudaabuzi abalungi bakomawo.

Okubudaabuda okw’ebikolwa

Omukulembeze ayinza kukola ki?

Genda. Kyalira abalwadde, abali kumpi okufa n’abali mu nnaku. Genda mu malwaliro, mu maka ne ku kuziika. Okubeerawo kwo kusinga ebigambo byo obukulu.

Wuliriza. Leka abantu banyumye ebyabatuukako, emirundi n’emirundi bwe kiba kyetaagisa. Baleke babeere n’obusungu oba okutabuka. Zabbuli zijjudde okwemulugunya okw’amazima eri Katonda: “Olinneerabira kutuusa ddi, Ayi Mukama? Okutuusa emirembe gyonna?” (Zabbuli 13:1). Katonda tanyiiga olw’ennaku ey’amazima. Yigiriza abantu nti basobola okugireeta gy’ali.

Saba. Musabire wamu nabo era obasabire. Bwe baba tebasobola kusaba, basabire. Yakobo agamba abalwadde okuyita abakadde b’ekkanisa babasabire (Yakobo 5:14).

Yamba mu bikolwa. Leeta emmere. Yamba ku baana, ku nnimiro, ku bisale oba ku kuziika. Tegeka ekkanisa erabirire, omugugu guleme kugwa ku muntu omu.

Yogera ku ssuubi mu kiseera ekituufu. Abakristaayo banakuwala ddala, naye Pawulo tayagala tunakuwale ng’abo abatalina ssuubi: “tetwagala mmwe obutategeera eby’abo abafu, ne munakuwala ng’abalala abatalina ssuubi. Kubanga bwe tukkiriza nti Yesu yafa era n’azuukira” (1 Abasessaloniika 4:13-14). Mu kaseera akatuufu, yogera ku kuzuukira, ku kubeerawo kwa Kristo, ne ku lunaku “Alisangula amaziga mu maaso gaabwe, olwo nga tewakyali kufa” (Okubikkulirwa 21:4).

Jjukira. Wandiika olunaku omuntu lwe yafiirako, era ku lunaku olwo mu mwaka oguddako kyalira ab’omu maka oba obakubire essimu. Kiyinza okuba eky’omuwendo gye bali okusinga ekintu ekirala kyonna ky’okola.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Samuel Rutherford ne Corrie ten Boom

Samuel Rutherford yali musumba mu kyalo ekitono Anwoth mu bukiikaddyo bw’obugwanjuba bwa Scotland mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omusanvu. Naye yennyini yali amanyi ennaku. Mukyala we yafa oluvannyuma lw’obulwadde obw’ebbanga eddene era obw’obulumi, era yafiirwa n’abaana. Mu 1636 yagobebwa mu kitundu kye eky’ekkanisa olw’ebiwandiiko bye, n’asindikibwa okubeera mu kibuga Aberdeen, ewala n’abantu be. Okuva eyo, ne mu bulamu bwe bwonna, yawandiikiranga abantu be yali ayagala ebbaluwa ez’okubudaabuda n’okugumya. Okuva olwo zisomebwa Abakristaayo ababonaabona, era ziri ku Ochorus nga Letters of Samuel Rutherford (Ebbaluwa za Samuel Rutherford).

Emu ku bbaluwa ze yawandiikirwa omukazi eyali afiiriddwa muwala we:

“Ddala nanakuwala bwe nakuvaako, naddala kubanga wali mu buzito bw’ennaku bwe butyo oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwa muwala wo. Naye nzikiriza nti omanyi nti enkomerero esinga obuzito ey’omusalaba gwa Kristo ogukuteekeddwako egalamidde ku Mulokozi wo ow’amaanyi.”

— Samuel Rutherford, Ebbaluwa II

Mu bigambo ebyangu: nnanakuwala okukuvaako, naddala kubanga wali mu nnaku nnyingi oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwa muwala wo. Naye nzikiriza nti omanyi nti ekitundu ekisinga obuzito eky’omusalaba gw’ositudde kiwummulidde ku Yesu, Omulokozi wo ow’amaanyi. Rutherford yalowooza ku musalaba ng’omuti omuzito ogwetikkiddwa abantu babiri. Maama yetikka enkomerero emu. Kristo yetikka enkomerero esinga obuzito. Awo Rutherford n’ajuliza Isaaya, nti mu bizibu byabwe byonna Mukama yennyini yabonaabonera wamu nabo (Isaaya 63:9), n’ayongerako nti, “Bw’onookoowanga, Ye ajja kwetikka ggwe n’omugugu gwo byombi.”

Rutherford teyeefuula nti ennaku ntono. Yakaabiranga wamu n’abo abali mu nnaku. Naye yabalaganga Kristo, asitula byombi, oyo abonaabona n’okubonaabona kwe.

Nga wayise ebyasa bisatu, Corrie ten Boom yali muddaabiriza wa ssaawa mu kibuga Haarlem eky’e Netherlands. Mu Lutalo olw’Okubiri olw’Ensi Yonna, ab’omu maka ge baakweka Abayudaaya okuva ku Banazi mu kisenge eky’ekyama mu nnyumba yaabwe. Mu 1944 baakwatibwa. Corrie ne mwannyina Betsie baasindikibwa e Ravensbrück, enkambi y’abasibe ey’entiisa mu Bugirimaani. Eyo, wakati mu nsekere, enjala n’obukambwe, bannyinaffe abo ababiri baakubanga enkuŋŋaana ez’okusoma Bayibuli ne basaba wamu n’abakazi abalala. Betsie yaggwaamu amaanyi n’afiira mu nkambi mu Ddesemba 1944. Corrie yateebwa mangu oluvannyuma.

Oluvannyuma lw’olutalo, Corrie yamala obulamu bwe bwonna obuwanvu obwasigalawo ng’atambula mu nsi yonna, ng’abudaabuda abantu n’okubudaabuda Katonda kwe yali amuwadde. Mu kitabo kye ekyaddirira, The Hiding Place (Ekifo eky’Okwekwekamu), yajjukira Betsie ng’agamba, nga kumpi okufa, nti balina okubuulira abantu nti tewali kinnya kiwanvu nnyo okwagala kwa Katonda ne kutakisinga buwanvu. Ebyafaayo Corrie ten Boom: A Life (Obulamu bwa Corrie ten Boom) ebiri ku Ochorus biraga nti ebigambo bino nga bwe biri biva mu kitabo ekyaddirira, so si mu kyogera kya Corrie ekyasooka ekyawandiikibwa mu 1945. Naye amazima agali emabega waabyo gaageezesebwa mu kimu ku bifo ebisinga ekizikiza ku nsi. Corrie yafuuka, mu bigambo bya Pawulo, omuntu asobola okugumya “abalala abayita mu kubonaabona okwa buli ngeri”, kubanga naye yali agumiziddwa mu kubonaabona kwe.

Enkomerero y’Ekitundu eky’Okuna

Kati tulabye ebifaananyi bitaano eby’omulimu gw’omusumba: okuliisa endiga, okumanya endiga, okunoonya abaabula, okunenya n’okuzzaawo, n’okubudaabuda ababonaabona. Tewali na kimu ku bino ekiyinza okukolebwa ng’oli wala. Buli kimu kyetaagisa omukulembeze okusemberera abantu, nga Yesu bwe yatusemberera.

Omusumba Omulungi asitula abaana b’endiga mu kifuba kye. Ffe abasumba abali wansi we, tuyitiddwa naffe okusitula abantu: mu kusaba, mu kubeerawo, ne mu kwagala. Era bwe tukoowa, Ye atusitula ffe n’omugugu gwaffe byombi.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Lowooza ku kiseera omuntu lwe yakubudaabuda obulungi mu biseera by’ennaku. Kiki kye yakola? Kiki ky’ataakola?
  • Soma Yokaana 11:32-36. Olowooza lwaki Yesu yakaaba, wadde nga yali anaatera okuzuukiza Laazaalo?
  • Ku mize gy’ababudaabuzi abatagasa, kiruwa ky’osinga okukemebwa okukola?
  • Soma 2 Abakkolinso 1:3-7. Katonda yakubudaabuda atya mu ngeri ekuyambye okubudaabuda abalala?
  • Ani mu kkanisa yo ali mu nnaku kati, oba eyali mu nnaku emyezi mitono emabega era kati ayinza okuwulira nga yeerabiddwa?
  • Ekifaananyi kya Rutherford ekya Kristo ng’asitula “enkomerero esinga obuzito” ey’omusalaba kitegeeza ki gy’oli?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Kola olukalala lw’abantu mu kkanisa yo oba mu kitundu kyo abalwadde, abali mu nnaku, oba abayita mu bizibu eby’amaanyi, nga mw’otwalidde n’abo abaafiirwa emyezi egiwerako emabega. Wiiki eno, kyalira waakiri babiri ku bo. Togenda na kubuulira. Genda okuwuliriza n’okubeerawo. Bambuuze nti, “Ddala oli otya?” era obaleke boogere. Nga tonnava wo, musabire wamu mu bufunze. Bwe wabaawo ekyetaago eky’ebikolwa, saba ekkanisa eyambe okukituukiriza.

study_questions.question: Nnyinza ntya okubudaabuda omuntu ali mu nnaku?
study_questions.answer: Ng’obeerawo, ng’owuliriza, ng’osaba era ng’oyamba mu bikolwa, mu kifo ky’okuwa eby’okuddamu eby’amangu. Katonda “atuzaamu amaanyi mu kubonaabona kwonna kwe tuyitamu, tulyoke tugumye abalala abayita mu kubonaabona okwa buli ngeri” (2 Abakkolinso 1:4). Mikwano gya Yobu gitulaga kye tutasaanidde kukola.

study_questions.question: Yesu yanakuwala?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Ku ntaana ya Laazaalo, bwe yalaba Maliyamu ng’akaaba, yanyolwa nnyo mu mutima n’akaaba amaziga (Yokaana 11:33-35). Okunakuwala si kubulwa kukkiriza. “Mukama abeera kumpi n’abalina emitima egimenyese” (Zabbuli 34:18).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza kufuna wa okubudaabudibwa bw’aba abonaabona?
study_questions.answer: Mu Katonda, “Katonda azaamu bonna amaanyi” (2 Abakkolinso 1:3). Pawulo yennyini yatuuka ku kiseera “essuubi ery’okuba abalamu ne lituggwaamu” (2 Abakkolinso 1:8), naye n’asanga nga Katonda mwesigwa. Essuula ekozesa Samuel Rutherford ne Corrie ten Boom.

fields.title: Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu
fields.body_html:
“Ky’okola si kirungi. Ggwe, n’abantu bano bonna abajja gy’oli, mujja kukoowa nnyo. Kubanga omulimu guno munene nnyo; tosobola kugukola bw’omu.”

— Okuva 18:17-18

Mu byalo bingi, ennyumba bw’eba yeetaaga akasolya akaggya, ekitundu kyonna kijja okuyamba. Omuntu omu yekka teyandisobodde kusitula miti emizito. Naye ng’abantu abiri, omulimu guggwa mu lunaku lumu, era ku nkomerero ne wabaawo okuyimba n’emmere. Buli muntu alina ekitundu kye. Abamu basitula. Abamu basiba. Abamu bafumba. Akasolya kalinnya kubanga tewali yagezaako kukikola yekka.

Essuula eno etandika Ekitundu eky’Okutaano: Okukulembera Awamu. Mu Kitundu eky’Okuna twatunuulira omulimu gw’okulunda: okuliisa, okumanya, okunoonya, okunenya n’okubudaabuda. Bwe wasoma essuula ezo n’olowooza nti, “Sisobola kukola ebyo byonna,” wali mutuufu. Tosobola. Katonda teyagenderera n’akatono nti obikole wekka.

Musa n’omugugu omuzito

Isirayiri bwe yava mu Misiri, Musa yabakulembera mu ddungu. Buli lunaku, okuva ku makya okutuusa akawungeezi, abantu bajjanga gy’ali n’enkaayana zaabwe n’ebibuuzo byabwe, era ye yekka n’abalamula bonna. Mukoddomi we Yesero bwe yakiraba, n’agamba nti, “Ky’okola si kirungi. Ggwe, n’abantu bano bonna abajja gy’oli, mujja kukoowa nnyo. Kubanga omulimu guno munene nnyo; tosobola kugukola bw’omu” (Okuva 18:17-18).

Yesero yawa Musa amagezi amalungi. Musa yali asaanidde okweyongera okukola ebyo ye yekka bye yali asobola okukola: okusabira abantu, okubayigiriza amateeka ga Katonda, n’okukola ku misango egisinga obuzibu. Naye yali asaanidde okulonda abakulembeze abalala okugabana omulimu. “Londayo abasajja abalina ebisaanyizo, ng’obaggya mu bantu bonna, abasajja abatya Katonda, ab’amazima era abatalya nguzi; obawe obukulembeze, ng’abamu bavunaanyizibwa abantu enkumi, n’abalala abantu ebikumi, n’abamu ebibiina eby’ataano n’abalala eby’ekkumi kkumi.” Awo, Yesero n’agamba nti, “Ekyo kinaawewulanga ku buzito bw’omugugu gwo, kubanga banaabanga bagukukwatirako” (Okuva 18:21-22).

Weetegereze nti Yesero teyali nnabbi mukulu. Yali kabona w’e Midiyaani, munnaggwanga. Naye Musa yali mwetoowaze ekimala okuwuliriza amagezi amalungi, n’akola Yesero bye yagamba. Oluusi Katonda aweereza amagezi ng’ayita mu bantu be tutasuubira.

Oluvannyuma mu ddungu, Musa yaddamu okubetentebwa okwemulugunya kw’abantu. N’akaabirira Katonda nti, “Sisobola kusitula bantu bano bonna bw’omu kubanga obuzito bwabwe buyinza okummenya nga ndi nzekka” (Okubala 11:14). Katonda n’amuddamu ng’amugamba akuŋŋaanye abakadde nsanvu. “Nzija kutoola ku mwoyo oguli mu ggwe ngubateekemu, balyokenga bakusitulireko omugugu gw’abantu oleme kugwetikkanga wekka” (Okubala 11:17).

Eky’okuddamu kya Katonda eri omukulembeze akooye ennyo tekyali nti “fuba nnyo okusingawo”. Kyali nti “gabana omugugu”.

Enkola y’Endagaano Empya

Bwe tutunuulira ekkanisa ez’omu Ndagaano Empya, tusangamu ekintu ekyewuunyisa. Kumpi tezaakulemberwanga muntu omu yekka.

Yesu yennyini yalonda abatume kkumi na babiri n’abatuma “babiri babiri” (Makko 6:7). Ekkanisa ey’omu Yerusaalemi bwe yasanga ekizibu kya bannamwandu, abatume baasaba ekkanisa erondemu abantu musanvu “abasiimibwa abantu, ng’abantu b’amagezi, era abajjudde Mwoyo Mutukuvu” okugabana omulimu (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:3). Pawulo ne Balunabba bwe baatandikawo ekkanisa empya, “buli kkanisa baagironderamu abakadde” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 14:23). Ekigambo kiri mu bungi: abakadde, so si mukadde omu. Pawulo yagamba Tito “otekewo n’abakadde b’ekkanisa mu buli kibuga” (Tito 1:5). Pawulo yawandiikira ekkanisa ey’e Firipi “awamu n’abalabirizi n’abadiikoni” (Abafiripi 1:1).

Tunuulira abakulembeze b’ekkanisa ey’omu Antiyokiya, ekkanisa ey’obuminsani esooka ennene: “Balunabba, ne Simooni, eyayitibwanga, ‘Omuddugavu’ ne Lukiyo ow’e Kuleene, ne Manaeni, eyakulira awamu ne kabaka Kerode, ne Sawulo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:1). Balunabba yava Kupulo. Simooni yayitibwanga “Omuddugavu” (mu Luyonaani “Niger”), era oboolyawo yava mu Afirika. Lukiyo yava e Kuleene, mu Bukiikakkono bwa Afirika. Manaeni yali akulidde mu lubiri lwa kabaka. Sawulo yali muyivu Omuyudaaya okuva e Taluso. Yali ttiimu ey’abantu ab’enjawulo ennyo, okuva mu mawanga n’embeera ez’enjawulo, nga bakulembera wamu. Era mu ttiimu eyo Omwoyo Omutukuvu mwe yatuma abaminsani abaasooka.

Ekkanisa ez’enjawulo zitegese obukulembeze bwazo mu ngeri ez’enjawulo mu byafaayo. Engeri enkulu tuzinnyonnyola mu bwenkanya mu Ssuula 53, Ekyongerezeddwako A: Ekkanisa Bwe Zikulemberwa. Naye mu ngeri zino zonna, enkola y’Endagaano Empya etegeerekeka: obukulembeze bugabanibwa.

Omubiri gwetaaga buli kitundu

Lwaki Katonda akola bw’atyo? Olw’ekyo Ekkanisa ky’eri. Pawulo agamba nti Ekkanisa mubiri: “Kubanga nga bwe tulina ebitundu ebingi mu mubiri ogumu, ebitundu ebyo byonna bikola emirimu gya njawulo. Noolwekyo nga bwe tuli omubiri ogumu mu Kristo, buli muntu kitundu ku mubiri ogumu ogwo” (Abaruumi 12:4-5). “Eriiso terisobola kugamba mukono nti, ‘Ggwe sikwetaaga,’ oba n’omutwe teguyinza kugamba bigere nti, ‘Mmwe sibeetaaga’” (1 Abakkolinso 12:21).

Tewali mukulembeze n’omu alina birabo byonna. Omu muyigiriza mulungi naye munafu mu by’ensimbi. Omu mubudaabuzi wa kitalo naye tasobola kutegeka. Omu alaba bulungi ebiseera eby’omu maaso naye yeerabira abantu b’ali nabo. Katonda yasaasaanya ebirabo bye mu mubiri gwonna, tulyoke twetaagane.

Pawulo era annyonnyola ekigendererwa ky’abakulembeze: Kristo yawa abatume, bannabbi, ababuulizi b’enjiri, abasumba n’abayigiriza “olw’okutendeka abantu ba Katonda olw’omulimu ogw’obuweereza, okuzimba omubiri gwa Kristo” (Abaefeso 4:11-12). Weetegereze ekyo. Omulimu gw’abakulembeze si kukola mulimu gwonna. Kwe kutendeka abantu ba Katonda okukola omulimu. Omusumba akola buli kimu yekka taba mwesigwa. Aziyiza abalala okukola Katonda by’abayitidde okukola.

Omubuulizi mu kitabo ky’Omubuulizi akyogera mu ngeri ennyangu: “Ababiri basinga omu, … Kubanga singa omu agwa, munne amuyimusa. Naye zimusanze oyo ali obw’omu, bw’agwa tabaako amuyimusa” (Omubuulizi 4:9-10). Abakulembeze abakola bokka bali mu kabi. Bwe bakoowa, tewali akitegeera. Bwe basobya, tewali abanenya. Bwe bagwa, tewali abaawo kubayimusa.

Lwaki abakulembeze bagezaako okukikola bokka

Obanga obukulembeze obugabanibwa lye kkubo lya Katonda, lwaki abakulembeze bangi bakola buli kimu bokka?

  • Amalala. “Tewali muntu mulala asobola kukikola bulungi nga nze.” Oluusi ekyo kiba kituufu mu kusooka. Naye abalala tebalyiga n’akatono bwe batawebwa mukisa.
  • Okutya okufiirwa obuyinza. Abalala bwe bagabana omulimu, bajja kugabana n’okusalawo. Abakulembeze abamu ekyo bakitya. Tujja kulowooza ku bulabe bw’obuyinza mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu.
  • Obutaba na bwesige. Abakulembeze abamu batya nti abalala bwe bakola obulungi, bo bajja kwetaagibwa kitono oba kwewuunyibwa kitono. Naye omukulembeze omunywevu asanyuka abalala bwe bayaka.
  • Empisa z’ensi. Mu mpisa ezimu, omukulembeze asuubirwa okuba ng’omukulu w’ekika asalawo buli kimu. Abantu n’okukisuubira bakisuubira. Naye Ekkanisa erina okugoberera Kristo, so si mpisa zaayo zokka.
  • Obutagumiikiriza. Kyangu okukikola ggwe kennyini okusinga okuyigiriza omulala. Ekyo kituufu leero. Naye mu myaka etaano, omukulembeze eyatendeka abalala ajja kuba n’abakozi bangi, ate oyo ataakikola ajja kuba akyali yekka.

Kino kigezo kyangu. Weebuuze nti: “Singa ndwala okumala emyezi esatu, omulimu gwandibadde gutya?” Bwe kiba nti buli kimu kyandiyimiridde, waliwo ekikyamu.

Engeri y’okugabanamu omugugu

Saba ofune bakozi banno. Yesu yagamba abayigirizwa be nti, “musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye” (Matayo 9:38). Nga tonnanoonya bayambi, basabire.

Sooka onoonye empisa. Yesero yagamba okunoonya abantu “abatya Katonda, ab’amazima era abatalya nguzi”. Abatume baanoonya abantu “ng’abantu b’amagezi, era abajjudde Mwoyo Mutukuvu”. Obukugu buyinza okuyigirizibwa. Empisa nzibu okuzimba.

Wa obuvunaanyizibwa obw’amazima. Towa bantu mirimu mitono gyokka ng’ate ggwe okuuma buli kusalawo. Bawe omulimu ogw’amazima obaleke basalewo eby’amazima, nga mw’otwalidde n’ensobi ezimu.

Kwata ebyo ggwe wekka by’osobola okukola. Abatume baanyweza okusaba n’okuweereza ekigambo (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:4). Musa yeeyongera okuyigiriza n’okukola ku misango egisinga obuzibu. Manya Katonda ky’akuyitidde mu ngeri ey’enjawulo okukola, ebisigadde obiwe abalala.

Mukuŋŋaanenga wamu. Ttiimu yeetaaga ebiseera nga bali wamu, okusaba, okuteekateeka, okuzziŋŋanamu amaanyi n’okugonjoola ebizibu. Abakulembeze abagabana omulimu naye ne batakuŋŋaana na lumu bajja kugenda beeyawula.

Wuliriza ttiimu yo. “Awatali kuluŋŋamizibwa entegeka zifa, naye awali abawi b’amagezi abangi ziyitamu” (Engero 15:22). Buuza abakulembeze banno kye balowooza, era obaleke bakyuse endowooza yo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: John Wesley n’abayambi be

John Wesley yali muweereza w’Ekkanisa ya Bungereza mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omunaana. Ng’ayita mu kubuulira kwe, n’okwa muganda we Charles ne George Whitefield, abantu emitwalo n’emitwalo bajja mu kukkiriza. Wesley yatambula mayiro nkumi na nkumi ku mbalaasi, ng’abuulira mu nnimiro, mu butale ne mu birombe. Naye teyandisobodde kulabirira bakkiriza abo bonna abaggya yekka.

Eky’okuddamu kyajja mu ngeri etaasuubirwa. Mu Febwali 1742, ekibiina ky’Abametodisiti mu kibuga Bristol kyalina ebbanja lye kyali kirina okusasula. Journal ya Wesley (ebiwandiiko bye ebya buli lunaku), eri ku Ochorus, ewandiika kye baakkaanyaako: “nti ekibiina kyonna kigabanyizibwemu obubinja obutono oba ebibiina—nga buli kibiina kirimu abantu nga kkumi na babiri; era … nti omuntu omu mu buli kibiina asolooze ebiweebwayo by’abalala.” Buli wiiki, omukulembeze w’ekibiina yakyaliranga ba memba okusolooza peni emu. Mangu ddala ne bategeera nti omukulembeze w’ekibiina era yali asobola okubuuza buli muntu omwoyo gwe nga bwe guli. Olukuŋŋaana lw’ekibiina ne luzaalibwa. Abasajja n’abakazi aba bulijjo, abasuubuzi, abasimi b’ebirombe n’abaweereza b’awaka, buli omu n’afuuka omusumba w’abantu nga kkumi na babiri. Ng’ayita mu bibiina bino, abakkiriza emitwalo n’emitwalo baamanyibwa, ne balabirirwa, ne bayambibwa okukula.

Wesley era yalina okuyiga okugabana okubuulira. Yali kabona eyayawulibwa, era yakkiririzanga nti abasajja abaayawulibwa bokka be basaanidde okubuulira. Bwe yali taliiwo, yaleka omuvubuka ayitibwa Thomas Maxfield ng’avunaanyizibwa ku kibiina ky’e London, okusisinkana ebibiina n’okunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa. Maxfield n’atandika okubuulira. Wesley yanyiiga n’ayanguwa okudda e London okumuziyiza. Naye maama we, Susanna Wesley, n’amulabula nti:

“Weegendereze ky’okola ku muvubuka oyo; kubanga mazima ddala Katonda amuyise okubuulira nga bwe yakuyita ggwe. Weekenneenye ebibala by’okubuulira kwe bye bibadde, era omuwulire ggwe kennyini.”

— Susanna Wesley, nga bwe kinyumizibwa mu Susanna Wesley ekya Eliza Clarke

Wesley yawuliriza Maxfield ng’abuulira, n’alaba omukono gwa Katonda. N’agamba nti, “Ye Mukama … akole nga bw’asiima. Nze ani eyandiwakanyizza Katonda?” Mu bigambo ebyangu: guno mulimu gwa Katonda, n’olwekyo Katonda ka akole ky’alaba nga kye kisinga. Nze ani okuziyiza Katonda? Okuva olwo, Wesley yalonda ababuulizi bangi abataayawulibwa. Baatwala enjiri mu Bungereza yonna, mu Amerika n’okusingawo.

Emboozi ya Wesley eraga ebintu bibiri. Ekisooka, Katonda emirundi mingi atuwa bakozi bannaffe mu ngeri ezeewuunyisa, ng’ayita mu kyetaago ekitono eky’ensonga oba mu muntu gwe tutasuubira. Eky’okubiri, n’abakulembeze abakulu balina okuba abeetoowaze ekimala okulaba Katonda ng’akolera mu balala, n’okubaleka bakole.

Toli wekka

Oboolyawo oli musumba mu kkanisa entono, era owulira nti ositula buli kimu wekka. Oboolyawo okooye, nga Musa bwe yali. Wulira ebigambo bya Yesero: “tosobola kugukola bw’omu.” Wulira ekisuubizo kya Katonda: “balyokenga bakusitulireko omugugu gw’abantu oleme kugwetikkanga wekka.”

Tunula okukwetooloola. Mu kkanisa yo mulimu abantu abalina ebirabo by’otonnaba kulaba. Basabire. Bayite. Batendeke. Beesige. Era akasolya ka kasitulibwe emikono mingi. Mu ssuula eddako tujja kutunuulira engeri y’okukuzaamu abakulembeze abaggya.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Okuva 18:13-26. Mu ngeri ki gy’ofaananamu Musa nga Yesero tannaba kwogera naye?
  • Singa olwala okumala emyezi esatu, omulimu gw’okulembera gwandibadde gutya?
  • Ku nsonga lwaki abakulembeze bakola bokka, eriwa erisinga okuba ery’amazima gy’oli?
  • Tunuulira abakulembeze b’ekkanisa ey’omu Antiyokiya (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:1). Enjawulo yaabwe etuyigiriza ki ku ttiimu z’obukulembeze leero?
  • Ani mu kkanisa yo alina ebirabo ebitakozesebwa? Kiki ky’oyinza okumuwa okukola?
  • Kiki ky’oyinza okuyigira ku magezi Susanna Wesley ge yawa mutabani we?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Kola olukalala lwa buli kimu ky’okola mu bukulembeze bwo mu wiiki eya bulijjo. Buli kintu kiteekeko akabonero: “Nze nzekka nsobola okukikola,” “Omuntu omulala yandisobodde okukikola ng’atendekeddwa,” oba “Omuntu omulala yandisobodde okukikola kati.” Londa ekintu kimu mu kibinja ekisembayo, era oluvannyuma lw’okusaba, saba omuntu akitwale wiiki eno. Londa ekimu mu kibinja eky’omu makkati, otandike okutendeka omuntu okukikola. Oluvannyuma tegeka ekiseera okusisinkana n’okusaba n’abakulembeze abalala b’okola nabo.

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze tebasaanidde kukola bokka?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga omugugu muzito nnyo eri omuntu omu. Yesero yagamba Musa nti, “Ggwe, n’abantu bano bonna abajja gy’oli, mujja kukoowa nnyo” (Okuva 18:18). Oluvannyuma Musa yagamba nti, “Sisobola kusitula bantu bano bonna bw’omu” (Okubala 11:14).

study_questions.question: Enkola y’obukulembeze mu Ndagaano Empya y’eruwa?
study_questions.answer: Obukulembeze obugabanibwa. Yesu yatuma abayigirizwa be “babiri babiri” (Makko 6:7). Pawulo ne Balunabba “buli kkanisa baagironderamu abakadde” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 14:23), mu bungi, era Pawulo yagamba Tito “otekewo n’abakadde b’ekkanisa mu buli kibuga” (Tito 1:5).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okugabana omulimu?
study_questions.answer: Ng’ategeera ebirabo by’abalala, ng’abatendeka, ng’abawa obuvunaanyizibwa obw’amazima era ng’abeesiga, nga Musa bwe yakola Katonda bwe yateeka Omwoyo we ku bakadde nsanvu “balyokenga bakusitulireko omugugu gw’abantu” (Okubala 11:17). Ababuulizi bangi abataayawulibwa abaayamba John Wesley balaga nti bingi ebiyinza okukolebwa nga tuli wamu.

fields.title: Okukuza Abakulembeze
fields.body_html:
“Ebyo bye wawulira nga njogera mu maaso g’abajulirwa abangi biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala.”

— 2 Timoseewo 2:2

Omulimi alya emmere ye yonna ey’empeke ajja kulya bulungi omwaka guno. Naye omwaka ogujja tajja kuba na ky’asimba. Omulimi omugezi bulijjo aterekawo ensigo esinga obulungi. Agisimba, era okuva mu lubatu lumu ayinza okukungula ennimiro yonna. Omulimu gwe tegukoma ku makungula ga mwaka guno. Gweyongerayo ne mu myaka egijja.

Abakulembeze bafaanana omulimi oyo. Tuyinza okukozesa amaanyi gaffe gonna ku mulimu gwa mwaka guno: okubuulira kwa Ssande eno, ebizibu by’omwezi guno. Oba tuyinza n’okusimba ensigo ey’ebiseera ebijja, nga tukuza abakulembeze abapya. Mu ssuula ewedde twalaba nti tewali mukulembeze asaanidde kukola yekka. Mu ssuula eno tubuuza nti abakulembeze abalala bava wa? Eky’okuddamu kiri nti, wansi wa Katonda, ffe tubakuza.

Emirembe ena mu lunyiriri lumu

Ddamu osome olunyiriri oluli waggulu ku ssuula eno. Pawulo yaluwandiikira Timoseewo ng’obulamu bwe bunaatera okuggwaako: “Ebyo bye wawulira nga njogera mu maaso g’abajulirwa abangi biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala” (2 Timoseewo 2:2).

Bala abantu abali mu lunyiriri olwo. Okusooka waliwo Pawulo. Oluvannyuma waliwo Timoseewo, eyawulira okuva eri Pawulo. Oluvannyuma waliwo “abantu abeesigwa” Timoseewo b’agenda okuyigiriza. Era oluvannyuma waliwo “abalala” abo be baliyigiriza. Emirembe ena egy’abakulembeze mu sentensi emu.

Pawulo teyalowooza ku Kkanisa ya mu biseera bye byokka. Yalowooza ku Kkanisa ng’amaze okugenda, era nga ne Timoseewo amaze okugenda. Ekigezo ky’omukulembeze si kye kibaawo ng’akyaliwo kyokka. Kye ekyo ekigenda mu maaso ng’amaze okuvaawo.

Weetegereze era abantu Timoseewo be yalina okulonda: “abantu abeesigwa”. Si abo abasinga okwagalibwa, abasinga obugagga oba abasinga ebitone, wabula abeesigwa. Era baalina okuba abantu “abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala”. Timoseewo teyali anoonya bantu abandimwewuunyizza obwewuunya. Yali anoonya abantu abandibiyisizza eri abalala.

Yesu yakuza abakulembeze

Yesu yabuulira ebibiina by’abantu, naye ebiseera bye ebisinga obungi yabiwa ekibinja ekitono. “N’alonda kkumi na babiri mu abo, be yafuula abatume babeerenga naye, era abatumenga okubuulira” (Makko 3:14). Weetegereze engeri ebintu gye biddiriŋŋanamu. Okusooka, “babeerenga naye”. Oluvannyuma, “abatumenga okubuulira”.

Engeri Yesu gye yatendekangamu abakulembeze yali naddala okubeera nabo. Okumala emyaka esatu abayigirizwa baalyanga naye, baatambulanga naye, baamulabanga ng’asaba, baamuwuliranga ng’ayigiriza, baamulabanga ng’awonya, era baawuliranga engeri gye yaddangamu abalabe be. Baayiga si naddala okuva mu kuyigirizibwa mu kibiina, wabula okuva mu bulamu.

Oluvannyuma yabatuma okugenda okukikola bo bennyini. Yatuma Ekkumi n’Ababiri “bategeeze abantu ebigambo by’obwakabaka bwa Katonda era bawonye n’abalwadde” (Lukka 9:2). Oluvannyuma yatuma abalala nsanvu mu babiri “babiri babiri bamukulembere” (Lukka 10:1). Bwe baakomawo “nga basanyuka”, yayogera nabo ku ebyo ebyali bibaddewo (Lukka 10:17-20). Yabagolola bwe baasobya. Yabagumiikiriza bwe baalwawo okutegeera. Era ku nkomerero, yakwasa omulimu gwonna mu mikono gyabwe.

Engeri nnyingi zaffe ez’okutendeka zikontana n’eyo. Tuteeka abantu mu kibiina, ne tubawa okumanya n’ebbaluwa ey’obujulizi, oluvannyuma ne tubasindika bokka. Ebibiina by’okuyigiriramu birina omugaso gwabyo. Naye Yesu atulaga nti abakulembeze bakuzibwa naddala nga babeera wamu n’omukulembeze, nga bakola naye omulimu, era nga boogera ku gwo oluvannyuma.

Musa ne Yoswa, Eriya ne Erisa

Endagaano Enkadde etuwa eby’okulabirako bibiri ebikulu eby’abakulembeze abaategeka abo abaabaddirira.

Yoswa yali muyambi wa Musa okumala emyaka amakumi ana. Yagenda ne Musa ku lusozi. Yasigalanga ku weema ey’okusisinkanirangamu. Yakulembera eggye nga Musa asaba. Ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwe, Musa yakwasa Yoswa obukulembeze mu lwatu: “n’amugambira mu maaso ga Isirayiri yenna nti, ‘Beera wa maanyi era ogume omwoyo’” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 31:7). Era Musa bwe yamala okufa, “Yoswa, mutabani wa Nuuni, yali ajjudde omwoyo ogw’amagezi, kubanga Musa yali yamuteekako emikono gye” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 34:9). Abantu baagoberera Yoswa kubanga Musa yali amutegese, era yali alaze abantu nti ye yali oyo Katonda gwe yali alonze.

Erisa yagoberera nnabbi Eriya okumala emyaka. Eriya bwe yali anaatera okutwalibwa mu ggulu, Erisa yagaana okumwawukanako. Yamusaba nti, “Nkusaba, nsikire emigabo ebiri egy’Omwoyo akuliko” (2 Bassekabaka 2:9). Eriya bwe yamala okugenda, bannabbi abalala ne bagamba nti, “Omwoyo wa Eriya ali ku Erisa” (2 Bassekabaka 2:15). Erisa yeeyongera n’akola ebyamagero okusinga n’omusomesa we.

Emboozi zombi ziraga ekintu kye kimu. Omulimu gwa Katonda tegwafiira wamu n’omukulembeze omukulu, kubanga omukulembeze omukulu yali akoledde oyo eyaddirira ekifo.

Balunabba, omuzzaamu amaanyi

Omu ku basinga obukulu mu kukuza abakulembeze mu Ndagaano Empya teyali Pawulo wabula Balunabba. Erinnya lye litegeeza “omwana w’okuzzaamu amaanyi”.

Sawulo (oluvannyuma eyayitibwa Pawulo) bwe yasooka okujja e Yerusaalemi ng’amaze okukyuka, abayigirizwa “bonna nga bamutya” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 9:26). Yali abadde atta Abakristaayo. Ani yandimwesize? “Naye Balunabba n’amuleeta eri abatume” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 9:27). Balunabba yassa erinnya lye ery’obwesigwa mu kabi ku lwa Sawulo.

Oluvannyuma, ekkanisa y’omu Antiyokiya bwe yali ekula, “Balunabba n’alaga e Taluso okunoonya Sawulo, bwe yamulaba n’amuleeta mu Antiyokiya. Bombi ne babeera mu Antiyokiya okumala omwaka mulamba … ne bayigiriza abantu bangi nnyo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 11:25-26). Mu kusooka, Bayibuli eyogera ku “Balunabba ne Sawulo”. Mangu ddala eyogera ku “Pawulo ne Balunabba”. Balunabba teyafaayo nti omusajja omuto yamusinga okumanyika.

Balunabba yakola kye kimu eri omuvubuka ayitibwa Yokaana Makko. Makko yali abaawukanyeko Pawulo ne Balunabba wakati mu lugendo lwabwe olwasooka. Pawulo yagaana okumutwala nate, era enkaayana yali ya maanyi nnyo ne kiba nti Pawulo ne Balunabba baayawukana (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:37-39). Balunabba yawa Makko omukisa ogw’okubiri. Emyaka bwe gyayitawo, Pawulo yennyini yawandiika nti, “Ggyayo Makko omuleete, kubanga annyamba nnyo mu buweereza” (2 Timoseewo 4:11). Makko yafuuka omuwandiisi w’emu ku Njiri ennya. Singa tekyali Balunabba, twandifiiriddwa Pawulo ne Makko bombi.

Buli kkanisa yeetaaga abantu nga Balunabba: abakulembeze abalaba abalala, ababakkiririzaamu, abeeteeka mu kabi ku lwabwe, era ababawa omukisa ogw’okubiri.

Engeri y’okukuza abakulembeze

Saba era otunule. Yesu yamala ekiro kyonna ng’asaba nga tannalonda Kkumi na Babiri (Lukka 6:12). Saba Katonda akulage b’osaanidde okuteekamu obudde bwo n’amaanyi go. Noonya obwesigwa, enjala ya Katonda n’omwoyo oguyigirizika, so si bitone byokka.

Baleke babeere naawe. Batwale naawe bw’ogenda okukyalira abantu, okubuulira, okusaba oba okugonjoola ebizibu. Baleke balabe obulamu bwo nga bali kumpi. Pawulo yali asobola okugamba nti, “Mundabireko nga nange bwe ndabira ku Kristo” (1 Abakkolinso 11:1), era nti, “Ebyo bye mwayiga, n’ebyo bye mwafuna ne muwulira, ebyo mubirowoozengako” (Abafiripi 4:9).

Bawe omulimu ogwa nnamaddala. Tandika n’ebintu ebitono, oyongerengako nga bwe balaga obwesigwa. Pawulo yagamba nti abo abaagala okuweereza “basookanga kugezesebwa” (1 Timoseewo 3:10). Era yalabula nti, “Toyanguyirizanga kussaako mikono ku muntu yenna” (1 Timoseewo 5:22).

Mwogere ku kyo oluvannyuma. Bwe bamala okukulembera okusoma Bayibuli, okubuulira oba okukyalira omuntu, tuula nabo. Babuuze nti, “Kiki ekyagenze obulungi? Kiki ekyabadde ekizibu? Kiki ky’oyize?” Wano okutendekebwa okusinga obungi okwa nnamaddala we kubeerera.

Zzaamu abavubuka amaanyi. Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo nti, “Waleme kubaawo muntu n’omu akunyooma olw’obuvubuka bwo” (1 Timoseewo 4:12). Mu mpisa nnyingi, abavubuka basuubirwa okulinda emyaka mingi nga tebannakulembera. Okussa ekitiibwa mu bakadde kirungi. Naye tofiiriza birabo Katonda by’awadde abavubuka.

Tendeka abakazi n’abasajja. Pulisikira ne Akula bwe baasisinkana omubuulizi Apolo eyalina ebirabo, bombi awamu “ne bamuyita mu maka gaabwe ne bamunnyonnyola bingi eby’Ekkubo lya Katonda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 18:26). Tujja kweyongera okulowooza ku kino mu Ssuula 26, Abasajja n’Abakazi mu Mulimu gwa Katonda.

Bawe omutima gwo. Pawulo yawandiikira Abasessaloniika nti, “bwe tutyo bwe twabalumirwa omwoyo ne tusanyuka okubatuusaako si Enjiri ya Katonda yokka naye n’okuwaayo emyoyo gyaffe ffe, kubanga mwafuuka baagalwa baffe” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:8). Abakulembeze tebakuzibwa nteekateeka zokka. Bakuzibwa kwagala.

Baleke bakusukkeko. Ekigendererwa si kwekoppa, oba okufuna abagoberezi abakwesigamako emirembe gyonna. Kwe kukuza abakulembeze abalikusinga amaanyi, abaligenda wala okukusinga, era abalitendeka abalala nabo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Polycarp, Irenaeus n’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba

Mu Ssuula 8, Obwesigwa: Omuntu Omu ne mu Kyama, twasisinkana Polycarp, omulabirizi w’e Sumuna eyattibwa ku lwa Kristo mu kyasa eky’okubiri. Polycarp yali ayigiridde ku mutume Yokaana. Era Polycarp naye yayigiriza abasajja abato. Omu ku bo yali Irenaeus, oluvannyuma eyafuuka omulabirizi e Lyon, mu Gaul (kati Bufalansa), era omu ku basomesa abakulu ab’Ekkanisa ey’edda.

Emyaka mingi bwe gyayitawo, Irenaeus yawandiikira mukwano gwe ow’edda eyali avudde ku kukkiriza okw’amazima. Yamujjukiza ennaku ze baawuliririzangamu Polycarp bombi nga bakyali bavubuka. Ebbaluwa eyo yaterekebwa omuwandiisi w’ebyafaayo Eusebius mu kitabo kye Church History (Ebyafaayo by’Ekkanisa), ekiri ku Ochorus:

“Ebyaliwo mu biseera ebyo mbijjukira bulungi okusinga eby’emyaka egiyise gye buvuddeko. Kubanga abalenzi bye bayiga bikulira wamu n’amagezi gaabwe ne bigattibwa nago; n’olwekyo nsobola okunnyonnyola ekifo kyennyini Polycarp eyaweebwa omukisa we yatuulanga ng’ayigiriza, n’okufuluma kwe n’okuyingira kwe, n’engeri gye yatambulirangamu obulamu bwe.”

— Irenaeus, ng’ajuliziddwa mu Eusebius, Church History, Ekitabo V

Mu bigambo ebyangu: ennaku ezo nzijjukira bulungi okusinga emyaka egiyise gye buvuddeko. Bye tuyiga nga tukyali bato bikula naffe ne bifuuka kitundu ku ffe. Nkyasobola okulaba mu birowoozo ekifo Polycarp we yatuulanga n’ayigiriza, engeri gye yajjangamu n’okugenda, n’engeri gye yatambulirangamu obulamu.

Irenaeus yeeyongera okugamba nti Polycarp yabanyumizanga ku mboozi ze yayogeranga ne Yokaana “n’abalala abaalaba Mukama”. Weetegereze Irenaeus kye yajjukira: si bigambo bya Polycarp byokka, wabula obulamu bwe, empisa ze, n’ekifo kyennyini we yatuulanga. Yokaana yayigiriza Polycarp. Polycarp yayigiriza Irenaeus. Irenaeus yayigiriza abalala. Eno ye 2 Timoseewo 2:2 mu byafaayo ebya nnamaddala.

Ebyasa kkumi na munaana oluvannyuma, mu Buvanjuba bwa Afirika, engeri y’emu eyo yalabika. Simeon Nsibambi yali mukozi wa gavumenti ow’eby’obulamu bw’abantu mu Kampala, Uganda, mu myaka gya 1920. Teyayawulibwa olw’obuweereza era teyalina kutendekebwa mu by’eddiini. Mu 1929 yasisinkana omusawo omuminsani Omungereza eyali akooye ayitibwa Joe Church, n’amubuuza ekyali kibulamu mu bulamu bwe. Abasajja abo bombi baafukamira ne basabira wamu, era bombi ne bakyusibwa. Ekitabo Tukutendereza ekiri ku Ochorus kinnyonnyola ebyaddirira. Nsibambi teyazimba kibiina kya nteekateeka. “Yalina abaana mu kukkiriza, nabo ne bazaala abaana, era ekyo ky’ekyali enkola ye yonna.” Yaleeta muganda we mu kukkiriza okulamu. Abalala be yakwatako baatwala obubaka e Rwanda, Kenya n’okusingawo. Okuva mu 1941 yali mulwadde nnyo nga tasobola kuva mu nnyumba ye, era ebisinga obungi yabirabira wala. Naye okuzuukuka kwe yayamba okutandika kwabumba ekkanisa mu Buvanjuba bwa Afirika yonna okumala emirembe n’emirembe.

Joe Church alaga oludda olulala olw’okukuza abakulembeze. Ye yali omuminsani Omuzungu eyatendekebwa, ng’alina ekibiina ky’abaminsani ekimuwagira. Naye yaleka omukristaayo Omufirika ataayawulibwa okumuyigiriza. Era okuzuukuka bwe kwakula, teyeefuula mutwe gwakwo. Nga Tukutendereza bwe kyogera, “Obukulembeze bw’okuzuukuka bwagenda mangu mu mikono gy’Abafirika era ne busigala eyo.” Yali mwetegefu okuba “omusajja omu mu bo mu kifo ky’okubeera waggulu waabwe”.

Ekyo kye kyali Henry Venn, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 4, Okuyitibwa kwa Katonda, kye yali asuubira. Venn yakulembera Church Missionary Society mu London mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omwenda. Yayigiriza nti ekigendererwa ky’omulimu gw’obuminsani kwe kubaawo ekkanisa ezeefuga zokka, ezeeyimirizaawo zokka, era ezeesaasaanya zokka, nga zikulemberwa abantu baazo bennyini. Yagamba nti omulimu gw’omuminsani gusaanidde okutuusa ku lunaku omuminsani lw’atakyetaagibwa.

Terekawo ensigo

Omulimu gwo ogusinga obukulu guyinza obutaba kubuulira kw’obuulira oba bizimbe by’ozimba. Guyinza okuba abantu b’otendeka. Musa yalina Yoswa. Eriya yalina Erisa. Yesu yalina Ekkumi n’Ababiri. Balunabba yalina Pawulo ne Makko. Pawulo yalina Timoseewo. Polycarp yalina Irenaeus. Ggwe olina ani?

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 2 Timoseewo 2:2. Osobola okulondoola emirembe ena egy’okukkiriza mu bulamu bwo? Ani yayigiriza omuntu eyakuyigiriza?
  • Yesu yasooka kulonda Ekkumi n’Ababiri “babeerenga naye”. Abantu b’otendeka bamala biseera bya bungi ki naawe, ebweru w’enkuŋŋaana ez’enteekateeka?
  • Ani abadde Balunabba gy’oli? Ani gw’oyinza okubeera Balunabba gy’ali?
  • Waliwo “Yokaana Makko” mu kkanisa yo, omuntu eyagwa omulundi gumu n’atawebwa mukisa gwa kubiri?
  • Irenaeus yajjukira ki ku Polycarp? Abantu b’otendeka balikujjukira ku ki?
  • Singa ova mu kkanisa yo enkya, ani yandibadde mwetegefu okukulembera?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Saba wiiki eno Katonda akulage omuntu omu oba babiri abeesigwa b’osaanidde okuteekamu obudde bwo. Oluvannyuma yita omu ku bo ajje naawe omulundi oguddako bw’onookulembera, bw’onookyalira omuntu, bw’onoobuulira oba bw’onoosaba n’omuntu. Oluvannyuma, tuula naye omubuuze nti, “Kiki ky’olabye? Kiki ky’oyize? Kiki ky’oyandikoze mu ngeri endala?” Teekateeka okumuwa omulimu ogwa nnamaddala okukola mu mwezi ogujja, n’okwogera naye ku gwo oluvannyuma.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze akuza atya abakulembeze abapya?
study_questions.answer: Ng’ayisa bye yafuna eri abalala abasobola okuyigiriza n’abalala: “biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala” (2 Timoseewo 2:2). Olunyiriri luno lulimu emirembe ena egy’abakulembeze.

study_questions.question: Yesu yatendeka atya abayigirizwa be?
study_questions.answer: “N’alonda kkumi na babiri mu abo, be yafuula abatume babeerenga naye, era abatumenga okubuulira” (Makko 3:14). Baasooka kubeera naye, oluvannyuma n’abatuma okuweereza, era oluvannyuma n’atuma abalala nsanvu mu babiri “babiri babiri bamukulembere” (Lukka 10:1).

study_questions.question: Kiki kye tuyinza okuyiga ku Musa ne Yoswa ku kutendeka abakulembeze?
study_questions.answer: Musa yakuuma Yoswa kumpi naye okumala emyaka, n’amuzzaamu amaanyi mu lwatu ng’agamba nti, “Beera wa maanyi era ogume omwoyo” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 31:7), era n’amuteekako emikono, Yoswa n’aba “ajjudde omwoyo ogw’amagezi” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 34:9). Abakulembeze bakuzibwa mu bbanga, nga bayita mu kyokulabirako n’obwesige.

fields.title: Obumu n’Okuleeta Emirembe
fields.body_html:
“bonna babeere bumu, nga ggwe Kitange bw’oli mu Nze, nange nga ndi mu ggwe, nabo babeerenga mu ffe, ensi eryoke ekkirize nga ggwe wantuma.”

— Yokaana 17:21

Olweyo olukoleddwa mu kisubi kimu tekiyinza kwera wansi. Kiweta ne kimenyeka. Naye ebisubi bingi bwe bisibibwa wamu, olweyo luba lwa maanyi ne lukola omulimu gwalwo. Mu mpisa nnyingi waliwo olugero olufaanana bwe lutyo. Omuggo gumu gumenyeka mangu. Omuganda gw’emiggo tegumenyeka.

Mu kiro ekyasooka okufa kwe, Yesu yasabira Ekkanisa ye. Mu byonna bye yandisabidde ku lwaffe, yasaba kino: nti “bonna babeere bumu” (Yokaana 17:21). Era n’awa n’ensonga: “ensi eryoke ekkirize nga ggwe wantuma.” Obumu bw’abantu be kitundu ku bubaka. Abakristaayo bwe beeyawulamu, ensi ekaluubirirwa okukkiriza. Bwe baba obumu, ensi erabayo ekintu ky’etasobola kunnyonnyola.

Mu ssuula ebbiri eziwedde twalaba nti abakulembeze balina okukolera mu bibinja era n’okukuza abakulembeze abalala. Naye ebibinja bisobola okuyombagana. Ekkanisa zisobola okwekutulamu. Abakristaayo basobola okunyoomagana olw’ekika, olulimi, eddaala mu bantu oba ekkanisa gye basinzizaamu. Essuula eno yogera ku buvunaanyizibwa bw’omukulembeze okukuuma obumu n’okuleeta emirembe.

Obumu kirabo kya kukuumibwa

Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Munyiikirenga okukuuma obumu obw’Omwoyo mu kwegatta awamu okw’emirembe” (Abaefeso 4:3). Weetegereze ebintu bibiri.

Ekisooka, obumu buno “bw’Omwoyo”: Omwoyo y’abuwa. Si ffe tubutonda. Abantu bwe bajja eri Kristo, bagattibwa gy’ali era ne ku bannaabwe olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Pawulo yeeyongera n’agamba nti, “Omubiri nga bwe guli ogumu, n’Omwoyo omu … Mukama waffe ali omu, n’okukkiriza kumu n’okubatizibwa kumu. Katonda ali omu, era ye Kitaawe wa bonna” (Abaefeso 4:4-6). Obumu bwaffe buliwo dda ddala, kubanga bwesigamye ku ekyo Katonda ky’akoze.

Eky’okubiri, tulina “okukuuma” obumu obwo, era “okunyiikira” okukikola. Obumu bufaanana omuliro. Katonda y’agukoleeza, naye ffe tulina okugukuuma, oba si ekyo gujja kuzikira. Pawulo atubuulira engeri: “Mubeerenga bakkakkamu, abawombeefu era abagumiikiriza, nga mugumiikirizagana mu kwagala” (Abaefeso 4:2). Obukkakkamu, obuwombeefu, okugumiikiriza n’okwagala. Bino bye bikozesebwa by’obumu. Amalala, obukambwe n’obutagumiikiriza bibuzikiriza.

Abantu abapya abali omu

Ekkanisa ey’olubereberye yali ekoleddwa mu bantu abaali bakyawagana. Abayudaaya n’Abamawanga. Abaddu ne bakama baabwe. Abasajja n’abakazi abaali batayisibwangako ng’abenkanankana. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Tewakyali kusosola wakati wa Muyudaaya na Muyonaani, wakati wa muddu na wa ddembe, wakati wa musajja na mukazi, kubanga mwenna muli omu mu Kristo Yesu” (Abaggalatiya 3:28).

Pawulo teyategeeza nti enjawukana zino zaggwaawo. Omuyudaaya yali akyali Muyudaaya, n’omuddu yali akyali muddu mu mateeka g’Abaruumi. Yategeeza nti mu Kristo, enjawukana zino tezikyatwawula wadde okututeeka mu madaala. “Kristo gy’emirembe gyaffe, oyo eyatufuula ffe Abayudaaya nammwe Abaamawanga, okuba omuntu omu, ng’amenyeewo ekisenge ekya wakati eky’obulabe, ekyatwawulanga” (Abaefeso 2:14).

Era ekifaananyi kya Bayibuli ekisembayo eky’Ekkanisa kye kimu. Yokaana yalaba “ekibiina ky’abantu ekinene ennyo nga tebasoboka na kubalika, nga bava mu buli nsi na buli kika, na buli ggwanga na buli lulimi, nga bayimiridde mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka ne mu maaso g’Omwana gw’Endiga” (Okubikkulirwa 7:9). Buli kika. Buli lulimi. Wamu, nga basinza Mukama omu.

Kino kusoomoozebwa kunene eri abakulembeze mu nsi yaffe. Mu bifo bingi, ekkanisa zeeyawuddemu okusinziira ku bika oba amawanga, abagagga n’abaavu, abakadde n’abavubuka, oba olulimi lumu n’olulala. Oluusi abakulembeze bennyini bakikubiriza, kubanga kyangu okukulembera abantu abatufaanana. Naye ekkanisa eyaniriza ekika ky’abantu kimu kyokka ebuulira enjiri entono okusinga eya Bayibuli. Tujja kutunuulira ekibi ky’obukyayi bw’ebika n’okusosola mu bujjuvu mu Ssuula 36, Obuggya, Okuvuganya n’Okusosola.

“Nze ndi wa Pawulo”

Ekkanisa y’omu Kkolinso yali ejjudde abantu abalina ebirabo. Naye era yali ejjudde enkaayana. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “buli omu ku mmwe agamba nti ‘nze ndi wa Pawulo,’ ‘nze ndi wa Apolo,’ ‘nze ndi wa Keefa,’ ‘nze ndi wa Kristo.’ Kale Kristo ayawuliddwamu? Pawulo yakomererwa ku musaalaba ku lwammwe?” (1 Abakkolinso 1:12-13).

Abakkolinso baali beeyawulamu nga beetooloola abakulembeze. Buli kibinja kyalina omubuulizi gwe kyasinga okwagala. Pawulo yagaana okuba omukulu w’ekiwayi. Yagamba nti, “Kale Apolo ye ani? Ne Pawulo ye ani? Baweereza buweereza ababakkirizisa” (1 Abakkolinso 3:5).

Abakulembeze leero boolekagana n’okukemebwa kwe kumu. Kiwooma okuba n’ekibinja ky’abantu abakwesigwa, abakwagala okusinga abakulembeze abalala. Abakulembeze abamu n’okukikubiriza bakikubiriza. Boogera mu kyama nga bavvoola abasumba abalala. Bazimba obwakabaka bwabwe obutono munda mu kkanisa, oba basika abantu okubaggya mu kkanisa emu ne batandikawo eyaabwe. Kino kibi kya maanyi. Kiyisa omubiri gwa Kristo nga gwe tulina obuyinza okwawulamu.

Kino kye kigezo eri buli mukulembeze: nzimba kibinja kyange, oba Kkanisa ya Kristo? Nsanyuka ekkanisa endala bw’ekula, oba mpulira nga ntiisibwa? Njogera bulungi ku bakulembeze abalala abeesigwa, oba nnoonya amakubo okwefuula omulungi okubasinga?

Okukkiriziganya mu Mukama waffe

Si buli butali bumu nti buva ku njigiriza enkulu. Emirundi mingi buva ku bantu babiri abatasobola kukwatagana. Mu kkanisa y’e Firipi, mwalimu abakazi babiri, Ewudiya ne Sintuke, abaali bakoze ne Pawulo n’obwesigwa. Naye kati baali bafunye obutakkaanya. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Ewudiya ne Sintuke mbeegayirira mukkiriziganye mu Mukama waffe. Era ggwe mukozi munnange, nkusaba oyambenga abakazi abo” (Abafiripi 4:2-3).

Weetegereze ebintu bisatu. Pawulo yayogera ku kizibu mu lwatu, naye mu bukkakkamu. Teyayingira ludda lwonna. Era yasaba omukulembeze omulala okubayamba okutabagana. Omukulembeze omugezi tabuusa maaso nkaayana wakati w’abakkiriza. Bwe zirekebwa, zeeyongera ne zisaasaana. Naye era omukulembeze omugezi tayanguwa kuyingira kusala musango. Ayamba enjuyi zombi okukkiriziganya “mu Mukama waffe”.

Yesu yagamba nti okutabagana kwanguwa okusinga okusinza: “Bw’obanga oli mu maaso ga Katonda, ng’omuleetedde ekirabo eky’okuwaayo nga ssaddaaka, n’ojjukira nga waliwo gw’olinako ensonga, ekirabo kyo sooka okireke awo oddeyo omale okumwetondera mutegeeragane, olyoke okomewo oweeyo ekirabo kyo eri Katonda” (Matayo 5:23-24).

Omulimu gw’omutabaganya

Yesu yagamba nti, “Balina omukisa abatabaganya, kubanga abo baliyitibwa baana ba Katonda” (Matayo 5:9). Weetegereze nti teyagamba nti “abo abasirika” oba “abo abeewala emitawaana”. Yagamba abatabaganya. Okuleeta emirembe mulimu gwa kukola. Zino ze ngeri ezimu abakulembeze gye bakikolamu.

  • Sooka oleete emirembe mu nkolagana zo ggwe. “Mukolenga kyonna ekisoboka okutabagana n’abantu bonna” (Abaruumi 12:18). Omukulembeze alwana n’abalala tasobola kubatabaganya.
  • Wuliriza enjuyi zombi. Nga tonnayogera, tegeera. Enkaayana ezisinga obungi zirimu obulumi ku njuyi zombi.
  • Yogera ku kizibu mu mazima. Emirembe si kwefuula nti tewali kikyamu. Emirembe egya nnamaddala emirundi mingi gijja nga amazima gamaze okwogerwa.
  • Yita abantu basonyiwe. “Bwe wabangawo omuntu yenna alina ensonga ku munne, muzibiikirizaganenga, era musonyiwaganenga. Nga Mukama waffe bwe yabasonyiwa era nammwe musonyiwaganenga” (Abakkolosaayi 3:13).
  • Nywerera ku bikulu, era beera mugabi ku nsonga endala. “Mwanirizenga omunafu mu kukkiriza, nga temumusalira musango” (Abaruumi 14:1). Si buli njawukana esaanidde kulwanirwa.
  • Gaana olugambo. Toddamu mboozi zoonoona abalala. Era toziwuliriza.
  • Leeta abantu ku musaalaba. Wansi w’omusaalaba ffenna tuli boonoonyi abaalokolebwa olw’ekisa. Tewali n’omu awo asinga munne.

Obumu n’amazima

Obumu tebutegeeza nti amazima tegalina makulu. Yesu yasabira obumu mu kusaba kwe kumu mwe yagambira nti, “ekigambo kyo ge mazima” (Yokaana 17:17). Pawulo, eyakola ennyo ku lw’obumu, era yalabula n’amaanyi ku njigiriza ez’obulimba (Abaggalatiya 1:6-9). Waliwo ebiseera abakulembeze abeesigwa lwe balina okwawukana ku njigiriza eyegaana enjiri.

Naye okwekutulamu kungi mu byafaayo by’Ekkanisa tekwali ku njiri n’akatono. Kwali ku malala g’abakulembeze, ku ssente, ku bika, oba ku nsonga entono ez’enkola. Olugero olw’ekyasa eky’ekkumi n’omusanvu lukyogera bulungi: “Mu bikulu obumu, mu bitali bikulu eddembe, mu byonna okwagala.” Mu bigambo ebyangu: mukkiriziganye ku ebyo ebikulu, muwe eddembe ku ebyo ebitali bikulu, era mwagalanenga mu buli kimu. Olugero olwo lwasooka okuwandiikibwa omusomesa Omulutheri Omugirimaani ayitibwa Rupertus Meldenius mu biseera by’entalo ez’eddiini ez’entiisa ez’omu mirembe gye. Oluvannyuma lwayagalibwa era ne luddiŋŋanwa Richard Baxter, omusumba Omungereza gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 9, Mwekuume Mwekka, eyayaayaanira okulaba Abakristaayo ab’ekkanisa ez’enjawulo nga babeera mu mirembe.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Clement, Cyprian ne Gahini

Ku nkomerero y’ekyasa ekisooka, ekkanisa y’e Kkolinso yali nate yeeyawuddemu. Abamu ku bammemba abato baali bagobye abakadde baabwe abeesigwa. Ekkanisa y’e Rooma yabaweereza ebbaluwa, gye tumanyi nga Ebbaluwa Esooka eya Clement eri Abakkolinso. Y’emu ku biwandiiko by’Ekikristaayo ebisinga obukadde ebitali mu Ndagaano Empya, era eri ku Ochorus. Clement yawandiika nti:

“Lwaki mubaamu empaka, n’okusasamala, n’okwawukana, n’enjawukana, n’entalo mu mmwe? Tetulina [ffenna] Katonda omu ne Kristo omu? Tewali Mwoyo omu ow’ekisa eyatufukibwako? Era tetulina kuyitibwa kumu mu Kristo? Lwaki twawula era ne tuyuzaayuza ebitundu bya Kristo?”

— Clement ow’e Rooma, Ebbaluwa Esooka eya Clement eri Abakkolinso

Mu bigambo ebyangu: lwaki mulwana era mwawukana? Ffenna tetulina Katonda omu, Kristo omu, Omwoyo Omutukuvu omu n’okuyitibwa kumu? Lwaki tuyuza omubiri gwa Kristo? Clement era yabagamba nti, “Mukwate ebbaluwa ya Omutume Pawulo alina omukisa”, ng’abajjukiza nti Pawulo yali yabawandiikira dda ku kizibu kyennyini kino.

Emyaka kikumi mu ataano oluvannyuma, Cyprian yali mulabirizi w’e Carthage mu Afirika ey’Obukiikakkono. Oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera eky’okuyigganyizibwa okw’obukambwe, ekkanisa eyo yayuzibwamu olw’enkaayana ku ngeri y’okuyisaamu abakkiriza abaali beegaanye Kristo nga banyigirizibwa. Ebibinja ebivuganya byassaawo abalabirizi abavuganya. Cyprian yawandiika ekitabo ekiyitibwa On the Unity of the Church (Ku Bumu bw’Ekkanisa), kati ekiri mu Treatises of Cyprian (Ebiwandiiko bya Cyprian) ku Ochorus. Yakozesa ebifaananyi okuva mu butonde:

“Ng’enjuba bw’erina emisana emingi, naye ng’ekitangaala kimu; n’omuti amatabi amangi, naye ng’amaanyi gamu agasimbiddwa mu kikolo kyagwo ekinywevu; era ng’okuva mu luzzi olumu bwe muva emigga emingi … naye obumu bukyakuumibwa mu nsibuko.”

— Cyprian ow’e Carthage, On the Unity of the Church

Mu bigambo ebyangu: enjuba erina emisana mingi naye ekitangaala kimu. Omuti gulina amatabi mangi naye ekikolo kimu eky’amaanyi. Emigga mingi gikulukuta okuva mu luzzi lumu. Mu ngeri y’emu, Ekkanisa esaasaanidde wala na buli wamu, naye emu, kubanga eva mu nsibuko emu. Cyprian yayongerako nti ettabi erimenyeddwa ku muti teriyinza kumera nnyondo.

Mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri, ku ddwaliro ly’abaminsani e Gahini mu Rwanda, waaliwo obutakkaanya obwa nnamaddala wakati w’abakozi Abafirika n’abaminsani Abazungu, ku nsonga z’obuyinza, ssente n’okuweebwa ekitiibwa. Omu ku bakozi Abafirika, Yosiya Kinuka, yali wakati mu nsonga eyo. Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba bwe kwajja, tekwabikka ku nkaayana eyo. Nga ekitabo Tukutendereza bwe kyogera, okuzuukuka kye kwakola kwe kuli nti “kwabuleeta mu lwatu era ne kwetaagisa enjuyi zombi okwatula.” Abafirika n’Abazungu beenenya buli omu eri munne. Ekitabo kiggyamu ekyokuyiga buli mukulembeze ky’asaanidde okuwulira: “Obumu obutaliiko kye bukusaba si bumu.” Ebisinga obungi bye tuyita obumu, bwe kigamba, “kukkiriziganya obutayogera ku bintu.” Obumu obwa nnamaddala bwakolebwa e Gahini “wakati w’abantu abaali batakkiriziganya ddala.”

Ensi eryoke ekkirize

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yayimba nti, “Laba bwe kiri ekirungi era nga kisanyusa, abooluganda okubeera awamu nga batabaganye” (Zabbuli 133:1). Yesu yagamba nti, “Bwe munaayagalananga abantu bonna kwe banaategeereranga nti muli bayigirizwa bange” (Yokaana 13:35).

Ekkanisa eyeeyawuddemu ebuulira enjiri ennafu, ne bwe kiba nti okubuulira kwayo kulungi kutya. Ekkanisa ey’obumu, abantu ab’ebika eby’enjawulo, amadaala ag’enjawulo n’ennimi ez’enjawulo mwe baagalanira, ebuulira enjiri ey’amaanyi nga tennayogera na kigambo. Abakulembeze ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala bajja kunyiikira okukuuma obumu obwo, era baliyitibwa baana ba Katonda.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Yokaana 17:20-23. Olowooza lwaki Yesu yayunga obumu bw’abantu be ku nsi okumukkiriza?
  • Ekkanisa yo yeeyawuddemu okusinziira ku bika, amadaala mu bantu, olulimi oba emyaka? Kiki ekyetaagisa okukikyusa?
  • Ozimba kibinja kyo, oba Kkanisa ya Kristo? Owulira otya ekkanisa endala oba omukulembeze omulala bw’akola obulungi?
  • Waliwo omuntu gw’olina okutabagana naye nga tonnaddamu kukulembera kusinza (Matayo 5:23-24)?
  • Nsonga ki mu kkanisa yo enkulu, era ziriwa ezitali nkulu abantu ze basaanidde okubeeramu eddembe?
  • Gahini eyigiriza ki ku njawulo wakati w’okusirisa obusirisa enkaayana n’okuleeta emirembe egya nnamaddala?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Lowooza ku nkolagana eyonoonese mu kkanisa yo, oba wakati wo n’omukulembeze omulala oba ekkanisa endala. Gisabire buli lunaku wiiki eno. Oluvannyuma kola ekigere kimu eky’okuleeta emirembe: okukyala, okukuba essimu, okwetonda, oba okwewaayo okuyamba abantu abalala babiri okusisinkana. Bw’oba ggwe walumya, kyogere mu lwatu. Era wiiki eno, yogera bulungi mu lujjudde ku mukulembeze omu omwesigwa ow’ekkanisa endala oba ekibinja ekirala, era osabire omulimu gwe.

study_questions.question: Lwaki obumu bukulu mu kkanisa?
study_questions.answer: Yesu yasaba nti abagoberezi be bonna “babeere bumu” ensi eryoke ekkirize (Yokaana 17:21). Obumu kirabo ky’Omwoyo kye tulina okukuuma: “Munyiikirenga okukuuma obumu obw’Omwoyo mu kwegatta awamu okw’emirembe” (Abaefeso 4:3).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okuba omutabaganya?
study_questions.answer: Ng’abeera mukkakkamu, muwombeefu era mugumiikiriza, “nga mugumiikirizagana mu kwagala” (Abaefeso 4:2), ng’agaana okwegatta ku biwayi, era ng’ayamba abantu okukkiriziganya mu Mukama waffe. Kristo “gy’emirembe gyaffe … ng’amenyeewo ekisenge ekya wakati eky’obulabe, ekyatwawulanga” (Abaefeso 2:14).

study_questions.question: Obumu bulina okukuumibwa ne bwe kiba nga kigula amazima?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Obumu n’amazima bitambulira wamu. Essuula ennyonnyola engeri y’okunywerera ku bikulu eby’okukkiriza ate ng’olaga ekisa ku nsonga ezitali nkulu, ng’eyigira ku Clement, Cyprian n’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba e Gahini mu Rwanda.

fields.title: Okuvumirirwa, Okuziyizibwa n’Enkaayana
fields.body_html:
“Okuddamu n’eggonjebwa kumalawo ekiruyi, naye ekigambo eky’obukambwe kisaanuula obusungu.”

— Engero 15:1

Omuti ogukula ne guwanvuwa gukwatibwa embuyaga nnyingi. Ebisaka ebitono ebiri wansi tebiwulira nnyo kibuyaga, naye omuti omuwanvu gwewetamu ne gunyeenyezebwa. Bwe kiri ne ku bakulembeze. Akaseera k’oyimirirako okukulembera, ojja kuvumirirwa. Okuvumirirwa okumu kujja kuba kwa butuukirivu. Okulala kujja kuba kwa butali bwenkanya. Abantu abamu bajja kukuziyiza mu lwatu. Era ekiseera kijja kutuuka, n’ojja kwesanga mu nkaayana n’omukulembeze omulala, oboolyawo ne mukwano gwo omulungi.

Tewali mukulembeze akiwona. Musa teyakiwona. Nekkemiya teyakiwona. Pawulo teyakiwona. Ne Yesu yennyini teyakiwona. Ekibuuzo si nti ojja kwolekagana n’okuvumirirwa, okuziyizibwa n’enkaayana, wabula nti ojja kubyanukula otya. Essuula eno etunuulira ebyo byonsatule.

Okukkiriza okuvumirirwa

Omuntu bw’atuvumirira, ekintu kye tusooka okukola kitera okuba okwerwanako. Twennyonnyola, tuwakana, oba tuddamu okulumba. Oluusi tusirika ne tulera obulumi bwaffe okumala wiiki nnyingi.

Bayibuli etuyita okwanukula mu ngeri endala. “Buli asanyukira okukangavvulwa ayagala amagezi; naye oyo akyawa okunenyezebwa musirusiru” (Engero 12:1). “Ekkubo ly’omusirusiru ddungi mu kulaba kwe ye, naye omugezi assaayo omwoyo ku magezi agamuweebwa” (Engero 12:15). Yakobo ayongerako nti, “Buli muntu abeerenga mwangu wa kuwulira, kyokka alemenga kubuguutana kwogera, era alemenga kwanguwa kunyiiga” (Yakobo 1:19).

Bw’ovumirirwa, gezaako emitendera gino.

  • Yimirira osooke osabe nga tonnaddamu. Toddamu ng’obusungu bukyali bwa bbugumu. Obubaka obuwandiikiddwa mu busungu emirundi mingi bwejjusibwa.
  • Weebuuze nti, “Kino kirimu amazima gonna?” Ne okuvumirirwa okutali kwa bwenkanya emirundi mingi kulimu akatundu k’amazima. Katonda bw’aba akukozesa okukulaga ekintu, kikkirize.
  • Lowooza ku oyo akwogeddeko, naye tokigaana butereevu. Omuntu akukyawa ayinza okuba ng’atuufu. Mukwano gwo ayinza okuba ng’akyamye.
  • Weebaze omuntu oyo bw’oba osobola. Abantu abasinga obungi kibeetaagisa obuvumu okuvumirira omukulembeze. Bwe baba bazze gy’oli butereevu, ekyo kisinga okukwogerako ng’otaliiwo.
  • Kyusa ekyetaaga okukyusibwa. Okuvumirirwa bwe kuba okw’amazima, kikkirize mu lwatu, era okole ekintu ku kyo.
  • Leka ekyo eky’obulimba. Bwe kiba nga si kya mazima, kikwase Katonda weeyongere mu maaso.

Kabaka Dawudi bwe yali adduka mutabani we Abusaalomu, omusajja erinnya lye Simeeyi yatambula ku mabbali g’ekkubo ng’amukolimira era ng’amukasuukirira amayinja. Omu ku baserikale ba Dawudi yayagala okumutta. Naye Dawudi n’agamba nti, “Mumuleke, akolime, kubanga Mukama amulagidde. Oboolyawo Mukama anaalaba okunakuwala kwange n’ansasula obulungi olw’okukolima okwo” (2 Samwiri 16:11-12). Dawudi teyalowooza nti bulijjo ye yali mutuufu. Yali mwetegefu okukkiriza nti Katonda ayinza okuba ng’ayogera naye, ne bw’aba ng’ayita mu mulabe.

Obutatwala buli kigambo ku mutima

Mu kiseera kye kimu, omukulembeze tasobola kwetikka buli kigambo ekimwogerwako. Omubuulizi mu kitabo ky’Omubuulizi awa amagezi ag’omugaso: “Towulirizanga buli kigambo, bantu kye boogera, si kulwa ng’owulira omuweereza wo ng’akukolimira, kubanga naawe okimanyidde ddala mu mutima gwo, ng’emirundi mingi okolimidde abalala” (Omubuulizi 7:21-22).

Mu bigambo ebirala, abantu bajja kukwogerako ebigambo ebitali bya kisa. Tobinoonya. Era jjukira nti naawe wali oyogedde ebigambo ebitali bya kisa ku balala. Ekyo kisaanidde okukufuula omwetoowaze, era kisaanidde okukufuula omugumiikiriza.

Abakulembeze abamu balumwa enjala y’okusiimibwa nnyo ne kiba nti buli kuvumirirwa kubafumita nnyo. Tebasobola kuwummula okutuusa nga buli muntu abasanyukira. Buno buddu bwa ngeri emu. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Singa nnali nkyagezaako okusanyusa abantu, sandibadde muddu wa Kristo” (Abaggalatiya 1:10). Tuweereza Mukama omu. Ky’alowooza ku ffe kye kisinga obukulu.

Okwolekagana n’okuziyizibwa: Nekkemiya

Nekkemiya yali mukungu Omuyudaaya mu lubiri lwa kabaka wa Buperusi, eyaddayo e Yerusaalemi okuddamu okuzimba bbugwe waayo eyali amenyese. Okuva ku lunaku olwasooka, yasanga okuziyizibwa. Abalabe be, Sanubalaati ne Tobiya, baakozesa kumpi buli kyakulwanyisa abaziyiza kye bakyakozesa ne leero.

Okuduulirwa. “Bano Abayudaaya abanafu bali ku ki? Balizzaawo bbugwe waabwe?” Tobiya n’ayongerako nti, “Ebyo bye bazimba, singa ekibe kinaalinnyako kinaasuula bbugwe waabwe ow’amayinja!” (Nekkemiya 4:2-3). Nekkemiya teyabaddamu. Yasaba era n’agenda mu maaso n’okukola.

Okutiisibwatiisibwa. Abalabe baateekateeka okulumba. Nekkemiya yaddamu mu ngeri ennyangu era ey’ensalesale: “Ne tusaba eri Katonda waffe, ne tuteekawo n’abakuumi abaakuumanga emisana n’ekiro” (Nekkemiya 4:9). Yeesiga Katonda era n’akola ekyali eky’amagezi. Yagamba abantu abaali batidde nti, “Temubatya. Mujjukire Mukama, omukulu era ow’entiisa” (Nekkemiya 4:14).

Okuwugulibwa. Abalabe be baamuyita mu lukiiko, nga bateekateeka okumukola akabi. Nekkemiya yaddamu nti, “Nnina omulimu munene, siisobole kuserengeta gye muli. Lwaki ndeka omulimu ne nzija okubasisinkana?” (Nekkemiya 6:3). Si buli kuyitibwa kwa kuwakana nti kusaanidde kuddibwamu. Okuziyizibwa okumu kuteekebwateekebwa lwa kuyimiriza mulimu kyokka.

Obulimba n’okutiisibwa. Baasaasaanya ebigambo eby’obulimba ku ye era ne bagezaako okumutiisa yeekweke mu yeekaalu (Nekkemiya 6:5-13). Nekkemiya yagaana okukola olw’okutya.

Era bbugwe yaggwa mu nnaku amakumi ataano mu bbiri (Nekkemiya 6:15). Abalabe baggwaamu obuvumu bwonna, “kubanga baalaba ng’omulimu gwakolebwa olw’okubeerwa kwa Katonda waffe” (Nekkemiya 6:16).

Okwolekagana n’okuziyizibwa: Musa

Okuziyizibwa okumu kuva munda mu bantu ba Katonda. Mu ddungu, omusajja erinnya lye Koola, wamu n’abakulembeze ebikumi bibiri mu ataano, baasituka ne balwanyisa Musa ne Alooni. Baagamba nti, “Mwekulumbaza nnyo! … Kale, lwaki mwekulumbaliza ku kibiina ky’abantu ba Mukama?” (Okubala 16:3).

Laba Musa kye yakola: “Musa bwe yakiwulira n’avuunama wansi” (Okubala 16:4). Kye yasooka okukola tekyali kuwakana oba kuddamu kulwana. Kyali kuvuunama mu maaso ga Katonda. Oluvannyuma yaleka okusala omusango eri Katonda. Bayibuli egamba nti “Musa yali musajja muwombeefu nnyo, nga muteefu okusinga abantu bonna abaali ku nsi” (Okubala 12:3). Omukulembeze omwetoowaze teyeetaaga kulwanirira kifo kye. Akireka mu mikono gya Katonda.

Lino lye kkubo lya Yesu. “Bwe yavumibwa, ye teyavuma. Era abaamubonyaabonya teyabeewerera, wabula yeewaayo eri Katonda alamula awatali kusaliriza” (1 Peetero 2:23). Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Temusasulanga kibi olw’ekibi … Towangulwanga kibi, naye wangulanga ekibi ng’okola obulungi” (Abaruumi 12:17, 21).

Enkaayana wakati w’abakulembeze

Oboolyawo enkaayana esinga obuzibu ye eyo ebaawo wakati w’abakulembeze abalungi abaagala Katonda. Bayibuli kino ekyogera mu bwesimbu. Pawulo ne Balunabba baali bakoze wamu okumala emyaka. Balunabba ye yali ayingizza Pawulo mu buweereza. Naye bwe baali bateekateeka olugendo lwabwe olw’okubiri, ne batakkaanya ku Yokaana Makko, eyali abaawukanyeko ku lugendo lwabwe olwasooka. “Ne balemwa okukkiriziganya mu nsonga eyo, n’ekyavaamu kwe kwawukana. Balunabba n’atwala Makko ne basaabala ku nnyanja okulaga mu Kupulo. Pawulo n’alonda Siira” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:39-40).

Lunyiriri lwa nnaku. Naye Katonda yakozesa ne kino. Mu kifo ky’ekibinja ky’abaminsani kimu, kaakano waaliwo bibiri. Pawulo yagenda mu maaso “nga bagenda bagumya ekkanisa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:41). Balunabba yawa Makko omukisa ogw’okubiri, era Makko oluvannyuma yafuuka wa mugaso ne eri Pawulo yennyini (2 Timoseewo 4:11). Emboozi tekoma ku nkaayana.

Waliwo ekika ekirala eky’enkaayana mu Bikolwa by’Abatume 15: obutakkaanya ku njigiriza. Abasomesa abamu baagamba nti abakkiriza Abamawanga baalina okukomolebwa okusobola okulokolebwa. “Pawulo ne Balunabba ne bawakana nnyo nabo ku nsonga eyo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:2). Ekkanisa tekyabuusa maaso, era teyakyekutulamu. “Awo abatume n’abakadde b’Ekkanisa ne bakuŋŋaana bateese ku nsonga eyo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:6). Baawuliriziganya, ne batunuulira Katonda kye yali akola, ne banoonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa, era ne batuuka ku kusalawo kwe bakkiriziganyaako: “kwe kuteesa kwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu, era naffe” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:28).

Gano ge magezi ag’enkaayana wakati w’abakulembeze:

  • Musisinkane maaso ku maaso. Temulwanira mu bbaluwa, mu bubaka oba mu ngambo.
  • Sooka owulirize. Kakasa nti otegedde endowooza ya munno nga tonnagiddamu.
  • Yawula omuntu ku nsonga. Muyinza obutakkaanya n’amaanyi naye ne mweyongera okwagalana n’okussaŋŋana ekitiibwa.
  • Mutunuulire Ebyawandiikibwa wamu. Ekigambo kya Katonda, so si malala ga muntu, kye kiba omulamuzi.
  • Manya ekisinga obukulu. Enjawukana ezimu zikwata ku njiri. Ezisinga obungi tezikwatako.
  • Bwe kiba nga mulina okwawukana, mwawukane bulungi. Temwogera bubi ku bannammwe oluvannyuma. Musabiraganenga. Muleke oluggi nga luggule olw’okutabagana.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: John Wesley ne George Whitefield

John Wesley ne George Whitefield be baali ababuulizi ababiri abasinga obukulu mu kuzuukuka okw’ekyasa eky’ekkumi n’omunaana mu Bungereza ne mu Amerika. Baali mikwano mu Oxford. Whitefield ye yasooka okusikiriza Wesley okubuulira ebweru mu bbanga, eri ebibiina by’abantu enkumi n’enkumi. Mu myaka egyasooka baakoleranga wamu.

Naye baatuuka okutakkaanya ennyo ku kibuuzo ky’enjigiriza: engeri Katonda okulonda abantu okulokolebwa gye kukwataganamu n’eddembe ly’omuntu ery’okwesalirawo. Whitefield yalina endowooza emu ate Wesley endala. Bombi baafulumya endowooza zaabwe, era enkaayana n’efuuka ya lwatu. Journal ya Wesley (ebiwandiiko bye ebya buli lunaku), eri ku Ochorus, ewandiika olukuŋŋaana olwalimu obulumi mu Marisi 1741. Whitefield yamugamba “nti ye nange twabuulira enjiri bbiri ez’enjawulo; n’olwekyo si kuba nti teyandyegasse nange oba okumpa omukono ogwa ddyo ogw’okussa ekimu kyokka, naye yali amaliridde okubuulira mu lwatu ng’alwanyisa nze ne muganda wange.” Abagoberezi baabwe ne beegatta ku njuyi. Ekibiina ne kyekutulamu.

Naye ne mu kiseera enkaayana we yali esinga okubuguma, Wesley yalaga ekisa ekimu. Ebbaluwa ey’ekyama Whitefield gye yawandiika ng’amulumba bwe yakubibwa mu kyapa awatali lukusa n’egabibwa eri abantu ba Wesley bennyini, Wesley yagamba ekibiina nti, “Nja kukola ddala kye ndowooza nti Mr. Whitefield yandikoze, singa yali wano yennyini.” Oluvannyuma n’agiyuza mu maaso gaabwe, era abalala bonna ne bakola bwe batyo.

Ekiseera bwe kyagenda kiyitawo, abasajja abo bombi baatabagana. Tebakkiriziganya ddala ku njigiriza eyo. Naye baddamu okulabagana ng’ab’oluganda mu Kristo, ne babuulira mu bisinzizo bya bannaabwe, era ne boogeragana bulungi n’okwagala. Whitefield bwe yafiira mu Amerika mu 1770, yali asabye Wesley abuulire mu kuziika kwe e London. Wesley yawandiika mu Journal ye nti:

“Ekibiina ky’abantu ekinene ennyo kyali kikuŋŋaanye okuva mu buli nsonda y’ekibuga … Kyali kiseera kya ntiisa: bonna baali basirise ng’ekiro; abasinga baalabika ng’abakwatiddwako ennyo mu mitima.”

— John Wesley, Journal, Novemba 1770

Mu bigambo ebyangu: ekibiina ky’abantu ekinene ennyo kyajja okuva mu buli kitundu ky’ekibuga. Kyali kiseera kya kitiibwa era kya buzito. Buli muntu yali asirise ddala, era abasinga baakwatibwako nnyo mu mitima. Wesley yasaba Katonda akozese omukolo ogwo okuyita “abaana be bonna okwagalana”. Era yasuubira nti Katonda yali akubye “ekikonde ku bukakanyavu bw’endowooza obwali bufuze okumala emyaka mingi”, omwoyo omufunda ogwali gwawudde ebibinja ebyo ebibiri.

Emboozi ya Wesley ne Whitefield eraga nti n’abakulembeze abakulu era abatya Katonda basobola okuyomba n’obukambwe. Naye era eraga nti okuyomba si kwe kulina okuba enkomerero y’emboozi.

Eriiso limu eriziba n’okutu kumu okuggaddwa

Charles Spurgeon yatera okugamba abayizi be nti “omuweereza w’Ekigambo asaanidde okuba n’eriiso limu eriziba n’okutu kumu okutawulira.” Yannyonnyola kye yali ategeeza mu kusomesa okuli kaakano mu Lectures to My Students, Second Series (Emboozi eri Abayizi Bange, Omuddirirwa ogw’Okubiri), ku Ochorus. Teyategeeza nti omukulembeze asaanidde okubuusa amaaso ebizibu ebya nnamaddala. Yategeeza nti omukulembeze tasaanidde kunoonya buli kigambo ekitali kya kisa, buli lugambo na buli kisobyo ekitono. Ebintu bingi kisinga obutabiraba n’obutabiwulira. Yalabula abayizi be obutasikirizibwa mu biwayi n’obubinja: “Tomanyanga biwayi na bubinja, naye beera musumba w’ekisibo kyonna, era ofeeyo ku bonna kyenkanyi.” Era n’ayongerako nti, “Balina omukisa abatabaganya, era engeri emu ekakafu ey’okuleeta emirembe kwe kuleka omuliro gw’enkaayana gwokka. Togufuuwa, togusaanuukula, era togwongerako nku, naye gulekere guzikire gwokka.”

Mu bigambo ebyangu: enkaayana ezimu kisinga kuzireka. Bw’ogenda mu maaso ng’oziyogerako, oziriisa. Bw’olekera, emirundi mingi zizikira zokka.

Okuddamu n’eggonjebwa

“Okuddamu n’eggonjebwa kumalawo ekiruyi, naye ekigambo eky’obukambwe kisaanuula obusungu” (Engero 15:1). Abasinga obungi mu ffe olunyiriri luno tulumanyi. Batono mu ffe abalutambuliramu nga tuvumiriddwa oba nga tuziyiziddwa. Naye buli mukulembeze eyamaliriza obulungi kyamwetaagisa okuluyiga.

Yesu yagamba nti, “Mwagalenga abalabe bammwe! Musabirenga ababayigganya!” (Matayo 5:44). Ekyo kye kyokuddamu ekisembayo eri okuziyizibwa. Sabira abakuvumirira. Saba omukisa ku abo abakuziyiza. Noonya emirembe n’abo b’otakkiriziganya nabo. Era weeyongere okuzimba bbugwe.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Lowooza ku mulundi ogwasembayo lwe wavumirirwa. Waddamu otya? Kiki ky’oyandikoze mu ngeri endala kaakano?
  • Soma 2 Samwiri 16:5-12. Kiki ky’oyiga ku ngeri Dawudi gye yaddamu Simeeyi?
  • Soma Nekkemiya 4 ne 6. Bintu ki ku byakulwanyisa ebyakozesebwa ku Nekkemiya by’owolekaganye nabyo? Yabyanukula atya kinnakimu?
  • Waliwo enkaayana n’omukulembeze omulala gy’olese nga tegigonjoddwa? Kigere ki ky’oyinza okukola?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga mu mboozi ya Wesley ne Whitefield?
  • Kyandikutegeezezza ki okuba n’“eriiso limu eriziba n’okutu kumu okutawulira”? Wa we kyandibadde eky’amagezi, era wa we kyandibadde kikyamu?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Lowooza ku kuvumirirwa kw’ofunye gye buvuddeko, kube kwa bwenkanya oba nedda. Kuwandiike. Oluvannyuma kusabire obuuze nti, “Mukama, kino kirimu amazima gonna gye ndi?” Wandiika ky’owulira. Bwe kiba nga kirimu amazima, kola ekigere kimu eky’okukyuka, era bwe kiba kisoboka weebaze omuntu eyakyogera. Oluvannyuma sabira mu mannya buli muntu eyali akuziyizza, ng’osaba Katonda abawe omukisa.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze asaanidde kwanukula atya okuvumirirwa?
study_questions.answer: Ng’asooka kuwuliriza era ng’abuuza obanga kwa mazima. “Buli muntu abeerenga mwangu wa kuwulira, kyokka alemenga kubuguutana kwogera, era alemenga kwanguwa kunyiiga” (Yakobo 1:19). “Omugezi assaayo omwoyo ku magezi agamuweebwa” (Engero 12:15). Era “Okuddamu n’eggonjebwa kumalawo ekiruyi” (Engero 15:1).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze asaanidde okutwala buli kuvumirirwa ku mutima?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Omubuulizi agamba nti, “Towulirizanga buli kigambo, bantu kye boogera” (Omubuulizi 7:21). Simeeyi bwe yamukolimira, Dawudi yagamba nti, “Mumuleke, akolime,” n’akikwasa Katonda (2 Samwiri 16:11).

study_questions.question: Abakulembeze Abakristaayo babiri bayinza batya okukwata obutakkaanya?
study_questions.answer: Mu bwesimbu, mu bwetoowaze ne mu kwagala, nga tebamenya kussa kimu. Essuula ennyonnyola engeri John Wesley ne George Whitefield gye baatakkaanyamu ennyo ku njigiriza naye ne bakuuma omukwano gwabwe, era Whitefield n’asaba Wesley abuulire mu kuziika kwe.

fields.title: Abasajja n’Abakazi mu Mulimu gwa Katonda
fields.body_html:
“Mu biro ebyo ndifuka Omwoyo wange, ku baweereza bange abasajja n’abakazi; baliwa obunnabbi.”

— Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:18

Yingira kumpi mu kkanisa yonna mu nsi ku Ssande ku makya, obale abantu. Mu bifo ebisinga obungi, abasukka mu kitundu bajja kuba bakazi. Oluvannyuma buuza nti ani asabira abalwadde mu wiiki, ani ayigiriza abaana, ani akyalira abali bokka, ani afumba ku nnyimbe, ani akulembera enkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba, era ani akuuma ekkanisa ng’egenda mu maaso ebiseera bwe biba ebizibu. Emirundi mingi, eky’okuddamu kiba kimu: abakazi.

Ekkanisa ya Yesu Kristo bulijjo yeesigamye ku kukkiriza n’omulimu gw’abakazi. Naye mu bifo bingi, ebirabo by’abakazi bibuusibwa amaaso, bifiirizibwa, oba ne binyoomebwa. Essuula eno, esembayo mu Kitundu eky’Okutaano: Okukulembera Awamu, eyogera ku basajja n’abakazi okukolera awamu mu mulimu gwa Katonda. Ejja kusooka kutunuulira Bayibuli by’etulaga, kumpi Abakristaayo bonna bye bakkiriziganyaako. Oluvannyuma, mu kitundu “Okugenda mu Buziba”, ejja kunnyonnyola mu bwenkanya endowooza enkulu ku kibuuzo Abakristaayo abeesigwa kye batakkaanyaako: obanga ebifo ebimu mu kkanisa bya basajja bokka.

Baatondebwa wamu mu kifaananyi kya Katonda

Emboozi etandikira ku kutondebwa. “Bw’atyo Katonda n’atonda omuntu mu kifaananyi kye, mu kifaananyi kya Katonda mwe yamutondera; n’abatonda omusajja n’omukazi” (Olubereberye 1:27). Abasajja n’abakazi bombi balina ekifaananyi kya Katonda. Bombi baaweebwa omulimu gw’okulabirira ensi ya Katonda. Tewali n’omu nti mukoppe wa wansi ow’omunne.

Ekibi bwe kyayingira mu nsi, kyamenya obwegassi buno. Abasajja baatandika okufuga abakazi mu ngeri ez’obukambwe n’okwefaako bokka (Olubereberye 3:16). Ebyafaayo by’abantu ebisinga obungi, mu buli mpisa, biraga ebivaamu ebyennaku. Mu bifo bingi leero, abawala baweebwa emmere ntono n’okusoma okutono okusinga abalenzi, abakyala bakubibwa, ne bannamwandu bagobebwa mu maka gaabwe. Enjiri eyogera ng’ewakanya bino byonna. Peetero agamba abasajja abafumbo okussa ekitiibwa mu bakazi baabwe, “nga mumanyi nga nabo Katonda alibaweera wamu nammwe, obulamu obutaggwaawo” (1 Peetero 3:7). Abasajja n’abakazi basika wamu ekisa kya Katonda.

Abakazi abaakulembera era abaaweereza mu Bayibuli

Bayibuli ejjudde abakazi Katonda be yakozesa mu ngeri ez’ekitalo.

  • Miryamu, mwannyina wa Musa, yayitibwa “nnabbi omukazi” era yakulembera abakazi ba Isirayiri mu kutendereza nga bamaze okusomoka ennyanja (Okuva 15:20).
  • Debola yali “Nnabbi” era “ye yali akulembera Abayisirayiri mu kiseera ekyo … Abayisirayiri ne bajjanga gyali okubalamula” (Abalamuzi 4:4-5). Yayita Baraki akulembere eggye, era n’agenda naye mu lutalo.
  • Kuluda yali nnabbi omukazi mu Yerusaalemi. Ekitabo ky’amateeka ekyali kibuze bwe kyazuulibwa mu yeekaalu, Kabaka Yosiya yatuma kabona asinga obukulu n’abakungu be gy’ali okubuuza Katonda kye yali ayogera (2 Bassekabaka 22:14).
  • Abakazi abaagoberera Yesu, Maliyamu Magudaleene, Jowaana, Susaana “n’abalala bangi”, baatambulanga ne Yesu n’Ekkumi n’Ababiri era “abaatoolanga ku byabwe ne balabirira Yesu n’abayigirizwa be” (Lukka 8:1-3).
  • Maliyamu Magudaleene ye yali omuntu eyasooka okulaba Mukama eyazuukira. Yesu yamutuma okutegeeza abayigirizwa, era “n’agenda n’abuulira abayigirizwa nga bw’alabye Mukama waffe” (Yokaana 20:18).
  • Pulisikira, wamu ne bba Akula, bayigiriza omubuulizi Apolo eyalina ebirabo, “ne bamunnyonnyola bingi eby’Ekkubo lya Katonda” mu bujjuvu okusingawo (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 18:26). Pawulo yabalamusa ng’abannyonnyola nti “bwe tukola omulimu mu Kristo Yesu” (Abaruumi 16:3).
  • Abaana ba Firipo abawala abana baali “nga balina ekirabo eky’obunnabbi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 21:9).
  • Foyibe ye yatwala ebbaluwa ya Pawulo eri Abaruumi. Pawulo yamuyita “omuweereza w’ekkanisa ey’omu Kenkereya”, era n’agamba nti “naye yennyini yayamba bangi era nange kennyini” (Abaruumi 16:1-2). Enkyusa za Bayibuli tezikkiriziganya ku kigambo ekisinga okutuukirira wano: abamu bakivvuunula “omuweereza”, abalala “omudyakoni”.
  • Ewudiya ne Sintuke, Pawulo yagamba nti “baakolera wamu nange omulimu gw’okubunyisa Enjiri” (Abafiripi 4:3).
  • Looyi ne Ewuniike, jjajja wa Timoseewo ne nnyina, baayisa okukkiriza okwabumba omu ku bakulembeze abakulu ab’Ekkanisa ey’olubereberye (2 Timoseewo 1:5).

Mu Abaruumi 16 mwokka, Pawulo ayogera ku mannya g’abakazi mwenda, nga mu bo mulimu Terufayina ne Terufoosa, “abaakola ennyo omulimu gwa Mukama waffe”, ne Perusi “eyakola ennyo omulimu mu Mukama waffe” (Abaruumi 16:12). Teyalaba bakazi ng’abalabi obulabi mu mulimu gw’enjiri. Yabalaba nga bakozi banne.

Omwoyo ku batabani ne ku bawala

Ku lunaku lwa Pentekoote, Peetero yannyonnyola ebyali bibaawo ng’ajuliza nnabbi Yoweeri: “ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku balina omubiri bonna.
