Batabani bammwe ne bawala bammwe baliwa obunnabbi … Mu biro ebyo ndifuka Omwoyo wange, ku baweereza bange abasajja n’abakazi; baliwa obunnabbi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:17-18).

Omwoyo Omutukuvu agaba ebirabo bye eri abakkiriza bonna. Peetero yawandiika nti, “Buli omu asaanidde okukozesa n’obwesigwa buli kirabo Katonda kye yamuwa olw’okugasa banne” (1 Peetero 4:10). Buli omu, omusajja oba omukazi. Ekibuuzo eri buli mukulembeze si nti abakazi balina ebirabo, kubanga Bayibuli eraga lwatu nti babirina. Ekibuuzo kiri nti tubayamba okukozesa ebirabo ebyo, oba tubifiiriza.

Ebirabo ebifiirizibwa

Kuba akafaananyi k’omulimi alina ente ennume ennungi kkumi ez’okulima, naye n’akkiriza ttaano zokka okusika enkumbi ey’ente. Ezo ttaano endala ziyimirira mu nnimiro, nga za maanyi era nga zeetegefu, naye tezikozesebwa. Omulimi akola emirundi ebiri okusinga bwe yandibadde, era amakungula gaba matono okusinga bwe gandibadde. Ekyo kye kibaawo ekkanisa bwe zibuusa amaaso ebirabo by’ekitundu ky’abammemba baazo.

Ne bwe kiba kkanisa erina ndowooza ki ku bifo by’omusumba n’omukadde w’ekkanisa, waliwo omulimu mungi nnyo mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda kumpi Abakristaayo bonna gwe bakkiriza nti abakazi bayinza okukola. Bayinza okusaba, okwogera eby’obunnabbi (1 Abakkolinso 11:5), okubunyisa enjiri, okuyigiriza abaana n’abakazi abalala (Tito 2:3-4), okulabirira abalwadde n’abaavu, okuweereza ng’abaminsani, okuvvuunula Ebyawandiikibwa, okukulembera ebitundu by’obuweereza, okubudaabuda n’okuwabula, okuwa abakulembeze b’ekkanisa amagezi ag’omugaso, n’ebirala bingi. Naye mu kkanisa nnyingi, ne bino tebikubirizibwa.

Bino bye bibuuzo eri buli mukulembeze, ne bw’aba n’endowooza ki:

  • Abakazi mu kkanisa yange bamanyi nti Katonda yabawa ebirabo, era nti ekkanisa ebeetaaga?
  • Abakazi batendekebwa era bakubirizibwa, oba baweebwa kufumba na kwera kwokka?
  • Bwe wabaawo okusalawo okukwata ku kkanisa yonna, amagezi n’obumanyirivu bw’abakazi biwulirwa?
  • Ekkanisa yange kifo kya mirembe eri abakazi n’abawala? Tujja kudda ku kino mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu.
  • Nsiima omulimu gw’abakazi mu lwatu, nga Pawulo bwe yakola mu Abaruumi 16?

Okugenda mu Buziba: empaka ku bifo by’obukulembeze mu kkanisa

Abakristaayo abaagala Bayibuli era abaagala okugigondera batuuse ku ndowooza ez’enjawulo ku kibuuzo obanga abakazi bayinza okuweereza ng’abasumba, abakadde b’ekkanisa oba abalabirizi. Zino si mpaka wakati w’abo abakkiriza Bayibuli n’abo abatagikkiriza. Mpaka ku ngeri y’okutegeeramu ebitundu ebimu mu Byawandiikibwa. Wano waliwo endowooza ebbiri enkulu, nga zinnyonnyoddwa nga abazikkiriza bennyini bwe bandizinnyonnyodde. Abasomi bayinza okubuuka ekitundu kino ne bakiddamu oluvannyuma.

Endowooza esooka etera okuyitibwa complementarian (ey’okujjuliragana). Egamba nti abasajja n’abakazi benkana mu muwendo ne mu kitiibwa, naye nti Katonda yabawa emirimu egy’enjawulo egijjuliragana. Mu kkanisa, bw’etyo bw’egamba, ekifo ky’omukadde w’ekkanisa oba omusumba, ekirimu obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okulabirira ekkanisa n’okuyigiriza kwayo, kya basajja abasaanidde. Abagikkiriza basonga ku 1 Timoseewo 2:12, Pawulo w’awandiikira nti, “Sikkiriza mukazi kuyigiriza wadde okuba n’obuyinza ku musajja”, era balaga nti Pawulo kino akisimba ku kutondebwa (“Kubanga Adamu ye yasooka okutondebwa, ne kuddako Kaawa”, 1 Timoseewo 2:13), so si ku mpisa za mu biseera bye zokka. Era balaga nti Yesu yalonda abasajja kkumi na babiri okuba abatume, era nti ebisaanyizo by’abakadde b’ekkanisa mu 1 Timoseewo 3 ne Tito 1 byawandiikibwa nga balowooza ku basajja. Abakkiriza endowooza eno bakubiriza abakazi okukozesa ebirabo byabwe mu bugazi, nga mw’otwalidde okuyigiriza n’okukulembera mu mbeera nnyingi, ate ekifo ky’omukadde w’ekkanisa ne bakirekera abasajja.

Endowooza ey’okubiri etera okuyitibwa egalitarian (ey’okwenkanankana). Egamba nti obuweereza bwonna n’ebifo byonna mu kkanisa biggule eri abasajja n’abakazi bombi, okusinziira ku birabo byabwe n’okuyitibwa kwabwe. Abagikkiriza basonga ku bakazi abaakulembera mu Bayibuli, nga Debola, Kuluda, Pulisikira ne Foyibe, ne ku Yuniya, Pawulo gw’ayogerako mu Abaruumi 16:7 mu bigambo enkyusa nnyingi bye zivvuunula nti “baali ba kitiibwa mu batume” (endala zibivvuunula nti “baali bamanyiddwa nnyo abatume”, ng’eno ey’Oluganda bw’egamba nti “bassibwamu nnyo ekitiibwa abatume”). Basonga ku Mwoyo okufukibwa ku batabani ne ku bawala, ne ku Abaggalatiya 3:28, “Tewakyali kusosola … wakati wa musajja na mukazi, kubanga mwenna muli omu mu Kristo Yesu.” Bakkiriza nti ebitundu nga 1 Timoseewo 2:11-15 ne 1 Abakkolinso 14:34-35 byali byogera ku bizibu ebyenjawulo mu kkanisa ezenjawulo, era nga tebyagendererwa kugaana bakazi kuyigiriza na kukulembera kwonna emirembe gyonna.

Waliwo n’endowooza nnyingi eziri wakati, era ekkanisa ez’omu kiti kimu zitera okwawukana. Ezimu zikkiriza abakazi okubuulira naye si kuba basumba abakulu. Ezimu zaawula abakazi ng’abadyakoni naye si ng’abakadde b’ekkanisa. Ezimu, ng’ezisinga obungi mu nnono ya Pentekoote, ezaasooka edda okusiima abakazi ng’ababunyisa b’enjiri era abatandisi b’ekkanisa.

Ne bw’oba olina ndowooza ki, gano ge magezi agamu.

  • Soma ebitundu ebyo ggwe kennyini, n’obwegendereza era mu mbeera gye byawandiikibwamu, ng’osaba. Togoberera butereevu mpisa za bantu bo, zibe za nnono oba za mulembe guno.
  • Kwata endowooza yo mu bwetoowaze. Abakristaayo abeesigwa, abatya Katonda era abayivu bakwata endowooza endala. Bayise ng’ab’oluganda, so si ng’abalabe.
  • Goberera okuyigiriza kw’ekkanisa yo okuggyako ng’omuntu wo ow’omunda akugaanira ddala, era bw’oba tokkiriziganya, kitwale eri abakulembeze bo mu kitiibwa, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 6, Obuyinza wansi w’Obuyinza.
  • Toleka mpaka kufuuka nsonga ya kwekwasa okufiiriza ebirabo by’abakazi mu buweereza obungi bwonna obwo tewali n’omu awakanya nti bayinza okubuweerezaamu.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: abawala ba Kabaka

Ebyafaayo by’Ekkanisa bijjudde abakazi okukkiriza kwabwe n’omulimu gwabwe kwe kwakyusa ensi. Bano bana okuva mu ssemazinga ena.

Susanna Wesley yali mukyala w’omusumba mu kyalo Epworth mu Bungereza, era nnyina wa John ne Charles Wesley. Mu kiseera ky’obutiti okuva mu 1711 okutuuka mu 1712, bba bwe yali agenze e London, yatandika okukuŋŋaanya abaana be n’abaweereza be mu ffumbiro lye ku Ssande akawungeezi okusoma n’okusaba. Baliraanwa ne basaba okujja. Mangu ddala abantu ne baba bangi nnyo okusinga ennyumba bwe yali esobola okubatuuza. Bba bwe yawandiika ng’awakanya, mu kitundu olw’okuba nti yali mukazi, yamuddamu mu bbaluwa ejuliziddwa mu byafaayo bye Eliza Clarke bye yawandiika, ebiri ku Ochorus:

“Nga bwe ndi omukazi, bwe ntyo era ndi nnyinimu w’amaka amanene. Era newakubadde obuvunaanyizibwa obusinga obukulu obw’emyoyo egirimu buli ku ggwe, ng’omutwe gw’amaka, era ng’omuweereza waabwe, naye nga toliiwo sisobola butalaba buli mwoyo gw’oleka mu kulabirira kwange nga ttalanta gye nakwasibwa, ng’ekintu kye neesigibwa, Mukama omukulu ow’amaka gonna ag’omu ggulu n’ag’oku nsi.”

— Susanna Wesley, ebbaluwa eri bba, 6 Febwali 1712

Mu bigambo ebyangu: weewaawo, ndi mukazi, naye era nze nvunaanyizibwa ku maka amanene. Ggwe mutwe gw’amaka era omuweereza waago. Naye nga toliiwo, nnina okutwala buli mwoyo gw’oleka mu kulabirira kwange ng’eky’obugagga Katonda kye yanneesiga. Weetegereze nti Susanna teyagaana buyinza bwa bba. Yabussaamu ekitiibwa. Naye era yagaana okuziika ttalanta Katonda gye yali amuwadde. Mutabani we John teyeerabira nkuŋŋaana ezo ez’omu ffumbiro.

Amanda Berry Smith yazaalibwa mu buddu mu Maryland, mu Amerika, mu 1837. Ab’omu maka ge bwe baafuna eddembe lyabwe, yamala emyaka mingi ng’akola omulimu gw’okwoza engoye. Yafuuka omubunyisa w’enjiri ow’amaanyi, era n’atambula okubuulira mu Bungereza, mu Buyindi, era okumala emyaka munaana mu Liberia mu Afirika ey’Ebugwanjuba. Autobiography ye (ebyafaayo bye yeewandiikira) eri ku Ochorus.

Mary Slessor yali mukozi mu kkolero e Dundee mu Scotland eyagenda ng’omuminsani e Calabar mu kitundu kati ekiyitibwa obuvanjuba bw’obukiikaddyo bwa Nayijeriya mu 1876. Yabeera mu bantu b’e Okoyong, n’ayiga olulimi lwabwe n’empisa zaabwe, n’alokola abaana abalongo abandirekeddwa okufa, era oluvannyuma abantu n’egavumenti ya Bungereza ne bamwesiga okuweereza ng’omulamuzi w’ekitundu. Ebyafaayo bye, Mary Slessor: A Life (Obulamu bwa Mary Slessor), biri ku Ochorus.

Pandita Ramabai yazaalibwa mu Buyindi mu 1858. Yafuuka omuyivu omukulu ow’olulimi Olusanskriti, n’akkiriza Kristo, era n’awaayo obulamu bwe eri bannamwandu ne bamulekwa ba Buyindi. Mu kitundu kye e Mukti, okumpi ne Pune, yalabiriranga abakazi n’abaana nga enkumi bbiri omulundi gumu. Mu myaka gy’obulamu bwe egyasembayo yavvuunula Bayibuli yonna okuva mu Lwebbulaniya ne mu Luyonaani okugiteeka mu Lumarathi olwa bulijjo olw’abakazi b’omu byalo. Pandita Ramabai: A Life (Obulamu bwa Pandita Ramabai), ekiri ku Ochorus, kiwandiika nti yeeyitanga omwezi: “Nneera ne nnyingiza mu kifo kino bonna be nsobola okufuna … bannamwandu abaana, abakyala abaalekebwawo, ne bamulekwa ab’engeri zonna.”

Twandyongeddeko n’abalala bangi: Dora Yu, omubunyisa w’enjiri Omuchina, mu kubuulira kwe Watchman Nee omuvubuka mwe yajjira eri Kristo mu 1920; Catherine Booth, eyayamba okutandikawo Salvation Army (Eggye ery’Obulokozi); n’abakazi abangi abatamanyiddwa mannya ab’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba. Ekkanisa yeetikkiddwa ku bibegabega bya bawala baayo nga bwe yeetikkiddwa ku bya batabani baayo.

Abakozi bannaffe

Pawulo yafundikira ebbaluwa ye eri Abaruumi n’olukalala oluwanvu olw’okulamusa abasajja n’abakazi abaali bakoze naye. Yabayita “bakozi banne”, “abaagalwa”, “abaakola ennyo” era “abali mu Kristo”. Omukulembeze ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala ajja kulaba Ekkanisa mu ngeri y’emu: si ng’abakulembeze abatono n’abalabi abangi, wabula ng’omubiri gw’abatabani n’abawala, buli omu ng’alina ebirabo okuva mu Mwoyo y’omu, nga bakolera wamu Mukama y’omu.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Abaruumi 16:1-16. Kiki ekikukwatako ku bakazi Pawulo b’alamusa, n’engeri gy’abogeramu?
  • Bakazi ki abasinga okubumba okukkiriza kwo? Katonda yabakozesa atya?
  • Mu kkanisa yo, ebirabo by’abakazi bikozesebwa, oba bifiirizibwa? Kiki ekiyinza okukyuka?
  • Soma endowooza ebbiri eziri mu “Okugenda mu Buziba”. Ggwe okwata eriwa? Osobola okunnyonnyola endowooza endala mu bwenkanya, mu ngeri abagikkiriza gye bandikkirizza?
  • Oyinza otya okukwata endowooza yo ku kibuuzo kino nga weekakasa era nga weetoowaza?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga mu bbaluwa Susanna Wesley gye yawandiikira bba?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Kola olukalala lw’abakazi mu kkanisa yo oba mu buweereza bwo, era ku mabbali ga buli linnya wandiika ekirabo kimu ky’olaba mu ye. Wiiki eno, yogera n’abakazi wakiri babiri ku bo. Bategeeze ekirabo ky’olaba, obeebaze olw’engeri gye baweerezaamu, era obabuuze ekkanisa engeri gy’eyinza okubayamba okukozesa ekirabo ekyo okusingawo. Bw’oba okulembera ekibinja ky’abakulembeze, buuza ekibinja kyonna awamu nti: “Ebirabo by’ani bye tutakozesa, era lwaki?”

study_questions.question: Abakazi bayinza okuweereza mu mulimu gwa Katonda?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Abasajja n’abakazi baatondebwa wamu mu kifaananyi kya Katonda (Olubereberye 1:27), era ku Pentekoote Omwoyo yafukibwa “ku baweereza bange abasajja n’abakazi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:18). Abakazi nga Debola, Maliyamu Magudaleene, Pulisikira ne Foyibe baaweereza Katonda mu ngeri nnyingi.

study_questions.question: Bayibuli eyogera ki ku bakazi mu bukulembeze bw’ekkanisa?
study_questions.answer: Abakristaayo abeesigwa tebakkiriziganya obanga abakazi bayinza okubeera mu bifo ebimu eby’obukulembeze mu kkanisa. Ekitundu ky’essuula “Okugenda mu Buziba” kinnyonnyola endowooza enkulu mu bwenkanya. Bonna bakkiriziganya nti ebirabo Katonda by’awa abakazi tebirina kufiirizibwa.

study_questions.question: Bakazi ki mu Bayibuli abaaweereza mu mulimu gwa Katonda?
study_questions.answer: Debola, “ye yali akulembera Abayisirayiri mu kiseera ekyo” (Abalamuzi 4:4); abakazi “abaatoolanga ku byabwe ne balabirira Yesu” (Lukka 8:3); Maliyamu Magudaleene, eyagenda “n’abuulira abayigirizwa nga bw’alabye Mukama waffe” (Yokaana 20:18); ne Pulisikira, eyannyonnyola Apolo “bingi eby’Ekkubo lya Katonda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 18:26).

fields.title: Okwolesebwa: Okulaba Katonda by’Alaba
fields.body_html:
“Wandiika okwolesebwa okwo ku bipande. Kuwandiike bulungi ate omubaka gwe banaatuma, akutwale bunnambiro. Kubanga okwolesebwa okwo kujja mu kiseera kyakwo ekigere.”

— Kaabakuuku 2:2-3

Omusajja azimba ennyumba asooka kugiraba mu birowoozo bye. Nga tannasima musingi, amanyi oluggi we lunaaba, ebisenge bwe binaaba bingi, n’amadirisa gye ganaatunula. Singa talina kifaananyi ekyo, yandituumye amayinja ng’asuubira nti ebinaavaamu binaaba birungi. Ng’alina ekifaananyi ekyo, omulimu gwa buli lunaku gulina ekigendererwa.

Abakulembeze beetaaga okulaba gye bagenda. Mu nsi y’obusuubuzi kino kitera okuyitibwa “vision”, mu Luganda “okwolesebwa”. Naye ekigambo kino kikozesebwa mu ngeri nnyingi, era ezimu ku zo si za Kikristaayo n’akatono. Essuula eno etandika Ekitundu eky’Omukaaga: Okwolesebwa n’Omulimu. Ebuuza nti: okwolesebwa okw’amazima eri abantu ba Katonda kye ki, kuva wa, era omukulembeze asaanidde kukukwata atya?

Olunyiriri olw’okusoma n’obwegendereza

Abakulembeze bangi bajulizza enkyusa ey’Olungereza enkadde eya Engero 29:18, esoma nti: “Awatali kwolesebwa, abantu bazikirira.” Bagikozesezza okugamba nti ekkanisa yeetaaga omukulembeze alina enteekateeka ennene, oba si ekyo ejja kufa. Naye olunyiriri luno si bwe lutegeeza.

Mu Lwebbulaniya, ekigambo ekivvuunulwa “okwolesebwa” kitegeeza okubikkulirwa okuva eri Katonda, obubaka obw’engeri nnabbi gy’afuna. Bayibuli ey’Oluganda gye tukozesa mu kitabo kino, ng’enkyusa ez’omulembe guno ezisinga obungi, ekiraga bulungi nti lwogera ku kwolesebwa okuva eri Katonda n’amateeka ge: “Awatali kwolesebwa abantu tebaba beegendereza, naye wa mukisa oyo akuuma amateeka ga Mukama” (Engero 29:18).

Olunyiriri luno lwogera ku Kigambo kya Katonda, so si ku nteekateeka z’omukulembeze. Abantu ba Katonda bwe batawulira kuva gy’ali, babula ekkubo era bakola kyonna kye baagala. Bwe bakuuma amateeka ge, baweebwa omukisa. N’olwekyo okwolesebwa okusooka era okusinga obukulu buli kkanisa kw’eyetaaga si kirooto kya mukulembeze. Kye Kigambo kya Katonda, nga kiwuliddwa bulungi era nga kigonderwa n’obwesigwa. Mu lulimi lwonna mw’osomera ekitabo kino, laba Bayibuli yo bw’evvuunula olunyiriri luno, era oluyigirize n’obwegendereza.

Okwolesebwa okw’amazima kye ki

Okwolesebwa bwe kuba nga si kirooto kya mukulembeze, kale kye ki? Okwolesebwa okw’amazima kwe kulaba Katonda by’agambye nti alikola, n’okubikkiriza ekimala okubikolerako.

Katonda yatubuulira dda bingi ku biseera ebijja. Yasuubiza Ibulayimu nti “mu ggwe amawanga gonna ag’omu nsi mwe galiweerwa omukisa” (Olubereberye 12:3). Yasuubiza ekibiina ky’abantu ekinene ennyo, “nga bava mu buli nsi na buli kika, na buli ggwanga na buli lulimi”, nga bayimiridde mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka (Okubikkulirwa 7:9). Yasuubiza nti, “Laba, ebintu byonna mbizzizza buggya” (Okubikkulirwa 21:5). Yesu yatuyigiriza okusaba nti, “Obwakabaka bwo bujje. By’oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu” (Matayo 6:10).

Ebisuubizo bino kye kifaananyi ekinene. Munda mu kifaananyi ekyo ekinene, Katonda emirundi mingi awa abakulembeze abamu n’ekkanisa ezimu ekitundu ekyenjawulo eky’okukola. Yalaga Ibulayimu ensi. Yalaga Nekkemiya bbugwe eyali amenyese. Yalaga Pawulo omusajja Omumakedoni ng’amwegayirira nti, “Jjangu ewaffe e Makedoniya otuyambe” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:9). Buli kimu ku bino kyali kulengera katono ku ngeri ekigendererwa kya Katonda ekinene gye kyandituukiriziddwamu mu kifo kimu, nga kiyita mu muntu omu oba mu bantu abamu.

N’olwekyo okwolesebwa okw’amazima kulina obubonero busatu. Kuva eri Katonda. Kukwatagana n’ebyo by’amaze okwogera mu Byawandiikibwa. Era kuweereza ekitiibwa kye n’obwakabaka bwe, so si linnya lyaffe.

Okwolesebwa okw’obulimba

Bayibuli erabula ku bakulembeze abeeyita okulaba ebintu Katonda by’atabalaze. Ng’ayita mu Yeremiya, Katonda yagamba nti, “Temuwuliriza bannabbi bye babategeeza: babajjuza essuubi ekyamu. Boogera ebirooto ebiva mu mitima gyabwe, so si ebiva mu kamwa ka Mukama Katonda” (Yeremiya 23:16).

Buno bulabe bwa nnamaddala leero. Abakulembeze abamu balangirira okwolesebwa okunene: ekkanisa ey’abantu omutwalo gumu, ekizimbe ekisinga obunene ebirala byonna mu kibuga, obuweereza ku ttivvi mu ggwanga lyonna. Oluusi Katonda ddala akulembera abantu okukola ebintu ebinene. Naye oluusi “okwolesebwa” kuno kuba kwegomba kwa muntu yekka okwambaziddwa ennyiriri za Bayibuli. Omukulembeze ayagala okuba omukulu, n’akiyita enteekateeka ya Katonda.

Bino bye bibuuzo eby’okugezesa okwolesebwa:

  • Kuva mu kusaba, oba mu birowoozo byange byokka?
  • Kukwatagana n’Ebyawandiikibwa, n’embala ya Yesu?
  • Ani anaafuna ekitiibwa bwe kunaatuukirira: Katonda, oba nze?
  • Abantu abakulu mu mwoyo era abatya Katonda bakukakasizza, oba nze nzekka akulaba?
  • Ndi mwetegefu okukuleka Katonda bw’agamba nti nedda?
  • Kuweereza bantu, oba kubakozesa?

Mu Ssuula 16, Okuluŋŋamizibwa n’Okusalawo, twatunuulira engeri Katonda gy’aluŋŋamyamu. Amagezi ago ge gamu ne wano. Okwolesebwa okw’amazima kusobola okugezesebwa, era kusaanidde okugezesebwa.

Nekkemiya: okwolesebwa okwazaalibwa mu kusaba

Ekyokulabirako ekisinga obulungi eky’okwolesebwa okutya Katonda mu Bayibuli kiyinza okuba Nekkemiya. Yali muweereza wa kabaka wa Buperusi, wala nnyo okuva e Yerusaalemi. Lumu, abagenyi baamutegeeza nti “bbugwe wa Yerusaalemi yamenyebwa, era ne wankaaki waakyo yayokebwa omuliro.” Laba bwe yaddamu: “Awo bwe nawulira ebigambo ebyo, ne ntuula wansi ne nkaaba, ne mmala ebiro nga nnakuwadde, nga nsiiba era nga nsaba mu maaso ga Katonda w’eggulu” (Nekkemiya 1:3-4).

Weetegereze nti okwolesebwa kwa Nekkemiya kwatandika n’omugugu ku mutima. Teyatandika na nteekateeka. Yatandika na maziga. Yalaba obwetaavu obwamenya omutima gwe, n’abutwala eri Katonda. Okusaba kwe mu Nekkemiya 1 kujjudde okwatula n’ebisuubizo bya Katonda. Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi egy’okusaba lwe yakola.

Kabaka bwe yamubuuza ekyali kimuluma, Nekkemiya yasaba mu kaseera ako ddala: “ne nsaba eri Katonda w’eggulu”. Oluvannyuma n’addamu nti, “ansindike ŋŋende mu Yuda … nkiddaabirize” (Nekkemiya 2:4-5). Bwe yatuuka e Yerusaalemi, teyalangirira nteekateeka ye mangu ago. Yafuluma ekiro, mu kasirise, okwetegereza bbugwe. “Ne sibuulira muntu n’omu ku ebyo Katonda wange bye yali atadde ku mutima gwange okukolera Yerusaalemi” (Nekkemiya 2:12).

Oluvannyuma, mu kiseera ekituufu, yakuŋŋaanya abantu: “Mulaba akabi ke tulimu; Yerusaalemi kizise … Mujje tuddaabirize bbugwe wa Yerusaalemi.” Yabategeeza engeri Katonda gye yali amuyambyemu. Abantu ne baddamu nti, “Tugolokoke tutandike okuzimba” (Nekkemiya 2:17-18).

Weetegereze engeri ebintu gye biddiriŋŋanamu: omugugu ku mutima, oluvannyuma okusaba, oluvannyuma okwetegereza n’obwegendereza, oluvannyuma okubuulira abalala okwolesebwa, oluvannyuma okukolera awamu. Okwolesebwa kwa Nekkemiya tekwali kwe yekka. Yayamba abantu okulaba kye yalaba, okutuusa lwe kwafuuka okwolesebwa kwabwe nabo.

Okukwata okwolesebwa mu kukkiriza

Katonda yagamba Kaabakuuku nti, “Wandiika okwolesebwa okwo ku bipande. Kuwandiike bulungi ate omubaka gwe banaatuma, akutwale bunnambiro. Kubanga okwolesebwa okwo kujja mu kiseera kyakwo ekigere. … Bwe kunaaba ng’okuluddewo, mukulindirire, kujja kutuukirira, tekugya kulwa” (Kaabakuuku 2:2-3).

Gano ge magezi eri abakulembeze. Ekisooka, okwolesebwa kuwandiike bulungi kutegeerekeke. Abantu bwe batategeera gy’olaga, tebasobola kugenda naawe. Kwogere mu ngeri ennyangu, era okwogerenga emirundi mingi.

Eky’okubiri, beera mugumiikiriza. Okwolesebwa kwa Katonda emirundi mingi kutwala ekiseera ekiwanvu okusinga bwe tusuubira. Ibulayimu yalinda emyaka amakumi abiri mu etaano okufuna omwana Katonda gwe yali amusuubizza. Yusufu yalinda emyaka mingi mu buddu ne mu kkomera ebirooto bye nga tebinnatuukirira. Okwolesebwa okumu tekutuukirira ng’oyo eyasooka okukulaba akyali mulamu. Ekitabo ky’Abaebbulaniya kyogera ku Ibulayimu ne bajjajja abalala nti, “Abo bonna baafiira mu kukkiriza. Baafa nga Katonda bye yabasuubiza tebannabifuna, naye nga basanyufu nga bamanyi nti bibalindiridde” (Abaebbulaniya 11:13).

Eky’okusatu, gondera. Pawulo yagamba Kabaka Agulipa nti, “Bwe ntyo, Ayi Kabaka Agulipa, ne sinyooma kwolesebwa okwo okwava mu ggulu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 26:19). Okwolesebwa si kintu kya kwewuunya bwewuunya. Kintu kya kugondera, mutendera ku mutendera, ne bwe kiba nti ekkubo lizibu.

Era eky’okuna, suubira Katonda okukola ebisinga by’olowooza. Pawulo yasaba Katonda “akola ebintu byonna okusinga byonna bye tusaba, ne bye tulowooza, ng’amaanyi ge bwe gali agakolera mu ffe” (Abaefeso 3:20). Abakulembeze bangi tebaloota birooto binene nnyo. Baloota ebitono nnyo, kubanga beerabira Katonda bw’ali omukulu.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: William Carey

William Carey yali mukozi w’engatto era omusumba w’ekyalo mu Bungereza mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omunaana. Teyasoma nnyo mu masomero. Naye bwe yabanga addaabiriza engatto, yateeka maapu y’ensi yonna ku kisenge ky’omu dduuka lye, era n’asoma buli kitabo ky’asobola okufuna ekikwata ku nsi ez’ewala. Kyamweraliikiriza nti obukadde n’obukadde bw’abantu baali tebawulirangako ku Kristo, era nti ekkanisa ezisinga obungi mu biseera bye tezaali zikolawo kintu kyonna ku nsonga eyo. Bangi baali bakkiriza nti Katonda bwe yandyagadde amawanga ag’ewala okulokolebwa, yandikikoze awatali buyambi bwa bantu.

Mu 1792, Carey yabuulira mu lukuŋŋaana lw’abaweereza b’Ekigambo mu kibuga ky’e Bungereza ekiyitibwa Nottingham. Olunyiriri lwe yabuulirako lwali Isaaya 54:2-3: “Gaziya weema yo, owanvuye emiguwa gyayo, tokwata mpola … Kubanga olisaasaanira ku mukono gwo ogwa ddyo era n’ogwa kkono.” Okubuulira okwo tekwakubibwa mu kyapa. Naye ng’ekitabo The Fire on the Altar (Omuliro ku Kyoto) ekiri ku Ochorus bwe kinnyonnyola, ebyafaayo byakwo ebisinga obukadde biva eri John Ryland, eyakuwulira. Yawandiika nti Carey yali:

“okusinga byonna ng’afuba okutukubiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe obw’okusuubira ebintu ebikulu okuva eri Katonda, n’okugezaako okukola ebintu ebikulu ku lwa Katonda.”

— John Ryland, ng’annyonnyola okubuulira kwa Carey okwa 1792

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Carey yabakubiriza nti buvunaanyizibwa bwabwe okusuubira ebintu ebikulu okuva eri Katonda, n’okugezaako okukola ebintu ebikulu ku lwa Katonda. Ebigambo bino byafuuka ekiragiro ky’obulamu bwe. Weetegereze engeri gye biddiriŋŋanamu. Okusooka suubira, oluvannyuma gezaako. Okwolesebwa kwa Carey tekwatandika na maanyi ge ye. Kwatandika n’obwesige mu ebyo Katonda bye yasuubiza.

Ne bwe yamala okubuulira, abaweereza baali beetegefu okuddayo awaka nga tewali kye basazeewo. Naye Carey yagaana ensonga eyo okugwa. Emyezi mitono oluvannyuma, ekibinja ekitono ku bo kyatandikawo ekibiina eky’okutuma abaminsani. Omwaka ogwaddako Carey yasaabala ku nnyanja okugenda e Buyindi. Yabeerayo obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo, nga emyaka amakumi ana, era teyaddayo waka. Okumala emyaka musanvu kumpi teyalaba kibala. Mukyala we yabonaabona nnyo n’obulwadde bw’omutwe. Omuliro gwayokya emyaka egy’omulimu gwe ogw’okuvvuunula. Naye yeeyongera mu maaso. Wamu ne bakozi banne, yavvuunula Bayibuli, yonna oba ekitundu kyayo, mu nnimi nnyingi eza Buyindi n’eza Asiya. Era yatandikawo amasomero, n’alwanyisa empisa ez’obukambwe, era n’aleetawo omulanga gwonna ogw’obuminsani.

Carey ajjukirwa nga yeeyogerako mu ngeri ennyangu ennyo: “Nsobola okunyiikira mpola mpola nga sikoowa.” Okwolesebwa kwe kwali kunene, naye engeri gye yakutuukirizaamu yali ya mulimu gwa buli lunaku ogw’obugumiikiriza era ogwa bulijjo. Bw’etyo okwolesebwa okusinga obungi Katonda kw’awa gye kutuukirizibwamu.

Okulaba Katonda by’alaba

Yesu “bwe yatunuulira ekibiina ky’abantu” “n’abasaasira nnyo” (Matayo 9:36). Nekkemiya yawulira ku bbugwe eyali amenyese n’akaaba. Carey yatunuulira maapu n’alaba abantu abaali tebawulirangako ku Kristo. Okwolesebwa okw’amazima kutandika bwe tulaba ensi nga Katonda bw’agiraba: obwetaavu bwayo, okumenyeka kwayo n’abantu baayo, era n’ebisuubizo bye gy’eri.

Saba Katonda akuwe amaaso agalaba. Oluvannyuma saba okutuusa omugugu lwe gufuuka enteekateeka, gubuulire abalala okutuusa nabo lwe bagulaba, era kola okutuusa Katonda lw’agutuukiriza, mu kiseera kye.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Owulidde otya Engero 29:18 nga lukozesebwa? Kaakano bw’omaze okusoma ddala kye lugamba, lusaanidde kuyigirizibwa lutya?
  • Waliwo obwetaavu mu kitundu kyo obumenya omutima gwo, nga bbugwe eyali amenyese bwe yamenya ogwa Nekkemiya? Omugugu ogwo ogukozeeko ki?
  • Kozesa ebibuuzo ebiri mu “Okwolesebwa okw’obulimba” okugezesa ekintu ky’osuubira okukola. Bikulaga ki?
  • Soma Nekkemiya 2:11-18. Mitendera ki Nekkemiya gye yayitamu nga tannabuulira balala nteekateeka ye?
  • Okwolesebwa kwo kuwandiikiddwa bulungi ekimala abalala okukutegeera n’okukutwala “bunnambiro”?
  • Carey yagamba nti, “Suubira ebintu ebikulu okuva eri Katonda; gezaako okukola ebintu ebikulu ku lwa Katonda.” Ki ky’osanga nga kizibu okusinga: okusuubira oba okugezaako?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Teekawo essaawa emu wiiki eno okusabira ekitundu kyo, nga Nekkemiya bwe yasabira Yerusaalemi. Saba Katonda akulage by’alaba: obwetaavu bwakyo, abantu baakyo n’ebisuubizo bye gy’ekiri. Wandiika ebikujjira mu birowoozo. Oluvannyuma soma Nekkemiya 1 ne 2 mpola. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, bategeeze abakulembeze omu oba babiri b’oyesiga by’owandiise, era obabuuze obanga nabo babiraba.

study_questions.question: Okwolesebwa mu bukulembeze obw’Ekikristaayo kye ki?
study_questions.answer: Kwe kulaba Katonda by’alaba ne by’ayagala okukola, n’okubikwata mu kukkiriza. Katonda yagamba Kaabakuuku nti, “Wandiika okwolesebwa okwo ku bipande. Kuwandiike bulungi ate omubaka gwe banaatuma, akutwale bunnambiro” (Kaabakuuku 2:2). Okwolesebwa okw’amazima kuweereza obwakabaka bwa Katonda: “Obwakabaka bwo bujje” (Matayo 6:10).

study_questions.question: Engero 29:18 etegeeza nti abantu bazikirira awatali kwolesebwa kwa mukulembeze?
study_questions.answer: Si bwe kiri ddala. Mu Bayibuli ey’Oluganda gye tukozesa lusoma nti, “Awatali kwolesebwa abantu tebaba beegendereza” (Engero 29:18). Lwogera ku kigambo kya Katonda ekibikkuliddwa, so si ku nteekateeka z’omukulembeze. Essuula esoma olunyiriri luno n’obwegendereza nga tennaluzimbirako.

study_questions.question: Okwolesebwa kuzaalibwa kutya?
study_questions.answer: Emirundi mingi mu kusaba ne mu nnaku olw’ekyo ekimenyese. Nekkemiya bwe yawulira ku Yerusaalemi, “ne ntuula wansi ne nkaaba, ne mmala ebiro nga nnakuwadde, nga nsiiba era nga nsaba” (Nekkemiya 1:4). Essuula erabula ku kwolesebwa okw’obulimba okuva mu mutima gw’omukulembeze yennyini (Yeremiya 23:16).

fields.title: Amagezi n’Okuteekateeka
fields.body_html:
“Emirimu gyo gyonna gikwasenga Mukama, naye anaatuukirizanga entegeka zo.”

— Engero 16:3

Omulimi talinda nkuba kutonnya n’alyoka alowooza ku kusiga. Edda ddala nga bukyali, addaabiriza ebikozesebwa bye, alonda ensigo ze, ateekateeka ettaka era n’asalawo ekirime ki ekinaagenda mu nnimiro ki. Atunuulira eggulu era n’awuliriza abakadde abamanyi ebiseera by’omwaka. Olwo enkuba bw’etonnya, aba mwetegefu. Naye omulimi era amanyi nti tasobola kutonnyesa nkuba. Ateekateeka n’obwegendereza, n’oluvannyuma yeesiga Katonda olw’amakungula.

Mu ssuula ewedde twalaba nti okwolesebwa okwa nnamaddala kuva eri Katonda. Naye okwolesebwa okutaliiko nteekateeka kuba kwegomba bwegomba. Essuula eno eyogera ku magezi ag’okuteekateeka: engeri abakulembeze abatya Katonda gye bafuulamu ebyo Katonda by’abalaze amadaala ag’amagezi era ag’enkola, nga bwe bakyamwesigama.

Okuteekateeka kikontana n’eby’Omwoyo?

Abakristaayo abamu balowooza nti okuteekateeka kiraga nti omuntu talina kukkiriza. Bagamba nti, “Oba nga Katonda y’atukulembera, lwaki twetaaga okuteekateeka? Ka tusabe busabi era tugoberere Omwoyo.” Abalala bateekateeka nnyo ne batalekera Katonda kifo n’akatono. Bombi basobya.

Bayibuli eyisa bulungi okuteekateeka n’obwegendereza. “Enteekateeka z’omunyiikivu zivaamu magoba meereere, naye okwanguyiriza okutalina nteekateeka kuvaamu bwavu” (Engero 21:5). “Amagezi ge gazimba ennyumba, n’okutegeera kwe kugiggumiza” (Engero 24:3). Engero zitusindika ne mu nkuyege, nga zigamba nti “byekuŋŋaanyiza emmere mu biseera eby’amakungula, ne bitereka emmere mu biseera ebituufu mu mwaka” (Engero 6:8).

Yesu yennyini yakozesa okuteekateeka ng’ekifaananyi ky’obuyigirizwa. “Singa omu ku mmwe ayagala okuzimba omulungooti, tamala kutuula n’abalirira omuwendo omulimu ogwo gwe gunaatwala, n’alaba obanga ensimbi ezeetaagibwa azirina okugumaliriza? Kubanga singa tagumaliriza n’akoma ku musingi gwokka, buli agulaba atandika okumusekerera …” (Lukka 14:28-29). Mu bibuga bingi olaba ebizimbe by’amakanisa ebyazimbibwa ekitundu, ebyatandikibwa n’essanyu lingi ne birekebwa awo okumala emyaka, kubanga tewaali yabalirira muwendo. Ebigambo bya Yesu kulabula eri abakulembeze.

Yusufu, mu Misiri, yakola emu ku nteekateeka ezisinga obunene mu Bayibuli. Katonda yalaga Falaawo, mu birooto, nti emyaka omusanvu egy’ekyengera gyandiddiriddwa emyaka omusanvu egy’enjala. Yusufu n’awa Falaawo amagezi okutereka emmere ey’empeke mu myaka emirungi: “Emmere eyo eriterekebwa olw’enjala eriba mu nsi okumalako emyaka omusanvu egy’enjala” (Olubereberye 41:35-36). Katonda ye yawa okubikkulirwa. Yusufu ye yakola enteekateeka. Obulamu bw’abantu obukadde n’obukadde ne bulokolebwa.

N’olwekyo okuteekateeka si kye kikontana n’okukkiriza. Bwe kukolebwa obulungi, kikolwa kya kukkiriza. Kitwala ebisuubizo bya Katonda nga bya maanyi nnyo ne twetegekera okutuukirizibwa kwabyo.

Enteekateeka ezikwatiddwa mu mukono gwa Katonda

Mu kiseera kye kimu, Bayibuli etujjukiza nti enteekateeka zaffe si ze zisalawo ekisembayo. “Omutima gw’omuntu guteekateeka ekkubo lye, naye Mukama y’aluŋŋamya bw’anaatambula” (Engero 16:9). “Enteekateeka z’omuntu ziba nnyingi mu mutima gwe; byo ebigendererwa bya Mukama bituukirira” (Engero 19:21).

Yakobo alabula abo abakola enteekateeka nga gy’obeera nti be bafuga ebiseera eby’omu maaso: “Muwulire mmwe abagamba nti, ‘Leero oba enkya nzija kugenda egindi maleyo omwaka gumu, era ntandikeyo omulimu ogunanfunyisa ensimbi ennyingi.’ Mumanyidde ku ki ebigenda okubaawo enkya oba obulamu bwammwe bwe bunaaba? Kubanga ebbanga lye mumala nga muli balamu liri ng’olufu olulabika ate mangwago ne lubula. Kino kye musaanira okwogera nti, ‘Katonda bw’anaaba ng’asiimye tuliba balamu ne tukola kino oba kiri’” (Yakobo 4:13-15).

Yakobo tagamba nti, “Temuteekateekanga.” Agamba nti, “Muteekateeke mu bwetoowaze.” Enteekateeka zo zikwate mu mukono omugolole. Beera mwetegefu Katonda okuzikyusa. Pawulo yateekateeka okugenda e Esupaniya (Abaruumi 15:24). Ku bye tumanyi okuva mu Bayibuli, teyatuukayo. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, Katonda yamusindika e Rooma ng’asibiddwa mu njegere. Enteekateeka za Pawulo zaakyuka, naye ekigendererwa kya Katonda tekyalemererwa.

Laba okwekebera okwangu: nsooka kusaba ne ndyoka nteekateeka, oba nsooka kuteekateeka ne ndyoka nsaba? Abakulembeze bangi basalawo buli kimu ne balyoka basaba Katonda abiwe omukisa. Ekkubo ery’amagezi kwe kutandika n’okusaba, okuteekateeka nga bwe tusaba, n’okweyongera okusaba ng’enteekateeka bw’egenda etuukirizibwa. “Emirimu gyo gyonna gikwasenga Mukama, naye anaatuukirizanga entegeka zo” (Engero 16:3).

Nekkemiya omuteesi w’enteekateeka

Mu ssuula ewedde twalaba nti okwolesebwa kwa Nekkemiya kwatandika n’okusaba n’amaziga. Kaakano laba engeri gye yateekateekamu n’obwegendereza.

Yetegeka nga tannasaba. Kabaka bwe yabuuza Nekkemiya ky’ayagala, yali amaze okukimanya. Yasaba ebbaluwa ezimuyisa emirembe eri abaamasaza ab’oku kkubo, n’ebbaluwa eri omukuumi w’ekibira kya kabaka ey’emiti, ng’ayogera n’enzigi ne bbugwe bye yali agyetaagira (Nekkemiya 2:7-8). Yali akirowoozezzaako bulungi.

Yeekebejja nga tannayogera. Bwe yatuuka mu Yerusaalemi, yafuluma ekiro, era nga bw’agamba, “ne ŋŋenda nga neetegereza bbugwe wa Yerusaalemi eyali amenyeddwa, ne wankaaki waakyo eyayokebwa omuliro” (Nekkemiya 2:13). Yalaba obuzibu n’amaaso ge nga tannalangirira nteekateeka ze mu lwatu.

Yagabanyaamu omulimu. Nekkemiya 3 lukalala luwanvu olw’amannya. Buli kika oba buli kibinja kyazimba ekitundu kya bbugwe ekyali kiriraanye amaka gaabwe. Kabona asinga obukulu ne baganda be bakabona “ne batandika okukola n’okuddaabiriza Omulyango gw’Endiga” (Nekkemiya 3:1). Abaweesi ba zaabu, abakozi b’ebyakawoowo, abasuubuzi n’abafuzi bonna baalina ekitundu kyabwe. Omulimu omunene ne gufuuka emirimu mingi emitono.

Yakyusa enteekateeka obuzibu bwe bwajja. Abalabe bwe baatiisatiisa, Nekkemiya yakyusa enteekateeka: “ekitundu ku basajja bange bazimbanga n’ekitundu ekirala nga bakutte amafumu, n’engabo, n’obusaale n’ebyokulwanyisa ebirala” (Nekkemiya 4:16). Teyaleka mulimu. Yaguwa engeri empya.

Bbugwe yaggwa mu nnaku amakumi ataano mu bbiri. Okukkiriza kwa Nekkemiya n’enteekateeka ze byakolera wamu.

Amagezi ag’enkola mu kuteekateeka

Gano ge misingi egimu egiyinza okuyamba buli mukulembeze, ka abe mu kkanisa ey’omu kyalo oba mu buweereza obw’omu kibuga.

  • Tandika n’okusaba n’Ekyawandiikibwa. Buuza Katonda ky’ayogedde, era n’ekyo ky’akola dda.
  • Manya embeera yo. Nga Nekkemiya, weetegereze bulungi. Abantu be b’ani? Ebyetaago bye biruwa? Bintu ki by’olina?
  • Teekawo ebisooka. Tosobola kukola buli kimu. Londa ebintu bitono ebikulu obikole bulungi. “Malirizanga omulimu gwo ogw’ebweru, oteeketeeke ennimiro zo, n’oluvannyuma olyoke weezimbire ennyumba yo” (Engero 24:27). Ebintu ebimu birina okusooka.
  • Balirira omuwendo. Nga tonnatandika kuzimba kizimbe, ssomero oba buweereza buggya, buuza ssente ki, biseera ki n’abantu ki ebinaabyetaagisa, si kutandika kwokka wabula n’okumaliriza n’okweyongerayo.
  • Noonya amagezi. “Awatali kuluŋŋamizibwa entegeka zifa, naye awali abawi b’amagezi abangi ziyitamu” (Engero 15:22). Buuza abakulembeze banno, n’abantu abakoze omulimu ogufaananako.
  • Gabana omulimu. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu, buli muntu muwe ekitundu ky’asobola okwetikka.
  • Kuuma ebiwandiiko eby’amazima. Wandiika ebiweebwayo n’ebisaasaanyizibwa. Pawulo yafaayo nnyo ku nsimbi, kubanga, nga bw’agamba, “kye tugenderera kwe kukola ebirungi, si mu maaso ga Katonda yekka wabula ne mu maaso g’abantu” (2 Abakkolinso 8:21). Kino tujja kukyongera okukitunuulira mu Ssuula 33, Ssente n’Omululu.
  • Kebera era okyuse. Oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, tunula emabega. Kiki ekyakola? Kiki ekitaakola? Beera mwetegefu okulekera awo ebintu ebitakyabala bibala.
  • Kozesa obulungi ebiseera. Mubeere “nga temwonoona biseera” (Abaefeso 5:16). “Otuyigirize okutegeeranga obulungi ennaku zaffe, tulyoke tubeere n’omutima ogw’amagezi” (Zabbuli 90:12).

Jjukira nti okuteekateeka kufaanana mu ngeri ez’enjawulo mu bifo eby’enjawulo. Mu buwangwa obumu, abakulembeze bawandiika enteekateeka mu bujjuvu. Mu bulala, okusalawo kukolebwa mu kwogerezeganya okuwanvu wansi w’omuti okutuusa buli muntu lw’akkiriziganya. Byombi biyinza okuba eby’amagezi. Ekikulu kwe kuba nti omulimu gukolebwa n’okulowooza, n’okusaba era nga tuli wamu, “nga bwe kisaana era mu ntegeka entuufu” (1 Abakkolinso 14:40).

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Hudson Taylor ne George Müller

Hudson Taylor yali muminsani Omungereza eyaweereza mu China mu kyasa ekye kkumi n’omwenda. Mu 1865 yali akomyewo e Bungereza, ng’alwadde era ng’azitoowereddwa. Ebitundu ebinene ennyo eby’omunda mu China tebyalina muminsani n’omu. Yakkiriza nti Katonda yali ayagala atandikewo ekibiina ky’obuminsani ekipya okutuuka gye bali, naye yatya obuvunaanyizibwa obwo. Watya singa yatwala abalala e China ne ssente ne zibaggwako oba ne bafa?

Mu kitabo kye A Retrospect (Okutunula Emabega), ekiri ku Ochorus, annyonnyola ebyaliwo ku Ssande emu mu Jjuuni 1865, ku lubalama lw’ennyanja e Brighton:

“Awo Mukama n’awangula obutakkiriza bwange, ne nneewaayo eri Katonda olw’obuweereza buno. Ne mmugamba nti obuvunaanyizibwa bwonna ku bivaamu n’ebiddirira bwali bwa kubeera ku ye; nti nga ndi muddu we, ekyange kwali kugondera n’okumugoberera — ekikye kwali kuluŋŋamya, okulabirira, n’okukulembera nze n’abo abandikoze nange.”

— Hudson Taylor, A Retrospect

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Katonda yawangula obutaba na kukkiriza bwange, ne nneewaayo gy’ali olw’omulimu guno. Ne mmugamba nti ebinaavaamu buvunaanyizibwa bwe. Ekitundu kyange kwali kugondera n’okugoberera. Ekitundu kye kwali kukulembera, okulabirira n’okuluŋŋamya nze na buli muntu eyakola nange.

Weetegereze ekyaddirira. Taylor teyakoma ku kusaba okwa bulijjo. Yawandiika ekisabo ekigere ku mabbali ga Bayibuli ye: abakozi amakumi abiri mu bana, babiri ku lwa buli limu ku masaza ekkumi n’erimu ag’omunda agaali gatalina muminsani, ne babiri ku lwa Mongolia. Okwo kwali kukkiriza okufuuliddwa enteekateeka. Ekibiina China Inland Mission ne kitandikibwawo, era omwaka ogwaddirira Taylor n’asaabala n’ekibinja ky’abaminsani. Mu biseera ebyaddirira, enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu ne baweereza mu kibiina ekyo.

George Müller, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 13, Okubeera mu Kigambo, yalaga bbalansi y’emu. Yalabirira enkumi n’enkumi z’abaana bamulekwa mu Bristol, mu Bungereza, nga tasabangako muntu yenna ssente. Yabuuliranga Katonda yekka ku byetaago bye. Naye teyali mulagajjavu. Ennyanjula y’ekitabo kye The Life of Trust (Obulamu bw’Okwesiga), ekiri ku Ochorus, eraga nti teyabanga na bbanja era nti “Embalirira ze zeekebejjebwanga buli mwaka akakiiko akakugu.” Buli kirabo kyawandiikibwanga era buli nsaasaanya yawandiikibwanga. Obulamu bwa Müller bulaga nti okwesiga Katonda ddala ddala n’okukuuma ebiwandiiko n’obwegendereza bitambulira wamu.

Omulimi n’enkuba

Ddayo eri omulimi. Ateekateeka ennimiro ze n’obwegendereza bungi. Alonda ensigo ezisinga obulungi. Akola nnyo okuva ku makya okutuusa ekiro. N’oluvannyuma atunula waggulu mu ggulu n’alinda Katonda aweereze enkuba. Yandibadde musiru singa teyateekateeka. Yandibadde musiru singa alowooza nti okuteekateeka kwe kwe kumeza ebirime.

Eryo lye kkubo ly’omukulembeze ow’amagezi. Teekateeka n’obwegendereza. Balirira omuwendo. Gabanyaamu omulimu. Kuuma ebiwandiiko ebirungi. N’oluvannyuma byonna bikwase Mukama, ye yekka akuza. “Mukama bw’atazimba nnyumba, abo abagizimba bazimbira bwereere” (Zabbuli 127:1).

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Otera okuteekateeka kitono nnyo, ng’olowooza nti Katonda ajja kukimalawo, oba nnyo ddala, n’otomulekera kifo? Lwaki?
  • Osooka kusaba n’olyoka oteekateeka, oba osooka kuteekateeka n’olyoka osaba?
  • Soma Lukka 14:28-30. Waliwo omulimu mu kkanisa yo ogwatandikibwa nga tewali yabalirira muwendo? Kiki ekiyinza okuguyigibwako?
  • Soma Nekkemiya 3. Kikuyigiriza ki ku kugabanya omulimu omunene mu bantu bangi?
  • Hudson Taylor yagamba nti ebivaamu byali buvunaanyizibwa bwa Katonda ate okugondera kwali kwe. Ekyo kyandikyusizza kitya engeri gy’otwalamu omulimu gwo?
  • Ebiwandiiko by’ensimbi n’eby’okusalawo mu buweereza bwo bitegeerekeka era bya mazima? Ani abikebera?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Londa ekitundu kimu eky’obuweereza bwo ekyetaaga enteekateeka. Sooka okumala ekiseera ng’osaba ku kyo. Oluvannyuma wandiika ku lupapula lumu: ky’okkiriza nti Katonda ayagala kibeewo, by’olina kaakano, ebintu bisatu ebisooka mu myezi mukaaga egijja, buli kimu kye kinaatwala mu biseera, mu ssente ne mu bantu, n’ani anaakola buli kitundu. Lupapula olwo lulage abakulembeze banno, basabe amagezi gaabwe, era mulusabire wamu. Waggulu wandiikako nti “Katonda bw’anaaba ng’asiimye”.

study_questions.question: Okuteekateeka kikontana n’eby’Omwoyo eri omukulembeze Omukristaayo?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Ekyawandiikibwa kisiima okuteekateeka okw’amagezi: “Enteekateeka z’omunyiikivu zivaamu magoba meereere” (Engero 21:5). Yesu yayogera ku kubalirira omuwendo ng’omuntu tannazimba mulungooti (Lukka 14:28). Okuteekateeka n’okusaba bitambulira wamu.

study_questions.question: Enteekateeka zaffe zikwatagana zitya n’ebyo Katonda by’ayagala?
study_questions.answer: Ffe tuteekateeka, naye Katonda y’aluŋŋamya. “Omutima gw’omuntu guteekateeka ekkubo lye, naye Mukama y’aluŋŋamya bw’anaatambula” (Engero 16:9). N’olwekyo enteekateeka tuzikwata mpola era tuzikwasa ye: “Emirimu gyo gyonna gikwasenga Mukama, naye anaatuukirizanga entegeka zo” (Engero 16:3).

study_questions.question: Nekkemiya atuyigiriza ki ku kuteekateeka?
study_questions.answer: Nekkemiya yasaba, n’oluvannyuma n’ateekateeka n’obwegendereza, n’akuŋŋaanya ebyetaagisa, n’ategeka abantu, era ne yeekuuma eri abaziyiza. Alaga nti okukkiriza n’amagezi ag’enkola bikolera wamu, nga ne Hudson Taylor ne George Müller bwe balaga mu mboozi y’essuula eno.

fields.title: Eri Amawanga
fields.body_html:
“Eky’okubeera omuweereza wange n’okuzza amawanga ga Yakobo era n’okukomyawo abantu ba Isirayiri kintu kitono nnyo. Nzija kukufuula ekitangaala eri abamawanga, olyoke oleete obulokozi bwange eri ensi yonna.”

— Isaaya 49:6

Omugga ogutalina wa kufulumira gufuuka olutobazi. Amazzi gayingira, naye tegafuluma, era mangu ddala ne gatereera, ne gavunda era ne gajjula ensiri. Omugga ogweyongerayo okukulukuta, nga guyita mu nsi nnyingi, guleeta obulamu buli gye guyita.

N’amakanisa gayinza okuba bwe gatyo. Ekkanisa efuna bufunyi n’etasindika, ekyukira munda n’evunda. Ekkanisa esindika abantu, okusaba n’ebirabo eri amawanga esigala mpya era nnamu. Mu Ssuula 19, Okunoonya Abaabula, twalowooza ku kutuuka ku bantu abatwetoolodde. Mu ssuula eno twongera okuyimusa amaaso gaffe, okutuuka ku nkomerero z’ensi.

Omutima gwa Katonda eri amawanga

Enteekateeka ya Katonda ey’okuwa amawanga omukisa si kintu ekyongerezeddwako ku nkomerero ya Bayibuli. Etambula okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Katonda bwe yayita Ibulayimu, yamusuubiza nti, “mu ggwe amawanga gonna ag’omu nsi mwe galiweerwa omukisa” (Olubereberye 12:3). Abawandiisi ba zabbuli baayimba nti, “Mutende ekitiibwa kye mu mawanga gonna, eby’amagero bye mubimanyise abantu bonna” (Zabbuli 96:3), era ne basaba nti, “Abantu bakutenderezenga, Ayi Katonda, abantu bonna bakutenderezenga” (Zabbuli 67:3).

Ng’ayita mu Isaaya, Katonda yayogera n’Omuweereza we, Endagaano Empya gw’eraga nti ye Yesu: “Eky’okubeera omuweereza wange n’okuzza amawanga ga Yakobo era n’okukomyawo abantu ba Isirayiri kintu kitono nnyo. Nzija kukufuula ekitangaala eri abamawanga, olyoke oleete obulokozi bwange eri ensi yonna.” (Isaaya 49:6). Okulokola Isirayiri kwennyini kwali “kintu kitono nnyo” eri omutima gwa Katonda omunene. Yayagala ensi yonna.

Era Bayibuli ekomekkerera ng’essuubi eryo lituukiriziddwa: ekibiina ky’abantu abava “mu buli nsi na buli kika, na buli ggwanga na buli lulimi”, nga boogera mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, “Obulokozi bwa Katonda waffe atudde ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka era bwa Mwana gw’Endiga” (Okubikkulirwa 7:9-10). Lumu buli lulimi lw’owulidde, n’enkumi z’ennimi z’otowulirangako, zirikozesebwa okutendereza Yesu.

Ekiragiro Ekikulu

Oluvannyuma lw’okuzuukira kwe, Yesu yawa abagoberezi be omulimu gwabwe: “Mpeereddwa obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi. Kale mugende mufuule abantu bonna mu nsi zonna, abayigirizwa nga mubabatiza mu linnya lya Kitaffe, Omwana era Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Era mubayigirize okugonderanga byonna bye nabalagira mmwe, era Ndi nammwe bulijjo n’okutuukira ddala ensi lw’eriggwaawo” (Matayo 28:18-20).

Weetegereze ebigambo ebina ebya “bonna”. Obuyinza bwonna bwa Yesu. Abantu bonna mu nsi zonna be tugenderera. Byonna bye yalagira birina okuyigirizibwa. Era ali naffe bulijjo, ennaku zonna. Ekiragiro kinene, naye obuyinza obukiri emabega n’okubeerawo kwe okukiwerekera binene okusingawo.

Nga tannalinnya mu ggulu, Yesu yagamba nti, “Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8). Ekitabo ky’Ebikolwa by’Abatume kinyumya engeri kino gye kyatandikamu: okuva e Yerusaalemi, okutuuka e Samaliya, e Antiyokiya, mu Asiya, mu Buyonaani, era ku nkomerero e Rooma.

Buli mukulembeze w’ekkanisa mukulembeze wa mulimu gw’obuminsani

Abakulembeze abamu balowooza nti obuminsani kintu kya njawulo ekisanyusa abantu abatono abakyagala ennyo. Naye Ekiragiro Ekikulu kyaweebwa Ekkanisa yonna. Buli musumba, buli mukadde w’ekkanisa na buli mukulembeze avunaanyizibwa okuyamba ekkanisa ye okukyetabamu.

Laba engeri Enjiri gye yasooka okutuuka mu mawanga. Oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwa Suteefano, okuyigganyizibwa kwasaasaanya abakkiriza okuva mu Yerusaalemi. “Naye abakkiriza abadduka mu Yerusaalemi ne bagenda mu buli kifo nga babuulira Enjiri ya Yesu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 8:4). Mu kusooka baabuulira Bayudaaya bokka. “Naye, abamu ku bakkiriza abaagenda mu Antiyokiya nga bava e Kupulo n’e Kuleene ne babuulira Abayonaani ku Mukama waffe Yesu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 11:20). Abakkiriza bano abatamanyiddwa mannya, abamu nga bava mu Afirika ey’Obukiikakkono, be baasooka okusomosa Enjiri ku lukomera olunene olwali wakati w’Abayudaaya n’Abamawanga. Tebaali batume. Baali bakkiriza ba bulijjo.

Oluvannyuma ekkanisa ey’e Antiyokiya, eyakulemberwanga ekibinja kyayo eky’abannabbi n’abayigiriza, n’efuuka ekkanisa esooka okusindika abaminsani mu bugenderevu. “Awo bwe baali nga basinza Mukama era nga bwe basiiba, Mwoyo Mutukuvu n’agamba nti, ‘Munjawulire Balunabba ne Sawulo olw’omulimu gwe mbayitidde.’ Awo bwe baamala okusaba n’okusiiba, ne bassa emikono gyabwe ku Balunabba ne Sawulo, ne babasiibula ne bagenda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:2-3). Weetegereze nti ekkanisa yasindika abakulembeze baayo abasinga. Teyasindika bantu be yali esobola okwerekereza. Yawaayo abayigiriza baayo abasinga ebirabo.

Okuva buli wamu okudda buli wamu

Okumala ebyasa ebiwerako, abaminsani abasinga obungi baava mu Bulaaya ne mu Amerika ey’Obukiikakkono. Bangi ku bo baaweereza n’obwesigwa era nga beewaayo nnyo, era tubabanja nnyo. Abamu era baatabula Enjiri n’obuwangwa bwabwe, oba n’obuyinza bw’obwakabaka bw’amatwale, ne bakola akabi.

Leero ekifaananyi kikyuse. Abakristaayo abasinga obungi kaakano babeera mu Afirika, mu Asiya ne mu Amerika ey’Obukiikaddyo. Abaminsani basindikibwa okuva e Korea, e Brazil, e Nayijeriya, e Buyindi, mu Philippines, e China ne mu nsi endala nnyingi. Abafirika basimba amakanisa mu Bulaaya. Abava mu Amerika ey’Obukiikaddyo baweereza mu nsi z’Obuwalabu. Abava mu Asiya baweereza mu Afirika. Enjiri kaakano ekulukuta okuva buli wamu okudda buli wamu.

Kino kitegeeza nti tewali kkanisa eri nnaavu nnyo oba entono ennyo obutasobola kwetabamu. Ekkanisa ey’e Firipi teyali ya bugagga, naye Pawulo yabawandiikira nti “tewali Kkanisa n’emu eyampaayo akantu olw’ebyo bye yafuna okuggyako mmwe mwekka” (Abafiripi 4:15). Era kitegeeza nti tewali kkanisa esaanidde kufuna bufunyi. Oba nga ekkanisa yo yasimbibwa abaminsani, kaakano y’olwo lwammwe okusindika.

Engeri ekkanisa gy’etwalamu ekitundu

Si buli muntu nti ayitibwa okugenda mu nsi endala. Naye buli muntu asobola okwetabamu.

  • Musabe. Musabire amawanga, amawanga g’abantu abatannawulira, n’abaminsani nga mubayita amannya. Amakanisa mangi gasabira ensi emu oba eggwanga limu ery’abantu buli wiiki.
  • Muwe. Muwagire abo abagenda. Yokaana yawandiika nti tusaana okuwa abaminsani bye beetaaga ku lugendo lwabwe olweyongerayo: “Kibeera kirungi singa obasiibuza ekirabo ekiba kisaanidde … Noolwekyo ffe ffennyini, ffe tusaana okubalabirira tulyoke tufuuke bakozi bannaabwe mu mazima” (3 Yokaana 6-8).
  • Musindike. Mwekaliriza abantu Katonda b’ayita, mubategeke era mubawe olukusa okugenda, nga Antiyokiya bwe yakola.
  • Mugende. Abamu baligenda wala. Abalala balisomoka ensalo entono: okugenda eri ekika ekirala, ekibinja ky’olulimi olulala oba ekitundu ekirala eky’ekibuga.
  • Musembeze. Abantu bangi abava mu mawanga agatannatuukibwako kaakano babeera mu nsi endala ng’abasenze, ng’abanoonyi b’obubudamu oba ng’abayizi. Amawanga gayinza okuba nga gabeera mu kibuga kyo kyennyini.
  • Muyigirize ku buminsani. Muyambe abantu bammwe okulaba nti Bayibuli yonna kitabo kya buminsani, era nti Ekiragiro Ekikulu kyabwe.

Pawulo yennyini yagamba nti, “Nduubirira okubuulira Enjiri mu bifo etayatulwanga linnya lya Kristo” (Abaruumi 15:20). Mu nsi mukyaliyo amawanga g’abantu mangi agatalina kkanisa mu bo era agatalina Bayibuli mu lulimi lwabwe. Omukulembeze ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala tajja kumatira okutuusa nga bawulidde.

Enjiri n’obuwangwa

Enjiri bw’esomoka okuva mu buwangwa obumu okudda mu bulala, abakulembeze ab’amagezi balina okuyiga okwawula wakati w’Enjiri yennyini n’obuwangwa bwe yazingibwamu ng’ejja. Pawulo yagamba nti, “Eri abantu bonna nfuuse byonna, mu ngeri yonna ndyoke mbeeko beentusa ku kulokolebwa” (1 Abakkolinso 9:22). Enjiri teragira Mufirika kufuuka Mulaaya, wadde Omuyindi okufuuka Omumerika. Eyita buli buwangwa okufukamira Kristo, era ekuuma ebirungi mu buli buwangwa ng’egaana ebirimu ekibi.

Eno y’ensonga lwaki kikulu nnyo abantu okuwulira Enjiri mu lulimi lwabwe, nga bayita mu bantu baabwe we kisoboka, era nga bakulemberwa abakulembeze abava mu bo bennyini. Okwolesebwa kwa Henry Venn, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 23, Okukuza Abakulembeze, kwali kwa makanisa ageefuga gokka, ageeyimirizaawo gokka era ageegaziya gokka. Ekyo kikyali kye kigendererwa.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: John R. Mott ne Samuel Ajayi Crowther

John R. Mott yali Mumerika Omumetodisiti atali musumba, eyayamba, ku nkomerero y’ekyasa ekye kkumi n’omwenda, okukulembera okusituka okunene kw’abayizi abaawaayo obulamu bwabwe eri omulimu gw’obuminsani mu nsi yonna. Mu 1900 yawandiika ekitabo ekyalina omutwe ogwafuuka ekigambo ekikulu eky’enkumi n’enkumi: The Evangelization of the World in This Generation (Okubuulira Ensi Yonna Enjiri mu Mulembe Guno). Kiri ku Ochorus. Mott teyategeeza nti buli muntu mu nsi yandikyuse mu myaka amakumi asatu. Yannyonnyola kye yali ategeeza:

“Kitegeeza okuwa abantu bonna omukisa ogumala okumanya Yesu Kristo ng’Omulokozi waabwe n’okufuuka abayigirizwa be aba nnamaddala.”

— John R. Mott, The Evangelization of the World in This Generation

Mu bigambo ebyangu: kitegeeza okuwa buli muntu omukisa ogwa nnamaddala okumanya Yesu Kristo ng’Omulokozi we n’okufuuka omugoberezi we ow’amazima. Era Mott yalaga lwaki kyalina okuba “mu mulembe guno”: “N’olwekyo okubuulira ensi yonna Enjiri mu mulembe guno kitegeeza okubuulira Enjiri abo abali abalamu kaakano.” Abantu bokka be tusobola okutuukako be bantu abalamu leero. Buli mulembe gulina okutuuka ku bantu b’omulembe gwagwo.

Samuel Ajayi Crowther, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 4, Okuyitibwa kwa Katonda, yali omu ku baminsani abakulu ab’omu Afirika. Bwe yali akyali mulenzi yawambibwa n’atundibwa mu buddu, n’atwalibwa ku lubalama lw’Afirika ey’Obugwanjuba mu mmeeri y’abaddu. Mu 1854, ng’amaze okuyawulibwa olw’obuweereza, yaddayo ng’ayambuka Omugga Niger ku lugendo lw’obuminsani, era n’awandiika ebyaliwo buli lunaku. Biri ku Ochorus nga Ebiwandiiko by’Olugendo Okwambuka Omugga Niger. Mu kibuga kimu yayogera n’omwami ku ssaddaaka ya Kristo. Yakozesa ekifaananyi ekyangu omwami kye yali asobola okutegeera:

“Wandirowoozezza ki ku bantu, abandikoleezza ettaala zaabwe emisana ttuku nga bwe kiri kati okuyamba ebitangaala eby’amaanyi eby’enjuba okubasobozesa okulaba obulungi?” N’agamba nti, “Tekyandibaddeko mugaso; bandibadde basirusiru okukola bwe batyo.”

— Samuel Ajayi Crowther, Ebiwandiiko by’Olugendo Okwambuka Omugga Niger

Awo Crowther n’annyonnyola nti nga enjuba emu bw’emala okumulisa ensi yonna, ne ssaddaaka ya Yesu Kristo bw’etyo bw’emala okuggyawo ebibi byaffe, era tewali ssaddaaka ndala zeetaagibwa. Yakozesa ensi y’abo abaali bamuwuliriza okunnyonnyola Enjiri, era n’ayogera ng’ayita mu muvvuunuzi mu lulimi omwami lwe yali ategeera.

Crowther yali omu ku nkumi n’enkumi z’abakkiriza Abafirika, ab’omu Asiya n’ab’omu Amerika ey’Obukiikaddyo abaatwala Enjiri eri baliraanwa baabwe. Tiyo Soga, Omufirika omuddugavu eyasooka mu South Africa okuyawulibwa ng’omusumba, mu 1856, yavvuunula Olugendo lw’Omutambuze mu lulimi Olukhosa era n’awandiika ennyimba ezikyayimbibwa. Mu China ey’obukiikakkono, omuyivu ayitibwa Xi Shengmo, abaminsani gwe baamanya ng’Omusumba Hsi, yasumululwa okuva mu buddu bw’enjaga eya opium ng’ayita mu Kristo mu 1879. Yeeyongerayo okuggulawo ebifo eby’obuddukiro, abalala bikumi na bikumi mwe baasumululirwa. Bangi ku baminsani abasinga obukulu mu byafaayo tebaava ku lukalu lwabwe.

Muyimuse amaaso gammwe

Yesu yagamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Nga Kitange bwe yantuma, nange bwe mbatuma mmwe” (Yokaana 20:21). Kitaffe yatuma Omwana okusomoka ebbanga erisinga obuwanvu eriyinza okubaawo, okuva mu ggulu okudda ku nsi. Omwana atutuma okusomoka buli bbanga ku nsi: okusomoka oluguudo, okusomoka ekika, okusomoka ennyanja ennene.

Nnabbi Kaabakuuku yalindirira olunaku “ensi erijjula okumanya ekitiibwa kya Mukama, ng’amazzi bwe ganjaala ku nnyanja” (Kaabakuuku 2:14). Olunaku olwo lujja. Abakulembeze ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala bajja kukulembera amakanisa gaabwe okutuukiriza ekitundu kyago mu lwo.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Olubereberye 12:1-3 n’Okubikkulirwa 7:9-10. Bayibuli yonna eraga etya omutima gwa Katonda eri amawanga?
  • Ekkanisa yo esindika, oba efuna bufunyi? Kiki ekyandikyuse singa etandika okusindika?
  • Soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:1-3. Kiki ky’oyiga ku ngeri ekkanisa ey’e Antiyokiya gye yasindikamu abaminsani?
  • Mawanga ki ag’abantu abali okumpi naawe, oba ewala, agatalina kkanisa mu bo? Ekkanisa yo eyinza kubasabira etya?
  • Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’Enjiri n’obuwangwa bw’ezingibwamu ng’ejja? Osobola okulowooza ku kyakulabirako?
  • Mott yagamba nti buli mulembe gulina okutuuka ku bantu b’omulembe gwagwo. Ekyo kitegeeza ki eri ekkanisa yo leero?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Londa eggwanga limu ery’abantu oba ensi emu abantu batono mwe bamanyi Kristo. Noonyereza ky’osobola okumanya ku lyo: olulimi lwalyo, eddiini yaalyo, n’obanga waliwo ekkanisa yonna mu bo. Wiiki eno, kulembera ekkanisa yo, ekibinja kyo ekitono oba amaka go mu kusabira abantu abo nga mubayita erinnya. Oluvannyuma buuza abakulembeze banno nti: “Ekkanisa yaffe eyinza etya okusaba, okuwaayo, okusindika oba okugenda, tulyoke tubeere ekkanisa esindika so si efuna obufunyi?”

study_questions.question: Lwaki buli mukulembeze w’ekkanisa asaanidde okufaayo ku buminsani eri amawanga?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga omutima gwa Katonda bulijjo gubadde eri abantu bonna. Yasuubiza Ibulayimu nti “mu ggwe amawanga gonna ag’omu nsi mwe galiweerwa omukisa” (Olubereberye 12:3), era Yesu yalagira nti, “Kale mugende mufuule abantu bonna mu nsi zonna, abayigirizwa” (Matayo 28:19).

study_questions.question: “Okuva buli wamu okudda buli wamu” kitegeeza ki?
study_questions.answer: Kitegeeza nti obuminsani tebukyava nnyo mu Bugwanjuba okudda mu nsi endala. Amakanisa mu Afirika, mu Asiya ne mu Amerika ey’Obukiikaddyo kaakano gasindika abaminsani mu nsi yonna, era buli kkanisa, ne bw’eba wa, esobola okuba ekkanisa esindika.

study_questions.question: Ekkanisa ey’omu kitundu eyinza etya okwetaba mu buminsani obw’ensi yonna?
study_questions.answer: Mu kusabira amawanga, okuwaayo, okusindika n’okulabirira abaminsani, okusembeza abantu abava mu nsi endala, n’okuyamba abakkiriza okulaba okwolesebwa kwa buli ggwanga na buli kika nga biri mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka (Okubikkulirwa 7:9). Essuula ekozesa ebyokulabirako bya John R. Mott ne Samuel Ajayi Crowther.

fields.title: Obwenkanya, Okusaasira n’Abaavu
fields.body_html:
“Mukama akulaze, ggwe omuntu, ekirungi ky’oteekwa okukola. Kaakano, Mukama kiki ky’akwetaaza, okuggyako okukola eby’ensonga, okuba n’ekisa era n’okutambulira mu buwombeefu ne Katonda wo.”

— Mikka 6:8

Omusajja agalamidde ku mabbali g’ekkubo. Abanyazi bamunyaze era bamukubye, era ali kumpi kufa. Kabona ajja ng’ayita mu kkubo eryo, amulaba, n’adda ku ludda olulala. Oluvannyuma omukozi wa yeekaalu naye akola bw’atyo. Bombi baali bakulembeze ba ddiini. Oboolyawo baali bagenda kukulembera kusinza. Olwo Omusamaliya, omusajja abalala gwe baanyoomanga, n’ayimirira. Asiba ebiwundu by’omusajja, amuteeka ku ndogoyi ye, amutwala mu nnyumba y’abagenyi era n’amusasulira okujjanjabibwa.

Yesu yanyumya olugero luno eri omunnyonnyozi w’amateeka eyabuuza nti, “Muliraanwa wange ye ani?” Ku nkomerero, Yesu yamubuuza ani ku basatu abo eyali muliraanwa w’omusajja eyali afunye ebiwundu. N’addamu nti, “Oyo eyamukolera ebyekisa.” Yesu n’amugamba nti, “Naawe genda okole bw’otyo” (Lukka 10:36-37).

Weetegereze abaalemererwa mu lugero: abakulembeze b’eddiini. Kisoboka omuntu okuba ng’ali bubize nnyo n’emirimu gy’eddiini n’ayita ku bantu ababonaabona. Essuula eno eyogera ku kuyitibwa kw’omukulembeze eri obwenkanya n’okusaasira, n’okulabirira abaavu.

Katonda alaba abaavu

Katonda wa Bayibuli afaayo mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku abo abanafu, abaavu n’abatalina buyinza. Ebyawandiikibwa byogera ku ye nti: “Bamulekwa abataliiko bakitaabwe, ne bannamwandu, abamalira ensonga zaabwe mu bwenkanya; era ayagala ne bannamawanga abatambuze, ng’abawa emmere n’ebyokwambala” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 10:18). “Omuntu atulugunya abaavu anyooma oyo eyabatonda, naye buli abakwatirwa ekisa, agulumiza Katonda” (Engero 14:31).

Olw’okuba Katonda afaayo ku baavu, n’abantu be balina okufaayo. Katonda yagamba Isirayiri nti, “Kale nno, mwagalenga bannamawanga kubanga nammwe mwaliko bannamawanga mu nsi ey’e Misiri” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 10:19). Baali bamanyi obuddu bwe bufaanana. Tebaalina kufuula balala baddu n’akatono.

Ng’ayita mu nnabbi Yeremiya, Katonda yayogera ku kabaka omulungi, Yosiya: “Yalwanirira abaavu n’abali mu bwetaavu kale byonna ne bimugendera bulungi. Ekyo si kye kitegeeza okummanya? bw’ayogera Mukama” (Yeremiya 22:16). Ekyo kigambo kya kitalo. Okulwanirira abaavu kitundu ku kye kitegeeza okumanya Katonda.

Okusinza Katonda kw’agaana

Bannabbi emirundi mingi baayogeranga ku bantu abaali abeddiini ennyo naye nga tebafaayo ku bwenkanya. Ng’ayita mu Isaaya, Katonda yagamba abantu nti okusiiba kwabwe tekwalina kye kumutegeeza nga bwe bakyanyigiriza abakozi baabwe era nga bayomba. Olwo n’ayogera okusiiba kw’ayagala: “okusumulula enjegere ezinyigiriza abantu, n’okuggyawo emiguwa gy’ekikoligo, n’okuta abo abanyigirizibwa … Si kugabira bayala ku mmere yo, n’okusembeza abaavu abatalina maka mu nnyumba yo; bw’olaba ali obwereere, n’omwambaza” (Isaaya 58:6-7).

Era Katonda yasuubiza abo abakola bwe batyo nti: “Awo omusana gwo gulyoke guveeyo gwake ng’emmambya esala … Olwo olikoowoola, Mukama n’akuddamu; olikaaba naye n’akuddamu nti, ‘Ndi wano’” (Isaaya 58:8-9).

Amosi yayogera ekintu kye kimu mu ngeri esingako obukambwe. Katonda teyayagala nnyimba zaabwe n’embaga zaabwe ng’abaavu babetentebwa. “Kye njagala okulaba ge mazima n’obwenkanya nga bikulukuta ng’amazzi, n’obutuukirivu nga bukulukuta ng’omugga ogw’amaanyi” (Amosi 5:24).

Abakulembeze balina okutwala kino nga kikulu. Ekkanisa eyinza okuba n’okusinza okulungi, okusaba okuwanvu n’okubuulira okw’amaanyi, naye n’enyiiza Katonda singa eba ebuusa amaaso okubonaabona okugyetoolodde, oba singa abakulembeze baayo bayisa abaavu mu bukyamu.

Yesu n’abaavu

Yesu bwe yatandika obuweereza bwe, yasoma okuva mu Isaaya mu kkuŋŋaaniro e Nazaaleesi: “Omwoyo wa Mukama ali ku nze. Anfuseeko amafuta okubuulira abaavu Enjiri. Antumye okubuulira abasibe okuteebwa, n’abazibe b’amaaso okuzibulwa amaaso balabe, n’abanyigirizibwa okufuna eddembe” (Lukka 4:18).

Mu bulamu bwe bwonna, Yesu yayaniriza abantu abalala be baasindiikiriza ebbali: abagenge, abasabirizi, bannamwandu, abaana, bannamawanga n’aboonoonyi. Yaliisa ebibiina by’abantu abaali enjala. Yawonya abalwadde nga tabasaba kusasula.

Era yayigiriza nti ku musango ogw’enkomerero aligamba abantu be nti, “nnali muyala ne mundiisa, nnali muyonta ne mumpa ekyokunywa, nnali mugenyi ne munnyaniriza, nnali bwereere ne munnyambaza, nnali mulwadde ne munnambula, nnali mu kkomera ne mujja okundaba.” Bwe balibuuza ddi lwe baakola ebyo, aliddamu nti, “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe mwabikolera baganda bange bano abasembayo wansi kye kimu mwabikolera nze!” (Matayo 25:35-40).

Yesu asangibwa mu baavu. Bwe tubaweereza, tuweereza ye.

Okukkiriza okukola

Ekkanisa eyasooka kino yakitwala nga kikulu. Mu Yerusaalemi, “Mu bo temwali baali mu kwetaaga”, kubanga abakkiriza baagabananga bye baalina (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:34). Obuweereza bwa Pawulo eri Abamawanga bwe bwakkirizibwa abakulembeze ab’omu Yerusaalemi, “Kye baatusaba kyokka tujjukirenga abaavu, ate ng’ekyo kye nnali nesunga okukola” (Abaggalatiya 2:10).

Yakobo yayogera butereevu: “Singa muganda wo oba mwannyoko takyalina kyakwambala wadde ekyokulya, naye omu ku mmwe n’amugamba nti, ‘Genda mirembe, obugume, era olye bulungi’, naye nga tamuwaddeeyo byetaago bya mubiri, olwo kimugasa ki? Noolwekyo n’okukkiriza bwe kutyo; bwe kutabaako bikolwa kuba kufu” (Yakobo 2:15-17). Era yawandiika nti, “Eddiini entuufu etaliiko bbala mu maaso ga Katonda Kitaffe, y’eyo ey’omuntu alabirira bamulekwa ne bannamwandu” (Yakobo 1:27).

Yokaana yabuuza ekibuuzo ekizibu: “Buli alina ebintu eby’omu nsi n’alaba muganda we nga yeetaaga, naye n’abulwako ky’amuwa, okwagala kwa Katonda, kuyinza kutya okuba mu ye?” (1 Yokaana 3:17).

Okulabirira abaavu si kintu ekituggya ku Njiri. Kitundu ku bulamu Enjiri bw’ezaala. Tetulokolebwa lwa bikolwa birungi. Naye nga Pawulo bw’agamba, “Tuli mulimu gwa Katonda, abaatondebwa mu Kristo Yesu, okukolanga ebikolwa ebirungi, nga Katonda bwe yatuteekerateekera” (Abaefeso 2:10).

Okusaasira n’obwenkanya

Bayibuli etuyita eri okusaasira n’eri obwenkanya. Bikwatagana, naye si kimu.

Okusaasira kukola ku kwetaaga okw’amangu. Kuliisa omusajja alumwa enjala leero. Kusiba ebiwundu by’omutambuze eyakubibwa, nga Omusamaliya bwe yakola. Buli kkanisa esobola okukola kino: okugabana emmere, okukyalira abalwadde, okulabirira bannamwandu ne bamulekwa, n’okwaniriza abanoonyi b’obubudamu.

Obwenkanya bubuuza lwaki omusajja alumwa enjala, era bukola okukyusa ekikyamu. Bubuuza lwaki ekkubo erigenda e Yeriko lijjudde abanyazi. Bwogerera abo abayisibwa mu ngeri etali ya bwenkanya. “Yogereranga abo abatasobola kweyogerera, otunulenga mu nsonga z’abo bonna abaasigala ettayo. Yogera olamulenga n’obwenkanya, olwanirirenga abaavu n’abali mu bwetaavu” (Engero 31:8-9). “Muyige okukola obulungi, musalenga emisango n’amazima, mudduukirirenga abajoogebwa, musalenga omusango gw’atalina kitaawe, muwolerezenga bannamwandu” (Isaaya 1:17).

Abakulembeze beetaaga amagezi wano. Si buli mukulembeze nti ayitibwa okwenyigira mu by’obufuzi, era Ekkanisa terina kufuuka kibiina kya byabufuzi bufuzi. Naye abakulembeze tebasobola kusirika ng’abantu mu bitundu byabwe bennyini balimbibwalimbibwa, bafuulibwa abaddu, batundibwa oba batulugunyizibwa. Mu bifo bingi, omusumba y’omu ku bantu abatono abaavu be beesiga. Obwo buvunaanyizibwa butukuvu. Tujja kulowooza ku bakulembeze mu bulamu bw’olwatu mu Ssuula 45, Abakulembeze ku Mulimu ne mu Bantu.

Abakulembeze era balina okwetegereza amakanisa gaabwe. Abaavu baanirizibwa, oba entebe ezisinga obulungi zikuumirwa abagagga? Yakobo yalabula ku kintu kino kyennyini (Yakobo 2:1-4). Abakozi ekkanisa b’ekozesa basasulwa mu bwenkanya era mu budde? Abakulembeze b’ekkanisa bakozesa ekifo kyabwe okufuna ettaka oba ssente okuva ku abo abatasobola kugaana? Obwenkanya butandikira waka.

Ebikolwa by’ekisa ebitono

Abakulembeze bangi bawulira ng’ebyetaago ebibeetoolodde bibasinga amaanyi. Obwavu bungi nnyo, obutali bwenkanya bungi nnyo. Ekkanisa emu entono eyinza kuleeta njawulo ki?

Yesu yagamba nti, “buli aliwa omu ku baana bano abato egiraasi y’amazzi agannyogoga olw’erinnya ly’omuyigiriza talirema kuweebwa mpeera ye” (Matayo 10:42). Katonda alaba ebikolwa by’ekisa ebitono. Ekijjulo eri nnamwandu. Ebisale by’essomero eri mulekwa. Okukyalira omusibe. Ekigambo ekyogerwa ku lw’omuntu eyalimbibwa. Tewali na kimu ku bino ekigenda obwereere. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Noolwekyo, buli lwe kinaabanga kisobose tukolerenga abantu bonna ebirungi, na ddala ab’omu nnyumba ey’okukkiriza” (Abaggalatiya 6:10).

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Basil, Allen ne Jones, ne Wilberforce

Mu kyasa eky’okuna, Basil yali omulabirizi w’e Kayisaliya, mu kitundu ekiri wakati mu Turkey ey’olwaleero. Mu kiseera ky’enjala ey’entiisa yatunda ebintu bye yali asikidde okuliisa abaali enjala, era n’akuŋŋaanya emmere n’agigabula abaavu n’emikono gye. Oluvannyuma yazimba ekifo ekinene ebweru w’ekibuga eky’okulabiriramu abalwadde, abaavu, abatambuze n’abantu abaalina ebigenge, abalala be baali batayagala kukwatako. Kyalimu eddwaliro, amayumba g’abaavu n’ebifo eby’emikono. Mikwano gye baakiyita “ekibuga ekiggya”. Kyafuuka ekyokulabirako eri amalwaliro g’Ekikristaayo mu byasa ebyaddirira.

Mu 1793, omusujja gw’enkaka ogw’entiisa gwayita mu kibuga ky’Amerika eky’e Philadelphia. Enkumi z’abantu zaafa, era buli eyali asobola okusasulira olugendo yadduka. Abasumba babiri Abaddugavu, Absalom Jones ne Richard Allen, abaazaalibwa mu buddu ne beegulira eddembe lyabwe, baasabibwa okuyamba. Ng’ekitabo The Fire on the Altar (Omuliro ku Kyoto) ekiri ku Ochorus bwe kinyumya, baakuŋŋaana, ne basaba era ne bakkiriziganya okugenda. Mu kapapula ke baawandiika omwaka ogwaddirira, baagamba nti:

“Mukama yasiima okutuwa amaanyi, n’atuggyamu okutya kwonna, n’ateekateeka emitima gyaffe okubeera ab’omugaso nga bwe kisoboka.”

— Absalom Jones ne Richard Allen, 1794

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Katonda yatufuula ba maanyi, n’atuggyako okutya era n’atufuula abeetegefu okuyamba mu buli ngeri gye twali tusobola. Okumala wiiki eziwera bo n’abayambi abalala Abaddugavu baajjanjaba abalwadde, ne baziika abafu era ne balabirira abaana abaali bafiiriddwa bazadde baabwe. Bangi ku bo baakwatibwa omusujja. Era omukubi w’ebitabo ayitibwa Mathew Carey bwe yavunaana abajjanjabi Abaddugavu nti balimba abalwadde, Jones ne Allen ne bamuddamu n’obumalirivu, nga bakozesa amazima.

William Wilberforce yali mubaka mu Paalamenti ya Bungereza ku nkomerero y’ekyasa ekye kkumi n’omunaana ne ku ntandikwa y’ekyasa ekye kkumi n’omwenda. Bwe yamala okufuna okukkiriza okulamu mu Kristo ng’akyali muvubuka, yalowooza ku kuva mu by’obufuzi afuuke omusumba. Naye mukwano gwe ow’amagezi, John Newton, eyali kapiteeni w’emmeeri y’abaddu edda, n’amukubiriza okusigala, aweereze Katonda mu Paalamenti. Mu 1787 Wilberforce yawandiika mu biwandiiko bye ebya buli lunaku nti Katonda yali amuteeseeko emirimu ebiri emikulu: okukomya obusuubuzi bw’abaddu n’okukyusa empisa z’eggwanga. Okumala emyaka amakumi abiri ye ne mikwano gye baakola, ne basaba, ne bawandiika era ne boogera nga bawakanya obusuubuzi bw’abaddu. Baasekererwa, ne batiisibwatiisibwa era ne bawangulwa emirundi n’emirundi. Mu 1807 obusuubuzi bw’abaddu obwa Bungereza bwakomezebwa mu mateeka. Ennaku ntono nga tannafa mu 1833, Paalamenti yayisa ekiteeso eky’okukomya obuddu bwennyini mu bitundu ebisinga obungi eby’Obwakabaka bwa Bungereza. Ekitabo kye A Practical View of Christianity (Endowooza ey’Enkola ku Bukristaayo), ekyakoowoola Abakristaayo abeegolodde okufuna okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala, kiri ku Ochorus.

Buli omu ku bakulembeze bano yalaba okubonaabona, n’agaana okudda ku ludda olulala olw’ekkubo, n’akola, ng’asasula nnyo, mu linnya lya Kristo.

Kola eby’ensonga, yagala ekisa, tambula mu buwombeefu

Mikka yakifunza mu sentensi emu: “Kaakano, Mukama kiki ky’akwetaaza, okuggyako okukola eby’ensonga, okuba n’ekisa era n’okutambulira mu buwombeefu ne Katonda wo” (Mikka 6:8). Okukola eby’ensonga, okuba n’ekisa, n’okutambulira mu buwombeefu ne Katonda bitambulira wamu. Omukulembeze ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala tajja kubyawukanya.

Kale naawe genda okole bw’otyo.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Lukka 10:25-37. Olowooza lwaki Yesu yafuula abakulembeze b’eddiini be baayitawo?
  • Soma Isaaya 58:6-10. “Okusiiba” okw’engeri ki Katonda kw’ayagala okuva mu kkanisa yo?
  • Ani mu kitundu kyo atalina amwogerera? Ekkanisa yo eyinza kubakolera ki?
  • Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okusaasira n’obwenkanya? Kiruwa ekkanisa yo ky’ekola ennyo?
  • Ekkanisa yo kifo abaavu we bawulira nga baanirizibwa era nga bayisibwa mu bwenkanya? Okimanyi otya?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga ku Absalom Jones ne Richard Allen mu kiseera ky’omusujja gwa 1793?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno tambula mu kitundu kyo ng’amaaso go maggule, era saba Katonda akulage ababonaabona: bannamwandu, bamulekwa, abalwadde, abanoonyi b’obubudamu, abasibe, abakozi abalimbibwa. Londa omuntu omu oba amaka gamu, obakolere ekikolwa kimu eky’ekisa eky’enkola wiiki eno. Oluvannyuma kuŋŋaanya abakulembeze banno obabuuze nti: “Waliwo obutali bwenkanya bwonna mu kitundu kyaffe bwe tusaanidde okwogerako oba okulwanyisa? Waliwo obutali bwenkanya bwonna mu kkanisa yaffe yennyini bwe tulina okutereeza?”

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze b’ekkanisa basaanidde okulabirira abaavu?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga Katonda abalabirira. “Bamulekwa abataliiko bakitaabwe, ne bannamwandu, abamalira ensonga zaabwe mu bwenkanya; era ayagala ne bannamawanga abatambuze” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 10:18). “Omuntu atulugunya abaavu anyooma oyo eyabatonda, naye buli abakwatirwa ekisa, agulumiza Katonda” (Engero 14:31).

study_questions.question: Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okusaasira n’obwenkanya?
study_questions.answer: Okusaasira kukola ku byetaago eby’amangu, nga Omusamaliya eyalabirira omusajja eyali afunye ebiwundu. Obwenkanya bukola ku nsonga ezibireeta, nga bulwanirira abaavu, nga Yosiya: “Yalwanirira abaavu n’abali mu bwetaavu” (Yeremiya 22:16). Katonda ayagala byombi: “okukola eby’ensonga, okuba n’ekisa era n’okutambulira mu buwombeefu ne Katonda wo” (Mikka 6:8).

study_questions.question: Okusinza okw’engeri ki Katonda kw’agaana?
study_questions.answer: Okusinza okubuusa amaaso obutali bwenkanya. Ng’ayita mu Isaaya, Katonda yagamba nti okusiiba kw’ayagala kwe “okusumulula enjegere ezinyigiriza abantu” n’okugabira abayala ku mmere (Isaaya 58:6-7). Essuula enyumya ku Basil, Richard Allen ne Absalom Jones, ne William Wilberforce.

fields.title: Okukulembera mu Kuzuukuka n’Enkyukakyuka
fields.body_html:
“Ayi Mukama, mpulidde ebigambo byo; mpulidde ettutumu lyo Ayi Mukama, ne ntya. Bizze buggya mu nnaku zaffe, bimanyise mu biro bino, era mu busungu jjukira okusaasira.”

— Kaabakuuku 3:2

Oluvannyuma lw’ekyeya ekiwanvu, enkuba ezisooka kintu kya kitalo. Enfuufu efuuka ebisooto. Ensigo ezibadde zeekwese mu ttaka okumala emyezi zimulisa amangu ago ebimera ebibisi. Emigga egibadde amayinja gokka gitandika okukulukuta. Mu wiiki ntono, ensi yonna erabika mu ngeri ndala. Tewali mulimi asobola kukireetawo. Naye buli mulimi amanyi eky’okukola bwe kijja: okulima, okusiga, n’okukola ennyo ng’enkuba ekyatonnya.

Emirundi n’emirundi mu byafaayo, Katonda aweerezza Ekkanisa ye ebiseera ng’ebyo. Abantu babiyita okuzuukuka oba okuzuukusibwa. Abakkiriza abaali bannyogovu bafuuka ababuguumirivu. Ebibi ebikwekeddwa byatulwa. Abantu bangi bafuna okukkiriza mu kiseera kitono. Ebitundu byonna bikyuka.

Essuula eno, esembayo mu Kitundu eky’Omukaaga: Okwolesebwa n’Omulimu, eyogera ku kukulembera mu biseera ng’ebyo. Era eyogera ku nkyukakyuka ey’engeri endala abakulembeze bangi gye basanga emirundi mingi okusingawo: omulimu omugonvu ogw’obugumiikiriza ogw’okuyamba ekkanisa okukyuka nga tewali kuzuukuka kunene n’akatono.

Okuzzibwamu obulamu omulundi omulala

Bayibuli ejjudde okusaba okw’okuzuukuka. Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli yakaaba nti, “Tolituzaamu ndasi, abantu bo basanyukirenga mu ggwe?” (Zabbuli 85:6). Kaabakuuku yasaba nti, “Ayi Mukama, … Bizze buggya mu nnaku zaffe” (Kaabakuuku 3:2). Yali awulidde Katonda bye yakola edda, era yeegomba okubiraba nate mu nnaku ze.

Katonda yawa Sulemaani ekisuubizo yeekaalu bwe yawongebwa: “abantu bange abatuumiddwa erinnya lyange bwe baneetowazanga, ne basaba, ne banoonya amaaso gange, ne bakyuka okuleka amakubo gaabwe amakyamu, kale nnaawuliranga nga nsinziira mu ggulu ne nsonyiwa ekibi kyabwe era ne mponya ensi yaabwe” (2 Ebyomumirembe 7:14). Ekisuubizo kino kyasooka kuweebwa Isirayiri. Naye kitulaga ekkubo lya buli kuzuukuka okwa nnamaddala: obwetoowaze, okusaba, okunoonya Katonda n’okukyuka okuva mu kibi, ne biddirirwa okusonyiwa kwa Katonda n’okuwonya kwe.

Weetegereze nti okuzuukuka kutandikira mu bantu ba Katonda bennyini. Olunyiriri luno teyogera nti, “abatakkiriza bwe beenenya”. Egamba nti, “abantu bange”. Okuzuukuka, okusookera ddala, kwe Kkanisa okuzzibwamu obulamu.

Okuzuukuka bwe kufaanana

Mu nnaku za Nekkemiya, bbugwe bwe yamala okuzimbibwa, abantu baakuŋŋaana okuwulira Ezera ng’asoma amateeka. Abantu bonna baakaaba nga bawulira ebigambo by’amateeka, Nekkemiya ne Ezera n’Abaleevi ne kibawaliriza okubagamba nti, “Olunaku lwa leero lutukuvu eri Mukama Katonda wammwe; temunakuwala so temukaaba” (Nekkemiya 8:9). Nga wayiseewo wiiki ntono, baddamu ne bakuŋŋaana, “ne basiiba, nga bambadde ebibukutu … ne bayimirira mu bifo byabwe ne baatula ebibi byabwe”, era “ne basoma mu Kitabo ky’Amateeka ga Mukama Katonda waabwe, okumala essaawa ssatu, n’oluvannyuma ne baatula era ne basinza Mukama Katonda waabwe okumala essaawa endala nga ssatu” (Nekkemiya 9:1-3).

Ku lunaku lwa Pentekoote, Peetero bwe yamala okubuulira, “ne beeyongerako ng’enkumi ssatu.” Kaakano laba ebyaddirira. “Ne banyiikiranga okuyigirizibwa kw’abatume ne mu kussekimu, ne mu kumenya omugaati era ne mu kusaba … ne bakuŋŋaananga ne mu maka gaabwe nju ku nju okumenya omugaati, ne baliiranga wamu emmere yaabwe n’essanyu lingi n’omutima ogutalina bukuusa, nga batendereza Katonda … Mukama n’abongerangako bulijjo abaalokolebwanga” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:41-47).

Mu byafaayo byonna, okuzuukuka okwa nnamaddala kubaddeko obubonero bungi obufaanagana:

  • Okuwulira ennyo obutukuvu bwa Katonda n’ekibi ky’omuntu yennyini.
  • Okwatula mu lwatu n’okwenenya okwa nnamaddala, nga mw’otwalidde n’okutereeza ebyasobyibwa.
  • Okwagala okuggya eri Yesu n’essanyu mu bulokozi bwe.
  • Enjala empya ey’okusoma Bayibuli n’ey’okusaba.
  • Okwagalana n’obumu mu bakkiriza, emirundi mingi nga busomoka enjawukana ez’edda.
  • Abantu bangi okufuna okukkiriza.
  • Obulamu obukyuse obubeerera, obulabibwa mu maka, ku mirimu ne mu bitundu.

Okugezesa ebiriwo

Katonda bw’akola n’amaanyi, ebintu ebyewuunyisa nabyo biyinza okubaawo. Abantu abamu bakaaba, bakankana oba boogerera waggulu. Abamu bagamba nti bafunye okwolesebwa oba obunnabbi. Abakulembeze abamu beenyumiriza mu kuzuukuka “kwabwe”. Era oluusi ebintu ebirabika ng’okuzuukuka mazima ddala kwe kucamuka kwokka, okukozesa abantu mu bukujjukujju, oba n’omulimu gw’emyoyo emibi.

Bayibuli etugamba obutayanguwa kugaana wadde okwanguwa okukkiriza. “Temuzikizanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu, era temunyoomanga abo aboogera eby’obunnabbi, naye mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga” (1 Abasessaloniika 5:19-21). “Abaagalwa, temukkirizanga buli myoyo, naye musookenga okugyetegereza mulabe obanga givudde eri Katonda” (1 Yokaana 4:1).

Tugezesa tutya? Yesu yagamba nti, “Mulibalabira ku bikolwa byabwe” (Matayo 7:16). Ekibuuzo ekya nnamaddala si nti enkuŋŋaana zirimu oluyoogaano olwenkana wa oba enneewulira ennyingi. Kiri nti abantu bagenda bafaanana Yesu? Baagala Kristo okusingawo? Baagala Bayibuli okusingawo? Beetoowaze okusingawo, ba mazima okusingawo, baagala abalala okusingawo? Baatula ebibi era batereeza ebyasobyibwa? Kristo y’agulumizibwa, oba muntu?

Abakulembeze mu biseera by’okuzuukuka beetaaga obuvumu obw’engeri bbiri. Beetaaga obuvumu okwaniriza Katonda by’akola, ne bwe biba nga tebabimanyidde. Era beetaaga obuvumu okutereeza ebikyamu, mu bukkakkamu ate n’obumalirivu, omulimu guleme kwonooneka. Pawulo yajjukiza ekkanisa ey’e Kkolinso eyali ecamuse nti, “Katonda si wa luyoogaano, wabula wa mirembe” (1 Abakkolinso 14:33).

Okugenda mu Buziba: tusobola okuleeta okuzuukuka?

Abakristaayo okuva edda tebakkiriziganya ku kitundu ky’omukulembeze mu kuzuukuka. Abamu, nga bagoberera omusumba Omumerika Jonathan Edwards mu kyasa ekye kkumi n’omunaana, bakkaatirizza nti okuzuukuka “mulimu gwa Katonda ogwewuunyisa”. Tusobola okusaba n’okwetegeka, naye tetusobola kukuleeta. Katonda akuweereza bw’asiima, nga bw’aweereza enkuba.

Abalala, nga bagoberera omubuulizi w’enjiri Omumerika Charles Finney mu kyasa ekye kkumi n’omwenda, bakkaatirizza ekitundu ky’abantu. Mu kitabo kye Emisomo ku Kuzuukuka kw’Eddiini, ekiri ku Ochorus, Finney yawandiika n’obuvumu nti, “Okuzuukuka kw’eddiini si kyamagero.” Yali ategeeza nti Katonda akolera mu ngeri eza bulijjo ze yawa, gamba ng’okubuulira, okusaba n’okwenenya, era nti abantu be bwe bazikozesa n’obwesigwa, okuzuukuka emirundi mingi kujja kuddirira. Ekyawandiikibwa kye yasinziirako yakiggya mu Koseya: “mukabale ettaka lyammwe eritali ddime, kubanga ekiseera kituuse okunoonya Mukama, okutuusa lw’alidda n’abafukako obutuukirivu” (Koseya 10:12).

Endowooza zombi zirina ekitundu ku mazima. Okuzuukuka mulimu gwa Katonda, era tewali mukulembeze ayinza kukulagira. Naye Katonda ayita abantu be okusaba, okwenenya n’okukabala ettaka ekkakanyavu ery’emitima gyabwe. Abamu bakyogedde bwe bati: tetusobola kutonnyesa nkuba, naye tusobola okulima ennimiro ne tuba beetegefu bw’etonnya.

Okukulembera enkyukakyuka empola

Abakulembeze abasinga tebajja kulaba kuzuukuka kunene mu bulamu bwabwe. Naye buli mukulembeze ajja kwetaaga okukulembera enkyukakyuka. Ekkanisa eyinza okwetaaga okwongera okwaniriza abaavu, okutandika okuyigiriza Bayibuli mu ngeri etegeerekeka obulungi, okutendeka abakulembeze abaggya, okutandika okusabira awamu, okukyusa empisa etayamba oba okwolekera ekibi ekikwekeddwa. Enkyukakyuka zino emirundi mingi zijja mpola.

Yesu yawandiikira ekkanisa ey’e Efeso nti, “tokyanjagala nga bwe wanjagalanga edda. Noolwekyo jjukira we waseeseetuka. Weenenye, onjagale nga bwe wanjagalanga edda” (Okubikkulirwa 2:4-5). Buli kkanisa egenda ewaba mpola ng’ebiseera biyitawo. Ekitundu ku mulimu gw’omukulembeze kwe kugikoowoola okudda.

Gano ge magezi ag’okukulembera enkyukakyuka:

  • Tandika n’okusaba n’omutima gwo gwennyini. Enkyukakyuka mu kkanisa emirundi mingi etandikira mu nkyukakyuka mu bakulembeze baayo. Ezera yali “ng’asaba, ng’ayatula ebibi mu lwatu, ng’akaaba, era ng’avunnamye mu maaso g’ennyumba ya Katonda” abantu nga tebannagoberera (Ezera 10:1).
  • Nnyonnyola ensonga. Abantu banaakkiriza enkyukakyuka mu bwangu bwe banaategeera ensonga yaayo, naddala bw’eba ng’esimbye ddala emirandira mu Kyawandiikibwa.
  • Ssaamu ekitiibwa ebyayita. Tonyooma abaakusooka bye baazimba. Ebyo byebaze Katonda, ne bw’oba ng’obikyusa.
  • Sooka owulirize. Manya abantu bye batya n’ensonga lwaki. Emirundi mingi bye beeraliikirira birimu amagezi.
  • Genda n’abakulembeze abalala. Enkyukakyuka esindikirizibwa omuntu omu tetera kubeerera. Sooka okuzimba okukkiriziganya mu bakulembeze banno.
  • Kyusa ebisinga obukulu. Si buli mpisa nti esaanira okulwanirwako. Londa enkyukakyuka eziweereza ddala Enjiri.
  • Tambula ku sipiidi abantu gye basobola okugoberera. Omusumba akulembera ekisibo ekirimu abaana b’endiga tasobola kutambula ku sipiidi y’omuserikale (Olubereberye 33:13-14).
  • Beera mugumiikiriza era weeyongereyo. Enkyukakyuka ezimu zitwala emyaka. Toggwaamu maanyi.

Era jjukira kino: ekkubo erisinga okukakasa okulaba enkyukakyuka ebeerera kwe kusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu akole ekyo ye yekka ky’asobola okukola. Enteekateeka z’emirimu zisobola okusengeka ekkanisa obuggya. Katonda yekka y’asobola okugizuukusa.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Jonathan Edwards ne Pandita Ramabai

Jonathan Edwards yali musumba mu kabuga akatono ak’e Northampton, mu New England, mu kyasa ekye kkumi n’omunaana. Yalaba ebiseera bibiri ebinene eby’okuzuukuka mu kkanisa ye ne mu kabuga ke, mu myaka gya 1730 ne 1740. Era yalaba n’ebizibu: okukyuka okw’obulimba, okucamuka okutafugika, amalala n’enjawukana. N’olwekyo yamala emyaka ng’anoonyereza engeri y’okwawula obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’amazima ku bw’obulimba. Ekitabo kye Religious Affections (Enneewulira z’Eddiini), ekiri ku Ochorus, kitandika n’endowooza eno enywevu:

“Eddiini ey’amazima, mu kitundu kyayo ekinene, eri mu nneewulira entukuvu.”

— Jonathan Edwards, Religious Affections

Mu bigambo ebyangu: okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala si nsonga ya birowoozo byokka. Gwe mutima ogwagala ddala Katonda, ogumutya, ogumusanyukira era ogumwegomba.
