Edwards yalwanirira enneewulira ez’omunda ennyo ez’okuzuukuka eri abo abaayagala eddiini ennyogovu enkalu yokka. Naye era yalabula nti enneewulira ez’amaanyi zokka tezikakasa kintu kyonna. Ku nkomerero y’ekitabo yawa kye yayita “akabonero akasinga obukulu mu bubonero bwonna” obw’ekisa eky’amazima: obulamu obukyuse. Yawandiika nti, “Okukola eby’Ekikristaayo, oba obulamu obutukuvu, kabonero kanene era ak’enjawulo ak’ekisa eky’amazima era ekirokola.” Okugezesa okusinga obulungi okw’okuzuukuka si bye bibaawo mu nkuŋŋaana, wabula engeri abantu gye babeeramu oluvannyuma.

Mu 1905, okuzuukuka kwajja e Mukti, ekifo kya bannamwandu ne bamulekwa ekyakulemberwanga Pandita Ramabai mu Buyindi obw’ebugwanjuba, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 26, Abasajja n’Abakazi mu Mulimu gwa Katonda. Okumala emyezi nga kukyali, Ramabai ne banne be yakola nabo baali bakusabira. Omwezi gwa Jjuuni we gwatuukira, abakazi n’abawala abasoba mu bikumi bitaano baali bakuŋŋaana emirundi ebiri buli lunaku okusaba. Awo, nga Jjuuni anaatera okuggwaako, Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’abakkako. Abawala baasangibwanga nga bafukamidde, nga bakaaba, nga basaba era nga baatula ebibi byabwe. Okuzuukuka kwabuna ebitundu ebirala bingi eby’omu Buyindi.

Ramabai yakukulembera atya? Pandita Ramabai: A Life (Obulamu bwa Pandita Ramabai), ekiri ku Ochorus, kitubuulira. Mu kusooka teyayagala mboozi eno kunyumizibwa, abantu baleme kutendereza Mukti mu kifo kya Katonda. Oluvannyuma n’akkiriza nti yali akoze kibi okukweka ekitiibwa kya Katonda. N’atwala ekibinja ky’abawala be mu kibuga Pune, n’ayatula mu lwatu nti yali “abuusizza amaaso emikisa gye yafuna egy’okubuulira Kristo n’obuvumu.” Oluvannyuma n’asindika ebibinja by’abakazi abavubuka abasaba mu masomero amalala, mu maka ga bamulekwa ne mu bifo by’obuminsani, okusabira Abakristaayo ab’eyo. Yabagamba nti:

“Omulimu gwaffe gujja kubala ebibala ebibeerera … singa tusaba nnyo ne tukola kitono.”

— Pandita Ramabai, nga bwe kyawandiikibwa mu Pandita Ramabai: A Life

Ramabai yali omu ku bakulembeze abasinga okukola ennyo mu Buyindi. Yaddukanyanga amasomero, faamu n’amaka g’abantu enkumi bbiri. Naye yali amanyi ebibala ebibeerera gye biva.

“Mu nnaku zaffe”

Kaabakuuku yasaba nti, “Bizze buggya mu nnaku zaffe.” Yali awulidde emboozi z’ebyo Katonda bye yakolera emirembe egyasooka. Teyamatira na kujjukira kwokka. Yayagala okubiraba.

Abakulembeze ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala bajja kusaba okusaba kwe kumu. Bajja kukulembera omulimu ogw’obugumiikiriza ogw’enkyukakyuka wiiki ku wiiki. Bajja kugezesa ebiriwo, banyweze ebirungi, era ekitiibwa kyonna bakidde eri Katonda. Era bajja kukabala ettaka ekkakanyavu, ne basaba enkuba.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 2 Ebyomumirembe 7:14. Ku bisaanyizo byakyo ebina (okwetoowaza, okusaba, okunoonya amaaso ga Katonda, okukyuka okuva mu bubi), kiruwa ekisinga okwetaaga okufiibwako mu kkanisa yo?
  • Wali olabye oba owulidde ku kuzuukuka okwa nnamaddala? Bubonero ki bwe kwalina?
  • Soma 1 Abasessaloniika 5:19-21. Oli wa kwanguwa okuzikiza Mwoyo Mutukuvu, oba okukkiriza ebintu nga tobigezesezza?
  • Edwards yagamba nti obulamu obukyuse “kabonero akasinga obukulu mu bubonero bwonna”. Okugezesa okwo kwandikyusizza kutya engeri gy’osalawo ku bintu by’omwoyo abantu bye bayitamu?
  • Nkyukakyuka ki ekkanisa yo gy’esinga okwetaaga? Misingi ki egy’okukulembera enkyukakyuka gy’onoosinga okwetaaga?
  • Ramabai yagamba nti, “tusaba nnyo ne tukola kitono.” Ekyo kyandifaananye kitya mu bukulembeze bwo?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno kuŋŋaanya abakulembeze abalala oba abakkiriza babiri oba basatu, musabire wamu okuzuukuka, nga mutandikira ku mmwe mwennyini. Musome Zabbuli 85 ne Kaabakuuku 3:1-2 mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka, era mubifuule okusaba. Mwatule ebibi byammwe eri Katonda mu mazima. Oluvannyuma mubuuzagane nti: “Nkyukakyuka ki emu ekkanisa yaffe gy’esinga okwetaaga? Ddaala ki erisooka ettono erigyolekera?” Mukkiriziganye okuddamu okusisinkana n’okusabira awamu wiiki ejja.

study_questions.question: Okuzuukuka kye ki?
study_questions.answer: Okuzuukuka kiseera Katonda mw’azzaamu abantu be obulamu, emirundi mingi nga waliwo okwenenya okw’amaanyi, okwagala Ekigambo, n’abantu bangi okujja eri Kristo. Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli yasaba nti, “Tolituzaamu ndasi, abantu bo basanyukirenga mu ggwe?” (Zabbuli 85:6).

study_questions.question: Abakulembeze b’ekkanisa basobola okuleeta okuzuukuka?
study_questions.answer: Abakristaayo baddamu mu ngeri za njawulo. Ekitundu ky’essuula “Okugenda mu Buziba” kinnyonnyola endowooza ezo. Bonna bakkiriziganya nti abakulembeze basobola okusaba, okwenenya n’okwetegeka: “abantu bange abatuumiddwa erinnya lyange bwe baneetowazanga, ne basaba” (2 Ebyomumirembe 7:14).

study_questions.question: Abakulembeze basaanidde kugezesa batya ebibaawo mu kuzuukuka?
study_questions.answer: Nga baggulawo emitima era nga beekenneenya: “Temuzikizanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu, era temunyoomanga abo aboogera eby’obunnabbi, naye mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga” (1 Abasessaloniika 5:19-21). Jonathan Edwards ne Pandita Ramabai bombi baakulembera mu kuzuukuka era bombi baakugezesa n’obwegendereza.

fields.title: Amalala n’Okwagala Okutenderezebwa
fields.body_html:
“Entamu erongoosa ya ffeeza n’ekikoomi kikola ku zaabu, naye omuntu ekimugezesa kutenderezebwa.”

— Engero 27:21

Omuweesi wa zaabu agezesa zaabu ng’agiteeka mu muliro. Bw’eba nnongoofu, efuluma ng’emasamasa. Bw’eba etabuddwamu ebyuma ebya layisi, omuliro gukyoleka. Bayibuli egamba nti okutenderezebwa kuli ng’omuliro ogwo. Abantu bwe batutendereza, ekyo ekiri ddala mu mitima gyaffe kifuluma.

Abakulembeze bangi bagezesebwa ebizibu ne bayita mu kugezesebwa okwo. Basigala beesigwa mu bwavu, mu kuziyizibwa ne mu kuyigganyizibwa. Naye obuwanguzi bwe bujja, ebibiina by’abantu bwe bikuŋŋaana n’abantu ne boogera bulungi ku bo, waliwo ekikyuka. Batandika okunyumirwa okutenderezebwa. Oluvannyuma ne batandika okukwetaaga. Era mpola mpola, nga tebakitegedde, batandika okwetwalira ekitiibwa ekya Katonda.

Essuula eno etandika Ekitundu eky’Omusanvu: Obulabe mu Kkubo. Wano tutunuulira mu lwatu ebibi ebisinga okusaanyaawo abakulembeze. Tutandika n’ekisinga obukadde mu byonna: amalala.

Ekibi ekisinga obukadde

Pawulo bwe yawandiika empisa omulabirizi z’alina okuba nazo, yawa okulabula kuno: “Omulabirizi tateekwa kuba muntu eyaakakkiriza Kristo, si kulwa nga yeekuluntaza, n’asalirwa omusango nga Setaani bwe yagusalirwa” (1 Timoseewo 3:6). Abakristaayo bangi kino bakitegedde nti amalala kye kyali ekibi kya Setaani yennyini, ekibi ekyafuula malayika omulabe wa Katonda. Emboozi yonna ne bw’eba nga bw’eri, Pawulo ategeeza bulungi: amalala ga bulabe nnyo eri abo abaweebwa obukulembeze nga bukyali nnyo.

Katonda agamba nti, “n’ekitiibwa kyange sirikiwa mulala” (Isaaya 42:8). Amalala kwe kugezaako okutwala ekyo Katonda ky’atagenda kugabana na muntu. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki Bayibuli egamba nti, “Katonda alwana n’ab’amalala naye abawombeefu abawa ekisa” (Yakobo 4:6). Weetegereze ebigambo “alwana n’ab’amalala”. Omukulembeze ow’amalala takoma ku kusobya kwokka. Katonda y’amulwanyisa.

“Amalala gakulembera okuzikirira, n’omwoyo ogwegulumiza gukulembera ekigwo” (Engero 16:18). Ebyafaayo bijjudde abakulembeze abaakakasa nti olugero luno lwa mazima.

Bakabaka babiri abeetwalira ekitiibwa

Kabaka Nebukadduneeza ow’e Babulooni ye yali omusajja asinga obuyinza mu nsi. Lumu, “kabaka yali atambulira ku kasolya k’olubiri lwe olwa Babulooni, n’ayogera nti, ‘Ono si ye Babulooni omukulu gwe nazimba n’amaanyi gange amangi okuba ekibuga ekikulu eky’ekitiibwa eky’obwakabaka bwange?’” (Danyeri 4:29-30). Bala ebigambo ebimwogerako ye yennyini: nazimba, amaanyi gange, obwakabaka bwange. “Awo bwe yali ng’akyayogera, eddoboozi ne liva mu ggulu” (Danyeri 4:31). Yagwa eddalu n’abeera ng’ensolo okumala ekiseera, okutuusa lwe yategeera “ng’Oyo Ali Waggulu ennyo y’afuga obwakabaka obw’abantu” (Danyeri 4:32).

Katonda yasaasira Nebukadduneeza. Amagezi ge bwe gaamukomawo, yatendereza Katonda n’agamba nti, “n’abo ab’amalala abakkakkanya” (Danyeri 4:37). Katonda yamukkakkanya alyoke amulokole.

Kabaka Kerode Agulipa ye teyafuna mukisa ogwo. Bwe yali ng’ayogera eri abantu ng’ayambadde engoye ze ez’obwakabaka, ekibiina kyaleekaana nti, “Lino ddoboozi lya Katonda so si lya muntu!” Teyakola kintu kyonna kubaziyiza. “Amangwago malayika wa Mukama n’amubonereza, n’ajjula envunyu yenna, ne zimulya n’afa, kubanga yakkiriza abantu ne bamusinza, n’atawa Katonda kitiibwa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 12:22-23).

Enjawulo wakati w’emboozi zino ebbiri si nti kabaka omu yali wa malala ate omulala nga si wa malala. Bombi baali ba malala. Enjawulo eri nti omu yeenenya n’awa Katonda ekitiibwa, ate omulala teyakikola.

Kabaka Uzziya owa Yuda naye kulabula. Yali kabaka mulungi okumala emyaka mingi. Katonda yamuyamba nnyo. “Yayambibwa nnyo, n’atutumuka era erinnya lye ne lyatiikirira nnyo. Kyokka Uzziya bwe yatutumuka, ne yeegulumiza, n’okugwa n’agwa” (2 Ebyomumirembe 26:15-16). Weetegereze obulabe: obuwanguzi. Uzziya teyagwa mu bunafu bwe, wabula mu maanyi ge.

Amalala gafaanana mu ngeri nnyingi

Amalala tegatera kulabika ng’okwewaana kwokka. Geefuula mu ngeri nnyingi, era abakulembeze beetaaga okugategeera.

  • Okwagala okutenderezebwa. Yesu yayogera ku bakulembeze b’eddiini abamu nti, “baayagala ekitiibwa ekibaweebwa abantu okusinga ekitiibwa kya Katonda” (Yokaana 12:43). Ndumwa nga tewali anneebaza? Nnoonya abantu okuntendereza nga mmaze okubuulira?
  • Okwagala ekifo. Yokaana yawandiika ku mukulembeze w’ekkanisa ayitibwa Diyotuleefe, eyali “olw’okwagala okwefuula omukulembeze” (3 Yokaana 9). Yagaana okwaniriza abakulembeze abalala, n’abasaasaanyaako obulimba era n’agoba abo abaali batakkiriziganya naye. Amalala emirundi mingi geeyoleka mu mukulembeze atasobola kugabana buyinza.
  • Okwagala ebitiibwa n’ekitiibwa. Yesu yalabula ku bakulembeze abaali “Baagala nnyo ebifo eby’oku mwanjo ku mbaga, ne mu bifo eby’ekitiibwa mu makuŋŋaaniro. Banyumirwa nnyo okuweebwa ekitiibwa mu butale” (Matayo 23:6-7). Abakulembeze abamu leero bakaka okuyitibwa ebitiibwa ebiwanvu, okufuna entebe ez’enjawulo n’okuyisibwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo.
  • Okweraga mu by’eddiini. “Mwegendereze, ebikolwa byammwe eby’obutuukirivu obutabikoleranga mu lujjudde lw’abantu nga mwagala babasiime” (Matayo 6:1). Omukulembeze ayinza okusaba, okusiiba n’okuwaayo alyoke alabibwe.
  • Okwetwalira ettendo. Okwogera ku “kkanisa yange”, “obuweereza bwange”, “abaakyuka ku lwange”. Okuleka abantu okulowooza nti ffe twakola ekyo Katonda kye yakola.
  • Okwegeraageranya. Okwepima ku bakulembeze abalala, ne twewulira nga tubasinga oba ne tubakwatirwa obuggya obukaawa. Obuggya tujja kubutunuulira mu Ssuula 36, Obuggya, Okuvuganya n’Okusosola.
  • Obutayigirizika. Obutasobola kukkiriza kunenyezebwa, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 25, Okuvumirirwa, Okuziyizibwa n’Enkaayana.
  • Amalala ag’omwoyo. Okuwulira nti tuli batukuvu okusinga abalala, nti tulina ebirabo okusinga bo, oba nti tuli ba mwoyo okubasinga. Kino oboolyawo kye kika ekisinga obulabe, kubanga kyekweka emabega w’ebintu ebitukuvu.

Lwaki okutenderezebwa kwa bulabe nnyo

Yesu yabuuza ekibuuzo ekikebera omutima: “Kale muyinza mutya okukkiriza nga munoonya kusiimibwa bantu bannammwe, so nga temunoonya kusiimibwa Katonda oyo Omu yekka?” (Yokaana 5:44). Okwagala okutenderezebwa abantu tekukoma ku kwonoona bukulembeze bwaffe. Kuyinza okufuula okukkiriza kwennyini okutasoboka. Endowooza y’abantu bw’etubeerera enkulu okusinga eya Katonda, tujja kwogera era tukole ebisanyusa abantu, so si ebisanyusa Katonda.

Abakulembeze bali mu bulabe buno okusinga abalala. Abantu batwebaza, batendereza okubuulira kwaffe era batutunuulira ng’ekyokulabirako. Mu buwangwa bungi, abakulembeze baweebwa ekitiibwa kinene olw’ekifo kyabwe kyokka. Ekitiibwa ekyo si kibi mu kyokka. Naye kiri ng’omwenge omukaawu. Katono kayinza obutaleeta kabi. Bwe kiyitirira, era nga kijja buli kiseera, tutamiira.

Ekkubo ery’okuwonamu

Omukulembeze ayinza atya okukuumibwa okuva mu malala?

Jjukira nti buli kimu kirabo. “Era mulina kye mutaaweebwa? Kale obanga ddala mwaweebwa, kiki ate ekibenyumirizisa ng’abataakifuna?” (1 Abakkolinso 4:7). Ebirabo byo, emikisa gyo, ebibala byo: byonna byava eri Katonda.

Ekitiibwa kizzeeyo amangu ddala. Bw’otenderezebwa, tokitereka mu mutima gwo. Kifuule okwebaza amangu ago. “Si ffe, Ayi Mukama, si ffe. Wabula erinnya lyo lye ligwana okuweebwanga ekitiibwa” (Zabbuli 115:1). Kuno kwe kwali okulemererwa okunene okwa Kerode. Yaleka ettendo ne lisigala gy’ali.

Weereza mu kyama. Yesu yatugamba okuwaayo, okusaba n’okusiiba mu kyama, Kitaffe yekka w’alaba (Matayo 6:1-18). Kola ebintu ebirungi ebimu abantu bye batalimanya n’akatono.

Leka abalala be bakutendereza, bwe kiba kyetaagisa. “Leka omulala akutenderezenga so si kamwa ko ggwe” (Engero 27:2). Toyogeranga ku bye watuukiriza.

Jjukira ky’oli. Yesu yagamba nti bwe tumala okukola buli kye twalagirwa, tusaanidde okugamba nti, “Ffe abaddu bo abatasaanira tukoze omulimu gwaffe ogutugwanidde” (Lukka 17:10). Pawulo yagamba buli muntu “obuteerowooza okusinga ekyo ky’asaanidde okulowooza, naye okulowoozanga nga yeegendereza” (Abaruumi 12:3).

Kkiriza okukkakkanyizibwa. Katonda bw’akkiriza okulemererwa, okuvumirirwa oba obunafu, kiyinza okuba okusaasira kwe, ng’atukuuma okuva mu malala. Pawulo yagamba nti “eriggwa mu mubiri” lye yaweebwa lyali lya kumukuuma aleme kwegulumiza (2 Abakkolinso 12:7).

Weenyumirize mu musaalaba. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Naye nze sigenda kwenyumiririza mu kintu kyonna okuggyako omusaalaba gwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo” (Abaggalatiya 6:14). Ku musaalaba tulaba ekibi kyaffe kye kyasasuza, n’obunene bw’ebbanja lye tulina. Kizibu nnyo okuba n’amalala ng’oyimiridde awo.

Mu Ssuula 7, Obwetoowaze, twatunuulira obulungi bw’omutima omwetoowaze. Wano tulaba oludda olulala: ekibaawo obwetoowaze bwe bubula. Eddagala ly’amalala si kwe kwerowoozaako bubi. Kwe kulowooza ku Katonda mu ngeri entuufu, n’okumutunuulira ennyo ne tweyerabira okwetunuulira.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Augustine ne Thomas à Kempis

Augustine, omulabirizi ow’omu Afirika ey’Obukiikakkono gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 17, Liisa Endiga Zange, yawandiika Okwatula mu mwaka nga 400. Ekitabo kino kusaba kuwanvu eri Katonda, nga kinyumya emboozi y’obulamu bwe n’ebibi bye. Kiri ku Ochorus. Mu Kitabo X, yeekebera omutima gwe ng’omulabirizi. Ayatula nti okukemebwa kw’omubiri tekwamutawaanya nnyo nga okukemebwa okulala okusirifu: okwagala okutenderezebwa. Yabuuza Katonda obanga okukemebwa kuno kuyinza okumuvaako mu bulamu buno:

“Kwe kugamba, okwagala okutiibwa n’okwagalibwa abantu, olw’ekigendererwa kino kyokka, tulyoke tufune mu kyo essanyu eritali ssanyu? Obwo bulamu bwa nnaku, n’okwewaana okw’ekivve!”

— Augustine, Okwatula, Ekitabo X

Mu bigambo ebyangu: nnyinza okuwona okwagala abantu okunzisaamu ekitiibwa n’okunjagala, ndyoke nnyumirwe okunneewuunya kwabwe, ekitali ssanyu lya nnamaddala n’akatono? Obwo bulamu bwa nnaku, era kika kya malala ekibi ennyo.

Augustine yalaba n’ekintu ekisingawo okwekweka. Omukulembeze ayinza okulaba okwagala kwe okutenderezebwa n’akulwanyisa, n’oluvannyuma ne yeenyumiriza olw’okukulwanyisa. Yawandiika nti okukemebwa okwo “emirundi mingi kwenyumiriza mu butaliimu okusingawo olw’okunyooma okwo kwennyini okw’okwenyumiriza okutaliimu”. Mu bigambo ebyangu: tuyinza n’okwenyumiriza olw’obwetoowaze bwaffe. Amalala galina obukujjukujju bungi nnyo ne kiba nti gayinza okweriisa ku kufuba kwaffe okw’okugawangula. Okuddamu kwa Augustine tekwali kufuba nnyo okusingawo, wabula okweyongera okwesuula ku kusaasira kwa Katonda.

Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka lukumi, Thomas à Kempis yali mumonaki mu Netherlands mu kyasa ekye kkumi n’ettaano. Yawandiika Okukoppa Kristo, ekimu ku bitabo by’Ekikristaayo ebisinze okusomebwa mu byafaayo, ekiri ku Ochorus. Yawa okubuulirira kuno:

“Bw’oba oyagala okuyiga n’okutegeera ekintu eky’omugaso, kale yagalanga obutamanyibwa n’okutwalibwa ng’atali kintu.”

— Thomas à Kempis, Okukoppa Kristo

Mu bigambo ebyangu: bw’oba oyagala okuyiga ekintu eky’omuwendo ddala, yiga okusanyuka nga tewali amanyi linnya lyo. Thomas era yawandiika nti, “Abantu bonna banafu, naye olina okukkiriza nti tewali n’omu asinga ggwe obunafu.” Omukulembeze akkiriza ekyo tajja kwanguwa kwegulumiza.

Ttendo lya ani?

Lumu buli mukulembeze aliyimirira mu maaso ga Kristo. Ku lunaku olwo, ettendo ly’ebibiina by’abantu teririba na kye litegeeza. Eddoboozi limu lyokka lye liriba ekkulu. Yesu yabuuza nti, “Kale muyinza mutya okukkiriza nga munoonya kusiimibwa bantu bannammwe, so nga temunoonya kusiimibwa Katonda oyo Omu yekka?”

Noonya ekitiibwa kye, so si ekikyo. Kolera okuwulira “Weebale” okuva gy’ali, so si okukubirwa mu ngalo abantu. “Noolwekyo mwewombeeke wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda ogw’amaanyi, naye alibagulumiza ng’obudde butuuse” (1 Peetero 5:6).

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Engero 27:21. Bw’otenderezebwa, kiki ekyo kye kyoleka ku mutima gwo?
  • Soma Danyeri 4:28-37 n’Ebikolwa by’Abatume 12:21-23. Kiki ekyaleeta enjawulo wakati wa Nebukadduneeza ne Kerode?
  • Ku ngeri amalala gye geefaananyirizaamu, ngeri ki gy’osinga okulaba mu ggwe kennyini?
  • Soma 3 Yokaana 9-10. Wali olabye abakulembeze nga Diyotuleefe? Olina ky’olaba ku ye mu ggwe kennyini?
  • Augustine yagamba nti tuyinza okwenyumiriza ne mu kulwanyisa amalala. Kino wali okirabye mu mutima gwo?
  • Kyandikutegeezezza ki “okwagala obutamanyibwa”?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno, buli muntu lw’anaakutenderezanga oba okukwebaza, saba mpola mu mutima gwo nti, “Si ffe, Ayi Mukama, si ffe. Wabula erinnya lyo lye ligwana okuweebwanga ekitiibwa”, nga tonnamuddamu. Kola waakiri ekikolwa kimu eky’obuweereza mu kyama ekitalimanyibwa muntu yenna. Ku nkomerero ya wiiki, buuza mukwano gwo gw’owesiga nti, “Amalala ogalaba wa mu nze?” era owulirize nga teweewolereza.

study_questions.question: Lwaki amalala ga bulabe nnyo eri abakulembeze?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga “Amalala gakulembera okuzikirira, n’omwoyo ogwegulumiza gukulembera ekigwo” (Engero 16:18), era “Katonda alwana n’ab’amalala” (Yakobo 4:6). Pawulo yalabula nti omukkiriza omuggya tasaanidde kukulembera, “si kulwa nga yeekuluntaza” (1 Timoseewo 3:6).

study_questions.question: Okutenderezebwa kugezesa kutya omukulembeze?
study_questions.answer: “Entamu erongoosa ya ffeeza n’ekikoomi kikola ku zaabu, naye omuntu ekimugezesa kutenderezebwa” (Engero 27:21). Okutenderezebwa kwoleka obanga tubeera mulamu olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda oba olw’ekyaffe. Katonda agamba nti, “n’ekitiibwa kyange sirikiwa mulala” (Isaaya 42:8).

study_questions.question: Kiki ekyatuuka ku Nebukadduneeza bwe yafuna amalala?
study_questions.answer: Yeewaana olwa “Babulooni omukulu” gwe yazimba, era “Awo bwe yali ng’akyayogera, eddoboozi ne liva mu ggulu” (Danyeri 4:30-31). Yakkakkanyizibwa okutuusa lwe yakkiriza nti Katonda y’afuga. Essuula ekozesa ebyokulabirako bya Augustine ne Thomas à Kempis.

fields.title: Ssente n’Omululu
fields.body_html:
“Kubanga okululunkanira ensimbi y’ensibuko y’ebibi byonna, era olw’okululunkana okwo abamu bawabye, ne bava mu kukkiriza, ne beereetera obulumi bungi mu mitima gyabwe.”

— 1 Timoseewo 6:10

Mu mboozi ya nnabbi Erisa, omuduumizi w’eggye ow’amaanyi ayitibwa Naamani yajja okuwonyezebwa endwadde ey’olususu embi ennyo. Katonda n’amuwonya, Naamani n’awa Erisa ekirabo ekinene ekya ffeeza n’engoye. Erisa n’akigaana. Yayagala Naamani ategeere nti ekisa kya Katonda tekigulibwa.

Naye omuweereza wa Erisa, Gekazi, yatunuulira ffeeza ng’egenda. N’alowooza mu mutima gwe nti, “Laba mukama wange bw’asaasidde Naamani ono Omusuuli, n’atakkiriza kirabo kimuweerebbwa. Mazima ddala, nga Mukama bw’ali omulamu nzija kumugoberera, mbeeko kye muggyako” (2 Bassekabaka 5:20). N’adduka okugoberera Naamani, n’ayogera eby’obulimba, n’atwala ffeeza n’agikweka mu nnyumba ye. Bwe yakomawo, Erisa n’amubuuza nti, “Ova wa Gekazi?” N’alimba omulundi ogw’okubiri. Erisa n’amugamba nti, “Ssaagenze naawe mu mwoyo, omusajja bwe yavudde mu ggaali lye okukusisinkana? Kino ky’ekiseera eky’okutwala ensimbi …?” (2 Bassekabaka 5:25-26). Gekazi n’avaawo ng’endwadde ya Naamani eri ku lususu lwe ye.

Gekazi yali amaze emyaka mingi ku mabbali g’omu ku bannabbi abasinga obukulu abaali babaddewo. Yali alabye ebyamagero. Naye byonna n’abisuula olw’ensawo ya ffeeza. Okuva olwo ssente zizikirizza abakulembeze bangi. Essuula eno etunuulira mu bwesimbu abakulembeze ne ssente.

Ssente si mbi, naye okuziyaayaanira kutta

Weetegereze Pawulo ky’agamba: “okululunkanira ensimbi y’ensibuko y’ebibi byonna” (1 Timoseewo 6:10). Ssente zennyini si mbi. Ziyinza okuliisa abalumwa enjala, okuzimba amasomero, okuwagira abaminsani n’okulabirira bannamwandu. Naye okululunkanira ensimbi kuli ng’ekikolo ekiri wansi mu ttaka. Tokiraba, naye okuva mu kyo mwe mumera “ebibi byonna”: obulimba, obubbi, obutali bwenkanya, amaka agasasika, n’abakulembeze abava mu kukkiriza.

Yesu yagamba nti, “Tewali n’omu ayinza kuweereza bakulu babiri … Toyinza kuweereza Katonda na mamona” (Matayo 6:24). Ssente, oba mamona, si kintu ekitaliiko ludda eri omutima gw’omuntu. Zaagala okuweerezebwa. Zisuubiza obukuumi, obuyinza n’ekitiibwa. Yesu yalabula nti, “Mwekuume! Temululunkananga. Kubanga obulamu bw’omuntu tebugererwa ku bugagga bw’abeera nabwo” (Lukka 12:15).

Eyo ye nsonga lwaki Bayibuli ekyogerako bulungi nnyo mu bisaanyizo by’abakulembeze. Omulabirizi alina okuba “nga talulunkanira nsimbi” (1 Timoseewo 3:3), era “nga teyeegomba kufuna magoba mu bukuusa” (Tito 1:7). Peetero yagamba abakadde okulunda ekisibo si lwa kwenoonyeza magoba, naye nga bakiriisa “nga mukirabirira n’okwagala so si na kwemulugunya” era “olw’okujjumbira Katonda” (1 Peetero 5:2).

Okutunda ebirabo bya Katonda

Abatume bwe baateeka emikono ku bakkiriza e Samaliya ne bafuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu, omusajja ayitibwa Simooni, eyali akola eby’obulogo, n’abawa ssente. N’agamba nti, “Mumpe obuyinza obwo.” Peetero n’amuddamu n’amaanyi nti, “Ensimbi zo zizikirire naawe olw’okulowooza nti ekirabo kya Katonda kiyinza okugulibwa obugulibwa n’ensimbi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 8:19-20).

Ekibi kino, eky’okugezaako okugula oba okutunda ebintu eby’omwoyo, mu byafaayo by’Ekkanisa kyamanyibwa nga “simony” (mu Luganda tuyinza okukiyita “obusimooni”), okuva ku linnya lya Simooni. Kirabise mu ngeri nnyingi. Mu Mirembe egy’Omu Makkati, ebifo by’obukulembeze mu kkanisa byagulibwanga era ne bitundibwa. Leero ekibi kye kimu kirabika abakulembeze bwe basaba ssente olw’okusabira abantu, bwe batunda amafuta, amazzi oba obugoye “obufukiddwako amafuta”, bwe basuubiza okuwonyezebwa oba omukisa olw’ekirabo, oba bwe bawa ebifo mu kkanisa abo abasinga okusasula.

Nnabbi Mikka yannyonnyola abakulembeze b’omu biseera bye: “Abakulembeze be, balya enguzi ne basala omusango nga beekubiira, bakabona be, baggya ensimbi ku bantu balyoke bayigirize, ne bannabbi be, baagala okuwa obunnabbi nga bamaze kusasulwa. Kyokka bajuliza Mukama nga boogera nti, ‘Mukama tali naffe? Tewali kinaatutuukako.’” (Mikka 3:11). Baakozesa erinnya lya Katonda okufuna ssente, ate ne bakyalowooza nti Katonda abasanyukira. Obwo bwe bumuzibe obw’entiisa.

Enjiri ey’obugagga

Mu bitundu bingi eby’ensi leero, okuyigiriza okw’obulimba kusaasaanye nnyo. Kutera okuyitibwa “enjiri ey’obugagga”. Kuyigiriza nti Katonda bulijjo ayagala abakkiriza babeere bagagga era balamu bulungi, nti obwavu n’obulwadde bubonero bwa kukkiriza okunafu oba bwa kibi, era nti bw’owa omubuulizi oba ekkanisa ssente, Katonda ajja kukusasula emirundi mingi.

Okuyigiriza kuno kukozesa ennyiriri za Bayibuli. Kujuliza ebisuubizo nga Malaki 3:10, Katonda w’agamba nti, “mungezese … obanga siribaggulirawo ebituli eby’omu ggulu”, ne Lukka 6:38, “Mugabenga nammwe muliweebwa.” Katonda mazima awa omukisa abo abagaba n’omutima omugabi. Naye enjiri ey’obugagga enyoola ebisuubizo bino mu ngeri nnyingi.

  • Efuula ssente empeera y’okukkiriza. Naye Yesu yagamba nti, “Temweterekeranga byabugagga wano ku nsi” (Matayo 6:19). Empeera ennene ey’Enjiri ye Kristo yennyini, n’obugagga mu ggulu.
  • Efuula obwavu ekikolimo. Naye Yesu yazaalibwa mu kiraalo, “talina kifo kya kuwumulizaamu mutwe gwe” (Lukka 9:58), era yagamba nti abaavu balina omukisa. Bangi ku bakkiriza abaasinga obwesigwa mu byafaayo babadde baavu.
  • Etwala okugaba ng’okusiga ensimbi mu bizinensi. Tugaba kubanga Katonda yatuwa, so si lwa kufuna bingi okudda gye tuli.
  • Egaggawaza omubuulizi. Emirundi mingi abantu beeyongera okwavuwala ng’omukulembeze bw’agula emmotoka, amayumba n’ennyonyi.

Pawulo yalabula ku bantu “abalowooza ng’okufuna amagoba kwe kutya Katonda” (1 Timoseewo 6:5). Mu kifo ky’ekyo yagamba nti, “Weewaawo okutya Katonda kulimu amagoba mangi, omuntu bw’amalibwa mu ekyo ky’alina. Kubanga tetulina kye twajja nakyo mu nsi, era tetuliiko kye tuliggyamu nga tuvaamu” (1 Timoseewo 6:6-7). Omukulembeze ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala ajja kugaana enjiri eno ey’obulimba, era akuume ekisibo kireme kugigwamu.

Ekyokulabirako kya Pawulo

Pawulo yalina eddembe okuwagirwa ekkanisa. Yawandiika nti, “Mukama waffe yalonda abo ababuulira Enjiri baliisibwenga olw’Enjiri” (1 Abakkolinso 9:14). Kituufu ekkanisa okuwagira abasumba baazo n’abaminsani mu ngeri ey’obwenkanya. Abasumba bangi abeesigwa basasulwa kitono nnyo, era amaka gaabwe gabonaabona.

Naye emirundi mingi Pawulo yasalawo obutakozesa ddembe lino. Yakolanga omulimu gw’okutunga weema waleme kubaawo n’omu amuvunaana nti abuulira lwa ssente. Yagamba abakadde b’e Efeso nti, “Siyaayaaniranga ffeeza newaakubadde zaabu wadde engoye eby’omuntu n’omu. Mmwe bennyini mumanyi nti neetuusizaako ebyetaago byange n’eby’abo bendi nabo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:33-34). Yawandiika nti, “Tetuli ng’abangi abakozesa ekigambo kya Katonda olw’okwenoonyeza ebyabwe” (2 Abakkolinso 2:17), era nti, “Tetugezangako kubawangula na bigambo biwaaniriza nga nammwe bwe mumanyi, wadde okuba ab’omululu era Katonda akimanyi” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:5).

Abakulembeze bangi mu nsi leero nabo “bakozi ba weema”. Balima, bayigiriza, basuubula oba bakola mu ofiisi, ate era ne bakulembera ekkanisa. Kino kuyitibwa kwa kitiibwa, so si buweereza bwa ddaala lya wansi.

Amagezi ag’omugaso eri abakulembeze

Kuuma embalirira ey’amazima. Tokwatanga ssente z’ekkanisa wekka. Wabeerewo abantu babiri waakiri ababala buli kiweebwayo era ne bakissaako omukono. Wandiika byonna. Embalirira yeekebejjebwe omuntu ow’ebweru ateekubiira. Pawulo yegendereza nnyo bwe yali atwala ekirabo ekinene eri abaavu b’e Yerusaalemi: “Kubanga kye tugenderera kwe kukola ebirungi, si mu maaso ga Katonda yekka wabula ne mu maaso g’abantu” (2 Abakkolinso 8:21).

Ssente z’ekkanisa n’ezizo ku bubwo zibeere nga zaawukana. Teweewolanga ku ssente z’ekkanisa, ne bw’oba ng’ogenderera okuzizzaayo.

Ba mwerufu ku musaala gwo. Abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yo bamanye ky’ofuna. Ssente eziweebwa mu kyama n’ebirabo ebikwekeddwa bizaala okwekengera.

Beera mu bulamu obwangu. “Naye bwe tuba n’emmere, n’ebyokwambala ebyo bitumalenga” (1 Timoseewo 6:8). Pawulo yagamba nti, “nayiga okumalibwanga. Mmanyi okubeera nga sirina kantu, era mmanyi okuba nga nnina buli kimu” (Abafiripi 4:11-12). Engeri omukulembeze gy’abeeramu ebuulira mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka ng’obubaka bwe.

Gaba n’omutima omugabi. Abakulembeze basaanidde okubeera mu basinga okugaba mu kkanisa. Pawulo yajjukiza abakadde ebigambo bya Yesu nti, “Okugaba kwa mukisa okusinga okuweebwa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:35).

Weewale amabanja bw’oba osobola. Ebbanja lifuula omukulembeze omuddu w’oyo amuwoze, era liyinza okumusindika okulekulira ku mazima.

Gaana ebirabo ebirina obukwakkulizo. Omuntu omugagga mu kkanisa bw’agaba alyoke afuge ekkanisa, oba yeewale okunenyezebwa, ekirabo ekyo mutego.

Saba essaala ya Aguli: “tonjavuwazanga wadde okungaggawaza, naye ndiisanga emmere eya buli lunaku. Nneme okukkutanga ne nkwegaana … Era nnemenga okuba omwavu ne nziba” (Engero 30:8-9).

Ekitabo kya Ochorus Omwesigwa mu Bintu Ebitono kigenda mu buziba bwa bino byonna, eri buli mukkiriza so si eri abakulembeze bokka. Kyandibadde kitabo kirungi okusoma awamu n’ekkanisa yo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Didache ne John Wesley

Ekimu ku biwandiiko eby’Ekikristaayo ebisinga obukadde ebitali mu Ndagaano Empya kitabo kitono ekiyitibwa Didache, ekitegeeza “okuyigiriza”. Kirabika kyawandiikibwa mu Siriya oba mu Palesitayini ku nkomerero y’ekyasa ekisooka, era kyawa ekkanisa ento ebiragiro ebyangu. Ne mu biseera ebyo eby’edda ennyo, Ekkanisa yalina okwetegereza ababuulizi abataayaayana abaakozesanga Enjiri okufuna ssente. Didache yawa ekigezo ekitegeerekeka. Omutume omutambuze yalinanga okumala olunaku lumu oba ennaku bbiri, n’alyoka agenda, nga atwala mugaati gwokka ogw’olugendo:

“Naye bw’asaba ssente, oyo nnabbi wa bulimba.”

— Didache, essuula 11 (okuva mu kuvvuunula kwa J. B. Lightfoot)

Mu bigambo ebyangu: omubuulizi akusaba ssente ku lulwe yennyini nnabbi wa bulimba. Era kyagamba nti omuntu yenna bw’aba yeeyita ayogera mu Mwoyo n’agamba nti, “Mpa ffeeza,” ekkanisa tesaanidde kumuwuliriza. Abakristaayo abaasooka baali bamanyi nti okululunkanira ssente kabonero ka ddala ak’omuyigiriza ow’obulimba.

John Wesley, omubuulizi Omungereza ow’ekyasa ekya kkumi na munaana gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu, yabuulira obubaka obwamanyika ennyo obuyitibwa “The Use of Money” (Enkozesa y’Ensimbi). Busangibwa mu kitabo kye Sermons on Several Occasions (Obubaka obwabuulirwa ku Mikolo egy’Enjawulo), ku Ochorus. Yafunza omulimu gw’Omukristaayo mu mateeka asatu: “Funa kyonna ky’osobola”, mu bwesimbu era nga tolumya ggwe wennyini wadde abalala; “tereka kyonna ky’osobola”, nga toonoona ssente ku bya kwejalabya na kwelaga; era “gaba kyonna ky’osobola”. Yannyonnyola lwaki etteeka ery’okusatu lye lisinga obukulu:

“Nnannyini ggulu n’ensi bwe yakutonda n’akuteeka mu nsi eno, teyakuteeka wano ng’omwannannyini, wabula ng’omuwanika.”

— John Wesley, “The Use of Money”

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Katonda, nnannyini ggulu n’ensi, teyakuteeka mu nsi ng’omwannannyini, wabula ng’omuddukanya w’ebintu ebibye. Wesley yabeera mu bulamu obwo. Ebitabo bye bwe byatundibwa, yafuna ssente nnyingi nnyo, naye ebyo bye yeetaaganga okubeerawo yabikuuma kumpi nga bye bimu obulamu bwe bwonna, n’ebisigadde n’abigaba. Bwe yafa, yaleka ssente ntono nnyo.

Wandyeyongedde okuweereza?

Kino kibuuzo ekinoonyereza buli mukulembeze: singa tewaaliwo musaala, tewaali birabo, era tewaali kitiibwa, nandyeyongedde okuweereza wano? Peetero yagamba abakadde okulunda “olw’okujjumbira Katonda”, so si lwa magoba. Omusumba Omukulu yasuubiza empeera ssente gye zitayinza kugula: “engule ey’ekitiibwa ekitaliggwaawo” (1 Peetero 5:4).

Gekazi yaddukira ffeeza n’afiirwa buli kimu. Erisa yagaana ffeeza n’akuuma emmeeme ye. Londa ekkubo lya Erisa.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 2 Bassekabaka 5:15-27. Ekibi kya Gekazi ekya ddala kyali ki? Okemebwa okwo kwe kumu okulaba wa leero?
  • Wali olabye enjiri ey’obugagga mu kitundu kyo? Wandinnyonnyodde otya omuntu, mu bukkakkamu era okuva mu Byawandiikibwa, ekikyamu kyayo?
  • Ssente zikwatibwa zitya mu kkanisa yo? Embalirira yammwe yandiyimiridde bw’eyekebejjebwa mu bwesimbu omuntu ow’ebweru?
  • Soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:33-35. Mu ngeri ki gy’oyinza okugoberera ekyokulabirako kya Pawulo?
  • Wesley yagamba nti tuli bawanika, so si bannannyini. Ekyo kyandikyusizza kitya engeri gy’okozesaamu by’olina?
  • Wandyeyongedde okuweereza w’oli singa tewaaliwo musaala wadde birabo?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Tunuulira mu bwesimbu engeri ssente gye zikwatibwamu mu buweereza bwo. Wiiki eno, kakasa nti abantu babiri waakiri be babala era be bawandiika buli kiweebwayo, era nti ebiwandiiko ebyo bisobola okwekebejjebwa. Bw’oba ng’okwata ssente wekka, kikyuse kaakano. Oluvannyuma tunuulira embalirira y’amaka go. Wandiika obungi bw’ogaba, era osabe ng’obuuza oba Katonda akuyita okwongera okugaba. Bw’oba nga waliwo kye watwala ekitali kikyo, kitereeze wiiki eno.

study_questions.question: Ssente mbi?
study_questions.answer: Nedda, naye okuziyaayaanira kutta. “Kubanga okululunkanira ensimbi y’ensibuko y’ebibi byonna, era olw’okululunkana okwo abamu bawabye, ne bava mu kukkiriza” (1 Timoseewo 6:10). Omukulembeze w’ekkanisa alina okuba “nga talulunkanira nsimbi” (1 Timoseewo 3:3).

study_questions.question: Bayibuli eyogera ki ku njiri ey’obugagga?
study_questions.answer: Essuula eno erabula nti okuyigiriza okusuubiza obugagga olw’okugaba kunyoola Enjiri. Yesu yagamba nti, “Toyinza kuweereza Katonda na mamona” (Matayo 6:24), era nti, “obulamu bw’omuntu tebugererwa ku bugagga bw’abeera nabwo” (Lukka 12:15).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okukwata ssente mu bwesimbu?
study_questions.answer: Ng’akuuma ssente z’ekkanisa nga ziri mu lwatu era nga zibalibwako, nga tazikwata yekka, ng’abeera mu bulamu obwangu era ng’amatidde, era ng’agaana okufuna amagoba mu buweereza, nga Gekazi bwe yakola bwe yagoberera Naamani (2 Bassekabaka 5:20). Essuula eno eyigira ku Didache ne John Wesley.

fields.title: Obulongoofu mu by’Okwegatta
fields.body_html:
“Kubanga Katonda ayagala mutukuzibwe, era mwewalenga obwenzi, buli omu ku mmwe amanyenga okufuga omubiri gwe mu butukuvu n’ekitiibwa.”

— 1 Abasessaloniika 4:3-4

Omuti omunene guyinza okumala emyaka kikumi nga guyimiridde. Guyita mu kibuyaga, mu kyeya ne mu muliro. Awo olunaku lumu ne gugwa, abantu ne beewuunya. Naye bwe batunuulira ekikolo kyagwo, ne balaba nga gwali gumaze emyaka mingi nga guvunda munda. Obuwuka obutono bwali bumaze ebbanga nga bugulya okuva munda, mu kasirise, awatali muntu yenna alaba.

Abakulembeze bangi bagwa mu ngeri y’emu ddala. Okugwa kwabwe kujja mangu era mu lwatu. Naye kwatandika dda nnyo, mu kulekulira okutono okwakwekebwa. Mu ngeri zonna abakulembeze mwe bagwira, ekibi eky’obwenzi kye kimu ku bisinga okubaawo era ku bisinga okuzikiriza. Kimenya obufumbo, kirumya abaana, kizikiriza ekkanisa era kireetera erinnya lya Kristo ensonyi. Essuula eno eyogera ku kyo mu lwatu, kubanga okusirika kuyambye abakulembeze bangi okugwa.

Yusufu: omuvubuka eyadduka

Yusufu yali muddu muvubuka mu Misiri, wala n’ab’omu maka ge. “Mukama n’aba ne Yusufu n’aba n’omukisa” (Olubereberye 39:2). Mukama we yamwesiga n’amukwasa buli kimu. Awo mukyala wa mukama we n’atandika okumusendasenda. Buli lunaku yamugambanga nti, “Weebake nange.”

Laba Yusufu bwe yamuddamu: “Laba, mukama wange yankwasa byonna ebiri mu nnyumba, n’abiteeka byonna mu mikono gyange … tewali na kimu ky’atankwasa okuggyako ggwe, kubanga ggwe oli mukazi we. Kale nnyinza ntya okuyingira mu kwonoona okwenkanidde awo n’okusobya eri Katonda?” (Olubereberye 39:8-9). Yusufu yalaba bulungi nti kino kyandibadde kulyamu mukama we olukwe, era okusinga byonna, kwandibadde kwonoona eri Katonda.

Era laba kye yakola. “Newaakubadde muka mukama we yamutayirira, Yusufu ye teyamuwulira na mulundi na gumu” (Olubereberye 39:10). Yeewala okumusemberera. Era olunaku lumu, nga tewali muntu mulala mu nnyumba, omukazi bwe yakwata ekyambalo kye, “Yusufu n’amwesimatulako, ekyambalo kye ne kisigala mu ngalo z’omukazi wa mukama we. Ye n’adduka n’ava mu nnyumba” (Olubereberye 39:12).

Yusufu yafiirwa ekyambalo kye. Yawaayirizibwa n’asuulibwa mu kkomera. Naye yakuuma obwesigwa bwe, era Katonda yali naye ne mu kkomera omwo. Kisinga okufiirwa ekyambalo kyo, omulimu gwo n’erinnya lyo okusinga okufiirwa obulongoofu bwo.

Pawulo awa amagezi ge gamu: “Mudduke obwenzi” (1 Abakkolinso 6:18). “Naye ddukanga okwegomba okubi okw’ekivubuka, ogobererenga obutuukirivu, n’okukkiriza, n’okwagalana era n’emirembe” (2 Timoseewo 2:22). Okukemebwa okumu kusaanidde okulwanyisibwa. Okukemebwa okw’obwenzi kusaanidde okuddukwa.

Dawudi: kabaka eyasigala awaka

Dawudi ye mboozi eyawukana ku eyo. Yali musajja ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala, kabaka omukulu, omuwandiisi wa zabbuli. Naye mu kiseera kimu, “mu biro ebyo, ekiseera bakabaka mwe bagendera okutabaala … Dawudi n’asigala mu Yerusaalemi. Olunaku olumu, mu ssaawa ez’olweggulo, Dawudi n’agolokoka, n’atambulatambula ku kasolya ak’olubiri lwe. N’asinziira waggulu eyo n’alengera omukazi ng’anaaba” (2 Samwiri 11:1-2).

Weetegereze amadaala g’okugwa kwe. Teyali w’asaanidde kubeera. Teyalina ky’akola. Yatunula, n’akomya okutunula. Yabuuza omukazi oyo y’ani. N’amutumya. N’asula naye. Omukazi bwe yafuna olubuto, n’agezaako okukikweka. Ekyo bwe kyagaana, n’ateekateeka bba Uliya attibwe mu lutalo. Ekibi ekimu kyaleeta ekirala, buli kimu nga kisinga ekyakisooka obubi. Yakobo annyonnyola enkola eno bulungi ddala: “Naye buli muntu akemebwa ng’okwegomba kwe okubi, bwe kuli, n’asendebwasendebwa. Okwegomba okwo bwe kumala okuba olubuto, ne kuzaala ekibi, n’ekibi bwe kikula ne kizaala okufa” (Yakobo 1:14-15).

Weetegereze nate nti Dawudi ye yali kabaka. Basuseba teyali mu mbeera ya kumugaana. Leero kino twandikirabye si nga bwenzi bwokka, wabula ng’omusajja ow’obuyinza ng’akozesa bubi obuyinza bwe ku mukazi atayinza kugamba nti nedda. Omukulembeze bw’akozesa ekifo kye okusendasenda omuntu okugwa mu kibi eky’obwenzi, ekyo si “mukwano gwa kyama” bugwa. Kuba kukozesa bubi obuyinza. Kino tujja kukitunuulira mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu.

Ekibi kya Dawudi kyaleetera amaka ge n’obwakabaka bwe ebivaamu eby’entiisa obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo. Naye nnabbi Nasani bwe yamwolekera, ne yeenenya. Zabbuli 51 y’essaala ye: “Ontondemu omutima omulongoofu, Ayi Katonda, era onteekemu omwoyo omulungi munda yange” (Zabbuli 51:10).

Kitandikira mu mutima

Yesu yayigiriza nti obulongoofu tebukwata ku bye tukola byokka. “Naye mbagamba nti Buli muntu atunuulira omukazi n’amwegomba aba amaze okumwendako mu mutima gwe” (Matayo 5:28). Kye kimu n’eri abakazi abatunuulira abasajja.

Yobu yagamba nti, “Nakola endagaano n’amaaso gange; obutatunuulira muwala n’amaaso ag’obukaba” (Yobu 31:1). Yasalawo nga bukyali ky’anaatunuulira n’ekyo ky’atajja kutunuulira. “Ekisinga byonna kuuma omutima gwo, kubanga y’ensulo y’obulamu bwo” (Engero 4:23).

Mu biseera byaffe, kino kizibuwadde okusinga bwe kyali kibadde. Ebifaananyi n’obutambi obw’obuseegu (pornography) bisangibwa kumpi ku buli ssimu, mu buli lulimi, mu kyama. Abakulembeze bangi, nga mw’otwalidde n’abasumba, babisibiddwamu mu kyama. Kiyinza okulabika ng’ekitaliiko kabi kubanga tewali muntu mulala akwatibwako. Naye kiwunya obusagwa mu birowoozo, kyonoona obufumbo, kitwala abantu abaatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda ng’ebintu, emirundi mingi kiriisibwa okunyigirizibwa kw’abaavu n’abo abatundibwa, era kiteekateeka ekkubo ly’ekibi ekisingawo. Bw’oba ng’osibiddwa mu kino, tokweka. Kyatulire Katonda n’omukkiriza omukulu mu mwoyo gw’oyinza okwesiga, ofune obuyambi. Waliwo ekkubo ery’okuvaamu.

Bbugwe ow’obukuumi

“Kale alowooza ng’ayimiridde, yeekuumenga aleme okugwa” (1 Abakkolinso 10:12). Tewali mukulembeze wa maanyi nnyo, mukadde nnyo oba wa mwoyo nnyo nti tayinza kugwa. Omukulembeze ow’amagezi azimba bbugwe ow’obukuumi ng’okulumbibwa tekunnajja. Engero zigamba ku mukazi omwenzi nti, “Mwewalenga omukazi oyo era temusembereranga luggi lwa nnyumba ye” (Engero 5:8). Tosemberera luggi.

Bino bye bbugwe abamu abayambye abakulembeze bangi. Birina okukozesebwa n’amagezi mu buwangwa obw’enjawulo, naye amazima agabirimu gakola buli wamu.

  • Kuuma amaaso go. Salawo nga bukyali ky’otojja kulaba wadde okutunuulira. Teeka obukuumi ku ssimu yo ne ku kompyuta yo. Totwalanga ssimu yo ku kitanda.
  • Weegendereze okubeera wekka. Weewale embeera mw’obeera wekka, mu kyama, n’omuntu ow’ekikula ekirala atali munno mu bufumbo oba ow’oluganda olw’okumpi, naddala mu kuwabula abantu, mu ngendo oba ekiro ekikeesezza. Musisinkane we basobola okubalaba. Leka enzigi nga nzigule. Twala omuntu omulala ng’ogenda okukyalira abantu.
  • Weekuume mu nneewulira zo. Emikwano mingi egy’obwenzi tegitandika na kusikirizibwa kwa mubiri, wabula n’okusembereragana mu mutima. Bw’olaba ng’ogabana omutima gwo n’omuntu omulala okusinga munno mu bufumbo, oba ng’olindirira nnyo okumulaba, ako kabonero ak’okulabula.
  • Yogeranga bulungi ku munno mu bufumbo mu lwatu. Era teweemulugunyanga ku bufumbo bwo eri omuntu ow’ekikula ekirala.
  • Labirira obufumbo bwo. “… osanyuke ne mukazi wo ow’omu buvubuka bwo” (Engero 5:18). Obufumbo obulamu, obujjudde okwagala, bwe bumu ku bbugwe abasinga amaanyi. Kino tujja kukitunuulira mu Ssuula 42, Amaka g’Omukulembeze.
  • Beeranga n’abakubalirira. Beera n’abantu omu oba babiri waakiri b’oyinza okwesiga, b’owadde olukusa okukubuuza ebibuuzo ebizibu ku bulongoofu bwo, era obiddemu mu bwesimbu. Kino tujja kukiddamu mu Ssuula 46, Omwesigwa mu Bitono: Okubalibwako.
  • Manya ebiseera byo eby’obunafu. Okukoowa, ekiwuubaalo, okuggwaamu amaanyi, okutuuka ku buwanguzi n’ebiseera by’engendo biseera eby’obulabe obw’enjawulo. Dawudi yagwa bwe yali nga talina ky’akola era ng’ali ku ntikko y’obuyinza bwe.
  • Jjukira omuwendo gw’osasula. Kuba ekifaananyi ky’amaaso ga munno mu bufumbo, ag’abaana bo, ag’ekkanisa yo n’ag’abantu abaakkiriza okuyita mu ggwe. “Omuntu ayinza okuwambaatira omuliro mu kifuba kye, ebyambalo bye ne bitaggya?” (Engero 6:27).

Abantu abamu beeraliikirira nti ensalo zino zitegeeza okutunuulira abakazi, oba abasajja, n’okwekengera, oba okugaana abakazi okuweereza. Ekyo si kye kigendererwa. Pawulo yagamba Timoseewo nti, “abakazi abakadde bayisenga ng’abazadde bo, abato nga bannyoko, ng’omutima gwo mulongoofu ddala” (1 Timoseewo 5:2). Ekigendererwa kwe kukuuma buli muntu, nga mw’otwalidde n’abo be tukola nabo, abasajja n’abakazi balyoke baweereze wamu mu kitiibwa ne mu kwesigagana.

Ekisa kya Katonda kirina amaanyi agamala

Essuula eno eyinza okuwulikika ng’enzito. Naye wulira amawulire amalungi. “Tewali kukemebwa kubatuukako okutali kwa bantu; kyokka Katonda mwesigwa, kubanga taabalekenga kutuukibwako kukemebwa kwe mutayinza kugumira, naye anaabasobozesanga okubigumira, n’abalaga n’ekkubo ery’okubiwangula” (1 Abakkolinso 10:13). Pawulo era atujjukiza nti, “Oba temumanyi ng’omubiri gwammwe ye Yeekaalu ya Mwoyo Mutukuvu Katonda gwe yabawa, era n’emibiri gyammwe si gyammwe ku bwammwe? Kubanga mwagulibwa na muwendo” (1 Abakkolinso 6:19-20). Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ggwe. Asinga amaanyi okukemebwa kwonna.

Era bw’oba ng’omaze okugwa, waliwo okusonyiwa. “Naye bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okutusonyiwa n’okutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna” (1 Yokaana 1:9). Okwenenya kw’omukulembeze kujja kutegeeza okwatula mu bwesimbu, si eri Katonda yekka, wabula n’eri abo b’osobezza n’eri abo abakulinako obuyinza. Emirundi mingi kujja kutegeeza okuva ku bukulembeze okumala ekiseera, oboolyawo emirembe gyonna. Kujja kutegeeza okukkiriza ebivuddemu nga toteeka musango ku balala. Era kujja kutegeeza ekkubo eddene ery’okuddamu okuzimba obwesige. Ekkubo eryo tujja kulitunuulira mu Ssuula 39, Okugwa n’Okuzzibwawo. Naye ekisa kya Katonda kisinga ekibi kyaffe.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Augustine

Augustine, omulabirizi ow’omu Bukiikakkono bwa Afirika gwe twasisinkana mu ssuula ezaasooka, yali amanyi amaanyi g’ekibi eky’obwenzi okuva munda. Bwe yali omuvubuka yabeera n’omukazi okumala emyaka mingi nga tamuwasizza, era n’azaala naye omwana ow’obulenzi. Yeegombanga okugoberera Kristo, naye nga tayinza kwesalirawo kuleka masanyu ge ag’ekibi. Mu kitabo kye Okwatula, ekiri ku Ochorus, yajjukira bwe yasabanga ng’akyali muvubuka:

“Mpa obulongoofu n’okwefuga, naye si kaakano.”

— Augustine, Okwatula, Ekitabo VIII

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Mukama, nfuula mulongoofu, naye si kaakano. Yannyonnyola nti yatya nti Katonda ayinza okumuddamu mangu nnyo. Yayagala okwegomba kwe kumatizibwe, so si kuggibwawo. Abantu bangi basaba bwe batyo. Baagala okufuna eddembe olunaku lumu, naye si leero.

Ku nkomerero, mu nnimiro e Milano, ng’ali mu nnaku nnyingi, yakaaba n’ayogerera waggulu nti, “Kutuusa ddi, kutuusa ddi, ‘enkya, n’enkya?’ Lwaki si kaakano?” Awo n’awulira eddoboozi ly’omwana okuva mu nnyumba eyali okumpi, nga liyimba nti, “Ddira osome; ddira osome.” N’abikkula ebbaluwa za Pawulo n’asoma ebigambo ebyasooka amaaso ge kwe gaagwa. Byali biva mu Baruumi 13: “so si mu binyumu ne mu kutamiira, ne mu bwenzi n’obukaba … naye twambale Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo so tetuwanga mubiri bbanga kukola ng’okwegomba kwagwo bwe kuli” (Abaruumi 13:13-14). Augustine yawandiika nti amangu ago, “ekizikiza kyonna eky’okubuusabuusa ne kibula.” Yakyuka, n’afuuka omu ku bakulembeze abasinga obukulu Ekkanisa b’erabye.

Emboozi ya Augustine eraga ebintu bibiri. Ekibi eky’obwenzi lujegere lwa maanyi. Naye Kristo asinga amaanyi, era asobola okuwa buli muntu eddembe.

Ebyasa bingi oluvannyuma, mu 1948, omubuulizi w’enjiri omuvubuka Omumerika ayitibwa Billy Graham yasisinkana n’abakozi be abatono mu wooteeri mu kibuga Modesto, e California. Baali balabye ababuulizi b’enjiri abalala nga bagwa olw’ensimbi, olw’obwenzi n’olw’amalala. N’olwekyo ne beeyama wamu ebintu ebyangu. Ekimu kyali nti tewali n’omu ku bo eyandigenze mu lugendo, eyandisisinkanye oba eyandiriiridde emmere yekka n’omukazi atali mukazi we. Graham yakuuma obweyamo buno obuweereza bwe bwonna obwali obuwanvu. Ne bwe tuba tulowooza tutya ku bitundu byabwo ebitono, amazima agabirimu ga magezi: salawo bbugwe wo ng’olutalo terunnatandika, era omukuume, wamu n’abalala.

Abatukuvu mu mubiri ne mu mutima

Pawulo agamba nti, “Kubanga Katonda ayagala mutukuzibwe” (1 Abasessaloniika 4:3). Obulongoofu tebukwata ku kwewala bugwagwa bwokka. Bukwata ku kuba ba Katonda, omubiri n’emmeeme. “Noolwekyo emibiri gyammwe gigulumizenga Katonda” (1 Abakkolinso 6:20).

Omuti ogumala emyaka kikumi nga guyimiridde si gwe gutasanga kibuyaga. Gwe guba n’omutima omulamu munda. Kuuma omutima gwo. Zimba bbugwe wo. Dduka bwe kiba kyetaagisa. Era weesige Oyo ayinza okukukuuma oleme okugwa.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Olubereberye 39:6-12. Yusufu yakola ki okwekuuma? Kiki ky’oyinza okumuyigirako?
  • Soma 2 Samwiri 11:1-5. Madaala ki agaatuusa Dawudi ku kugwa? Amadaala agafaanana bwe gatyo ogalaba wa mu bulamu bwo?
  • Ku “bbugwe ow’obukuumi” abo, ki ky’olina dda? Ki ky’oleseeyo ne kigwa mu kasirise?
  • Olina omuntu gw’owadde olukusa okukubuuza ebibuuzo ebizibu ku bulongoofu bwo? Bw’oba tomulina, ani gw’oyinza okusaba?
  • Wali osabye, nga Augustine bwe yakola, nti “nfuula mulongoofu, naye si kaakano”? Kyandibadde kitegeeza ki okugamba nti “kaakano”?
  • Ensalo ziyinza zitya okukuuma abakulembeze n’abantu be baweereza, nga tewali n’omu aziyizibwa kuweereza?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno, wandiika ensalo z’ojja okukuuma okukuuma obulongoofu bwo, ng’okozesa olukalala oluli mu ssuula eno ng’akulambika. Zibuulire munno mu bufumbo, bw’oba ng’oli mufumbo, n’omukkiriza omu omukulu mu mwoyo gw’oyinza okwesiga ow’ekikula kyo. Saba omuntu oyo akubuulirizenga buli kiseera. Bwe wabaawo ekibi kyonna eky’ekyama mu bulamu bwo, nga mw’otwalidde n’ebifaananyi eby’obuseegu, kyatulire Katonda n’omuntu oyo wiiki eno, osabe obuyambi okufuna ekkubo ery’okuvaamu.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okusigala nga mulongoofu mu by’okwegatta?
study_questions.answer: Ng’akuuma omutima n’azimba bbugwe ow’obukuumi, era ng’adduka okukemebwa: “Mudduke obwenzi” (1 Abakkolinso 6:18). “Naye ddukanga okwegomba okubi okw’ekivubuka, ogobererenga obutuukirivu, n’okukkiriza, n’okwagalana era n’emirembe” (2 Timoseewo 2:22).

study_questions.question: Kiki kye tuyinza okuyiga ku Yusufu ne mukazi wa Potifaali?
study_questions.answer: Yusufu yamugaananga buli lunaku, era omukazi bwe yamukwata, “Yusufu n’amwesimatulako, ekyambalo kye ne kisigala mu ngalo z’omukazi wa mukama we. Ye n’adduka n’ava mu nnyumba” (Olubereberye 39:12). Yalaba nti ekibi ekyo kyandibadde kwonoona eri Katonda. Dawudi ye, ku ludda olulala, yasigala awaka mu kiseera we yali asaanidde okuba mu lutalo, n’agwa.

study_questions.question: Waliwo essuubi eri omukulembeze agudde mu kibi eky’obwenzi?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Ekisa kya Katonda kirina amaanyi agamala okusonyiwa n’okuwonya. Essuula eno ekubiriza okwatula kwonna, okubeera n’abakubalirira n’okuzzibwawo, era enyumya engeri Augustine gye yafunamu eddembe okuva mu kibi eky’obwenzi olw’ekisa kya Katonda.

fields.title: Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu
fields.body_html:
“Be mukulembera temubakambuwaliranga wabula mubakulemberenga nga mubalaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi.”

— 1 Peetero 5:3

Omusumba atambula n’omuggo. Ku gwo ayinza okuluŋŋamya endiga, okusikayo omwana gw’endiga mu kisaka ky’amaggwa, oba okugoba omusege. Naye omuggo gwe gumu guyinza okukozesebwa okukuba endiga. Omuggo gwennyini si mulungi wadde mubi. Ekikulu gwe mutima gw’omusumba.

Buli mukulembeze alina obuyinza. Buyinza buva mu kitiibwa ky’ekifo kye, mu kumanya, mu ssente, mu kwesigibwa, oba mu kwogera ku lwa Katonda. Obuyinza mu bwabwo si bubi. Katonda abuwa abakulembeze balyoke bakuume era baweereze. Naye obuyinza busobola okukozesebwa okufuga abantu, okubatiisa, okubanyaga n’okubalumya. Essuula eno ekwata ku kukozesa obubi obuyinza mu Kkanisa, n’omulimu omutukuvu omukulembeze gw’alina ogw’okukuuma abanafu, naddala abaana. Y’emu ku ssuula ezisinga obukulu mu kitabo kino.

Abasumba abaalya ekisibo

Ekigambo kya Katonda okuyita mu Ezeekyeri kye kimu ku kulabula okusinga amaanyi mu Bayibuli: “Zibasanze abasumba ba Isirayiri abeefaako bokka. Abasumba tebasaanye kuliisa ndiga? Mulya amasavu, ne mwambala ebyoya, ne mutta ensolo ensava, naye temufaayo ku bisibo … naye muzifuze n’amaanyi” (Ezeekyeri 34:2-4).

Abakulembeze bano baakozesa ekisibo ku lwabwe bokka. Beetwalira emmere n’engoye ebisinga obulungi. Baafuga n’obukambwe. Omusango Katonda gwe yasala gwali gutegeerekeka: “Nnina ensonga ku basumba” (Ezeekyeri 34:10).

Batabani ba Eri, kabona omukulu, nabo baali bwe batyo. Baali bakabona mu nnyumba ya Katonda, naye nga “tebatya Mukama Katonda.” Ennyama esinga obulungi okuva mu ssaddaaka baagitwalanga lwa maanyi (1 Samwiri 2:12-16). Ekisinga n’obubi, “beetabanga n’abakyala abaweerezanga ku mulyango gw’Eweema ey’Okukuŋŋaanirangamu” (1 Samwiri 2:22). Baakozesa ekifo kyabwe mu nnyumba ya Katonda okunyigiriza abantu abajjanga okusinza.

Era weetegereze Eri. Yali amanyi. “N’awulira ebyo byonna batabani be bye baakolanga.” Yayogera nabo, naye teyakola kintu kyonna kubaziyiza. Katonda yagamba nti yandibonerezza ennyumba ya Eri: “ndibonereza ennyumba ye ennaku zonna, olw’obutali butuukirivu bwa batabani be abavvoola Katonda, n’akimanya naye n’atabaziyiza” (1 Samwiri 3:13). Ekibi kya Eri tekyali nti yatulugunya abantu. Kyali nti yamanya okutulugunyizibwa kwabwe n’atakolawo kantu. Kuno kulabula eri buli mukulembeze awulira ku kutulugunya abantu n’asirika.

Mu mmwe si bwe kiri

Yesu yayigiriza abayigirizwa be engeri ey’enjawulo ddala ey’okukozesa obuyinza: “Mumanyi ng’abakulembeze b’abamawanga, n’abakulu baabwe bakuluusanya abantu, naye mu mmwe si bwe kiri bwe kityo. Yenna ayagala okuba omukulembeze mu mmwe, asaanira abeerenga muweereza wa banne” (Makko 10:42-43).

Peetero, eyawulira ebigambo bino, oluvannyuma yawandiikira abakadde nti: “Be mukulembera temubakambuwaliranga wabula mubakulemberenga nga mubalaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi” (1 Peetero 5:3). Pawulo yawandiikira Abakkolinso nti, “Temusaanye kulowooza nti ffe tufuga okukkiriza kwammwe, naye tuli bakozi bannammwe, mulyoke musanyuke” (2 Abakkolinso 1:24).

Mu Ssuula 5, Ekiremba n’Ebbensani, twalaba nti obukulembeze obw’Ekikristaayo bwe bukulembeze obw’okuweereza. Mu Ssuula 6, Obuyinza wansi w’Obuyinza, twalaba nti buli mukulembeze ali wansi wa Kristo. Okukozesa obubi obuyinza kwe kukontana n’ebyo byombi. Kufuula omuweereza mukama, era kwerabira Mukama ali waggulu.

Okutulugunya okw’omwoyo bwe kulabika

Okukozesa obubi obuyinza mu Kkanisa si bulijjo nti kulimu kukuba. Emirundi mingi kukwekebwa emabega w’ebigambo eby’omwoyo. Pawulo yalabula Abakkolinso nti baali beetegefu nnyo okugumiikiriza abakulembeze ab’obulimba: “Omuntu yenna bw’abafuula abaddu, oba n’abanyaga, oba n’abalyazaamanya, oba ne yeegulumiza, oba n’abakuba empi, mukigumiikiriza” (2 Abakkolinso 11:20). Bino bye bimu ku bubonero bw’okutulugunya okw’omwoyo.

  • Okutya. Abantu batya omukulembeze. Tebaguma kubuuza bibuuzo wadde okulowooza mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku ye.
  • Okufuga. Omukulembeze y’asalawo abantu gwe bayinza okufumbiriganwa naye, gye bayinza okukolera, gwe bayinza okwogera naye, oba afuga ssente zaabwe.
  • Okukozesa erinnya lya Katonda ng’ekyokulwanyisa. “Bw’onoovanga mu kkanisa eno, Katonda ajja kukukolimira.” “Temukomanga ku bafukeko amafuta bange.” Ebigambo ng’ebyo bikozesebwa okusirisa buli muntu alaga ekimweraliikiriza.
  • Tewali kubalibwako. Omukulembeze tavunaanyizibwa eri muntu yenna. Tewali yeekebejja ssente wadde ebyo by’asalawo.
  • Ekyama. Ebizibu bulijjo bikwekebwa “okukuuma obuweereza”. Abo aboogera bonerezebwa, baswazibwa oba bagobebwa.
  • Okunyaga. Omukulembeze atwala ku bantu ssente, emirimu gyabwe, ebirabo oba okwegatta nabo, naddala ku abo abaavu oba abamwesigamako.
  • Emigugu emizito. Yesu yagamba ku Bafalisaayo nti, “Basiba emigugu emizito ne bagitikka abalala, so nga bo n’okugezaako tebagezaako kukwatako n’engalo yaabwe” (Matayo 23:4).

Kino kibuuzo ekinoonyereza buli mukulembeze: abantu bawulira nga tebalina kabi okumbuulira amazima? Bawulira nga ba ddembe okuŋŋamba nti nedda? Bwe kiba nga si bwe kityo, wayinza okubaawo ekikyamu.

Yesu n’abato

Yesu yalina okwagala okw’enjawulo eri abaana. Abayigirizwa be bwe baagezaako okubagoba, n’agamba nti, “Mukkirize abaana abato bajje gye ndi so temubaziyiza, kubanga abafaanana ng’abo be bannannyini bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu” (Matayo 19:14). Era yawa okulabula okumu ku kusinga okutiisa: “alyesittaza omu ku baana abato anzikiririzaamu, asaanidde okusibibwa olubengo mu bulago asuulibwe mu nnyanja” (Matayo 18:6). Era n’agamba nti, “Mwekuume obutanyoomanga n’omu ku baana bano abato. Kubanga mbagamba nti bamalayika baabwe ennaku zonna babeera mu maaso ga Kitange ali mu ggulu” (Matayo 18:10).

Eky’ennaku, abaana batulugunyiziddwa mu kkanisa mu nsi yonna, mu buli kika ky’ekkanisa, abasumba, bakabona, abasomesa, abakulembeze b’abavubuka n’abalala be baali beesiga. Emirundi n’emirundi abakulembeze b’ekkanisa babadde bakimanyi ne bakibikkirira, okukuuma oyo eyatulugunya, erinnya ly’ekkanisa oba bo bennyini. Emirundi mingi omwana eyatulugunyizibwa teyakkirizibwa, oba yateekebwako omusango, oba yagambibwa okusonyiwa n’okusirika. Kino kirumizza nnyo abantu bangi okumala ebbanga eddene, era kigobye bangi okuva eri Kristo. Kibi kinene nnyo.

Tokibikkiriranga n’akatono

Abakulembeze balina okubeera abategeevu ddala ku kino. Bwe wabaawo okuteebereza oba okuloopa nti omwana, oba omuntu yenna omunafu, atulugunyiziddwa, bino birina okukolebwa.

  • Kitwale ng’ensonga enkulu era owulirize. Wuliriza mu kakkamu omuntu akubuulira. Kkiriza nti ayinza okuba ng’ayogera amazima. Tomuteekako musango. Tomusuubiza kukuuma kyama.
  • Sooka okukuuma omunafu. Kakasa amangu ddala nti omwana oba omuntu omunafu ali mu bukuumi, ewala n’oyo avunaanibwa.
  • Kiloope eri ab’obuyinza abatuufu. Okutulugunya omwana musango gwa mateeka, so si kibi kyokka. Pawulo agamba nti obuyinza obufuga “muweereza wa Katonda … awoolera eggwanga eri oyo akola ekibi” (Abaruumi 13:4). Kiloope eri poliisi n’eri ab’obuyinza abakuuma abaana. Togezaako kukigonjoolera mu kkanisa yokka.
  • Tosooka kwogera n’oyo avunaanibwa mu kyama. Mu Ssuula 20, Okunenya n’Okuzzaawo, twalaba amadaala ga Matayo 18:15. Amadaala ago ga bibi bya bulijjo wakati w’abakkiriza. Si ga misango egikolebwa ku baana. Okugenda mu kyama eri oyo atulugunya kiyinza okuteeka omwana mu bulabe obusingawo era ne kiwa omukisa obujulizi okukwekebwa.
  • Ggya avunaanibwa ku buweereza ng’ensonga ekyanoonyerezebwako, naddala ku buli kintu kyonna ekimusisinkanya n’abaana.
  • Tokuumanga atulugunya olw’okuba alina ebirabo, wa buyinza, ayagalibwa abantu oba wa luganda lwo. Tewali linnya, tewali kkanisa era tewali buweereza businga mwana muwendo.
  • Labirira omuntu eyalumizibwa, ebbanga lyonna eryetaagisa. Mufunire obuyambi.

“Temwenyigiranga mu bikolwa bya kizikiza kubanga tebigasa, wabula munenyenga ababikola” (Abaefeso 5:11). Yesu yagamba nti, “tewali kintu na kimu ekyakwekebwa ekitalikwekulwa” (Lukka 8:17). Ekkanisa ky’ekweka, Katonda lumu alikyolesa. Kisinga nnyo Ekkanisa yennyini okukireeta mu kitangaala.

Mu bifo ebimu, ab’obuyinza bennyini bayinza obutaba ba kwesigibwa. Ne mu bifo ebyo, abakulembeze balina okukola kyonna kye basobola okukuuma abanafu, okubatwala mu bukuumi n’okunoonya obwenkanya. “Odduukiriranga n’owonya abo abatwalibwa okuttibwa … Bw’ogambanga nti, ‘Laba kino twali tetukimanyi,’ oyo akebera emitima aba talaba?” (Engero 24:11-12).

Okuzimba ekkanisa omutali kabi

Buli kkanisa, ne bw’eba ntono etya, esaanidde okukola emitendera egyangu okukuuma abaana n’abantu abakulu abanafu.

  • Kebera n’obwegendereza buli muntu agenda okukola n’abaana nga tannatandika.
  • Toganya muntu mukulu n’omu kubeera yekka n’omwana nga tebalabika. Kozesa abantu abakulu babiri, enzigi enzigule n’ebisenge ebirabika.
  • Yigiriza abaana nti emibiri gyabwe gyabwe, nti tewali muntu akkirizibwa kubakwatako mu ngeri embi, era nti bulijjo basobola okubuulira omuntu omukulu gwe beesiga.
  • Beera n’enteekateeka ewandiikiddwa ennyonnyofu ku kye munaakola nga waliwo aloopye okutulugunya, era mukakase nti buli mukulembeze agimanyi.
  • Mulonde omuntu ow’okwesigibwa, okusinga omusajja n’omukazi, buli muntu gw’asobola okugendako n’ekimweraliikiriza, nga mw’otwalidde n’ebyo ebikwata ku mukulembeze omukulu.
  • Mukakase nti tewali mukulembeze, nga mw’otwalidde n’omusumba omukulu, ali waggulu w’okubalibwako.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Gregory Omukulu ne Amy Carmichael

Gregory Omukulu, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 2, Ekifuula Obukulembeze Okuba obw’Omwoyo, yawandiika mu The Book of Pastoral Rule (Ekitabo ky’Obulagirizi bw’Abasumba) ku ngeri abakulembeze gye basaanidde okulowooza ku buyinza bwabwe. Yabajjukiza nti abantu bonna benkana mu buzaaliranwa bwabwe, era nti obukulembeze buweebwa olw’obulungi bw’abalala:

“Noolwekyo bonna abali waggulu w’abalala basaanidde okulowooza mu bo bennyini, si ku buyinza bw’ekifo kyabwe, wabula ku kwenkana kw’embeera yaabwe, era basanyuke, si lwa kuba waggulu w’abantu, wabula olw’okubakolera ebirungi. Kubanga mazima bajjajjaffe ab’edda boogerwako nti tebaali bakabaka ba bantu, wabula basumba ba bisibo.”

— Gregory Omukulu, The Book of Pastoral Rule, Ekitundu II

Mu bigambo ebyangu: abakulembeze tebasaanidde kulowooza ku bugulumivu bw’ekifo kyabwe. Basaanidde okujjukira nti nabo bantu ng’abo be bakulembera. Essanyu lyabwe terisaanidde kuba mu kuba waggulu w’abantu, wabula mu kubakolera ebirungi. Ibulayimu ne bajjajja abalala tebaali bakabaka abafuga abantu, wabula baali basumba ba bisibo.

Amy Carmichael yali muminsani eyava mu Ireland eyagenda mu Bukiikaddyo bwa Buyindi mu 1895 n’atakomawo waka. Mu biseera ebyo, abawala abato abamu baaweebwangayo mu masabo g’Ekihindu, oluvannyuma ne “bafumbizibwa katonda” era abasajja ne babakozesa olw’okwegatta. Nga 7 Ogwokusatu 1901, omuwala omuto ow’emyaka nga musanvu, ayitibwa Preena, yadduka okuva mu nnyumba y’essabo n’ajja ku nnyumba Amy gye yali abeeramu. Yalinnya n’atuula ku bugulu bwa Amy, n’amunyumiza emboozi ye. Yali abadde mu nnaku nga tewali amwagala. Omukazi eyamulabiriranga yamwokya engalo okumubonereza. Lumu yali yaddukira ewa nnyina, naye n’akomezebwawo. N’agamba Amy nti, “Nzize okusigala.”

Amy n’amukuuma. Okuva ku lunaku olwo, Amy ne bakozi banne ne bawaayo obulamu bwabwe okukuuma abaana abali mu bulabe. Ng’ekitabo ky’ebyafaayo bye Amy Carmichael: A Life (Obulamu bwa Amy Carmichael) ekiri ku Ochorus bwe kiraga, abaana bonna be yalabirira tebaava mu masabo. Bangi baali bawere oba baana bato abaali batalina wa kugenda. Emyaka bwe gyagenda giyitawo, omulimu ogwo gwakula ne gufuuka Dohnavur Fellowship, amaka amanene ag’abaana ebikumi abaawonyezebwa, abaalabirirwa mu bukuumi ne mu kwagala. Amy yasanga okuziyizibwa okw’amaanyi, okutiisibwatiisibwa, n’emisango mu kkooti. Naye teyakkiriza kuddiza mwana mu bulabe. Ekitabo kye ekyasooka ku Buyindi, Things as They Are (Ebintu nga Bwe Biri), ekiri ku Ochorus, kyabuulira Ekkanisa mu lwatu ebibi bingi abantu bangi bye baali batayagala kuwulira.

Gregory ayigiriza abakulembeze engeri y’okukwatamu obuyinza. Amy alaga bwe kifaanana okubukozesa ku lw’abato.

Katonda omulwanirizi

Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli yawandiika nti, “Mukama awulira okwetaaga kw’ababonyaabonyezebwa, ogumye emitima gyabwe; otege okutu kwo obaanukule. Olwanirira abataliiko bakitaabwe n’abajoogebwa; omuntu obuntu ow’oku nsi n’ataddayo kubatiisa” (Zabbuli 10:17-18).

Katonda ye mulwanirizi w’abanafu. Alaba buli kutulugunya okukwekeddwa. Awulira buli mwana akaaba. Alisalira omusango buli musumba eyalya ekisibo. Era ayita abakulembeze be okumufaanana: okukozesa omuggo gwabwe okukuuma, so si okukuba, n’okufuula ennyumba ye ekifo omutali kabi eri abato.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Ezeekyeri 34:1-10. Abasumba ba Isirayiri baakozesa batya obuyinza bwabwe? Ekyo kye kimu okiraba wa leero?
  • Soma 1 Samwiri 2:22-25 ne 3:13. Ekibi kya Eri kyali ki? Lwaki kya maanyi nnyo?
  • Abantu bawulira nga tebalina kabi okukubuulira amazima, oba okukugamba nti nedda? Wandizudde otya?
  • Ekkanisa yo erina enteekateeka ennyonnyofu ey’okukuuma abaana n’okukola ku kutulugunya? Bw’eba tegirina, ddaala ki erisooka?
  • Lwaki kikyamu okukola ku kutulugunya abaana mu kyama kyokka, ng’okozesa Matayo 18:15?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga ku Amy Carmichael okugaana okuddiza Preena?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno sisinkana n’abakulembeze banno mwogere ku bukuumi mu kkanisa yammwe. Mubuuze nti: “Ani akola n’abaana baffe? Tebabeera bokka n’omwana n’omulundi gumu? Abaana baffe bamanyi gwe bandibuulidde? Twandikoze ki singa omuntu aloopa okutulugunya, ne bwe kuba nga kwakolebwa omukulembeze?” Wandiika enteekateeka ennyangu, era musalewo ddi lwe muligibuulira ekkanisa. Oluvannyuma buuza abantu babiri oba basatu b’okulembera nti, “Wali otidde okulowooza mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku nze?” era owulirize n’obwegendereza eky’okuddamu.

study_questions.question: Okutulugunya okw’omwoyo kye ki?
study_questions.answer: Kwe kukozesa obuyinza obw’omwoyo okufuga abantu, okubatiisa, okubaswaza oba okubanyigiriza. Peetero yagamba abakadde nti, “Be mukulembera temubakambuwaliranga wabula mubakulemberenga nga mubalaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi” (1 Peetero 5:3). Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Temusaanye kulowooza nti ffe tufuga okukkiriza kwammwe” (2 Abakkolinso 1:24).

study_questions.question: Ekkanisa esaanidde kukola ki okutulugunya bwe kubaawo?
study_questions.answer: Tekibikkiriranga n’akatono. Kuuma eyatulugunyizibwa, loopa emisango eri ab’obuyinza abatuufu, era oyo eyatulugunya avunaanibwe. Eri yasalirwa omusango kubanga batabani be baayonoona, “n’akimanya naye n’atabaziyiza” (1 Samwiri 3:13).

study_questions.question: Ekkanisa eyinza etya okukuuma abanafu?
study_questions.answer: Ng’ezimba obukuumi: enteekateeka ennyonnyofu, okukebera abo abakola n’abaana, obutaleka muntu mukulu n’omu yekka n’omwana, n’okubalirira buli mukulembeze, nga mw’otwalidde n’asinga obukulu. Katonda alina ensonga ku basumba abalya ekisibo (Ezeekyeri 34:10).

fields.title: Obuggya, Okuvuganya n’Okusosola
fields.body_html:
“Okwatiddwa obuggya ku lwange? Kyandibadde kirungi singa abantu ba Mukama bonna bannabbi, ne Mukama Katonda n’abawa omwoyo gwe!”

— Okubala 11:29

Abalimi babiri balina ennimiro eziriraanaganye. Omwaka gumu enkuba n’etonnya nnyo ku nnimiro emu okusinga ku ndala, amakungula g’omulimi omu ne gaba emirundi ebiri okusinga aga munne. Omulimi omulala ayinza okusanyuka wamu ne muliraanwa we n’ebaza Katonda olw’emmere eri mu kyalo. Oba ayinza okuleka obukyayi okukula mu mutima gwe, okutuusa lw’atakyasobola na kulamusa muliraanwa we mu kkubo. Enkuba yali kirabo kye kimu okuva eri Katonda y’omu. Enjawulo eri mu mutima gw’omusajja eyafuna ekitono.

Abakulembeze basanga ekigezo kino buli kiseera. Ekkanisa endala ekula mangu okusinga eyaffe. Omubuulizi omulala ayitibwa okwogera mu lukuŋŋaana olunene. Omukulembeze omuto atenderezebwa okusinga ffe. Era ekintu eky’ekizikiza ne kisagaasagana mu mutima. Essuula eno, esembayo mu Kitundu eky’Omusanvu: Obulabe mu Kkubo, etunuulira obuggya n’okuvuganya wakati w’abakulembeze. Era etunuulira ekintu ekiri okumpi ennyo n’obuggya: okusosola, ekibi eky’okutwala abantu abamu ng’abakulu okusinga abalala olw’eggwanga lyabwe, eddaala lyabwe mu bantu, obugagga bwabwe oba olw’amaka gaabwe.

Sawulo ne Dawudi

Ekyokulabirako ky’obuggya ekisinga okunakuwaza mu Bayibuli ye Kabaka Sawulo. Dawudi bwe yamala okutta Goliyaasi, abakazi ne bava mu bibuga nga bayimba nti, “Sawulo asse enkumi ze Dawudi n’atta emitwalo gye.” Sawulo n’atayinza kukigumiikiriza. N’ayogera nti, “Dawudi bamuwaanye n’emitwalo, nze ne bampaana n’enkumi; kiki ky’ataafune bw’ataalye bwakabaka?” Awo ne wajja ebigambo bino eby’entiisa: “Awo okuva mu kiseera ekyo Sawulo n’akwatirwa Dawudi obuggya” (1 Samwiri 18:7-9).

Dawudi yali talina kibi kye yakola. Yali mwesigwa eri Sawulo. Yali alokodde Isirayiri. Naye obuggya bwa Sawulo bwamukyusa n’amwolekera omuntu yennyini Katonda gwe yali atumye okumuyamba. Okumala emyaka mingi yayigganya Dawudi, n’agezaako okumutta, n’amalira amaanyi g’obwakabaka bwe ku kuvuganya okwali mu mutima gwe yekka. “Omutima ogulina emirembe guwangaaza omuntu, naye obuggya buvunza amagumba ge” (Engero 14:30). Obuggya bwavunza Sawulo okuva munda.

Musa ne Yoswa

Geraageranya ne Musa. Mu Ssuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu, twalaba Katonda bwe yateeka Omwoyo we ku bakadde nsanvu okugabana omugugu gwa Musa. Babiri ku bo, Eridaadi ne Medadi, baali basigadde mu lusiisira, naye Omwoyo n’abajjako nabo, ne batandika okutegeeza obunnabbi. Omuvubuka n’adduka okutegeeza Musa. Yoswa, omuyambi wa Musa omwesigwa, n’agamba nti, “Mukama wange Musa, baziyize.”

Musa n’addamu nti, “Okwatiddwa obuggya ku lwange? Kyandibadde kirungi singa abantu ba Mukama bonna bannabbi, ne Mukama Katonda n’abawa omwoyo gwe!” (Okubala 11:28-29).

Ng’omutima ogwo gwa kitalo! Musa teyawulira nti atiisibwatiisibwa Katonda bwe yakozesa abalala. Yayagala Katonda akozese buli muntu. Yoswa yakwatibwa obuggya ku lwa Musa, ekiyinza okulabika ng’obwesigwa. Naye Musa yalaba nti mu mazima gwali mwoyo mufunda.

Abayigirizwa ba Yesu nabo baalina omwoyo omufunda ogwo gwe gumu. Yokaana yagamba nti, “Omuyigiriza, twalaba omuntu ng’agoba baddayimooni mu linnya lyo, ne tumuziyiza kubanga tayita naffe.” Yesu n’addamu nti, “Temumuziyizanga … Kubanga buli atatuvuganya aba akolera wamu naffe” (Makko 9:38-40). Weetegereze ebigambo “tayita naffe.” Omusajja oyo teyali akola kikyamu kyonna. Yali bubeezi si wa mu kibinja kyabwe.

“Kimugwanira ye okugulumizibwa”

Mu Ssuula 7, Obwetoowaze, twasisinkana Yokaana Omubatiza. Abayigirizwa be bwe beemulugunya nti buli muntu kaakano agenda eri Yesu mu kifo ky’okujja gy’ali, Yokaana n’addamu nti, “Omuntu tayinza kuba na kintu okuggyako nga kimuweereddwa okuva mu ggulu. … Kimugwanira ye okugulumizibwa naye nze okutoowazibwa” (Yokaana 3:27-30).

Sentensi ya Yokaana esooka lye ddagala ly’obuggya: “Omuntu tayinza kuba na kintu okuggyako nga kimuweereddwa okuva mu ggulu.” Omukulembeze omulala bw’aba n’ekkanisa ennene, ekirabo ekisingawo oba ebibala ebingi, ebyo yabiweebwa okuva mu ggulu. Okumukwatirwa obuggya kwe kwemulugunyiza Katonda olw’ebyo by’asalawo. Yesu yagera olugero lw’abakozi mu nnimiro y’emizabbibu abeemulugunya kubanga abalala baasasulwa kye kimu nga bakoze kitono. Nnannyini nnimiro n’agamba nti, “Siyinza kukozesa byange nga bwe njagala? Obuggya bukukutte kubanga ndi wa kisa?” (Matayo 20:15).

Pawulo yagenda wala n’okusingawo. Bwe yali mu kkomera, ababuulizi abalala abamu baabuuliranga Kristo “lwa buggya na kuvuganya”, nga basuubira okwongera ku kubonaabona kwa Pawulo. Yaddamu ki? “Naye nze nfaayo ki? Kristo bw’abuulirwa, mu buli ngeri, oba za bukuusa oba za mazima, nze nsanyuka busanyusi” (Abafiripi 1:15-18). Pawulo yafaayo nnyo ku Kristo okumanyibwa okusinga ku ani afuna ettendo.

Ebibala by’okuvuganya

Yakobo annyonnyola ekibaawo obuggya bwe bufuga: “Bwe muba n’omutima omukyayi ogujjudde n’obuggya, era nga mwefaako mwekka, temusaanidde kwewaana na kulimba nga mukontana n’amazima. Kubanga amagezi ng’ago tegava eri Katonda mu ggulu wabula ga ku nsi, era si ga mwoyo wazira ga Setaani. Kubanga buli awabeera obuggya n’okwefaako wekka, wabeerawo okutabukatabuka era n’ebikolwa ebirala ebibi byonna” (Yakobo 3:14-16).

Okuvuganya wakati w’abakulembeze kweyoleka mu ngeri nnyingi: okwogera mu kaama obubi ku musumba omulala; okugaana okukolera awamu n’ekkanisa ez’ekibinja ekirala; “okubba” abakkiriza okuva mu kkanisa eriraanyeewo; okuvuganya ku bunene bw’amakanisa oba obungi bw’abantu; okugaana okugabana ekituuti; oba okwawulamu ekkanisa okutandika eyiyo. Pawulo yagamba Abakkolinso nti, “obanga mukyalimu obuggya n’ennyombo, temufugibwa mubiri era temutambula ng’abalina empisa z’abantu obuntu?” (1 Abakkolinso 3:3).

Eddagala lyakwo kwe kubeera “nga muwaŋŋana ekitiibwa” (Abaruumi 12:10). Pawulo agamba nti omubiri gwa Kristo gumu: “ekitundu ekimu bwe kigulumizibwa, ebitundu byonna bijaguliza wamu nakyo” (1 Abakkolinso 12:26). Ekkanisa endala bw’ekula, n’eyaffe eba ekuze, kubanga tuli ba mubiri gumu. Osobola okusanyuka omukulembeze omulala bw’aweebwa omukisa? Ekyo kye kimu ku bigezo ebisinga okweyoleka eby’omutima ng’ogwa Katonda.

Okusosola

Obuggya butunuulira abo abali waggulu waffe n’obukyayi. Okusosola kutunuulira abantu ne kubateeka mu madaala. Byombi bigaana nti buli muntu ayimiridde nga yenkana n’abalala mu maaso ga Katonda.

Yakobo yayagala Yusufu okusinga batabani be abalala, n’amuwa ekkanzu ey’enjawulo. “Naye baganda ba Yusufu bwe baalaba nga kitaabwe amwagala okusinga bo ne bakyawa Yusufu, ne batayinza na kwogera naye na kisa” (Olubereberye 37:4). Okusosola kwa kitaabwe kwabulako katono okuleeta obutemu, era kwayawulamu amaka okumala emyaka abiri.

Yakobo yalabula ekkanisa nti: “Abooluganda, mmwe abakkiririza mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, Mukama ow’ekitiibwa, temusosolanga mu bantu.” Yannyonnyola omusajja omugagga aweebwa ekifo ekisinga obulungi okutuula, ate omwavu n’agambibwa okuyimirira. “Naye bwe musosola mu bantu muba mukoze kibi” (Yakobo 2:1, 9). Pawulo yakuutira Timoseewo okukola byonna “nga teweekubira wadde okusaliriza” (1 Timoseewo 5:21).

Mu Kkanisa leero, okusosola kulabika mu ngeri nnyingi.

  • Okwekubiira mu mawanga n’okusosola mu bika. Okuwa ebifo, obuyambi oba ekitiibwa abantu ab’eggwanga lyange, ab’ekika kyange oba ab’olulimi lwange, n’obutafaayo ku balala. Mu bitundu bingi eby’ensi, kino kye kimu ku bibi ebisinga obuziba mu Kkanisa, era kiyambye n’okuleeta obukambwe n’entalo.
  • Ebika by’obuzaale n’amadaala mu bantu. Okutwala abantu ng’aba waggulu oba aba wansi olw’amaka mwe baazaalibwa, oba olw’okusoma kwabwe oba omulimu gwe bakola. Mu bifo ebimu, abakkiriza ab’ebika by’obuzaale eby’enjawulo (caste) bakyagaana okuliira awamu oba okufumbiriganwa.
  • Obugagga. Okuwa abagagga ebifo ebisinga obulungi, ebifo by’obukulembeze n’ekigambo ekisembayo, kubanga be bagaba ssente ennyingi.
  • Ab’omu maka. Okukwasa batabani, bawala n’ab’oluganda obukulembeze bw’ekkanisa kubanga ba mu maka, so si kubanga Katonda yabayita n’abawa obusobozi.
  • Langi y’olususu. Okutwala abakkiriza aba langi emu oba ab’eggwanga erimu ng’abakulu okusinga abalala.

Peetero yalina okuyiga essomo lino mu ngeri enzibu. Katonda yamulaga mu kwolesebwa nti tasaanidde kuyita muntu yenna atali mulongoofu. Bwe yagenda mu nnyumba ya Koluneeriyo, Omumawanga, n’agamba nti, “Kaakano ntegeeredde ddala nga Katonda tasosola mu bantu, wabula ayaniriza abantu bonna ab’omu mawanga gonna kasita baba nga bamutya era nga bakola by’asiima” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 10:34-35). Naye oluvannyuma lw’emyaka, mu Antiyokiya, Peetero yeewala okuliira awamu n’abakkiriza Abamawanga, olw’okutya abalala bye bandirowoozezza. Pawulo agamba nti, “ne mmunenya mu lwatu kubanga yali mukyamu” (Abaggalatiya 2:11). N’abakulembeze abakulu basobola okuddayo mu kusosola. Kulina okulwanyisibwa emirundi n’emirundi.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Allen, Crowther ne Sabiti

Richard Allen, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 30, Obwenkanya, Okusaasira n’Abaavu, yali muddu eyafuna eddembe era omubuulizi Omumetodisiti mu Philadelphia. Abametodisiti Abaddugavu n’Abazungu baasinzizanga wamu mu Kkanisa ya St George’s, era abakkiriza Abaddugavu baali bawaddeyo ssente okugizimba. Naye Ssande emu, oboolyawo awo nga mu 1792, ne bagambibwa okutuula mu kifo ekya waggulu (gallery). Bwe baali bafukamidde nga basaba, omu ku bakwasaganya b’ekkanisa n’atandika okusika Absalom Jones okumugolokosa ku maviivi ge. Allen oluvannyuma yawandiika, nga The Fire on the Altar (Omuliro ku Kyoto) ekiri ku Ochorus bwe kiraga: “Mu kiseera ekyo okusaba kwali kuwedde, ne tufuluma ffenna mu kkanisa nga tuli kibinja kimu, era tebaddamu kutaawanyizibwa ffe mu kkanisa.” Allen yeeyongerayo n’atandika Ekkanisa ya Bethel, eyafuuka ekkanisa nnyina w’Ekkanisa ya African Methodist Episcopal. Ekkanisa eyagaana abakkiriza Abaddugavu okufukamira ku mabbali g’Abazungu yali eyonoonye eri omubiri gwa Kristo.

Samuel Ajayi Crowther, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 4, Okuyitibwa kwa Katonda, yafuuka omulabirizi Omufirika eyasooka mu Kkanisa ya Anglican mu 1864. Yakulembera omulimu gw’obuminsani ku mugga Niger okumala emyaka mingi. Naye ng’obulamu bwe bunaatera okuggwaako, mu 1890, ekibinja ky’abaminsani Abangereza abavubuka, abaali bamaze mu Afirika emyezi mitono gyokka, ne batandika okunenya abakozi b’ekkanisa Abafirika. Mu lukiiko e Onitsha, baayimiriza abaweereza Abafirika abawerako, abamu ku bo Crowther yennyini be yali ayawudde, nga mw’otwalidde ne mutabani we, ng’ate ye atudde awo. Samuel Ajayi Crowther: A Life (Obulamu bwa Samuel Ajayi Crowther), ekiri ku Ochorus, kinnyonnyola engeri omulabirizi omukadde “gye yayimuka ng’akankana okwegaana ebyali bikoleddwa.” Yasigala nga mulabirizi okutuusa lwe yafa omwaka ogwaddako. Naye obuyinza bwe bwali bumenyeddwa nnyo ab’oludda lwe bennyini. Ebimu ku bye baanenya biyinza okuba nga byalimu amazima. Naye engeri abavubuka abo gye beeyisaamu yalaga omwoyo ogw’okwetwala ng’eggwanga erisinga, ogwanakuwaza bangi, era ebyavaamu byamala emyaka mingi nga bikyakosa Ekkanisa mu Nigeria. Ekitabo ky’ebyafaayo bye kijuliza zabbuli: “Kubanga si mulabe eyanvuma; kale nandiyinzizza okukigumiikiriza.”

Erica Sabiti alaga ekkubo ery’okuwonya. Bwe yalondebwa mu 1966 okuba Ssaabalabirizi Omunnayuganda eyasooka ow’Ekkanisa ya Uganda, waaliwo okuwakanya okw’amaanyi. Yali Munyankore okuva mu bukiikaddyo-bugwanjuba, era abamu ne bakakasa nti Ssaabalabirizi ateekwa kuva mu Baganda. Ng’ekitabo Tukutendereza ekiri ku Ochorus bwe kigamba, “Enkaayana tezaali za njigiriza. Zaali za mawanga, nga za kivve, era ne zimala emyaka.” Ku nkomerero, abalabirizi ne bakuŋŋaana, era “abalabirizi omwenda ab’obulabirizi ne baatula ebibi ebyali bivuddeko okwawukana, oluvannyuma bonna wamu ne bakkiriza Erica nga Ssaabalabirizi waabwe.” Ekitabo kino kiggyamu essomo: “Enjawukana z’ekkanisa ezisinga obubi tezikwata ku njigiriza.” Era: “Okwatula kukola ne ku bitongole.” Mu byonna ebyo, Sabiti teyakuba kampeyini ku bamuwakanya wadde okwawulamu ekkanisa. Yalinda, n’aleka okwatula kujje.

Waliwo ekifo eri buli muweereza

Mu bwakabaka bwa Katonda mulimu ekifo eri buli muweereza gw’ayita. Ekisa tekibulawo, omulimu tegubulawo, n’empeera tebulawo. “… buli muntu n’alyoka atendebwa Katonda” (1 Abakkolinso 4:5). Obuwanguzi bw’omukulembeze omulala tebukuggyako kintu kyonna. Omukisa gw’eggwanga eddala tegukendeeza ku gugwo.

Sabira abakulembeze b’okwatirwa obuggya. Wa ekitiibwa abantu b’okemebwa okubuusa amaaso. Yaniriza ku mmeeza yo abo abalala be basindika mu kifo ekya waggulu. Era yogera ne Musa nti, “Kyandibadde kirungi singa abantu ba Mukama bonna bannabbi, ne Mukama Katonda n’abawa omwoyo gwe!”

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 1 Samwiri 18:6-9. Wali owuliddeko Sawulo bye yawulira ng’omuntu omulala atenderezebwa okukusinga? Wakola ki nabyo?
  • Soma Okubala 11:24-29 ne Makko 9:38-40. Lwaki kyangu nnyo okwekengera abo “abatayita naffe”?
  • Osobola okusanyuka ekkanisa endala oba omukulembeze omulala bw’aweebwa omukisa? Londa omukulembeze omu gw’oyinza okusabira n’okuwa ekitiibwa wiiki eno.
  • Ngeri ki ey’okusosola esinga okuba obulabe mu kkanisa yo oba mu kitundu kyo: eggwanga, ebika by’obuzaale, amadaala mu bantu, obugagga, ab’omu maka oba langi y’olususu?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga ku ebyo Crowther bye yayitamu mu 1890?
  • Abalabirizi ba Sabiti baawonya enjawukana ey’amawanga nga baatula omugabo gwabwe mu yo. Waliwo enjawukana mu kkanisa yo eyeetaaga ekintu kye kimu?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Lowooza ku mukulembeze omu oba ekkanisa emu gy’okwatirwa obuggya oba gy’ovuganya nayo. Bisabire buli lunaku wiiki eno ng’oyogera erinnya, ng’osaba Katonda abiwe omukisa n’okusingawo. Bw’oba osobola, bituukirire obizzeemu amaanyi. Oluvannyuma tunuulira mu bwesimbu ekkanisa yo: ani atuula mu bifo ebisinga obulungi, ani alina ebifo by’obukulembeze, era ani abuusibwa amaaso? Buuza abakulembeze banno obanga waliwo okusosola kwonna kwe mwetaaga okwatula n’okutereeza awamu.

study_questions.question: Obuggya bulumya butya abakulembeze?
study_questions.answer: “Omutima ogulina emirembe guwangaaza omuntu, naye obuggya buvunza amagumba ge” (Engero 14:30). Obuggya bwa Sawulo eri Dawudi bwatandika abakazi bwe baayimba nga batendereza Dawudi: “Awo okuva mu kiseera ekyo Sawulo n’akwatirwa Dawudi obuggya” (1 Samwiri 18:9).

study_questions.question: Musa yakola ki ku kuvuganya?
study_questions.answer: Yoswa bwe yayagala okuziyiza abalala okutegeeza obunnabbi, Musa yagamba nti, “Okwatiddwa obuggya ku lwange? Kyandibadde kirungi singa abantu ba Mukama bonna bannabbi” (Okubala 11:29). Ne Yesu bw’atyo yagamba nti, “Temumuziyizanga” (Makko 9:39).

study_questions.question: Yokaana Omubatiza yayigiriza ki ku kuvuganya?
study_questions.answer: Abagoberezi be bwe baamuvaako ne bagenda eri Yesu, Yokaana yagamba nti, “Omuntu tayinza kuba na kintu okuggyako nga kimuweereddwa okuva mu ggulu. … Kimugwanira ye okugulumizibwa naye nze okutoowazibwa” (Yokaana 3:27-30). Essuula eno era erabula ku kusosola olw’eggwanga, eddaala mu bantu oba obugagga.

fields.title: Ekiwuubaalo n’Emigugu Egikwekeddwa
fields.body_html:
“Mu kuwoza kwange okwasooka, tewaali n’omu yajja kubeera nange, bonna banjabulira. Nsaba Katonda ekyo kireme kubavunaanibwa. Kyokka Mukama waffe yabeera nange, n’ampa amaanyi.”

— 2 Timoseewo 4:16-17

Omusajja asitudde omugugu omuzito ku mutwe atambula mu katale. Abantu bamulamusa, bagula ku bibye era banyumya naye. Naye tewali n’omu ku bo ayinza kuwulira buzito obuli ku nsingo ye. Ye yekka y’amanyi obuzito bwagwo bwe bwenkana, ebbanga ly’amaze ng’agwetisse, n’olugendo olumusigaddeko.

Abakulembeze batera okwetikka emigugu ng’egyo. Beetooloddwa abantu, naye bawulira nga bali bokka. Bamanyi ebintu bye batayinza kubuulira balala: amaka agali mu buzibu, ekibi eky’ekyama mu kkanisa, okusalawo okuzibu, okutiisibwatiisibwa, enkaayana mu bakadde b’ekkanisa. Basuubirwa okuba ab’amaanyi, ab’amagezi era abasanyufu. Abantu bangi babeetaaga, naye batono ababuuza bwe bali. Essuula eno etandika Ekitundu eky’Omunaana: Okukulembera mu Bizibu. Tutandika n’ekiwuubaalo ky’obukulembeze n’emigugu egikwekeddwa abalala gye batalaba.

“Neeraliikirira buli lunaku nga ndowooza ku Kkanisa zonna”

Pawulo yawandiika okubonaabona kungi kwe yali ayiseemu ku lwa Kristo: okukubwa, ebyombo okumenyekera mu nnyanja, ekkomera, enjala, obulabe okuva eri abanyazi n’okuva eri abeeyita abooluganda (2 Abakkolinso 11:23-27). Oluvannyuma n’ayongerako ekintu ekyali oboolyawo kisinga byonna obuzibu: “Ebirala bye simenye nga nabyo bikyali awo, neeraliikirira buli lunaku nga ndowooza ku Kkanisa zonna nga bwe ziri. Bwe wabaawo anafuye, nange nzigwamu amaanyi, omulala bw’agwa mu kibi, nange njaka munda yange” (2 Abakkolinso 11:28-29).

Guno gwe mugugu ogukwekeddwa ogwa buli musumba ow’amazima. Gumunyigiriza “buli lunaku”. Abantu be twagala bwe bagwa mu kibi, twaka munda yaffe. Bwe banafuwa, tukiwulira. Abalala bayinza okuddayo eka oluvannyuma lw’olukuŋŋaana ne beerabira. Omukulembeze agwetikka n’atuuka nagwo mu kiro.

Pawulo ku nkomerero
