Ng’obulamu bwe bunaatera okuggwaako, Pawulo yawandiika ebbaluwa ye esembayo ng’ali mu kkomera e Rooma. Wuliriza ekiwuubaalo kye yalimu: “Fuba okujja amangu gye ndi. Kubanga Dema yandekawo ng’ayagala omulembe gwa kaakano, n’agenda e Sessaloniika. Kulesuke yagenda Ggalatiya ne Tito n’agenda e Dalumatiya. Lukka yekka y’ali nange” (2 Timoseewo 4:9-11). Yasaba Timoseewo amuleetere omunagiro gwe, kubanga obutiti bwali bujja, n’ebitabo bye (2 Timoseewo 4:13). Era n’agamba nti: “Mu kuwoza kwange okwasooka, tewaali n’omu yajja kubeera nange, bonna banjabulira” (2 Timoseewo 4:16).

Pawulo yali asimbye ekkanisa okubuna ensi y’Abaruumi. Enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu baali bakkirizza okuyita mu ye. Naye mu kuwozesebwa kwe, tewaali n’omu yayimirira naye. Naye weetegereze ebintu bibiri. Ekisooka, yasonyiwa: “Nsaba Katonda ekyo kireme kubavunaanibwa.” Eky’okubiri, yalaba nga Katonda mwesigwa: “Kyokka Mukama waffe yabeera nange, n’ampa amaanyi” (2 Timoseewo 4:17).

Ekiwuubaalo kya Yesu

Tewali muntu yali awuubadde nga Yesu. Ab’omu maka ge baalowooza nti alaluse (Makko 3:21). Ab’omu kibuga kye baamugaana. Abayigirizwa be emirundi mingi tebaamutegeera. Mu kiro nga tannafa, yatwala Peetero, Yakobo ne Yokaana mu nnimiro ya Gesusemane. “N’atandika okweraliikirira n’okuteganyizibwa mu mutima. N’abagamba nti, ‘Omwoyo gwange guliko ennaku nnyingi nnyo zaagala na kunzita, kale mubeere wano mukuume’” (Makko 14:33-34). Yasaba mikwano gye egy’okumpi okubeera naye. Emirundi esatu yakomawo n’abasanga nga beebase. “Simooni! Weebase? Tosobodde kutunulako nange wadde essaawa emu?” (Makko 14:37). Era abaserikale bwe bajja, “Bonna ne bamwabulira ne badduka” (Makko 14:50).

Yesu yali yakyogerako dda: “mwenna lwe munaasaasaana buli omu n’addayo ku bibye, ne mundeka nzekka. Kyokka sijja kuba nzekka, kubanga Kitange ali wamu nange” (Yokaana 16:32). Oluvannyuma, ku musaalaba, yayita ne mu kiwuubaalo eky’okulekebwa Katonda, bwe yali yeetisse ekibi kyaffe.

Kino kitegeeza nti tewali kiwuubaalo kya mukulembeze Yesu ky’atayinza kutegeera. Amanyi bwe kiba okwetoolooddwa ebibiina by’abantu naye nga tewali n’omu akutegeera. Amanyi bwe kiba okuswazibwa mikwano. Era kubanga yalekebwa, asobola okutusuubiza nti: “Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono” (Abaebbulaniya 13:5).

Lwaki abakulembeze bawuubaala

Abakulembeze bawuubaala olw’ensonga nnyingi. Okuzimanya kiyinza okuyamba.

  • Emigugu egy’ekyama. Abakulembeze bawulira ebyama bye balina okukuuma. Tebayinza kubibuulira balala, wadde mikwano gyabwe egy’okumpi ennyo.
  • Okusalawo. Ku nkomerero, omuntu omu alina okusalawo. Okusalawo bwe kuba okuzibu, oyo asalawo atera okuyimirira yekka.
  • Okuvumirirwa. Abantu bwe batasanyuka, omukulembeze y’atera okuteekebwako omusango.
  • Ebbanga wakati we n’abalala. Abantu abamu bayisa abakulembeze mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Beegendereza bye boogera. Bateeka omukulembeze ku kituuti waggulu, era waggulu eyo waba wa kiwuubaalo.
  • Ebisuubirwa. Abakulembeze bangi balowooza nti bulijjo balina okulabika ng’ab’amaanyi, n’olwekyo ne bakweka okulwana kwabwe.
  • Okusenguka. Abaminsani n’abasumba abasengukira mu bifo ebipya baleka emabega mikwano gyabwe n’ab’omu maka gaabwe.
  • Bbugwe gwe beezimbira. Abakulembeze abamu bawuubaala kubanga tebakkiriza muntu yenna kubasemberera. Amalala, okutya oba ebiwundu eby’emabega bibaleetera okukuuma buli muntu wala.

Eriya, oluvannyuma lw’obuwanguzi bwe obunene ku Lusozi Kalumeeri, yaddukira mu ddungu n’agamba nti, “Nze nsigaddewo nzekka” (1 Bassekabaka 19:10). Kyali kiwulikika ng’amazima, naye tekyali bwe kityo. Katonda n’amugamba nti, “Wabula nesigaliza akasanvu mu Isirayiri, abatavuunamiranga Baali wadde okumunywegera” (1 Bassekabaka 19:18). Ekiwuubaalo kitera okutugamba nti tuli bokka okusinga bwe tuli mu mazima. Tujja kwongera okutunuulira Eriya mu ssuula eddako, Essuula 38, Okuggwaamu Amaanyi n’Okukoowa Ennyo.

Okuleeta ekiwuubaalo eri Katonda

Bayibuli etuwa ebigambo eby’okwogera mu kiwuubaalo kyaffe. Dawudi yasaba ng’ali mu mpuku nga yeekweka Sawulo: “Bwe ntunula ku mukono gwange ogwa ddyo, sirabayo anambeera; sirina wa kwekweka, era tewali n’omu anfaako. Nkaabirira ggwe, Ayi Mukama, nga ŋŋamba nti, ‘Ggwe kiddukiro kyange, ggwe mugabo gwange mu nsi muno’” (Zabbuli 142:4-5). Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli omulala yasaba nti, “Nkyukira, Ayi Mukama, onkwatirwe ekisa, kubanga nsigadde bw’omu, era ndi munafu” (Zabbuli 25:16).

Zabbuli 88 y’emu ku ssaala ezisinga okubaamu ekizikiza mu Bayibuli. Ekomekkerezebwa nga temuli kubudaabudibwa n’akatono: “Ommazeeko ab’emikwano n’abo abanjagala ennyo; nsigazza nzikiza yokka” (Zabbuli 88:18). Kirabo kinene nti zabbuli eno eri mu Bayibuli. Etutegeeza nti Katonda tanyiiga olw’ekizikiza kyaffe kye tumubuulira mu bwesimbu. Tuyinza okukimuleetera nga bwe kiri.

Era Katonda addamu. “Totya kubanga nze ndi wamu naawe; tokeŋŋentererwa, kubanga nze Katonda wo. Nnaakuwanga amaanyi. Wewaawo nnaakuyambanga” (Isaaya 41:10). “Kitange ne mmange bwe balindeka, Mukama anandabiriranga” (Zabbuli 27:10).

Okukkiriza abalala okukusemberera

Katonda ye munno asooka. Naye era atuwa n’abantu. “Katonda afunira abatalina we babeera ekifo eky’okubeeramu” (Zabbuli 68:6). Ne Yesu yayagala mikwano gye babeere kumpi naye mu Gesusemane. Pawulo yeegayirira Timoseewo ajje. Omukulembeze tafuuka wa mwoyo nnyo olw’okuba nga talina mikwano.

Dawudi bwe yali ayigganyizibwa Sawulo nga yeekwese mu ddungu, “Awo Yonasaani mutabani wa Sawulo n’agenda eri Dawudi mu kibira, Kolesi, okumugumya mu Mukama” (1 Samwiri 23:16). Buli mukulembeze yeetaaga Yonasaani: mukwano gwe ajja, era amuyamba okufuna amaanyi mu Katonda.

Zino ze ngeri ezimu ez’okulwanyisa ekiwuubaalo.

  • Beera mwesimbu eri Katonda ku ngeri gy’owuliramu, ng’okozesa zabbuli.
  • Funa mikwano egy’amazima emu oba ebiri gy’oyinza okubeera nagyo omwesimbu ddala. “… wabaawo ow’omukwano akwagala ennyo okusinga owooluganda” (Engero 18:24). Emirundi mingi bano baba bantu ab’ebweru w’ekkanisa yo, ng’abasumba abalala oba abakulembeze mu kibuga ekiriraanyewo.
  • Sisinkananga abakulembeze abalala buli kiseera, okusaba awamu n’okugabana emigugu. Ebibinja by’abasumba bingi biwonyezza abakulembeze okuggwaamu essuubi.
  • Kkiriza munno mu bufumbo okukusemberera, bw’oba ng’oli mufumbo, nga bwe kiba eky’amagezi. Toyetikka byonna wekka awaka.
  • Kkiriza obuyambi. “Muyambaganenga” (Abaggalatiya 6:2). Ekyo kitegeeza n’okukkiriza abalala okukuyamba okwetikka emigugu gyo.
  • Jjukira akasanvu. Oli mu maka amanene ag’abakkiriza mu nsi yonna ne mu byafaayo byonna.
  • Noonya obuyambi ekiwuubaalo bwe kifuuka ekizikiza. Bw’owulira ng’oggwaamu essuubi okumala ebbanga eddene, yogera n’omuntu gw’oyinza okwesiga, era bwe kiba kisoboka, n’omuntu atendekeddwa mu kubudaabuda abantu oba omusawo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: David Brainerd ne David Livingstone

David Brainerd, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 19, Okunoonya Abaabula, yamala omwaka gwe ogwasooka ng’omuminsani mu 1743 mu kifo ekiyitibwa Kaunaumeek, mu bibira bya New York, ng’abeera yekka mu kayumba akatali kalungi mu bantu enzaaliranwa be yaweerezanga. Ebiwandiiko bye eby’olunaku ku lunaku, ebiri ku Ochorus, biraga ekiwuubaalo kye mu bwesimbu:

“Embeera yange eri bw’eti nti sirina kubudaabudibwa kwa ngeri yonna, okuggyako kwe nnina mu Katonda. Mbeera mu ddungu erisingayo okuwuubaaza; nnina omuntu omu yekka gwe nnyinza okunyumya naye ayogera Olungereza … Sirina Mukristaayo munnange gwe nnyinza okubikkulira omutima gwange, oba okumulaga ennaku zange ez’omwoyo; gwe nnyinza okuteesa naye mu ssanyu nga tunyumya ku bintu eby’omu ggulu, n’okwegatta naye mu kusaba awamu.”

— David Brainerd, ebiwandiiko bye, nga 18 Ogwokutaano 1743

Mu bigambo ebyangu: wano sirina kubudaabudibwa okuggyako Katonda. Mbeera mu ddungu ery’ekiwuubaalo ennyo. Omuntu omu yekka wano y’ayogera olulimi lwange. Sirina mukwano gwange Omukristaayo gwe nnyinza kubikkulira mutima gwange, kugabana naye okulwana kwange okw’omwoyo, kunyumya naye ku Katonda, oba kusaba naye. Weetegereze Brainerd kye yasinga okwetaaga: si mmere ennungi oba kitanda kirungi, newaakubadde nga yali talina na kimu ku ebyo, wabula mukwano gwe Omukristaayo okusaba naye. Naye era weetegereze sentensi esooka. Yalina okubudaabudibwa mu Katonda, era ekyo kyamuyisa mu byonna.

David Livingstone yali musawo era muminsani Omuskootilandi eyatambula mu bitundu bingi eby’Obukiikaddyo n’eby’Amasekkati ga Afirika mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omwenda. Yamala emyaka mingi nga yeeyawudde ku mukyala we Mary n’abaana baabwe, emirundi mingi ng’ali mu bulabe ne mu bulwadde. Mu 1862, ku nkomerero, Mary n’amwegattako ku mugga Zambezi. Okumala wiiki ntono, baddamu okubeera awamu. Awo n’akwatibwa omusujja n’afa, mu kifo ekiyitibwa Shupanga, nga 27 Ogwokuna 1862. David Livingstone: A Life (Obulamu bwa David Livingstone), ekiri ku Ochorus, kinyumya nti yawandiika mu biwandiiko bye nti yali alekeddwa yekka mu nsi oyo gwe yali awulira ng’ekitundu ku ye yennyini, era nti omulundi gwe ogwasooka mu bulamu bwe yawulira ng’ayagala okufa. Teyafiirwa kukkiriza kwe. Ebiwandiiko bye byali bijjudde okusaba n’essuubi ery’eggulu. Naye era byali bijjudde ennaku eyali tetaagala kubudaabudibwa mangu.

Emboozi ya Livingstone era kulabula. Ekitabo ky’ebyafaayo bye kiraga omusajja eyali awaddeyo bingi ku lw’Enjiri, naye era emirundi mingi eyaleka ab’omu maka ge nga beetisse ekiwuubaalo ekinene ekyabwe bo. Tujja kulowooza ku maka g’omukulembeze mu Ssuula 42, Amaka g’Omukulembeze.

Toli wekka

Pawulo, eyalekebwa yekka mu kuwozesebwa kwe, yawandiika nti, “Kyokka Mukama waffe yabeera nange, n’ampa amaanyi.” Yesu, eyalekebwa mikwano gye, yagamba nti, “Kyokka sijja kuba nzekka, kubanga Kitange ali wamu nange.” Brainerd, eyali yekka mu kibira, yawandiika nti yali talina kubudaabudibwa “okuggyako kwe nnina mu Katonda.”

Bw’oba ng’oli mukulembeze awuubadde, oli mu kibinja kirungi. Leeta ekiwuubaalo kyo eri Katonda. Kkiriza abantu omu oba babiri okukusemberera. Twala emigugu gyo egikwekeddwa eri Oyo akwetikka. Era jjukira nti Omusumba Omulungi, eyalekebwa yekka ku lulwo, yasuubiza obutakuleka wekka n’akatono.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 2 Abakkolinso 11:28-29. Migugu ki gy’owetikka “buli lunaku” abalala gye batalaba?
  • Soma 2 Timoseewo 4:9-18. Pawulo yakola ki bwe yalekebwa?
  • Ensonga ki ku ezo ezireetera abakulembeze okuwuubaala ezikukwatako ggwe?
  • Ani akumanyi nga bw’oli ddala? Wali okkirizza omuntu yenna okukusemberera?
  • Ani Yonasaani wo? Ggwe oyinza kuba Yonasaani w’ani?
  • Soma Zabbuli 142 mu ddoboozi ng’essaala yo ggwe. Kiki ky’oyagala okugamba Katonda ku kiwuubaalo kyo?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno, wandiika emigugu gy’owetisse nga tewali muntu mulala agimanyi, era osabe ng’oyita mu lukalala olwo ng’okozesa Zabbuli 142. Oluvannyuma tuukirira omukulembeze omu mu kkanisa endala oba mu kibuga ekirala gw’oyinza okwesiga era gw’owa ekitiibwa. Musabe musisinkane mulye emmere oba mutambule ebbanga eddene. Mubuulire mu bwesimbu bw’oli, era omubuuze bw’ali. Musabire wamu, era mukkiriziganye okuddamu okusisinkana.

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze Abakristaayo batera okuwuubaala?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga beetikka emigugu gye batayinza kubuulira buli muntu, ekifo kyabwe kiyinza okubaawula ku balala, era abamu basanga okuziyizibwa nga bali bokka. Pawulo yawandiika nti “neeraliikirira buli lunaku nga ndowooza ku Kkanisa zonna” (2 Abakkolinso 11:28), era n’agamba nti, “bonna banjabulira” (2 Timoseewo 4:16).

study_questions.question: Yesu yawuubaala?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Mu Gesusemane yagamba nti, “Omwoyo gwange guliko ennaku nnyingi nnyo zaagala na kunzita” (Makko 14:34), era mikwano gye ne beebaka. Amanyi ekiwuubaalo ky’obukulembeze okuva munda.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze awuubadde ayinza kukola ki?
study_questions.answer: Okukireeta eri Katonda, abeera okumpi, nga Pawulo bwe yakizuula: “Kyokka Mukama waffe yabeera nange, n’ampa amaanyi” (2 Timoseewo 4:17). Oluvannyuma akkirize mikwano egy’okwesigibwa okumusemberera. Essuula eno eyigira ku David Brainerd ne David Livingstone.

fields.title: Okuggwaamu Amaanyi n’Okukoowa Ennyo
fields.body_html:
“Awa amaanyi abazirika, n’oyo atalina buyinza amwongerako amaanyi.”

— Isaaya 40:29

Ettaala ey’amafuta esobola okwaka ekiro kyonna. Naye bwe wataba agiteekamu mafuta, ennimi z’omuliro zigenda zikendeera. Eyinza okumyukamyuka okumala ebbanga ddene, ng’ewa omusana omutono buli kaseera, okutuusa lw’ezikira. Tewali yagifuuwa. Amafuta gaagigwaamu bugwi.

Abakulembeze bangi baggwaamu amaanyi mu ngeri eno. Tebagwa mu kibi kinene. Tebalekera awo kukkiriza. Bakoowa bukoowi, oluvannyuma ne baddirira, oluvannyuma ne basigala nga bakalu. Beeyongera okukola ebyo bye bamanyidde, naye essanyu lyabaggwaamu. Abamu tebeebaka kiro. Abamu tebasobola kusaba. Abamu basalawo mu kasirise okuva mu buweereza. Abamu bagwa mu kizikiza ekiwulira ng’ekitaliggwaawo. Essuula eno etunuulira okuggwaamu amaanyi n’okukoowa ennyo, era n’engeri Katonda gy’asisinkanamu abaweereza be ng’ettaala kumpi ezikidde.

Eriya wansi w’omwoloola

Eriya yali yaakalaba obuwanguzi obusinga obunene mu bulamu bwe. Ku Lusozi Kalumeeri, omuliro gwali guvudde mu ggulu ne gugwa, abantu ne bakaaba nti, “Mukama, ye Katonda!” (1 Bassekabaka 18:39). Awo obubaka ne buva eri Nnaabakyala Yezeberi: essaawa nga zino enkya ojja kuba ofudde. Nnabbi oyo omuzira n’amenyeka.

“Eriya n’atya nnyo, n’adduka okuwonya obulamu bwe. … n’atuuka awali omwoloola, n’atuula wansi waagwo, n’asaba afe. N’ayogera nti, ‘Kino kimala, Mukama, kaakano twala obulamu bwange, kubanga sisinga bajjajjange’” (1 Bassekabaka 19:3-4).

Laba obubonero bw’okukoowa ennyo mu Eriya. Yali akooye nnyo oluvannyuma lw’olutalo oluwanvu. Yali atidde. Yadduka n’ava ku buli muntu, n’aleka n’omuweereza we. Yawulira nga yalemereddwa: “sisinga bajjajjange.” Yayagala okufa. Era yakkiriza nti yali asigadde yekka ddala: “Nze nsigaddewo nzekka” (1 Bassekabaka 19:10). Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 37, Ekiwuubaalo n’Emigugu Egikwekeddwa, ekyo tekyali kituufu. Naye yawulira nga kituufu.

Weetegereze ddi lwe kyabaawo. Tekyajja oluvannyuma lw’okuwangulwa, wabula oluvannyuma lw’obuwanguzi obunene. Abakulembeze bangi bakizuula nti ennaku ezisinga okuba enzibu zijja oluvannyuma lw’omukolo omunene: oluvannyuma lw’enkuŋŋaana ez’enjiri, okuggulawo ekizimbe, olukuŋŋaana olunene. Omubiri n’emmeeme bibadde biddukira ku maanyi mangi, era bwe biggwa, ne bigwa wansi.

Katonda bwe yalabirira Eriya

Mu Ssuula 15, Okuwummula, Okwawukana ku Balala, n’Enteekateeka y’Obulamu, twalaba ekitundu ekisooka eky’okuddamu kwa Katonda. Teyanenya Eriya. Yamuleka ne yeebaka. Yamutumira malayika n’omugaati n’amazzi, n’amugamba nti, “Golokoka olye, kubanga olugendo lunene” (1 Bassekabaka 19:7). Katonda yali amanyi nti omuweereza we yali mubiri era emmeeme. “Kubanga amanyi nga bwe twakolebwa era ng’ajjukira nti tuli nfuufu” (Zabbuli 103:14).

Naye Katonda teyakoma awo. Eriya bwe yamala okuwummula, Katonda yamutwala ku Lusozi Kolebu, olusozi kwe yayogerera ne Musa. Eyo Katonda yamubuuza ekibuuzo: “Okola ki wano, Eriya?” (1 Bassekabaka 19:9). Yaleka Eriya n’ayiwa okwemulugunya kwe kwonna. Oluvannyuma Katonda ne yeeraga. “Embuyaga nnyingi ey’amaanyi n’emenya ensozi … naye Mukama nga taliimu. Oluvannyuma lw’embuyaga, musisi ow’amaanyi n’ayita naye era Mukama nga taliimu. Oluvannyuma lwa musisi ne wajja omuliro, naye era Mukama teyaliimu mu muliro. Oluvannyuma lw’omuliro, ne wajja eddoboozi ttono nga lya ggonjebwa” (1 Bassekabaka 19:11-12). Bayibuli endala ziyita eddoboozi eryo “eddoboozi ettono erikkakkamu” oba “okwogera okw’akasirise”.

Eriya yali alabye Katonda mu muliro ku Kalumeeri. Kaakano yali yeetaaga okuyiga nti Katonda abeerawo ne mu kasirise. Omukulembeze akooye si buli kiseera nti yeetaaga omukolo omulala omunene. Emirundi mingi yeetaaga okuddamu okuwulira eddoboozi lya Katonda eriweweevu.

Ku nkomerero, Katonda yawa Eriya omulimu ogw’okukola, n’omubeezi. Yamugamba nti, “Ddirayo mu kkubo lye wajjiddemu,” n’amulagira okufuka amafuta ku bakabaka abaggya, “ate era ofuke n’amafuta ku Erisa mutabani wa Safati ow’e Aberumekola okudda mu kifo kyo” (1 Bassekabaka 19:15-16). Era yamubuulira amazima: waaliwo abalala akasanvu abaali basigadde nga beesigwa (1 Bassekabaka 19:18).

Bw’atyo Katonda yazzaawo Eriya mu ngeri nnya:

  • Okuwummula n’emmere olw’omubiri gwe.
  • Okubeerawo kwe, mu ddoboozi eriweweevu, olw’emmeeme ye.
  • Amazima, okutereeza obulimba nti yali yekka.
  • Ekigendererwa ekiggya n’omubeezi, aleme kuddamu kwetikka mulimu yekka.

Si ggwe osoose

Eriya si ye yekka omuweereza wa Katonda eyatuuka ku nkomerero y’amaanyi ge. Musa yakaabirira Katonda nti, “Sisobola kusitula bantu bano bonna bw’omu kubanga obuzito bwabwe buyinza okummenya nga ndi nzekka. Obanga bw’otyo bw’ojja okumpisa, ate nga bulijjo ondaga ekisa kyo, kale nno nzitiraawo kaakano” (Okubala 11:14-15). Yeremiya, eyasekererwa n’akubibwa olw’okubuulira ekigambo kya Katonda, yakolimira olunaku lwe yazaalibwako (Yeremiya 20:14). Yona, ng’anyiize era ng’akooye wansi w’omusana, yasaba afe (Yona 4:8).

Ne Pawulo yennyini yawandiika nti, “okubonaabona kwe twayitamu mu Asiya kwali kungi ekiyitiridde n’essuubi ery’okuba abalamu ne lituggwaamu” (2 Abakkolinso 1:8). Kyokka n’ayongerako nti ekyo kyabaawo “nga tetusaanidde kwetekamu bwesige bwaffe ffe, wabula mu Katonda azuukiza abafu” (2 Abakkolinso 1:9).

Bayibuli tekweka biseera bino. Eyogera amazima ku bunafu bw’abaweereza ba Katonda abasinga obukulu. Kino kibudaabuda. Bw’oba ng’oweddemu amaanyi oba ng’oli mukalu, toli Mukristaayo eyalemererwa. Oyimiridde we baayimirira edda Musa, Eriya, Yeremiya ne Pawulo.

Okwogera n’emmeeme yo

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli 42 ne 43 yali aweddemu nnyo amaanyi. Yajjukira ennaku lwe yakulemberanga ebibiina okusinza, ate kaakano ng’awulira ali wala ne Katonda. Yawandiika nti, “Amaziga gange gabadde emmere yange emisana n’ekiro” (Zabbuli 42:3). Naye yakola ekintu eky’amagezi. Yatandika okwogera n’emmeeme ye: “Lwaki oweddemu amaanyi ggwe emmeeme yange? Lwaki otabusetabuse mu nda yange? Essuubi lyo liteeke mu Katonda, kubanga natenderezanga omulokozi wange era Katonda wange; ye mubeezi wange” (Zabbuli 42:5).

Ebigambo bino abyogera emirundi esatu (Zabbuli 42:5, 42:11 ne 43:5). Teyeefuula nti musanyufu. Akkiriza nti emmeeme ye “eweddemu amaanyi”. Naye agaana okuleka enneewulira ze okuba nga ze zisembayo okwogera. Agamba emmeeme ye okussa essuubi lyayo mu Katonda.

Abakulembeze abaweddemu amaanyi batera okuwuliriza enneewulira zaabwe: “Walemererwa. Tewali kyakyuka. Katonda akwerabidde. Lekera awo.” Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli atuyigiriza okuziddamu n’amazima ga Katonda. Ne Pawulo yakola bw’atyo: “Noolwekyo tetuterebuka, kubanga newaakubadde ng’emibiri gyaffe gifa, naye omuntu waffe ow’omunda adda buggya bulijjo. Kubanga okubonaabona kwaffe okutono okw’ekiseera ekya kaakano, kwongerayongera nnyo okututeekerateekera ekitiibwa eky’amaanyi eky’emirembe n’emirembe” (2 Abakkolinso 4:16-17).

Ebibya eby’ebbumba

Pawulo atuwa ekifaananyi buli mukulembeze akooye ky’yeetaaga: “Naye kaakano tulina ekyobugagga kino mu bibya eby’ebbumba, okulaga nti obuyinza bwonna bwa Katonda, so si bwaffe. Tunyigirizibwa erudda n’erudda, naye ne tutabetenteka. Ne tweraliikirira, naye ne tutazirika. Tuyigganyizibwa, naye Katonda tatuleka. Tusuulibwa wansi, naye ne tutabetentuka” (2 Abakkolinso 4:7-9).

Ekibya eky’ebbumba kya bulijjo, kyangu okumenyeka era kyangu okwatika. Katonda yasalawo okuteeka ekyobugagga ky’Enjiri mu bibya ebiri bwe bityo, mu bantu abanafu era aba bulijjo nga ffe. Lwaki? Buli muntu alyoke alabe nti obuyinza buva eri Katonda so si eri ffe. Obunafu bwaffe si nsobi mu nteekateeka ya Katonda. Kitundu ku nteekateeka ye.

Era Katonda mukwatampola eri ebibya ebyatise. Isaaya yayogera ku Muweereza eyali ajja, Yesu, nti: “Talimenya lumuli lubetentefu oba okuzikiza olutambi olwaka empola ennyo” (Isaaya 42:3). Ettaala yo bw’eba ng’eyaka kitono nnyo, Yesu tajja kugizikiza. Ajja kugirabirira. Akyagamba nti, “Mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, nange nnaabawummuza” (Matayo 11:28).

Lwaki abakulembeze bakoowa ennyo

Okuggwaamu amaanyi kuyinza okuva mu njuyi nnyingi. Kiyamba okumanya gye kuva.

  • Okukola ennyo okusukkiridde. Yesero yagamba Musa nti, “Ggwe, n’abantu bano bonna abajja gy’oli, mujja kukoowa nnyo. Kubanga omulimu guno munene nnyo; tosobola kugukola bw’omu” (Okuva 18:18). Abakulembeze bangi bagezaako okukola buli kimu bokka.
  • Obutawummula. Abakulembeze abatawummula lunaku na lumu, abateebaka kimala era abatagenda ku luwummula, lumu bajja kumenyeka. “Oteganira bwereere bw’okeera mu makya n’okola, ate n’olwawo n’okwebaka ng’okolerera ekyokulya; kubanga Mukama abaagalwa be abawa otulo” (Zabbuli 127:2).
  • Obutalaba bibala. Emyaka egy’okukola nga tolaba kinene kivuddemu giyinza okumalamu amaanyi omutima ogusinga okuba omugumu.
  • Enkaayana n’okuvumirirwa. Okuziyizibwa obutasalako kumalamu emmeeme amaanyi. Kino twakitunuulira mu Ssuula 25, Okuvumirirwa, Okuziyizibwa n’Enkaayana.
  • Ennaku n’okufiirwa. Abakulembeze beetikka ennaku zaabwe bo, era n’ez’abantu abalala.
  • Obwavu. Abasumba bangi mu nsi balwana nnyo okuliisa amaka gaabwe. Okweraliikirira olw’ensimbi kukooya omubiri n’ebirowoozo.
  • Ekibi ekikwekeddwa oba obutakkiriza. Oluusi obukalu buva mu kibi ekikwekeddwa, oba mu kugezaako okuweereza mu maanyi gaffe ffe so si mu ga Katonda.
  • Obulwadde. Ekizikiza ekimu kiva mu mubiri. Obwennyamivu (depression) bulwadde bwa ddala, so si kubulwa kukkiriza kwokka.

Amadaala agakuzza mu maanyi

“Kale tulemenga okuterebuka mu kukola obulungi, kubanga oluvannyuma tulikungula emikisa, bwe tutaggwaamu maanyi” (Abaggalatiya 6:9). Omukulembeze aweddemu amaanyi ayinza atya okugenda mu maaso, oba okuddamu okutandika?

  • Labirira omubiri gwo. Weebake, olye, otambule era owummule, nga Eriya bwe yakola. Kino si kubulwa mwoyo. Kuwulira Katonda.
  • Buulira Katonda amazima. Saba zabbuli ez’okukungubaga. Katonda asobola okugumira obwesimbu bwo.
  • Buulira omuntu omulala. Tokikweka. Yogera ne mukwano gwo gw’oyesiga, munno mu bufumbo, oba omukulembeze akuze mu mwoyo. Okukoowa ennyo kukulira mu kyama.
  • Gabana omugugu. Leka abalala bakole ku mulimu. Si ggwe Masiya. Kino twakiraba mu Ssuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu.
  • Funa ekiseera ekimala eky’okuwummula. Bw’oba osobola, weewummuze okumala ekiseera. Oluusi omukulembeze yeetaaga wiiki oba emyezi, so si lunaku lumu.
  • Jjukira lwaki watandika. Ddamu osome emboozi y’okuyitibwa kwo. Jjukira abantu abazze eri Kristo.
  • Funa obuyambi bw’abasawo. Bw’owulira nga tolina ssuubi okumala wiiki nnyingi, nga tosobola kwebaka, nga tosobola kukola bya bulijjo, oba ng’olina ebirowoozo eby’okwetta, nkwegayiridde yogera n’omusawo oba omuwabuzi amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka. Okunoonya obuyambi si kubulwa kukkiriza. Bw’oba ng’oli mu kabi, buulira omuntu leero.
  • Lindirira Katonda. “Naye abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe, balitumbiira n’ebiwaawaatiro ng’empungu; balidduka mbiro ne batakoowa, balitambula naye ne batazirika” (Isaaya 40:31).

Era bw’oba ng’okulembera abakulembeze abalala, balabirire. Babuuze bwe bali ddala. Kakasa nti bawummula. Bayambe nga balina obuzibu. Omukulembeze akooye tomutwala ng’omunafu.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Charles Spurgeon ne Hudson Taylor

Charles Spurgeon, omubuulizi omukulu ow’omu London gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 9, Mwekuume Mwekka, yabonaabona n’obwennyamivu obw’amaanyi okumala ekitundu ekinene eky’obulamu bwe. Era yabonaabona n’obulwadde obw’obulumi, era mu 1856, bwe yali ng’alina emyaka amakumi abiri mu ebiri gyokka, mu kumu ku kusinza kwe, omuntu yalekaana nti omuliro gukutte so nga si bwe kyali, ne wabaawo okuwagala mu bantu, abantu musanvu ne bafa. Okumala ekiseera oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, ennaku yali kumpi emubetenta.

Spurgeon teyakweka bizibu bye eri abayizi be. Yabawa omusomo oguyitibwa “The Minister’s Fainting Fits” (Omuweereza Bw’Aggwaamu Amaanyi), oguli mu kitabo kye Lectures to My Students (Emboozi eri Abayizi Bange) ku Ochorus. Yatandika n’obwesimbu:

“Ebiseera eby’okwennyamira bitujjira ffenna kumpi. Ne bwe tuba nga bulijjo tuli basanyufu, tulina okugwa wansi mu mwoyo oluusi n’oluusi. Ab’amaanyi si buli kiseera nti balina amaanyi, ab’amagezi si buli kiseera nti beetegefu, abazira si buli kiseera nti bavumu, n’abasanyufu si buli kiseera nti basanyufu.”

— C. H. Spurgeon, “The Minister’s Fainting Fits”

Mu bigambo ebyangu: abasinga obungi mu ffe tuyita mu biseera eby’obwennyamivu. Ne abantu abasanyufu oluusi bagwa wansi mu mwoyo. Abantu ab’amaanyi, ab’amagezi, abazira n’abasanyufu si buli kiseera nti baba ba maanyi, ba magezi, bazira era basanyufu.

Yababuulira nti kino kyali kimutuseeko ku ntandikwa ddala ey’omulimu gwe mu London, ebibiina ebinene bwe byatandika okujja. Yagamba nti, “Obuwanguzi bwange bwantiisa,” era nti “bwansuula mu buziba obusingayo wansi.” Yalowooza n’okudduka agende mu kyalo ekitono. Era yabalabula, nga Yesu bwe yakola, nti baali beetaaga okuwummula: “Omutego gw’obusaale tegusobola kuleegebwa buli kiseera nga tewali kutya nti gujja kumenyeka. Okuwummula kwetaagisa eri ebirowoozo nga otulo bwe kwetaagisa eri omubiri.”

Yamaliriza omusomo n’ebigambo eby’essuubi eri abo abali mu kizikiza:

“Amaanyi g’obwennyamivu bwe gaba nga gasusse aga bulijjo, tolowooza nti omugaso gwo gwonna guweddewo … Beera mulamu olunaku ku lunaku—weewaawo, essaawa ku ssaawa. Teweesiga nneeyisa na nneewulira. Faayo nnyo ku kaweke k’okukkiriza okusinga ttani y’okucamuka.”

— C. H. Spurgeon, “The Minister’s Fainting Fits”

Mu bigambo ebyangu: obwennyamivu bwo bwe buba obw’amaanyi ennyo, tolowooza nti Katonda takyasobola kukukozesa. Beera mulamu lunaku lumu lumu, wadde essaawa emu emu. Teweesiga mbeera z’omwoyo gwo na nneewulira zo. Akatono ak’okukkiriza okwa ddala kasinga omuwendo okucamuka okungi ennyo. Spurgeon, omubuulizi eyasinga okumanyika mu mulembe gwe, yali kibya kya bbumba, era Katonda yamukozesa okumala emyaka kumpi amakumi ana.

James Hudson Taylor, eyatandikawo ekibiina China Inland Mission, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 5, Ekiremba n’Ebbensani, yatuuka ku nkomerero y’amaanyi ge mu 1869. Ekibiina kyali kiyise mu bujagalalo, mu kuvumirirwa ne mu nkaayana. Yali akooye nnyo, era ng’aweddemu nnyo amaanyi olw’okulemererwa kwe yennyini mu by’omwoyo. Yalowooza n’okulekera awo. Awo ebbaluwa n’ejja okuva eri munne omuto, John McCarthy. Ng’ekitabo kya Ochorus Key Teachings of Hudson Taylor (Enjigiriza Enkulu za Hudson Taylor) bwe kinnyonnyola, abaawandiika ebyafaayo bya Taylor bawandiika obubaka bwayo: ekkubo ery’okugenda mu maaso teryali kufuba nnyo okunoonya okukkiriza, wabula okwesigama ku Oyo Omwesigwa. Taylor yategeera nti teyalina kwetikka kibiina mu maanyi ge ye. Kristo ye yandikyetisse, era n’amwetikka ne ye. Kino kyakyusa obulamu bwe bwonna obwaddirira. Ennaku enzibu zaali zikyali mu maaso, nga mw’otwalidde n’okufa kwa mukyala we Maria omwaka ogwaddirira. Naye yazisisinkana ng’ali mu kuwummula.

Ettaala eddamu okujjuzibwa

Eriya yagalamira wansi w’omwoloola n’asaba afe. Naye emboozi ye teyakoma awo. Katonda yamuliisa, n’amusisinkana, n’amubuulira amazima, era n’amuwa Erisa. Oluvannyuma, Eriya yatwalibwa mu ggulu mu kibuyaga, era omulimu gwe ne gugenda mu maaso mu oyo gwe yali atendese.

Bw’oba ng’oweddemu amaanyi, n’emboozi yo tennaggwa. Katonda “awa amaanyi abazirika” takwerabidde. Wummula. Mubuulire amazima. Leka abalala bakuyambe. Era mulindirire, kubanga abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe. “Okufuba kwammwe si kwa bwereere mu Mukama waffe” (1 Abakkolinso 15:58).

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 1 Bassekabaka 19:1-18. Bubonero ki obw’okukoowa ennyo obwali mu Eriya bw’olaba mu ggwe?
  • Katonda yazzaawo Eriya ng’ayita mu kuwummula, mu kubeerawo kwe, mu mazima ne mu mubeezi. Kiki ku bino ky’osinga okwetaaga kaakano?
  • Soma Zabbuli 42. “Okwogera n’emmeeme yo” kifaanana kitya?
  • Soma 2 Abakkolinso 4:7-18. Ekifaananyi ky’ebibya eby’ebbumba kikyusa kitya engeri gy’otunuuliramu obunafu bwo?
  • Biki ku bivaako okukoowa ennyo ebisinga okubeera mu bulamu bwo?
  • Spurgeon yagamba nti, “Faayo nnyo ku kaweke k’okukkiriza okusinga ttani y’okucamuka.” Ekyo kitegeeza ki gy’oli?
  • Waliwo omukulembeze gw’omanyi agenda aggwaamu amaanyi? Oyinza otya okumuyamba?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno beera mwesimbu ku ngeri ettaala yo gy’ejjudde oba gy’eweddemu. Ku mutendera okuva ku emu okutuuka ku kkumi, okooye kwenkana wa mu mubiri, mu birowoozo ne mu mwoyo? Kiwandiike. Oluvannyuma londa eddaala limu ery’ensonga: okwebaka nga bukyali, olunaku olw’okuwummula, okutambulako, okulya ne mukwano gwo, oba okulaba omusawo. Buulira omuntu omu gw’oyesiga bw’oli ddala. Saba Zabbuli 42 mu ddoboozi eriwulikika, era oyogere n’emmeeme yo: “Essuubi lyo liteeke mu Katonda.”

study_questions.question: Katonda yalabirira atya Eriya bwe yakoowa ennyo?
study_questions.answer: Eriya yatuula wansi w’omwoloola n’asaba afe (1 Bassekabaka 19:4). Katonda yamuleka ne yeebaka, n’amuliisa, n’amugamba nti, “Golokoka olye, kubanga olugendo lunene” (1 Bassekabaka 19:7). Oluvannyuma yayogera naye mu ngeri eweweevu, n’amuwa omulimu omuggya n’abaamubeera.

study_questions.question: Kibi omukulembeze okuggwaamu amaanyi?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Abaweereza abeesigwa bangi kyabatuukako. Katonda “amanyi nga bwe twakolebwa era ng’ajjukira nti tuli nfuufu” (Zabbuli 103:14). Charles Spurgeon yawandiika ku “kuggwaamu amaanyi” kwe (“fainting fits”), ne Hudson Taylor yayita mu kizikiza eky’amaanyi mu 1869.

study_questions.question: Madaala ki agazza omuntu okuva mu kukoowa ennyo?
study_questions.answer: Okuwummula n’okulabirira omubiri, okwogera amazima ne Katonda n’abalala, obuyambi bw’omusawo oba omuwabuzi we kyetaagisa, okukendeeza ku mugugu, n’okuddamu okwesigama ku Katonda, “awa amaanyi abazirika” (Isaaya 40:29).

fields.title: Okugwa n’Okuzzibwawo
fields.body_html:
“Tonjeeyereza ggwe omulabe wange, kubanga wadde ngudde, nnaayimuka. Ne bwe naatuula mu kizikiza, Mukama anaabeera ekitangaala kyange.”

— Mikka 7:8

Eggumba bwe limenyeka, omusawo omulungi akola ebintu bibiri. Ekisooka, alizza mu kifo kyalyo n’aligolola, newaakubadde nga kiruma. Oluvannyuma alinyweza ne litaseeseetuka, oluusi okumala wiiki nnyingi, nga liwona. Eggumba bwe litazzibwa mu kifo kyalyo, liyinza okuwona nga likyamye, omuntu n’awenyera obulamu bwe bwonna. Bwe litaweebwa kiseera kuwummula, terijja kuwona n’akatono.

Buli mukulembeze agwa. Okugwa okumu nsobi ntono. Okulala bibi bya maanyi ebirumya abantu bangi. Omukulembeze bw’agwa, waba obulabe bubiri obunene. Obumu kwe kukweka ekimenyese n’agenda mu maaso ng’alinga nti tewali kyabaddewo. Obulala kwe kukkiriza nti ekimenyese tekiyinza kuwona n’akatono. Essuula eno etunuulira okugwa n’okuzzibwawo: okwenenya okw’amazima bwe kufaanana, ebiyinza okuvaamu, ne Kristo bw’azzaawo abo abagwa.

Peetero: omukulembeze eyeegaana Mukama we

Peetero ye yali omukulembeze w’ekkumi n’ababiri. Mu kiro ekyasooka okufa kwa Yesu, Yesu yamulabula nti: “Simooni, Simooni, Setaani asabye okukuwewa ng’eŋŋaano, naye ggwe nkusabidde okukkiriza kwo kuleme kukuggwaamu. Era bw’olimala okwenenya, yamba mu kuzimba n’okunyweza okukkiriza kwa baganda bo” (Lukka 22:31-32).

Peetero yali yeekakasa. “Mukama wange, neeteeseteese okusibirwa awamu naawe mu kkomera, era n’okufiira awamu naawe.” Yesu n’amuddamu nti, “Peetero, nkutegeeza nti leero ononneegaana emirundi esatu enkoko nga tennakookolima” (Lukka 22:33-34).

Essaawa ntono oluvannyuma, mu luggya lwa kabona asinga obukulu, omuwala omuweereza yagamba nti Peetero yali ne Yesu. Peetero n’akyegaana. N’addamu. N’omulundi ogwokusatu. “Peetero bwe yali akyayogera enkoko n’ekookolima. Mu kaseera ako Mukama waffe n’akyuka n’atunuulira Peetero. … Awo Peetero n’afuluma okuva mu luggya n’akaaba nnyo amaziga!” (Lukka 22:60-62).

Weetegereze ebintu bisatu ku bigambo bya Yesu ebyasooka okugwa kwe. Ekisooka, Yesu yali amanyi nti Peetero yali wa kugwa, n’akyamulonda. Eky’okubiri, yasabira Peetero nga tannagwa. Eky’okusatu, yayogera ku biseera eby’omu maaso: “bw’olimala okwenenya, yamba mu kuzimba n’okunyweza okukkiriza kwa baganda bo.” Yesu yali alaba dda Peetero ng’ali emitala w’okugwa kwe, ng’azziddwawo era ng’anyweza abalala.

“Ne Peetero”

Ku makya g’okuzuukira, malayika ku ntaana enkalu yawa abakazi obubaka: “mugende mutegeeze abayigirizwa be, ne Peetero, ebigambo bino nti, ‘Yesu abakulembeddemu okugenda e Ggaliraaya’” (Makko 16:7). “Ne Peetero.” Oboolyawo Peetero yali alowooza nti takyali omu ku bayigirizwa. Mukama eyazuukira yakakasa nti amanya nti teyerabiddwa.

Oluvannyuma, ku lubalama lw’Ennyanja y’e Ggaliraaya, Yesu yafumbira abayigirizwa be eky’enkya ku muliro ogw’amanda. Peetero yali amwegaanidde ku mabbali g’omuliro. Kaakano, ku mabbali g’omuliro omulala, Yesu yamubuuza emirundi esatu nti, “Simooni omwana wa Yokaana, onjagala?” Okwegaana kusatu, ebibuuzo bisatu. “Peetero n’anakuwala kubanga Yesu yamubuuza omulundi ogwokusatu nti, ‘Onjagala?’ Peetero n’amuddamu nti, ‘Mukama wange ggwe omanyi buli kimu, omanyi nga nkwagala.’ Yesu n’amugamba nti, ‘Kale liisanga endiga zange’” (Yokaana 21:17).

Yesu teyeefuula ng’okugwa tekwabaawo. Ebibuuzo ebisatu byakuzza mpola mu kitangaala, era byaluma. Naye Yesu teyaleka Peetero mu nsonyi ze. Yamuddiza omulimu gwe: “Kale liisanga abaana b’endiga zange … Kale lundanga endiga zange … Kale liisanga endiga zange.” Era n’amaliriza n’ekigambo kye kimu kye yayogera lwe yasooka okuyita Peetero: “Ngoberera” (Yokaana 21:19).

Wiiki musanvu oluvannyuma, ku Pentekoote, Peetero yayimirira mu Yerusaalemi, mu kibuga kye kimu mwe yeegaanira Yesu, n’abuulira. Abantu nga enkumi ssatu ne bakkiriza. Omusajja eyagwa mu lwatu okusinga abalala yafuuka omubuulizi omukulu ow’olubereberye ow’Ekkanisa.

Yokaana Makko: omuvubuka eyavaamu

Yokaana Makko yagenda ne Pawulo ne Balunabba ku lugendo lwabwe olw’obuminsani olwasooka. Naye nga bali mu kkubo wakati, yabaleka n’addayo ewaabwe (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:13). Tetubuulirwa nsonga. Ekiseera eky’olugendo olw’okubiri bwe kyatuuka, Balunabba yayagala okuddamu okutwala Makko. “Naye Pawulo ekyo n’atakyagala, kubanga Makko yabaawukanako n’abaleka e Panfuliya ng’omulimu ogwabatwala tebannagumaliriza. Ne balemwa okukkiriziganya mu nsonga eyo, n’ekyavaamu kwe kwawukana. Balunabba n’atwala Makko ne basaabala ku nnyanja okulaga mu Kupulo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:38-39).

Ani yali mutuufu? Oboolyawo bombi. Pawulo yali mutuufu nti omulimu gwali gwetaaga abantu abatavaamu. Balunabba, ng’erinnya lye litegeeza “omwana ow’okuzzaamu amaanyi”, yali mutuufu nti omuvubuka eyali agudde yali yeetaaga omukisa omulala.

Emyaka bwe gyayitawo, emboozi eno yafuna enkomerero ennungi. Pawulo yawandiika ng’ali mu kkomera nti, “Makko omujjwa wa Balunabba … bw’aliba ng’aze gye muli mumusembezanga” (Abakkolosaayi 4:10). Yamubala mu “bakozi bannange” (Firemooni 24). Era mu bbaluwa ye esembayo ddala, Pawulo yawandiikira Timoseewo nti, “Ggyayo Makko omuleete, kubanga annyamba nnyo mu buweereza” (2 Timoseewo 4:11). Omuvubuka eyavaamu ye yafuuka oyo Pawulo gwe yayagala okuba naye ku nkomerero. Bangi bakkiriza nti ye yawandiika n’Enjiri ya Makko.

Abamu ku bantu abagwa nga bali wansi w’obukulembeze bwo, lumu bajja kufuuka bakozi banno abasinga okukuyamba. Beera Balunabba gye bali.

Dawudi: omuwendo gw’ekibi ekikwekeddwa

Okugwa kwa Dawudi twakutunuulira mu Ssuula 34, Obulongoofu mu by’Okwegatta. Kaakano weetegereze ebyaddirira. Okumala emyezi mingi Dawudi yakweka ekibi kye. Oluvannyuma yannyonnyola ekiseera ekyo: “Bwe nasirikiranga ekibi kyange, ne nkogga, kubanga nasindanga olunaku lwonna. Wambonerezanga emisana n’ekiro, amaanyi ne ganzigwamu ng’amazzi bwe gakalira mu kyeya” (Zabbuli 32:3-4). Ekibi ekikwekeddwa tekisigala kisirise. Kirya emmeeme n’omubiri.

Nnabbi Nasani bwe yamwolekera, Dawudi teyawakana, teyanenya Basuseba, era teyeewolereza. Yagamba bugambi nti, “Nnyonoonye Mukama.” Nasani n’addamu nti, “Kale, Mukama aggyeewo ekyonoono kyo era toofe” (2 Samwiri 12:13). Katonda yasonyiwa Dawudi amangu ddala. Naye Nasani yeeyongera okumubuulira ebirumya ebyali bigenda okuvaamu (2 Samwiri 12:14). Okusonyiyibwa kujjuvu. Naye okusonyiyibwa si buli kiseera nti kuggyawo ebiva mu bye twakola.

Essaala ya Dawudi ey’okwenenya, Zabbuli 51, abakulembeze abaagwa babadde bagisaba okumala emyaka enkumi ssatu. “Onsaasire, Ayi Mukama, ggwe alina okwagala okutaggwaawo. Olw’okusaasira kwo okungi nziggyaako ebyonoono byange byonna. … Ebyonoono byange mbikkiriza, era ebibi byange mbimanyi bulijjo” (Zabbuli 51:1, 3). “Ssaddaaka Katonda gy’ayagala gwe mwoyo ogutegedde okusobya kwagwo. Omutima ogumenyese era oguboneredde, Ayi Katonda, toogugayenga” (Zabbuli 51:17).

Si buli kugwa nti kibi

Kikulu okwawula wakati w’engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okugwa.

  • Ensobi. Enteekateeka etaakola, okusalawo okukyamu okwakolebwa n’omutima omulungi, okubuulira okutaakwata ku bantu. Bino kitundu ku kuba omuntu. Bibeeko ky’oyigiramu, saba bakusonyiwe we kyetaagisa, ogende mu maaso.
  • Obunafu. Okunyiiga amangu ng’okooye, obutakyalira muntu eyali akwetaaga, okutya okwakusirisa. Bino byetaaga okwatulwa n’okukula.
  • Ekibi eky’amaanyi. Obwenzi, obubbi, okutulugunya, obulimba obw’amaanyi, obukambwe. Bino byetaaga okwenenya okw’omu buziba, era emirundi mingi bireeta ebivaamu eby’amaanyi ku buweereza bw’omukulembeze.

Abakulembeze abamu batwala buli nsobi ng’ekibi eky’entiisa, ne babeera mu kweraliikirira olw’omusango obutasalako. Abalala batwala ekibi eky’amaanyi ng’ensobi entono, ne bagaana okwolekera obuzito bwakyo. Bombi bakyamu. Saba Katonda, n’emikwano egy’amagezi, bakuyambe okulaba okugwa kwo nga bwe kuli ddala.

Okwenenya okw’amazima bwe kufaanana

“Oyo akweka ebibi bye, talifuna mukisa kukulaakulana, naye buli abyatula n’abireka, alisaasirwa” (Engero 28:13). Omukulembeze bw’aba ayonoonye nnyo, okwenenya okw’amazima emirundi mingi kujja kubaamu ebintu bino.

  • Okwatula awatali kwekwasa. Okugamba nti “Nnyonoonye”, nga Dawudi bwe yakola, so si “ensobi zaakolebwa” oba “nnali nnyigirizibwa”.
  • Okwatulira abantu abatuufu. Okusooka eri Katonda. Oluvannyuma eri abo abaalumizibwa, bwe kiba nga tekiriimu kabi era nga kya magezi gye bali. Oluvannyuma eri abo abalina obuyinza ku ggwe.
  • Okukyuka n’okukireka. Okuleka ekibi ddala, n’okusalako buli ekyakisobozesa.
  • Okutereeza. We kisoboka, okuzzaayo ekyatwalibwa n’okuddaabiriza ekyayonoonebwa. Zaakayo yagamba nti, “obanga waliwo omuntu gwe nnali ndyazaamaanyizza, nnaamuliyira emirundi ena” (Lukka 19:8).
  • Okukkiriza ebivaamu. Obutakaka bantu kuddamu kukwesiga mangu ago. Obutanenya abo abakubuuza ku by’okola.
  • Okwewaayo wansi w’abalala. Okukkiriza abakkiriza ab’amagezi abakuze okutambula naawe n’okusalawo awamu naawe ekiddako.

Omukulembeze agamba nti “Nsonyiwa” naye n’akaka okusigala mu kifo kye, n’alumba abo abaleeta obuzibu obwo mu lwatu, oba n’akweka ekitundu ku mazima, tannaba kwenenya mu bujjuvu.

Okuzzibwa eri Kristo, n’okuzzibwa mu bukulembeze

Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Abooluganda omuntu bw’abanga alina ekibi ky’akoze, mmwe ab’omwoyo mumuluŋŋamyenga mu buwombeefu nga mwegendereza si kulwa nga nammwe mugwa mu kukemebwa” (Abaggalatiya 6:1). Ekkanisa erina bulijjo okuwa omukulembeze eyeenenyezza okusonyiyibwa n’okumwaniriza. Twalaba engeri y’okunenya mu bukkakkamu mu Ssuula 20, Okunenya n’Okuzzaawo.

Naye waliwo enjawulo enkulu wakati w’okuzzibwa eri Kristo n’eri obussekimu bw’ekkanisa, n’okuzzibwa mu bukulembeze. Ekisooka kirabo kya kisa, era kiweebwa bwereere eri buli eyeenenya. “Abo abali mu Kristo Yesu, tebaliiko musango” (Abaruumi 8:1). Eky’okubiri nsonga ya kwesigibwa n’empisa. Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti omukulembeze ateekwa okuba “nga taliiko kya kunenyezebwa” (1 Timoseewo 3:2), era “ng’assibwamu ekitiibwa abo abatali ba Kkanisa” (1 Timoseewo 3:7).

Kale omukulembeze bw’agwa mu kibi eky’amaanyi, ekkanisa ez’amagezi emirundi mingi zikola bino:

  • Zisaba omukulembeze okuva ku bukulembeze, waakiri okumala ekiseera.
  • Ziwa omukulembeze n’amaka ge okulabirirwa, okubuulirirwa, n’abantu ab’okumubuuza ku bulamu bwe.
  • Zisooka era zisinga kulabirira buli eyalumizibwa.
  • Ziwaayo ekiseera ekiwanvu, emirundi mingi emyaka, obwesige okuddamu okuzimbibwa n’enkyukakyuka ey’amazima okulabibwa.
  • Zisalawo wamu, so si muntu omu yekka, obanga omukulembeze ayinza okuddamu okukulembera, era mu kifo kya ngeri ki.

Abakulembeze abamu, oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera ekiwanvu eky’enkyukakyuka erabiddwa, bazzibwa mu buweereza obubala ebibala. Abalala tebazzibwa, ne baweereza Kristo n’obwesigwa mu ngeri endala. Byombi bubonero bwa kisa. Omukulembeze bw’aba yatulugunya omwana oba omuntu omunafu, obukuumi bw’abanafu bulina bulijjo okusooka, era omuntu ng’oyo tasaanidde kuddamu kuweebwa kifo kya kwesigibwa ku bo. Kino twakiraba mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: John Bunyan ne John Newton

John Bunyan yali muddaabiriza w’ebintu by’ebyuma omwavu, eyaddaabirizanga entamu n’ebisaani, mu Bungereza mu kyasa ekya kkumi n’omusanvu. Yafuuka omubuulizi, n’amala emyaka kkumi n’ebiri mu kkomera olw’okubuulira, era n’awandiika Olugendo lw’Omutambuze. Era yawandiika ebyafaayo by’emmeeme ye mu kitabo ekiyitibwa Ekisa Ekyayitirira eri Asinga Aboonoonyi Bonna, ekiri ku Ochorus. Okumala emyaka mingi yabonyaabonyezebwa ebibi bye n’okutya nti Katonda yali amugobye. Awo lumu, bwe yali ng’atambula mu nnimiro, ekigambo kino ne kimujjira mu birowoozo: “Obutuukirivu bwo buli mu ggulu.” Yawandiika nti:

“Era ne ndaba nti si mbeera ennungi ey’omutima gwange yafuulanga obutuukirivu bwange okuba obulungi, wadde embeera embi okubufuula obubi; kubanga obutuukirivu bwange bwali Yesu Kristo yennyini, nga bwe yali jjo, ne leero bw’ali era bw’aliba emirembe n’emirembe.”

— John Bunyan, Ekisa Ekyayitirira eri Asinga Aboonoonyi Bonna, 229

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Nalaba nti enneewulira zange ennungi tezaamfuula mutuukirivu okusingawo mu maaso ga Katonda, era enneewulira zange embi tezaamfuula mutuukirivu katono. Obutuukirivu bwange bwali Yesu Kristo yennyini, atakyuka. Bunyan yawandiika nti, “Kaakano enjegere zange ne zigwa ddala ku magulu gange.” Guno gwe musingi gwa buli kuzzibwawo. Tetuyimirira mu maaso ga Katonda ku lw’ebyaffe bye twakola, birungi oba bibi, wabula ku lwa Kristo.

John Newton yazaalibwa mu London mu 1725. Bwe yali muvubuka yali mukozi ku mmeeri, era oluvannyuma n’aba omuduumizi w’emmeeri ezaasomosanga Abafirika abafuulibwa abaddu okuyita mu Atlantic. Ne bwe yamala okutandika okugoberera Kristo, yeeyongera mu busuubuzi bw’abaddu okumala emyaka egimu. Okwenenya kwe kwakula mpola, era kitundu ku byafaayo bye nti kyatwala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo. Ekiseera bwe kyayitawo, yafuuka omusumba ayagalwa ennyo e Olney, oluvannyuma mu London, era n’awandiika oluyimba “Amazing Grace” (Ekisa Eky’Ekitalo). Ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwe, mu 1788, yayatula mu lwatu omugabo gwe mu busuubuzi bw’abaddu, ne yeegatta ku kaweefube ow’okubukomya, ng’azzaamu amaanyi omuvubuka William Wilberforce, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 30, Obwenkanya, Okusaasira n’Abaavu.

Newton teyeerabira bye yali. Yawandiika ebigambo eby’okuteekebwa ku ntaana ye, ebiwandiikiddwa mu kitabo kya Ochorus Abasajja Abaalunda Ekisibo:

“John Newton, omuweereza w’ekkanisa, eyali edda atakkiriza era ow’empisa embi, omuweereza w’abaddu mu Afirika, yali, olw’okusaasira okungi okwa Mukama waffe era Omulokozi Yesu Kristo, akuumibwa, azzibwa obuggya, asonyiyibwa, era alondebwa okubuulira okukkiriza kwe yamala ebbanga ddene ng’afuba okuzikiriza.”

— John Newton, ebigambo ku ntaana ye

Mu bigambo ebyangu: John Newton, omuweereza w’ekkanisa, edda yali atakkiriza era omusajja eyabeeranga mu kibi, era yaweerezanga obusuubuzi bw’abaddu mu Afirika. Naye olw’okusaasira okungi okwa Yesu Kristo, yakuumibwa nga mulamu, n’akomezebwawo, n’asonyiyibwa, era n’aweebwa omulimu ogw’okubuulira okukkiriza kwe yagezaako edda okuzikiriza.

Weetegereze ebigambo ebina: akuumibwa, azzibwa obuggya, asonyiyibwa, alondebwa. Eyo ye mboozi ya buli muweereza eyagwa Katonda gw’azzaawo. Emboozi ya Newton era etuyigiriza nti okwenenya kuyinza okutwala ekiseera okutuuka ku buli kitundu ky’obulamu bwaffe, era nti okwenenya okw’amazima lumu kujja kukola okuggyawo obulabe bwe twakola.

Twagwa, naye tuyimuka

“Omuntu omutuukirivu ne bw’agwa emirundi omusanvu, addamu n’ayimuka” (Engero 24:16). Enjawulo wakati w’abatuukirivu n’ababi si nti abatuukirivu tebagwa n’akatono. Kwe kuba nti baddamu ne bayimuka, olw’ekisa kya Katonda.

Pawulo, eyali edda ayigganya Ekkanisa, yawandiika nti, “Kristo Yesu yajja mu nsi okulokola aboonoonyi. Mu bo nze mwonoonyi asookera ddala. Katonda kyeyava ansaasira, Kristo Yesu alyoke ayoleseze mu nze, omwonoonyi asingira ddala okugumiikiriza kwe okutakoma” (1 Timoseewo 1:15-16). Bw’oba ng’ogudde, leeta okugwa kwo mu kitangaala. Tokweka kimenyese. Kireke kizzibwe mu kifo kyakyo, ne bwe kiba nga kiruma. Kkiriza ekiseera kye kitwala okuwona. Era wuliriza eddoboozi ly’Oyo eyabuuza Peetero nti, “Onjagala?”, oluvannyuma n’amugamba nti, “Ngoberera.”

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Lukka 22:31-34 ne Yokaana 21:15-19. Kiki ky’oyiga ku ngeri Yesu gy’ayisaamu abo abagwa?
  • Soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:36-40 ne 2 Timoseewo 4:11. Yokaana Makko ali mu buweereza bwo y’ani? Oyinza otya okuba Balunabba gy’ali?
  • Soma Zabbuli 32:3-5. Wali owuliddeko ekyo Dawudi kye yawulira bwe yali asirikidde ekibi kye?
  • Lwaki kikulu okwawula wakati w’ensobi, obunafu n’ekibi eky’amaanyi?
  • Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w’okuzzibwa mu bussekimu n’okuzzibwa mu bukulembeze? Lwaki kikulu?
  • Ebigambo ku ntaana ya Newton bigamba nti “akuumibwa, azzibwa obuggya, asonyiyibwa, era alondebwa”. Kigambo ki ku bino ekisinga okukukwatako?
  • Waliwo okugwa mu bulamu bwo kw’okyakweka?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno soma Zabbuli 51 mpola era ng’osaba. Bwe wabaawo ekibi ky’obadde okweka, kyatulire Katonda, oluvannyuma okyatulire omukkiriza omu akuze era gw’oyesiga, omusabe akuyambe okutwala eddaala eddala ettuufu. Bw’oba walumya omuntu, buuza Katonda engeri y’okukitereeza. Oluvannyuma lowooza ku muntu mu kkanisa yo eyagwa era ng’awulira ensonyi. Genda gy’ali wiiki eno, nga Yesu bwe yagenda eri Peetero, omugambe nti teyerabiddwa.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze agwa ayinza okuzzibwawo?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Peetero yeegaana Yesu emirundi esatu, kyokka Mukama eyazuukira yaweereza obubaka eri “abayigirizwa be, ne Peetero” (Makko 16:7), n’amuzzaawo ng’amubuuza emirundi esatu nti, “Onjagala?”, era n’amugamba nti, “Ngoberera” (Yokaana 21:17-19).

study_questions.question: Okwenenya okw’amazima kufaanana kutya?
study_questions.answer: Kukkiriza ekibi awatali kwekwasa, kukinakuwalira mu maaso ga Katonda, kukyatulira abo abaalumizibwa, kutereeza ebintu we kisoboka, era kukkiriza ebivaamu. Okwatula kwa Dawudi oluvannyuma lw’ekibi kye ne Basuseba kye kyokulabirako.

study_questions.question: Buli kugwa kibi?
study_questions.answer: Nedda. Okugwa okumu kuva mu bunafu, mu butaba na bumanyirivu oba mu mbeera. Yokaana Makko yavaamu ku lugendo lw’obuminsani naye oluvannyuma Pawulo yawandiika nti “annyamba nnyo mu buweereza”. “Wadde ngudde, nnaayimuka. Ne bwe naatuula mu kizikiza, Mukama anaabeera ekitangaala kyange” (Mikka 7:8).

fields.title: Okuyigganyizibwa n’Omuwendo Ogusasulwa
fields.body_html:
“Temutya n’akatono ebyo bye mugenda okubonaabona. … Mubeere beesigwa okutuusa okufa, nange ndibawa engule ey’obulamu.”

— Okubikkulirwa 2:10

Omulimi akwata olubatu lw’ensigo n’aziyiwa mu ttaka. Eri omuntu atamanyi bya bulimi, kirabika ng’okwonoona. Ensigo zibula mu ttaka eriddugavu. Ziziikibwa era zirabika ng’ezaabula. Naye ekiseera bwe kituuka, emimera emibisi giranda, ennimiro yonna n’ejjula emmere ey’empeke.

Okumala emyaka enkumi bbiri, abalabe b’Ekkanisa bagezezzaako okugiziika. Basibye abakulembeze baayo, bayokezza ebitabo byayo, baggaddewo ebizimbe byayo era batta abantu baayo. Era emirundi n’emirundi, Ekkanisa ekuze mu bifo we yalumbibwa ennyo okusinga. Leero, mu nsi nnyingi, abakkiriza boolekagana n’ekkomera, ebikolwa eby’obukambwe n’okufiirwa olw’okugoberera Kristo. Abakulembeze be batera okusooka okulumbibwa. Essuula eno ekwata ku kukulembera mu kuyigganyizibwa, ne ku muwendo ogusasulwa olw’okugoberera Yesu.

“Balina omukisa abayigganyizibwa”

Yesu teyakweka muwendo gw’okumugoberera. Mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi, yagamba nti, “Balina omukisa abayigganyizibwa olw’obutuukirivu, kubanga abo obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu bwe bwabwe. Mulina omukisa mmwe, bwe banaabavumanga, ne babayigganya, ne baboogerako ebibi ebya buli ngeri, ne babawaayiriza, nga babalanga nze. Musanyuke era mujaguze kubanga empeera yammwe nnene mu ggulu, ne bannabbi ab’edda bwe baayigganyizibwa bwe batyo” (Matayo 5:10-12).

Yagamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Ensi bw’ebakyawanga mumanye nti yasooka kukyawa nze. … ‘Omuddu tasinga mukama we.’ Kale obanga Nze banjigganya era nammwe bagenda kubayigganyanga” (Yokaana 15:18, 20). Pawulo yawandiikira Timoseewo mu bwangu nti, “bonna abaagala okuba mu bulamu obutya Katonda mu Kristo Yesu, banaayigganyizibwanga” (2 Timoseewo 3:12). Ne Peetero yawandiikira ekkanisa ezaali mu bizibu nti, “Abaagalwa, temwewuunya obulumi obw’amaanyi bwe bubatuukako ng’abatuukiddwako ekintu ekitali kya bulijjo” (1 Peetero 4:12).

Okuyigganyizibwa si kintu kya kyewuunyo. Kya bulijjo eri abantu ba Katonda. Abakkiriza bangi ababeera mu bifo ebirimu emirembe kibeewuunyisa. Abakkiriza bangi ababeera mu bifo eby’obulabe bakimanyi dda bulungi.

Abatume abaasanyuka

Oluvannyuma lwa Pentekoote, abakulembeze mu Yerusaalemi baakwata abatume ne babalagira okulekera awo okubuulira. Mu Ssuula 6, Obuyinza wansi w’Obuyinza, twalaba okuddamu kwa Peetero: “Kitugwanira okugondera Katonda okusinga okugondera abantu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:29). Awo olukiiko ne lukola bwe luti: “Abatume ne bayitibwa, bwe baamala okukubibwa ne balabulwa obutaddayo kwogera mu linnya lya Yesu, ne babata. Abatume ne bava mu Lukiiko nga basanyuka kubanga baasaanyizibwa okukwatibwa ensonyi n’okubonaabona olw’Erinnya. Awo ne bayigirizanga mu Yeekaalu buli lunaku ne mu maka g’abantu, nga babuulira Yesu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:40-42).

Weetegereze ebintu bisatu. Baasanyuka, si lwa kuba nti obulumi bulungi, wabula kubanga baagabana ku kubonaabona kwa Kristo. Baakitwala ng’ekitiibwa. Era tebaalekera awo. Beeyongera okuyigiriza buli lunaku.

Emabegako, bwe baasooka okutiisibwatiisibwa, ekkanisa teyasaba kukuumibwa. Baasaba nti, “Ne kaakano, Ayi Mukama, wulira okutiisatiisa kwabwe; owe abaddu bo obuvumu babuulire ekigambo kyo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:29). Pawulo ne Siira bwe baakubibwa ne basibibwa mu kkomera ery’omunda e Firipi, “ekiro mu ttumbi Pawulo ne Siira bwe baali nga basaba, era nga bwe bayimba n’ennyimba ez’okutendereza Katonda, nga n’abasibe abalala bawuliriza” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:25).

Okuyigganyizibwa bwe kufaanana

Okuyigganyizibwa kujja mu ngeri nnyingi. Mu bifo ebimu, kwa bukambwe: abakkiriza bakubibwa, basibibwa, bagobebwa mu maka gaabwe oba battibwa. Amakanisa gookebwa. Abasumba babula. Mu bifo ebirala, kusirifu, naye era kuluma.

  • Okugobebwa ab’omu maka. Omuvubuka akyukira Kristo ayinza okugobebwa mu maka g’ewaabwe, okwegaanibwa, oba okukakibwa okufumbirwa oba okuwasa.
  • Okufiirwa omulimu n’ensimbi. Abakkiriza bayinza okugaanibwa emirimu, okufiirwa bizinensi zaabwe, oba okugaanibwa obuyambi abalala bwe bafuna.
  • Amateeka n’abakungu. Gavumenti ziyinza okuziyiza enkuŋŋaana, okulagira ekkanisa okwewandiisa n’okufugibwa, oba okubonereza abo ababuulira abalala okukkiriza kwabwe.
  • Obukambwe okuva eri baliraanwa. Mu bifo ebimu, obulabe tebuva mu gavumenti wabula mu bibinja by’abantu abajagalalo, mu bibinja ebirina eby’okulwanyisa, oba mu bantu b’omu kitundu.
  • Okusekererwa n’obulimba. Ne mu nsi ezirimu eddembe, abakkiriza bayinza okusekererwa, okwogerwako ebitali bituufu, oba okusindikibwa ebbali mu bulamu bw’olukale.

Tulina okwegendereza obutayita buli buzibu kuyigganyizibwa. Peetero yawandiika nti, “Mulina omukisa bwe muvumibwa olw’erinnya lya Kristo” (1 Peetero 4:14). Naye era yalabula nti tetusaanidde kubonaabona lwa kukola bibi (1 Peetero 4:15). Abantu bwe batatwagala kubanga tuli bakambwe mu kwogera, ba malala oba basirusiru, okwo si kuyigganyizibwa. Abakkiriza ababeera mu bifo ebirimu obweyagaza era bajjukire nti baganda baabwe ne bannyinaabwe mu bifo ebirala basasula omuwendo ogusingako ennyo. “Mujjukirenga abasibe abali mu kkomera, nga muli nga abaasibirwa awamu n’abo. Munakuwaliranga wamu nabo ababonyaabonyezebwa, kubanga nammwe muli mu mubiri” (Abaebbulaniya 13:3).

Okukulembera ekkanisa eri mu kunyigirizibwa

Omukulembeze asaanidde atya okukulembera ng’ekkanisa eri mu kabi? Gano gemu ku magezi okuva mu Byawandiikibwa ne mu kkanisa ezaayita mu kuyigganyizibwa.

  • Teekateeka ekisibo nga kunnaba kujja. Yigiriza abantu bo nti okubonaabona kitundu ku kugoberera Kristo. Banyweze mu Kigambo. Bayambe okukwata Ebyawandiikibwa mu mutwe, kubanga Bayibuli ziyinza okubaggibwako.
  • Kuza abakulembeze bangi. Ekkanisa bw’eba yeesigama ku mukulembeze omu, eyinza okusaanyizibwawo olw’okukwatibwa kw’omuntu omu. Tendeka abalala, ekkanisa esobole okugenda mu maaso nga toliiwo. Kino twakiraba mu Ssuula 23, Okukuza Abakulembeze.
  • Mukuŋŋaanire mu bibinja ebitono. Ekkanisa eyasooka yakuŋŋaananga “mu maka g’abantu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:42). Ebibinja ebitono bisobola okugenda mu maaso ng’enkuŋŋaana ennene tezisoboka.
  • Beera wa magezi, so si wa kwesuula mu kabi. Yesu yagamba nti, “Laba mbatuma ng’endiga mu misege. Noolwekyo mubeere bagezigezi ng’emisota, era abataliiko kya kunenyezebwa ng’amayiba” (Matayo 10:16). Obuvumu tebutegeeza kunoonya kabi.
  • Manya ddi lw’olina okusengula. Yesu era yagamba nti, “Bwe babayigganyanga mu kibuga ekimu muddukirenga mu kirala!” (Matayo 10:23). Pawulo yadduka okuva e Ddamasiko mu kisero (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 9:25). Mu Ssuula 11, Obuvumu, twalaba nti okugenda mu buwaŋŋanguse si kulya mu nsi lukwe. Buli mukulembeze alina okunoonya Katonda okumanya obanga asigale oba agende.
  • Labirira amaka g’abasibe. Omukulembeze bw’akwatibwa, amaka ge emirundi mingi ge gasinga okubonaabona. Ekkanisa erina okugalabirira.
  • Yagala abalabe bo. Yesu yagamba nti, “Mwagalenga abalabe bammwe! Musabirenga ababayigganya!” (Matayo 5:44). Suteefano, bwe yali akubibwa amayinja, yasaba nti, “Mukama wange, tobavunaana olw’ekibi kino” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 7:60).
  • Ddamu n’obukkakkamu. “Bulijjo mubenga beetegefu okuddamu buli ababuuza okunnyonnyola essuubi lyammwe, era muddengamu n’obuwombeefu, awamu n’eggonjebwa” (1 Peetero 3:15-16).
  • Teweegaana Kristo n’akatono. Abakulembeze bayinza okukakibwa okuteeka emikono ku biwandiiko, okulyamu abakkiriza abalala olukwe, oba okuleka okukkiriza kwabwe. Kakasa mu mutima gwo kaakano nti tojja kukikola.

Omusaayi gw’abajulizi

Suteefano bwe yattibwa, “okuyigganya Ekkanisa ne kutandika n’amaanyi mangi nnyo mu Yerusaalemi. Abakkiriza bonna, okuggyako abatume, ne basaasaanira mu Buyudaaya ne mu Samaliya” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 8:1). Kyalabika ng’akabenje akanene. Naye Lukka atubuulira ekyaddirira: “Naye abakkiriza abadduka mu Yerusaalemi ne bagenda mu buli kifo nga babuulira Enjiri ya Yesu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 8:4). Okuyigganyizibwa kwabunyisa Enjiri okugenda ewala.

Pawulo yalaba ekintu kye kimu ng’ali mu kkomera: “Abooluganda, njagala mmwe mutegeere kaakano nti ebimu ebyambaako byongera bwongezi kubunyisa Njiri, … N’abooluganda mu Mukama waffe abasinga obungi beeyongedde okuguma olw’okusibibwa kwange, era nga bamaliridde okwaŋŋanga okubuulira nga tebatya” (Abafiripi 1:12, 14).

Awo nga mu mwaka 200, omuwandiisi Omukristaayo mu Afirika ey’Obukiikakkono ayitibwa Tertullian yawandiikira abafuzi Abaruumi abaali batta abakkiriza. Ebigambo bye bitera okujjukirwa mu bufunze buno: “Omusaayi gw’Abakristaayo nsigo.” Gye baakoma okutemebwa, gye baakoma okweyongera. Kino kibadde kituufu emirundi n’emirundi. Mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri, ekkanisa mu China yasalibwako ku nsi endala, abakulembeze baayo ne basibibwa, abaminsani baayo ne bagobebwa. Enzigi bwe zaddamu okuggulwawo, Ekkanisa yali ekuze, ng’abasinga bwe babalirira, emirundi mingi nnyo.

Ekitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa kyogera ku bakkiriza abaawangula Setaani: “Ne bamuwangula olw’omusaayi gw’Omwana gw’Endiga, n’olw’ekigambo eky’obujulirwa bwabwe, ne bawaayo obulamu bwabwe nga tebatya na kufa” (Okubikkulirwa 12:11).

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Ignatius ne Perpetua

Mu Ssuula 8, Obwesigwa: Omuntu Omu ne mu Kyama, twawulira Polycarp ng’agamba gavana Omuruumi nti yali aweerezza Kristo okumala emyaka kinaana mu mukaaga. Emyaka nga amakumi ana nga Polycarp tannafa, mukwano gwe Ignatius, omulabirizi w’e Antiyokiya gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 6, Obuyinza wansi w’Obuyinza, yatwalibwa ng’akuumibwa e Rooma okuttibwa ensolo enkambwe. Mu kkubo yawandiikira ekkanisa ebbaluwa. Eri Abakristaayo ab’e Rooma, abaali bayinza okugezaako okumuwonya, yawandiika nti:

“Mundeke mpeebwe ensolo enkambwe, kubanga mu zo mwe nnyinza okutuuka eri Katonda. Nze ndi ŋŋaano ya Katonda, era ngaaya amannyo g’ensolo enkambwe ndyoke nsangibwe nga ndi mugaati mulongoofu [ogwa Kristo].”

— Ignatius ow’e Antiyokiya, Ebbaluwa eri Abaruumi

Mu bigambo ebyangu: ka nsuulibwe eri ensolo enkambwe, kubanga mu zo mwe nnaatuukira eri Katonda. Ndi ng’eŋŋaano eya Katonda, era amannyo g’ensolo gajja kunsa ng’olubengo, ndyoke mbe omugaati omulongoofu eri Kristo. Ignatius teyalaba kufa kwe ng’enkomerero y’obuweereza bwe, wabula ng’okutuukirizibwa kwabwo. Yawandiika nti olwo lwokka lw’alyoka abeera omuyigirizwa wa Yesu Kristo ddala.

Mu mwaka 203, e Carthage mu Afirika ey’Obukiikakkono, omukazi omuvubuka ayitibwa Perpetua yakwatibwa wamu n’abakkiriza abapya abalala. Yali wa myaka nga amakumi abiri mu ebiri era ng’alina omwana omulenzi omuwere. Omuzaana we, Felicity, naye yakwatibwa, n’azaalira mu kkomera nga basigazza ekiseera kitono okufa. Perpetua yawandiikanga ebyamutuukangako buli lunaku mu kkomera, era ebiwandiiko ebyo bituuse gye tuli. Mu byo ayogera ku ngeri kitaawe, ataali mukkiriza, gye yamwegayiriranga emirundi n’emirundi okuleka okukkiriza kwe. Yasonga ku nsuwa y’amazzi n’amubuuza obanga eyinza okuyitibwa erinnya eddala lyonna okuggyako ly’eri. N’agamba nti nedda. N’amugamba nti mu ngeri y’emu, ye teyali ayinza kweyita kintu kirala okuggyako ky’ali: Omukristaayo. Perpetua ne Felicity baafiira wamu mu kisaawe. Amannya gaabwe Ekkanisa ebadde egassaamu ekitiibwa okuva olwo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa ey’Ensi Yonna: Watchman Nee ne Yona Kanamuzeyi

Watchman Nee yali mubuulizi era muwandiisi Omuchina, ng’ebitabo bye bisomeddwa mu nsi yonna. Gavumenti ey’Abakomunisiti bwe yamala okutuula mu buyinza, yakwatibwa mu Gwakuna 1952, ng’alina emyaka amakumi ana mu munaana. Ebyafaayo bye Ebifaananyi by’Obuvumu – Watchman Nee, ebiri ku Ochorus, bitubuulira nti yasalirwa ekibonerezo eky’emyaka kkumi n’etaano mu kkomera, era nti emyaka kkumi n’etaano gyafuuka amakumi abiri. Teyateebwa n’akatono. Yafa mu 1972. Ebyafaayo ebyo bigamba nti kigambibwa nti wansi w’omutto gwe waasangibwa akapapula, okwatula okwangu nti Yesu Kristo Mwana wa Katonda, nti yafiirira aboonoonyi n’azuukira, era nti Nee yafa ng’amukkiriza.

Yona Kanamuzeyi yali mudyakoni mu Rwanda era omusajja w’Okuzuukuka kw’Afirika ey’Obuvanjuba. Nga 24 Janwali 1964, mu butabanguko obwaddirira okwefuga kwa Rwanda, abaserikale baamutwala ne bamuvuga okutuuka ku mugga. Ng’ekitabo Tukutendereza ekiri ku Ochorus bwe kiwandiika, abaaliwo baajjukira nti yali ayimba oluyimba bwe yali atwalibwa ku mugga, “There Is a Happy Land” (Waliwo Ensi ey’Essanyu). Nga tebannamukuba masasi, yasaba akkirizibwe okuwandiika mu katabo ke. Yawandiika nti: “Tugenda mu ggulu,” era n’asaba akatabo ako kaweebwe mukyala we. Ekitabo kiggyamu eky’okuyiga buli mukulembeze ky’asaanidde okuwulira: “Ekizibu kyo ekinene ojja kukyolekera n’empisa z’olina dda.” Obuvumu bwa Kanamuzeyi ku mugga bwava mu myaka mingi egy’obwesigwa obwa bulijjo obwa buli lunaku.

Mwesigwa okutuusa okufa

Yesu yagamba ekkanisa ey’e Sumuna, ekibuga kya Polycarp, nti, “Temutya n’akatono ebyo bye mugenda okubonaabona. … Mubeere beesigwa okutuusa okufa, nange ndibawa engule ey’obulamu” (Okubikkulirwa 2:10). Si buli mukulembeze nti alyolekera ekkomera oba okufa. Naye buli mukulembeze ayitibwa okuba omwetegefu.

Pawulo yabuuza nti, “Ani alitwawukanya n’okwagala kwa Kristo? Kubonaabona, oba bulumi, oba kuyigganyizibwa, oba njala, oba kuba bwerere, oba kabi, oba kitala?” Era n’addamu nti, “mu bino byonna tuwangudde n’okukirawo ku bw’oyo eyatwagala” (Abaruumi 8:35, 37). Ensigo egwa mu ttaka teba ebuze. Eba esimbiddwa.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Matayo 5:10-12 n’Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:40-42. Lwaki abatume baasobola okusanyuka nga bamaze okukubibwa?
  • Ngeri ki ez’okuyigganyizibwa abakkiriza ze boolekagana nazo mu ggwanga lyo oba mu kitundu kyo?
  • Singa okwatibwa enkya, ekkanisa yo yandisobodde okugenda mu maaso? Kiki ekyandyetaaze okukyuka?
  • Osalawo otya obanga osigale mu kabi oba ogende mu kifo ekirimu obukuumi?
  • Ekkanisa yo eyinza etya “okujjukiranga abasibe abali mu kkomera” (Abaebbulaniya 13:3)?
  • Kanamuzeyi yayolekera ekizibu kye ekinene n’empisa ze yalina dda. Mpisa ki z’ozimba kaakano?
  • Waliwo ekintu kyonna kye wandyegaanidde Kristo okusobola okukikuuma? Kiki ekyetaagisa okukimalawo leero?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno, yiga ku bakkiriza abayigganyizibwa mu kitundu ekirala eky’ensi, obasabire ng’oyogera amannya gaabwe wamu n’ekkanisa yo. Ekkanisa yo bw’eba eri mu kunyigirizibwa, tuula wansi ne bakulembeze banno mubuuze nti: “Singa omukulembeze waffe omukulu aggibwawo enkya, ani yandikulembedde? Twandikuŋŋaanidde wa? Kiki kye twandyetaaze?” Wandiika enteekateeka ennyangu. Oluvannyuma kwata mu mutwe Abaruumi 8:35-39 ogisabe ng’essaala yo.

study_questions.question: Abakristaayo basaanidde kweyisa batya mu kuyigganyizibwa?
study_questions.answer: Mu bwesigwa era ne mu ssanyu. Yesu yagamba nti, “Balina omukisa abayigganyizibwa olw’obutuukirivu” (Matayo 5:10). Abatume, nga bamaze okukubibwa, baagenda nga basanyuka era ne beeyongera okubuulira (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:40-42).

study_questions.question: Abakristaayo basaanidde okusuubira okuyigganyizibwa?
study_questions.answer: Yee. “Bonna abaagala okuba mu bulamu obutya Katonda mu Kristo Yesu, banaayigganyizibwanga” (2 Timoseewo 3:12). Peetero yawandiika nti, “temwewuunya” (1 Peetero 4:12). Yesu yagamba nti ensi bwe yamukyawa, era yandikyaye n’abagoberezi be (Yokaana 15:18).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okukulembera ekkanisa eri mu kunyigirizibwa?
study_questions.answer: Ng’ateekateeka abantu n’Ekigambo kya Katonda, ng’asooka kugondera Katonda, “Kitugwanira okugondera Katonda okusinga okugondera abantu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:29), era ng’asigala nga mwesigwa okutuusa ku nkomerero: “Mubeere beesigwa okutuusa okufa” (Okubikkulirwa 2:10). Essuula eyogera ku Ignatius, Perpetua, Watchman Nee ne Yona Kanamuzeyi.

fields.title: Emyaka Egikwekeddwa
fields.body_html:
“Yanfuula akasaale akazigule era nankweka mu mufuko gwe.”

— Isaaya 49:2

Omuti omunene mu kibira guyinza okuwanvuwa mita amakumi asatu. Naye nga tegunnakula kwambuka waggulu, gwasooka kukula kukka wansi. Okumala emyaka mingi, nga kumpi tewali kirabika waggulu w’ettaka, emirandira gyagwo gyali gikka wansi ddala mu ttaka, nga ginoonya amazzi era nga gyekwata ku njazi. Kibuyaga bwe yajja oluvannyuma, emirandira egyo egyali egikwekeddwa gye gyaguyimiriza.

Katonda atera okukola mu ngeri y’emu n’abakulembeze. Nga tannabakozesa mu lwatu, abateekateeka mu kyama. Wabaawo emyaka egy’okulinda, emyaka egy’emirimu emitono egya bulijjo, emyaka nga kirabika tewali abafaako. Emyaka gino egikwekeddwa giyinza okuwulikika ng’egyafa obwereere. Si bwe kiri. Essuula eno, esembayo mu Kitundu eky’Omunaana: Okukulembera mu Bizibu, ekwata ku myaka egikwekeddwa: okulinda, obutamanyibwa n’entandikwa entono, ne Katonda bw’ateekateeka abaweereza be awatali abalaba.

Musa: emyaka amakumi ana n’endiga

Musa yakulira mu lubiri lwa Falaawo. “Musa n’ayigirizibwa mu magezi gonna ag’Abamisiri, n’akula nga w’amaanyi mu bigambo ne mu bikolwa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 7:22). Bwe yaweza emyaka amakumi ana, yasalawo okuyamba abantu be. Yalaba Omumisiri ng’akuba omuddu Omwebbulaniya, era “bwe yalaba nga teri muntu mulala amulaba, n’akwata Omumisiri n’amutta, n’amukweka mu musenyu” (Okuva 2:12). Yagezaako okukulembera mu maanyi ge ye ne mu kiseera kye ye, ne kiggwera mu butemu n’okulemererwa. Yadduka okuwonya obulamu bwe n’agenda mu nsi ya Midiyaani.

Awo ne wajja emyaka egikwekeddwa. “Awo nga wayiseewo emyaka amakumi ana, Musa bwe yali ng’ali mu ddungu ly’olusozi Sinaayi, malayika n’amulabikira mu muliro ogwaka, wakati mu kisaka” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 7:30). Okumala emyaka amakumi ana, omulangira w’e Misiri yalunda endiga z’omusajja omulala mu ddungu. “Musa bwe yali ng’alunda ekisibo ky’endiga za mukoddomi we Yesero” (Okuva 3:1).

Kiki ekyabaawo mu myaka egyo? Musa yamanya eddungu, eddungu lye limu lye yali agenda okuyisaamu Isirayiri lumu okumala emyaka amakumi ana. Yayiga okulabirira endiga, ekyo kyennyini Katonda kye yali agenda okumuyitira okukola n’abantu be. Era yafiirwa okwekkiririzaamu kwe. Ku myaka amakumi ana yali mwetegefu okukulembera awatali Katonda. Ku myaka kinaana, Katonda bwe yamuyita, yagamba nti, “Nange nze ani agenda ewa Falaawo nziggyeyo abaana ba Isirayiri mu Misiri?” (Okuva 3:11). Kaakano Katonda yali asobola okumukozesa, kubanga Musa yali takyeesiga Musa. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 7, Obwetoowaze, yafuuka “musajja muwombeefu nnyo, nga muteefu okusinga abantu bonna abaali ku nsi” (Okubala 12:3).

Yusufu: yalongoosebwa mu kkomera

Yusufu yafuna ebirooto okuva eri Katonda ng’alina emyaka kkumi na musanvu. Oluvannyuma baganda be ne bamutunda ng’omuddu. Mu Misiri yawaayirizibwa n’asuulibwa mu kkomera, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 34, Obulongoofu mu by’Okwegatta. Yeerabirwa eyo. Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli annyonnyola emyaka egyo: “Yusufu eyatundibwa ng’omuddu, ebigere bye ne binuubulwa enjegere ze baamusibya, obulago bwe ne buteekebwa mu byuma, okutuusa bye yategeeza lwe byatuukirira, okutuusa ekigambo kya Mukama lwe kyamukakasa nti bye yayogera bya mazima” (Zabbuli 105:17-19).

“Okutuusa ekigambo kya Mukama lwe kyamukakasa.” Mu myaka egyo gyonna ekigambo kya Mukama kyali kimugezesa era nga kimulongoosa: nga zaabu mu muliro, Yusufu yali alongoosebwa. Yali wa myaka amakumi asatu bwe yayimirira mu maaso ga Falaawo (Olubereberye 41:46). Emyaka nga kkumi n’esatu gyali giyiseewo okuva ku birooto bye. Naye ne mu kkomera, “Mukama n’abeera ne Yusufu” (Olubereberye 39:21). Yaweereza n’obwesigwa we yali. Yalabirira abasibe abalala. Yabategeeza amakulu g’ebirooto byabwe. Era ekiseera bwe kyatuuka, yali mwetegefu okukulembera eggwanga mu njala.

Emyaka bwe gyayitawo, Yusufu yasobola okutunula emabega n’agamba baganda be nti, “Mwagenderera okunnumya, naye Katonda n’akifuula ekirungi, n’akikozesa abantu baleme okufa” (Olubereberye 50:20).

Yesu: emyaka amakumi asatu e Nazaaleesi

Emyaka egikwekeddwa egisinga okwewuunyisa gya Yesu. Omwana wa Katonda ow’emirembe n’emirembe yabeera emyaka nga amakumi asatu mu kabuga akatono abantu ke baanyoomanga. Kumpi tetulina kye tumanyi ku myaka egyo. Lukka atubuulira kino kyokka: “N’asituka n’agenda nabo e Nazaaleesi, n’abagonderanga; … Awo Yesu n’akula mu mubiri, mu magezi, era n’alaba ekisa mu maaso ga Katonda ne mu maaso g’abantu” (Lukka 2:51-52). Bwe yatandika okubuulira, abantu b’e Nazaaleesi baagamba nti, “Ono si ye mwana w’omubazzi? Maliyamu si ye nnyina” (Makko 6:3).

Okumala emyaka amakumi asatu, Omulokozi w’ensi yakola enzigi, emmeeza n’ebyuma ebirima. Yagondera bazadde be. Yakola n’emikono gye. “Yesu yali awezezza emyaka ng’amakumi asatu bwe yatandika omulimu gwe” (Lukka 3:23). Obuweereza bwe obw’olwatu bwamala emyaka nga esatu gyokka. Emyaka gye egikwekeddwa gyali emirundi kkumi okusingawo.

Era ku nkomerero y’emyaka egyo egikwekeddwa, nga tannabuulira kubuulira na kumu wadde okukola eky’amagero na kimu, Kitaawe yayogera okuva mu ggulu bwe yabatizibwa: “Ggwe Mwana wange omwagalwa, ggwe, gwe nsanyukira ennyo” (Makko 1:11). Kitaawe yali asanyukira emyaka egikwekeddwa. Yesu bwe yamatira okumala emyaka amakumi asatu nga tamanyiddwa, naffe tetusaanidde kuggwaamu bugumiikiriza ku gyaffe.

Pawulo ne Dawudi: bateekebwateekebwa awatali abalaba

Pawulo bwe yamala okusisinkana Kristo ku kkubo erigenda e Ddamasiko, teyapapira kwettutumya. “Sseebuuza ku muntu n’omu, … naye nagenda mu Buwalabu era oluvannyuma ne nkomawo e Damasiko. Awo bwe waayitawo emyaka esatu ne ŋŋenda e Yerusaalemi” (Abaggalatiya 1:16-18). Oluvannyuma lw’okukyala okumpi, yaddayo ewaabwe e Taluso, era okumala emyaka mingi tetuwulira kinene ku ye. Ku nkomerero, Lukka atubuulira nti, “Balunabba n’alaga e Taluso okunoonya Sawulo, bwe yamulaba n’amuleeta mu Antiyokiya” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 11:25-26). Engendo za Pawulo ennene ez’obuminsani zaatandika emyaka egisukka mu kkumi oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka kwe.

Dawudi yafukibwako amafuta okuba kabaka ng’akyali mulenzi. Nnabbi Samwiri bwe yajja, kitaawe teyalowooza n’akatono kumuyita: “Ekyasigaddeyo asingira ddala obuto, alunda ndiga” (1 Samwiri 16:11). Dawudi yaddayo eri endiga. Oluvannyuma okumala emyaka mingi yaweereza Sawulo era n’amudduka. Naye emyaka egikwekeddwa gyamubumba. “Yalonda Dawudi omuweereza we; n’amuggya mu kulunda endiga. … N’abalabirira n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa, n’abakulembera n’amagezi g’emikono gye” (Zabbuli 78:70, 72). Obukugu bw’omusumba bwafuuka obukugu bwa kabaka.

Katonda by’akola mu myaka egikwekeddwa

Lwaki Katonda atera okulindiriza abakulembeze be? Bayibuli eraga ensonga nnyingi.

  • Azimba empisa nga tannawa kifo kya lwatu. Ebirabo bisobola okukula amangu. Empisa zikula mpola. Omukulembeze ng’ekirabo kye kisinga empisa ze, lumu ajja kugwa.
  • Aggyawo okwekkiririzaamu. Musa yalina okufiirwa okwesiga kwe yennyini nga tannasobola kwesiga Katonda mu bujjuvu.
  • Agezesa obwesigwa. “Omuntu omwesigwa mu kintu ekitono, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene” (Lukka 16:10). Katonda atunuulira kye tukola n’ebintu ebitono.
  • Ayigiriza obukugu. Dawudi yayiga okulwanyisa empologoma n’eddubu ng’ali n’endiga. Musa yayiga eddungu. Yesu yayiga okukola.
  • Asimbira emirandira gyaffe wansi ennyo. Omukulembeze eyayiga okutambula ne Katonda nga tewali amulaba ajja kuyimirira ng’embuyaga zijja.
  • Ateekateeka ekiseera. “Kubanga okwolesebwa okwo kujja mu kiseera kyakwo ekigere. … Bwe kunaaba ng’okuluddewo, mukulindirire, kujja kutuukirira, tekugya kulwa” (Kaabakuuku 2:3).

Isaaya annyonnyola Omuweereza wa Mukama ng’agamba nti, “Yanfuula akasaale akazigule era nankweka mu mufuko gwe” (Isaaya 49:2). Akasaale akali mu mufuko kaba kakwekeddwa. Naye tekaba keerabiddwa. Kaba kakuumibwa nga kategefu olw’ekiseera omulasi ky’alonda.

Tonyoomanga ntandikwa ntono

Abaawaŋŋangusibwa bwe baakomawo e Yerusaalemi ne batandika okuddamu okuzimba yeekaalu, abamu ku bakadde baakaaba. Ekizimbe ekiggya kyali kitono nnyo bw’okigeraageranya ku yeekaalu ennene eya Sulemaani. Naye Katonda yayogera ng’ayita mu nnabbi Zekkaliya: “Ani anyooma olunaku olw’ebintu ebitono?” (Zekkaliya 4:10).

Abakulembeze bangi leero baweereza mu bifo ebitono: ekkanisa y’omu kyalo ey’abantu amakumi abiri, okusoma Bayibuli mu maka, ekibiina ky’abaana, obuweereza tewali abuwulirangako. Bayinza okuwulira nti omulimu gwabwe tegulina mugaso. Naye Katonda tapima nga ffe bwe tupima. Yesu yageraageranya obwakabaka bwa Katonda ku kaweke ka kaladaali: “Kaladaali kaweke katono nnyo okusinga ensigo endala zonna”, naye kakula ne kavaamu omuti omunene (Matayo 13:31-32).

Zino ze zimu ku ngeri z’okuba omwesigwa mu myaka egikwekeddwa:

  • Kola bulungi omulimu oguli mu maaso go. “Buli kye mukola mukikole ng’abakolera Mukama waffe so si abantu” (Abakkolosaayi 3:23).
  • Tambula ne Katonda mu kyama. “Kitaawo amanyi ebyama byonna alikuwa empeera” (Matayo 6:4).
  • Yiga. Soma, weekenneenye, buuza ebibuuzo, era oyige okuva ku bakulembeze abakulu.
  • Weereza wansi w’abalala. Nga Yoswa wansi wa Musa ne Erisa wansi wa Eriya, yiga ng’oweereza okwolesebwa kw’omuntu omulala.
  • Teweesindika mu maaso. Leka Katonda aggule enzigi. Okusindika enzigi z’ataggudde kituusa ku kulemererwa okwo okwatuuka ku Musa ku myaka amakumi ana.
  • Lindirira n’essuubi. “Lindirira Mukama. Ddamu amaanyi, ogume omwoyo. Weewaawo, lindirira Mukama” (Zabbuli 27:14).

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Brother Lawrence ne Josephine Bakhita

Mu Ssuula 15, Okuwummula, Okwawukana ku Balala, n’Enteekateeka y’Obulamu, twasisinkana Brother Lawrence, mumonaki Omufalansa ow’emyaka gya 1600 eyamala emyaka mingi ng’akola mu ffumbiro ly’ennyumba y’abamonaki mu Paris. Teyafuna kifo kya waggulu n’akatono. Yafumbanga emmere, oluvannyuma n’atunga engatto. Kyokka abantu baavanga wala okuyiga okuva gy’ali engeri y’okubeera mu maaso ga Katonda. The Practice of the Presence of God (Okwegezaamu Okubeera mu Maaso ga Katonda), ekiri ku Ochorus, kiwandiika nti yasanyukanga bwe yasobolanga okulondawo akasubi ku ttaka “olw’okwagala Katonda, ng’anoonya Ye yekka, so si kirala kyonna, wadde ebirabo bye.” Tewaali kintu kitono nnyo nti tekiyinza kukolebwa ku lwa Katonda. Effumbiro eryali erikwekeddwa lyafuuka ekifo eky’okusinza.

Josephine Bakhita yazaalibwa mu Darfur, mu kitundu ekiri mu Sudan leero, awo nga mu 1869. Bwe yali akyali mwana muto, yawambibwa abasuubuzi b’abaddu. Ekyamutuukako kyamukankanya nnyo ne yeerabira n’erinnya lye. Abaamuwamba baamutuuma Bakhita, ekitegeeza “ow’omukisa”. Yatundibwa emirundi egiwerako era n’ayisibwa bubi nnyo, era omubiri gwe gwasigaza enkovu z’ebyo obulamu bwe bwonna. Mu 1883 yagulibwa omukungu Omuyitale era oluvannyuma n’atwalibwa e Yitale, gye yakolera ng’omulezi w’abaana.

E Venice, yateekebwa okumala ekiseera mu kibiina ky’abakyala abaweereza Katonda, Ababiikira ba Canossa. Eyo yayiga ku Yesu, n’amwagala. Mukama we omukazi bwe yayagala okumuzzaayo mu Afirika, Bakhita yagaana okugenda, era mu 1889 kkooti y’e Yitale n’esala nti yali wa ddembe, kubanga obuddu bwali tebukkirizibwa mu Yitale. Wiiki ntono oluvannyuma, mu Janwali 1890, yabatizibwa n’atwala erinnya Josephine. Yasalawo okusigala n’ababiikira, era oluvannyuma n’afuuka omu ku bo.

Okumala emyaka egisukka mu amakumi ana yabeera mu nnyumba y’ababiikira mu kabuga akatono ak’e Yitale ak’e Schio. Yafumbanga, yatunganga era yakolanga emiddalizo, era okumala emyaka mingi ye yali omukuumi w’omulyango. Ye yaggulirangawo abagenyi n’abaavu oluggi. Abaana b’omu kabuga baamwagalanga nnyo. Yali mukkakkamu, musanyufu era ng’ajjudde okusaba. Ajjukirwa olw’okugamba nti singa yali asisinkanye abasajja abaamuwamba ne bamutulugunya, yandifukamidde n’anywegera emikono gyabwe, kubanga singa si bo teyandimanyi Yesu. Yafa mu 1947. Mu 2000 Ekkanisa Katoliki yamussaamu ekitiibwa ng’omutukuvu, era afuuse akabonero k’essuubi eri abantu bangi abaatundibwa oba abaafuulibwa abaddu.

Bakhita teyabuulira bibiina binene wadde okukulembera kibiina kinene. Obulamu bwe yabumala mu buweereza obukwekeddwa ku mulyango gw’ennyumba y’ababiikira. Kyokka obwesigwa bwe obusirifu, okusonyiwa kwe n’essanyu lye bikutte ku bantu mu nsi yonna.

Tewali kiseera kifa bwereere

Musa yalina emyaka gye amakumi ana n’endiga. Yusufu yalina ekkomera lye. Yesu yalina Nazaaleesi. Pawulo yalina Buwalabu ne Taluso. Dawudi yalina ebiyumba by’endiga. Tewali na kimu ku biseera bino ekyafa obwereere.

Bw’oba ng’oli mu kiseera ekikwekeddwa kaakano, guma omwoyo. Tewerabiddwa. Oli kasaale mu mufuko gwa Katonda. Kola omulimu oguli mu maaso go, tambula ne Katonda awatali akulaba, era olindirire ekiseera kye. Era Katonda bw’atakuleeta mu lwatu n’akatono, ekyo nakyo si kulemererwa. Bangi ku baweereza be abasinga obukulu baabeera era ne bafiira mu bifo ebikwekeddwa, era Kitaawe alaba mu kyama alibasasula mu lwatu.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Okuva 2:11-15 ne 3:1-11. Musa yali wa njawulo atya ku myaka kinaana okusinga bwe yali ku myaka amakumi ana?
  • Soma Zabbuli 105:17-19. Kitegeeza ki nti mu myaka egyo “ekigambo kya Mukama” kyalongoosa Yusufu, okutuusa “lwe kyamukakasa”?
  • Yesu yamala emyaka nga amakumi asatu e Nazaaleesi nga tannatandika buweereza bwe obw’olwatu. Kino kikuyigiriza ki ku kiseera kya Katonda?
  • Oli mu kiseera ekikwekeddwa kaakano? Kiki Katonda ky’ayinza okuba ng’akola mu ggwe ng’ayita mu kyo?
  • “Ntandikwa ntono” ki mu buweereza bwo z’okemebwa okunyooma?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga okuva mu ffumbiro lya Brother Lawrence ne ku mulyango gwa Bakhita?
  • Oli mwesigwa we watali akulaba?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno, londa omulimu gumu omutono, ogukwekeddwa, mu kkanisa yo oba mu kitundu kyo ogutaliiko ajja kukwebaza: okuyonja, okukyalira abantu, okufumba, okuddaabiriza oba okusaba. Gukole n’obwegendereza, ku lwa Mukama. Tobuulirako muntu yenna. Oluvannyuma mala ekiseera ne Katonda ng’omwebaza olw’ebiseera ebikwekeddwa eby’obulamu bwo okutuusa kati, era omubuuze ky’ayagala okukuyigiriza mu kino.

study_questions.question: Lwaki Katonda awa abakulembeze emyaka egikwekeddwa?
study_questions.answer: Okubateekateeka. Musa yamala emyaka amakumi ana n’endiga nga tannakulembera Isirayiri (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 7:30), Yusufu yalongoosebwa mu kkomera, ne Yesu yabeera emyaka amakumi asatu e Nazaaleesi. Omuweereza wa Katonda agamba nti Katonda “yanfuula akasaale akazigule era nankweka mu mufuko gwe” (Isaaya 49:2).

study_questions.question: Katonda akola ki mu myaka egikwekeddwa?
study_questions.answer: Atwetoowaza, azimba empisa zaffe mu buziba, atuyigiriza okwesigama ku ye era atutendeka okuba abeesigwa mu bintu ebitono. Musa, eyali yeekakasa edda, yafuuka omusajja eyabuuza nti, “Nange nze ani agenda ewa Falaawo nziggyeyo abaana ba Isirayiri mu Misiri?” (Okuva 3:11).

study_questions.question: Nnyinza ntya okuweereza n’obwesigwa nga tewali akiraba?
study_questions.answer: Ng’okola emirimu emitono ku lwa Katonda so si lwa kutenderezebwa. Brother Lawrence yasanga Katonda mu nsuwa n’entamu, ne Josephine Bakhita yaweereza okumala emyaka mingi ng’omukuumi w’omulyango. Tewali kiseera na Katonda kifa bwereere.

fields.title: Amaka g’Omukulembeze
fields.body_html:
“Naye nze n’ennyumba yange, ffe tunaaweerezanga Mukama Katonda.”

— Yoswa 24:15

Mu byalo bingi waliwo olugero olukwata ku baana b’omukozi w’engatto: be batambula enkya n’eggulo nga tebambadde ngatto. Omukozi w’engatto akolera ekyalo kyonna engatto, naye aba n’emirimu mingi nnyo n’atafuna budde kukolera ngatto ab’omu maka ge.

Amaka mangi ag’abakulembeze gamanyi bulungi enneewulira eyo. Omusumba akyalira buli mulwadde mu kkanisa, naye tatuula ku mabbali g’ekitanda ky’omwana we ye. Omukulembeze abuulirira buli bufumbo obulimu ebizibu, naye talina budde eri bba we. Omuminsani atuusa Enjiri ku ggwanga lyonna, naye abaana be ye n’abafiirwa. Essuula eno etandika Ekitundu eky’Omwenda: Obulamu bw’Omukulembeze. Tutandikira waka, kubanga ekisibo ekisooka eky’omukulembeze ge maka ge ye.

Amaka mu Byawandiikibwa

Okuva ku lubereberye, Katonda yawa amaka ekifo ekikulu mu kukwasa abalala okukkiriza. Musa yagamba Isirayiri nti, “Amateeka gano ge nkuwa leero ogakwatanga ku mutima gwo. Ogayigirizanga abaana bo n’obwegendereza. Ogoogerengako bw’onoobanga otudde mu maka go, ne bw’onoobanga otambula mu kkubo, bw’onoobanga ogalamiddeko, ne bw’onoobanga ogolokose” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 6:6-7). Okukkiriza kwalina okuyigirizibwa si mu weema ey’okukuŋŋaanirangamu kyokka, wabula ne ku mmeeza, mu kkubo, ne mu kiseera eky’okugenda okwebaka.

Yoswa, ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwe, yayimirira mu maaso ga Isirayiri yonna n’asalawo ku lw’amaka ge gonna: “mulondeewo leero gwe munaaweerezanga … Naye nze n’ennyumba yange, ffe tunaaweerezanga Mukama Katonda” (Yoswa 24:15). Nga tannakulembera ggwanga, yasooka kukulembera maka ge.

Pawulo kino yakifuula ekisaanyizo ky’abakulembeze b’ekkanisa: “Ateekwa kuba ng’afuga bulungi amaka ge, abaana be nga bamuwulira, era nga bamussaamu ekitiibwa. Kubanga omuntu atasobola kufuga maka ge, alisobola atya okulabirira ekkanisa ya Katonda?” (1 Timoseewo 3:4-5). Amaka kifo kya kutendekebwamu era kifo kya kugezesebwamu. Engeri gye tukulemberamu awaka eraga engeri gye tunaakulemberamu mu kkanisa. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 8, Obwesigwa: Omuntu Omu ne mu Kyama, omukulembeze ateekwa okuba omuntu y’omu awaka ne ku kituuti. Dawudi yagamba nti, “Nnaabeeranga mu nnyumba yange nga siriiko kya kunenyezebwa” (Zabbuli 101:2).

Eri ne Samwiri: okulabula
