Mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu, twalaba ekibi kya batabani ba Eri, n’engeri Eri gye yali amanyi bye baali bakola, “n’akimanya naye n’atabaziyiza” (1 Samwiri 3:13). Eri yali kabona era omulamuzi. Yaweereza mu nnyumba ya Katonda okumala emyaka mingi. Yatendeka n’omulenzi Samwiri. Naye yalemererwa batabani be ye.

Ekinakuwaza kiri nti Samwiri naye oluvannyuma yakola ensobi y’emu. “Samwiri bwe yakaddiwa, n’alonda batabani be okuba abalamuzi ba Isirayiri. … Naye batabani be ne batagoberera mpisa ze, ne bakyama ne banoonya amagoba, ne balya enguzi, era nga tebalamula mu bwenkanya” (1 Samwiri 8:1, 3). Samwiri yali omu ku bakulembeze abasinga obukulu mu byafaayo bya Isirayiri. Naye batabani be baali boonoonefu nnyo, abantu ne babakozesa ng’ensonga y’okusaba kabaka.

Ne bakulembeze abalungi basobola okulagajjalira amaka gaabwe. Obuweereza obulimu emirimu mingi, obwesigwa era obulimu obuwanguzi, tebukuuma muntu. Omukulembeze ateekwa okusalawo, emirundi n’emirundi, okuwa ab’omu maka ge obudde, okubafaako n’okubaagala.

Obufumbo: okwagala nga Kristo bwe yayagala

Eri abakulembeze abali mu bufumbo, obufumbo gwe mutima gw’amaka. Pawulo yawandiikira abakkiriza bonna nti, “Mutyenga Kristo, nga muwuliragananga” (Abaefeso 5:21). Oluvannyuma n’awa abaami ekiragiro omusajja omufumbo yenna ky’atakwatangako mu bujjuvu: “Nammwe abaami mwagalenga bakyala bammwe nga Kristo bwe yayagala Ekkanisa ne yeewaayo ku lwayo” (Abaefeso 5:25). Okwagala kwa Kristo kye kyokulabirako: kugumiikiriza, kwewaayo, kwesigwa era kuweereza. Pawulo era yalabula nti, “Nammwe abaami mwagalenga bakyala bammwe era mubakwasenga kisa so si bukambwe” (Abakkolosaayi 3:19). Peetero yagamba abaami okubeera ne bakyala baabwe nga “mubakwatenga n’obwegendereza”, n’okubassaamu ekitiibwa “nga mumanyi nga nabo Katonda alibaweera wamu nammwe, obulamu obutaggwaawo. Bwe munaakolanga bwe mutyo okusaba kwammwe tekuziyizibwenga” (1 Peetero 3:7).

Weetegereze ebigambo ebyo ebisembayo. Engeri omukulembeze gy’ayisaamu munne gw’afumbiriganwa naye ekwata ku bulamu bwe obw’okusaba. Omukulembeze tasobola kuba mukambwe awaka n’asuubira okuba n’amaanyi mu kusaba.

Bino bye bimu ku bubonero bw’obufumbo bw’omukulembeze obulamu obulungi.

  • Obudde awamu. Obudde obukuumibwa obw’okwogera, okuwummula n’okusanyukira awamu, so si obw’okwogera ku bizibu by’ekkanisa byokka.
  • Okukolera awamu. Abakulembeze bangi abakulu baali bafumbiriganwa n’abantu abaali bakolera wamu nabo omulimu. Pawulo yalamusa ng’agamba nti, “Mundabire Pulisikira ne Akula, bwe tukola omulimu mu Kristo Yesu” (Abaruumi 16:3). Bombi baayigiriza Apolo, mu maka gaabwe (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 18:26).
  • Ekitiibwa mu lwatu. Yogeranga bulungi ku munno mu bufumbo mu maaso g’abalala. Tomufuulanga wa kusekererwa mu kubuulira.
  • Obwesigwa. Bbugwe w’obukuumi twamulaba mu Ssuula 34, Obulongoofu mu by’Okwegatta.
  • Eddembe. Munne w’omusumba gw’afumbiriganwa naye si mukozi wa kkanisa atasasulwa. Alina ebirabo bye n’okuyitibwa kwe, era tasaanidde kuwalirizibwa kukola mulimu ekkanisa gw’esuubira.
  • Obwerufu. Mubuuliraganenga ebibakaluubirira, nga bwe kiba eky’amagezi.

Abaana: okubakuza mu Mukama

“Nammwe abazadde, temunyigirizanga baana bammwe, wabula mubakuze nga mubagunjula era nga mubayigiriza ebya Mukama waffe” (Abaefeso 6:4). “Nammwe bakitaabwe temunyiizanga baana bammwe baleme okuddirira mu mwoyo” (Abakkolosaayi 3:21). Ebigambo bino tebikoma ku bataata bokka; bikwata ne ku bamaama.

Abaana b’abakulembeze boolekagana n’okunyigirizibwa okw’enjawulo. Buli muntu abatunuulira. Basuubirwa okuba nga tebalina kamogo. Ebizibu by’ekkanisa babiraba okumpi ddala. Bayinza okuwulira nti omuzadde waabwe ayagala ekkanisa okubasinga. Abamu bakaawa ku Katonda olw’engeri ekkanisa gye yayisaamu omuzadde waabwe.

Abakulembeze bayinza batya okuyamba abaana baabwe?

  • Beeranga nabo. Abaana beetaaga obudde bwo, so si ssente zo oba okubuulirira kwo kwokka. Mulye wamu. Muzannye wamu. Genda ku mikolo gyabwe. Teeka wansi essimu.
  • Okukkiriza kubeere kwa ddala awaka. Musabire wamu, musome Bayibuli wamu, era mwogere ku Katonda mu ngeri ey’obulijjo, “bw’onoobanga otudde mu maka go, ne bw’onoobanga otambula mu kkubo”. Bakulabe ng’osaba, ng’weenenya era ng’weesiga Katonda.
  • Tobakozesanga ng’ebyokulabirako. Tofuulanga bulamu bw’abaana bo byakulabirako mu kubuulira nga tebakuwadde lukusa.
  • Bakuumenga eri ebyo ekkanisa by’ebasuubiramu. Baleke babe baana. Si basumba batono.
  • Bakuumenga eri enkaayana z’ekkanisa. Toyiwanga busungu bwo ku bammemba b’ekkanisa ku mmeeza ng’olya ekyeggulo.
  • Saba bakusonyiwe. Bw’olemererwa abaana bo, bategeeze nti osonyiwe. Kino kibayigiriza bingi ku Njiri okusinga okubuulira kungi.

Amaka bwe gataba nga tegalina kamogo

Tewali maka ga mukulembeze agatalina kamogo. Abakulembeze abamu balina abaana abava ku Katonda, ne bwe baakuzibwa n’okwagala. Abamu balina bannaabwe mu bufumbo abatakkiriza. Abamu bannamwandu oba baayawukana. Abamu beegomba abaana naye tebalina. Abamu bazadde abakuza abaana bokka. Abamu beetisse ebiwundu eby’amaanyi okuva mu buto bwabwe.

Ekisa kituuka ne mu maka gano. Timoseewo, omukulembeze omuvubuka omukulu, yava mu maka nga kitaawe, nga bwe kirabika, teyali mukkiriza. Pawulo yamujjukiza “okukkiriza kwo okw’amazima olubereberye okwali mu jjajjaawo Looyi ne mukadde wo Ewuniike” (2 Timoseewo 1:5). Katonda yakolera mu maama ne jjajja mu maka omwali abakkiriza n’abatakkiriza.

Bw’oba n’omwana eyabula, jjukira kitaawe mu lugero lwa Yesu, eyatunuuliranga ekkubo buli lunaku. “Naye bwe yali ng’akyaliko wala n’awaka, kitaawe n’amulengera ng’ajja, n’amusaasira nnyo. Kitaawe ng’ajjudde amaziga n’amusisinkana” (Lukka 15:20). Weeyongere okusaba. Weeyongere okwagala. Oluggi lulekenga nga luggule. Omwana by’asalawo si bulijjo nti kuba kulemererwa kwa muzadde.

Ekkanisa nazo zirina okwegendereza. Ekisaanyizo ekiri mu 1 Timoseewo 3 kikwata ku ngeri omukulembeze gy’akulemberamu amaka ge, so si oba buli mwana avaamu nga talina kamogo. Ekkanisa tesaanidde kubonereza mukulembeze mwesigwa olw’ebyo omwana omukulu by’asalawo mu ddembe lye. Naye amaka g’omukulembeze bwe gaba mu buzibu obw’amaanyi, emirundi mingi kiba kya magezi omukulembeze oyo okuva ku mulimu okumala ekiseera n’asooka okulabirira amaka ge.

Amagezi ag’omugaso eri amaka g’omukulembeze

  • Amaka go gateeke mu kitabo kyo eky’enteekateeka. Obudde bw’amaka go bwe butategekebwa, ekkanisa ejja kubujjuza.
  • Funa olunaku olw’okuwummula buli wiiki, era ekitundu kyalwo okimale n’ab’omu maka go.
  • Mugende mu luwummula wamu, ne bwe luba lwa bulijjo.
  • Yiga okugamba nti nedda. Si buli kye bakusaba nti kuba kuyitibwa kwa Katonda. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu, mugabane emirimu oleme kubeera bulijjo ng’oli bweru.
  • Buuza ab’omu maka go bwe bali. Buuza munno mu bufumbo n’abaana bo abakulu nti, “Owulira nti ofuna ekisinga obulungi mu nze, oba ebyo byokka ebisigaddewo?” Wuliriza eky’okuddamu.
  • Amaka go gafuule kifo kya kwaniriza. Okusembeza abagenyi kuyinza okuba essanyu ab’omu maka bonna lye bagabana, so si mugugu ku muntu omu.
  • Ekkanisa, mulabirire amaka g’abakulembeze bammwe. Musasule abakulembeze bammwe ekimala okulabirira amaka gaabwe (1 Timoseewo 5:8). Mukuume ennaku zaabwe ez’okuwummula. Temusuubira munne gw’afumbiriganwa naye n’abaana okuba nga tebalina kamogo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Jonathan ne Sarah Edwards, ne William ne Catherine Booth

Jonathan Edwards, omusumba era omulowoozi ow’e New England gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 31, Okukulembera mu Kuzuukuka n’Enkyukakyuka, yawasa Sarah Pierpont mu 1727. Baazaala abaana kkumi na omu. Edwards yali muyivu eyamalanga essaawa nnyingi buli lunaku mu kisenge kye eky’okusomeramu. Naye buli kawungeezi yasomeranga ab’omu maka ge era n’asaba nabo. Sarah yaddukanyanga amaka amakulu ag’abantu kkumi na basatu, ng’abagenyi tebakoma kujja, era yali mukazi wa kusaba okw’amaanyi. Buli abaabamanya bagamba nti obufumbo bwabwe bwalimu essanyu eritali lya bulijjo. Naye tuteekwa n’okwogera amazima, nga ekitabo kya Ochorus Key Teachings of Jonathan Edwards (Enjigiriza Enkulu za Jonathan Edwards) bwe kikola, nti ab’omu maka ago baalina abantu be baafuula abaddu, era omulimu gwabwe gwe gwasobozesa Edwards okufuna essaawa ezo ez’okusoma. Ne maka agatya Katonda gayinza obutalaba kibi kinene, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 30, Obwenkanya, Okusaasira n’Abaavu.

Mu 1758 Edwards yafuuka akulira ettendekero ly’e Princeton. Yali amazeeyo wiiki ntono zokka n’afa, oluvannyuma lw’okugemebwa ennamba okwagenda obubi. Sarah teyali naye. Ekitabo ekyo kye kimu kyogera nti, ng’anaatera okufa, yalekera Sarah obubaka ku “bumu obutali bwa bulijjo” obwali wakati waabwe, n’essuubi lye nti bwandigenze mu maaso emirembe gyonna. Sarah bwe yawulira amawulire, yawandiika nti Katonda yali amusobozesezza okusinza obulungi bwe olw’okubawa omwami we okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo, era nti ye n’abaana be baali balekeddwa mu mikono gya Katonda. Sarah naye yafa oluvannyuma lw’emyezi mukaaga. Obufumbo bwabwe bwali kukolera wamu mu kukkiriza, abaana baabwe kwe bataayerabira.

William ne Catherine Booth baatandika Eggye ly’Obulokozi mu London mu kyasa ekya kkumi n’omwenda. Baafumbiriganwa mu 1855 ne bazaala abaana munaana, era abamu ku bo oluvannyuma baakulembera Eggye ku ssemazinga basatu. Nga Key Teachings of Catherine Booth (Enjigiriza Enkulu za Catherine Booth), ekiri ku Ochorus, bwe kinnyonnyola, okuva ku ntandikwa “yali amuwa amagezi nga bwe yali munne mu bulamu.” Baawakananga, baasabanga era baateekateekanga wamu. Catherine naye yali mubuulizi mukulu ku lulwe, era omulimu baagwetikka nga bakolera wamu ddala. Amaka gaabwe tegaali ga kasirise wadde ag’obwangu. Naye abaana baabwe baabakuliza mu mulimu, so si wala nagwo, era abaana baabwe baalina okwagala okw’amaanyi eri abaavu nga bazadde baabwe.

Tewali n’amu ku maka ago agaali gatalina kamogo. Naye gombi galaga nti obuweereza obukulu n’amaka ag’okwagala si balabe. Bisobola okuwagira buli kimu kinnaakyo.

Mukama bw’atazimba nnyumba

“Mukama bw’atazimba nnyumba, abo abagizimba bazimbira bwereere” (Zabbuli 127:1). Abakulembeze bazimba ebintu bingi: ekkanisa, obuweereza, enteekateeka n’ebizimbe. Naye tewali buwanguzi mu buweereza busobola kuliyirira maka agalagajjaliddwa.

Ab’omu maka go si kintu ekikuwugula okuva ku buweereza bwo. Kitundu ku buweereza bwo, era kye kitundu ekisooka. Bawe ekisinga obulungi mu ggwe, so si ebyo byokka ebisigaddewo. Era weesige Mukama okuzimba ennyumba yo.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 6:4-9. Okukkiriza kuyigirizibwa kutya mu maka go, ku mmeeza, mu kkubo ne mu kiseera eky’okwebaka?
  • Soma 1 Samwiri 3:13 ne 8:1-5. Olowooza lwaki Eri ne Samwiri baalemererwa ku batabani baabwe?
  • Bw’oba oli mu bufumbo, munno mu bufumbo yandinnyonnyodde atya engeri gy’omwagalamu? Mubuuze.
  • Abaana bo bawulira nti ekkanisa ebasooka?
  • Kunyigirizibwa ki abaana b’abakulembeze kwe boolekagana nakwo mu kkanisa yo oba mu buwangwa bwo? Ekkanisa yo eyinza kubayamba etya?
  • Amaka go bwe gataba nga bwe wali osuubira, ekisa kya Katonda kikusisinkana kitya awo?
  • Kiki ky’oyigira ku ba Edwards ne ba Booth?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wiiki eno, tuula wansi n’ekitabo kyo eky’enteekateeka oteekeyo obudde bw’ab’omu maka go: olunaku olw’okuwummula, ekijjulo awamu, okutambulako oba akawungeezi awaka. Bukuume n’obwegendereza nga bw’okuuma olukiiko n’omugenyi omukulu. Bw’oba oli mu bufumbo, buuza munno mu bufumbo nti, “Owulira nti ofuna ekisinga obulungi mu nze, oba ebyo byokka ebisigaddewo?” era owulirize nga teweewolereza. Bw’oba olina abaana, babuuze kiki kye basinga okunyumirwa okukola naawe, era okikole wiiki eno.

study_questions.question: Lwaki amaka g’omukulembeze makulu?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga omukulembeze “ateekwa kuba ng’afuga bulungi amaka ge” (1 Timoseewo 3:4), era kubanga amaka kye kifo ekisooka okukkiriza we kubeerwamu ne we kuyigirizibwa: “Ogayigirizanga abaana bo n’obwegendereza” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 6:7). “Naye nze n’ennyumba yange, ffe tunaaweerezanga Mukama Katonda” (Yoswa 24:15).

study_questions.question: Okulabula ki amaka ga Eri kwe gawa abakulembeze?
study_questions.answer: Eri yaweereza Katonda mu lwatu naye n’alemererwa okukola ku kibi kya batabani be; “n’akimanya naye n’atabaziyiza” (1 Samwiri 3:13). Ne batabani ba Samwiri “ne batagoberera mpisa ze” (1 Samwiri 8:3). Abakulembeze tebasaanidde kuwa kkanisa ekisinga obulungi ate ab’omu maka ne babawa ebyo byokka ebisigaddewo.

study_questions.question: Watya singa amaka g’omukulembeze tegaba nga tegalina kamogo?
study_questions.answer: Tewali maka ng’ago. Essuula eyogera n’ekisa eri abakulembeze abaana baabwe be baawaba oba obufumbo bwabwe bwe buli mu kalumwa, ebakubiriza okunoonya obuyambi, era esonga ku Jonathan ne Sarah Edwards ne William ne Catherine Booth, mu mazima, n’obunafu bwabwe.

fields.title: Okuweereza ng’Oli Omu Ataali mu Bufumbo
fields.body_html:
“Kubanga njagala musobole okuweereza Mukama nga tewali birala bibaziyiza okweweerayo ddala.”

— 1 Abakkolinso 7:35

Mu buwangwa bungi, omuntu atali mu bufumbo ayisibwa ng’atannafuuka muntu mukulu mujjuvu. Ku nkuŋŋaana z’ab’oluganda, bamubuuza emirundi n’emirundi nti, “Onoowasa ddi?” oba “Onoofumbirwa ddi?” Mu kkanisa bayinza okumuwa omulimu gw’abaana, naye ne batamuwa kifo mu bakulembeze. Abantu bamusaasira, oba bamweraliikirira, oba bagezaako okumunoonyeza omwami oba omukyala. Abamu ku bantu abatali mu bufumbo batandika okuwulira nti obulamu bwabwe tebunnatandika ddala.

Naye Bayibuli eyogera kirala. Mukama Yesu yennyini teyawasa. Omutume Pawulo teyalina mukyala okumala ebbanga eddene ery’obuweereza bwe. Bangi ku bakulembeze, abaminsani n’abaweereza abasinga obukulu mu Kkanisa baaweereza Katonda nga si bafumbo. Mu ssuula ewedde, Essuula 42, Amaka g’Omukulembeze, twatunuulira abakulembeze abalina amaka. Essuula eno etunuulira abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo. Obutaba mu bufumbo si kisenge kya kulindiramu. Kuyitibwa kujjuvu era okw’ekitiibwa.

Yesu, omusajja ataawasa

Oluusi twerabira nti omuntu eyasingira ddala okuba omujjuvu mu bantu bonna abaali babaddewo teyali mufumbo. Yesu teyawasa. Teyalina baana be ku bubwe. Naye obulamu bwe tebwali bwa kitundu, wadde obutali bwa buntu mu bujjuvu. Yalina emikwano egy’okumpi ennyo: Peetero, Yakobo ne Yokaana; Maliyamu, Maliza ne Laazaalo; n’abakazi abaatambulanga naye nga bamuyamba. Yayagalanga abaana. Yali amanyi kye kitegeeza okuwulira ekiwuubaalo, naye teyabeeranga nga talina Kitaawe.

Singa obutaba mu bufumbo bwafuula omuntu obutaba mujjuvu, kale ne Yesu yandibadde si mujjuvu. Naye yali mujjuvu. Ekyo kyokka kisaanidde okukyusa engeri Ekkanisa gy’erowoozaamu ku bantu abatali mu bufumbo.

Pawulo by’ayigiriza: ekirabo n’eddembe

Pawulo ye yawandiika okuyigiriza okusinga obuwanvu mu Bayibuli ku butaba mu bufumbo n’obufumbo, mu 1 Abakkolinso 7. Yagamba nti, “Nandyagadde buli omu abeere nga nze; naye buli muntu alina ekirabo ekikye ku bubwe ekiva eri Katonda, omu mu ngeri emu n’omulala mu ngeri endala” (1 Abakkolinso 7:7). Obufumbo kirabo. N’obutaba mu bufumbo nakyo kirabo. Tewali kisinga kinnaakyo mu maaso ga Katonda. Byombi kuyitibwa.

Oluvannyuma Pawulo n’annyonnyola omugaso gumu ogw’obutaba mu bufumbo eri obuweereza: “Naye kye mbagaliza mmwe bwe buteraliikirira. Omusajja atali mufumbo yeemalira ku bya Mukama, engeri gy’asanyusa Mukama. Naye omufumbo yeeraliikirira bya nsi, nga bw’anaasanyusa mukazi we; aba yeesazeemu, ng’atta aga n’aga. N’omukazi atali mufumbo n’embeerera bafaayo ku bintu bya Mukama” (1 Abakkolinso 7:32-34). Amangu ago n’ayongerako nti, “Bino mbyogera olw’okubagasa, so si kubaziyiza kuwasa na kufumbirwa” (1 Abakkolinso 7:35). Teyali awaliriza muntu yenna kusigala nga si mufumbo, wadde okugamba nti abafumbo tebeewaayo nnyo. Yali agamba nti abantu abatali mu bufumbo balina eddembe ery’enjawulo ery’okwewaayo eri omulimu gwa Mukama.

Ne Yesu yayogera ku balala abagaana okuwasa “ne beewaayo okukola omulimu ogw’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Buli asobola okutegeera kino akitegeere” (Matayo 19:12).

Abaweereza abatali mu bufumbo mu Byawandiikibwa

Bayibuli ejjudde abantu abatali mu bufumbo Katonda be yakozesa.

  • Yeremiya Katonda yamugamba nti, “Towasa, kuzaalira balenzi na bawala mu kifo kino” (Yeremiya 16:2). Obutaba mu bufumbo bwe bwennyini bwali bubaka eri eggwanga ku musango ogwali gujja.
  • Bawala ba Firipo. Lukka atubuulira nti Firipo omubuulizi w’Enjiri “Yalina abaana be abawala abaali batannafumbirwa bana nga balina ekirabo eky’obunnabbi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 21:9). Baali bamanyiddwa olw’obuweereza bwabwe.
  • Ana bba yafa nga bamaze emyaka musanvu mu bufumbo, n’amala emyaka mingi nnyo nga nnamwandu, ng’aweereza Katonda mu Yeekaalu ng’asiiba era ng’asaba (Lukka 2:36-38). Yali omu ku basooka okutegeera omwana Yesu.
  • Foyibe, Pawulo gwe yayanjulira ekkanisa ey’omu Rooma nga “omuweereza w’ekkanisa ey’omu Kenkereya”, era eyali “yayamba bangi” (Abaruumi 16:1-2), tewali we kyogerwa nti yalina omwami. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 26, Abasajja n’Abakazi mu Mulimu gwa Katonda, Bayibuli ez’Olungereza zaawukana ku ky’okumuyita “omudyakoni” oba “omuweereza”; Bayibuli y’Oluganda gye tukozesa emuyita “omuweereza”.
  • Pawulo yennyini.

Era Katonda awa ekisuubizo eky’enjawulo abo abatalina baana: “amannya gaabwe galijjukirwa mu yeekaalu yange mu bisenge byamu, ng’ekijjukizo n’okusinga bwe mwandibadde n’abaana aboobulenzi n’aboobuwala. Ndibawa erinnya eritaliggwaawo ery’emirembe n’emirembe” (Isaaya 56:5).

Obutaba mu bufumbo bujja mu ngeri nnyingi

Abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo si bonna bafaanagana.

  • Abamu baasalawo obutawasa oba obutafumbirwa, basobole okwewaayo eri omulimu ogumu ogw’enjawulo.
  • Abamu beegomba okuyingira obufumbo naye tebannafuna muntu mutuufu.
  • Abamu bannamwandu, era beetisse ennaku awamu n’okubeera bokka.
  • Abamu baayawukana, era bayinza okuba nga beetisse obulumi, ensonyi oba okulabirira abaana bokka.
  • Abamu tebali mu bufumbo olw’obulwadde, obulemu, obuvunaanyizibwa mu maka, oba olw’obutaba na bakkiriza bamala kufumbiriganwa nabo. Mu kkanisa nnyingi okwetooloola ensi, abakazi abakkiriza bangi nnyo okusinga abasajja abakkiriza.

Buli omu ku bano asaanidde kutegeerwa, so si kulowoozebwako bulowoozi. Ekkanisa tesaanidde kuyisa buli muntu atali mu bufumbo ng’alinda bulinzi bufumbo. Era tesaanidde kugamba abo abeegomba obufumbo nti okwegomba kwabwe kukyamu.

Essanyu n’ebizibu by’abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo

Abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo batera okuba n’eddembe lingi. Basobola okutambula, okusenguka, okwesuula mu bulabe n’okuwaayo obudde mu ngeri ezandibadde enzibu ennyo nga balina amaka. Bangi ku baasooka okutwala Enjiri mu nsi yonna baali si bafumbo, era bangi nnyo ku bo baali bakazi. Baali ba ddembe okugenda mu bifo ebisingayo obuzibu.

Naye abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo nabo boolekagana n’ebizibu ebya ddala.

  • Ekiwuubaalo. Okuddayo mu nnyumba omutali muntu oluvannyuma lw’olunaku oluzibu olw’obuweereza kiyinza okulumya ennyo. Kino twakitunuulira mu Ssuula 37, Ekiwuubaalo n’Emigugu Egikwekeddwa.
  • Okukemebwa mu by’okwegatta. Abantu abatali mu bufumbo bayitibwa okubeera abalongoofu, nga n’abafumbo bwe bayitibwa, era olutalo luyinza okuba oluzibu. Bbugwe w’obukuumi ali mu Ssuula 34, Obulongoofu mu by’Okwegatta, akwata ne ku bakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo.
  • Okukola ennyo okusukkiridde. Olw’okuba tebalina maka agabalindirira awaka, abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo batera okusuubirwa okukola ebisingawo. Abamu tebawummula n’akatono. Ekkanisa eyinza okubayisa ng’abatalina bye beetaaga.
  • Okubuusibwa amaaso. Mu kkanisa ezimu, abantu abatali mu bufumbo tebeesigibwa na bukulembeze, olw’ensonga y’okuba nti si bafumbo kyokka.
  • Okuteeberezebwa n’olugambo. Abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo bayinza okwogerwako eŋŋambo, naddala ku mikwano gyabwe.
  • Okunyigirizibwa. Ebibuuzo ebitakoma ku bufumbo biyinza okulumya ennyo.

Ekkanisa engeri gy’eyinza okuwa ekitiibwa abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo

Yesu yasuubiza nti, “Tewali muntu n’omu eyali yeeresezza ekintu kyonna, ng’amaka, abooluganda, bannyina, nnyina, kitaawe, abaana be, oba ettaka n’amayumba olw’okunjagala n’okubuulira Enjiri, ataliddizibwawo emirundi kikumi mu mulembe guno amaka, abooluganda, bannyina, nnyina, abaana, ettaka awamu n’okuyigganyizibwa!” (Makko 10:29-30). Yesu awa atya “amaka, abooluganda, bannyina, nnyina, abaana” bano? Ng’ayita mu Kkanisa ye. “Katonda afunira abatalina we babeera ekifo eky’okubeeramu” (Zabbuli 68:6). Ekkanisa erina okuba ab’omu maka g’omuntu atali mu bufumbo.

  • Babagattenga mu bulamu bwammwe. Muyitenga abantu abatali mu bufumbo mu maka gammwe ne mu bulamu bw’amaka gammwe. Abaana bammwe babamanye nga bassenga ne bakojja mu Kristo.
  • Mussengamu ekitiibwa okuyitibwa kwabwe. Temuyisanga butaba mu bufumbo ng’ekizibu ekirina okugonjoolwa. Mulekere awo okubuuza nti, “Onoowasa ddi?” oba “Onoofumbirwa ddi?” Mubuuze mu kifo ky’ekyo nti, “Omulimu gwo gutambula gutya? Tukusabire ki?”
  • Mubawenga obukulembeze. Mutegeere era mulonde abantu abatali mu bufumbo abalina ebirabo n’empisa ez’okukulembera, nga Yesu ne Pawulo bwe baakola.
  • Mukuumenga okuwummula kwabwe. Temubatikkanga mirimu mingi kubanga “balina obudde bungi”.
  • Mubawenga omukwano. Mukakase nti abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo balina emikwano egy’okumpi n’ebifo ebitali bya bulabe mwe basobola okugabana emigugu gyabwe.
  • Mulabirirenga bannamwandu n’abaayawukana. Mubeerenga nabo mu nnaku, era muyambe abazadde abakuza abaana bokka mu ngeri ey’ebikolwa, nga mubawa emmere, nga mulabirira abaana baabwe, era nga mubawa omukwano.

Era bw’oba oli mukulembeze atali mu bufumbo, obulamu bwo bukkirize ng’ekirabo. Zimba emikwano egy’amaanyi. Leka abalala bayingire mu bulamu bwo. Wummula. Weewe Mukama mu bujjuvu, “nga tewali birala bibaziyiza okweweerayo ddala”. Osobola okugamba ng’omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli nti, “Mukama, ggwe mugabo gwange, era ggw’oliisa obulamu bwange; … Ensalo zange ziri mu bifo ebisanyusa” (Zabbuli 16:5-6).

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Amy Carmichael ne Mary Slessor

Amy Carmichael, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 10, Okwagala: Ekikukubiriza n’Akabonero, ne mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu, teyafumbirwa n’akatono. Bwe yali omuminsani omuto mu Japan, ng’ali mu myaka amakumi abiri, yagenda yekka mu mpuku ku nsozi okusaba. Yali atya ekiwuubaalo eky’obulamu obutaliimu bufumbo. Ekitabo ky’ebyafaayo bye Amy Carmichael: A Life (Obulamu bwa Amy Carmichael), ekiri ku Ochorus, kyogera engeri gye yaleeta okutya okwo eri Katonda, n’afuna obukakafu okuva mu lunyiriri olusembayo olwa Zabbuli 34, lwe yali amanyi mu Bayibuli ey’Olungereza enkadde eya Authorised Version: “tewali n’omu ku abo abamwesiga aliba mu kiwuubaalo.” Enkyusa ez’omulembe guno, nga mw’otwalidde ne Bayibuli ekitabo kino gye kikozesa, olunyiriri olwo zirukyusa mu ngeri endala, kubanga ekigambo eky’Olwebbulaniya kiyinza okutegeeza okusingibwa omusango era n’okulekebwa awo nga oli wekka. Naye Amy yakitwala ng’ekisuubizo kya Katonda nti talirekebwa yekka. Ekitabo ekyo kyongerako mu mazima nti oluvannyuma yawuliranga ekiwuubaalo emirundi mingi. Naye yagamba nti ekisuubizo kyanywera, era nti teyaddamu kubuusabuusa nti Katonda yandimumalidde.

Mary Slessor, omuminsani Omuskootilandi eyagenda e Calabar, mu kitundu ekiri mu Nigeria leero, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 26, Abasajja n’Abakazi mu Mulimu gwa Katonda, naye yaweereza Katonda nga si mufumbo. Naye emboozi ye eraga nti obutaba mu bufumbo si bulijjo nti busalibwawo mu ngeri nnyangu. Mu 1890, ng’alina emyaka nga amakumi ana mu ebiri, yayogerezebwa omuminsani omuto okumusinga, Charles Morrison. Yateekawo akakwakkulizo kamu: teyandivudde wakati mu bantu b’e Okoyong, gye yali omuminsani yekka. Bwe bandifumbiriganwa, Morrison yandibadde alina okumwegattako eyo. Yawandiikira mukwano gwe nti:

“Byonna mbiteeka mu mikono gya Katonda, era nja kukkiriza kyonna ky’alaba nti kye kisinga obulungi eri omulimu gwe mu Okoyong. Obulamu bwange bwateekebwa ku kyoto kye ku lw’abantu abo edda ennyo, era sandiggyako wadde akatundu akasingayo obutono.”

— Mary Slessor, mu bbaluwa, ng’ejuliziddwa mu Mary Slessor: A Life (Obulamu bwa Mary Slessor)

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Byonna mbirekera Katonda, era nja kukkiriza kyonna ky’alowooza nti kye kisinga obulungi eri omulimu gwe mu bantu bano. Obulamu bwange nabuwaayo eri Katonda ku lwabwe edda, era sijja kuddiza wadde ekitundu ekisingayo obutono. Akakiiko k’obuminsani kaagaana Morrison okusenguka. Mary yagamba kyokka nti, “Mukama ky’asalawo kye kituufu.” Oluvannyuma obulamu bwa Morrison bwagwa, era tebaafumbiriganwa n’akatono. Mary yeeyongera okuweereza mu Okoyong n’ewalala, ng’abantu bamwagala nga maama waabwe, era n’atwala abaana bangi abaali basuuliddwa n’abakuza nga be.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa ey’Ensi Yonna: Sadhu Sundar Singh

Sundar Singh yazaalibwa mu 1889 mu maka g’Abasikh mu Punjab, mu bukiikakkono bwa Buyindi. Bwe yali omuvubuka, nnyina bwe yamala okufa, yali mweraliikirivu era munyiivu nnyo n’ayokya Bayibuli. Ennaku ntono oluvannyuma, mu 1904, yasaba okukeesa obudde n’akkiriza Yesu Kristo. Ab’omu maka ge ne bamwefuukira, n’awalirizibwa okuva awaka. Yasalawo okubeera nga sadhu, omuntu omutukuvu atambulatambula ng’empisa za Buyindi bwe ziri, ng’ayambala ekyambalo ekyangu era nga kumpi talina kintu kyonna, asobole okubuulira Kristo mu ngeri abantu be gye bandisobodde okutegeera. Teyawasa n’akatono. Okumala emyaka amakumi abiri mu etaano yatambulanga n’ebigere mu Buyindi, mu Nepal ne mu Tibet, emirundi mingi mu bulabe bungi, ng’abuulira Kristo. Era yakyala mu nsi nnyingi, abantu gye baakwatibwako ennyo olw’okukkiriza kwe okw’obwetoowaze era okwangu. Mu 1929 yasitula omulundi omulala okugenda e Tibet, n’atalabikako nate. Obulamu bwe obutaliimu bufumbo bwamuwa eddembe okuba, nga bwe yali akkiriza, omugoberezi wa Yesu Omuyindi eyali owa buli muntu.

Omujjuvu mu Kristo

Obufumbo kirabo kirungi nnyo, era kifaananyi kya Kristo n’Ekkanisa ye. Naye si gwe mulamwa ogusembayo ogw’obulamu bw’omuntu. Yesu yagamba nti mu kuzuukira “teriiyo kuwasa wadde okufumbirwa” (Matayo 22:30). Obufumbo bwokka obubeerawo emirembe gyonna bwe bufumbo bwa Kristo n’abantu be. Buli mukkiriza, omufumbo oba atali mufumbo, ali mu bufumbo obwo.

Noolwekyo omukulembeze atali mu bufumbo si kitundu kya muntu, wadde omuntu alindirira. Mu Kristo mujjuvu, era mu Kkanisa ye alina ab’omu maka. Mubassengamu ekitiibwa. Mubayigireko. Era bw’oba toli mu bufumbo, weereza n’essanyu, ng’omanyi nti Mukama gwe mugabo gwo, era y’aliisa obulamu bwo.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 1 Abakkolinso 7:7 ne 7:32-35. Pawulo ayigiriza ki ku butaba mu bufumbo ng’ekirabo?
  • Ensonga nti Yesu teyali mufumbo ekyusa etya engeri gy’olowoozaamu ku bantu abatali mu bufumbo?
  • Abantu abatali mu bufumbo bayisibwa batya mu kkanisa yo ne mu buwangwa bwo? Bawebwa obukulembeze?
  • Bw’oba toli mu bufumbo, ssanyu ki n’ebizibu ki ebiri mu kuyitibwa kwo? Mikwano gyo egy’okumpi be baani?
  • Bw’oba oli mu bufumbo, ab’omu maka go bayinza batya okugatta omuntu atali mu bufumbo mu bulamu bwabwe?
  • Kiki ky’oyigira ku kusaba kwa Amy Carmichael mu mpuku ne ku bbaluwa ya Mary Slessor?
  • Soma Makko 10:29-30. Ekkanisa yo eyamba etya Yesu okutuukiriza ekisuubizo kino eri abakkiriza abatali mu bufumbo?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Bw’oba oli mu bufumbo, wiiki eno yita omuntu atali mu bufumbo okuva mu kkanisa yo alye n’ab’omu maka go, omubuuze engeri gye muyinza okumusabira. Bw’oba oli mukulembeze, tunuulira abakulembeze n’abakozi b’ekkanisa yo: abantu abatali mu bufumbo bassibwamu ekitiibwa era bagattibwamu, oba babuusibwa amaaso era batikkibwa emirimu egisukkiridde? Bw’oba toli mu bufumbo, wandiika engeri ssatu obutaba mu bufumbo bwo gye bukuwadde eddembe okuweereza Katonda, omwebaze ku lwazo, era wiiki eno tuukirira mukwano gwo omu omubuulire mu mazima bw’oli.

study_questions.question: Bayibuli eyogera ki ku butaba mu bufumbo?
study_questions.answer: Nti kirabo, ng’obufumbo. Pawulo yawandiika nti, “buli muntu alina ekirabo ekikye ku bubwe ekiva eri Katonda, omu mu ngeri emu n’omulala mu ngeri endala” (1 Abakkolinso 7:7). Yesu yennyini teyawasa, era obutaba mu bufumbo buwa eddembe “okuweereza Mukama nga tewali birala bibaziyiza okweweerayo ddala” (1 Abakkolinso 7:35).

study_questions.question: Omuntu atali mu bufumbo ayinza okuba omukulembeze w’ekkanisa?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Yesu ne Pawulo baali si bafumbo, era bwe batyo bwe baali Yeremiya, bawala ba Firipo abana abaalina ekirabo eky’obunnabbi (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 21:9), n’abaminsani bangi abakulu nga Amy Carmichael, Mary Slessor ne Sadhu Sundar Singh. Obutaba mu bufumbo kuyitibwa kujjuvu era okw’ekitiibwa, so si kisenge kya kulindiramu.

study_questions.question: Ekkanisa eyinza etya okulabirira abakulembeze abatali mu bufumbo?
study_questions.answer: Ng’ebagatta mu bulamu bw’amaka, ng’essa ekitiibwa mu kuyitibwa kwabwe mu kifo ky’okubabuuza nti “Onoowasa ddi?”, ng’ebawa obukulembeze, ng’ekuuma okuwummula kwabwe, ng’ebawa omukwano, era ng’erabirira bannamwandu n’abaayawukana. Ng’ayita mu Kkanisa, Yesu atuukiriza ekisuubizo kye eky’okuddizibwa “amaka, abooluganda, bannyina, nnyina, abaana” (Makko 10:30).

fields.title: Okwerabirira ng’Omuwanika
fields.body_html:
“Otuyigirize okutegeeranga obulungi ennaku zaffe, tulyoke tubeere n’omutima ogw’amagezi.”

— Zabbuli 90:12

Omulimi alina ente emu erima ennimiro ye. Bw’ataakoza nte eyo n’akatono, egejja n’efuuka nnafu, era ennimiro terimibwa. Bw’agikoza emisana n’ekiro nga tagiwa mmere, mazzi wadde okuwummula, ejja kugwa wansi wakati mu sizoni, era ennimiro nayo terimibwa. Omulimi ow’amagezi aliisa ente ye, agiwummuza, era agikoza mpola mpola mu ngeri etakyukakyuka, sizoni ku sizoni, okumala emyaka mingi.

Katonda awadde buli mukulembeze obulamu bumu, omubiri gumu, ebirowoozo bimu, n’omuwendo gw’ennaku ogukomye. Bino si byaffe okubyonoona. Mu Ssuula 9, Mwekuume Mwekka, twalaba nti emmeeme y’omukulembeze ye nnimiro esooka okulabirirwa. Essuula eno etunuulira ebirala byonna mu bulamu bw’omukulembeze: obudde, omubiri, obulamu bw’omubiri n’okuyiga. Ekwata ku kulabirira obulungi ekikozesebwa ekimu Katonda ky’akuwadde.

Oli muwanika, so si nnannyini

“Oba temumanyi ng’omubiri gwammwe ye Yeekaalu ya Mwoyo Mutukuvu Katonda gwe yabawa, era n’emibiri gyammwe si gyammwe ku bwammwe? Kubanga mwagulibwa na muwendo, noolwekyo emibiri gyammwe gigulumizenga Katonda” (1 Abakkolinso 6:19-20).

Mu Ssuula 33, Ssente n’Omululu, twawulira John Wesley ng’agamba nti Katonda yatuteeka mu nsi “si ng’omwannannyini, wabula ng’omuwanika”. Ekyo kya mazima ku ssente zaffe. Era kya mazima ku budde bwaffe, emibiri gyaffe, ebirowoozo byaffe n’ebirabo byaffe. Byonna bya Katonda. Yabituwola, era olunaku lumu alitubuuza kye twabikozesa. Mu lugero lwa Yesu olw’ettalanta, mukama teyanenya muddu olw’okuba n’ekitono. Yamunenya olw’okuziika kye yalina: “Ggwe omuddu omubi era omugayaavu!” (Matayo 25:26).

Pawulo yakubiriza abakkiriza ab’omu Rooma nti, “muwengayo emibiri gyammwe nga ssaddaaka ennamu entukuvu esanyusa Katonda” (Abaruumi 12:1). Ssaddaaka ennamu eweebwayo buli lunaku. Tesuulibwa mu kiseera kimu eky’obunyiikivu obw’amaanyi. Eweebwayo n’obwesigwa, obulamu bwonna.

Obulabe obubiri obukontana

Abakulembeze bayinza okwonoona amaanyi Katonda ge yabawa mu ngeri bbiri ezikontana.

Ey’olubereberye bwe bugayaavu. Abakulembeze abamu tebalina muntu akebera mulimu gwabwe. Beebaka okutuusa obudde nga bukedde nnyo, bonoona essaawa, era bakola kitono. Bategeka obubaka bwabwe ku Lwomukaaga ekiro. Tebalina gwe bakyalira. Bakiyita “okulindirira Katonda”, naye ddala bwe bugayaavu. Engero zoogera n’amaanyi: “Nayita ku nnimiro ey’omugayaavu, … Kale laba, ng’ennimiro eyo ebunye amaggwa, wansi wonna nga wabikkiddwa omuddo, n’olukomera lwayo olw’amayinja nga lugudde. … Otulo otutonotono, n’okusumagira akatono, n’okufunya emikono okuwummulako, obwavu bulikutuukako ng’omutemu” (Engero 24:30-31, 33-34). Ekkanisa y’omukulembeze omugayaavu ejja kufaanana ennimiro eyo.

Ey’okubiri kwe kukola ennyo okusukkiridde. Abakulembeze abalala tebayimirira n’akatono. Bakola buli lunaku lwa wiiki, tebeebaka kimala, tebalya bulungi, tebakola dduyiro, era tebagenda mu luwummula. Balowooza nti baweereza Katonda. Naye mpola mpola basaanyaawo omubiri gwe yabawa, era emirundi mingi n’amaka gaabwe. Kino twakitunuulira mu Ssuula 15, Okuwummula, Okwawukana ku Balala, n’Enteekateeka y’Obulamu, ne mu Ssuula 38, Okuggwaamu Amaanyi n’Okukoowa Ennyo.

Byombi kulemererwa mu buwanika. Ekimu kiziika ettalanta. Ekirala kigyokya mangu nnyo. Omukulembeze ow’amagezi asaba Katonda ekisa eky’okukola ennyo, n’ekisa eky’okuwummula.

Okuwanika obudde

“Mutunule nga mutambula n’obwegendereza, si ng’abatalina magezi wabula ng’abalina amagezi, nga temwonoona biseera kubanga ennaku zino mbi” (Abaefeso 5:15-16). Musa yasaba nti, “Otuyigirize okutegeeranga obulungi ennaku zaffe, tulyoke tubeere n’omutima ogw’amagezi” (Zabbuli 90:12). Ennaku zaffe zibaliddwa. Buli lumu kirabo ekitalikomawo.

Zino ze zimu ku ngeri abakulembeze gye bayinza okukozesaamu obulungi obudde bwabwe.

  • Tandika ne Katonda. Ku Yesu tusoma nti, “Enkeera ng’obudde tebunnalaba Yesu n’azuukuka n’agenda yekka mu kifo ekyekusifu, okusaba” (Makko 1:35). Ekitundu eky’olunaku ekisooka era ekisinga obulungi kiwe Katonda, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 12, Okusaba Okusooka.
  • Manya ebisinga obukulu gy’oli. Wandiika ebintu ebitono Katonda by’akuyitidde okukola mu ngeri esinga okweyoleka. Bireke bibumbe wiiki yo.
  • Tegeka wiiki yo. “Enteekateeka z’omunyiikivu zivaamu magoba meereere” (Engero 21:5). Teekawo obudde obw’okusaba, okusoma, abantu, amaka n’okuwummula nga wiiki tennajjula.
  • Weekuume ebibba obudde. Essimu, emikutu gy’empuliziganya, olugambo olutaliimu n’enkuŋŋaana ezitakoma biyinza okubba essaawa nnyingi buli lunaku. Beera mwesimbu ku budde bwo gye bugenda.
  • Gamba nti nedda. Si buli kirungi nti mulimu gwo. Mugabane emirimu, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu.
  • Ddamu otunuulire ennaku zo. Ku nkomerero ya buli wiiki, tunula emabega. Wakola ki? Kiki kye walagajjalira? Kiki ky’onookyusa?

Okuwanika omubiri

Abakristaayo bangi, nga mw’otwalidde abakulembeze bangi, bayisizza omubiri ng’ogutalina mugaso, ng’emmeeme yokka y’erina omugaso. Naye Katonda ye yakola emibiri gyaffe. “Nkutendereza, kubanga wankola mu ngeri ey’entiisa era ey’ekitalo” (Zabbuli 139:14). Yesu yafuna omubiri gw’omuntu, era n’azuukira mu bafu mu mubiri. Emibiri gyaffe nagyo girizuukizibwa.

Pawulo yafangayo ku bulamu bw’omubiri bwa Timoseewo. Yamugamba nti, “nywanga ne ku wayini mutono olw’olubuto lwo, n’olw’okulwalalwala kwo” (1 Timoseewo 5:23). Yawandiika nti, “okumanyiiza omubiri kigasa katono, naye okutya Katonda kugasa mu byonna” (1 Timoseewo 4:8). Okutya Katonda kwe kusinga obukulu. Naye okumanyiiza omubiri kukyali “kigasa katono”. Era Yokaana yasabira mukwano gwe Gayo nti, “nkusabira okole bulungi ebintu byonna era obeere mulamu mu mubiri, nga bw’oli mu mwoyo” (3 Yokaana 2).

Eriya bwe yagwa wansi, eky’okuddamu kya Katonda ekyasooka kwali kwebaka n’emmere (1 Bassekabaka 19:5-7). Oluusi ekintu eky’omwoyo ekisingayo omukulembeze ky’ayinza okukola kwe kugenda okwebaka.

  • Weebake. Abantu abakulu abasinga beetaaga okwebaka essaawa musanvu oba munaana. Omukulembeze atebaka kimala ajja kusalawo bubi, aggwemu obugumiikiriza, era alwale.
  • Lya n’amagezi. Lya emmere ennyangu era ennungi eri obulamu w’osobola. Weewale ssukaali, amasavu n’omwenge ebingi. Abakulembeze bangi balya bubi kubanga bulijjo bali mu kwanguyiriza oba bulijjo baliisibwa mu maka g’abalala.
  • Tambula, kola dduyiro. Tambula n’ebigere, kola emirimu gy’emikono, zannya oba kola dduyiro bulijjo. Abakulembeze bangi batuula ekitundu ekisinga eky’olunaku.
  • Laba omusawo. Kebeza obulamu bwo w’osobola. Tobuusa maaso bubonero bulabula.
  • Labirira ebirowoozo byo. Okweraliikirira okw’amaanyi n’okwennyamira bya ddala. Noonya obuyambi bw’obwetaaga.
  • Weewale ebikulumya. Taaba, obutamiivu, ebiragalalagala n’empisa endala ezoonoona omubiri biswaza yeekaalu ya Mwoyo Omutukuvu.

Okuwanika ebirowoozo: weeyongere okuyiga

Yesu “n’akula mu mubiri, mu magezi” (Lukka 2:52). Ne Omwana wa Katonda yakula. “Ddala amagezi kye kintu ekisingira ddala obukulu; noolwekyo fuba ofune amagezi, era fubira ddala nnyo ofune okutegeera” (Engero 4:7).

Pawulo, ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwe, mu kkomera eryali ery’empewo, yasaba Timoseewo amuleetere ebintu bisatu: “omunagiro gwange gwe naleka e Tulowa ewa Kappo. Ondeeteranga n’emizingo gy’ebitabo, na ddala egyo egy’amaliba” (2 Timoseewo 4:13). Omunagiro gwali gwa mubiri gwe. Emizingo n’amaliba byali bya birowoozo bye. Pawulo yali anaatera okufa, naye yali akyayagala okusoma n’okuyiga.

Yagamba Timoseewo nti, “Ebyo biteeke mu nkola, era bissengako omwoyo, bonna balyoke balabe bwe weeyongera okukola obulungi. Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza” (1 Timoseewo 4:15-16). Omukulembeze alekera awo okuyiga mangu ajja kulekera awo okukulembera obulungi.

  • Soma Bayibuli yonna, emirundi n’emirundi, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 13, Okubeera mu Kigambo.
  • Soma ebitabo ebirungi. Soma ebitabo eby’edda ebikulu eby’okukkiriza Okw’ekikristaayo. Bingi biri ku Ochorus ku bwereere. Soma ebyafaayo, ebyafaayo by’abantu, n’ebitabo ebikwata ku nsi.
  • Yigira ku balala. Buuza ebibuuzo abakulembeze abakulu mu myaka. Wuliriza abantu abatakkiriziganya naawe.
  • Kulaakulanya ebirabo byo. Fuba okufuuka omubuulizi, omuyigiriza, omubuulirizi oba omuddukanya omulungi okusingawo. Noonya okutendekebwa w’osobola.
  • Yigira ku nsobi zo. Buli kulemererwa kuyinza okuba omusomesa.

Abakulembeze bangi mu nsi balina ssente ntono ez’okugula ebitabo oba ez’okutendekebwa. Bw’oba bw’otyo, toggwaamu maanyi. Bangi ku bakulembeze abasinga obukulu mu byafaayo baalina Bayibuli yokka n’ebitabo bitono, ne bayiga okubisoma mu buziba.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Jonathan Edwards ne John Wesley

Jonathan Edwards, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 42, Amaka g’Omukulembeze, yawandiika olukalala lw’ebintu nsanvu bye yamalirira okukola ng’akyali muvubuka, wakati w’emyaka nga kkumi na munaana ne amakumi abiri. Yabiddangamu okubisoma buli wiiki. Bibiri ku byo bikwata ku budde n’amaanyi:

“Mmaliridde obutafiirwa wadde akaseera akamu ak’obudde; wabula okukakozesa mu ngeri esingayo okugasa gye nsobola.”

“Mmaliridde okubeera omulamu n’amaanyi gange gonna, nga bwe nkyali mulamu.”

— Jonathan Edwards, Resolutions (Bye Yamalirira), 5 ne 6

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Nsazeewo obutayonoonanga wadde akaseera akamu ak’obudde, wabula okukakozesa mu ngeri esinga okugasa gye nsobola. Nsazeewo okubeera omulamu n’amaanyi gange gonna ebbanga lyonna lye ndimala nga ndi mulamu. Ng’ekitabo kya Ochorus Key Teachings of Jonathan Edwards (Enjigiriza Enkulu za Jonathan Edwards) bwe kinnyonnyola, Edwards yali amanyi nti tayinza kutuukiriza bye yamalirira ku maanyi ge ku bubwe. Yabitandika ng’asaba Katonda ekisa. Tebyali kkubo lya kufuna kisa kya Katonda ng’akikolera, wabula nteekateeka ya ngeri omuntu eyafuna ekisa gy’anaakozesaamu obudde bwe.

John Wesley yawangaala okutuusa ku myaka kinaana mu musanvu, era yali akyatambula ng’abuulira ng’ali mu myaka kinaana. Ku lunaku lwe olw’amazaalibwa ag’emyaka kinaana mu etaano, mu 1788, yawandiika mu Journal ye (ebiwandiiko bye ebya buli lunaku), ekiri ku Ochorus, ku nsonga lwaki yali akyali w’amaanyi bw’atyo. Ekitiibwa yasooka kukiwa Katonda, n’oluvannyuma okusaba kw’abalala. Oluvannyuma n’awandiika amakubo agamu “amatono”:

“1. Olw’okukola dduyiro bulijjo n’okukyusakyusa empewo gye nnina? 2. Olw’obutafiirwa tulo twa kiro kimu, nga ndwadde oba nga ndi mulamu, ku lukalu oba ku nnyanja, okuva lwe nnazaalibwa? 3. Olw’okusobola okwebaka bwe njagala, ne kiba nti buli lwe mpulira nga kumpi nzigwaamu amaanyi, ndagira otulo ne tujja, emisana oba ekiro? 4. Olw’okuzuukukanga bulijjo, okumala emyaka nga nkaaga, ku ssaawa kkumi ez’ekiro?”

— John Wesley, Journal, 28 Jjuuni 1788

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Wesley yeebaza Katonda olw’okukola dduyiro bulijjo n’okutambula, olw’okwebakanga obulungi bulijjo, olw’okusobola okwebaka buli lwe yakoowanga ennyo, n’olw’empisa ey’okuzuukuka amangu. Batono mu ffe abayinza okwebaka “bwe njagala”, era si buli mukulembeze nti alina okuzuukuka ku ssaawa kkumi ez’ekiro. Naye Wesley atulaga nti empisa ennungi ez’okwebaka, okukola dduyiro n’okwefuga zaamuyamba okuweereza Katonda okumala emyaka egisukka mu amakumi ataano.

Okulabula okuva e Dundee

Robert Murray M’Cheyne, omusumba omuvubuka Omuskootilandi gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 9, Mwekuume Mwekka, yafa mu 1843 ng’alina emyaka amakumi abiri mu mwenda, oluvannyuma lw’okukwatibwa omusujja ng’akyalira abalwadde. Yeewaayo ddala eri abantu be. Waliwo ebigambo ebitera okugambibwa nti yabyogera ng’anaatera okufa. Tetuyinza kukakasa nti yabyogera, naye bibadde biddiŋŋanwa okumala ebbanga ddene kubanga abakulembeze bangi nnyo balaba amazima agabirimu: “Katonda yampa obubaka okubutuusa n’embalaasi okugyebagala. Woowe, nzise embalaasi era sikyasobola kutuusa bubaka.”

Obulamu bwa M’Cheyne obumpi bwabala ebibala bingi, era yafa ng’aweereza abalwadde, nga Yesu bwe yakola. Tetusaanidde kumusalira musango. Naye ebigambo ebigambibwa nti bibye kulabula eri buli mukulembeze. Omubiri gwo y’embalaasi Katonda gy’akuwadde okutwala obubaka bwe. Tottanga mbalaasi.

Buli omukono gwo kye gugenda okukola

“Buli omukono gwo kye gugenda okukola, kikole n’amaanyi go gonna” (Omubuulizi 9:10). Katonda ayita abakulembeze be okukola ennyo, n’amaanyi gaabwe gonna, nga bakyali balamu. Era abayita okwebaka, okulya, okuwummula n’okuyiga, basobole okumuweereza okumala emyaka mingi. Byombi bitundu by’okuwaayo omubiri gwo nga ssaddaaka ennamu.

Olunaku lumu, Mukama alikomawo n’abuuza kye twakola n’ebyo bye yatuwa. Buli omu ku ffe k’awulire nti, “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa.”

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 1 Abakkolinso 6:19-20. Kitegeeza ki gy’oli nti omubiri gwo ye yeekaalu ya Mwoyo Omutukuvu?
  • Okemebwa nnyo bugayaavu oba kukola nnyo okusukkiridde? Ab’omu maka go bandigambye ki?
  • Tunula emabega ku wiiki ewedde. Obudde bwo bwagenda wa? Kiki ky’owandikyusizza?
  • Olabirira otya omubiri gwo: okwebaka, emmere, okutambula n’obulamu bw’omubiri?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga mu kiseera kino? Ddi lwe wasembayo okusoma ekitabo ekirungi?
  • Edwards yamalirira “obutafiirwa wadde akaseera akamu ak’obudde.” Kino kiyinza kukuyamba kitya, nga tekikutwala mu kukola nnyo okusukkiridde?
  • Ebigambo ebigambibwa nti bya M’Cheyne bikugamba ki?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Okumala wiiki emu, wandiika mu ngeri ennyangu engeri gy’okozesaamu obudde bwo. Ku nkomerero, bitunuulire mu mazima ng’oli ne Katonda. Oluvannyuma londa enkyukakyuka emu ku mubiri gwo (okugeza, okugenda okwebaka amangu oba okutambulako buli lunaku), enkyukakyuka emu ku birowoozo byo (okugeza, okusoma ekitabo ekirungi okumala eddakiika amakumi abiri buli lunaku) n’enkyukakyuka emu ku budde bwo (okugeza, okuggyako essimu yo mu ssaawa esooka ey’olunaku). Saba mukwano gwo akulondoole oluvannyuma lw’omwezi.

study_questions.question: Kitegeeza ki omukulembeze okwerabirira ng’omuwanika?
study_questions.answer: Kitegeeza okulabirira obudde bwaffe, omubiri n’ebirowoozo ng’ebirabo ebya Katonda. “omubiri gwammwe ye Yeekaalu ya Mwoyo Mutukuvu” (1 Abakkolinso 6:19). Tusaba nti, “Otuyigirize okutegeeranga obulungi ennaku zaffe, tulyoke tubeere n’omutima ogw’amagezi” (Zabbuli 90:12).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze Omukristaayo asaanidde kukozesa atya obudde bwe?
study_questions.answer: N’amagezi era n’ekigendererwa: “nga temwonoona biseera” (Abaefeso 5:16). Essuula erabula ku bugayaavu, ng’ennimiro eyabikkibwa omuddo (Engero 24:30-31), era ne ku kukola ennyo okusukkiridde okwonoona obulamu bw’omubiri n’amaka.

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze basaanidde okweyongera okuyiga?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga ebirowoozo ebirekera awo okukula bifuuka bikadde ebitakyalina bulamu. Essuula ekubiriza okusoma, okuyiga n’okuyigira ku balala, era ejulira ebyo Jonathan Edwards bye yamalirira ku kukozesa obudde, n’empisa za John Wesley ez’okwefuga okutuusa mu bukadde.

fields.title: Abakulembeze ku Mulimu ne mu Bantu
fields.body_html:
“Era munoonye emirembe n’okukulaakulana kw’ekibuga gye mbatutte mu buwaŋŋanguse. Musabenga Mukama, ekibuga mukisabire kubanga bwe kikulaakulana nammwe mujja kukulaakulana.”

— Yeremiya 29:7

Mu kabuga akatono, omusumba azuukuka nga bukyali okugenda okulima mu nnimiro. Mu ttuntu aba mu katale ng’atunda enva endiirwa. Akawungeezi akyalira amaka agalimu omulwadde. Ku Ssande abuulira. Tagenderangako mu ttendekero lya Bayibuli, era tafuna musaala okuva mu kkanisa. Abantu abamu balowooza nti si musumba “wa ddala”. Naye akulembedde ekkanisa eno n’obwesigwa okumala emyaka amakumi abiri.

Mu nsi yonna, ekkanisa ezisinga obungi zikulemberwa abantu nga ye. Balimi, basomesa, basawo, basuubuzi, baddereeva n’abazimbi, nga bwe balunda n’abantu ba Katonda. Era ebweru w’ekkanisa, abakkiriza obukadde n’obukadde bakulembera mu bya bizinensi, mu gavumenti, mu masomero, mu malwaliro ne mu bitundu bye babeeramu. Essuula eno ekwata ku bakulembeze ku mulimu ne mu bantu. Ekwata ku musumba nga naye akola omulimu omulala, ne ku mukkiriza akulembera mu nsi.

Omulimu gwava eri Katonda

Omulimu si kivudde mu kugwa kw’omuntu. Ekibi nga tekinnayingira mu nsi, “Mukama Katonda n’ateeka omuntu mu nnimiro Adeni agirimenga era agikuumenga” (Olubereberye 2:15). Omulimu kitundu ku kye kitegeeza okutondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda. Katonda yennyini mukozi, eyatonda eggulu n’ensi.

Yesu yamala ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky’obulamu bwe ng’omuntu omukulu ng’akola n’emikono gye. Abantu beebuuza nti, “Ono si ye mutabani w’omubazzi?” (Matayo 13:55). Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 41, Emyaka Egikwekeddwa, Omwana wa Katonda yamala emyaka mingi ng’akola ebintu mu dduuka ly’omubazzi e Nazaaleesi. Kino kitegeeza nti omulimu ogwa bulijjo mutukuvu bwe gukolerwa Katonda. “Buli kye mukola mukikole ng’abakolera Mukama waffe so si abantu” (Abakkolosaayi 3:23).

Abakristaayo abamu balowooza nti waliwo ebika by’emirimu bibiri: omulimu “ogw’omwoyo”, ng’okubuulira n’okusaba, n’omulimu “ogw’ensi”, ng’okulima ne bizinensi. Balowooza nti ogwolubereberye gusanyusa Katonda, ate ogw’okubiri gwa kufuna ssente bufunyi. Bayibuli teyawula bulamu bw’etyo. Omusawo Omukristaayo alabirira abalwadde, omusomesa Omukristaayo ayigiriza abaana, n’omusuubuzi Omukristaayo asuubula mu bwesimbu bonna baweereza Katonda.

Pawulo omukozi wa weema

Mu Ssuula 33, Ssente n’Omululu, twalaba nti Pawulo emirundi mingi yeeyimirizangawo ng’akola. Bwe yatuuka e Kkolinso, yasanga Akula ne Pulisikira, era “Olw’okuba nga baali bakola omulimu gwe gumu ogw’okukola weema, n’abeeranga nabo, era n’akolanga nabo. Buli lwa Ssabbiiti Pawulo yabeeranga mu kkuŋŋaaniro ng’amatiza Abayudaaya n’Abayonaani” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 18:3-4). Yajjukiza Abasessaloniika nti, “Abooluganda mujjukire okufuba kwaffe n’okutegana kwaffe; bwe twakolanga emisana n’ekiro tuleme okubazitoowerera, nga tubabuulira Enjiri ya Katonda” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:9).

Pawulo kino yakikola olw’ensonga nnyingi. Kyategeeza nti teyali mugugu ku kkanisa empya. Kyamukuuma obutavunaanibwa nti abuulira lwa ssente. Kyamuwa okusisinkana abantu aba bulijjo mu katale. Era kyawa abakkiriza ekyokulabirako eky’okukola ennyo (2 Abasessaloniika 3:8-9).

Leero, abakulembeze abakola omulimu omulala ate nga bakulembera n’ekkanisa batera okuyitibwa “abakozi ba weema” oba “abakulembeze ab’emirimu ebiri”. Be bakulembera ekkanisa ezisinga obungi mu nsi. Bw’oba oli omu ku bo, wulira kino bulungi: obuweereza bwo si bwa ddaala lya wansi. Otambulira mu bigere by’omutume Pawulo.

Essanyu n’emigugu by’omukozi wa weema

Abakulembeze abakozi ba weema balina amaanyi mangi.

  • Bategeera obulamu bw’abantu baabwe obwa buli lunaku, kubanga babeera mu bulamu bwe bumu.
  • Tebanyigirizibwa kkanisa ku nsonga za ssente.
  • Basisinkana abantu abatandizze mu kizimbe ky’ekkanisa n’akatono.
  • Balaga nti okukkiriza kwa bulamu bwonna, so si kwa Ssande yokka.

Naye era beetikka emigugu emizito. Batera okukoowa, nga balina obudde butono obw’okusoma, okusaba n’amaka. Bayinza okwewulira nga balina omusango olw’obutasobola kukolera kkanisa bisingawo. Ekkanisa ezimu zibasuubira okukola nga omusumba akola ekiseera kyonna.

Gano ge magezi agamu eri abakulembeze abakozi ba weema n’ekkanisa zaabwe.

  • Mugabane emirimu mu bantu bangi. Omusumba omukozi wa weema tayinza kukola buli kimu. Mukuze abakadde b’ekkanisa, abadyakoni n’abalala okwetikka omugugu, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu.
  • Mukuume obudde bwa Katonda n’obw’amaka. Ne bwe bubeera butono, bukuumenga n’obwegendereza.
  • Kola omulimu gwo bulungi. “Omanyi omuntu omunyiikivu era omukugu mu mulimu gwe? Aliweereza bakabaka” (Engero 22:29). Omulimu gwo mu nsi bujulirwa.
  • Ekkanisa, muwagire abakulembeze bammwe nga bwe musobola. Ne ekirabo ekitono, okubayamba mu nnimiro zaabwe oba okuwa ab’omu maka gaabwe emmere kiyinza okukendeeza ku mugugu.
  • Noonya okutendekebwa okukutuukirira. Enteekateeka nnyingi ennungi ez’okutendeka zitegekeddwa abakulembeze abakola, nga mulimu ebibiina eby’akawungeezi, emisomo emimpi, oba okusomera ku ssimu.

Yusufu, Danyeri ne Nekkemiya: abakulembeze mu nsi

Abamu ku bakulembeze abasinga obukulu mu Bayibuli tebaakulemberera mu yeekaalu wabula mu gavumenti.

Yusufu yaddukanya ebyenfuna byonna eby’e Misiri mu myaka omusanvu egy’ekyengera n’emyaka omusanvu egy’enjala. Falaawo yagamba nti, “Tuyinza okufuna omuntu ng’ono Yusufu omuli Omwoyo wa Katonda?” (Olubereberye 41:38). Amagezi ga Yusufu gaawonya obulamu bw’abantu obukadde n’obukadde, nga mw’otwalidde n’ab’omu maka ga Isirayiri.

Danyeri yaweereza mu gavumenti ya Babulooni n’oluvannyuma eya Buperusi okumala ekitundu ekisinga eky’obulamu bwe obuwanvu. Okuva ku lubereberye yateekawo ensalo: “Naye Danyeri n’amalirira mu mutima gwe obuteeyonoonyesa na mmere na wayini ebyavanga ku mmeeza ya kabaka” (Danyeri 1:8). Yakola mu bwesimbu bungi nnyo, abalabe be “ne batayinza kulaba nsonga nkyamu newaakubadde akabi konna, kubanga yali musajja mwesigwa ataalina kwonoona okw’engeri yonna newaakubadde obulagajjavu” (Danyeri 6:4). Kabaka bwe yafuula okusaba Katonda omusango, Danyeri “n’agenda ewuwe mu nnyumba ye, n’ayambuka mu kisenge kye ekya waggulu ekyalina amadirisa nga goolekedde Yerusaalemi, n’afukamiranga emirundi esatu olunaku, n’asabanga era ne yeebazanga Katonda we nga bwe yakolanga bulijjo” (Danyeri 6:10). Yaweereza kabaka n’obwesigwa, naye teyawa kabaka ekyo ekyali ekya Katonda.

Nekkemiya yali muweereza mu lubiri lwa kabaka wa Buperusi, n’afuuka ow’essaza wa Yuda. Yakulembera okuddamu okuzimba bbugwe wa Yerusaalemi. Yagaana okutwala emmere ey’omugabo abaamasaza abalala gye baali basaba abantu: “Naye abessaza abansooka baazitoowerezanga abantu, … Naye nze si bwe nakolanga, olw’okutya Katonda” (Nekkemiya 5:15).

Abasatu bano batulaga omukulembeze atya Katonda mu bantu bw’afaanana: mukugu, mwesimbu, musabi, agaana obuli bw’enguzi, era aweereza obulungi bw’abantu bonna, nga mw’otwalidde abo abatakkiriza.

Omunnyo n’omusana mu bantu

Katonda yagamba abawaŋŋanguse mu Babulooni okukola ekintu ekyewuunyisa. Baali mu nsi y’abagwira, nga bafugibwa obwakabaka obwali bwazikiriza ekibuga kyabwe. Naye Katonda yagamba nti, “Era munoonye emirembe n’okukulaakulana kw’ekibuga gye mbatutte mu buwaŋŋanguse. Musabenga Mukama, ekibuga mukisabire kubanga bwe kikulaakulana nammwe mujja kukulaakulana” (Yeremiya 29:7).

Yesu yagamba nti, “Mmwe muli munnyo gwa nsi. … Mmwe muli musana gwa nsi. … Kale nammwe ebikolwa byammwe ebirungi byakirenga abantu bonna, babirabenga, bagulumize Kitammwe ali mu ggulu” (Matayo 5:13-14, 16). Omunnyo tegulina kye gugasa nga gukyali mu kibya kyagwo. Omusana tegulina kye gugasa nga gubikkiddwako ekibbo. Abakkiriza balina okubeerawo mu buli kitundu ky’obulamu bw’abantu.

Abakulembeze Abakristaayo mu nsi boolekagana n’ebigezo eby’enjawulo.

  • Obuli bw’enguzi. Mu nsi nnyingi, enguzi esuubirwa mu bizinensi ne mu gavumenti. Ekyokulabirako kya Danyeri kiraga nti kisoboka okuweereza n’obwesigwa awatali buli bwa nguzi, wadde nga kiyinza okusaasaanyiza.
  • Obwesigwa obwawuddwamu. Abakulembeze bayinza okusabibwa okukulembeza kampuni yaabwe, ekibiina kyabwe eky’ebyobufuzi oba ekika kyabwe okusinga ekituufu.
  • Okunyigirizibwa okukweka okukkiriza kwabwe. Ebifo by’emirimu ebimu bisekerera oba bibonereza okukkiriza okwolesebwa mu lwatu.
  • Okwegomba obukulu. Obuwanguzi mu nsi buyinza okuliisa amalala n’okwagala ssente, nga bwe twalaba mu Kitundu eky’Omusanvu: Obulabe mu Kkubo.
  • Eby’obufuzi. Abakristaayo bayinza okuweereza mu by’obufuzi, era abamu bayitibwa okukikola. Naye Ekkanisa terina kufuuka muweereza wa kibiina kimu eky’ebyobufuzi. Obwesigwa bwayo bwa Kristo.

Abasumba era basaanidde okutegekera abantu baabwe emirimu gyabwe. Osabira abasomesa, abasawo, abalimi, abasuubuzi n’abakozi ba gavumenti abali mu kkanisa yo? Obayamba okulowooza ku ngeri y’okugoberera Kristo ku mulimu? Obuweereza bw’ekkanisa yo obusinga bubaawo ku Bbalaza, so si ku Ssande.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: William Wilberforce ne Lemuel Haynes

Mu Ssuula 30, Obwenkanya, Okusaasira n’Abaavu, twasisinkana William Wilberforce. Oluvannyuma lw’okukyuka mu 1785, yeebuuza oba yandivudde mu by’obufuzi n’afuuka omuweereza w’ekkanisa. John Newton, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 39, Okugwa n’Okuzzibwawo, yamuwa amagezi okusigala mu Paalamenti aweerereze Katonda eyo. Wilberforce yasigalayo, n’amala emyaka amakumi mangi ng’alwanyisa obusuubuzi bw’abaddu n’oluvannyuma obuddu bwennyini. Okuyitibwa kwe kwali mu by’obufuzi, so si ku kituuti.

Lemuel Haynes yazaalibwa mu Connecticut, mu Amerika, mu 1753. Kitaawe yali Mufirika ate nnyina yali mweru, era bwe yali omwana omuwere yaweebwayo n’akula ng’omuddu ow’endagaano, eyali ateekwa okukolera amaka g’abalimi. Yeeyigiriza okusoma era yayagala nnyo Bayibuli. Bwe yali omuvubuka, yalwana ng’omuserikale mu Lutalo lw’Amerika olw’Okwefuga. Era yawandiika ng’awakanya obuddu, ng’agamba nti eddembe kirabo okuva eri Katonda eri buli muntu, owa buli langi. Mu 1785 yayawulibwa okuba omuweereza w’ekkanisa, ng’omu ku Bamerika Abaddugavu abaasooka okuyawulibwa ekkanisa ennene mu Amerika. Okumala emyaka nga amakumi asatu yalunda ekibiina ky’abazungu e Rutland, mu Vermont, mu kiseera ekyo ng’ekintu ng’ekyo kumpi tekiwulirwangako. Yali mwana wa mulimi, muserikale, muwandiisi era musumba, era yaweereza Katonda mu buli kimu ku ebyo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa ey’Ensi Yonna: Fanny Jackson Coppin ne Kanzo Uchimura

Fanny Jackson Coppin yazaalibwa mu buddu mu Washington, D.C., mu 1837. Ssenga we yatereka ssente n’amugulira eddembe lye. Yakola ng’omukozi w’awaka, n’asoma buli lwe yasobolanga, era mu 1865 n’amaliriza emisomo gye mu Oberlin College. Yafuuka omukulu w’essomero Institute for Colored Youth e Philadelphia, essomero ly’abavubuka Abamerika Abaddugavu, era n’alikulembera okumala kumpi emyaka amakumi ana. Yatendeka abasomesa bikumi na bikumi, era n’atandika enteekateeka ey’okuyigiriza abavubuka emikono basobole okufuna emirimu emirungi. Yali akkiriza nti okusoma n’okukola emirimu mu bwesimbu ngeri za kuweereza Katonda n’okusitula abantu be. Ng’akaddiye, yatambula ne bba, omulabirizi mu African Methodist Episcopal Church, okugenda okuweereza mu South Africa.

Kanzo Uchimura yazaalibwa mu Japan mu 1861. Yakkiriza Kristo ng’akyali musomi, n’afuuka omusomesa era omuwandiisi. Mu 1891, mu ssomero e Tokyo, abasomesa baalagirwa okukutama nnyo mu maaso g’omukono gwa Kabaka Omukulu ogwali ku kiwandiiko ekitongole. Uchimura yali akkiriza nti ekyo kwali kusinza, era nti tayinza kukikola. Teyakutama mu bujjuvu. Abantu ne baleekaana nnyo mu lwatu, n’afiirwa omulimu gwe. Oluvannyuma yafuuka munnamawulire era omuyigiriza wa Bayibuli, era ebiwandiiko bye byakwata nnyo ku Bakristaayo ab’omu Japan. Yayagala nnyo eggwanga lye, era yayogeranga ku kwagala “J bbiri”: Jesus (Yesu) ne Japan. Ajjukirwa olw’ebigambo ebiwandiikiddwa kaakano ku jjinja ly’oku ntaana ye: “Nze ku lwa Japan; Japan ku lw’Ensi; Ensi ku lwa Kristo; era Byonna ku lwa Katonda.”

Byonna ku lwa Katonda

Ka obe musumba alima, omusomesa akulembera okusoma Bayibuli, nnannyini bizinensi awa abalala emirimu, oba omukungu agaana enguzi, omulimu gwo gwa mugaso eri Katonda. “ng’abakolera Mukama waffe so si ng’abakolera abantu, nga mumanyi ng’ekirungi kyonna omuntu ky’akola, … Mukama alimusasula empeera ennungi” (Abaefeso 6:7-8).

Tolowooza nti ekituuti kyokka kye kifo ekitukuvu. Ennimiro, ekibiina, eddwaliro, edduuka ne ofiisi nabyo biyinza okuba ebifo ebitukuvu. Noonya emirembe gy’ekibuga Katonda gy’akuteeka. Leka omusana gwo gwakire eyo.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Olubereberye 2:15 n’Abakkolosaayi 3:23. Ennyiriri zino zikyusa zitya engeri gy’olowoozaamu ku mulimu ogwa bulijjo?
  • Oli mukulembeze mukozi wa weema? Ssanyu ki n’emigugu ki ebiri mu mbeera yo? Ekkanisa yo eyinza kukuyamba etya?
  • Soma Danyeri 6:1-10. Abakulembeze mu gavumenti ne mu bizinensi bayinza kuyigira ki ku Danyeri?
  • Buli bwa nguzi bwa ngeri ki obutera okubaawo mu ggwanga lyo? Abakkiriza bayinza batya okubuziyiza?
  • Soma Yeremiya 29:4-7. Ekkanisa yo eyinza etya “okunoonya emirembe” gy’ekibuga kyammwe oba ekitundu kyammwe?
  • Ekkanisa yo etegeka etya abantu baayo okuweereza Kristo mu mirimu gyabwe?
  • Eddoboozi ki ku ago agali mu ssuula eno erisinga okwogera naawe: Wilberforce, Haynes, Coppin oba Uchimura?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Bw’oba oli musumba, wiiki eno noonyereza emirimu bammemba b’ekkanisa yo gye bakola. Ku Ssande, basabire mu mannya gaabwe ne mu mirimu gyabwe: abalimi, abasomesa, abasawo, abasuubuzi, abayizi n’abalala. Bw’oba okulembera mu nsi, wandiika engeri emu gy’oyinza okuweereza Katonda n’obwesigwa obusingawo ku mulimu wiiki eno, oboolyawo ng’ogaana obukumpanya obutono, ng’ozzaamu munno gw’okola naye amaanyi, oba ng’osabira ekifo ky’okoleramu. Oluvannyuma saba Yeremiya 29:7 ku lw’ekibuga kyo.

study_questions.question: Omukristaayo ayinza okuweereza Katonda mu mulimu ogwa bulijjo?
study_questions.answer: Yee. Omulimu gwava eri Katonda; yateeka Adamu mu nnimiro “agirimenga era agikuumenga” (Olubereberye 2:15). Yesu yali “mutabani w’omubazzi” (Matayo 13:55). “Buli kye mukola mukikole ng’abakolera Mukama waffe” (Abakkolosaayi 3:23).

study_questions.question: Omukozi wa weema mu buweereza y’ani?
study_questions.answer: Mukulembeze eyeeyimirizaawo ng’akola omulimu omulala ng’ate aweereza ekkanisa, nga Pawulo bwe yakola bwe yakolanga ne Akula ne Pulisikira, “Olw’okuba nga baali bakola omulimu gwe gumu ogw’okukola weema” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 18:3), “tuleme okubazitoowerera” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:9).

study_questions.question: Abakkiriza bayinza batya okuba omunnyo n’omusana mu bantu?
study_questions.answer: Nga bakola n’obukugu era mu bwesimbu, nga banoonya obulungi bw’ekibuga kyabwe, era nga bayimirira ku lw’obwenkanya. “Era munoonye emirembe n’okukulaakulana kw’ekibuga gye mbatutte mu buwaŋŋanguse” (Yeremiya 29:7). Essuula eyogera ku Yusufu, Danyeri, Nekkemiya, William Wilberforce, Lemuel Haynes, Fanny Jackson Coppin ne Kanzo Uchimura.

fields.title: Omwesigwa mu Bitono: Okubalibwako
fields.body_html:
“Omuntu omwesigwa mu kintu ekitono, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene; n’oyo ataba mwesigwa mu kitono era ne mu kinene taba mwesigwa.”

— Lukka 16:10

Ekyalo kizimba etterekero ly’emmere y’empeke. Omusajja omu aweebwa ekisumuluzo. Mu kusooka, buli muntu akebera emmere buli mwezi. Naye omusajja oyo yeesigibwa, era oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera tewakyali muntu yeeraliikirira kukebera. Nga wayiseewo emyaka, mu kiseera ky’enjala, ekyalo kiggulawo etterekero ne kisanga nga kijjudde kitundu kyokka. Omusajja teyali ategese kubba. Kyatandika n’ensawo emu entono mu mwezi omuzibu. Naye tewaaliwo yali alaba, era ensawo emu n’efuuka nnyingi.

Ekizibu mu kyalo ekyo tekyali kibi kya musajja omu kyokka. Yali nkola eteriimu kukebera. Essuula eno, esembayo mu Kitundu eky’Omwenda: Obulamu bw’Omukulembeze, ekwata ku kubalibwako. Ekwata ku mazima nti abakulembeze bawanika abaliwa embalirira, era ku magezi ag’okuzimba okubalibwako mu bulamu bwaffe nga bukyali nnyo, nga tetunnalowooza nti tukwetaaga.

Abawanika b’ebintu by’omulala

Pawulo yannyonnyola abakulembeze bw’ati: “Omuntu asaanidde atulabe ng’abaweereza ba Kristo era abawanika b’ebyama bya Katonda. Ate era omuwanika kimugwanira okuba omuntu omwesigwa” (1 Abakkolinso 4:1-2).

Omuddukanya w’ennyumba, oba omuwanika, yalabiriranga ennyumba y’omugagga ng’omwami taliiwo. Yaddukanyanga ssente, abaweereza, emmere n’ettaka. Tewaali na kimu ku ebyo kyali kikye. Olunaku lumu omwami yandikomyewo n’amusaba embalirira. Ekintu kimu omwami kye yeetaaganga mu muwanika bwali bwesigwa.

Abakulembeze bawanika ng’abo. Ekkanisa si yaffe. Abantu si baffe. Ssente si zaffe. Ebirabo byaffe, obudde bwaffe n’ekifo kyaffe si byaffe. Byonna bya Kristo, eyagenda era alikomawo. Yesu yagera olugero lw’omwami eyagenda olugendo, “n’ayita abaddu be n’abalekera ebintu bye. Eyasooka yamuwa ttalanta ttaano, owookubiri bbiri n’owookusatu emu, ng’ageraageranya ng’okusobola kwa buli omu bwe kwali” (Matayo 25:14-15). Bwe yakomawo, yabuuza buli omu kye yakola n’ebyo bye yamuwa. Abeesigwa yabagamba nti, “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa, obadde mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, ndikusigira ebintu ebingi” (Matayo 25:21).

Weetegereze omwami kye yatendereza. Si bunene. Si kwatiikirira. Bwesigwa. Omuddu eyalina ttalanta bbiri yatenderezebwa kye kimu n’omuddu eyalina ettaano. Katonda asasula obwesigwa, so si kwatiikirira.

Omwesigwa mu bitono

“Omuntu omwesigwa mu kintu ekitono, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene; n’oyo ataba mwesigwa mu kitono era ne mu kinene taba mwesigwa” (Lukka 16:10). Abakulembeze tebatera kugwa omulundi gumu. Nga bwe twalaba mu Kitundu eky’Omusanvu: Obulabe mu Kkubo, okugwa okunene kutera okutandika n’okwekkiriranya okutono: okugaziya ebigambo katono, ssente ntono ezeewoleddwa, okwegwanyiza okutono, amalala matono.

Ekikontana n’ekyo nakyo kya mazima. Obwesigwa obunene buzimbibwa okuva mu bwesigwa obutono. Okutuukiriza ekisuubizo ekitono. Okuzzaayo ekyenkanyi. Okwogera amazima nga obulimba bwandibadde bwangu. Okutuuka mu budde. Okukola kye wagamba nti ojja kukikola. Ebintu bino biyinza okulabika ng’ebitono, naye ge mirandira gy’obulamu obwesigika.

Ekitabo kya Ochorus Omwesigwa mu Bintu Ebitono kinoonyereza ku kino eri buli mukkiriza, naddala ku nsonga ya ssente. Obubaka bwakyo bukwata nnyo n’amaanyi ku bakulembeze: engeri gye tukwatamu ebitono eraga engeri gye tunaakwatamu ebingi.

Okubalibwako mu Kkanisa ey’olubereberye

Ne abatume baabalibwangako. Peetero bwe yagenda mu nnyumba ya Koluneeriyo n’alya n’Abamawanga, “Naye Peetero bwe yakomawo mu Yerusaalemi, abakomole ne bamunenya, … Awo Peetero n’abannyonnyola byonna” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 11:2, 4). Peetero ye yali omutume akulembera, naye teyagamba nti, “Ggwe ani okumbuuza?” Yeennyonnyolako.

Pawulo ne Balunabba bwe baakomawo okuva mu lugendo lwabwe olw’obuminsani olwasooka, “ne bakuŋŋaanya ekkanisa ne babategeeza … byonna Katonda bye yabakozesa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 14:27). Baawa embalirira ekkanisa eyali ebatumye. Pawulo yagenda n’e Yerusaalemi okwanjulira abatume abalala Enjiri gye yabuuliranga. Yawandiika nti yakikola “si kulwa nga nteganira bwereere” (Abaggalatiya 2:2).

Pawulo bwe yali atwala ekirabo ekinene eky’ensimbi eri abaavu ab’omu Yerusaalemi, yakakasa nti abakkiriza abalala abeesigika batambula nakyo, “nga twewala omuntu yenna okutunenya olw’ekirabo kino kye tuweereza. Kubanga kye tugenderera kwe kukola ebirungi, si mu maaso ga Katonda yekka wabula ne mu maaso g’abantu” (2 Abakkolinso 8:20-21).

Pawulo era yawa ebiragiro ku kiseera omukadde w’ekkanisa lw’avunaanibwa: “Tokkirizanga ebyo bye bavunaana omukulembeze okuggyako nga biriko abajulirwa babiri oba basatu. Kyokka abo aboonoona banenyezenga mu lwatu, abalala balyoke batye” (1 Timoseewo 5:19-20). Abakulembeze bakuumibwa okuvunaanibwa eby’obulimba. Naye tebali waggulu wa kunenyezebwa.

Lwaki abakulembeze beewala okubalibwako

Okubalibwako bwe kuba nga kwa magezi bwe kutyo, lwaki abakulembeze bangi bwe batyo bakwewala?

  • Amalala. “Nze mukulembeze. Nnyanukula Katonda yekka.” Naye Katonda yatuteeka mu mubiri, era emirundi mingi ayogera ng’ayita mu balala.
  • Okutya. Omuntu bw’amanya amazima agakwata ku nze, ayinza okunnyooma.
  • Ekibi ekikwekeddwa. Omukulembeze alina ky’akweka atera okuziyiza omuntu yenna ayinza okukizuula.
  • Obuwangwa. Mu buwangwa obumu, kiswaza okubuuza omuntu omukulu oba omukulembeze. Omukulembeze n’afuuka atakwatibwako.
  • Ekiwuubaalo. Abakulembeze abamu tebalina muntu ali kumpi nabo ekimala okubabuuza ebibuuzo ebizibu.
  • Okubeera n’emirimu mingi. Okubalibwako kutwala obudde, era kyangu okukuleka ne kuseeseetuka.

Naye omukulembeze atabalibwako ali mu bulabe bunene. “Ababiri basinga omu, … Kubanga singa omu agwa, munne amuyimusa. Naye zimusanze oyo ali obw’omu, bw’agwa tabaako amuyimusa” (Omubuulizi 4:9-10). Abaebbulaniya kigamba nti, “Mubuuliraganenga mwekka na mwekka bulijjo ng’ekiseera kikyaliwo, waleme okubaawo n’omu ku mmwe akakanyazibwa obulimba bw’ekibi” (Abaebbulaniya 3:13). Ekibi kirimba. Bulijjo tetusobola kwerabira ddala bulungi. Twetaaga abalala okutuyamba okulaba.

Okuzimba okubalibwako nga tonnakwetaaga

Ekiseera ekisinga obulungi okuzimba okubalibwako kwe kiseera nga byonna bitambula bulungi. Zino ze zimu ku ngeri gye kuyinza okubaamu.

  • Okubalibwako ku bubwo. Beera n’abakkiriza abakuze omu oba babiri abeesigika, ab’ekikula kyo, b’owadde olukusa okukubuuza ebibuuzo ebizibu ku kutambula kwo ne Katonda, obufumbo bwo, ssente zo, obulongoofu bwo n’engeri gy’okozesaamu obuyinza. Musisinkanenga bulijjo. Bagambenga amazima. “Noolwekyo mwatulireganenga ebibi byammwe, era buli omu asabirenga munne, mulyoke muwonyezebwe” (Yakobo 5:16).
  • Okubalibwako mu bukulembeze. Kulembera wamu n’ekibinja ky’abakadde b’ekkanisa oba abakulembeze abalala, so si wekka, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu. Ebintu ebikulu mubisalengawo wamu.
  • Okubalibwako eri abali waggulu wo. Beera mu kibiina ekigazi eky’ekkanisa, mu kkanisa ennene gy’oliko, oba mu kibinja ky’abasumba abeesigika abayinza okwogera mu bulamu bwo era, bwe kiba kyetaagisa, ne bakola ekintu singa wabaawo ekigenze obubi. Kino twakiraba mu Ssuula 6, Obuyinza wansi w’Obuyinza.
  • Okubalibwako mu by’ensimbi. Waakiri abantu babiri babale era bawandiike buli kiweebwayo. Ebitabo by’ensimbi bikeberwe abantu abeetongodde. Omusaala gw’omukulembeze gumanyibwe abakulembeze b’ekkanisa. Kino twakiraba mu Ssuula 33, Ssente n’Omululu.
  • Okubalibwako eri ekkanisa. Bulijjo tegeezanga ekkanisa yo ebigenda mu maaso, nga Pawulo ne Balunabba bwe baakola. Beera mwerufu ku bisalibwawo ne ku nsimbi.
  • Okubalibwako ku by’obukuumi. Beera n’enteekateeka etegeerekeka ey’okukola ku kyonna ekiteeberezebwa eky’okutulugunya, nga mw’otwalidde ebiteeberezebwa ku mukulembeze omukulu, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu.

Okubalibwako tekukoma ku kukwata kibi kyokka. Era kukwata ku kuzzaamu amaanyi, okusaba n’okukula. “Ng’ekyuma bwe kiwagala ekyuma, n’omuntu bw’abangula muntu munne” (Engero 27:17). Mukwano gwo omulungi akubalirira ajja kusanyuka naawe, akusabire, era akuyambe okufaanana Kristo okusingawo.

Okukkiriza okunenyezebwa

Okubalibwako kukola bwe tuba nga tuli beetegefu okuwulira ebintu ebizibu. “Okunywegera kw’omulabe kwandiba okungi, naye ebiwundu by’okunenya kw’owoomukwano tebitiisa” (Engero 27:6). “Ekkubo ly’omusirusiru ddungi mu kulaba kwe ye, naye omugezi assaayo omwoyo ku magezi agamuweebwa” (Engero 12:15).

Dawudi yasaba nti, “Leka omuntu omutuukirivu ankube, kubanga anaaba ankwatiddwa ekisa; muleke annenye, ekyo kinaaba ng’amafuta amalungi agafukiddwa ku mutwe gwange; sijja kugagaana” (Zabbuli 141:5). Nasani bwe yagamba Dawudi nti, “Omusajja oyo ye ggwe” (2 Samwiri 12:7), Dawudi yandimuttisizza. Wabula yeenenya. Ako ke kabonero k’omukulembeze ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala.

Omuntu bw’akunenya, toyanguwa kwewolereza. Wuliriza. Buuza ebibuuzo. Kisabireko. Ne bwe kiba nti okunenya kwa mazima kitundu kyokka, saba Katonda akulage ekitundu ekya mazima. Kino twakitunuulira mu Ssuula 25, Okuvumirirwa, Okuziyizibwa n’Enkaayana.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: enkuŋŋaana za John Wesley ez’ebibinja ebitono

Mu Ssuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu, twalaba engeri John Wesley gye yategekamu abagoberezi be mu bibiina by’abantu nga kkumi na babiri. Wesley era yatandikawo ebibinja ebitonotono ebyayitibwanga “bands”, eby’abantu batono ab’ekikula kimu era ab’embeera emu, olw’obwerufu obw’omunda ennyo. Mu 1738 yawandiika amateeka g’ebibinja bino. Buli mmemba yalina okuddamu ebibuuzo nga bino mu buli lukuŋŋaana:

“Bibi ki by’omanyi by’okoze okuva lwe twasembayo okukuŋŋaana? Bikemo ki by’osisinkanye? Wawonyezebwa otya? Kiki ky’olowoozezza, ky’oyogedde oba ky’okoze, ky’obuusabuusa oba kibi oba si kibi? Tolina ky’oyagala kukuuma nga kya kyama?”

— John Wesley, Rules of the Band Societies (Amateeka g’Ebibinja), 1738

Mu bigambo ebyangu: bibi ki by’omanyi nti wabikola okuva lwe twasembayo okusisinkana? Bikemo ki bye wayolekagana nabyo? Katonda yakuyamba atya? Waliwo ky’olowoozezza, ky’oyogedde oba ky’okoze, ky’otakakasa oba kyali kituufu? Waliwo ky’oyagala okukweka?

Ebibuuzo bino bizibu. Kyali kigendererwa okuba bwe bityo. Abametodisiti abaasooka baali bakkiriza nti ekibi kikula mu kizikiza era kifiira mu kitangaala. Bangi ku babuulizi ba Wesley n’abakulembeze be baakuŋŋaananga mu bibinja nga bino. Tebaali batuukiridde, naye empisa eno ey’okwatula mu bwesimbu yayamba okukuuma omulimu omunene ogw’abantu aba bulijjo obutagwa mu bivve n’obunnanfuusi.

Si buli mukulembeze nti ajja kukozesa ebibuuzo bino nga bwe biri, era birina okukozesebwa n’okwagala, so si ng’engeri y’okufuga abantu. Naye buli mukulembeze yeetaaga omuntu ayinza okumubuuza nti, “Tolina ky’oyagala kukuuma nga kya kyama?” era omukulembeze gw’anaabuuliranga amazima.

Mu Ssuula 34, Obulongoofu mu by’Okwegatta, twalaba engeri Billy Graham n’ekibinja kye gye beeyamamu awamu mu 1948 ku nsonga za ssente, obwesimbu n’obulongoofu. Baakuumagana mu bweyamo obwo okumala emyaka amakumi mangi. Okubalibwako kukola bulungi nnyo nga kugabanwa.

Buli omu ku ffe aliwa embalirira

“Noolwekyo buli omu ku ffe alyennyonnyolako eri Katonda” (Abaruumi 14:12). Abakulembeze beetisse obuzito obw’enjawulo. Abaebbulaniya boogera ku bakulembeze nti “obuweereza bwabwe kwe kulabirira emyoyo gyammwe” (Abaebbulaniya 13:17), era emyoyo egyo gye balibalirwako. “Oyo aweebwa ebingi alisuubirwamu bingi” (Lukka 12:48). Olunaku olwo olusembayo tujja kulutunuulira mu Ssuula 50, Okuwa Embalirira.

Naye ekigendererwa ky’okubalibwako kaakano kwe kututeekateeka okutuuka ku lunaku olwo n’essanyu, so si n’okutya. Bwe tukkiriza abalala okutuyamba okuba abeesigwa mu bintu ebitono leero, tujja kuba beetegefu okuwulira Mukama waffe ng’agamba nti, “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa.”

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 1 Abakkolinso 4:1-2 ne Matayo 25:14-30. Kitegeeza ki okuba omuwanika so si nnannyini?
  • Soma Lukka 16:10. “Bintu bitono” ki mu bulamu bwo ebiraga oba oli mwesigwa?
  • Ani akubuuza bulijjo ebibuuzo ebizibu ku bulamu bwo? Omubuulira amazima?
  • Nsonga ki ku ezo abakulembeze ze beewalira okubalibwako ekwata ku ggwe?
  • Ngeri ki ez’okubalibwako ekkanisa yo z’erina? Ziruwa ezibulawo?
  • Soma waggulu ebibuuzo bya Wesley eby’ebibinja. Kiruwa ekisinga obuzibu gy’oli okuddamu mu bwesimbu?
  • Otera kukola ki omuntu bw’akunenya?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Londa abakkiriza abakuze era abeesigika omu oba babiri ab’ekikula kyo, obasabe babeere banno ab’okukubalirira. Mukkiriziganye okusisinkananga bulijjo, oboolyawo omulundi gumu buli mwezi. Bawe olukusa okukubuuza ku kutambula kwo ne Katonda, ab’omu maka go, ssente zo, obulongoofu bwo n’engeri gy’okozesaamu obuyinza. Wandiika ebibuuzo by’oyagala bakubuuze. Mu lukuŋŋaana lwammwe olusooka, ddamu mu bwesimbu ekibuuzo kya Wesley ekisembayo: “Tolina ky’oyagala kukuuma nga kya kyama?”

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze beetaaga okubalibwako?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga abakulembeze bawanika b’ebintu bya Katonda, era “omuwanika kimugwanira okuba omuntu omwesigwa” (1 Abakkolinso 4:2). Ne Peetero yannyonnyola ebikolwa bye eri ekkanisa ey’omu Yerusaalemi (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 11:2-4).

study_questions.question: Kitegeeza ki okuba omwesigwa mu bitono?
study_questions.answer: “Omuntu omwesigwa mu kintu ekitono, abeera mwesigwa ne mu kinene” (Lukka 16:10). Katonda alaba engeri gye tukwatamu ebintu ebitono. Omwami yagamba nti, “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa, obadde mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono” (Matayo 25:21).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okuzimba okubalibwako?
study_questions.answer: Nga tannakwetaaga: ng’aba n’emikwano emyesigwa omu oba babiri abamubuuza ebibuuzo ebizibu, ng’aba mwerufu ku ssente n’obudde, era ng’ayaniriza okunenyezebwa. Enkuŋŋaana za John Wesley ez’ebibinja ebitono zaasabanga ba mmemba okuddamu ebibuuzo bitaano ebinoonyereza mu buli lukuŋŋaana.

fields.title: Okuwaayo Omuggo
fields.body_html:
“Ebyo bye wawulira nga njogera mu maaso g’abajulirwa abangi biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala.”

— 2 Timoseewo 2:2

Mu mpaka z’okudduka ez’okukwasaganya omuggo, abaddusi bana bagabana olugendo lumu. Buli omu adduka n’amaanyi ge gonna. Naye emirundi mingi empaka teziwangulwa oba okuwangulwa ku luguudo lw’okudduka, wabula mu kaseera ak’okukwasa munno omuggo. Omuggo bwe gugwa, ttiimu yonna ewangulwa, ne bwe kiba nti buli muddusi wa misinde. Omuddusi omulungi tayimirira kudduka mu kaseera omuddusi addako lw’atandika. Adduka ku lusegere lwe okumala ebigere bitono, okutuusa omuggo lwe gunywerera mu mukono gwa munne. Olwo n’alyoka agulekera.

Buli mukulembeze adduka ekitundu kimu eky’olugendo oluwanvu. Tewali akulembera emirembe gyonna. Olunaku lumu, ka kibe lwa kweroboza, lwa myaka, lwa bulwadde oba lwa kufa, tujja kuwaayo bye tubadde tusitudde. Essuula eno etandika Ekitundu eky’Ekkumi: Okumaliriza Obulungi. Ekwata ku kuwaayo omuggo: okuteekateeka abalala, okulekera, n’okukwasa obulungi.

Musa ne Yoswa

Musa yamanya nti tagenda kuyingira mu nsi ensuubize. Kyeyava asabira abantu: “Mukama Katonda w’emyoyo gy’abantu bonna, alonde omusajja okulabirira ekibiina kino, afulumenga era ayingirenga mu maaso gaabwe, … abantu ba Mukama baleme okuba ng’endiga ezitaliiko musumba” (Okubala 27:16-17). Musa teyali alowooza ku linnya lye. Yali alowooza ku kisibo.

Katonda n’addamu: “Twala Yoswa mutabani wa Nuuni, omusajja alimu omwoyo, omusseeko omukono gwo. Muyimirize mu maaso ga Eriyazaali kabona ne mu maaso g’ekibiina kyonna, omukuutirire mu maaso gaabwe. Mukwase ekitundu ky’obuyinza bwo” (Okubala 27:18-20).

Weetegereze ebintu ebiwerako ku kukwasa kuno.

  • Kwateekebwateekebwa okumala emyaka mingi. Yoswa yali muweereza wa Musa okuva mu buvubuka bwe. Yalwana entalo za Isirayiri, n’ayambuka ku lusozi ne Musa, era n’asigalanga mu Weema ey’Okusisinkaniramu (Okuva 33:11).
  • Katonda ye yalonda omusika. Musa teyalonda bulonzi mutabani we oba gwe yasinga okwagala.
  • Kwali mu lwatu. Yoswa yakuutirwa “mu maaso gaabwe”, mu maaso ga kabona n’abantu bonna, buli muntu alyoke amanye ani anaakulembera.
  • Obuyinza bwagabanibwa nga tebunnakwasibwa. Musa yawa Yoswa “ekitundu ky’obuyinza bwo” nga Musa akyali mulamu.
  • Omusika yazzibwamu amaanyi. Musa yagamba Yoswa mu maaso ga Isirayiri yenna nti, “Beera wa maanyi era ogume omwoyo; … Mukama Katonda yennyini y’ajjanga okukukulemberanga. Anaabanga naawe bulijjo, taakulekenga so taakwabulirenga. Totya so totekemuka” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 31:7-8).

Ekyavaamu: “Yoswa, mutabani wa Nuuni, yali ajjudde omwoyo ogw’amagezi, kubanga Musa yali yamuteekako emikono gye. Abaana ba Isirayiri ne bamuwulira” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 34:9).

Okulabula: omulembe ogutaamanya

Naye olugero luno lulina ekyaddirira eky’ennaku. Yoswa yakulembera Isirayiri n’obwesigwa. Naye bwe yafa, tewali kiwandiikiddwa kiraga nti yali ateeseteese omusika nga Musa bwe yamuteekateeka. “Awo ab’omulembe gwa Yoswa bonna bwe baafa ne baggwaawo ne waddawo omulembe gw’abataamanya Mukama yadde ebikolwa eby’amaanyi bye yakolera Abayisirayiri” (Abalamuzi 2:10). Ekitabo ky’Abalamuzi kiddirira, ekiseera eky’okutabulwa, ekibi n’okubonaabona.

Okukkiriza bulijjo kubeera omulembe gumu gwokka okuva ku kubula. Omukulembeze akola ebikulu naye n’atabiwaayo eri abalala ayinza okulaba omulimu nga gugwa mu myaka mitono. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 23, Okukuza Abakulembeze, Pawulo yawa Timoseewo olujegere lw’emirembe ena: Pawulo, Timoseewo, “abantu abeesigwa”, n’“abalala” (2 Timoseewo 2:2). Omulimu gwa buli mukulembeze si kukola mulimu kyokka, wabula n’okukakasa nti omulimu gugenda mu maaso.

Eriya ne Erisa

Katonda yagamba Eriya okufuka amafuta ku Erisa “okudda mu kifo kyo” (1 Bassekabaka 19:16). Eriya yamusanga ng’alima mu nnimiro, n’amusuulako omunagiro gwe. Erisa n’asala ente ze, n’azifumbira abantu, “n’agolokoka n’agoberera Eriya era n’amuweerezanga” (1 Bassekabaka 19:21). Okumala emyaka, Erisa yaweereza Eriya.

Ku nkomerero, Eriya yamubuuza nti, “Kiki ky’oyagala nkukolere nga sinnaba kukuggyibwako?” Erisa n’asaba “emigabo ebiri egy’Omwoyo akuliko” (2 Bassekabaka 2:9). Awo Eriya n’atwalibwa mu ggulu mu mbuyaga ey’amaanyi. Erisa n’alonda omunagiro ogwali gumuvuddeko ne gugwa, n’agenda ku Yoludaani, n’akuba amazzi n’abuuza nti, “Kaakano Mukama, Katonda wa Eriya ali luuyi wa?” (2 Bassekabaka 2:14). Amazzi ne geeyawulamu. Bannabbi abaali balaba ne bagamba nti, “Omwoyo wa Eriya ali ku Erisa” (2 Bassekabaka 2:15).

Ekibuuzo kya Erisa kikulu. Teyabuuza nti, “Eriya ali luuyi wa?” Yabuuza nti, “Mukama, Katonda wa Eriya ali luuyi wa?” Omukulembeze omukulu yali agenze. Naye Katonda w’omukulembeze oyo omukulu yali akyaliwo. Omulimu si gwa mukulembeze. Gwa Katonda, era Ye ajja kugutwala mu maaso.

Okusiibula kwa Pawulo

Okusiibula kwa Pawulo eri abakadde b’ekkanisa y’e Efeso, mu Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20, kye kimu ku bifo ebisinga okukwata ku mutima mu Bayibuli. Yali amanyi nti tagenda kuddamu kubalaba. Yabajjukiza engeri gye yabeeramu mu bo. Yabategeeza ekyali kisinga obukulu gy’ali: “ndyoke ntuukirize omulimu gwange, n’obuweereza bwe nnaweebwa Mukama waffe Yesu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:24). Awo n’abakwasa ekisibo: “Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna Mwoyo Mutukuvu mwe yabateeka okuba abalabirizi okulabiriranga Ekkanisa ya Katonda gye yeegulira n’omusaayi gwe” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28). Yabalabula ku bulabe obwali bubalindiridde. Era ku nkomerero, n’abakwasa Katonda: “Kaakano mbasigira Katonda n’ekigambo eky’ekisa kye” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:32).

“Awo Pawulo bwe yamala okwogera ebyo, n’afukamira n’asaba nabo bonna. Buli omu n’akaaba nnyo amaziga” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:36-37).

Mu bbaluwa ye esembayo ddala, Pawulo yakwasa Timoseewo omuggo: “Nkukuutirira mu maaso ga Katonda ne Kristo Yesu, … buuliranga ekigambo kya Katonda, … ng’otuukiririza ddala obuweereza bwo. Nze kaakano mpebwayo, era ekiseera kyange eky’okuva ku nsi kituuse” (2 Timoseewo 4:1-2, 5-6).

Ne Yesu yennyini yateekateeka abayigirizwa be olw’okugenda kwe. “Ekisinga obulungi gye muli Nze kwe kugenda. Kubanga bwe sigenda Omubeezi tagenda kujja, kyokka bwe ŋŋenda, ndimutuma gye muli” (Yokaana 16:7). Oluusi ekintu ekisinga obukulu omukulembeze ky’ayinza okukola kwe kwesegulira ebbali, abalala balyoke bakule.

Lwaki abakulembeze kibazibuwalira okulekera

Abakulembeze bangi beekwata ku bukulembeze okumala ebbanga ddene nnyo. Abamu tebateekateeka muntu n’omu. Lwaki?

  • Ekyo omuntu ky’ali. Bwe mba nga ndaba kye ndi mu kifo kye nkolamu, okukiwaayo kiwulikika ng’okwebula nze kennyini.
  • Okutya olw’omulimu. “Tewali mulala ayinza kugukola bulungi nga nze.” Kino emirundi mingi gaba malala agakwese mu kufaayo.
  • Ssente n’obukuumi. Abakulembeze abamu tebalina we banaabeera wadde kye banaalyako bwe bawummula. Ekkanisa kizigwanira okulabirira abakulembeze abawummula.
  • Obutaba na bukakafu. Abakulembeze abamu bawulira nga batiisibwatiisibwa abavubuka abalina ebirabo, nga Sawulo bwe yali ne Dawudi, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 36, Obuggya, Okuvuganya n’Okusosola.
