  • Okunyigirizibwa ab’omu maka. Abamu baagala okukwasa ekkanisa mutabani waabwe oba muwala waabwe, ka Katonda abe nga yabayita oba nedda.
  • Okunywerera kw’eyatandikawo. Abakulembeze abaatandikawo omulimu emirundi mingi be kisinga okuzibuwalira okugulekera.

Yokaana Omubatiza yalina omwoyo omutuufu: “Kimugwanira ye okugulumizibwa naye nze okutoowazibwa” (Yokaana 3:30). Omukulembeze aweerezza Kristo mu mazima ajja kusanyuka okulaba omulimu nga gugenda mu maaso nga ye taliiwo.

Okukwasa obulungi

Gano agamu ku magezi ag’okuwaayo omuggo.

  • Tandika nga bukyali. Tandika okuteekateeka abasika emyaka mingi nga tonnatuuka kiseera ky’osuubira okuvaawo. Buli mukulembeze asaanidde okuba ng’atendeka abantu abawerako.
  • Saba Katonda akulage gw’alonze. Nga Musa bwe yakola, saba Katonda akulage ani anaddako okukulembera. Noonya amagezi g’abakulembeze abalala n’ag’ekkanisa.
  • Gabana obuyinza nga tonnavaawo. Wa abakulembeze abato obuvunaanyizibwa obwa ddala ng’okyaliwo okubayamba.
  • Kikole mu lwatu era kitegeerekeke. Leka ekkanisa emanye ani anaakulembera, era omuwe omukisa mu lwatu.
  • Weeteekereteekere ebitasuubirwa. Obulwadde, okukwatibwa oba okufa biyinza okujja nga tebimanyiddwa. Kakasa nti waliwo ayinza okukulembera enkya bwe kiba kyetaagisa. Kino twakiraba mu Ssuula 40, Okuyigganyizibwa n’Omuwendo Ogusasulwa.
  • Vaawo bulungi. Tolekera musika wo mabanja, byama oba enkaayana ezitaggwa. Dawudi yakuŋŋaanya ebyetaagisa okuzimba yeekaalu, Sulemaani alyoke agizimbe (1 Ebyomumirembe 22:5).
  • Lekera. Bw’omala okukwasa, weesegulire ebbali. Tosigala ng’oyingirira, ng’ovumirira oba ng’onafuya. Toleka bantu kujja gy’oli okwemulugunya ku musika wo.
  • Sigala ng’oli mukisa. Bw’osigala mu kkanisa, beera omuwagizi asinga ow’omukulembeze omuggya. Musabire. Mugumye. Muwe amagezi nga gakusabiddwa kyokka.

Era bw’oba ggwe musika: ssaamu ekitiibwa oyo eyakusooka. Yiga okuva gy’ali. Toyanguyiriza kukyusa buli kimu. Era jjukira nti naawe olunaku lumu olikwasa omulala omuggo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Henry Venn ne Hudson Taylor

Mu Ssuula 23, Okukuza Abakulembeze, twasisinkana Henry Venn, omukulembeze wa Church Missionary Society mu London mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omwenda. Venn yayigiriza nti ekigendererwa ky’obuminsani kwe kusimba ekkanisa ezeefuga zokka, ezeeyimirizaawo zokka, era ezeebunyisa zokka. Yakkiriza nti abaminsani basaanidde okuteekateeka okuva ku ntandikwa okukwasa obukulembeze abakkiriza ab’omu kitundu, n’oluvannyuma ne beeyongerayo. Yayogera ne ku “euthanasia” y’omulimu gw’obuminsani, ekigambo ekitegeeza okufa okw’ekisa era okulungi. Kino yakitegeezaamu nti omulimu gw’obuminsani gusaanidde okukoma n’essanyu mu kifo ekkanisa ey’omu kitundu bw’emala okuba n’amaanyi ag’okwetengerera yokka. Omuminsani akyali y’akulira oluvannyuma lw’emyaka amakumi ataano, bwe yalowooza, aba tannamaliriza mulimu, ne bw’aba ng’akoze bingi bitya.

Si buli mulimu gwa buminsani nti gwagoberera okwolesebwa kwa Venn. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 36, Obuggya, Okuvuganya n’Okusosola, obukulembeze bw’Abafirika bwe yali asuubira ku Mugga Niger bwakosebwa nnyo oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera kya Crowther. Naye enkola ye ebadde ebumba Ekkanisa ey’ensi yonna okuva olwo. Leero Abakristaayo abasinga obungi mu nsi bakulemberwa bantu baabwe bennyini.

Hudson Taylor yatandikawo China Inland Mission mu 1865 n’agukulembera okumala emyaka egisukka mu amakumi asatu mu etaano. Ekyasa we kyaggwerako, gwali gufuuse gumu ku mirimu gy’obuminsani egisinga obunene mu nsi. Mu 1900, mu kiseera ky’akeegugungo ka Boxer mu China, omulimu ogwo gwafiirwa abaminsani amakumi ataano mu munaana n’abaana amakumi abiri mu omu, wamu n’abakkiriza Abachina bangi. Taylor, eyali akaddiye era omulwadde, ng’ali mu Switzerland, amawulire gaamumenya kumpi okumuggwaamu ddala. Ng’ekitabo kya Ochorus Key Teachings of Hudson Taylor (Enjigiriza Enkulu za Hudson Taylor) bwe kiwandiika, oluvannyuma yakwasa obukulembeze bw’omulimu ogwo omusajja omuto, Dixon Hoste.

Tekyali kyangu eri eyatandikawo omulimu okugulekera nga yaakagusitula okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo. Naye Taylor yakikola, era omulimu ne gugenda mu maaso ne gukula. Mu 1905, yagenda mu China omulundi ogusembayo, era n’afiira eyo mu mirembe, mu Changsha. Yali adduse ekitundu kye eky’olugendo, era yali ateeka omuggo bulungi mu mukono gw’omulala.

Omulimu gwa Katonda

Musa bwe yafa, Katonda yagamba Yoswa nti, “Musa omuweereza wange afudde, kale kaakano weeteeketeeke osomoke omugga guno Yoludaani” (Yoswa 1:2). Omulimu tegwayimirira. Gwagenda mu maaso, kubanga gwali mulimu gwa Katonda, so si gwa Musa.

Dawudi yagamba mutabani we Sulemaani nti, “Ba n’amaanyi era guma omwoyo, okole omulimu. Totya so totekemuka wadde okuggwamu omwoyo, kubanga Mukama Katonda, Katonda wange ali wamu naawe. Taakwabulirenga so taakulekenga okutuusa omulimu gwonna ogw’okuweereza ogwa yeekaalu ye Mukama nga guwedde” (1 Ebyomumirembe 28:20). Pawulo yawandiika nti, “oyo eyatandika omulimu omulungi mu mmwe, aligutuukiriza okutuusa ku lunaku lwa Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 1:6).

Dduka bulungi ekitundu kyo eky’olugendo. Olwo oteeke omuggo mu mukono gw’omulala, era olekere. Katonda wa Eriya akyali wano.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Okubala 27:15-23 ne Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 31:7-8. Kiki ky’oyinza okuyiga mu ngeri Musa gye yakwasaamu Yoswa?
  • Soma Abalamuzi 2:7-10. Olowooza lwaki omulembe ogwaddirira gwali gw’“abataamanya Mukama”?
  • Soma 2 Bassekabaka 2:9-15. Ekibuuzo kya Erisa, “Kaakano Mukama, Katonda wa Eriya ali luuyi wa?”, kikuyigiriza ki?
  • Baani b’oteekateeka okukulembera ng’ovuddewo? Singa ovaawo enkya, ani yandikulembedde?
  • Ku nsonga lwaki abakulembeze kibazibuwalira okulekera, eriwa ekwata ku ggwe?
  • Bw’oba wadda mu kifo ky’omukulembeze omulala, wamussaamu otya ekitiibwa?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga mu ndowooza ya Venn ey’“euthanasia” y’omulimu gw’obuminsani?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wandiika amannya g’abantu b’oteekateeka okukulembera ng’ovuddewo. Bwe wataba n’omu, saba Katonda akulage omu oba babiri, era otandike okusisinkana nabo omwezi guno. Oluvannyuma weebuuze nti, “Singa okuva enkya sikyasobola kukulembera, kiki ekkanisa kye yandyetaaze okumanya?” Kiwandiike, era okigabane ne bakulembeze banno. Bw’oba ng’osemberedde enkomerero y’ekiseera kyo mu kifo ky’olimu, yogera n’abakulembeze bo wiiki eno ku nteekateeka y’okukwasa obulungi.

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze asaanidde kuwaayo atya obukulembeze?
study_questions.answer: Nga bukyali era mu bugenderevu. Musa yasaba Katonda omusika, n’assa emikono ku Yoswa era n’amuzzaamu amaanyi: “Beera wa maanyi era ogume omwoyo; … Mukama Katonda yennyini y’ajjanga okukukulemberanga” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 31:7-8). Pawulo yakwasa Timoseewo omulimu era n’amugamba naye agukwase abalala (2 Timoseewo 2:2).

study_questions.question: Lwaki abakulembeze kibazibuwalira okulekera?
study_questions.answer: Kubanga ekyo kye bali bakisiba ku kifo kye balimu, kubanga batya nti omulimu gujja kugwa nga tebaliiwo, oba kubanga tewali muntu yatendekebwa. Essuula ejjukiza abakulembeze nti omulimu gwa Katonda, so si gwabwe.

study_questions.question: Kiki ekibaawo ng’omulembe oguddako tegwateekebwateekebwa?
study_questions.answer: Ekitabo ky’Abalamuzi kirabula nti ab’omulembe gwa Yoswa bwe baafa, “waddawo omulembe gw’abataamanya Mukama” (Abalamuzi 2:10). Essuula ennyonnyola engeri Henry Venn gye yateekateekamu “euthanasia” y’omulimu gw’obuminsani, n’engeri Hudson Taylor gye yakwasaamu Dixon Hoste.

fields.title: Ebirekebwawo: Ekisigalawo
fields.body_html:
“Abo abalina okutegeera balyakaayakana ng’okumasamasa kw’omu bbanga; n’abo abakyusa abangi okudda eri obutuukirivu, balyakaayakana ng’emmunyeenye emirembe n’emirembe.”

— Danyeri 12:3

Mu kibuga ekimu mulimu ekizimbe eky’amayinja ekirabika obulungi, nga waggulu w’omulyango kuwandiikiddwako erinnya. Kyazimbibwa emyaka mingi emabega omusajja omugagga, ng’ekijjukizo kye yennyini. Leero ekizimbe kino kikalu, akasolya kakulukusa, era tewali muntu mu kibuga ajjukira omusajja oyo kye yali. Naye mu kibuga kye kimu, omukadde omukazi ataalina ssente yali ayigiriza abaana mu maka ge okusoma Bayibuli. Abamu ku baana abo baafuuka basumba, basomesa n’abasawo. Abaana baabwe n’abazzukulu baabwe bagoberera Kristo leero. Erinnya lye teriwandiikiddwa wonna. Naye omulimu gwe gukyali mulamu.

Buli mukulembeze alina ky’aleka emabega. Ekibuuzo kiri nti kiki. Essuula eno ekwata ku birekebwawo: ekinaasigalawo nga tetukyaliwo. Okuddamu kwa Bayibuli kutegeerekeka bulungi. Ekisigalawo si bizimbe, si nteekateeka, era si mannya. Ekisigalawo bantu abaakulira mu Kristo, n’omulimu ogwakolebwa ku lulwe.

“Twekolere erinnya”

Edda ennyo, abantu baakuŋŋaanira mu lusenyi lwa Sinaali ne bagamba nti, “Mujje twezimbire ekibuga, tutuuse omunaala gwakyo ku ggulu; twekolere erinnya” (Olubereberye 11:4). Eno y’emu ku mpisa z’omuntu ezisinga obukadde: okwagala okujjukirwa, okuleka ekijjukizo, okufuula erinnya lyaffe ekkulu. Katonda yabasaasaanya, era omunaala ne gusigala nga tegumaliriziddwa.

Abakulembeze bafuna okukemebwa kwe kumu. Twagala okuzimba ekkanisa esinga obunene, ekizimbe ekisinga obulungi, obuweereza obusinga okumanyibwa. Twagala erinnya lyaffe libeere ku mulyango. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 32, Amalala n’Okwagala Okutenderezebwa, okwagala kuno kuyinza okwesirikirira ne kudda mu kifo ky’okwagala ekitiibwa kya Katonda.

Omubuulizi mu kitabo ky’Omubuulizi yalaba obutaliimu bw’okwezimbira ffekka: “Nakyawa okutegana kwange kwonna kwe nateganamu wansi w’enjuba, kubanga byonna ndi wakubirekera oyo alinzirira mu bigere. Kale ani amanyi obanga aliba musajja mugezi oba musirusiru?” (Omubuulizi 2:18-19). Buli kye twezimbira olw’erinnya lyaffe, tujja kukirekera omulala, era kijja kuggwaawo.

Ezaabu oba essubi

Pawulo atuwa ekifaananyi ky’ekyo ekisigalawo: “Kubanga tewali n’omu ayinza kuteekawo musingi mulala okuggyako ogwo ogwateekebwawo, ye Yesu Kristo. Naye Omuntu bw’aguzimbisaako ezaabu, effeeza, n’amayinja ag’omuwendo n’emiti, n’essubi, oba ebisasiro; omulimu gwa buli omu gulirabibwa, kubanga omuliro guligwolesa ku lunaku olwo, era omuliro ogwo gwe gulyoreka omulimu gwa buli omu nga bwe guli. Omuntu kye yazimba ku musingi ogwo bwe kirisigalawo, aliweebwa empeera. Naye omulimu gw’omuntu yenna bwe gulyokebwa omuliro, alifiirwa, kyokka ye yennyini alirokolebwa, naye ng’ayita mu muliro” (1 Abakkolinso 3:11-15).

Pawulo yali awandiikira abakulembeze, abo abazimba ekkanisa. Abakulembeze babiri bayinza bombi okuzimba ku Kristo. Naye omu azimbisa ezaabu n’effeeza, ate omulala emiti n’essubi. Okuva ebweru, ekizimbe eky’essubi kiyinza okulabika ng’ekisinga obunene era kiyinza okuzimbibwa amangu. Naye ku Lunaku olw’enkomerero, omuliro gujja kugezesa omulimu gwa buli mukulembeze. Ekya ddala kyokka kye kijja okusigalawo.

Ezaabu kye ki, n’essubi kye ki? Ezaabu gwe mulimu ogukoleddwa mu Kristo, ku bw’Omwoyo we, n’ebigendererwa ebituufu, ng’Ekigambo kye bwe kiri. Be bantu abaleeteddwa ddala mu kukkiriza era abazimbiddwa ddala mu ye. Essubi gwe mulimu ogukoleddwa olw’erinnya lyaffe, mu maanyi gaffe, n’ebigendererwa ebikyamu, oba mu ngeri ezitamuwa kitiibwa. Guyinza okusikiriza ebibiina by’abantu. Naye tegujja kugumira muliro.

Abantu bye birekebwawo ebiwangaala

Pawulo bwe yalowooza ku ekyo ky’alyanjulira Kristo ku kujja kwe, teyalowooza ku bizimbe oba ku miwendo gy’abantu. Yalowooza ku bantu: “Kale Mukama waffe Yesu bw’alijja, si mmwe mulibeera essuubi n’essanyu lyaffe, n’engule ey’okwenyumiriza kwaffe? Kubanga mmwe kitiibwa kyaffe era essanyu lyaffe” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:19-20). Eri Abakkolinso yawandiika nti, “Mmwe muli bbaluwa yaffe, … muli bbaluwa eva eri Kristo, enywezeddwa ffe, etaawandiikibwa na bwino, wabula na Mwoyo wa Katonda omulamu, … ku bipande by’emitima egy’omubiri” (2 Abakkolinso 3:2-3).

Yokaana omukadde yawandiika nti, “Tewali kindeetera ssanyu lisinga ng’eryo lye nfuna bwe mpulira nti abaana bange batambulira mu mazima” (3 Yokaana 4). Yesu yagamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala ate ebibala eby’olubeerera” (Yokaana 15:16).

Danyeri yalaba empeera y’abo abawaayo obulamu bwabwe eri omulimu guno: “abo abakyusa abangi okudda eri obutuukirivu” “balyakaayakana ng’emmunyeenye emirembe n’emirembe” (Danyeri 12:3). Ebizimbe bigwa. Emmunyeenye zeeyongera okwakaayakana.

Okuwaayo okukkiriza eri emirembe egitannazaalibwa

Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli yalaba omulimu gwe nga gubuna emirembe n’emirembe: “tunaabuuliranga buli mulembe ogunnaddangawo ebikolwa bya Mukama eby’ekitalo, … ab’omu mulembe oguliddirira nabo babimanye, n’abaana abalizaalibwa, nabo babiyigirize abaana baabwe, balyoke beesigenga Katonda” (Zabbuli 78:4, 6-7).

Weetegereze emirembe ena wano: ffe “tunaabuuliranga”, “ab’omu mulembe oguliddirira”, “abaana abalizaalibwa”, n’“abaana baabwe”. Ekirekebwawo ekisinga obukulu omukulembeze ky’ayinza okuleka lwe lujegere lw’okukkiriza olutuuka ku bantu b’atalisisinkana. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 47, Okuwaayo Omuggo, Pawulo yawa Timoseewo okwolesebwa kwe kumu: “biyigirizenga abantu abeesigwa, abalisobola okubiyigiriza abalala” (2 Timoseewo 2:2).

Abaebbulaniya batugamba nti Aberi, omuntu eyasooka okufa, “newaakubadde nga Aberi yafa, akyayogera” (Abaebbulaniya 11:4). Okukkiriza kw’abo abaatusooka kukyatwogerako. Bye baaleka bikyali biramu mu bantu be baabumba, ne mu kyokulabirako kye baaleka. “Mujjukirenga abakulembeze bammwe abaababuulira ekigambo kya Katonda, nga mutunuulira empisa zaabwe nga mugobereranga okukkiriza” (Abaebbulaniya 13:7).

Empeke y’eŋŋaano

Yesu yayigiriza ekyama ekisinga obuziba eky’ebirekebwawo: “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti empeke y’eŋŋaano bw’egwa mu ttaka efa, bwe tefa ebeera yokka, naye bw’efa ebala ebibala bingi” (Yokaana 12:24). Yesu yasooka kwogera ku kufa kwe yennyini. Naye yeeyongera n’agamba nti bwe kityo bwe kiri eri buli amugoberera.

Omukulembeze agezaako okuwonya obulamu bwe, okukuuma erinnya lye n’okuzimba obwakabaka bwe, ajja kusigala yekka, nga empeke “ebeera yokka”. Omukulembeze awaayo obulamu bwe, mu kwagala, ku lwa Kristo n’abalala, ajja kubala ebibala bingi. Bangi ku bakulembeze abaakola omulimu ogwasinga okuwangaala baafa nga baavu, nga tebamanyiddwa, oba nga bakyali bato. Naye obulamu bwabwe, obwaziikibwa ng’ensigo, bwafuuka amakungula.

Kiki ky’olireka?

Bino bye bimu ku bibuuzo ebiyamba omukulembeze okulowooza ku birekebwawo.

  • Baani be nteekamu obulamu bwange? Bantu ki abanaatwala okukkiriza mu maaso nga nvuddewo?
  • Nzimba ku ki? Omulimu gwange guzimbiddwa ku Kristo n’Ekigambo kye, oba ku mbala yange n’ebirabo byange?
  • Lwaki nzimba? Olw’erinnya lye oba olw’erinnya lyange?
  • Ab’omu maka gange balijjukira ki? “Omuntu omulungi alekera bazzukulu be ebyobusika” (Engero 13:22). Obusika obusinga obulungi kwe kukkiriza okulamu.
  • Kiki ekirisigalawo erinnya lyange bwe lirieerabirwa? Singa tewali anjijukira mu myaka amakumi ataano, omulimu gulyeyongera okugenda mu maaso?
  • Kiki kye mpandiika? Si mu bitabo kyokka, wabula mu bulamu bw’abantu be nkulembera.

Musa yasaba nti, “otusobozesenga okutuukiriza obulungi emirimu gyaffe; weewaawo, otusobozesenga okutuukiriza obulungi emirimu gyaffe” (Zabbuli 90:17). Okwo kusaba kulungi eri buli mukulembeze.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Francke, Müller ne Brainerd

Ku ntandikwa y’emyaka gya 1700, pulofeesa Omugirimaani ayitibwa August Hermann Francke yatandikawo ennyumba y’abaana bamulekwa mu kibuga Halle, nga yeesiga Katonda mu kusaba okulabirira abaana. Francke yafa mu 1727. Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka kikumi, omuyizi Omugirimaani omuvubuka ayitibwa George Müller yajja e Halle n’abeera emyezi ebiri mu bizimbe ebyo byennyini Francke bye yazimba. Ekitabo ky’ebyafaayo George Müller of Bristol (George Müller ow’e Bristol), ekiri ku Ochorus, kinnyonnyola engeri ebizimbe ebyo gye byali gy’ali “obukakafu obulabika, obwa ddala era obukwatikako nti Katonda Omulamu awulira okusaba.” Essomo eryo, bwe kigamba, teryamuvaako n’akatono.

Müller, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 13, Okubeera mu Kigambo, ne mu Ssuula 28, Amagezi n’Okuteekateeka, oluvannyuma yatandikawo amaka g’abaana bamulekwa e Ashley Down mu Bristol, Bungereza. Okumala emyaka egisukka mu nkaaga yalabirira bamulekwa nga tasabangako muntu yenna ssente, ng’ebyetaago bye abibuulira Katonda yekka. Ekiseera bwe kyayitawo, amaka ago gaali gasuza abaana abasukka mu nkumi bbiri omulundi gumu. Francke teyamanya Müller. Naye okukkiriza kwa Francke, okwazimbibwa mu mayinja ne mu kusaba, kwayogera ne Müller oluvannyuma lw’emyaka kikumi. Era olugero lwa Müller okuva olwo luzizzaamu amaanyi obukadde n’obukadde bw’abakkiriza okwetooloola ensi okwesiga Katonda.

David Brainerd, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 19, Okunoonya Abaabula, ne mu Ssuula 37, Ekiwuubaalo n’Emigugu Egikwekeddwa, yafa mu 1747 ng’aweza emyaka abiri mu mwenda. Obuminsani bwe mu Bayindi b’omu Amerika bwamala emyaka mitono gyokka, era emirundi mingi yabanga mulwadde era ng’aweddemu amaanyi. Ng’ensi bw’epima, obulamu bwe bwali bumpi era butono. Naye oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwe, Jonathan Edwards yafulumya ebiwandiiko bye ebya buli lunaku, ebiri ku Ochorus. Ebiwandiiko ebyo bisomeddwa emirembe n’emirembe gy’abaminsani. William Carey, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 27, Okwolesebwa: Okulaba Katonda by’Alaba, ne bakozi banne mu Buyindi oluvannyuma baawandiika mu ndagaano yaabwe nti basaanidde okutunuuliranga ennyo ekyokulabirako kya Brainerd. Henry Martyn, omuyivu Omungereza omuvubuka ow’amagezi amangi, yasoma ebyafaayo bya Brainerd n’alekayo omulimu ogwali gumusuubiza ebirungi, n’agenda ng’omuminsani e Buyindi ne Buperusi, gye yavvuunula Endagaano Empya nga tannafa ku myaka amakumi asatu mu gumu. Brainerd, ng’empeke y’eŋŋaano, yagwa mu ttaka n’afa. Naye obulamu bwe bwabala ebibala bingi.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa ey’Ensi Yonna: Dohnavur Fellowship

Mu Ssuula 35, Obuyinza, Okutulugunya n’Okukuuma Abanafu, twalaba engeri akawala akayitibwa Preena gye kaddukira Amy Carmichael mu 1901. Okuva ku mwana oyo omu kwe kwava Dohnavur Fellowship mu bukiikaddyo bwa Buyindi, amaka amanene agaalabirira abaana ebikumi n’ebikumi mu myaka amakumi egyaddirira. Amy yennyini yafa mu 1951, oluvannyuma lw’emyaka mingi ng’ali ku ndiri. Naye yali atendese bakozi banne Abayindi okukulembera, era omulimu ne gugenda mu maaso ng’avuddewo. Bangi ku baana abaakulira e Dohnavur nabo baafuuka abajjanjabi, basomesa n’abakozi b’Ekikristaayo. Amy teyayagala muntu yenna kumuzimbira kijjukizo. Yasaba waleme kubaawo jjinja liriko erinnya lye n’ebyo bye yakola ku ntaana ye. Nga Amy Carmichael: A Life (Obulamu bwa Amy Carmichael), ekiri ku Ochorus, bwe kinyumya, ab’ekibiina baateeka ku ntaana ye akabya ebinyonyi mwe binywera amazzi, ne bawandiikako ekigambo kimu kyokka: Amma, ekigambo ky’Olutamiri ekitegeeza “maama” abaana kye baamuyitanga. Ekyo kye yaleka si jjinja, wabula bulamu bw’abantu.

Emmunyeenye, so si bijjukizo

“Awo ne mpulira eddoboozi nga liva mu ggulu nga ligamba nti, ‘Wandiika kino nti okuva kaakano, balina omukisa abafu, abafiira mu Mukama waffe.’ ‘Balina omukisa ddala,’ bw’ayogera Omwoyo. ‘Banaawummula okutegana kwabwe, kubanga ebikolwa byabwe bibagoberera.’” (Okubikkulirwa 14:13).

Bye tukola mu Kristo bitugoberera. Tewali kintu kyonna ekikoleddwa ku lulwe mu kwagala ekifa obwereere. Tomala bulamu bwo ng’ozimba omunaala olw’erinnya lyo. Bumale ng’ozimba abantu, ku musingi gwa Kristo, ng’ozimbisa ezaabu so si essubi. Olunaku lumu, erinnya lyo liyinza okwerabirwa ku nsi. Naye abo abakyusa abangi okudda eri obutuukirivu balyakaayakana ng’emmunyeenye, emirembe n’emirembe.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Olubereberye 11:1-9. Mu ngeri ki abakulembeze gye bakemebwamu okugamba nti “twekolere erinnya”?
  • Soma 1 Abakkolinso 3:10-15. Kiki mu buweereza bwo ekiri ezaabu, era kiki ekiyinza okuba essubi?
  • Soma 1 Abasessaloniika 2:19-20. Baani abaliba “essuubi n’essanyu” lyo era “engule” yo nga Kristo azze?
  • Soma Zabbuli 78:4-7. Owaayo otya okukkiriza eri emirembe egitannazaalibwa?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga mu lugero lwa Francke ne Müller?
  • Obulamu bwa Brainerd bwali bumpi, naye ebibala byabwo byali bingi. Ekyo kikuzzaamu kitya amaanyi?
  • Singa erinnya lyo lyerabirwa mu myaka amakumi ataano, kiki ekyandisigaddewo ku mulimu gwo?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Wandiika ebbaluwa ennyimpi eri omuntu gw’oteekamu obulamu bwo, oboolyawo omukulembeze omuto, omwana oba omukkiriza omuggya. Mubuulire ky’oyize ku kugoberera Kristo, n’ebyo by’omusuubirira era by’omusabira. Oluvannyuma wandiika, mu sentensi emu oba bbiri, ekyo ky’oyagala okuleka emabega. Kisabiremu Zabbuli 90:17: “otusobozesenga okutuukiriza obulungi emirimu gyaffe.”

study_questions.question: Ebirekebwawo bya ngeri ki ebiwangaala emirembe gyonna?
study_questions.answer: Si bizimbe wadde erinnya, wabula abantu abaleeteddwa eri Kristo era abakuze mu ye. “Abo abakyusa abangi okudda eri obutuukirivu” “balyakaayakana ng’emmunyeenye emirembe n’emirembe” (Danyeri 12:3). Pawulo yagamba abakkiriza be yaweereza nti, “si mmwe mulibeera essuubi n’essanyu lyaffe, n’engule ey’okwenyumiriza kwaffe?” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:19-20).

study_questions.question: Pawulo ategeeza ki bw’ayogera ku kuzimbisa ezaabu oba essubi?
study_questions.answer: Buli mukulembeze azimba ku musingi gwa Yesu Kristo, naye abamu bazimbisa ebintu ebiwangaala ate abalala ebintu ebyokebwa. Ku Lunaku olw’enkomerero omuliro gujja kugezesa omulimu gwa buli omu (1 Abakkolinso 3:11-15).

study_questions.question: Omukulembeze ayinza atya okuleka ebirekebwawo eri emirembe egitannazaalibwa?
study_questions.answer: Ng’ateeka obulamu bwe mu bantu, ng’atendeka abakulembeze, era ng’awaayo okukkiriza. Essuula enyumya ku August Francke ne George Müller, ku ngeri ebiwandiiko bya David Brainerd ebya buli lunaku gye byakwata ku baminsani abaaddirira, ne ku Dohnavur Fellowship.

fields.title: Okukaddiwa mu Mulimu
fields.body_html:
“Ne mu bukadde bwabwe balibala ebibala; baliba balamu era abagimu.”

— Zabbuli 92:14

Mu bitundu bingi eby’ensi, wakati mu kyalo mubaamu emiti emikadde. Ebikolo byagyo bigazi era byeweta olw’obukadde. Amatabi gaagyo tegakyakula mangu nga bwe gaakulanga edda. Naye wansi w’ekisiikirize kyagyo abakadde mwe basisinkanira, abaana mwe bazannyira, n’abatambuze mwe bawummulira. Emiti emito egigyetoolodde mu bifo ebimu miwanvu okugisinga era gikula mangu. Naye tewali muti muto guyinza kuwa kisiikirize ng’eky’omukadde.

Abakulembeze bakaddiwa. Emibiri gyabwe ginafuwa. Tebakyasobola kukola ssaawa mpanvu nga bwe baakolanga edda. Naye Katonda tasuula baweereza be abakadde. Obukadde bulina ebirabo byabwo n’ebibala byabwo. Era bulina n’obulabe bwabwo. Essuula eno ekwata ku kukaddiwa mu mulimu: amagezi g’abakulembeze abakadde, omukisa gwe bayinza okuwa abato, n’obulabe obw’okwekwata ku kifo.

Bakyabala ebibala

Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli yayimba nti, “Abatuukirivu balyegolola ng’enkindu, ne bakula ne bawanvuwa ng’emivule gy’e Lebanooni. Egisimbibwa mu nnyumba ya Mukama. Baligimukira mu mpya za Katonda waffe. Ne mu bukadde bwabwe balibala ebibala; baliba balamu era abagimu” (Zabbuli 92:12-14).

Ensi etera okugamba nti abakadde baggwaako, nti ekiseera kyabwe kyayita. Bayibuli eyogera kirala. “Omutwe ogw’envi ngule ya kitiibwa, gufunibwa abo abatambulira mu bulamu obutuukirivu” (Engero 16:31). “Amaanyi kye kitiibwa ky’abavubuka, envi kye kitiibwa ky’abakadde” (Engero 20:29). “Amagezi tegasangibwa mu bakaddiye? Okuwangaala tekuleeta kutegeera?” (Yobu 12:12). Katonda yalagira abantu be nti, “Ositukiranga ow’envi, n’omukadde omussangamu ekitiibwa” (Ebyabaleevi 19:32).

Era Katonda asuubiza okusitula abaweereza be okutuusa ku nkomerero: “Ne mu bukadde bwammwe nzija kusigala nga ye nze Nzuuyo. Ne bwe muliba mulina envi nnaabasitulanga. Nze nabakola era nze nnaabawekanga. Nnaabasitulanga era nnaabanunulanga” (Isaaya 46:4). Pawulo yagamba nti, “newaakubadde ng’emibiri gyaffe gifa, naye omuntu waffe ow’omunda adda buggya bulijjo” (2 Abakkolinso 4:16). Omubiri gweyongera kunafuwa. Omwoyo guyinza okweyongera okuba n’amaanyi.

Kalebu ku myaka kinaana mu etaano

Kalebu yali omu ku bakessi ekkumi n’ababiri Musa be yatuma mu nsi ensuubize. Ye ne Yoswa bokka be beesiga Katonda. Emyaka amakumi ana mu etaano oluvannyuma, Isirayiri bwe yali emaze okuyingira mu nsi, Kalebu yajja eri Yoswa n’okusaba, ng’aweza emyaka kinaana mu etaano: “Nkyalina amaanyi leero nga ge nalina Musa bwe yantuma, … Kale noolwekyo mpa olusozi luno, Mukama lwe yayogera ku lunaku luli, kubanga wawulira ku olwo ng’Abanaki kwe baali n’ebibuga ebinene ebiriko enkomera. Mukama nga ye mubeezi wange, nnaabagoba nga Mukama bwe yayogera” (Yoswa 14:10-12).

Kalebu teyasaba kifo kyangu okuwummuliramu. Ku myaka kinaana mu etaano yasaba omulimu ogusinga obuzibu, ensi ey’ensozi abanene mwe baabeeranga. Yali akyeesiga Katonda, akyali mwetegefu okusanga okusoomoozebwa, akyatunuulira eby’omu maaso. Si buli mukulembeze mukadde nti ajja kuba n’amaanyi g’omubiri nga Kalebu. Naye buli mukulembeze mukadde ayinza okuba n’amaanyi g’okukkiriza nga Kalebu.

Simyoni ne Ana

Maliyamu ne Yusufu bwe baaleeta omwana Yesu mu Yeekaalu, abakadde babiri baali balindirira. Simyoni yali “mutuukirivu, ng’atya Katonda, era ng’ajjudde Mwoyo Mutukuvu, ng’alindirira okusanyusibwa kwa Isirayiri” (Lukka 2:25). Yasitula omwana mu mikono gye n’agamba nti, “Mukama wange, kaakano osiibule omuweereza wo mirembe, ng’ekigambo kyo bwe kigamba. Kubanga amaaso gange galabye Obulokozi bwo” (Lukka 2:29-30).

Ana yali “mukadde nnyo, … yali yaakamala emyaka kinaana mu ena, era teyavanga mu Yeekaalu ng’asiiba n’okwegayiriranga Katonda emisana n’ekiro. Awo Ana mu kiseera ekyo … n’atandika okutendereza Katonda ng’amwogerako eri abo bonna abaali balindirira okununulibwa kwa Yerusaalemi” (Lukka 2:36-38).

Abakadde bano bombi tebaalina kifo kya bukulembeze. Naye baali bamaze emyaka mingi mu kusaba n’okulindirira Katonda. Olw’ekyo, baategeera Masiya ng’abalala tebamutegedde. Era baamwogerako eri abalala. Obuweereza bw’abakkiriza abakadde emirundi mingi buba buweereza bwa kusaba, bwa kwawula ebintu mu mwoyo, ne bwa kuwa bujulirwa, era bwa muwendo nnyo eri Katonda.

Ebirabo by’abakulembeze abakadde

Omuwandiisi wa zabbuli yasaba mu bukadde bwe nti, “Ne bwe ndiba nga nkaddiye nga mmeze n’envi, tonjabuliranga, Ayi Katonda, okutuusiza ddala nga mmaze okutendera abo abaliddawo amaanyi go amangi, n’okumanyisa emirembe egigenda okujja obuyinza bwo” (Zabbuli 71:18). Guno gwe mulimu omukulu ogw’abakulembeze abakadde: okuwaayo eri omulembe oguddako ebyo Katonda by’akoze.

Abakulembeze abakadde balina ebirabo eby’enjawulo eby’okuwaayo.

  • Amagezi. Emyaka egy’okutambula ne Katonda, ng’osobya era ng’oyigira ku nsobi ezo, giwa okutegeera okw’ebuziba okutayinza kuyigibwa mu bitabo.
  • Okujjukira. Bajjukira obwesigwa bwa Katonda mu kugezesebwa okwayita. Basobola okugamba abato nti, “Ndabye Katonda ng’akola kino emabega.”
  • Okusaba. Abakkiriza bangi abakadde balina obudde bungi obw’okusaba. Nga Ana, basobola okufuuka amaanyi agakwekeddwa ag’ekkanisa.
  • Omukisa. Mu Bayibuli, abakadde baawanga abato omukisa. Yakobo yawa bazzukulu be omukisa. Musa yawa ebika omukisa. Omukisa n’okuzzaamu amaanyi okuva eri omukulembeze omukadde biyinza okuba eby’omuwendo ennyo eri omukulembeze omuto.
  • Okuluŋŋamya. Pawulo yagamba Tito nti abasajja abakulu n’abakazi abakulu basaanidde okuyigiriza n’okugunjula abato (Tito 2:2-4). Abakulembeze abakadde basobola okutambula n’abato nga Pawulo bwe yakola ne Timoseewo.
  • Ekyokulabirako. Obulamu obusigadde nga bwesigwa okutuusa ku nkomerero bwo bwennyini kubuulira.

Ekkanisa zisaanidde okussa ekitiibwa mu bakulembeze baazo abakadde n’okukozesa ebirabo byabwe. Tobasindika ebbali. Basabe amagezi. Lekobowaamu yafiirwa ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky’obwakabaka bwe kubanga “n’atawuliriza magezi abakadde ge baamuwa, n’agenda ne yeebuuza ku bavubuka be yali akuze nabo” (1 Bassekabaka 12:8).

Obulabe bw’obukadde

Obukadde nabwo bulina obulabe bwabwo. Ebimu ku byafaayo ebisinga okunakuwaza mu Bayibuli bikwata ku bakulembeze abaatandika obulungi ne bamaliriza bubi.

  • Okukyuka okuva ku Katonda. “Mu bisera bya Sulemaani eby’obukadde, bakyala be ne basendasenda omutima gwe okugoberera bakatonda abalala” (1 Bassekabaka 11:4), era omutima gwe ne gutaba gwonna eri Mukama Katonda we. Omusajja eyasinga amagezi mu nsi yawaba okuva ku Katonda mu bukadde bwe.
  • Okwefaako kwokka ku by’omu maaso. Isaaya bwe yagamba Kabaka Keezeekiya nti akabi kaliba ku bazzukulu be, Keezeekiya yalowooza nti, “Kasita, emirembe n’obutebenkevu binaabeerangawo mu mirembe gyange” (2 Bassekabaka 20:19). Yafaayo ku bulamu bwe bwokka.
  • Amalala. Kabaka Uzziya yaweebwa omukisa mungi, naye “Uzziya bwe yatutumuka, ne yeegulumiza, n’okugwa n’agwa” (2 Ebyomumirembe 26:16), era n’amaliriza obulamu bwe ng’agobeddwa mu bantu.
  • Okwekwata ku buyinza. Abakulembeze abamu abakadde tebaagala kulekera. Baziyiza abakulembeze abato, bakakaatika ekyo kye baagala, era basigala mu kifo ebbanga ddene oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera kye baalina okwesegulira ebbali. Kino twakitunuulira mu Ssuula 47, Okuwaayo Omuggo.
  • Obukyayi obw’omu mutima. Abamu bafuna obukaawu olw’ebyabalumya edda, oba olw’enkyukakyuka mu kkanisa ze batayagala.
  • Okulekera awo okuyiga. Abakulembeze abamu abakadde balekera awo okukula. Babeera ku bye baayitamu edda ne ku bubaka obukadde. Okukkiriza kwabwe kufuuka kijjukizo mu kifo ky’okutambula okulamu ne Katonda.

Mu mpisa ez’amawanga agamu, obulabe buli nti abakulembeze abakadde bassibwamu ekitiibwa kingi nnyo ne kiba nti tewali ayinza kubanenya, era abato tebaweebwa kifo kya kukulembera. Mu mpisa endala, obulabe buba bwa njawulo ddala: abakadde basindikibwa ebbali ne beerabirwa. Ekkanisa erina okukola obulungi okusinga ebyo byombi. Erina okussa ekitiibwa mu bakadde n’okuwa abato ekifo. “Tokambuwaliranga musajja mukulu, wabula omubuuliriranga nga kitaawo. Abavubuka bayisenga nga baganda bo, abakazi abakadde bayisenga ng’abazadde bo” (1 Timoseewo 5:1-2).

Okumaliriza obulungi

Abakulembeze abakadde bayinza batya okumaliriza obulungi?

  • Kuuma okutambula kwo ne Katonda nga kupya. Weeyongere okusoma, okusaba n’okuyiga. Saba Katonda akuume omutima gwo nga gwonna gwewaddeyo gy’ali.
  • Wa abato ekifo. Sanyuka abakulembeze abato bwe bavaayo. Vva mu bifo mu kiseera ekituufu, obawe ebbanga.
  • Beera ng’osangibwa. Beera mwetegefu okusaba, okuwa amagezi n’okuzzaamu amaanyi, nga tokakaatika ky’oyagala.
  • Wa omulembe oguddako omukisa. Yogera ebigambo by’omukisa ku bakulembeze abato. Bategeeze Katonda by’akoze.
  • Kkiriza obunafu bwo. Omubiri gwo gujja kugenda mpola. Kkiriza okuyambibwa n’ekisa.
  • Kola ku biwundu ebikadde. Sonyiwa abaakulumya. Totwala bukaawu mu ntaana.
  • Weeteekereteekere okufa obulungi. Teekateeka ensonga zo. Yogera n’ab’omu maka go ku kukkiriza kwo n’essuubi lyo. Lindirira n’essanyu okulaba Kristo.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: John Wesley ne George Müller

John Wesley, gwe tusisinkanye emirundi mingi mu kitabo kino, yeeyongera okutambula n’okubuulira ng’asemberedde emyaka kyenda. Mu Ssuula 44, Okwerabirira ng’Omuwanika, twasoma bye yawandiika ku lunaku lwe olw’amazaalibwa ng’aweza emyaka kinaana mu etaano. Ne mu kiseera ekyo yali akyeebagala embalaasi, ng’abuulira ku makya ennyo era ng’alabirira ebibiina. Journal ye (ebiwandiiko bye ebya buli lunaku), eri ku Ochorus, emulaga ng’akyakyalira amasomero ga Ssande, ng’akyetegereza abaana “abatya ddala Katonda”, era ng’akyasanyukira omulimu gwa Katonda mu bavubuka.

Ennaku ntono nga tannafa mu 1791, ng’aweza emyaka kinaana mu musanvu, Wesley yawandiikira William Wilberforce omuvubuka ebbaluwa, ng’amuzzaamu amaanyi okweyongera okulwanyisa obusuubuzi bw’abaddu. Yali akyawa omulembe oguddako omukisa. Bwe yali agalamidde ng’afa mu London, abaali bamwetoolodde baawandiika, mu byafaayo ebigattiddwa ku Journal ye, nti yakuŋŋaanya amaanyi ge gonna agaali gasigaddewo n’ayogerera waggulu nti:

“Ekisinga byonna kye kino: Katonda ali naffe.”

— John Wesley, nga bwe kyawandiikibwa abaaliwo ng’afa, 1791

Yakyogera emirundi ebiri. Oluvannyuma lw’obulamu obuwanvu obw’okuweereza, essanyu lye erisinga obunene teryali mu bye yali akoze, wabula mu kubeerawo kwa Katonda.

George Müller, gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 48, Ebirekebwawo: Ekisigalawo, yazaalibwa mu 1805. Mu 1875, bwe yali ng’aweza emyaka nga nsanvu, yatandika obuweereza obuggya. Okumala emyaka ekkumi n’omusanvu egyaddirira, okutuusa mu 1892, yatambula ensi yonna ng’agenda okubuulira. Ekitabo ky’ebyafaayo George Müller of Bristol (George Müller ow’e Bristol), ekiri ku Ochorus, kinnyonnyola engeri entambula zino gye zaatuuka mu Bulaaya, Amerika, Asiya, Afirika ne Australia, era kigamba nti “zo zokka zandibadde zimala okuba omulimu gw’obulamu bw’omuntu owa bulijjo.” Mu myaka gye egy’ensanvu n’ekinaana, Müller yali akyategeeza ensi ku Katonda awulira okusaba. Yafiira e Ashley Down mu 1898, ng’aweza emyaka kyenda mu ebiri.

Engule ey’ekitiibwa

Si buli mukulembeze mukadde nti ajja kutambula ensi yonna nga Müller oba okubuulira nga Wesley. Abamu bajja kumala emyaka gyabwe egisembayo mu kisenge ekitono, mu bunafu ne mu bulumi. Naye okusaba kwabwe, ekyokulabirako kyabwe n’okukkiriza kwabwe bikyayinza okubala ebibala. “Ne mu bukadde bwabwe balibala ebibala.”

Bw’oba ng’okaddiwa mu mulimu, guma omwoyo. Katonda tannamala naawe. Weeyongere okukula. Weeyongere okusaba. Wa abato omukisa. Bawe ekifo. Era tunuulira eby’omu maaso. Ennaku zo ezisinga obulungi teziri mabega wo. Ziri mu maaso, mu kubeerawo kw’Oyo gw’oweerezza.

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma Zabbuli 92:12-15 ne Zabbuli 71:17-18. Bibala bya ngeri ki abakulembeze abakadde bye bayinza okubala?
  • Soma Yoswa 14:6-12. Kiki ky’owuniikirira ku Kalebu ku myaka kinaana mu etaano?
  • Soma Lukka 2:25-38. Simyoni ne Ana bakuyigiriza ki ku buweereza bw’abakkiriza abakadde?
  • Bulabe ki obw’obukadde bw’olaba mu bakulembeze abakadde abakwetoolodde? Buliwa bw’otya okukwatako ggwe?
  • Ekkanisa yo essa etya ekitiibwa mu bammemba baayo abakadde? Ewa etya abato ekifo?
  • Bw’oba ng’oli mukadde, baani mu bato b’owa omukisa era b’ozzaamu amaanyi?
  • Bw’oba ng’okyali muto, mukulembeze ki omukadde gw’oyinza okusaba amagezi n’omukisa?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Bw’oba ng’oli mukulembeze mukadde, wandiika ebbaluwa oba kwata obubaka bw’eddoboozi eri omukulembeze omuto, ng’omubuulira Katonda by’akoze mu bulamu bwo era ng’omuwa omukisa mu mulimu gwe. Oluvannyuma weebuuze mu mazima: waliwo ekifo kye nkutte kye nsaanidde okuba nga nteekateeka okukwasa omulala? Bw’oba ng’oli mukulembeze muto, kyalira omukkiriza omukadde wiiki eno. Musabe akunyumize olugero lwe olw’obwesigwa bwa Katonda, era omusabe akusabire.

study_questions.question: Abakulembeze abakadde bakyayinza okubala ebibala?
study_questions.answer: Weewaawo. “Ne mu bukadde bwabwe balibala ebibala; baliba balamu era abagimu” (Zabbuli 92:14). Ku myaka kinaana mu etaano Kalebu yasaba omulimu ogusinga obuzibu, ensi ey’ensozi abanene mwe baabeeranga, ate Simyoni ne Ana baaweereza Katonda mu bukadde bwabwe.

study_questions.question: Birabo ki abakulembeze abakadde bye baleeta mu kkanisa?
study_questions.answer: Amagezi, obumanyirivu, okusaba n’okulaba ebintu mu ngeri enzijuvu. “Amagezi tegasangibwa mu bakaddiye? Okuwangaala tekuleeta kutegeera?” (Yobu 12:12). Ebyawandiikibwa biyita ekkanisa okussa ekitiibwa mu bakadde: “n’omukadde omussangamu ekitiibwa” (Ebyabaleevi 19:32).

study_questions.question: Bulabe ki obuli eri abakulembeze abakadde?
study_questions.answer: Okwekwata ku kifo okumala ebbanga ddene nnyo, okufuna obukaawu oba okukalambala, n’obutawa bakulembeze bato kifo. Katonda asuubiza nti, “Ne bwe muliba mulina envi nnaabasitulanga” (Isaaya 46:4). John Wesley ne George Müller beeyongera okuweereza ne mu bukadde.

fields.title: Okuwa Embalirira
fields.body_html:
“Kubanga ffe ffenna kitugwanira okulabika mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako omusango, buli muntu asalirwe olw’ebyo bye yakola ng’akyali mulamu, okusinziira ku ebyo bye yakola oba birungi oba bibi.”

— 2 Abakkolinso 5:10

Omusumba ku nsozi apangisibwa okulabirira ekisibo ky’omusajja omugagga okumala ekiseera. Buli kawungeezi abala endiga. Emu bw’ebula, afuluma n’agenda okuginoonya, ne mu kizikiza. Amanyi nti ku nkomerero y’ekiseera ekyo, nnannyini kisibo ajja kujja abale ekisibo ye kennyini. Omusumba ajja kuba alina okuwa embalirira ku buli ndiga eyamukwasibwa okulabirira.

Buli mukulembeze olunaku lumu aliyimirira mu maaso g’Omusumba Omukulu n’awa embalirira. Mu Ssuula 46, Omwesigwa mu Bitono: Okubalibwako, twatunuulira okubalibwako mu bulamu buno. Essuula eno etunuulira embalirira esembayo, ku lunaku lwe tuliyimirira mu maaso ga Kristo. Ensonga eno ya kitiibwa era ereetera omuntu okufumiitiriza. Naye era ejjudde ekisa. Oyo gwe tuliyimirira mu maaso ge ye Oyo eyatufiirira.

Ffenna tuliyimirira mu maaso ga Kristo

Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Noolwekyo kyetuva tunoonya oba nga tuli ewaffe oba nga tetuli waffe, tumusanyuse. Kubanga ffe ffenna kitugwanira okulabika mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako omusango, buli muntu asalirwe olw’ebyo bye yakola ng’akyali mulamu, okusinziira ku ebyo bye yakola oba birungi oba bibi” (2 Abakkolinso 5:9-10). “Ffenna tuliyimirira mu maaso g’entebe ya Katonda, ey’okulamula” (Abaruumi 14:10). “Katonda amanyi ebintu byonna, so tewali kitonde na kimu ekikwekeddwa amaaso ge. Alaba buli kintu, era tulyogera mazima nga tumutegeeza buli kimu” (Abaebbulaniya 4:13).

Eri abo abali mu Kristo, omusango guno tegukwata ku kya bwe tunaalokolebwa oba nedda. Ekyo kyasalibwawo ku musaalaba. “Ani alibasalira omusango? Kristo Yesu yafa, kyokka okusinga byonna yazuukizibwa, era ali ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, ng’atwegayiririra” (Abaruumi 8:34). Naye gukwata ku kye twakola n’obulamu, ebirabo n’abantu be yatuwa. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 48, Ebirekebwawo: Ekisigalawo, omuliro gujja kugezesa omulimu gwa buli muzimbi. Emirimu egimu gijja kusigalawo era giweebwe empeera. Egimu gijja kwokebwa, era omuntu oyo “alifiirwa, kyokka ye yennyini alirokolebwa, naye ng’ayita mu muliro” (1 Abakkolinso 3:15).

Obuzito obw’enjawulo ku bakulembeze

Buli mukkiriza aliwa embalirira. Naye Ebyawandiikibwa bigamba nti abakulembeze basitula obuzito obw’enjawulo. “Abooluganda, abayigiriza tebasaanye kubeera bangi mu mmwe, kubanga mukimanyi nga ffe tulisalirwa omusango munene okusinga abalala” (Yakobo 3:1). Abaebbulaniya boogera ku bakulembeze nti “obuweereza bwabwe kwe kulabirira emyoyo gyammwe” (Abaebbulaniya 13:17), era nti balibuuzibwa ku gyo.

Katonda yagamba Ezeekyeri nti, “Omwana w’omuntu, nkufudde omukuumi w’ennyumba ya Isirayiri, era buli lw’onoowuliranga ekigambo kye nnaayogeranga, balabulenga. Bwe ŋŋamba atali mutuukirivu nti, ‘Mazima tolirema kufa,’ n’otamulabula newaakubadde okwogera naye ng’omulabula alekeyo engeri ze ezitali za butuukirivu asobole okuwonya obulamu bwe, omuntu oyo atali mutuukirivu alifa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwe, naye omusaayi gwe ndiguvunaana ggwe” (Ezeekyeri 3:17-18).

Eno y’ensonga lwaki Pawulo yasobola okugamba abakadde b’ekkanisa y’e Efeso nti, “sirina kyenvunaanwa olw’omusaayi gwa bonna, kubanga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mbabuulira okwagala kwa Katonda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:26-27). Yali abayigirizza buli kimu Katonda kye yali amuwadde okuyigiriza. Teyali akwese bitundu ebizibu. Yali akoze omulimu gwe ng’omukuumi.

Abakulembeze baliwa embalirira ku ki? Ebyawandiikibwa biraga ebintu bingi.

  • Abantu abaatukwasibwa. Twabaliisa, twabakuuma, twabanoonya era twabaagala?
  • Okuyigiriza kwaffe. Twayigiriza amazima, gonna, nga tetugakyusizza era nga tetulina kye tukwese?
  • Ekyokulabirako kyaffe. Twatambulira mu bye twayigiriza?
  • Ebigendererwa byaffe. Lwaki twakulembera? Olw’ekitiibwa kye oba olw’ekyaffe? Katonda “ayolesa n’ebigendererwa by’omutima” (1 Abakkolinso 4:5).
  • Ebigambo byaffe. “Buli kigambo kyonna ekitasaana abantu kye boogera, kiribabuuzibwa ku lunaku olw’okusalirako emisango” (Matayo 12:36).
  • Engeri gye twakozesaamu obuyinza ne ssente. Twaweereza, oba twetwalira?
  • Obulamu bwaffe obw’omu kyama. “Kubanga Katonda alisala omusango olwa buli kikolwa; ekyo ekyakwekebwa, nga kirungi oba nga kibi” (Omubuulizi 12:14).

Okulabula okw’amaanyi

Yesu yawa okumu ku kulabula okusinga okutiisa mu Bayibuli, era yakuwa abantu abaali bakoze ebintu ebinene mu linnya lye. Yagamba nti ku lunaku olwo, “bangi baliŋŋamba nti, ‘Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe, twayogeranga eby’obunnabbi mu linnya lyo, era ne tugoba ne baddayimooni mu linnya lyo, ne tukola n’ebyamagero bingi mu linnya lyo.’ Ndibaddamu nti, ‘Sibamanyi, muve mu maaso gange, kubanga ebikolwa byammwe byali bibi.’” (Matayo 7:22-23).

Abantu bano baali babuulidde, bagobye baddayimooni era bakoze ebyamagero. Baalina obuweereza obwalabikanga nga bunene. Naye tebaamanya Kristo, era tebaakola Kitaffe by’ayagala. Kisoboka omuntu okukulembera mu linnya lya Kristo nga si wuwe. Kyeyava Pawulo agamba Timoseewo nti, “Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza” (1 Timoseewo 4:16). Kino twakiraba mu Ssuula 9, Mwekuume Mwekka. Ekibuuzo ekisinga obukulu omukulembeze ky’ayinza okwebuuza si kiri nti, “Obuweereza bwange bunene kyenkana wa?” wabula nti, “Mmanyi Kristo, era ye ammanyi?”

Tetusalirwa musango balala, wadde ffe ffennyini

Pawulo yalina endowooza ku musango ewa eddembe: “Naye gye ndi ekyo kintu kitono nnyo mmwe okunsalira omusango oba omuntu yenna ku lunaku olw’okusalirako omusango; nange sseesalira musango. Kubanga nze seemanyiiko nsonga yonna, wabula ekyo tekimpeesa butuukirivu, naye ansalira omusango ye Mukama waffe. Noolwekyo temusalanga musango ekiseera nga tekinnatuuka okutuusa Mukama waffe lw’alijja, alimulisa ebyakwekebwa eby’ekizikiza, n’ayolesa n’ebigendererwa by’omutima, buli muntu n’alyoka atendebwa Katonda” (1 Abakkolinso 4:3-5).

Kino kiwummuza nnyo abakulembeze. Endowooza z’abatuvumirira si ze zisalawo omuwendo gwaffe. N’okutendereza kw’abatwagala nakwo si kwe kugusalawo. Ne kye twesalira ffe ffennyini si kye kisembayo. Omusango gwa Kristo gwokka gwe gukulu. Abakulembeze abamu abaatenderezebwa ku nsi balifuna okutendereza kutono okuva gy’ali. Abamu abaavumirirwa oba abeerabirwa baliweebwa ekitiibwa. Era weetegereze Pawulo bw’amaliriza: “buli muntu n’alyoka atendebwa Katonda.” Pawulo yali asuubira nti Mukama alisanga ekintu eky’okutendereza.

Ekisa ku lunaku olw’okusalirako omusango

Olunaku olw’okuwa embalirira lwa maanyi. Naye eri abo abali aba Kristo, si lunaku lwa kutya kungi. Yokaana yawandiika nti tujja kuba nga “tetulibaako kye tweraliikirira ku lunaku olw’okusalirako omusango. Mu kwagala temuliimu kutya, kubanga okwagala okutuukiridde kumalawo okutya” (1 Yokaana 4:17-18). “Kaakano, abaana abaagalwa, munywerere mu Kristo, bw’alirabika tulyoke tube bagumu abatalikwatibwa nsonyi ku lunaku lw’aliddirako” (1 Yokaana 2:28).

Omulamuzi ku lunaku olwo si mugenyi gwe tutamanyi. Ye Musumba Omulungi eyawaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga, era n’olw’abasumba. Amanyi nti tuli nfuufu. Abadde atusabira ebbanga lyonna. “Kubanga Katonda mwenkanya tayinza kwerabira mulimu gwammwe omunene bwe gutyo, n’okwagala kwe mwagala erinnya lye, era amanyi bwe mwaweereza abantu be” (Abaebbulaniya 6:10).

Era alimaliriza kye yatandika. “Nkakasiza ddala nti oyo eyatandika omulimu omulungi mu mmwe, aligutuukiriza okutuusa ku lunaku lwa Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 1:6). Pawulo yasobola okugamba nti, “mmanyi gwe nakkiriza, era nkakasa nti ayinza okukuuma ekyo kye namuteresa okutuusa olunaku luli” (2 Timoseewo 1:12).

Okubeera kaakano mu kitangaala ky’olunaku olwo

Olunaku olw’okuwa embalirira lusaanidde lutya okubumba engeri gye tukulemberamu kaakano?

  • Kulembera ng’olina Omuwuliriza Omu yekka. Noonya “Weebale” ye okusinga okutenderezebwa abantu.
  • Kuuma omutima gwo. Saba Katonda bulijjo akulage ebigendererwa byo ebya ddala.
  • Yigiriza amazima gonna. Tokweka kizibu. Beera mukuumi mwesigwa.
  • Labirira buli muntu. Oliwa embalirira ku bantu, so si ku nteekateeka zokka.
  • Kola ku kibi kaakano. Ekyo ekyatuliddwa ne kisonyiyibwa kaakano tekirikubalirwa olwo.
  • Kola ebirungi mu kyama. Mukama alaba ekyo omuntu omulala yenna ky’atalaba, era alikisasula.
  • Jjukira ekisa. Tokulembera mu kutya, wabula mu bugumu bw’abo abaagalwa.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: John Chrysostom ne Richard Baxter

John Chrysostom, gwe twasisinkanako katono mu Ssuula 4, Okuyitibwa kwa Katonda, yali mubuulizi mukulu mu kibuga Antiyokiya, mu kitundu kati ekiri mu Turkey, ku nkomerero y’emyaka gya 300, era oluvannyuma n’afuuka omulabirizi w’e Constantinople. Erinnya lye litegeeza “akamwa aka zaabu”, olw’okubuulira kwe. Bwe yali akyali muvubuka, yeekweka aleme okuyawulibwa olw’obuweereza, kubanga yawulira obuzito bw’obuweereza obwo nnyo nnyo. Oluvannyuma yawandiika ekitabo ekiyitibwa On the Priesthood (Ku Bwakabona), ekiri ku Ochorus, ng’annyonnyola lwaki. Yaddangamu emirundi n’emirundi ebigambo by’Abaebbulaniya 13:17 ebikwata ku bakulembeze abalina okuwa embalirira:

“Naye embeera yaffe mu biseera ebigenda okujja tuligigumira tutya, nga tukakiddwa okuwa embalirira yaffe ku buli omu ku abo abaatukwasibwa? … ‘Muwulirenga abo ababafuga, era mubagonderenga, kubanga batunula ku lw’emyoyo gyammwe ng’abo abaliwa embalirira;’ newaakubadde nga nkyogeddeko dda omulundi gumu, kyokka nja kumenya obusirise ku kyo kaakano, kubanga okutya okw’okulabula kwakyo kweyongera buli kiseera okusiikuula emmeeme yange.”

— John Chrysostom, On the Priesthood, Ekitabo VI

Mu bigambo ebyangu: tuligumira tutya olunaku lwe tulina okuwa embalirira ku buli muntu eyatukwasibwa okulabirira? Olunyiriri luno ndwogeddeko dda, naye nteekwa okuddamu okulwogerako, kubanga okulabula kwalwo kweyongera okutawaanya emmeeme yange. Chrysostom obukulembeze teyabutwala ng’ekintu ekitono. Yali amanyi nti bulisalirwa omusango. Ku nkomerero, yakkiriza okuyitibwa okukulembera, era n’aweereza n’obwesigwa, okutuusa n’okuwaŋŋangusibwa n’okufa. Naye teyeerabira buzito bwa mbalirira.

Richard Baxter, omusumba Omungereza gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 9, Mwekuume Mwekka, ne mu Ssuula 18, Okumanya Endiga, yawandiika The Saints’ Everlasting Rest (Ekiwummulo ky’Abatukuvu eky’Olubeerera) bwe yali mulwadde nnyo era ng’asuubira okufa. Kiri ku Ochorus. Baxter yali amanyi obuzito bw’omusango nga Chrysostom bwe yagumanya. Naye era yali amanyi Omulamuzi gw’aliba. Yawandiika ku lunaku abakkiriza lwe baliyimirira mu maaso ga Kristo:

“Omulamuzi waffe bw’atalitusalira musango gwa kutusinga, ani alitusalira? Oyo eyagamba omukazi omwenzi nti, Tewali muntu akusalidde musango? Nange sikusalira … alitugamba, mu bwesigwa okusinga Peetero bwe yamugamba, nti newaakubadde abantu bonna bakwegaana, oba bakusalira omusango, nze sijja kukikola.”

— Richard Baxter, The Saints’ Everlasting Rest

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Omulamuzi waffe bw’atatusalira musango gwa kutusinga, ani ayinza? Yesu oyo eyagamba omukazi eyakwatibwa mu bwenzi nti, “Nange sikusalira musango,” alitugamba nti ne bwe kiba nti abalala bonna batugaana oba batusalira omusango, ye tagenda kukikola. Era alinywerera ku kigambo kye okusinga Peetero bwe yanywerera ku kikye. Chrysostom atulaga obuzito bw’embalirira. Baxter atulaga ekisa ky’Omulamuzi. Buli mukulembeze yeetaaga byombi.

Okubeera abeetegefu olw’olunaku olwo

Omusumba ku nsozi abala endiga buli kawungeezi, kubanga amanyi nti nnannyini zo ajja kujja. Talinda lunaku lwa nkomerero okutandika okulabirira ekisibo. Akirabirira buli lunaku, nnannyini kyo bw’alijja asangibwe nga mwetegefu.

Yesu yabuuza nti, “Omuweereza oyo omwesigwa era ow’amagezi ye aluwa …? Alina omukisa mukama we bw’alikomawo gw’alisanga ng’atuukiriza bulungi emirimu gye” (Lukka 12:42-43). Buli omu ku ffe asangibwe nga mwesigwa bw’alijja. Era tuwulire, olw’ekisa kye, ebigambo buli muweereza ow’amazima by’alumirwa okuwulira: “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa, … Yingira osanyukire wamu ne mukama wo” (Matayo 25:23).

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 2 Abakkolinso 5:9-10 ne 1 Abakkolinso 3:10-15. Kiki ekirigezesebwa ku lunaku olw’okusalirako omusango?
  • Soma Yakobo 3:1 ne Abaebbulaniya 13:17. Lwaki abakulembeze “balisalirwa omusango munene okusinga abalala”?
  • Soma Ezeekyeri 3:17-19. Mu ngeri ki gy’oli omukuumi? Obadde mwesigwa mu kulabula?
  • Soma Matayo 7:21-23. Omukulembeze ayinza atya okukakasa nti amanyi ddala Kristo?
  • Soma 1 Abakkolinso 4:3-5. Ekitundu kino kikuwa kitya eddembe okuva mu kusalirwa omusango abalala n’okwesalira ggwe wennyini?
  • Chrysostom alaga obuzito bw’embalirira. Baxter alaga ekisa ky’Omulamuzi. Kiruwa ky’osinga okwetaaga okuwulira leero?
  • Singa omulimu gwo gugezesebwa leero, kiki ekyandisigaddewo?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Teekawo essaawa emu wiiki eno otuule mu kasirise mu maaso ga Katonda. Lowooza nti omuwa embalirira y’obukulembeze bwo okutuusa kati. Yita mu lukalala oluli mu ssuula eno: abantu abaakukwasibwa, okuyigiriza kwo, ekyokulabirako kyo, ebigendererwa byo, ebigambo byo, engeri gy’okozesaamu obuyinza ne ssente, n’obulamu bwo obw’omu kyama. Mwebaze olw’ekisa kye mu buli kimu. Yatula ekyetaaga okwatulwa. Oluvannyuma soma Abafiripi 1:6 mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka, era omwesige okumaliriza omulimu omulungi gwe yatandika mu ggwe.

study_questions.question: Abakulembeze Abakristaayo baliwa Katonda embalirira?
study_questions.answer: Weewaawo. “Ffe ffenna kitugwanira okulabika mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako omusango, buli muntu asalirwe olw’ebyo bye yakola” (2 Abakkolinso 5:10). Abayigiriza balisalirwa omusango munene okusinga abalala (Yakobo 3:1).

study_questions.question: Abakkiriza basaanidde okutya olunaku olw’okusalirako omusango?
study_questions.answer: Si kutya kungi, kubanga Kristo yatufiirira era atwegayiririra: “Ani alibasalira omusango? Kristo Yesu yafa” (Abaruumi 8:34). Naye omulimu gw’omuntu bwe gwokebwa, “alifiirwa, kyokka ye yennyini alirokolebwa, naye ng’ayita mu muliro” (1 Abakkolinso 3:15).

study_questions.question: Omusango ogujja gusaanidde gutya okubumba obulamu bw’omukulembeze leero?
study_questions.answer: Gusaanidde okutuleetera okubeera nga tusanyusa Kristo: “kyetuva tunoonya oba nga tuli ewaffe oba nga tetuli waffe, tumusanyuse” (2 Abakkolinso 5:9). Essuula ekozesa ebigambo bya John Chrysostom eby’amaanyi ku buzito bw’obwakabona, n’ekitabo kya Richard Baxter ekiyitibwa Saints’ Rest.

fields.title: Omusumba Omukulu Bw’Alirabika
fields.body_html:
“Era Omusumba Omukulu bw’alikomawo, muliweebwa engule ey’ekitiibwa ekitaliggwaawo.”

— 1 Peetero 5:4

Mu bifo ebimu, omuddusi bw’awangula empaka, abantu bamutikkira engule ey’ebikoola ku mutwe. Kitiibwa kinene. Naye mu nnaku ntono ebikoola bifuuka bya kitaka ne bikala, era engule n’emenyekamenyeka. Mu myaka mitono, abantu abasinga obungi baba beerabidde eyawangula.

Peetero yasuubiza abakadde b’ekkanisa engule ey’engeri endala: “engule ey’ekitiibwa ekitaliggwaawo.” Tegenda kufuuka ya kitaka. Tegenda kwerabirwa. Era Oyo agiwaayo si kabaka oba ekibiina ky’abantu, wabula Omusumba Omukulu yennyini. Eno y’essuula esembayo mu Kitundu eky’Ekkumi: Okumaliriza Obulungi. Ekwata ku ssuubi erinyweza abakulembeze mu buli buzibu: olunaku Omusumba Omukulu lw’alirabika.

Omusumba Omukulu

Peetero yawandiikira abakadde ng’ali “mukadde munnammwe, omujulirwa w’okubonaabona kwa Kristo, era agabanira awamu ekitiibwa ekigenda okubikkulirwa” (1 Peetero 5:1). Yali alabye Yesu ng’abonaabona. Yali alindirira n’essanyu okulaba Yesu mu kitiibwa. Era yajjukiza abakadde kye baali: abasumba abali wansi w’Omusumba omusinga obukulu. “Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe, … Era Omusumba Omukulu bw’alikomawo, muliweebwa engule ey’ekitiibwa ekitaliggwaawo” (1 Peetero 5:2, 4).

Mu kitabo kino kyonna tulabye nti ekisibo si kyaffe. Kya Kristo. Ye Musumba Omulungi, “Omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga” (Yokaana 10:11). Ye “Omusumba w’endiga omukulu”, Katonda gwe yazuukiza mu bafu (Abaebbulaniya 13:20). Ffe tuli bayambi be. Tuliisa abaana b’endiga be, tunoonya endiga ze ezaabula era tukuuma ekisibo kye, okutuusa lw’alijja.

Era ajja. “Laba, nzija mangu nsasule buli omu ng’ebikolwa bye bwe biri” (Okubikkulirwa 22:12). Buli mukulembeze amuweerezza n’obwesigwa, ne bwe kiba nti ekisibo kye kyali kitono kitya era omulimu gwe nga gwali gukwekeddwa kitya, alimulaba amaaso n’amaaso.

“Weebale”

Mu Ssuula 46, Omwesigwa mu Bitono: Okubalibwako, ne mu Ssuula 50, Okuwa Embalirira, twawulira olugero lwa Yesu olwa ttalanta. Omwami yakomawo n’agamba abaddu be abeesigwa nti, “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa, obadde mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, ndikusigira ebintu ebingi. Yingira sanyukira wamu ne mukama wo” (Matayo 25:21).

Lowooza ku bigambo ebyo bye birikola. Omusumba w’ekkanisa ey’omu kyalo ey’abantu amakumi asatu, eyaweereza okumala emyaka amakumi ana era ensi engazi n’etemulaba n’akatono. Maama eyayigiriza abaana be okusaba. Omubuulizi w’enjiri eyasibibwa mu kkomera n’atasumululwa. Omuminsani eyaziika munne mu bufumbo n’abaana mu nsi ey’ewala. Omukozi w’emitanda eyakolanga wiiki yonna n’abuulira ku Ssande. Omukulembeze eyagwa, n’azzibwawo, n’addamu okuweereza mu bwetoowaze. Buli omu ku bano, Mukama w’ensi yonna alimugamba nti, “Weebale.”

Weetegereze nti omwami yatendereza omuddu olw’obwesigwa, so si olw’obunene. Era weetegereze ky’abayita okuyingiramu: “Yingira sanyukira wamu ne mukama wo.” Empeera esinga obukulu si kifo oba kintu ky’olina. Kwe kuyingira mu ssanyu lya Kristo yennyini.

Buli kintu ekyakwekebwa kirirabibwa

Omulimu omungi ogw’omukulembeze gukwekeddwa. Okusaba ekiro. Amaziga olw’abantu abawaba. Okukyala okutamanyiddwa muntu yenna. Obubaka obwategekebwa n’obwegendereza obungi ne buwulirwa abantu batono. Ebirabo ebiweebwayo mu kyama. Ebivume ebigumiikirizibwa nga tewali kuddamu. Obwesigwa mu myaka egikwekeddwa. Ebisinga obungi ku bino tewali abiraba.

Naye ye abiraba. “Kitaawo amanyi ebyama byonna alikuwa empeera” (Matayo 6:4). Yesu yagamba nti ne “egiraasi y’amazzi agannyogoga” eweereddwa omu ku baana be abato tegirirema kuweebwa mpeera yaayo (Matayo 10:42). Era ku lunaku olw’enkomerero, Kabaka aligamba nti, “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe mwabikolera baganda bange bano abasembayo wansi kye kimu mwabikolera nze!” (Matayo 25:40). Ebintu bye walowooza nti byerabirwa birijjukirwa. Ebintu bye walowooza nti bitono biriweebwa ekitiibwa.

Pawulo yawandiika nti, “Kye nsigazza kwe kufuna engule ey’obutuukirivu enterekeddwa, Mukama omulamuzi omutuukirivu gy’alimpeera ku lunaku luli. Taligiwa nze nzekka, naye aligiwa n’abo bonna abeegomba okujja kwe” (2 Timoseewo 4:8). Engule si ya batume na bajulizi bokka. Ya “abo bonna abeegomba okujja kwe”.

Engule ezisuulibwa wansi

Engule zaffe tulizikola ki? Ekitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa kitulaga ekifaananyi ky’eggulu. Abakadde amakumi abiri mu abana, abakiikirira abantu ba Katonda bonna, basinza mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka: “Ne bateeka engule zaabwe mu maaso g’entebe eyo, nga bwe bagamba nti, ‘Mukama waffe era Katonda waffe, osaanidde okuweebwanga ekitiibwa n’ettendo n’obuyinza’” (Okubikkulirwa 4:10-11).

Eno ye nkomerero entuufu ey’ebyafaayo bya buli mukulembeze. Tetujja kusigaza ngule zaffe tuzeewuunye. Tujja kuziteeka wansi ku bigere bye, kubanga byonna bye twakola, twabikola lwa kisa kye. Buli kirungi mu buweereza bwaffe kyava gy’ali. Nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 7, Obwetoowaze, ne mu Ssuula 32, Amalala n’Okwagala Okutenderezebwa, ekitiibwa kibwe yekka. Ku lunaku olwo, ku nkomerero, buli mukulembeze alisumululwa ddala okuva mu kwagala okutenderezebwa. Tulibeera nga tubbidde ddala mu kumutendereza.

Ekisibo nga kikuŋŋaanyiziddwa awaka

Era n’ekisibo kiribaawo. Yokaana yalaba abantu Kristo be yagula n’omusaayi gwe, “abantu ba Katonda okubaggya mu buli kika, na buli lulimi, na buli ggwanga, na buli nsi” (Okubikkulirwa 5:9). Abantu be twakulembera, be twasabira, be twayigiriza, be twanenya ne be twabudaabuda baliba eyo, bwe baali aba Kristo. Pawulo yali alindirira olunaku olwo n’essanyu: “Kale Mukama waffe Yesu bw’alijja, si mmwe mulibeera essuubi n’essanyu lyaffe, n’engule ey’okwenyumiriza kwaffe?” (1 Abasessaloniika 2:19).

Omusumba omukulu alirabirira ekisibo kye emirembe gyonna: “Omwana gw’Endiga ayimiridde mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka, y’anaabeeranga omusumba waabwe era y’anaabakulemberanga okubatwala eri ensulo ez’amazzi ag’obulamu. Era Katonda alisangula buli zziga mu maaso gaabwe” (Okubikkulirwa 7:17). “Tewakyali kufa, wadde ennaku, wadde okukaaba, wadde okulumwa” (Okubikkulirwa 21:4). Emigugu gy’omukulembeze girikoma. Tewalibaawo nkaayana nate, okugwa nate, ennaku ezikwekeddwa nate, wadde ekiwuubaalo nate.

Era ekisinga byonna, “abaddu be balimuweereza, era banaalabanga amaaso ge” (Okubikkulirwa 22:3-4). Tulilaba Oyo gwe tubadde tuweereza. “Bw’alirabika tulifaanana nga ye, kubanga tulimulabira ddala nga bw’ali” (1 Yokaana 3:2).

Okubeerera olunaku olwo

Essuubi lino lisaanidde litya okubumba engeri gye tukulemberamu kaakano?

  • Lituwa obuvumu. Engule bw’eba nkakafu, tusobola okugumira omuwendo ogusasulwa. “Olw’essanyu lye yali alindirira bwe yagumiikiriza omusaalaba” (Abaebbulaniya 12:2).
  • Lirongoosa ebigendererwa byaffe. “Weebale” ye bwe kiba nga kye kikulu, tetwetaaga kubeerawo lwa kutenderezebwa bantu.
  • Litunyweza okugenda mu maaso. “Mubenga banywevu era abatasagaasagana nga mweyongeranga bulijjo okukola omulimu gwa Mukama waffe, kubanga mumanyi nti okufuba kwammwe si kwa bwereere mu Mukama waffe” (1 Abakkolinso 15:58).
  • Lituzzaamu amaanyi nga tufiiriddwa. Abakkiriza be tuziika tebabuze. Tuliddamu okubalaba.
  • Lituleetera obwetoowaze. Engule zaffe ziriteekebwa ku bigere bye. Omulimu gwaffe bulijjo gwali gugwe.
  • Lituleetera okumulumirwa. Yesu agamba nti, “Weewaawo nzija mangu!” Era Ekkanisa n’eddamu nti, “Amiina! Jjangu Mukama waffe Yesu!” (Okubikkulirwa 22:20).

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Polycarp ne Valiant-for-Truth

Mu Ssuula 8, Obwesigwa: Omuntu Omu ne mu Kyama, ne mu Ssuula 23, Okukuza Abakulembeze, twasisinkana Polycarp, omulabirizi omukadde ow’e Sumuna eyali ayigiridde ku mutume Yokaana. Bwe yagaana okukolimira Kristo, yasalirwa omusango ogw’okwokebwa. The Martyrdom of Polycarp (Okufa kwa Polycarp ng’Omujulizi), ekiri ku Ochorus, kiwandiika nti yasaba aleme kukomererwa ku kikondo, kubanga Katonda yandimuwadde amaanyi okuyimirira nga tanyeenya mu muliro. Awo, emikono gye nga gisibiddwa emabega we, n’atunula waggulu mu ggulu n’asaba nti:

“Ayi Mukama Katonda Ayinza Byonna, Kitaawe w’Omwana wo omwagalwa era alina omukisa Yesu Kristo, gwe twayitamu okufuna okukumanya … Nkwebaza nti ombaze okuba nsaanidde olunaku luno n’essaawa eno, nfune omugabo mu muwendo gw’abajulizi bo, mu kikompe kya Kristo wo, okutuuka ku kuzuukira okw’obulamu obutaggwaawo.”

— Polycarp ow’e Sumuna, nga bwe kyawandiikibwa mu The Martyrdom of Polycarp

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Mukama Katonda Ayinza Byonna, Kitaawe wa Yesu Kristo, gwe tuyitiddemu okukumanya, nkwebaza olw’okumbala nga nsaanidde olunaku luno n’essaawa eno, okugabana ku kubonaabona kwa Kristo n’okuzuukira mu bulamu obutaggwaawo. Omukulembeze omukadde ku nkomerero y’olugendo lwe teyakolimira balabe be wadde okutya omuliro. Yeebaza, kubanga yali atunuulira ebisukka omuliro, okutuuka ku kuzuukira.

Oluvannyuma lw’ebyasa kkumi na bitaano, John Bunyan, omubuulizi Omungereza gwe twasisinkana mu Ssuula 39, Okugwa n’Okuzzibwawo, yawandiika ekitundu eky’okubiri ekya Olugendo lw’Omutambuze, ekiri ku Ochorus. Kumpi ku nkomerero, abatambuze batuuka ku mugga buli mutambuze gw’alina okusomoka okutuuka mu Kibuga eky’omu Ggulu, ekibuga kya Katonda. Omu ku bo mutabaazi mukadde ayitibwa Mwami Valiant-for-Truth (Omuzira olw’Amazima), eyalwanye entalo nnyingi ku lwa Mukama we. Bw’ayitibwa, akuŋŋaanya mikwano gye n’agamba nti:

“Ŋŋenda ewa Kitange; era newaakubadde nga ntuuse wano n’obuzibu bungi, kaakano seenenya olw’okutawaana kwonna kwe nnayitamu okutuuka we ndi. Ekitala kyange nkiwa oyo alinsikira mu lugendo lwange, n’obuvumu bwange n’obukugu bwange mbiwa oyo ayinza okubifuna. Obubonero bwange n’enkovu zange ngenda nabyo, bibe abajulirwa bange nti nnalwana entalo z’Oyo kaakano agenda okumpeera.”

— John Bunyan, Olugendo lw’Omutambuze, Ekitundu eky’Okubiri

Mu bigambo ebyangu: Ŋŋenda eka ewa Kitange. Kibadde kizibu nnyo okutuuka wano, naye sejjusa n’akatono ku buzibu bwonna bwe kinsasudde. Ekitala kyange nkiwa oyo alingoberera mu lugendo, n’obuvumu bwange n’obukugu bwange eri omuntu yenna ayinza okubikkiriza. Ebiwundu byange n’enkovu zange ntwala nabyo, ng’obukakafu nti nnalwanira Oyo kaakano agenda okumpeera. Awo, bwe yali akka mu mugga, n’agamba nti, “Ggwe kufa, amaanyi go agalumya galuwa?” Era Bunyan awandiika nti: “Bw’atyo n’asomoka, n’amakondeere gonna ne gamuvugira emitala.”

Weetegereze Valiant-for-Truth ky’akola ku nkomerero. Awaayo ekitala kye eri oyo amuddirira, nga bwe twalaba mu Ssuula 47, Okuwaayo Omuggo. Atwala enkovu ze eri Oyo agenda okumuwa empeera. Era tejjusa olw’omuwendo gw’asasudde.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa ey’Ensi Yonna: Amma

Amy Carmichael, gwe tusisinkanye emirundi mingi mu kitabo kino, yamala emyaka ekkumi n’omwenda egyasembayo egy’obulamu bwe ng’ebiseera ebisinga asibiddwa mu kisenge kye e Dohnavur, oluvannyuma lw’okugwa mu 1931. Teyali akyasobola kufuluma kununula baana wadde okutambula okubuulira. Naye ng’ali mu kisenge kye yasabanga, yawandiikanga ebitabo n’ebbaluwa, era yayagalanga amaka amanene ge yali azimbye. Bwe yafa nga 18 Janwali 1951, ng’aweza emyaka kinaana mu esatu, yali yeetooloddwa abasajja n’abakazi Abayindi n’Abangereza abaakulira e Dohnavur oba abajja okwegatta ku mulimu, era abaali bayize okuva gy’ali engeri y’okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe ku lw’abalala. Ku ntaana ye tekuli lukalala lwa bye yakola. Kuliko kigambo kimu kyokka, erinnya abaana lye baali bamutuumye: Amma, “maama”. Eyo ye ngule eteriwotoka.

Okutuusa lw’alijja

Kale, musumba munnange, weeyongere mu maaso. Liisa endiga ze. Noonya abaabula. Kuuma omutima gwo. Saba. Yagala. Gumiikiriza. Waayo omuggo. Era tunula waggulu. Omusumba Omukulu ajja. Bw’alirabika, buli zziga lirisangulwa, buli bwesigwa obwakwekebwa bulirabibwa, era buli muweereza ow’amazima aliwulira nti, “Weebale.”

“Ddala ddala obulungi n’okwagala okutaggwaawo binaagendanga nange ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwange; nange nnaabeeranga mu nnyumba ya Mukama, ennaku zonna” (Zabbuli 23:6).

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Soma 1 Peetero 5:1-4. Okusuubiza kwa “engule ey’ekitiibwa ekitaliggwaawo” kukuzzaamu kutya amaanyi mu mulimu gwo?
  • Soma Matayo 25:14-30. Kyandikutegeezezza ki okuwulira nti “Weebale”?
  • Bikolwa ki eby’okuweereza eby’omu kyama mu bulamu bwo Katonda byokka by’amanyi? Matayo 6:4 ekuzzaamu etya amaanyi?
  • Soma Okubikkulirwa 4:10-11. Lwaki abakadde bateeka engule zaabwe mu maaso g’entebe? Kino kikuyigiriza ki ku mulimu gwo?
  • Soma Okubikkulirwa 7:9-17. Baani b’osuubira okubeera nabo eyo?
  • Kiki ky’oyiga mu kusaba kwa Polycarp ne mu kusiibula kwa Valiant-for-Truth?
  • Obeerera lunaku olwo, oba lwa leero?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Soma Okubikkulirwa 21 ne 22 mpola wiiki eno, oboolyawo mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka n’ab’omu maka go oba ne bakulembeze banno. Oluvannyuma wandiika amannya g’abantu b’okulembedde, b’oyigirizza oba b’olabiridde, era osabire buli omu, olyoke obalabe ku lunaku olwo. Ku nkomerero, wandiika okusaba kwo okumpi, ng’okomyawo engule yo eri Kristo nga bukyali, era ng’omaliriza n’okusaba okusembayo mu Bayibuli: “Amiina! Jjangu Mukama waffe Yesu!”

study_questions.question: Engule ey’ekitiibwa ey’abasumba abeesigwa kye ki?
study_questions.answer: Peetero yasuubiza abakadde abalunda ekisibo kya Katonda nti, “Omusumba Omukulu bw’alikomawo, muliweebwa engule ey’ekitiibwa ekitaliggwaawo” (1 Peetero 5:4). Empeera eva eri Kristo, agamba nti, “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa” (Matayo 25:21).

study_questions.question: Okuweereza okw’omu kyama kuliweebwa empeera?
study_questions.answer: Weewaawo. Yesu yagamba nti, “Kitaawo amanyi ebyama byonna alikuwa empeera” (Matayo 6:4). Ku lunaku olwo buli kintu ekyakwekebwa kirirabibwa, era abakulembeze abaaweereza nga tebalabibwa baliweebwa ekitiibwa.

study_questions.question: Abakulembeze basaanidde kubeera batya nga balindirira Kristo okukomawo?
study_questions.answer: Mu bwesigwa era mu ssuubi, nga babeerera “Weebale” ye mu kifo ky’okutenderezebwa abantu. Yesu agamba nti, “Laba, nzija mangu nsasule buli omu ng’ebikolwa bye bwe biri” (Okubikkulirwa 22:12). Essuula ekozesa Polycarp, Valiant-for-Truth owa Bunyan, ne Amy Carmichael.

fields.title: Okufundikira: Abasumba ng’Omutima Gwe Bwe Gwagala
fields.body_html:
“Era ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala, abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera.”

— Yeremiya 3:15

Ekitabo kino twakitandika n’ekisuubizo. Edda ennyo, abantu ba Katonda bwe baali bamaze emyaka mingi nga bakulemberwa bubi, Katonda yayogera ng’ayita mu Yeremiya nti: “Ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala.” Kaakano tutambudde wamu olugendo luwanvu: essuula amakumi ataano, ebitundu kkumi, n’amaloboozi mangi okuva mu Byawandiikibwa ne mu Kkanisa mu byasa byonna ne mu nsi yonna. Nga tetunnaggalawo, ka tutunule emabega ku kkubo lye tuyiseemu, oluvannyuma tutunule mu maaso.

Ekkubo lye tutambuddemu

Ekitundu Ekisooka: Okuyitibwa kyatulaga nti obukulembeze obw’Omwoyo butandikira ku Katonda. Ye ayita, Ye awa obusobozi, era Ye atuma. Abakulembeze ab’amazima baweereza abakwata ekiremba n’ebbensani, era abakulembera nga bali wansi w’obuyinza bwa Kristo.

Ekitundu eky’Okubiri: Omutima gw’Omukulembeze kyatuyingiza munda. Katonda atunuulira omutima. Twalaba obwetaavu bw’obwetoowaze, obwesigwa, okwekuuma mu myoyo gyaffe, okwagala ng’ekikubiriza buli kintu, n’obuvumu okugondera Katonda mu kifo ky’okugondera okutya kwaffe.

Ekitundu eky’Okusatu: Omukulembeze ne Katonda kyatulaga nti amaanyi g’omukulembeze gava mu biseera by’ayita ne Katonda: okusaba okusooka, okubeera mu Kigambo, okujjuzibwa Omwoyo, enteekateeka y’okuwummula, n’okunoonya okuluŋŋamya kwe.

Ekitundu eky’Okuna: Okulunda Ekisibo kyatuyigiriza omulimu gw’omusumba: okuliisa endiga, okuzimanya amannya gaazo, okunoonya abaabula, okunenya n’okuzzaawo mu bukkakkamu, n’okubudaabuda ababonaabona.

Ekitundu eky’Okutaano: Okukulembera Awamu kyatulaga nti Katonda teyagenderera bakulembeze kukola bokka. Tugabana omulimu, tukuza abakulembeze abaggya, tukuuma obumu bw’Omwoyo, tusisinkana enkaayana n’ekisa, era tussaamu ekitiibwa ebirabo Katonda bye yawa abasajja n’abakazi bombi.

Ekitundu eky’Omukaaga: Okwolesebwa n’Omulimu kyatuyimusa amaaso okulaba Katonda by’alaba: ensi ebuze, amawanga, abaavu, n’okusoboka kw’okuzuukuka. Twayiga okuteekateeka n’amagezi n’okukolerera obwenkanya n’okusaasira.

Ekitundu eky’Omusanvu: Obulabe mu Kkubo kyatutunuuliza mu bwesimbu amakubo abakulembeze mwe bagwira: amalala, ssente, ekibi eky’okwegatta, okukozesa obubi obuyinza, n’obuggya.

Ekitundu eky’Omunaana: Okukulembera mu Bizibu kyatuyisa mu kiwuubaalo, mu kuggwaamu amaanyi, mu kugwa, mu kuyigganyizibwa ne mu myaka egikwekeddwa, era twasanga nga Katonda mwesigwa mu buli kimu.

Ekitundu eky’Omwenda: Obulamu bw’Omukulembeze kyatunuulira amaka g’omukulembeze, obulamu obutali bwa bufumbo, okulabirira omubiri, ebirowoozo n’ebiseera, omulimu mu nsi, n’okubalibwako.

Era Ekitundu eky’Ekkumi: Okumaliriza Obulungi kyatutunuuliza enkomerero: okuwaayo omuggo, okulekawo ebirekebwawo ebibeerawo, okukaddiwa mu mulimu, okuwa embalirira, n’olunaku Omusumba Omukulu lw’alirabika.

Ekifaananyi ky’omusumba ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala

Bwe tukuŋŋaanya awamu byonna bye tulabye, omusumba ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala afaanana atya? Tewali n’omu ku ffe atuukana n’ekifaananyi kino mu bujjuvu. Naye kye kifaananyi Katonda ky’akuba mu baweereza be.

  • Bayitiddwa Katonda, era bakimanyi.
  • Baweereza, so tebeefuula bakama ku balala.
  • Bali beetoowaze, era bali bamu mu kyama ne mu lwatu.
  • Baagala Katonda okusooka, era baagala abantu ku lulwe.
  • Basaba, era babeera mu Kigambo.
  • Beesigama ku Mwoyo, so si ku maanyi gaabwe.
  • Bamanyi endiga zaabwe, baziliisa, banoonya ezaabula era basiba ezimenyese.
  • Bakulembera wamu n’abalala, era bakuza abakulembeze abaggya.
  • Balaba amawanga n’abaavu n’amaaso ga Kristo.
  • Bakuuma emitima gyabwe eri amalala, omululu, okwegomba okubi, okukozesa obubi obuyinza n’obuggya.
  • Bagumiikiriza ebizibu, era bwe bagwa bayimuka nate.
  • Balabirira amaka gaabwe, emibiri gyabwe n’ebirowoozo byabwe.
  • Babalibwako, era beesigwa mu bintu ebitono.
  • Bamaliriza bulungi, bawaayo omulimu eri abalala, era babeerera olunaku Kristo lw’alirabika.

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yannyonnyola Dawudi mu sentensi emu: “N’abalabirira n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa, n’abakulembera n’amagezi g’emikono gye” (Zabbuli 78:72). Omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa n’amagezi g’emikono. Ekyo kye kitabo kino kyonna mu lunyiriri lumu. Omutima gwe gusooka. Obukugu bukula nga buva mu gwo.

Okuweereza ekigendererwa kya Katonda mu mulembe gwo

Pawulo, bwe yali abuulira mu kkuŋŋaaniro e Antiyokiya, yayogera ekintu ekyangu ku Kabaka Dawudi: “Dawudi bwe yamala okuweereza omulembe gwe nga Katonda bwe yayagala, n’afa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:36).

Dawudi teyaweereza buli mulembe. Yaweereza ogugwe. Naawe waweebwa omulembe gumu, ekifo kimu, n’ekibinja ky’abantu kimu eky’okuweereza. Tosobola kukola buli kintu. Toyitibwanga kukola buli kintu. Oyitibwa okuweereza ekigendererwa kya Katonda mu mulembe gwo, mu kifo w’akuteeka, n’abantu b’akuwadde. Oluvannyuma naawe olifa, n’owaayo omulimu eri abalala.

Ekyo kisaanye kikuteere eddembe. Omulimu gwo si kulokola nsi. Kristo yamala dda okukikola. Omulimu gwo kwe kuba omwesigwa mu ebyo by’atadde mu mikono gyo, leero.

Omusumba ali emabega wa buli musumba

Okusinga byonna, jjukira kino. Ekisuubizo kya Yeremiya ku nkomerero tekyali kutukwatako ffe. Katonda yagamba nti, “Ndibawa abasumba.” Ye mugabi. Ye akola abakulembeze. Era ku nkomerero, yatuukiriza ekisuubizo kye mu ngeri esinga okwewuunyisa. Yajja Ye kennyini. Ezeekyeri yawulira Katonda ng’agamba nti, “Nze kennyini ndinoonya endiga zange ne nzirabirira” (Ezeekyeri 34:11). Yesu yagamba nti, “Nze musumba omulungi. Omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga” (Yokaana 10:11).

Buli musumba omwesigwa mu kitabo kino, okuva ku Musa okutuuka ku Polycarp, okuva ku Gregory okutuuka ku Crowther, okuva ku Brainerd okutuuka ku Bakhita, yali kifaananyi kitono eky’Omusumba Omulungi. Byali bifaananyi ebitatuukiridde, era abamu baalina obunafu bungi. Naye mu buli omu ku bo, waaliwo ekintu kya Kristo ekyalabikanga. Ekyo kye kigendererwa kya buli mukulembeze Omukristaayo: si nti abantu balitulaba ffe, wabula nti nga bayita mu ffe balimulaba Ye.

Kale tokulemberanga mu maanyi go. Kulembera ng’omuntu akulemberwa. Goberera Omusumba, onooyiga okulunda.

Eddoboozi okuva mu Kkanisa: Gregory Omukulu

Eddoboozi erisooka okuva mu byafaayo by’ekkanisa mu kitabo kino, mu Ssuula 2, Ekifuula Obukulembeze Okuba obw’Omwoyo, lyali lya Gregory Omukulu, omulabirizi w’e Rooma eyawandiika The Book of Pastoral Rule (Ekitabo ky’Obulagirizi bw’Abasumba) awo nga mu mwaka 590. Kirabika kituufu okumuleka ayogere ekigambo ekisembayo. Ku nkomerero ddala ey’ekitabo kye, ng’amaze okunnyonnyola mu bugazi obunene omusumba ky’asaanidde okuba, Gregory yakyukira mukwano gwe eyali amusabye okukiwandiika n’agamba nti:

“Laba kaakano, omuntu omulungi, nga, bwe nnawalirizibwa obwetaavu bwe wanteekako olw’okunenya kwo, nga nnyiikirira okulaga omusumba ky’asaanidde okuba, nfuuse ng’omukubi w’ebifaananyi omubi ennyo akuba ekifaananyi ky’omusajja omulungi; era nga bwe ndagirira abalala okutuuka ku lubalama lw’obutuukirivu, nze kennyini nga nkyasuukundibwa mu mayengo g’ebyonoono. Naye mu kumenyeka kw’eryato ly’obulamu buno, nkwegayiridde, nnyweza n’olubaawo lw’okusaba kwo.”

— Gregory Omukulu, The Book of Pastoral Rule, Ekitundu IV

Mu bigambo ebyangu: olaba, mukwano gwange, nti mu kugezaako okulaga omusumba ky’asaanidde okuba, nfaanana ng’omukubi w’ebifaananyi omubi akuba ekifaananyi ky’omusajja omulungi. Ndaga abalala ekkubo erigenda ku lubalama lw’obutuukirivu, sso nga nze kennyini nkyasuukundibwa amayengo g’ebibi byange. Kale mu kumenyeka kw’eryato ly’obulamu buno, nkusaba ompanirire n’okusaba kwo, ng’omuntu abbira mu mazzi bw’awanirirwa olubaawo.

Abo abawandiise ekitabo kino basobola kwogera bumu obwo. Tugezezzaako okukuba ekifaananyi ky’omusumba ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala. Tetwekubye ffe kennyini. Tukyasuukundibwa amayengo. Tusabire, nga naffe bwe tukusabira.

Omukisa

Kale tukuzzaayo eri ekisibo kyo, abo bonna be bali era wonna we bali: ekibiina ky’abasinza, ekkanisa ey’omu maka, ekibiina ky’abaana, amaka, ttiimu ku mulimu, ekyalo, ekibuga. Genda n’omukisa guno:

“Kale, Katonda ow’emirembe eyazuukiza Mukama waffe Yesu, Omusumba w’endiga omukulu ow’endagaano etaggwaawo gye yanyweza n’omusaayi gwe, abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina” (Abaebbulaniya 13:20-21).

Ebibuuzo eby’Okufumiitirizaako

  • Kitundu ki eky’ekitabo kino ekyakwogeddeko ennyo okusinga? Lwaki?
  • Tunuulira ekifaananyi ky’omusumba ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala. Bubonero ki bw’olaba nga bukula mu bulamu bwo? Bwe businga ki bw’olina okusaba Katonda?
  • Soma Zabbuli 78:70-72. Kitegeeza ki okukulembera n’“omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa” era n’“amagezi g’emikono”?
  • Soma Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:36. Kigendererwa ki Katonda ky’alina gy’oli mu mulembe gwo?
  • Gregory yeeyita “omukubi w’ebifaananyi omubi ennyo akuba ekifaananyi ky’omusajja omulungi.” Obwetoowaze bwe bukuzzaamu butya amaanyi?
  • Ani gw’onoosabiranga, era ani gw’onoosaba akusabirenga, ng’ogenda mu maaso n’okukulembera?

Eky’Okukola Wiiki Eno

Ddayo ku kapapula ke wawandiikako ku nkomerero y’Essuula 1, Ennyanjula: Ng’Omutima Gwe Bwe Gwagala, nga kaliko amannya g’abantu b’okulembera. Bw’oba tewakawandiika olwo, kawandiike kaakano. Soma amannya ago mu ddoboozi eriwulikika mu maaso ga Katonda, era omwebaze olwa buli muntu. Oluvannyuma londa essuula emu ey’ekitabo kino gy’osinga okwetaaga okuddamu okusoma, ogiddemu ogisome wiiki eno, ng’oli wamu ne mukwano gwo oba omukulembeze munno bw’oba osobola. Ku nkomerero, saba omuntu omu akusabirenga buli kiseera, nga Gregory bwe yasaba mukwano gwe, era omusuubize nti naawe onoomusabiranga.

study_questions.question: Omusumba ng’omutima gwa Katonda bwe gwagala afaanana atya?
study_questions.answer: Ayitiddwa Katonda, aweereza era mwetoowaze, ayagala Katonda okusooka, musabi era ajjudde Omwoyo, amanyi ekisibo era akiliisa, akulembera wamu n’abalala, afaayo ku mawanga n’abaavu, yeekuuma eri ekibi, agumiikiriza ebizibu era amaliriza bulungi. Dawudi “n’abalabirira n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa, n’abakulembera n’amagezi g’emikono gye” (Zabbuli 78:72).

study_questions.question: Kitegeeza ki okuweereza ekigendererwa kya Katonda mu mulembe gwo?
study_questions.answer: Buli mukulembeze aweebwa omulembe gumu, ekifo kimu n’abantu abamu. “Dawudi bwe yamala okuweereza omulembe gwe nga Katonda bwe yayagala, n’afa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:36). Tuyitibwa okuba abeesigwa mu ebyo Katonda by’atadde mu mikono gyaffe, so si kukola buli kintu.

study_questions.question: Omusumba ali emabega wa buli musumba y’ani?
study_questions.answer: Yesu Kristo. Katonda yasuubiza abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwe bwe gwagala, oluvannyuma n’ajja Ye kennyini: “Nze musumba omulungi. Omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga” (Yokaana 10:11). Buli mukulembeze omwesigwa kifaananyi kitono ekya Ye.

fields.title: Ekyongerezeddwako A: Ekkanisa Bwe Zikulemberwa
fields.body_html:
“Ye gwe mutwe gw’omubiri, n’omubiri ogwo ye Kkanisa.”

— Abakkolosaayi 1:18

Ekkanisa mu nsi yonna zikulemberwa mu ngeri ez’enjawulo. Mu kibuga ekimu, omulabirizi alabirira ebibiina by’abakkiriza bingi era ayawula bakabona baabyo. Mu kibuga ekiddirira, ekkanisa ekulemberwa ekibinja ky’abakadde abasisinkana n’abakadde b’ekkanisa endala mu lukuŋŋaana lw’ekitundu. Ku luguudo olwo lwennyini, ekibiina kikuŋŋaanya ab’omu kkanisa okulonda omusumba waakyo. Mu kibuga ekiri ewala, omukutu gw’ekkanisa ez’omu maka gukulemberwa omutume eyazitandikawo n’abakulembeze b’atendese, ka abe musajja oba mukazi.

Abakristaayo abeesigwa bamaze ebyasa bingi nga tebakkiriziganya ku ngeri ekkanisa gy’efugibwamu. Ekyongerezeddwako kino kinnyonnyola engeri enkulu mu bwenkanya nga bwe tusobola, n’ensonga abazikwatira ze baggya mu Byawandiikibwa ne mu byafaayo, n’amaanyi n’obulabe bwa buli emu. Tekyeroboza ludda. Kigendererwa kyakyo kuyamba bakulembeze okutegeera obulungi ennono yaabwe, okussa ekitiibwa mu balala, n’okunywerera ku ebyo bonna bye bakkiriziganyaako. Essuula 6, Obuyinza wansi w’Obuyinza, Essuula 22, Tewali Mukulembeze wa Bwomu, n’Essuula 26, Abasajja n’Abakazi mu Mulimu gwa Katonda, nazo zikwata ku bibuuzo bino.

Endagaano Empya ky’eraga

Endagaano Empya tewaayo kitabo kimu ekijjuvu eky’amateeka ku ngeri ekkanisa gy’efugibwamu. Naye eraga enkola ezimu ezeeyoleka obulungi.

  • Abakadde. Pawulo ne Balunabba “buli kkanisa baagironderamu abakadde” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 14:23). Pawulo yagamba Tito “otekewo n’abakadde b’ekkanisa mu buli kibuga” (Tito 1:5). Abakadde baabanga basukka mu omu mu buli kkanisa.
  • Abalabirizi. Ekigambo ky’Oluyonaani episkopos kitegeeza “omulabirizi”, era kye kikolo ky’ekigambo ky’Olungereza “bishop”. Pawulo yayita abakadde b’e Efeso bajje gy’ali (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:17) n’oluvannyuma n’abagamba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu yali abateeka “okuba abalabirizi okulabiriranga Ekkanisa ya Katonda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28). Mu Tito 1:5-7 ebigambo ebyo ebibiri nabyo birabika ng’ebyogera ku bantu be bamu. N’olwekyo bangi bakkiriza nti mu Ndagaano Empya, “omukadde” ne “omulabirizi” gaali mannya abiri ag’ekifo kimu. Abalala balowooza nti ebifo ebyo ebibiri byali bitandise dda okwawulwa.
  • Abadyakoni. Pawulo yalamusa ekkanisa ey’e Firipi “awamu n’abalabirizi n’abadiikoni” (Abafiripi 1:1). Abadyakoni baaweerezanga mu byetaago by’ekkanisa eby’omubiri. Bangi balaba abasanvu abaalondebwa mu Bikolwa by’Abatume 6 ng’abadyakoni abaasooka.
  • Abatume n’abayambi baabwe. Abatume nga Pawulo baalina obuyinza ku kkanisa nnyingi. Abayambi baabwe, nga Timoseewo ne Tito, baatumibwanga okutereeza ekkanisa n’okulonda abakulembeze mu kitundu kyonna (Tito 1:5).
  • Enkiiko. Ekibuuzo ekinene bwe kyajjawo ku bakkiriza Abamawanga, “Awo abatume n’abakadde b’Ekkanisa ne bakuŋŋaana bateese ku nsonga eyo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:6). Okusalawo kwabwe ne kukolebwa nga bali wamu “n’abooluganda bonna mu Kkanisa” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 15:22).
  • Ekibiina kyonna. Ekkanisa yonna awamu ye yalonda abasanvu (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 6:3). Yesu yagamba nti ekibi ekitaggwa kisaana kutwalibwa mu Kkanisa: “ensonga ozitwala eri Ekkanisa” (Matayo 18:17). Pawulo yasuubira ekkanisa okukola ekikolwa nga bali “mu linnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu, mukuŋŋaane” (1 Abakkolinso 5:4).
  • Okussaako emikono. Abakulembeze baayawulibwanga nga basabirwa, nga basiiba, era nga bassibwako emikono (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:2-3; 1 Timoseewo 4:14).

Weetegereze nti buli emu ku ngeri enkulu ez’okufuga ekkanisa eziri wansi esobola okusonga ku zimu ku nkola zino. Eyo y’emu ku nsonga lwaki empaka zino zimaze ebbanga eddene bwe lityo.

Enfuga ey’Abalabirizi (Episcopal): ekkanisa ekulemberwa abalabirizi

Kye kiri. Mu kkanisa ez’enfuga ey’abalabirizi (okuva mu episkopos, “omulabirizi”), wabaawo emirundi mingi amadaala asatu ag’obuweereza: abalabirizi, bakabona (oba abapresbuteri) n’abadyakoni. Omulabirizi alabirira ekkanisa ez’ekitundu, ekiyitibwa obulabirizi (diocese). Abalabirizi bokka be bayawula abaweereza abaggya. Ekkanisa ezimu ez’enfuga eno zirina ne bassaabalabirizi oba abapatriaki abali waggulu w’abalabirizi bangi.

Ani agikozesa. Ekkanisa z’Abasodokisi (Orthodox), Ekkanisa Katoliki ey’e Rooma, Ekkanisa za Anglican mu nsi yonna, ekkanisa ez’edda ez’Ebuvanjuba, ekkanisa nnyingi eza Lutheran, n’ezimu ku kkanisa za Methodist. Ekkanisa nnyingi mu Afirika, mu Asiya ne mu Latin America zifugibwa abalabirizi.

Ensonga ezigiwagira. Abagiwagira basonga ku batume ne ku Timoseewo ne Tito ng’abalabirizi b’ekkanisa nnyingi. Basonga ku Kkanisa ey’edda ennyo. Ignatius ow’e Antiyokiya, eyawandiika awo nga mu AD 110, yagamba nti: “Omulabirizi wonna w’alabikiranga, abantu nabo babeerenga awo.” Ekyasa eky’okubiri we kyaggweerako, abalabirizi baali basangibwa mu kkanisa mu nsi yonna eyali efugibwa Rooma.
